{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫命岂易言哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233791022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其旨深，其義奥，其理直，上通夫乾元无极之微。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233807406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以圣人惟恐人之钩玄索隐而罕言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233823790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命岂易言哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233840174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然夫子又曰：不知命，無以爲君子者，何居？","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233856558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢富貴利達，命也，困窮","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233872942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097191842938907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死喪亦命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233872942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟其不知，一若世之可欣可羡者，竟可僥倖而得，孰肯居易以俟之？","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233889326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世之可驚可愕者，皆可規避而免，孰肯順受其正耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233905710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不幾宇宙之大，林總之繁，相率爲行險者流，而綱常名敎，日用當然之道，不且絶滅於","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233922094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097227213586483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今古哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233922094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吾知命雖聖人所罕言，而爲君子者又不可不知也。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233938478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予幼隨先君子宦遊兩浙，與二三博洽士剖晰玄微，畧知毛髪。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233954862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後予守郡齊安，聞津門有三命通会一書最善。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233971246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時宮保田公巡視長蘆，遂寓书購之，不可得。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461233987630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234004014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097191842955291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予來司轉運，旁捜徧訪，知雕板尚藏滄州李氏家，顧已殘失百十篇。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234004014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惜哉古錢掘得，輪廓槎牙，斷碣捫來，觚稜缺齾，今昔同嗟，良有以夫！","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234020398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遂求其遺帙校正，付剞劂補全之，而爲之叙日：古來之爲子臣弟友者，徃徃有事君","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234036782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097259006377999"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而天澤之義不講，事親而明發之懷不生，以及昆弟朋友之間，彼責此尤，爾虞我詐，求如棠棣之章、伐木之什者甚難，亦獨何歟？","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234036782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今而知，總由於不知命之故。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234053166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天之隨人賦予，原自有限量，而不容非分要求，滿腔怨懟者。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234069550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097227213570099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今觀是書所載，悉以日時爲主，附麗年月。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234085934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孰者富貴利達造其極，孰者困窮死喪終其身，千變萬態，不爽秋毫。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234102318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"援往徵來，瞭如指掌。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234118702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其於陰陽逓嬗。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234135086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行生尅之道，言之詳而且宻，苟世之學士大夫深求而黙體之，雖不能","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234151470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097191842922523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直窮夫乾元無極之微，而事之可欣可羡、可驚可愕者，一存乎吾命之固然，俱無庸絲毫趨避於其際。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234151470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吾知節性防滛，懲忿窒慾之中，自實踐夫日用綱常之道，居易以俟，順受其正，以漸臻君子之域不難矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577342461234167854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又何必以旨","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611793458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097227213602867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深義奥而諱言命哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611793458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予言未竟，有戸外之士揖而進，日：如子所言，是三命通㑹一書，不僅爲術士衣鉢，直可以正人心而維風俗歟？","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611809842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予笑而不言，遂舉其說以弁諸簡端，并以告世之觀是書者。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611826226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097217402994728"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雍正乙卯花朝，長蘆都轉鹽運使司運使、管鹽法道事，蘿村蔣國祥撰","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611842610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097259006427151"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097259006443535"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"序。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611858994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天以隂陽五行化生萬物，人得之爲徤順五常之德，故中庸首言天命，誠重之也。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611875378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世儒因術士竊其剰義，鑿爲休咎之言，以愚人耳目，遂以二氣五行概屏爲数而不之察，此真寡聞鮮","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611891762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097217403043880"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見者流，未尝與於羲、文之大道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611891762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖自有天地以來，而隂陽之理已具，故地皇定三辰，伏羲𦘕八卦，黄帝作甲子，以開萬世矇聵，而周文、孔子復大闡竒奧，洩天地不盡之藴，於是日月星辰、山川草木，咸禀受於二氣以行，","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611908146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097240933171263"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而人之清濁窮通，遂定於有生之初而不能遁。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611908146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人以爲此数也，而不知皆理也。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611924530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠹉觀納音之例，隔八相生，五音六屬，潜符大衍，是命之理通於律。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611940914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過宫躔次，氣候淺深，七政四餘，迭爲喜忌，是命之理通於曆。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611957298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年根月比，生子","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611973682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097259006541839"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅妻，圓缺妍婢，合下已定，是命之理通於倫。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611973682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生尅制化，錯行四時，印綬財官，配合雷雨，是命之理通於天山國。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503611990066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澤國淳秀不同，南條北條，夀夭亦異，是命之理通於地，誰謂二氣五行僅屬之数，而不謀於理也哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612006450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六經唯易","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612022834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097259006492687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲尊，而命理皆自大易衍出，故甲爲乾之始，壬爲乾之終，乙爲坤之始，癸爲坤之終。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612022834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亁主甲，甲對庚，故震主庚子午屬之；坤主乙，乙對辛，故巽主辛丑未屬之。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612039218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎爲中男，故主中干；戊寅申屬之，離爲中女，亦主中干。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612055602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯酉","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612071986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097259006459919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屬之。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612071986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾主壬，壬對丙，故艮主丙辰戌屬之；坤主癸，癸對丁，故兌主丁巳亥屬之。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612088370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是十干十二支，根極八卦，毫髪不𤕤，雖其間千變萬化，莫可窮究，而總不外於大易爻彖之理。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612104754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行或可言数，而八卦亦可言数乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612121138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦既","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612137522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097240933154879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可言数，而八卦中之二氣五行，猶得僅以数言乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612137522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愚賦性慵踈，一生碌碌，無所短長。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612153906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"每讀書至天時地利篇，朱子有時日支干、孤虛王相之說，亦心艷而不得其觧。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612170290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇星家談命者，姑聼而由繹之。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612186674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其言多浮誕不切，絕無","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612203058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097227213635635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"涉於河馬洛龜之精義。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612203058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖彼目中原未睹有竒書，亦何恠其剽掠而塗說也。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612219442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申冬月，郡伯镐翁公祖以前進士育吾萬公所著三命通㑹惠閱。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612235826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愚盥手披讀，純是太極之理。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612252210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又探輯諸家，窮神盡變，無微不悉。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612268594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二氣五行，","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612284978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097230526988329"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至此觀止矣，更有何術能出其範圍哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612284978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此書者，從何處得來？","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612301362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：嘻！","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612317746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余亦曷能有此縁？","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612334130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃先大夫以数千余購於之啇之手，乆欲公諸世而未逮。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612350514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余不敢辜先人志，謀付到劂，丐兄文以弁諸首，以爲是書光。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612366898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愚謝不敏，","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612383282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097230527004713"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至再而不能辭，爰憑臆而強爲之說。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612383282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知俚而膚，不足以表章萬一，竊幸微名，附於此書之未，俾群知老生亦頗妄談也云爾。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612399666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平干王謙撝齋氏書。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612416050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097230527021097"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫洛馬出書之初，有一","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612432434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白點六，黒㸃在背，近尾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七白點，","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612432434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二黑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㸃在背，近洛書之圖","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612432434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頭三，白點八，黑㸃在背。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之左，九白㸃，四黒點","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612432434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"在。背之右五白點，十黑點。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在背之中，大撓","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612432434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"定之一六在下，合於北，生水亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子屬焉，","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612432434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二七在上，合於南生火，巳午屬焉。三八。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在左合","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612432434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"於東生木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、卯","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612432434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"屬焉。四九在右，合於西生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金、申酉屬","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612432434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"焉五。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十，在","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612432434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中合於中，生土辰戌丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未屬焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612432434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四維也，斯地之氣重濁焉，","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612448818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097227213701171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右肩右脇、右足。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612448818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫河龍負圖者，非龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612465202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃大龜也，其背上所有之紋一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長書","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612481586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二短","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畫白黙近尾，九紫點近頸，","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612481586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四碧㸃在肩之左，二黒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㸃在肩，","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612481586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之右六白點近。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612481586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"足之右入，白點近足之左三，緑㸃在脇之左。七。尾。赤㸃在脇之右五，黄點在背之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中几九所","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612481586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而七。色焉。羲皇以九位而定方，以二長畫二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短畫","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612481586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而生爻，以三才而設位。易","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道，凣是而生矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612481586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左肩、左脇、左足。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612497970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097191842988059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余按易言河出圖，洛出書，聖人則之，未嘗明言圖書之數，如漢儒所指，觀伏羲定方畫，掛大禹第疇首五行，則術家之說是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612514354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况洛書之數，術家以爲大撓定之，與吾儒之說逈别。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612530738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宋程、朱以一六居北爲河圖，戴九履一爲洛書，亦因漢儒之舊云爾。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612547122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚川王子以伏羲作易，造端於陰陽二畫而已，故曰易有太極，是生兩儀，兩儀生四象，四象生八卦，先後自然之序，有非人力強爲排比。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612563506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今目因河圖之數以作易，是不從太極以爲易，豈不於仲尼易有太極之論戾乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612579890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易繫河出圖，洛出書，聖人則之，意以八卦之畫出於天地所","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612596274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097227213717555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元官然之文，其實聖人神道設敎之意也。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612596274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漢儒不逹手比，乃以伏羲畫卦爲本於河圖之文，大禹衍疇爲用於浴書之文，則誣矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612612658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易口天一地一，天三地四，天五地六，天七地八，天九地十。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612629042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以天陽也，故數三五七九；地陰也，故數二四六八十。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612645426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此専論揲蓍之義，故先言天地奇耦之數五十有五。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612661810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人立揲，用大衍之五十，以見法象於天地奇耦之數，與下象四時𧰼、三才等象，同一義也，於河圖之數何相渉乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612678194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况天一地二之辭，爲作易後立揲而言，非作易之始事，而何以取圖爲哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612694578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又疑聖人則圖、書皆言畫卦，非禹則之","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612710962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097335707500584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明疇也。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612710962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀洪範九疇，乃治天下之大經大法，如周官九式、九兩之義，非數也。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612727346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"箕子首言天錫，不過水土平而五行之政可修，五行之政修而治天下之庻政可舉，故於地平天成之時，天乃錫禹大法曰天者，是天予以治天下，叙彛倫，此九者不可缺一云爾。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612743730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀疇次第，首五行，次五事，次八政，本天而推之於人；次五紀，次三德，次稽疑，以人而合乎天，次庻徵，次五福、六極，則人感天應，而皇極乃其主也，故居中焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612760114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其先後次第，輕重緩急，自當如此。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612776498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"想大禹筆之書以傳後世，而箕子獨傳之也。","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612792882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畫卦、稽疑，乃疇中之一事，惡可以洛","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612809266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097240933220415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書之數當之哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612809266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海沂子曰：聖人觀河圖，悟乾坤之象而生卦；觀洛書，悟天地之數而衍蓍，豈知言哉！","logicSentenceId":"7577342503612825650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老子日：無名，天地之始；有名萬物之毋。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725411859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有物混成，先天地生。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725428243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"列圉冦日：有形生於無形。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725444627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之初，有太易，有太初，有太始，有太素。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725461011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太易者，未見氣；太初者，氣之始，太始者，形之始；太素者，質之始。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725477395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣與形質合而未離，曰渾淪。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725493779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曆紀云：未有天地之時，混沖如鷄子，溟滓始芽，鴻濛滋萌。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725510163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"律曆志云：太極元氣，凾三爲一。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725526547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易日：易有太極，是生兩儀，兩儀生四象，四象生八卦，八卦定吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725542931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易疏云：太極謂天地未分之前，元氣混而爲合用之","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725559315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097240933285951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725559315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蒙泉子曰：太初者，理之始也；太虚者，氣之始也；太素者，象之始也；太乙者，數之始也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725575699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極者，兼理、氣、象、數之始也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725592083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由數論言之，可見渾淪未判之先，只一氣混合，杳㝠昏昧，而理未嘗不在其中，與道爲一，是謂太極。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725608467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莊子以道在太極之先，所謂太極，乃是指天、地、人三者氣形已具而未判者之名，而道又别是一懸空底物，在太極之先。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725624851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知道卽太極，太極卽道，以其理之通行者言，則曰道，以其理之極至者言，則曰太極，又何嘗有二邪？","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725641235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向非周子啓其祕，朱子闡而明之，孰知太極之爲理，而與氣自不相離也哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725657619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂太極","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725674003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097191843119131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，乃隂陽動静之本體，不離於形氣而實無聲臭，不窮於變化，而實有凖則。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725674003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故一動一静，互爲其根，分隂分陽，兩儀立焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725690387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"儀者，物也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725706771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢物未始無對，而亦未嘗獨立。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725723155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天以生覆而依乎地，地以形載而附乎天。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725739539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有理斯有氣，隂陽之謂也；有氣斯有形，天地之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725755923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地不生於天地，而生於隂陽，隂陽不生於隂陽，而生於動静。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725772307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動静不生於動静，而生於太極。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725788691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢太極者，本然之玅也；動静者，所乗之機也；隂陽者，所生之本也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725805075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極，形而上，道也；隂陽，形而下，噐也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725821459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動静無端，隂陽無始，此造化所由立焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725837843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097230527217705"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"栢齊何子曰：天，陽之動者也，果何時動極而静子？地，隂之静者也，果何時静極而動乎？天不能生地。水不能生火，無智愚皆知之，乃謂隂陽相生，不亦誤乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894764720169/1-9079cb523e483d64.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=4ivo2xIhHYXHlZWlWA%2ByCWqXA%2Bw%3D","uri":"read/HY0852/33/ref/1koeun02ul7oy/1-9079cb523e483d64.webp","fontType":1,"components":"共血","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690894764720169"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天地水火，雖渾然不可離，實燦然不可亂。故隂之與陽，謂之相依則可，謂之相生則不可，謂之互藏其宅則可，謂之互藏相生則不可。此言的。有見也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天地未立，道本天地。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725854227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地旣立，則太極之理，散在萬事，由是而五行生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725870611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行一隂陽，五殊二實無餘欠也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725886995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽一太極，精粗本末，無彼此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725903379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行質具於地，而氣形於天，以質而語，其生之序，則水、火、木、金、土，而水木陽也，火金隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725919763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又綂而言之，則氣陽而質隂也；又錯而言之，則動陽而静隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725936147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894764720169/1-9079cb523e483d64.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=4ivo2xIhHYXHlZWlWA%2ByCWqXA%2Bw%3D","uri":"read/HY0852/33/ref/1koeun02ul7oy/1-9079cb523e483d64.webp","fontType":1,"components":"共血","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690894764720169"},"logicSentenceId":"7577378716725952531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之變，至不","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725952531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097316656939019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可窮，然無適而非太極之本然也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725952531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"栢齊何子曰：五行一陰陽，隂陽一太極。周子固謂隂太極不外乎隂陽，陽不外乎五行矣。自今論之。水，水也，火火也，金木水火，土之交變也。土，地也。天安在乎？有地而無天，謂造化全可乎？若以謂天，卽太極，故朱子以上天之載釋太極，天道流行釋隂陽。觀易曰：易有太極，是生兩儀。兩儀生四象，四象。生八卦，八卦之中，有乾有坤，則天地皆太極之分體明矣。以天爲太極之全體，而地爲天之分體，豈不誤甚也哉！其說似有理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行之生，各一其性，四時之行，亦有其序，春以生之，夏以長之，秋以肅之，冬以藏之。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725968915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春而夏，夏而秋，秋而冬，冬而復春，而相循無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716725985299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢五行異質，四時異氣，而皆不外乎隂陽；隂陽異位，動靜異時，而皆不離乎","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726001683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097191843053595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726001683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於所以爲太極者，又無聲臭之可言，是性之本體然也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726018067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故五行各一其性，所謂各具一太極也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726034451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四時自有其序，所謂運用一太極也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726050835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行四時，週而復始，所謂綂體一太極也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726067219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而性之無所不在，又可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726083603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天下無性外之物，而性無不在，此無極、二五所以混融而無間，所謂玅合者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726099987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無極是理，二五是氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726116371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞以理言，太極無妄之謂也；精以氣言，隂陽五行，不二之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726132755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凝者，聚也，氣聚而成形也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726149139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢性爲之主，而隂陽五行爲之經緯錯綜，又各以類凝聚而成形焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726165523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽而健者成男，則父之道也；隂而順者成女，則母之道。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726181907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097303969185804"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，是人物之始，以氣化而生者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726198291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣聚成形，則形交氣感，遂以形化，而萬物生生變化無窮矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726214675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鮑魯齋司：大地以氣交而生人物，觀其所交，則氣之所至，可以知其類之所從出矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726231059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天氣交乎地，於人爲男，於物爲牡；地氣交乎天，於人爲女，於物爲牝，男女牝牡，又自交而生生化化不窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726247443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人物旣生，氣隨天地之氣升降交感。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726263827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人得天地之中氣，四方之氣無不感；物得天地之徧氣，而亦各隨所感。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726280211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故觀天地之氣交，可以知人物之初生矣；觀天地之氣感，可以知人物之相生矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726296595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子曰：乾道成男，坤道成女，凝體於造化之初，二氣","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726312979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097217403109416"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交感，化生萬物，流行於造化之後，此理之常也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726312979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若姜嫄、簡狄之生稷、契，則又不可以先後言矣，此理之變也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726329363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"張九韶曰：論人物始生於天地肇判之初，則由氣化而後有形化，張子所謂天地之氣生之是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726345747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論人物始生於結胎受形之初，則由精氣之聚而後有是物，朱子所謂隂精陽氣聚而成物是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726362131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由是言之，則人也、物也，氣也、形也，孰有出於隂陽之外哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726378515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫命禀於陰陽，有生之初，非人所能移，莫之爲而爲，非我所能必。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726394899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於是有生而富、生而貴者，有生而壽、生而夭者，有生而貧、生而賤者，有生而富貴雙夫巍巍人上者，","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726411283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097303969251340"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有生而貧賤兼，有落落人下者，有生而宜壽而反夭閼，有生而宜夭而反長年之數者，謂由於所積而然與？","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726411283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦由於所性而然與？","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726427667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂由於所積，則貧可以致富，賤可以致貴，夭可以致壽，古之所謂人能勝天者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726444051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂由於所性，以得乎富貴者終於富貴，貧賤者終於貧賤，壽夭者終於壽夭，古之所謂命不可移也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726460435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫謂之積，則不可專以爲命，夫謂之性，則不可專以爲人，將以付之於所積與？","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726476819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未知命之所禀，富貴壽夭、貧賤何如也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726493203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將以付之於所性與？","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726509587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未有富貴壽夭、貧賤可坐待者，而人爲似不可缺也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726525971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：命稟有生之初，誠","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726542355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097304141234214"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"哉是言也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726542355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何人生天地之中，有五行八字相同，而富貴、貧賤、壽夭之不一，其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726558739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：隂陽二氣交感之時，受眞精玅合之氣，凝結爲胎，成男成女，得天地父母一時氣候，是以禀其清者爲智爲贒，禀其濁者爲愚爲不肖。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726575123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"智者贒者，由是或富或貴或壽，必有所得，所謂德足以獲福也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726591507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愚者、不肖者不能自奮，日益昏蔽，則貧賤與夭有不能免，所謂下愚不移是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726607891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其富貴兩全者，原禀清輕之氣，生逢得令之時，兼以財官亨通，祿馬旺相，其運與限，甚吉甚祥，縱有少晦，不係駁雜。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726624275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其貧賤兼有者，原稟重濁之氣，生逢失令之","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726640659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097191843135515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，刑衝駁雜，無些順羙，雖無禍患侵擾，未免蹇滯不前。","logicSentenceId":"7577378716726640659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有富而貧，貧而富，貴而賤、賤而貴，壽而天，夭而壽者。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091804848171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有爲贒爲智而反貧賤，爲愚不肖而反富貴者。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091804864555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地間之人，萬有不齊，此亦四時五行徧正得失向背淺深之氣之所致也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091804880939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故當時元氣雖禀輕清，然而生於衰敗之時，行休囚之運，富者損失財源，貴者剝官退位，壽者夭閼不祿。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091804897323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其元氣雖禀重濁，其人生中和之令，行旺相之運，貧不終貧而爲富，賤不終賤而爲貴，夭不終夭而爲壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091804913707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然修爲在人，人定勝天。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091804930091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命禀中和，性加積善，豈但一身享福已哉，而子子孫","logicSentenceId":"7577379091804946475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097335707566120"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫榮昌利逹，理宜然也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091804946475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命値徧枯，性加積惡，非惟自身值禍已也，而子子孫孫落落人下，得非報與？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091804962859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由前言之，雖係于命，亦在於人之積與不積耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091804979243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：積善之家必有餘慶，積不善之家，必有餘殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091804995627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殆此之謂歟！","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805012011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耕野子日：天一氣爾，氣化生水，水中滓濁，積而成土，水落士出，遂成山川。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805028395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土之剛者成石，而金生焉；土之柔者生木，而火生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805044779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行具，萬物生，而變化無窮矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805061163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚川子曰：天地之初，惟有隂陽二氣而巳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805077547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽則化火，隂則化水，水之渣滓，便結成地，潘滓成地，卽土也，何至天五方言生土？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805093931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水、火土，天地之大化。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805110315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木者，三物","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805126699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097303969284108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之所自出。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805126699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金石之質，必積久而後結，生之必同於人物。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805143083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂金之氣生人，得乎哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805159467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且天地之間，無非元氣之所爲，其性其種，己各具。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805175851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太始之先，金有金之種，木有木之種，人有人之種，物有物之種，各各完具，不相假借，不相凌犯，而謂五行逓互相生，可乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805192235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今五行家以金生水，厥類懸絶不侔，厥理顚倒失次。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805208619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知木以火爲氣，以水爲滋，以土爲宅，此天然至道。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805225003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而曰水生木無土，將附木於何所？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805241387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水多火滅土絶，木且死矣，夫安能生？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805257771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"周子惑於五行家之說，而謂五氣順布，四時行焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805274155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知日有進退，乃成寒暑，寒暑分平，乃成四時，於","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805290539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097328266772530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五氣之布何與焉？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805290539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其日春木夏火，秋金冬水，皆假合之論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805306923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土無所歸，配於四季。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805323307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知土之氣在天地内，何口不然，何處不有，何止流行於季月之晦？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805339691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"季月之晦尚有，而孟月之朔卽滅，其滅也歸於何所，其來也孰？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805356075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲命之天一生水，乃緯書之辭，而儒者拔以入經。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805372459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火者，隂陽始生之玅物也，故一化而爲火，日是也；再化而爲水，雨露是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805388843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今日天一生水，地二生火，戾於造化本然之玅，可乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805405227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其折朱子以四時流行之氣論五行，天地竒偶之數論五行。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805421611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極圖陽變隂合而生水、火、木、金、土論五行。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805437995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其折五行配四時，如五行家四","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805454379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097303969300492"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時各主其一，舂止爲木，則水火土金之氣孰絶滅之？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805454379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋止爲金，則水火土木之氣孰留停之？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805470763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土惟旺於四季，則餘月之氣，孰把而不使之運？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805487147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又安有今日爲木，明日爲火，又明日爲土、爲金、爲水乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805503531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"按王氏之說有理，而非逹觀之見。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805519915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞錄子日以爲有也，是從無而立有；以爲無也，关𡸁象以示文。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805536299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天凭日月五星三垣二十八宿之象，觀天王會通，其立名分野，是亦人爲之耳，而義象符合。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805552683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至災祥占上，或屬類某事，或指見某方，應於某年月日，如探左契。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805569067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖天道玄遠，亦不外人事與五行。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805585451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽家以十干十二支分爲五行，因目悽甬會，橹","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805601835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097335707549736"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與天會而爲歲，月與曰㑹而爲月。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805601835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日有三十，時有十二，以人生年月日時所得干攴，立爲四柱，以推一生吉匈，亦理之自然者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805618219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王氏以春屬木，而土何在？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805634603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知五行旺相、死休囚，各主其當時不當時，用事不用事而言，非爲春木旺而土則無。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805650987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干十二支，錯綜爲六十甲子，週而復始，不假安排，卽造化之所在也，非爲今日屬木，明口屬火，便非天道之自然。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805667371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不思人立而天從之，人感而天應之，卽天象立名分野之義天。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805683755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人合一之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805700139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀一日有早午晏晚，自有溫凉寒熱氣候，是金木水火土備於一口，五行之不相離如此，","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805716523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097303969316876"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂今日木，明日火，又何莫而非天道之自然也耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805716523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且朝廷造曆，頒之天下，其載一年三百六十五日，中間一年之神煞方位，毎月之天行德旺，而一日之中，文有黒黃吉凶事之宜與不宜人，遵之則福，違之則禍，是果無理强造，而率天下以必從哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805732907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又相人術，觀氣色之靑黄赤白黒，而决禍福，應於某年月日時，青則甲乙，黃則戊巳，赤則丙丁，白則庚辛，黑則壬癸，一亳不爽，察病亦然，觀素問可見。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805749291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是干支雖所以紀目，而造化不外是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805765675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又人之精神夢寐，預兆吉㐫，占之者或以意斷，或以物象，或以字觧，或以音叶，皆人爲之二，正肎曽𡚶之乙","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805782059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097191843151899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，而吉㐫不能外焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805782059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是有是人而後有是夢，因是夢而求是人，造化且不外，而况干支五行，自有天地，便有此理，因有此理，便生是人。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805798443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人與天一也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805814827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外人以言天，外天以言人，皆誣矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805831211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若伏羲畫卦，仰觀俯察，遠稽近取，是得天地人物之理，而八卦所由作也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805847595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之談隂陽者，雖窮極天地之變，探索人物之微，彰徃察來，因著知微，與天地合其德，與日月合其明，與四時合其序，與鬼神合其吉㐫，亦豈能外干支五行，而别有造化，以盡天地人物之大哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805863979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今王氏知尊易而不信隂陽家說，是知有理而不知有數也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805880363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理數合一，天人","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805896747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097217403158568"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一理，神而明之，存乎其人焉耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805896747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論五行生成：天高廖廓，六氣囘旋，以成四時；地厚幽深，五行化生。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805913131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以成萬物，可謂無窮而莫測者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805929515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人立法以推歩者，葢不能逃其數。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805945899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀其立數之因，亦皆出乎自然，故載於經典，同而不異。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805962283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推以逹其機，窮以通其變，皆不離於數内。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805978667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一日水，二曰火，三曰木，四曰金，五曰土者，咸有所自也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091805995051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，北方子之位也，子者，陽之初，一，陽數也，故水曰一。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806011435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火，南方午之位也，午者，隂之初，𣈆，隂數也，故火曰二。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806027819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木居東方，東，陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806044203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三者，竒之數，亦陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806060587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二泬未，","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806076971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097328266788914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故木日二。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806076971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金居西方，西，隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806093355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四者，偶之數，亦隂也，故金日四。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806109739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土應西南長夏，五者，竒之數，亦陽也，故土曰五。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806126123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由是論之，則數以隂陽而配者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806142507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若攷其深義，則水生於一，天地未分，萬物未成之初，莫不先見於水，故靈樞經曰：太一者，水之尊號，先天地之母，後萬物之源。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806158891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以今驗之，草木子實未就，人蟲胎卵、胎胚皆水也，豈不以爲一？","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806175275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及其水之聚而形質化，莫不備隂陽之氣，在中而後成。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806191659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故物之小而味苦者，火之兆也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806208043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物熟則廿，土之味也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806224427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甘極而反淡，淡，本也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806240811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然人禀父母隂男生成之化，故先生二腎。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806257195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左腎屬水，右腎屬火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806273579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806289963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097304141266982"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰命門，則火之因水而後見，故火日次二。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806289963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖草木子實，大小雖異，其中皆有兩以相合者，與人腎同，亦隂陽之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806306347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以萬物非隂陽合體，則不能化生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806322731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"既隂陽合體，然後而春生而秋成，故次三曰木，次四曰金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806339115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢水有所屬，火有所藏，木有所發，金有所别，莫不皆因土而後成也，故次五曰土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806355499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木居於東，金居於酉，火居於南，水居於北，土居於中央，而寄位四維，應令四季，在人四支，故金、木水、火皆待土而後成。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806371883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼其土數五以成之，則水六、火七、木八、金九土，常以五之生數不可至十者。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806388267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土不待十以成，是生成之數皆五以合甬膾卷之","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806404651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097217403191336"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之明，大衍之數由是以立，則萬物豈能逃其數哉！","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806404651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三隂三陽，正化者從本生數，對化者從標成數。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806421035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五運之紀，則太過者其數成，不及者其數生，各取其數之生成多少，以占政令。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806437419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣化者復著之述作，葢明諸用也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806453803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"周子日：五行之序，以質之所生而言，則水本是陽之濕氣，以其初動，爲隂所陷而不得遂，故水隂勝。","logicSentenceId":"7577379091806470187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火本是隂之燥氣，以其初動，爲陽所檢而不得達，故火陽勝。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162650837011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢生之者微，成之者盛，生之者，形之始，成之者，形之終也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162650853395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然各以偏勝言也，故雖有形而未成質，以氣升降，王不得而制焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162650869779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木則陽之濕氣侵，多以感於隂","logicSentenceId":"7577379162650886163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097303969333260"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而舒，故發而爲木，其質柔，其性暖；金則隂之燥氣侵，多以感於陽而縮，故結而爲金，其質剛，其性寒。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162650886163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土則隂陽之氣各盛，相交相摶，凝而成質。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162650902547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以氣之行而言，則一隂一陽，徃來相代，木、火、金、水、土者，各就其中而分老少耳，故其序各由少而老。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162650918931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土則分旺四季，而位居中者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162650935315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此五者若參差，而造化所以爲發育之具，實並行而不相悖。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162650951699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢質則隂陽交錯，凝合而成，氣則隂陽兩端，循環不已。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162650968083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"質日水、火、木、金，葢以隂陽相間言，猶日東西南北，所謂對待者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162650984467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣曰木火、金、水，葢以隂陽相因言，猶日東南西北，所謂流行者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651000851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"質雖而雨衣之，","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651017235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097316657004555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一定而不易，氣則變化而無窮，所謂易也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651017235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程子曰：動。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651033619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜，隂陽之本也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651050003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之運，則參差不齊矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651066387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"張子日：木曰曲直，能既曲而反伸也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651082771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金日從革，一從革而不能自反也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651099155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火氣也，故炎上潤下，與隂陽升隆，土不得而制焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651115539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木、金者，壬之華實也，其性有水火之雜，故木之爲物，水漬則生火，然而不雜也，葢得土之浮華於水火之交也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651131923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金之爲物，得火之精於火之躁，得水之精於水之濡，故水火相待而不相害，鑠之反流而不耗，葢得土之精實於水火之際也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651148307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土者，物之所以成始而成終也，地之質也，化之終也，水火之所以升降，","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651164691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097217403224104"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物兼體而不遺者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651164691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：陽㬐於隂爲水，隂附於陽爲火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651181075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子曰：五行之序，木爲之始，水爲之終，而土爲之中。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651197459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以河圖、洛書之數言之，則水一木三而土五，皆陽之生數而不可易者也，故得以更迭爲主，而爲五行之綱。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651213843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以德言之，則木爲發生之性，水爲貞靜之體，而士又包育之毋。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651230227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故水之包五行也，以其流通貫徹而無不在也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651246611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木之包五行，以其歸根反本而藏於此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651262995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫土，則水火之所寄，金木之所資，居中而奠四方，二體而載萬類者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651279379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日：水火清，金木濁，土又濁。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651295763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邵子曰：金火相守則流，木火相得則然，從其類也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651312147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651328531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097335707631656"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇寒則結，遇火則渴，從其所勝也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651328531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論五行生尅，五行相生相尅，其理昭然。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651344915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干十二支，五運六氣，嵗月日時，皆自此立，更相爲用，在天則爲氣，寒暑燥濕、風，在地則成形，金木水火土，形氣相感，而化生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651361299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此造化生成之大紀也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651377683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原其玅用，可謂無窮矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651394067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木主於東，應春。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651410451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木之爲言，觸也，陽氣觸動，冐地而生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651426835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水流趨東，以生木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651443219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木上發而覆下，乃自然之質也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651459603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火主於南，應夏，火之爲言化也，燬也，陽在上，隂在下，燬然盛而變化萬物也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651475987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鑚木取火，木所生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651492371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然火","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651508755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097328266919986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無正體，體本木焉，出以應物，盡而復入，乃自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651508755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金主於西，應秋，金之爲言禁也，隂氣始禁止萬物而揫歛。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651525139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"披沙揀金，土所生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651541523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於土而别於土，乃自然之形也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651557907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水主於北，應冬，水之爲言潤也，隂氣濡潤，任養萬物也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651574291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水西而東，金所生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651590675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水流曲折，順下而逹，乃自然之性也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651607059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土主於中央，兼位西南，應於長夏。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651623443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土之爲言吐也，含吐萬物，將生者出，將死者歸，爲萬物家，故長於夏末，火所生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651639827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土或勝水，水乃反土，自然之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651656211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行相尅，子皆能爲母復讎也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651672595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木尅土，土之子，金反尅木；金尅木，木之子，火反尅金；火","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651688979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097316657020939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅金，金之子，水反尅火；水尅火，火之子，土反尅水；土尅水，水之子，木反尅土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651688979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"互能相生，乃其始也；互能相尅，乃其終也，皆出乎天之性也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651705363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"素問所謂水生木，木復生火，是木受竊氣，故水怒而尅火，卽子逢竊氣，母乃力爭，與母被鬼傷，子來力救，其義一也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651721747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"強可攻弱，土得木而逹，實可勝虚，水得土而絶，隂可消陽，火得水而滅，烈可","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651738131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690885151096895/1-fcf90ee2befff516.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=rAUHd02mW8Hwg4czL4P%2Fgs85UkQ%3D","uri":"read/HY0785/1/ref/1kodyq71ljm6r/1-fcf90ee2befff516.webp","fontType":1,"components":"亠丷冖古攵","variants":"敵","charPicId":"7456690885151096895"},"logicSentenceId":"7577379162651738131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛；金得火而缺，堅可制柔，木得金而伐，故五者流行而更轉，順則相生，逆則相尅，如是則各各爲用，以成其道而己。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651738131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論支干源流","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651754515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097335707648040"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫干猶木之幹，強而爲陽；支猶木之枝，弱而爲隂。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651754515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔盤古氏明天地之道，逹隂陽之變，爲三才首君，以天地旣分之後，先有天而後有地，由是氣化而人生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651770899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故天皇氏一姓十三人，繼盤古氏以治，是曰天靈，澹泊無爲，而俗自化，始制干支之名，以定嵗之所在。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651787283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其十干曰閼逢、𣃼蒙、柔兆、疆圉、著雍、屠維、上章、重光、玄黙、昭陽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651803667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二支曰困敦、赤奮若、攝提格、單閼、執徐、大荒落、敦牂、恊洽、涒灘、作噩、閹茂大淵獻。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651820051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡邕獨斷曰：于幹也，其名有十，亦曰十母，卽今甲、乙、丙丁、戊巳、庚辛、壬癸是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651836435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支，枝也，其名一有二，亦曰十二子，卽今","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651852819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097217403240488"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子、丑、寅、卯、辰、巳、午、未、申、酉、戌、亥是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651852819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之天皇氏者，取其天開於子之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651869203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之地皇氏者，取其地闢於丑之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651885587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之人皇氏者，取其人生於寅之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651901971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故干支之名，在天皇時始制。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651918355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而地皇氏則爰定三辰，道分書夜，以三十日爲一月，而干支始各有所配。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651934739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人皇氏者，王不虚土，臣不虚貴，政教君臣所自起，飮食男女所自始，始得天地隂陽之氣，而有子母之分，於是干攴始各有所屬焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651951123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於伏羲，仰觀象於天，俯觀法於地，中觀萬物與人，始畫八卦，以通神明之德，以類萬物之情，以作甲歷，而文字生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651967507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逮及黃帝授河圖，","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651983891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097451940118537"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見日月星辰之象，於是始有星官之書。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162651983891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命大撓探五行之情，占斗綱所建，於是始作甲子，配五行納音之屬。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652000275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路史云：伏羲命潜龍氏筮之，乃迎日推策，相剛建造甲子，以命𡻕時。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652016659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"配天爲幹，配地爲枝，枝幹配類，以綱維乎四象，故情僞相感，而星辰以順則。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652033043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至黃帝命大撓探五行之情，考天書三式，以十干十二支衍而成六十𭸸納音，聲而定之爲納音，卽甲子、乙丑、海中金之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652049427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風后釋之，以致其用，而三命行矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652065811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼術家以皇帝定天干十字屬河之圖，地支十二，屬洛之書，以鬼谷子筭成納音，束方朔觧納音象，皆不得其","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652082195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097316657037323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源而妄云也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652082195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
