{"lines":[{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚川王氏曰：昔大撓作甲子，名數無有窮己，便於紀時，偶爾定之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652098579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若推考其源，必日月初轉之日，而後爲甲子可也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652114963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天之開尚未有地，安能有人？","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652131347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尚未有人，孰從而傳以記之，以爲本於十二辰之常而知之耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652147731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之運，如環無端，運周一元，磨磑之轉，獨不再始乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652164115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日周十二時，天之運獨不再子乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652180499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一元之上，安知其不有一元耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652196883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况曆元之度，牛斗之變，歲差遠矣，後世之曆，各自爲據，以求合時爾。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652213267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古曆之法，隨世亡矣，安能筭而合之？","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652229651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之言甲乙者，必曰實有木氣王之，而今日木、明日火、後日土，不亦誣乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652246035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652262419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097328267001906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大撓占斗柄而造甲子，必能遠遡天地之始，故以年甲子、月甲子、日甲子、時甲子爲曆元。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652262419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不思占斗柄止可定十二月，天地初開闢，日月如合璧，五星如連珠，俱起於牽牛之初，而後可以定夜半之冬至，此乃死法，故孟子以爲千嵗之曆可坐而致。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652278803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以今之曆考之，如所云云，則天地之開闢者亦數矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652295187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是豈天地之如耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652311571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月初轉之始耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652327955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文字未興，天運無稽，又安能盡推之也耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652344339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"按王說果爲有見，然古今高人達士，稽考天數，推察隂陽，以太乙數而推天運吉㐫，以六壬而推人事吉㐫，以竒門而推地方吉㐫，以年月日時而","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652360723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097328266936370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推人一生吉㐫，如天罡、淳風、一行、虚中軰，無不竒中，抑又何耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652360723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若如王氏所說，前皆不足信矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652377107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其然，豈其然乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652393491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論十干名字之義","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652409875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天氣始於甲干，地氣始於干支者，乃聖人究乎隂陽重輕之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652426259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"著名以彰其德，立號以表其事，由是于甲相合，然後成紀。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652442643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遠可歩於嵗而綂六十年，近可推於日而明十二時。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162652459027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗運之盈虚，氣令之早晏，萬物生死，將今驗古，或得而知之，非特是也，將攷其細而知未萌之禍福，明其用而察向徃之死生，則精微之義，","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747306027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097303969398796"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可謂大矣哉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747306027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以東方甲乙，南方丙丁，西方庚辛，牝方壬癸，中央戊巳，五行之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747322411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢甲乙其位，木，得春之令，甲乃陽内而隂尚包之，草水始甲而出也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747338795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙者，陽過中，然未得正方，尚乙屈也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747355179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：乙，軋也，萬物皆觧莩甲，自抽軋而出之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747371563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁其位，火，行夏之令，丙乃陽上而隂下，隂内而陽外。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747387947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽丁其强，適能與隂氣相丁。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747404331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：丙，炳也，萬物皆炳然著見而强大。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747420715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳其位，土，行周四季。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747437099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊，陽土也，萬物生而岀之，萬物伐而入之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747453483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己，隂土也，無所爲而得己者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747469867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：戊，茂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747486251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已，起也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747502635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土行四季之未，萬物含秀者抑屈而起也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747519019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛其","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747535403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097328266985522"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位，金行秋之令，庚乃隂干，陽更而續者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747535403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛乃陽在下，隂在上，隂于陽極於此。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747551787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚更故也，而辛，新也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747568171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚、辛皆金，金味辛物戊而後有味。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747584555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：萬物肅然更改，秀實新成。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747600939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸其位，水行冬之令。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747617323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬之言任也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747633707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬乃陽生之位，壬而爲胎，萬物懐妊於壬，與子同意。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747650091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸者，揆也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747666475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天令至此，萬物閉藏，懷姙於其下，揆然萌芽，此天之道也，以爲日各焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747682859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故經曰：天有十日，日六竟而周甲者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747699243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天地之數，甲丙、戊庚壬爲陽，乙、丁、巳辛癸爲陰，五行各一隂一陽，故有十日也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747715627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論十二支名字之義","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747732011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097328267083826"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫清陽爲天，五行彰而十干立；濁隂爲地，八方定而十二支分。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747732011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運移氣遷，嵗嵗而盈虚應紀；上升下降，物物而變化可期。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747748395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以支干配合，共臻玅用矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747764779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子者，北方至隂寒水之位，而一陽肇生之始，故隂極則陽生，壬而爲胎。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747781163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子之爲子，此十一月之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747797547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至丑，隂尚執而紐之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747813931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又丑，隂也，助也，謂十二月終始之際，以結紐爲名焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747830315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，正月也，陽已在上，隂已在下，人始見之時，故律管飛灰以候之，可以述事之始也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747846699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又寅，演也，津也，謂物之津塗。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747863083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，日升之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747879467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又卯，茂也，言二月陽氣盛而孳茂。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747895851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰者，陽已過半，三月之時，物盡震而長，","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747912235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097303969382412"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又謂辰言震也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747912235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747928619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，四月，正陽而無隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747928619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自子至巳，陽之位，陽於是𥁞。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747945003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又巳，起也，物畢𥁞而起。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747961387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午者，陽尚未屈，隂始生而爲主。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747977771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：午，長也，大也，物至五月皆豐滿長大也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162747994155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未，六月，木巳種而成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748010539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：未，味也，物成而有味，與辛同意。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748026923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申者，七月之辰，申陽所爲，而己隂至於申，則上下通而人始見。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748043307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白露葉落，乃其候也，可以述隂事以成之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748059691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：申，身也，言物體皆成。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748076075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉者，日入之時，乃陽正中八月也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748092459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：酉，猶也，萬物皆繒縮收歛。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748108843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九月戌，陽未旣也，然不能事，潜藏於戌。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748125227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌中乃乾位，戌爲天門，故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748141611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：戌，滅也，萬物皆衰滅矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748157995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097304141299750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十月亥，純隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748174379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又亥，劾也，言隂氣劾殺萬物，此地之道也，故以此名月焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748190763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲之干乃天之五行，以一隂一陽言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748207147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子之支乃地之五行，以地之方隅言之，故子寅午申爲陽，卯己酉亥爲隂。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748223531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土居四維，王在四季之末。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748239915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土有四，辰戌爲陽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748256299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未爲隂，故其數不同也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748272683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合而言之，十配十二，共成六十日，復六六而成嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748289067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故經曰：天以六六之節，以成一嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748305451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748321835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳摶曰：天干始於甲而終於癸，河圖生成之數也；地支起於子而終於亥，洛書竒偶之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748338219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽自復始，六變而乾陽備；隂自姤始，六變而坤隂","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748354603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097451940020233"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成，合二六之數而爲十二辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748354603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫甲、丙、戊、庚壬，陽幹也；子寅辰、午申戌，陽枝也；乙、丁、巳辛癸，隂幹也，丑卯巳、未酉亥，隂枝也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748370987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法以陽幹配陽枝，隂幹配隂枝，猶木之有幹而有枝。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748387371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自甲子爲首，以六甲五子次第推排，而𥁞於癸亥，仍以幹枝本數而計其成數，總其成數幹枝若干，然後以五數除之，遇其有剰者，約之以生五行之音，是爲六甲納音。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748403755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人推之以入用，以分金六十位，定布於二十四位，以正五行爲各宫之主，以六甲大五行爲緯，察其分金胎養衰死之氣，定其孤虗旺相之卦。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748420139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內有戊巳黛龜甲空亡，甲乙爲補接","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748436523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097328267067442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之空，以是消息隂陽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748436523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢立葬乘氣、定命納音，皆宗乎此。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748452907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總論納音。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748469291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠹉觀筆談論六十甲子納音，本六十律旋相爲宫法也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748485675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一律含五音，凢氣始於東方而右行，音起於西方而左行，隂陽相錯而生變化，所謂氣始於東方者，四時始於木，右行傳於火，火傳於土，土傳於金，金傳於水，所謂始於西方者，五音始於金，左旋傳於火，火傳於木，木傳於水，水傳於土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748502059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"納音與易納甲同法，乾納甲，坤納癸，始於乹而終於坤。納音始於金，金，乹也，終於土，土，坤也。五行之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097451940053001"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中惟有金，鑄而爲噐，則音聲彰，納音所以先金。白虎通曰：鍾，兌音也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納音之法，同類娶妻，隔八生子，","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748518443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此漢志語也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"律吕相生之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748518443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子金之仲同位，娶乙丑，隔八下生壬中金之孟壬申同位，娶癸酉，隔八上生庚辰金之季庚。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748534827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰同位娶辛巳，隔八下生戊子火之仲，成子娶己丑，生内申火之孟，丙申娶丁酉，生甲辰火之季，甲辰娶乙巳，生壬子木之仲。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748551211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是左行，至於丁巳，中吕之宫，五音一終，復自甲午金之仲娶乙未，□八生□寅，一如甲子之法，終於癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748567595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自子至□巳爲陽□，曰黄鍾至于中吕，皆下生。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748583979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自午至於亥爲□，故□□鍾至於","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748600363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097335707697192"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應鍾，皆上生。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748600363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫上下生者，正謂天氣下㖓，地氣上升。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748616747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰天地交泰，義見於此。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748633131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然所生止三者，亦三元之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748649515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故經曰：三而成天，三而成地，三而成人。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748665899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易爻之象取三。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748682283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老子曰：一生二，二生三，三生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748698667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢有始有中，有終畢矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748715051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又觀路史云：甲乙木，丑未土，子水而午火，六者無一金，而風后配合，乃以甲子、乙丑、甲午、乙未爲之金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748731435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此出乎數者然也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748747819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數之所合，變之所由出也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748764203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乹爲天，坤爲地，乹坤合而爲泰，德爲父，紅爲母，德紅合而爲東，千爲君，支爲臣，干支合而納音生。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748780587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故甲乙爲君，子丑爲臣，子丑甲乙合而爲金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748796971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢五行之在","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748813355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097335707729960"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天下，各有氣性，有材位，或相濟，或相尅，若成噐、木成噐，旺中受絶，絶中受氣，惟相配而取之爲不同耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748813355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此金數之所以難同，而又有海中、沙中之異。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748829739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或日：甲乙以相尅取，甲嫁庚，乙嫁辛，甲乙遂有金氣，故凢木必受金胎。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748846123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生於子，水旺之地，故甲子乙丑爲海中之陽金；隂生於午，火旺之地，故甲午乙未爲沙中之隂金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748862507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子陽之始，午隂之始，以甲加子、乙加丑，數之，至午，得庚，至未得辛，爲陽索隂。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748878891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以甲加午，乙加未，數至子丑，亦得庚、辛，爲隂匹陽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748895275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢亦旋宫之法。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748911659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻子母，相濟相尅，相上相下，而吉㐫之兆著矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379162748928043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"草有莘與藟，獨","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070267433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097335707746344"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食之殺人，合而食之有壽；金錫兩柔，合而煉之則剛，理固如是。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070267433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又觀六微㫖論云：納音者，謂子午數至庚，丑未數至辛，寅申數至戊，卯酉數至己，辰戌數至丙，己亥數至丁。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070283817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得七者，西方素皇之氣，納音屬金也；得三者，南方丹天之氣，納音屬火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070300201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得九者，東方陽九之氣，納音屬木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070316585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得一者，中央總綂之氣，納音屬土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070332969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得五者，北方玄極之氣，納音屬水也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070349353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲子甲午，從甲至庚，乙丑乙未，從乙至辛，其數皆七，所以納音屬金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070365737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅丙申，從丙至戊，丁卯丁酉，從丁至己，其數皆三，所以納音屬火；戊辰戊戌，從戊至丙，己巳巳","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070382121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097303969431564"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，從己至丁，其數皆九，所以納音屬木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070382121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子庚午、辛未辛丑，其數皆一，所以納音屬土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070398505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子丙午，從丙至𢈏，丁未丁丑，從丁至辛，其數皆五，所以納音屬水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070414889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納，干數也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070431273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以只數其干，不數其支。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070447657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如從丙至庚，卽丙丁戊巳庚，是其數五也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070464041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如從甲至庚，卽甲乙、丙丁、戊巳庚，其數七，卽路史之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070480425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又瑞桂堂暇錄則云：六十甲子之納音，此以金木水火土之音而明之也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070496809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一六爲水，二七爲火，三八爲木，四九爲金，五十爲土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070513193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然五行之中，惟金木有自然之音，水火土必相假而後成音。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070529577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢水假土，火假水，土假火，故金音四九，木音三","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070545961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097316657070091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八，水音五十，火音一六，土音二七。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070545961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子乙丑，其數三十有四，四者金之音，故曰金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070562345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰、己巳，其數二十有八，八者木之音，故曰木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070578729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午辛未，其數三十有二。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070595113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二者火也，土以火爲音，故曰土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070611497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申、乙酉，其數三十。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070627881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十者土也，水以上爲音，故曰水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070644265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子、己丑，其數三十有一。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070660649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一者水也，火以水爲音，故曰火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070677033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢六十甲子皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070693417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢兩金兩木相擊，自然成音，而水必以土擊，火必以水激，相勝而成音，土必以火陶，成噐而後有音，亦自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070709801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又一說，六十甲子納音，皆從五音所生，有條不紊，端如貫珠。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070726185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢甲子爲首，而五音始於宫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070742569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070758953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097304141332518"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土生金，故甲子爲金，而乙丑以隂從陽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070758953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"商金生水，故丙子爲水，而丁丑從之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070775337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"角木生火，故戊子爲火，徵，火生土，故庚子爲土羽，水生木，故壬子爲木，而己丑、辛丑、癸丑各從之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070791721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於甲寅，則納音起於商，商金生水，故甲寅爲水角，木生火，故丙寅爲火徵，火生土，故戊寅爲土羽，水生木，故庚寅爲木宫，土生金，故壬寅爲金，而五卯各從之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070808105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至甲辰，則納音起於角。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070824489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"角木生火，故甲辰爲火徴，火生土，故丙辰爲土羽，水生木，故戊辰爲木宫，土生金，故庚辰爲金商，金生水，故壬辰爲水，而五己各從之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070840873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫、商、角皆然，惟徵、羽不得居首，於","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070857257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097335707779112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是甲午復如甲子，甲中如甲寅，甲戌如甲辰，而五未、五酉、五亥，亦各從其類。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070857257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又一說：大衍之數五十，其用四十九。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070873641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先布四十九數，𨚫用太玄數。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070890025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己子午九，乙庚丑未八，丙辛寅申七，丁壬卯酉六，戊癸辰戌五，己亥單名四。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070906409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以五數除，不滿五者，作納音，屬水一、火二、木三、金四、土五，相生取用便是。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070922793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如餘一水，水生木，餘二火，火生土，餘三木，木生火，餘四金，金生水，餘五土，土生金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070939177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲子、乙丑四位干支，𠔏除三十四數外。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070955561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有十五數，以二五除一十餘剰，得五數，屬土，土能生金，是甲子、乙丑金也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070971945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内寅、丁卯四位，干支除二十六","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070988329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097451940069385"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數外，有二十三數，以四五除二十餘剰三數，屬木，木能生火，是丙寅、丁卯火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163070988329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071004713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天抵六十甲子，曆也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071021097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納音，律也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071037481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支干納音之别也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071053865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此天地自然之數。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071070249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖生數也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071086633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生者左旋，故以中央之土而生西方之金，西方之金而生北方之水，北方之水而生東方之木，東方之木而生南方之火，南方之火而復生中央之士。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071103017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書尅數也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071119401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅者右轉，故以中央之土而尅北與西此之水，北與西北之水，而尅西與西南之火，西與西南之火而尅南與東南之金，南與東南之金而尅東與東北之木，東與東北之木，而又尅中央之土，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071135785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097451940102153"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無㣲不通。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071135785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此納音之所爲玅也，斷斷乎出自黃帝無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071152169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再考太玄數如何，以甲己子午爲九數。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071168553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢萬物者，本乎天地，運乎四時。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071184937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春以萬物滋長於艮，秋以萬物凋零於坤，生發歸藏，莫離於土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071201321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土者，坤、艮也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071217705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：艮乃生物之始，坤乃成物之終。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071234089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲，天干之首，于地支之首，二義之𬍸環，一陽之來復，故甲子起於天地之數是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071250473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子一陽屬乹，父道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071266857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲壬配之，從子數甲，至申見壬，得九數，乾元用九也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071283241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫婦配合，故甲己二于皆得九也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071299625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑上加乙，至申得八，故乙庚二干皆得八也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071316009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅上加丙，至申得七，故丙辛二干皆得七也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071332393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯上","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071348777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097312882081844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加丁，至申得六，故丁壬二干皆得六也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071348777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰上加戊，至申得五，故戊癸二于皆得五也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071365161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此天干起於乹也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071381545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午冩一隂屬坤，臣道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071397929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙癸配之，從午加乙，至寅見癸。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071414313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得九也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071430697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子爲一陽，午爲一隂，夫婦之道，故子午二支皆得九也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071447081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑加寅至未得八，故丑、未二支皆得八也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071463465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以寅加申，至寅得七，故寅、申二支皆得七也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071479849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以卯加酉，至寅得六，故卯酉二支皆得六也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071496233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以辰加戌，至寅得五，故辰、戌二支皆得五也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071512617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以巳加亥，至寅得四，故己亥二支皆得四也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071529001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數止於九，不言十者，十則又起一矣，故凢十數則曰一十。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071545385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書數始於一，終於九太，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071561769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097316657119243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此圖書生尅自然之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071561769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢術根理數，無微不通，此納音之所爲玅也，斷斷乎出自黄帝無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071578153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再考太玄數如何，以甲己子午爲九數。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071594537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢萬物者，本乎天地，運乎四時。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071610921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春以萬物滋長於艮，秋以萬物凋零於坤，生發歸藏，莫離於土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071627305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土者，坤、艮也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071643689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：艮乃生物之始，坤乃成物之終。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071660073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲，天干之首，子地支之首，二義之𬍸環，一陽之來復，故甲子起於天地之數是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071676457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子一陽，屬乹，父道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071692841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲、壬配之，從子數甲至申，見壬，得九數，乾元用九也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071709225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫婦配合，故甲己二干皆得九也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071725609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑上加乙，至申得八，故乙、庚二干皆得八也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071741993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅上加丙，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071758377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097316657152011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至申得七，故丙辛二干皆得七也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071758377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯上加丁，至申得六，故丁壬二干皆得六也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071774761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰上加戊，至申得五，故戊癸二干皆得五也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071791145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此天干起於乹也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071807529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午爲一隂，屬坤，臣道也，乙癸配之，從午加乙，至寅見癸得九也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071823913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子爲一陽，午爲一隂，夫婦之道，故子午二支皆得九也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071840297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑加寅至未得八，故丑未二支皆得八也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071856681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以寅加申至寅得七，故寅、申二支皆得七也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071873065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以卯加酉，至寅得六，故卯酉二支皆得六也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163071889449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以辰加戌，至寅得五，故辰戌二支皆得五也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163082850358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以巳加亥，至寅得四，故己亥二支皆得四也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163082866742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數止於九，不言十者，十則又起一矣，故凢十","logicSentenceId":"7577379163082883126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097312882130996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數則曰一十。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163082883126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書數始於一，終於九，太玄獨從四起數，不言一、二三者，葢一生二，二生三，三生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163082899510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一爲天，二爲地，三爲人，有天地而後有萬物，故曰三元。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163082915894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且天干十，地支十二，起於九，終於四，天干地支己𥁞，自無一二三。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163082932278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太玄起數，皆理之自然如此，不可不知。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163082948662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論納音取象：昔者黃帝將甲子分輕重而配成六十，號曰花甲子。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163082965046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其花字誠爲奥玅，聖人借意而喻之，不可着意執泥。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163082981430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫自子至亥，十二宫各有金木、水火、土之屬，始起於子爲一陽，終於亥爲六隂。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163082997814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其五行所屬，金木、水火、土，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083014198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097303969464332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在天爲五星，於地爲五岳，於德爲五常，於人爲王臟，其於命也爲五行。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083014198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故甲子之屬乃應之於命，命則一世之事，故甲子納音象，聖人喻之，亦如人一世之事也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083030582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何言乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083046966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑二位，隂陽始孕，人在胞胎，物藏荄根，未有涯際。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083063350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯二位，隂陽漸闢，人漸生長，物以拆甲，群葩漸剖，如人將有立身也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083079734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、巳二位，隂陽氣盛，物當華秀，如人三十、四十而有立身之地，始有進取之象。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083096118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午未二位，隂陽彰露，物已成齊，人至五十、六十，富貴貧賤可知，凢百興衰可見。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083112502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083128886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉二位，隂陽肅殺，物已收成，人已龜縮，各得其靜矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083128886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌亥二位，隂陽閉","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083145270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097427420217355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"塞，物氣歸根，人當休息，各有歸著。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083145270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳此十有二位，先後六十甲子，可以次第而曉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083161654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子、乙丑何以取象？","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083178038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲海中之金，葢氣在包藏，有名無形，猶人之在母腹也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083194422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅癸卯，絶地存金，氣尚柔弱，薄若繒縞，故曰金泊金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083210806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰辛巳，以金居火土之地，氣己𤼵生，金尚在鑛，寄形生養之鄕，受西方之正色，乃曰白鑞金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083227190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午乙未，則氣已成物，質自堅實，混於沙而别於沙，居於火而煉於火，乃曰沙中金也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083243574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申癸酉，氣盛物極，當施收歛之功，頴脫鋒銳之刃。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083259958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢申酉金之正位，干値壬癸，金水淬礪，故取象劔鋒，而金之功用極矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083276342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至戌亥，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083292726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097415902593064"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則金氣藏伏，形體已殘，煆煉首飾，已成其狀，藏之閨閣，無所施爲，而金之功用畢，故曰庚戌辛亥釵釧金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083292726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子癸丑，何以取象桑柘木？","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083309110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢氣居盤屈，形狀未伸，居於水地，蚕衰之月，桑柘受氣，取其時之生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083325494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅、辛卯，則氣巳乘陽，得栽培之勢力，其爲狀也，柰居金下，凢金與霜素堅，木居下得其旺，嵗寒後凋，取其性之堅也，故曰松栢木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083341878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰、己巳，則氣不成量，物已及時，枝葉茂盛，欝然成林，取其木之盛也，故曰大林木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083358262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午癸未，木至午而死，至未而墓，故楊柳盛夏葉凋，枝幹微弱，取其性之柔也，故曰楊柳木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083374646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申辛酉，五","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083391030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097312882163764"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行屬金，而納音屬木，以相尅取之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083391030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢木性辛者，唯石榴木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083407414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉，氣歸靜肅，物漸成實，米居金地，其味成辛，故曰石榴木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083423798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀他木至午而死，惟此木至午而旺，取其性之偏也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083440182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌己亥，氣歸藏伏，隂陽閉塞，术氣歸根，伏乎土中，故曰平地木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083456566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子丁丑，何以取象澗下水？","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083472950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢氣未通濟，高叚非水流之所，𤰞濕乃水就之鄕，由地中行，故曰澗下水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083489334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅乙卯，氣出陽明，水勢恃源，東流滔注，其勢浸大，故曰大溪水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083505718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰癸巳，勢極東南，氣傍離宫，火明勢盛，水得歸庫，盈科後進，乃曰長流水也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083522102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午丁未，氣當升降，在高明火位有水，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083538486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097415902625832"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沛然作霖，以濟火中之水，惟天上乃有，故曰天河水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083538486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申乙酉，氣息安静，子母同位，出而不窮，汲而不竭，乃曰井泉水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083554870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌癸亥，天門之地，氣歸閉塞，水歷遍而不趋，勢歸乎寧謐之位，來之不窮，納之不溢，乃曰大海水也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083571254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子己丑，何以取象？","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083587638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霹靂火？","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083604022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢氣在一陽，形居水位，水中之火，非神龍則無，故曰霹靂火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083620406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅丁卯，氣漸發輝，因薪而顯，隂陽爲冶，天地爲爐，乃曰爐中火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083636790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰乙巳，氣形盛地，勢定高岡，傳明繼晦，子毋相承，乃曰覆燈火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083653174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午巳未，氣過陽宫，重離相會，炳靈交光，𤼵輝炎上，乃曰天上火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083669558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申丁酉，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083685942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097316657201163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣息形藏，勢力韜光，龜縮兌位，力𠌝體弱，明不及遠，乃曰山下火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083685942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌乙亥，謂之山頭火者，山乃藏形，頭乃投光，内明外暗，隱而不顯，飛光投乹，歸於休息之中，故曰山頭火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083702326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子辛丑，何以取象壁上土？","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083718710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣居閉塞，物尚包藏，掩形遮體，內外不交，故曰壁上土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083735094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅己卯，氣能成物，功以育物，發乎根荄，壯乎蕚蕋，乃曰城頭土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083751478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰丁巳，氣以承陽，𤼵生己過，成齊未來，乃曰沙中土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083767862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午辛未，氣當承形，物以路彰，有形可質，有物可彰，乃日路傍上也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083784246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申己酉，氣以歸息，物當收歛，龜縮退閑，羙而無事，乃曰大驛土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083800630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097415902609448"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌丁亥，氣成物府，事以美圓，隂陽歷遍，勢得其閒，乃曰屋上土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083817014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余見路傍之土，播殖百穀，午未之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083833398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其盛夏長養之時乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083849782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大驛之土，通達四方；申酉之地，其得朋利亨之理乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083866166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城頭之土，取隄防之功，王公恃之，立國而衛民也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083882550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"璧上之土，明粉餙之用，臣庻資之，爰居而爰處也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083898934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沙中之上，土之最潤者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083915318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土潤則生，故成齊未來而有用。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083931702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屋上之土，土之成功者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083948086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成功者静，故止於一定而不遷。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083964470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢居五行之中，行負載之令，主養育之權。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083980854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三才五行，皆不可失。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163083997238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處高下而得位，居四季而有功。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084013622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金得之𨦟銳雄剛，火得之光明照燿，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084030006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097451940134921"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木得之英華越秀，水得之濫波不泛，土得之稼穡愈豐。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084030006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聚之不散，必能爲山，山者高也；散之不聚，必能爲地，地者原也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084046390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用之無窮，生之罔極，土之功用大矣哉！","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084062774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又聞日家云：甲子乙丑，子屬水，又爲湖，又爲水旺之地，兼金死於子，墓於丑，水旺而金死墓，故曰海中金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084079158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申癸酉，申酉金之正位，兼臨官申帝旺酉，金旣生旺，則誠剛矣，剛則無踰於劔鋒，故曰劔鋒金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084095542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰辛巳，金養於辰，生於巳，形質初成，未能堅利，故曰白鑞金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084111926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午、乙未，午爲火旺之地，火旺則金敗，未爲火衰之地，火衰則金冠帶敗而方冠帶，未能斫伐，故日沙","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084128310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097312882196532"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084128310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅癸卯，寅卯爲木旺之地，木旺則金𮊵，又金絶於寅，胎於卯，金旣無力，故曰金泊金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084144694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌辛亥，金至戌而衰，至亥而病，金旣衰病，則誠柔矣，故日釵釧金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084161078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅、丁卯，寅爲三陽，卯爲四陽，火旣得地，又得寅卯之木以生，此時天地開爐，萬物始生，故曰爐中火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084177462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌乙亥，戌亥爲天門，火照天門，其光至高，故曰山頭火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084193846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子己丑，丑屬土，子屬水，水居正位，而納音乃火，非神龍則無，故曰霹靂火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084210230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申丁酉，申爲地户，酉爲日入之門，日至此而藏光，故曰山下火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084226614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰、乙巳，辰爲食時，巳爲禺中，日之將中，艷陽之勢，光於天下，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084242998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097316657250315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰覆燈火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084242998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午、巳未，午爲旺火之地，未中之木又復生之，火性炎上，及逢生地，故曰天上火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084259382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰、己巳，辰爲原野，己爲六陽，木至此則枝榮葉茂，以茂盛之木而居原野之間，故曰大林木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084275766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午癸未，木死於午，墓於未，木既死墓，雖得天干壬癸水生，終是柔弱，故曰楊柳木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084292150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅辛卯，木臨官，寅帝旺卯，木旣生旺，則非柔弱之比，故曰松栢木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084308534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戍己亥，戍爲原野，亥爲木生之地，木生原野，則非一根一株之比，故曰平地木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084324918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子癸丑，子屬水，丑屬金，水方生木，金則伐之，猶桑柘方生八便以餧蚕，故曰桑柘木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084341302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申辛酉，申爲","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084357686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097304141365286"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七月，酉爲八月，此時木絶，惟石榴之木反結實，故曰石榴木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084357686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午辛未，未中之木，而生午位之旺火，火毦則土於斯而受形。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084374070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土之始生，未能育物，猶傍路若也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084390454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅己卯，天干戊巳屬土，寅爲艮山，土積而爲山，故曰城頭土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084406838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戍、丁亥，丙丁屬火，戍亥爲天門，火旣炎上，則土非在下而生，故曰屋上土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084423222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子、辛共丑雖土家正位，而子則水旺之地，土見水則爲泥，故曰壁上土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084439606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申己酉，申屬坤爲地，酉屬兌，爲澤，戊巳之土，加於坤澤之上，非它浮薄之土比，故曰大驛土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084455990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰丁巳，土庫辰絶，巳，而天干丙丁之火至辰冠帶，巳臨官，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084472374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097312882229300"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土旣庫絶，旺火復與生之，故日沙中士。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163084472374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子丁丑水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414200362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺於子，衰於丑，旺而反衰，則不能爲江河，故曰澗下水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414216746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申乙酉，金臨官，申帝旺酉，金旣生旺，則水山是以生，力量未洪，故曰井泉水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414233130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰癸巳，辰爲水庫，巳爲金長生之地，金生之水旺巳存，以庫水而逢生金，則泉源不竭，故曰長流水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414249514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午丁未，丙丁屬火，午爲火旺之地，而納音乃水，水自火出，非銀漢不能有，故曰天河水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414265898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅乙卯，寅爲東北維，卯爲正東，水流正東，則其性順，而川澗池沼俱合而歸，故曰大溪水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414282282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戍癸亥，水冠带，戍臨官，亥則力厚，兼亥爲江，非他水","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414298666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097316657233931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比，故曰大海水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414298666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其說雖鑿，與前互相發明，可以見古人取象之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414315050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡮢試論之，五行取象，皆以對待而分隂陽，卽始終而明變化。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414331434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子乙丑對甲午乙未，海中沙中，水土之辨，隂陽之分也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414347818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅癸卯對壬申癸酉，金泊劔鋒，金木之辨，剛柔之别也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414364202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰辛巳、庚戍辛亥，白鑞釵釧，乹巽異方，形色各𥁞也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414380586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子癸丑對壬午癸未，桑柘楊柳，一曲一柔，形質各别也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414396970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅辛卯對庚申辛酉，松栢石榴，一堅一辛，性味逈異也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414413354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰己巳對戊戍己亥，大林平地，一盛一衰，巽乾殊方也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414429738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子己丑對戊午己未，霹靂天上，雷霆揮鞭，日月","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414446122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097427420168203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同照也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414446122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅丁卯對丙申丁酉，爐中山下，火盛木焚，金旺火滅也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414462506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰乙巳對甲戌乙亥，覆燈山頭，含光畏風，投光止艮也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414478890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子辛丑對庚午辛未，壁上路傍，形分聚散，類别死生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414495274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅己卯對戊申己酉，城頭大驛，東南西北，坤艮正位也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414511658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰丁巳對丙戍丁亥，沙中屋上，乾濕互用，變化始終也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414528042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圓看方看，不外旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414544426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相死休囚，近取遠取，莫逃金木水火土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414560810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以干支而分配五行，論隂陽而大明終始。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414577194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天成，人力相蕪，生旺死絶并類。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414593578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼！","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414609962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六十甲子，聖人不過借其象以明其理，而五行性情材質、形色功用，無不曲𥁞，而造化無餘","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414626346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097451940216841"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藴矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414626346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：立天之道，隂與陽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414642730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日，天道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414659114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十日迭運，而隂陽之義明。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414675498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立地之道，柔與剛。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414691882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，地道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414708266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自子至亥，十二辰更次，而剛柔之義顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414724650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"单出爲聲，而己雜比，然後爲音。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414741034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故以日辰錯綜納甲，以成五音，以取六象，於是三才備而五行無餘藴矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414757418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以干爲祿定貴賤，以支爲命定脩短；以納音爲身察盛衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414773802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人得祿命身俱旺相，三才有氣，主快樂長壽；若値死絶休囚，三才無氣，必爲塵埃困窘之命無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414790186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"釋六十甲子性質吉㐫：甲子金、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲寳物，喜金木旺地進神，喜福星平頭，懸針破字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097312882245684"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑金、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲頑鑛，喜火及南方日時，福星華葢正印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅火、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲爐炭，喜冬及木，福星禄刑，平頭聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯火、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲爐煙喜巽地及秋冬，平頭截路懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰木、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山林山野處不材之木，喜水禄庫、華葢、水禄馬庫、棒杖、伏神、平頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳木、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山頭花草，喜春及秋。祿庫八專，□字曲脚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午土、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"路傍乾土，喜水及春。福星官貴截路棒杖懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未土、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"含萬寳，待秋威喜秋及火華葢懸針破字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申金、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戈戟大喜，子午卯酉，平頭大敗，妨害□啞，破字懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉金、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金之椎鑿，喜本及寅卯伏神，破字聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戍火、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火所宿處，喜春及夏。正印華葢平頭，懸針破字棒杖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097427420200971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥火、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火之熱氣，喜土，及夏天德曲脚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子水、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"江湖喜木及土，福星官貴，平頭聾啞，交神飛刃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑水、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水之不流，清徹處，喜金及夏。華葢退神，平頭飛刃闕字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅土、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"堤阜城墎，喜木及火伏神棒杖聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯土，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"破堤敗城，喜申酉及火進神短夭。九醜闕字曲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚懸針，庚辰金、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"錫鑞喜秋及微木，華葢大敗，棒杖平頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳金、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金之生者，雜沙石，喜火及秋天德福星官貴，截路大敗，懸針曲脚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午木、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楊柳幹節，喜春夏，官貴。九醜。飛刃平頭，聾啞懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未木、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楊柳根喜冬，及水亦宜春。正印華葢短夭，伏神飛刃、破字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申水","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甘井喜春及夏破禄馬，截路平頭破字懸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"針，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097451940184073"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉水、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"隂粲水喜東方及南破禄知夭。九醜曲脚，破字聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌土、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"堆阜喜春夏及水天德，華葢，平頭聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥土、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"平原喜火及木，天乙福星官貴德合平頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子火、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雷也，喜水，及春夏，得土而神天伏神短天九醜杖刑飛刃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑火、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"電也，喜水，及春夏，得地而晦，華葢大敗，飛刃曲脚闕字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅木、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}
