,{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"松栢幹節喜秋冬破，禄馬相刑，杖刑聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯木、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"松栢之根，喜水土及宜春。破禄交神九醜懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰水、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍水喜雷電，及春夏，正印天德水禄馬庫退神，平頭聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳水、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水之不息流入海，喜亥子乃變□。天乙官貴、德合、伏馬、破字曲脚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午金、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"百煉精金，喜水木土進神德合平頭破字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸針","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097415902658600"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未金、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爐炭餘金喜大火及土，華葢截路，曲脚破字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申火、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白茅野燒，喜秋冬。及木平頭，聾啞大敗破字懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉火、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼神之𤫊響，火之無形者，喜辰戌北天乙。喜神平頭破字，聾啞大敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌木、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蒿艾之枯者，喜火，及春夏，華葢大敗。八専杖刑截路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥木、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蒿艾之茅，喜水及春夏闕字曲脚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子土、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"士中空者，屋宇也，喜木及金木德合杖刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑土、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"墳墓喜木及火與春，華葢懸針闕字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅金、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金之華餙者，喜木及微火，截路平頭聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯金、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"環鈕鈴鐸喜盛火及秋，貴人破字懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰火、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"燈也，喜夜及水，惡書華葢大敗，平頭破字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸針，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097432394580031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳火、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"燈光也。同上尤喜申酉及秋正，禄馬大敗，曲脚闕字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午水、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月輪喜夜及秋水旺也喜神，羊刃交神，平頭聾啞懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未水、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火光也。同上華葢羊刃退神八專，平頭破字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申土、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"秋間田地喜申酉，及火福星伏馬杖刑破孛、懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉土，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"秋間禾稼喜申酉，及冬進神截路九醜闕字曲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚破字聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414806570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌金、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414822954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刃劒之餘喜微火，及木華葢杖刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥金、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414822954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鍾鼎寶物，喜木火及土，正禄馬懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子木、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414822954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷水多之木，喜火土及夏，羊刃九醜，平頭聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑木、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414822954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷水少之木，喜金水及秋華葢福星八専破字闕字羊刃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅水、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414822954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雨也喜夏及火正，祿馬福神八專，平頭破字懸針聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097432394596415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯水，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414822954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"露也，喜水及火，建祿喜神人専。九醜曲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚懸針，丙辰土","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414822954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"堤㟁喜金及木禄庫，正印華葢截路平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414822954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414839338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上土之沮涗，喜火，及西北禄庫，平頭，闕字曲脚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午火、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414839338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日輪夏則人畏，冬則人愛，思。戊子、己丑，甲寅、乙卯。伏神陽刃九醜，棒杖懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己未火，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414839338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日光忌夜，亦畏四者，福星、華葢、羊刃、闕字曲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚破字，庚申木、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414839338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"榴花喜夏，不宜秋。冬建禄馬八専杖刑破字懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉木、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414839338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"榴子喜秋及夏，建禄交神，九醜八專，懸針聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌水、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414839338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"海也喜春夏及木，華葢退神平頭，聾啞杖刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414839338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"百川喜金土火伏馬大敗，破字截路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右件六十甲子，盛大者忌變爲小弱，小弱者欲變爲","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414855722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097427420250123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盛大。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414855722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如先貧賤而後富貴則榮華；先富貴而後貧賤則卑辱，不可。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414872106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以其先貧賤而不論其富貴，亦不可。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414888490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以其先富貴而不論其貧賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414904874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且生年屬木，假令是庚寅、辛卯，則木之盛大可知。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414921258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月日時胎不見他木，則以松栢論；萬一上見楊柳木，或柘榴木，則捨大就小，不以松栢論也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414937642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令是壬午、癸未生人，則木之小弱可知。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414954026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月日時胎不見他木，則以楊柳論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414970410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬一見松栢木，或大林木，則棄小論大，不可以楊柳論也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163414986794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以至天上火、劔鋒金、大海水、大驛土，生人月日時胎，别見他位，納音同而小弱者。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415003178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如覆燈火、金泊金、井泉水、","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415019562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097304141447206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沙中土，生人月日時胎，别見他位，納音同而盛大者。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415019562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或引凢而入聖，或先重而後輕，皆當從其變者而論之，不可拘於一端。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415035946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子從革之金，其氣散，得戊申土、癸巳水相之則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415052330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申乃金臨官之地，土者更旺於子，必能生成。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415068714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳係金生於巳，水旺於子，納音各有所歸，又爲朝元祿。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415085098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌丁卯、丁酉、戊午之火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415101482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：甲子金爲進神，稟沉潜虗中之德，四時皆吉，入貴格，承旺氣，則術業精微，王奪魁之榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415117866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑白庫之金，火不能尅，葢退藏之金，𱽏無刑害衝","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415134250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097304141414438"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破，未有不顯榮者。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415134250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨忌己丑、己未之火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415150634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：乙丑爲正印，具大福德，秋冬富貴壽考，春夏吉中有㐫人格，則建功享福，帶煞類爲㐫會。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415167018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寳鑑云：甲子、乙丑未成噐，金見火則成，多見則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415183402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅赫𣌀之火，無水制之，則有燔灼炎烈之患。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415199786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水不可過，獨愛甲寅之水，就位濟之，又名朝元祿。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415216170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：丙寅火含靈明冲粹之氣，四時生生之德，入貴格則文彩發應，主魁甲之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415232554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯伏明之火，氣弱，宜木生之，遇水則卤。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415248938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯、乙酉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415265322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水最毒五行要論云：丁卯沐浴之火，含雷動風作之","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415281706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097427420266507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，水濟則達，土載之則基厚，以木資之爲文彩，以金槖之，更逢夏令則㐫暴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415281706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷遺文云：丙寅、丁卯，秋冬宜以保持。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415298090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註云：火無西旺，火至秋冬，勢恐不久。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415314474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰兩土下木，衆金不能尅，葢土生金，有子母之道，得水生之爲隹。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415330858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：戊辰、庚寅、癸丑三辰，挺木德淸健之數，生於春夏，能特立獨奮，隨變成功，更乗旺氣，則有凌霄聳𡋹之志。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415347242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟忌秋生，雖懷志節，屈而不伸。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415363626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳爲近火之木，金自此生，於我無傷，忌見生旺之火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415380010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨶒東叟云：己巳在巽，爲風動之木，根危易拔，和之","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415396394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097451940249609"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以金土，運歸東南，方成材用，雖外陽內隂，别無輔助，則其氣虗散，更爲金鬼所尅，乃不材之木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415396394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415412778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890570219539/1-f12ce790c7d44f99.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=pfg19jKaQp1KKkO4jr3J0o9k22Y%3D","uri":"read/HY1521/6/ref/1kvl939d41jcj/1-f12ce790c7d44f99.webp","fontType":1,"components":"王糸","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690890570219539"},"logicSentenceId":"7577379163415412778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子云：己巳戊辰，度軋宫而脱厄。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415412778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註云：己巳、戊辰，舉木之類，西方金鬼旺鄕，納音之木至此絶矣，斯謂厄會。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415429162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若度乹亥之宫，木得水以長生，故脫厄。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415445546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午、辛未，始生之土，木不能尅，惟忌水多反傷其氣，不多却有歸，葢木歸未也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415461930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨶒東叟云：庚午、辛未、戊申、己巳，皆厚德之土，含容鎭靜，和氣融洽，福祿優裕，入格則多歷方岳之任，有普惠愽愛之功。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415478314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申臨官之金，利見水土，若丙申、丙寅、戊午之火，則","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415494698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097312882294836"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲災害。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415494698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨶒東叟云：壬申金持天將之威，資臨官之氣，秋冬掌生殺之權，春夏吉少㐫多，入格以功名自𡚒，帶煞以刻剥爲能。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415511082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉堅成之金，火死於酉，見火何傷？","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415527466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟忌丁酉火就位尅之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415543850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：癸酉自旺之金，禀純粹之氣，春夏爲性英明，秋冬尤貴，入格則功業。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415560234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節槩挺特出倫，帶煞則少年剛勁，四十之後，漸成純德。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415576618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寶鑑云：壬申、癸酉，金旺之位，不可復旺，旺則傷物，不可見火，見火則自傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415593002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌自庫之火，不嫌衆水，只忌壬戍，所謂墓中受尅，其患難逃。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415609386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：甲戌火爲印爲庫，含至陽藏","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415625770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097451940265993"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宻之氣，貴格逢之，富貴光大，惟忌夏生，防吉中有㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415625770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥伏明之火，其氣湮欝而不𤼵，藉己亥、辛卯、己巳、壬午發未木生之，則精神旺相；癸亥、丙午水有之，則不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415642154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨶒東叟云：乙亥火自絶，含明敏自靜之氣，葆光晦跡，寂然無形。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415658538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禀之得數者，爲玅道高人，吉德君子。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415674922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙于流衍之水，不忌衆土，惟嫌庚子，乃旺中逢鬼，不祥莫大焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415691306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：丙子自旺之水，陽上隂下，精神俱全，禀之者，天資曠逹，識量淵深。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415707690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙夏爲濟物之氣，多建利澤之功。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415724074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑福聚之水，最愛金生，忌辛未、内辰、丙戌，相刑破","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415740458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097432394629183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415740458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：丁丑、乙酉，在數爲渙弱之水，隂盛陽弱，禀之者，噐識清明，多慧少福。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415756842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"槖以水木旺氣，則隂陽均恊，爲貴逹崇顯之士。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415773226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅受傷之土，最爲無力，要生旺火以資其氣，忌己亥、庚寅、辛卯諸色木尅，主短折之㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415789610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：戊寅、内戌，此二位乗土德厚氣，一含生火，一含宿火，是謂陽靈襲中，福慶之辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415805994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格得之，道德葢世，貴極人臣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163415822378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟親王貴公子多於此日生，常格得之，亦主福壽遐遠，始終安逸。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426783286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯自死之土，抑又甚焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426799670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴得丁卯、甲戌、乙亥、己未","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426816054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097312882343988"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之火，由合而來，以致其福。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426816054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：己卯自死土，建於震位，風行雷動，散爲和氣，德自冲虚，禀之者類。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426832438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有道行隨變而適，有養生自在之福壽，惟不利死絶，則爲久假不歸之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426848822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命纂局云：戊寅、己卯受傷之土，不可爲木所損，其土無力。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426865206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寳鑑云：戊寅、己卯，土不宜見水，見水不爲財，不畏木，見木愈堅。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426881590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅承土德旺氣而含生火，得之主福壽綿遠。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426897974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯不宜再見，死絶見則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426914358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰氣聚之金，不用火制，其噐自成，火盛反䘮其噐，病絶火無害。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426930742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲辰、乙巳火，惡不可言，亦不能尅衆","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426947126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097415902707752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木，葢我氣亦聚耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426947126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：庚辰之金，具剛健沉厚之德，禀聰明疏通之性，春夏禍福𠋣伏，秋冬秀頴𭀚實，入格則兼資文武，帶煞則好弄兵權。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426963510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳自生之金，精神具足，體氣完備，炎烈熾化而不亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426979894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌丙辰、乙巳、戊午之火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163426996278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋金生於巳而不能生，敗於午，絶於寅而氣散，復見生旺之火，烏可當之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427012662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：辛巳金爲自生學堂，具英明瑰竒之德，秋冬得力十全，春夏七㐫三吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427029046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入貴格，則主學行英偉，致身清貴，常懷濟物之心。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427045430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寳鑑云：庚辰、辛巳未成噐，金宜見火，兼辛巳是自生，巳爲火，得之者光輝日","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427061814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097427420299275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"新。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427061814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午柔和之木，枝幹微弱，木能生火，𨚫忌見火多，多則燼矣，雖生旺之金亦不能傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427078198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢金就我敗，得金反貴，水土盛者亦貴，惟忌甲午金傷之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427094582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：壬午自死之木，木死絶則魂遊而神氣靈秀，禀之者挺靜明之德，抱仁者之勇，建立功行，可謂静而有勇，延年益壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427110966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未自庫之木，生旺則隹，雖乙丑金不能衝破，各歸其根而不相犯。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427127350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌庚戊、乙未金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427143734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：癸未木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427160118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲正印，挺文明吉會之德，禀之者類抱間世之才，享","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427176502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097411603398707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清華之福。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427176502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寳鑑云：壬午、癸未謂之楊柳木者，葢木至午而死，至未而墓，故盛夏葉稠，得其時則富壽，非其時則貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427192886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申自生之水，其氣流衍，宜有所歸，亦藉金生，不忌衆土，特嫌戊申庚子之士。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427209270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：甲申水自生，含天眞學堂，得之入局，主智識聰慧，妙用無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427225654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉自敗之水，假衆金以相之，葢我氣旣弱，藉母以育，忌己酉、己卯、戊申、庚子、辛丑之土，則夭折窮賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427242038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌福壯祿厚之土，木不能尅，忌見生旺之金，若遇火盛，則貴不可言。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427258422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097427420332043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥臨官之土，木不能尅，嫌金多，須得火生救之乃吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427274806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌己亥、辛卯之木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427291190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：丁亥、庚子二土，中含金數，内剛外和，禀之者，得有定力，土下濟之以水火旺氣，能建功立事，敢爲威果之行。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427307574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子、己丑，水中之火，又曰神龍之火，遇水方貴，爲六氣之君火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427323958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：戊子含精神輝光全實之氣，作四時保生之福，入貴格，則爲大人君子，噐字含弘，富貴終吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427340342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳丑爲天將之火，又爲天乙本家，含威福光厚之氣，發越峻猛，貴局乗之，爲將德、爲魁名而建功。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427356726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427373110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097312882376756"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：丑胎養之火，其氣漸隆，若遇丙寅、戊午之火助之，可成濟物之功。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427373110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𢈏寅、辛卯嵗寒之木，雪霜無以改其操，况金能尅之乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427389494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上有庚辛，不假制治，自然成材。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427405878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：辛卯木自旺，春夏則氣節挺拔，建功立事；生於秋，則狂狷折剉，勁氣不伸。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427422262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰自庫之水，若池沼水積之地，忌金來決破。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427438646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若再見壬辰，是謂自刑，别辰無咎，遇多水上皆喜，惟畏壬。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427455030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌癸亥、丙子之水，生旺太過，汗漫無歸。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427471414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：壬辰水爲正印，含清明潤沃之德。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427487798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禀之者，含容弘大，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427504182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097461410758690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心識如鏡，春夏得之，作大福慧；秋冬得之，類姦詐濤德。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427504182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳爲自絶之水，名曰涸流，若丙戌、丁亥、庚子壯厚之土，其涸可待。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427520566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得三合生旺之金生之，則源泉混混，盈科而進也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427536950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：癸巳、乙卯自絶自死之水，乃至隂退藏，眞精嗇養，凝成貴氣，貴局乗之類，是妙道君子，夙體常德，有功及物。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427553334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午自敗之金，亦曰强悍之金，遇火生旺，其噐乃成。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427569718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌丁卯、丁酉、戊子之火，㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427586102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：甲午金爲進神魁氣，具剛明之德，秋冬則吉，春夏或㐫，入貴格王","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427602486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097411603513395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"科，塲建綂衆之功。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427602486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非時帶煞，則暴戾尅忍，寡恩少義。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427618870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經云：甲午金傷强悍，或抑之乃沉潜。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427635254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註云：沙石金剛礦喜殺，抑之者，火革之也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427651638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷遺文云：甲午愛官鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427668022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李虗中云：甲午金傷强悍，壬子木失之柔，或壬子得甲午，或甲午得壬子，隂陽專位，𨚫有炳靈。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427684406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未偏庫之金，亦火制而土生之，則福壯氣聚。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427700790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌巳未、丙申、丁酉之火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427717174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：乙未金在數爲木庫，又爲天將，具純仁厚義之德，無徃不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427733558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格得之，是不世之英傑，魁鎭士倫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427749942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常格得之，帶煞衝犯，亦作小人中之君子，眉壽人也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427766326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097415902740520"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邴申自病之火，丁酉自死之火，其氣極微，假木相助，其氣方生。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427782710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌甲申、乙酉、甲寅、乙卯之水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427799094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：丙申病火，以木爲文明之德，以水爲曠逹之性，以土爲福慧之基，惟金爲暴虐，縱有吉辰，革爲不和之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427815478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：丁酉火自死，含韜晦寂靜之氣，外和内剛。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427831862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格乗之，類爲有道君子自然之德行。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427848246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌土中之木，忌重見土，若納音土多，一生屯蹇，金不能尅，葢金氣至戌而散，遇金乃能致福利，見水多术盛而爲貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427864630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：戊戌之木，孤根獨立，和之以水火旺氣，則有英明秀實之德，入格則文章進逹，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427881014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097461410775074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福祿始終。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427881014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然乗天將之氣，主備歷艱險，節操不移，方見晚福。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427897398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥自生之木，根本繁盛，不忌衆金，惟嫌辛亥、辛巳、癸酉之金，若見乙卯、丁未水、癸未木，未有不大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427913782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：己亥木自生，挺英才秀拔之德，得之於特逹處，類皆清貴少逹。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427930166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：己亥之木，得時則清貴，非時則辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427946550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𢈏子厚德之土，能尅衆水，不忌他木，葢木至子無氣，若遇壬申之金，謂之明位祿，其貴必矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427962934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑福聚之土，衆木不能尅，葢丑爲金庫，丑中有金，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427979318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097411603480627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見木何傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427979318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寳鑑云：庚子、辛丑，土愛木而惡水，見木爲官，見水不相宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163427995702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：辛丑、己酉之土，中含金數厚，德性剛和而不同，上下，濟以水火旺氣，則威名功烈，見爲果敢。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428012086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅自絶之金，癸卯氣散之金，若見衆火則喪氣，惟水土朝之則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428028470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：壬寅、癸卯爲虛薄之金，具仁柔義剛之德，秋冬剛健無㐫，㐫爲吉兆；春夏則内㐫外吉，吉乃先㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428044854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入貴格則志節英明，帶煞則𠒋暴，不能終也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428061238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命纂局云：癸卯自胎之金，若逢丙寅、丁卯，爐中之火，不爲鬼，以胎金爐中成器故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428077622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097451940298761"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰偏庫之火，多火助之吉，所謂同氣之求，以資其不足。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428094006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見戊辰、戊戌木生之爲貴格，忌壬辰、壬戌、丙。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428110390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午、丁未水最毒。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428126774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：甲辰爲天將之火，含敏速峻烈之氣，入貴格，則爲特逹，爲文魁，利秋冬，不利於夏。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428143158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳臨官之火，水不能尅，葢水絶於已，得水濟之，則爲純粹，若得二三火助之亦佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428159542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：乙巳火含純陽㢲發之氣，光輝𠑽實，春冬向吉，夏秋向㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428175926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午、丁未，銀漢之水，土不能尅，天上之水，地金不能生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428192310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺太過，反傷於萬物；死絶太多，又不能生萬","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428208694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097411603529779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428208694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：丙午至崇之水，體南方温厚之氣，禀之者，類有道氣虗變，頴異有爲，魁衆出倫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428225078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未具足三才全數，得冲正之氣，禀之者，主精神氣全，性根高玅，𥁞變之道。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428241462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申重阜之土，木絶於申，不能尅，若見金水多助，則富貴尊榮之格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428257846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉自敗之土，其氣不足，藉火以相助之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428274230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見丁卯、丁酉火則吉，切忌死絶，畏辛卯、辛酉木，災蹇夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428290614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌、辛亥堅成之金，不可見火，恐有所傷，若得水土相之爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428306998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：庚戌火墓之金，有剛烈目恃之","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428323382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097432394694719"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暴，秋冬庻幾沉厚，春夏動生悔吝，君子執兵刑之權，小人恣獷悍之性。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428323382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥金，稟乹健純明中正之氣，春秋冬三時吉夏，七吉三㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428339766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格乗之，體仁守義，若𢃄刑煞，肆暴貪功。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428356150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子專位之木，癸丑偏庫之木，遇死絶則富貴，生旺則貧賤，水多則夭折，金多土盛爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428372534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：壬子幽隂之木，陽弱隂盛，柔而無立，類仁水德，用事，惟對以丙午水，則爲水木冲粹之德，類入神仙異士標格，非常流也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428388918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經云：壬子之木，失於優柔，其或揚之，仁而高明。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163428405302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註云：壬子木在水旺之鄕，假子中得微。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800076294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097432394711103"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之氣而生，柔脆易折，則自敗木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800092678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"揚之者，欲得火土之氣，益之使敷榮，則仁勇而高明。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800109062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅自病之水，乙卯自死之水，雖然死病，土不能尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800125446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢支干二木，可以制土，若見壬寅、癸卯之金，則爲優裕。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800141830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：甲寅、壬戌二水爲伏逆，隂勝於陽，主姦邪害物，惟濟之以火土損益，方成大器。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800158214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰自庫之土，厚且壯，喜甲辰火，惡戊辰木，此土凢木不能傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800174598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢丙火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800190982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰爲火偏庫，土已成噐，惟嫌戊戌、己亥、辛卯、戊辰之木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800207366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：丙辰土爲正印，建五福吉會之德，禀之者，類皆亨大有爲，不貴卽富，","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800223750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097461410824226"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟犯衝者，多爲僧道。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800223750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳自絶之土，又不爲絶。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800240134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢一土居二火之下，在父母之鄕，乗天屬之恩，故不爲絶。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800256518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木不能尅，火，多益佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800272902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寳鑑云：丁巳含東南火德旺數，得之者，含容福壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800289286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午自旺之火，巳未偏庫之火，居離明之方，旺相之地，其氣極盛，他水無傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800305670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌丙午、丁未天上之水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800322054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：戊午自旺，火含離明炎上之氣，無情治物，動違於衆。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800338438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬得之，濟以水土旺氣，則豁逹高明，福力堅壯。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800354822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏乘之以金木，雖騰光迅速，命非久常。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800371206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800387590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097411603546163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論云：巳未衰火，含餘藏寳之氣，春夏之月，運入沉潜之鄕，則明達峻敏，福慶深遠。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800387590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏得之，非和氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800403974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋得之，則先吉後㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800420358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申、辛酉二木，金居木上，因金以成噐，忌再見金，致毁其噐。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800436742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見甲申、乙酉水，則入格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800453126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寳鑑云：庚申自絶，木爲魂游神變，遇此日生者，類非凢噐。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800469510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常格主賦性頴異，家族不覊。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800485894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入貴格，則是英傑之才，立不世之功。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800502278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉失位之木，木困金卿，乗之者，涉世多艱，惟對癸卯金，則剛柔相濟，挺拔出群，决取巍科。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800518662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經云：魂貴天遊，故庚申之木，不嫌於死絶，獨坐而守庚","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800535046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097427420364811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800535046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註云：庚申自絶木，木於五臓屬肝，肝藏魂，木休絶則魂遊於天，故庚申之木不嫌死絶，所以貴於天遊。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800551430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷遺文云：辛酉期生旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800567814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註云：辛酉氣絶之木，欲生旺以爲榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800584198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌偏庫之水，癸亥臨官之水，名曰大海水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800600582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢支干納音皆水，忌見衆水，雖壬辰水庫，亦不能當，不忌他土，死絶則吉，生旺則汎濫而無所歸也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800616966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寳鑑云：亥子水之正位，壬戌氣伏而不順，惟以火土損益之，乃成大噐。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800633350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥具純陽之數，內體至仁，禀之者，天資夷曠，志氣浩然，發爲功業利澤。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800649734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時帶煞，則㐫狡之","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800666118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097432394727487"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800666118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：丙戌之土，爲福隆厚，火鍾於此故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800682502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已未、庚辰、戊辰、丁丑，與此同義。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800698886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未火也，未中有墓木，庚辰金也，辰中有墓士，戊辰木也，辰中有墓水，丁丑水也，丑中有墓金，皆父母之氣，各有所養。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800715270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此五者福壯厚，以上有鬼所傷，不爲害，氣成故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800731654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李虚中云：丙戌尤異，以戌又爲土之本位，而尤旺盛。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800748038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳戊午乃盛炎之火，秋冬作德吉，春夏作刑㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800764422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若仲夏暴炎一發，旋卽歸燥，竟焚和而爲咎。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800780806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳臨官之火，上有一木生之，其氣盛矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800797190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午自旺之火，若生","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800813574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097415902756904"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬，爲温燠之氣，爲濟物之德；若生春夏旺火，復得陽位，則作㐫；生仲夏爲暴戾刻忍，㐫夭之流也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800813574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯癸巳、丁酉乙亥，水火雖死絶，却清明而妙佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800829958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火死絶而内明外晦，返照回光；水死絶而湛然清徹，可燭鬚眉，故却清明而妙佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800846342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李虚中云：四位水火雖死絶，𨚫清明而妙佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800862726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀天乙貴人，自可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800879110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅之金，事君不逆；庚申之木，爲臣不强。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800895494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行屬五音，宫土者，君也；商金者，臣也；角木者，民也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800911878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"商大過則臣强，角太過則君弱，故五音之中，常用四清宮以殺商角。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800928262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申者，角木自絶也；壬寅者，商金自絶也，皆使","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800944646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097498438074395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得忠順之道，故事君不逆，爲臣不强。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800944646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以自紫微、鸞臺、鳯閣以上官，切忌金木生旺之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800961030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是必不爲之，爲之亦不能久，獨臺諫則可。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800977414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若金木生旺而尅破則不然。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163800993798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申木、乙巳火土金生而還不生；丙午水、癸卯金木水死而還不死。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801010182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土生申而不生於庚申，水生申而不生於戊申，火生寅而不生於甲寅，金生巳而不生於乙巳，木生亥而不生於辛亥，葢生處而反受制故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801026566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得之者夭壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801042950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水死卯而不死於癸卯，土死卯而不死於丁卯，木死午而不死於丙午，金死子而不死於庚子，火死酉而不死於辛酉，葢死處得生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801059334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801075718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097411603562547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之者長壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801075718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子支干旺於北方，乃水之位，納音屬火，乃水中之火，非神龍不能有之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801092102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午支干旺於南方，乃火之位，納音屬水，乃火中之水，非天河不能有之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801108486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子人得丙午，或丙午人得戊子，無不貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801124870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢火中出水，水中藏火，水火旣濟，精神運動，必靈異於人矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801141254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李虚中云：丙午天上之水，銀漢有之，卽十二辰之天后也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801157638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得之者，高明豁達，頴異不凢。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801174022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子水中之火，神龍有之，卽六氣之君火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801190406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得之者，自神而明。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801206790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沉幾先物，二氣兼得。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801223174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尤妙絶。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801239558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘□氣，凖此詳之之丑之土不嫌於木，戌","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801255942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097427420381195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌之木，不怕於金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801255942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何以辯之？","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801272326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑中金庫，木不爲鬼；戊中有火，金反受其殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801288710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若戊戌之木，二土在上，一木在下，埋在二土之内，尚未萌芽，不見其形，是土盛木弱，餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801305094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅木、丁巳土，不嫌金木之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801321478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金至寅宫，雖爲鬼，而金絶在寅，故不爲鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801337862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木至巳宫，而巳有生金尅木，故不爲鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801354246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若庚寅木逢壬申金，相衝受尅，餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801370630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午之土，乗南方旺火，以養其形。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801387014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申之土自生，庚子之土自盈，不忌木鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801403398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢木至午死，申絶子敗，又自强之土何傷？","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801419782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801436166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097461410856994"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申、癸酉、庚戌、辛亥四金氣壯，不嫌於鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801452550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子之火，不畏其鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801468934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水中霹靂之火，神龍有之，葢有水則雷方鳴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801485318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢丙午、丁未天上水，則有所忌，有相戰之功。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801501702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凢本命支干受傷，則主六根不足，有始無終。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801518086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁巳見癸亥，壬子見戊午，餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801534470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午、庚申，彼我得之超異。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801550854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申石榴木夏旺，故喜戊午。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801567238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢火官旺而石榴木性得時，戊午乃旺極之火，喜於申見天馬相資也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801583622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其神頭祿者，卽十干專位祿，乃隂陽專位，天地神會也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801600006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"列人卦之眞源，演五行之成敗，剛柔相推，有無合化。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801616390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故壬子之水，應北方之坎，丙","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801632774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097498438123547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午之火，實南宫之離。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801632774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以丙午得壬子不爲破，丁巳得癸亥不爲衝，是水火相濟之源，有夫婦配合之理。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801649158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離爲男女精神之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801665542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子得丙午，癸亥得丁巳，則先後火水有未濟之象，不如丁巳見壬子，丙午得癸亥也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801681926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申辛酉之金，應西方之兌，甲寅乙卯之木，象東方。","logicSentenceId":"7577379163801698310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之震，所以甲寅得庚申不爲刑，乙卯得辛酉不爲鬼，是木女金夫之正體，明左右之神化也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219506731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"术主魂，金主魄，二者左右相間不合。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219523115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若能全合，則神之化生以無間也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219539499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若庚申得乙卯，辛酉得甲寅，不爲元辰，變通之","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219555883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097461410971682"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219555883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰、戊戌之土，爲魁罡相會，乹坤厚德，覆載含生，不得以爲返吟。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219572267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰、戊戌不爲衝，土得正位，干守元會也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219588651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑、己未，是貴神，守忠貞。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219605035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此四真土，有萬物始終之道，非大人君子，孰能備此德？","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219621419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况神頭祿各有神以主之，左右運動於六合之中，盈縮於吉㐫之變也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219637803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑土爲天乙貴人，己未土爲太常福神，觧百煞之㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219654187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得之當用，爲橫財之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219670571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰爲勾陳，戊戌爲天空，土之神，多遷攺，居帥外藩，出鎭邉防，有不常矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219686955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219703339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097498438172699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳爲螣蛇之神，㐫以㐫用，吉以吉承，多熒惑之憂，有滑稽之性。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219703339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午爲朱雀之神，應陽明之體，文詞藻麗。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219719723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅爲青龍之神，慱施濟衆，得四方之利。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219736107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯爲六合之神，主發生榮華，和弱順黨。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219752491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子爲天后之神，主陰隲天德，容羙多權。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219768875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥爲玄武之神，乃陰陽終極，有潜伏之氣，從下如流，雖有大智，非軒昻超逹之士，順則安平，逆則姦宄。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219785259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申爲白虎之神，利於武而不利於文，有抱道孤騫之性；善中嚴外，色厲内荏，有仁義，好幽僻。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219801643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉爲太隂之神，懷肅殺之氣，有清白之風，爲文章利口，不世之才。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219818027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然更各以親踈休旺，定遇","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219834411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097513738928191"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者之情性禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219834411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子、乙丑，海中金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219850795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海中金者，寳藏龍官，珠孕蛟室，出現雖假於空衝，成噐無藉乎火力。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219867179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故東方朔以蛤𧉻名之，良有理也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219883563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙選有珠藏淵海格，以甲子見癸亥，是不用火逢空，有𧉻珠照月格，以甲子見巳未，是欲合化互貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219899947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢以海金無形，非空衝則不能出現，而乙丑金庫，非旺火則不能陶鑄故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219916331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子見戊寅、庚午，是土生金，乙丑見丙寅、丁卯，是火制金，又天干逢三竒，此等格局，無有不貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219932715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊說甲子、乙丑俱喜見爐中火，丙寅旺火，不","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219949099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097411603595315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜木助；丁卯敗火，𨚫宜木助。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219949099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覆燈山下山頭諸火性微，不能煉金，故宜木助。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219965483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天上火不能尅金，須假凢火，再得水濟，無衝破爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219981867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霹火就位相尅，性主昏蒙。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164219998251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運如再犯大㐫，見木則無造化，以此金未能成噐，不能制物故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220014635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月日有火而時遇木，𨚫以財論則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220031019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井泉、澗下、大溪、天河等水，無火俱不宜，見海水亦不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220047403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然以妙選論之，則爲貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220063787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"據理甲子見癸亥，逢生趋乾，何不可之有路傍屋壁、城頭大驛諸土，在日時柱中，天元、支辰、納音俱無火制，主賤中年夭，余見亦未然。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220080171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以庚午、辛未、戊寅、己卯二土，造化有情故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220096555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220112939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097432394760255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子見庚午，坎離相濟，見辛未，官星帶貴；乙丑見庚午，官貴互換。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220112939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子見戊寅，絶地逢生，見己卯，天子合化；乙丑見戊寅，亦絶地逢生，見己卯，則歸祿帯財，餘土又當仍分年上祿馬貴人方准。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220129323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沙土埋金，誠不宜見，有火亦不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220145707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中逢金，砂鑞原未成噐，海中又未成噐，彼此無益，故無火不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220162091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劒釵已成噐金相見有助，玅選謂之脫體化神，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220178475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泊金亦好。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220194859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子見甲子，乙丑見乙丑，同類相資，柱中喜見一寅，見戊寅，謂之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220211243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"崑山片玉，如甲子見乙丑，謂之干支連珠，非得火煉不可，卽子平金神格之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220227627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097461410906146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅、癸卯金泊金金泊金者，潤色盃盤，増光宮室。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220244011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"打薄須藉乎别金，描彩必假乎水力。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220260395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此金甚微，非木則無所依。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220276779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木以平地爲上，有此不宜見火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220293163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有火主天遇太陽，爲日間之顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220309547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二火相反，不宜同見。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220325931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山下山頭有清水助之亦𠮷，惟忌爐火就位相尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220342315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此金體薄，不能反源，定天限運同論井泉澗下，天河水清，日時喜見，須月令有木方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220358699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"溪流大海水濁，見溪流主漂蕩；見大海，無木爲基，主㐫殘。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220375083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金遇劔鋒釵釧，可以裝餙，有輔成造化之理，故喜見砂海、白鑞無益，有火濟之亦吉，無則終㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220391467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城頭","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220407851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097498438189083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壁上二土有靠安身，城頭多主寄人，壁上加木則貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220407851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再遇燈火，輝光照耀，主權貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220424235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌土中藏火，干支却不宜太炎，亦爲貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220440619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考妙選金命而遇戊寅，崑山片玉格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220457003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯而遇己卯，玉兎東升格也，與前海金同。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220473387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰、辛巳白鑞金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220489771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白鑞金者，崑山片玉，洛浦遺珍，交棲日月之光，凝聚隂陽之氣，形明體潔，乃金之正色也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220506155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此金惟喜火煉，須爐中炎火，然庚辰見之，若無水濟，主貧天。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220522539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳却以貴論，縁已是金生之地，見丙寅化水逢貴故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220538923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山下火生，早主榮貴，亦須水助，方得井泉大溪，俱爲貴","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220555307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097415902789672"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220555307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚官在丁，辛官在丙，故庚見丁丑，官貴俱全。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220571691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛見丙子，不如癸巳更清，不貴卽富。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220588075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論中見水逢多無益，以此金不能相尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220604459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若柱遇無氣之火，𨚫要木生，有祿馬貴人方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220620843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見土只宜磨砌，方成噐物則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220637227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"別土無用金忌海砂爲汨没。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220653611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：時逢火則榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220669995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見清金，加水相助，火亦不愛，只怕衝刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220686379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙選有哨風猛虎格，以此金日時遇辛巳，或乙巳是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220702763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午、乙未，砂中金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220719147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂中金者，剛形布地，寳質藏砂，直教淘洗爲珍，必須因人始貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220735531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此金非爐火則不能制。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220751915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但甲午見丙寅，寅","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220768299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097461410955298"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中火生，寅午合局，柱無長生之土則燥，更値木助，主疾夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220768299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午納音雖水，而支干純火，加逢尤㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220784683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山頭山下覆燈三火，旣有木生尅制，此金又須清水濟之，决主少年榮貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220801067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子己丑，龍火相逢，子午有交搆之妙，甲己有合化之理，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220817451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜以凢火，則不爲竒。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220833835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見水惟宜井泉澗下，天河清淨則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220850219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長溪大流，動而不静，並見則金泛不安。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220866603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海水尤忌見木，有何關係，火衰𨚫喜生扶，更有祿馬貴人互換朝拱爲上。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220882987","marginNoteIdList":nul
