l,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如柱無火，逢一二木則危。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220899371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲午見己巳，是謂採精金於黃磧，乃貴格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220915755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金生於砂，得造化則吉，若更逢砂土，反有埋没","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220932139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097461410938914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220932139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路傍太驛，亦在所忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220948523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有火庻幾城頭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220964907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅、乙未喜見，謂之採精金於青沙，乃貴格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220981291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟丙戌之土，中藏火庫，乃喜見之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164220997675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金爲同類，最喜清氣爲上。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164221014059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海中白鑞，有火制亦得。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164221030443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申癸酉劒鋒金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164221046827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劔鋒金者，白帝司權，剛由百錬。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164221063211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅光射於斗牛，白刄凝於霜雪。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164221079595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此金造化，非水不能生。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164221095979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大溪海水，曰時相逢，爲上格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164221112363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井泉澗下有霹靂助，或得乙卯之雷方好。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164221128747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無雷霹，亦金白水清格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236283967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋生更吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236300351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：時遇長流，在壬辰爲寳劒，化爲青龍。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236316735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳亦得此劔，不能通變。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236333119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097513738895423"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然癸丑爲劒氣衝斗最吉，松栢楊柳亦吉，但多聚散。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236349503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大林平地，嫌有土制，主勞苦。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236365887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火見神龍，隂陽交遇。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236382271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬申逢己丑，癸酉逢戊子，方爲上格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236398655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇天上、爐中二火，無水救，則天諸土見，皆不吉，以其埋没，只壁上城頭，有磨鋒淬礪之用，此二土則可。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236415039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金喜同類，如壬申見壬申，癸酉見癸酉，有木制之，是謂盤根錯節，所以别利噐也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236431423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無木主帶疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236447807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海砂、白鑞，此三金因乙丑獨吉，釵釧成噐，相見亦宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236464191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若柱有未成之金，無加於劔，故最忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236480575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見則性蒙猖狂，戌則金混雜，時中𨚫宜火勝。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236496959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵剱鋒乃金之最利者，只宜水潤，不宜火刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236513343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236529727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097498438238235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見寅巳三刑全者，大㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236529727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌辛亥釵釧金釵釧金者，美容首餙，增光膩肌，猥紅𠋣翠之珍，枕玉眠香之寳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236546111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此金藏之閨閣，惟宜静水，井澗溪流見之皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236562495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多見則泛海水，貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236578879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天河辛亥見之無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236595263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午眞火，庚戌所忌，以午戌凑成火局，有傷此金故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236611647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽火日生顯耀，覆燈火，夜間顯耀，故皆宜見。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236628031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但甲辰、乙巳與庚戌、辛亥相衝，隂陽交見爲玅。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236644415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子、己丑與丙午、丁未相持，二火忌疊，見之，非貧卽夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236660799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爐中火庚戌最忌，辛亥見之，丙辛化水稍吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236677183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山下山頭俱不宜","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236693567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097498438205467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見，若有水濟亦可。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236693567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中有水，此金入於匣中，有福貴方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236709951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土見砂中，相生相養，更有澗下水助，榮華富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236726335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金喜劔鋒，則成造化。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236742719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泊金增光，釵釧須假微火濟之，除此二金，别金無用。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236759103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命中只有金水，更無夾雜，爲金白水清，在活法推之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236775487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子己丑霹靂火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236791871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霹靂火者，一數毫光，九天號令，電掣金蛇之𫝑，雲驅鐡馬之奔。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236808255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此火須資風水雷，方爲變化。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236824639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若五行得値。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236841023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一件皆主亨通。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236857407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如日時見大海，癸亥爲引凢人聖，己丑爲上，□子次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236873791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見大溪，乙卯爲雷火變化，巳晝爲","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236890175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097513738960959"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，戊子忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236890175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰巳爲風，連中遇之尤佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236906559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天上水名爲旣濟，主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236922943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇之者，禀性含靈，聰明特異，長流無用，澗下雖就位相尅，此神火也，不忌，有風亦顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236939327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行見木，辛卯有雷，大林有風，平地有天門，與此火相資，餘木無用，王見路傍，加巽則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236955711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂中丁巳有風，己卯有雷，得泉助之，共主貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236972095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劔金加水，海金遇風，鑞金逢澗，皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164236988479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘金無用，見爐中丁卯爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237004863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子逢丙寅，太燥，性㐫，主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237021247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑見丙申，却得戊子忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237037631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燈火東南巽地有風，最宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237054015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午、己未天上火，日時遇之，防刑尅，再考妙選。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237070399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有烈風雷雨格，卽霹靂見天河是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237086783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有天地","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237103167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097461411020834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中分格，卽戊子見戊午是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237103167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有雷霆得門格，卽戊子己丑日時遇卯是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237119551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三格純戊午，與前說不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237135935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅、丁卯爐中火爐中火者，天地爲爐，隂陽爲炭，騰光輝於宇宙，成陶冶於乹坤。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237152319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此火炎上，喜得木生，惟乎地之木爲上。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237168703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以丙寅見己亥，謂之天乙貴，見戊戌，謂之歸庫，故吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237185087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237201471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然丙寅火自生，無木庻幾。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237217855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯火自敗，若無木則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237234239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且此火以金爲用，更得金來，方應化機。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237250623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但丁卯無木，而更遇金，主勞苦之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237267007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫寅見木，多火炎而無水制，主天。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237283391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯見三四木不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237299775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚寅、辛卯，就位相","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237316159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097513738993727"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生，壬午、癸未化爲眞火，寅見之，多主㐫暴或疾天。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237316159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若天地元有水制，亦主中壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237332543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237348927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此火雖喜得金爲財，内劔金寅見之稍可。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237365311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯火旣自敗，又到申酉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237381695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而死絶如何能尅，非貧卽夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237398079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海中砂鑞諸金，須資木生，方喜見之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237414463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"釵泊無用，見土須先有金與木，𨚫喜土以宿之，不至太燥。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237430847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如城頭屋壁，皆成噐之土，方好見水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237447231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命中先愛木，不然火多喜逢之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237463615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天上清水，寅命遇之爲吉，卯中無木，則嫌大海。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237479999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅見壬戌爲福庫，見癸亥爲官星，帶合，半㐫半吉，井澗溪流皆㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237496383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有木不在此論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237512767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火見同類，若日月上衰敗則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237529151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霹靂火本自","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237545535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097513738977343"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無益，若得木生，更日時有海水則宜，無木遇水㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237545535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天上火須有屋土遮之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237561919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燈火巽風，又爲鼓舞亡神，須兼造化斷。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237578303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙寅、丁酉、己酉丙寅，火爲無氣，不失大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237594687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙寅、甲午、己巳丙寅，則漂泛不安。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237611071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰乙巳覆燈火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237627455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覆燈火者，金盞啣光，玉臺吐艷，照日月不照之處，明天地未明之時。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237643839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此火乃人間夜明之火，以木爲心，以水爲油，遇隂則吉，遇陽則不利。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237660223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢日時最忌再見辰巳，地支有衝，恐風吹燈滅，主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237676607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或以戌亥子丑爲隂，或以自未至亥爲隂。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237692991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行見木爲根本，凢木皆好，更","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237709375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097411603628083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得官星、祿貴相扶，干頭化水尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237709375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限運遇相助，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237725759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水以井泉、澗下爲眞油，長流假油。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237742143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙選有暗燈添油格，卽此理也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237758527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大海河水則不可以爲油，遇者主尋常。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237774911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凢此火見水須資木，不喜長生旺氣，水太泛反㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237791295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命値泊金照耀，最爲清貴，亦須水木相資，方能顯逹。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237807679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂中釵釧二金皆吉，劔鋒一金，謂之燈花，拂劒尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237824063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鑞金不宜，五行見土，須防尅破。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237840447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若壁土可以安身，屋土可以覆庇，日時並見，主福貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237856831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂土有木，亦主衣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237873215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食餘土無用，火愛同類，𨚫怕風吹霹靂，爲龍神變化之火，必帶風來。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237889599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此火難在，天上爐中，二火相見，最㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164237905983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097498438254619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再考玅選。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546662454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有魁星格指南格，以甲辰生人，日時遇午未爲是。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546678838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有火土入堂格，以此火怕風，日時遇丙戌、丁亥屋上土，則燈在屋中，更得添油尤貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546695222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午、己未，天上火，天上火者，温暖山河，輝光宇宙，陽德麗天之照，隂精離海之明。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546711606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午爲太陽則剛，巳未爲太隂則柔，或以爲夏日則剛，冬日則温，誣也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546727990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱要戌亥爲天門，卯酉爲出入之門，東南爲行陸之地則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546744374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此火見木，謂之震折，要日時有風與水，方得大林木有辰巳，松棑、石榴有卯酉，故惟此三木主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546760758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午見木多猶可，未三四","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546777142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097415902855208"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，勞苦之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546777142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見金且能照耀，不能尅濟。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546793526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"釵金有戌亥，泊金有寅卯，主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546809910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劔金爲耀日月之光，必主少年登第，餘金則殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546826294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水宜澗下，須戊午見丁丑，巳未見丙子，隂陽交互，方爲福貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546842678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中更有木滋生，富貴雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546859062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大溪有乙卯，井泉有己酉，出入得門，皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546875446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天河雨露相濟，不以就位尅論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546891830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午見丁未亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546908214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午則不明。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546924598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火愛燈頭，再有别火則燥。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546940982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霹靂帶雲雨，則日月無光，故主昏蒙。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546957366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爐中午忌丙寅，以午爲剛火，𦆵見丙寅，便爲火生之地，若無清水解救，主犯刑㐫死。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546973750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯稍可。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164546990134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土見砂中有巽風相假，路傍城屋皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547006518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中更有金","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547022902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097432394793023"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木資助，尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547022902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考玅選戊午遇卯，巳未遇酉，爲日月分秀格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547039286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而卯以乙卯、辛卯爲正，己卯、丁卯次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547055670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉以乙酉、癸酉爲正，己酉、丁酉次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547072054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有日出扶桑格，卽日分。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547088438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀再見己午日時，有日輪當表格，以戊午生於午月，逢己午日，又以戊午見戊子，爲坎離正位。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547104822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有月生滄海格，卽月分秀，而酉得乙癸是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547121206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有月照寒潭格，是取壬癸亥子納音屬水爲潭，然必秋生爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547137590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有月桂芬芳格，是巳未生人，柱有三四木拱集，與桂林一枝同。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547153974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桂林以少爲貴，芬芳以多爲貴，義各有所取也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547170358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再考㐫格中：太陽損明，戊午不禁於水溢，是嫌水盛；太","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547186742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097415902871592"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂薄食，己未豈堪於土多，是嫌土重也須如是並叅，方𥁞其理。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547186742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申丁酉山下火山下火者，草間熠燿，花𫟚熒煌，寒林綴葉之光，隔幔㸃衣之彩。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547203126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方朔以螢火名之，故玅選有螢火照水格，遇秋生則貴爲卿監，是以此火喜水，地支逢亥子，或納音水，更遇申酉月是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547219510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或以山下之火最喜木與山，更得風來増輝爲貴，又不以熒火論矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547235894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大林木有辰巳爲風，桑柘木有癸丑爲山，松栢平地最吉，更得風助主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547252278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若風多吹散，王夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547268662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水愛井泉澗下，有水相","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547285046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097536342065189"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"資，主爵位崇顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547285046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大海水不宜，然有山亦應貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547301430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯爲東方木旺火生之地，只甲寅水吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547317814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯爲震，有風見之不佳，若無火無山，更加霹火，主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547334198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天上水爲驟雨，此火不宜相見，若先得山水滋助，亦無大害。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547350582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命𫟚有金，以清秀爲吉，無木多逢，以竊氣論之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547366966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑爲山，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547383350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘金若無尅破，遇貴人祿馬，只以財論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547399734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土見砂中，辰巳有風，若有木有山加助，主大貴，無則虛名。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547416118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火忌太陽霹靂，燈頭是巽，主光顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547432502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大都五行有火，須資木則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547448886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限𢿙喜忌，俱依此斷。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547465270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌乙亥山頭火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547481654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097461411069986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山頭火者，野焚燎原，延燒極目，依稀天際斜輝，彷彿山頭落日，此乃九月燒荒衰草𥁞𤑔之火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547498038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大槩宜山木與風木，喜大林松栢，以辰巳有風，寅卯歸祿，臾得癸丑爲山上木，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547514422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無山則木無所依，火無所見，縱有風，亦不光顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547530806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘木無用，只以祿馬看。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547547190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水宜澗下，名爲交泰，主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547563574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井泉清水，有木助之亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547579958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大溪甲戊見甲寅，乙亥見乙卯，𨚫眞祿俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547596342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天上須有雨露，而火到午未得地，再得清水濟之，不至於燥，主福，不然則夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547612726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大海就位，相尅最㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547629110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有山逢之，稍得日時，見金爲財，須有山木助之則吉，無則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547645494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見士惟砂中有巽，","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547661878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097546706124835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能揚此火，别土無益。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547661878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凢此火無木見土，多是下賤之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547678262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見火爐中太炎，霹火卤害，太陽昏蒙，山下戰刑，皆所不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547694646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命帶二三火，如限數逢木，主禍生不測，或夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547711030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大都此火大怕刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547727414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子癸丑桑柘木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547743798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桑柘木者，繒綵鎡基，綺羅根本，士民飄飄之袂，聖賢楚楚之衣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547760182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此木供蚕爲弧，其用甚大。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547776566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最愛砂土以爲根基。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547792950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以辰巳爲蚕食之地，","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547809334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不宜刑衝互破路傍大。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛二土次吉，餘土無益。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547809334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水喜天河，爲雨露之滋，長流溪澗、井泉諸水，皆可相依，亦須先得土爲基，更加祿","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547825718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097432394874943"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547825718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滄海水漂泛無定，無土主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547842102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見火燈頭最吉，亦以辰巳之中爲蚕位故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547858486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爐中位居寅卯，木之旺地，天上霹靂二火，與此木干支有合化之情，有坎離交搆之妙，俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547874870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但諸火不宜疊見，以金言之，砂中第一，劒鋒能脩整，此木爲次。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547891254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"釵泊二金，須得土爲基，如逢衝破，又㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547907638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"术喜庚寅、辛卯，爲以弱就强，以小變大。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547924022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作貴格論，縱無砂土亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547940406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平地栢榴，無土則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547956790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大林乃東南蚕食之位，有土資生，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547973174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇楊柳爲桑柳成林，亦是貴格，須生春夏方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164547989558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅、辛卯松栢木","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548005942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097536342032421"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"松栢木者，撥雪凑霜，參天覆地，風撼笙篁之奏，雨餘旌斾之張。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548005942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此木藏居金下，位列正東，乃爲極旺，最喜山爲根基，水爲滋潤。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548022326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天河雨露之水，可以滋潤澗下。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548038710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑屬山，可爲根基。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548055094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子不如大溪。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548071478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水有乙卯爲雷，可以發榮，𨚫嫌風霹，有損折之凶。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548087862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大海水有山則吉，癸亥清淨，無山亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548104246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若柱有平地，得屋土，則爲已成楝梁無用。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548120630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山水無此二件，乃山間之茂木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548137014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須要山水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548153398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命中有火，最忌爐中就位相生，再加風木，灰飛煙滅。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548169782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行無水，主天折。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548186166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山頭山下，太陽覆燈，皆不可犯。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548202550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅人尤忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548218934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午、丙寅，以木不南奔，寅午三合火局故","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548235318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097411603710003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548235318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯無害，霹火雖可滋生，運加凢火，主㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548251702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土見路傍，似無足貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548268086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無死木，其福還眞。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164548284470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛土無山，貧夭，更加海水尤㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559245348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金逢乙丑，爲印爲山，泊金就位，自旺主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559261732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劒鋒能削能斵，更得壁土相成，松栢相資，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559278116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大林有風，楊柳會火，二木最忌桑柘。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559294500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑爲山，可以相助。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559310884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"石榴是辛酉金，反化死木，有造化，却吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559327268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玅選有蒼松冬秀格，是以此木生人月日時屬三冬爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559343652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有日合辛卯，月値庚寅二格，雖取戊午己未，生居夏秋，然専論此二木爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559360036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰、己巳大林木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559376420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097513739059263"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大林木者，枝幹撼風，柯條撑月，聳壑昻霄之德，凌雲蔽日之功。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559392804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此木生居東南，春夏之交，長養成林，全假艮土爲源。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559409188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑爲山，三命無破䧟，最爲福厚權貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559425572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰爲上，己巳次之，土遇路傍爲負載。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559441956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰見辛未爲貴，己巳見庚午爲祿，主福。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559458340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壁屋二土，再得劒金，則大林之木取爲棟梁，成格最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559474724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無此乃山間茂林之水也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559491108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此木無論死活，皆欲見土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559507492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己人見甲，雖云化土，然不如辰戌丑未土局純全爲玅。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559523876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若此木已死在山之下，見甲戌、乙亥燒之，主㐫夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559540260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燈火就位相生，乙巳不如甲辰更吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559556644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霹靂、太陽二火皆能長育，運中遇之","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559573028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097505446756404"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559573028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然二火𭒡並見持勝，須有士爲根基方可。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559589412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水見天河，戊辰見丁未爲帶貴，雖無土與山，亦主有衣食，卽靈槎入天河格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559605796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生秋冬，𣦸絕，方是溪海。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559622180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二水重見，主貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559638564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有山稍得妙選，有蒼龍駕海格是。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559654948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰見癸亥爲貴，澗下丁丑最吉，丙子不如，諸金俱不宜見海中有乙丑爲山，釰𨦟，得屋壁爲本，餘金無用，逄之，主夭賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559671332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木喜桑柘，惟癸丑最妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559687716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平地還須得路傍土，謂之平林在野。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559704100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"松栢，東方生旺之地，柱有癸丑，而得松柏，爲宻蔭最住。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559720484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午、癸未，楊柳木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559736868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097546706141219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊柳木者，隋堤裊娜，漢苑輕盈，萬縷不蚕之絲，千條不針之帶。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559753252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午未术之𣦸墓，壬癸木之滋潤。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559769636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此木根基，惟喜砂土，見艮山則依倚。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559786020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"揺金遇寅卯，則東方得地。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559802404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑有山，庚子不如。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559818788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅雖吉，巳卯尤勝。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559835172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰、丁巳，却嫌戌亥對衝，若見大驛，有丑爲山邉之驛，稍可。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559851556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無丑獨見此土，主夭賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559867940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路傍就位，復値𣦸墓，日時遇之，主人𤰞弱。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559884324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屋土壬午見丁亥，丁壬合化則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559900708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌不如水，見井泉長流大溪澗下皆吉，中間又分合化旺位尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559917092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午、丁未，丙丁眞火，午未亦火，此木至午未。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559933476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已𣦸壬午，見之大㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559949860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸庻幾有别水濟之，無害。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559966244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此木","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559982628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097536342048805"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午未已自有火，更見别火，恐引起傷壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559982628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燈頭乙巳有風，木折主㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164559999012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爐中寅卯本位木旺，反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560015396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霹火如壬午見己丑，癸未見戊子，陰陽交遇，更有砂土爲基，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560031780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若子午丑未對衝，則不爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560048164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金見本無造化，釵釧金泊，却喜成功。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560064548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海鑞劒砂雖忌見之，其間輕重，當以禄貴德煞参詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560080932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見松栢木，爲脫體化神之格也，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560097316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桑柘癸丑爲山，作倚傍成林，主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560113700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申辛酉，木旣𣦸絕，又逄金尅，以弱遇小，其人必賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560130084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙選有花紅柳縁格，是以此木遇石榴，生於春夏，不以賤論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560146468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有楊柳拖金格，是以此木生於三春，而時得一金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560162852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥、甲子、癸卯、","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560179236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097513739108415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳最妙，乃壬癸禄貴之地故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560179236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申辛酉，石榴木石榴木者，性辛如薑，花紅似火，數顆枝頭纍纍多子，房内瑩瑩。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560195620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支純金，而納音屬木，乃木之變者也，可以移盆内而粧做山，故喜成噐之土，以爲根基。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560212004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城頭爲上，屋上次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560228388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然必陰陽交見，則丙辛、丁庚互官，戊辛巳寅互印，主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560244772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路壁、驛砂四土，有山𦔳之，亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560261156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無何用，見金砂中最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560277540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泊金干支水木而納音金，榴木干支金而納音木，皆脫去本性，而互換歸旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560293924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以木旺寅卯，金旺申酉，各得其位，謂之功侔造化格，主大","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560310308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097432394842175"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560310308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海中乙丑爲山，更逄水𦔳則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560326692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或壁土城頭，亦得劒𨦟就位相尅，最㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560343076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若先有砂金，能制其毒，亦不爲害。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560359460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水見天河，雨露相滋，井泉溪澗，清水澆灌大海，太泛濫，非貧則夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560375844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有艮土，稍得太陽、霹靂二火，雖喜不宜並見。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560392228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爐中寅卯旺位本吉，再加别火，則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560408612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若此木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560424996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於五月日時，止帶一火，謂之石榴噴火，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560441380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桑柘、大林、楊柳三木皆喜見之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560457764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見桑柘，癸丑爲山，見大林，戊辰脫體，見楊柳，花紅柳緑，皆主功名。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560474148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見松栢則強，見平地則大，若無别物夾雜，則縁遶紅園，亦主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560490532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如得城土爲基，水運爲𦔳，享福優游，最爲長久。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560506916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097513739157567"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌、己亥平地木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560523300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平地木者，初生萌葉，始發枝條，惟資雨露之功，不喜雪霜之積。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560539684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃地上之茂材，人間之屋木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560556068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌爲棟，己亥爲梁，最宜互換見之，須以土爲基上愛路傍爲正格，更逄子午尤貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560572452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以子午爲天地正柱故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560588836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屋壁、城頭三土，以此木相資，中間有升化尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560605220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂驛無用，日時見之，主災夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560621604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火愛太陽霹靂，最爲顯耀。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560637988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爐中遇水則福，燈頭無風則固，餘火無水則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560654372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此已成之木，不宜劒金，有木相資，則可泊金増餙光輝。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560670756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又天干合地支旺，更有傍土爲基，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560687140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘金無用。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560703524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水見天河","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560719908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097513739141183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲潤澤，主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560719908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"溪海無山俱㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560736292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井泉、澗下雖吉，内甲申合丁丑爲山，遇之尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560752676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"术見大林，有風動揺，主壽促。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560769060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桑柘癸丑最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560785444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子、己亥人見之爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560801828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌人不堪松栢木倚輔平地爲棟鿄，更有士助，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560818212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵此木惡金而喜水士。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560834596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生三冬時，得寅卯，爲寒谷囘春，亦貴論也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560850980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子、辛丑壁上土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164560867364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壁上土者，恃棟依鿄，興門立戶，却暑禦寒之德，遮霜護雪之功，此乃人間壁土，非平地何以爲靠？","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932538404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午天地正柱，逄之，尤爲吉慶。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932554788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡見木皆可爲主。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932571172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅、辛卯","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932587556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097513739190335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦是棟鿄，只辛酉衝破，子卯相刑，大林有風，若無承載之土，加凡火，主作事難成，貧賤而夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932587556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土愛路傍，謂之負載，屋上城頭，可以護身，皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932603940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見火全無造化，太陽霹靂，雖云照耀，到底蹇危。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932620324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命先巳見木，遇火，助鬼焚尅，運再逢之，主禍患夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932636708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱有水救濟，稍得水見，甲申爲最吉，乙酉次之，天上雨露亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932653092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大海漂泛，此土何安？","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932669476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有根基，亦㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932685860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸金惟愛泊金，命裏，先有木神則貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932702244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以其成宫室而金碧輝煌，非朝廷不敢用也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932718628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劔金傷害，餘金無用。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932735012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅己卯城頭土","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932751396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097522001690678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城頭土者，天京玉壘，帝里金城，龍盤千里之形，虎踞四維之勢。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932751396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此土有成有未成，作兩般論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932767780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇見路傍爲已成之土，不必月火；若無路傍爲未成之土，必須用火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932784164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大都城土皆須資木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932800548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊柳癸未最隹，壬午則忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932816932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桑柘，癸丑爲上，壬子次之，庚寅、辛卯，就位相尅，則城崩不寕，何以安人也耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932833316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如見木無夾輔，只以貴人禄馬論之，見水有山爲顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932849700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申、丁丑俱吉，天河滋𦔳亦吉，惟忌霹靂、大海，壬戍不忌合化，俱以吉推。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932866084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土愛路傍，防見諸火，大驛逄山，須作貴觀。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932882468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若獨見無根本，貧夭孤寒。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932898852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行見金，只有白鑞、怕巽，二者相妨，餘金","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932915236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097536342081573"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無用，亦須以貴人禄馬㸔之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932915236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰、丁巳砂中土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932931620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂中土者，浪囘所積，波渚而成，龍蛇盤隱之宫，陵谷變遷之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932948004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此土清秀，惟喜淸金養之，更得清淨之土，主早貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932964388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"釵砂、劒泊，此四金清秀相𦔳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932980772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙人見辛亥，爲丙丁入於乹戶，號曰駕海長虹，又有星拱北之論，皆貴格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164932997156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更得水相涵，尤爲土吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933013540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無水而時日得天上火照亦可。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933029924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙辰、乙未、癸酉、戊午，此命有二金資養，却全無水，得太陽火照，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933046308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁巳、癸卯、己未。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933062692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申此命，二金資養，得天土火照亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933079076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然戊午太燥，","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933095460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097536342097957"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未稍緩，壽夭不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933095460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水以井澗清潔爲吉，若有金以養之，貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933111844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此土已得金養，而日時有海水，便壞造化。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933128228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥輕清，丙人見之，限運逢，亦主顯榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933144612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘水無用。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933160996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火喜太陽在格，號爲朱雀騰空，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933177380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山頭山下，爐中覆燈。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933193764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸火若無水濟，主壽夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933210148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木愛桑柘楊柳，以此土能栽二木故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933226532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘木却以禄馬貴人𠫭之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933242916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如日中刑破衝尅之木，雖見有何造化，不如無爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933259300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行最忌土相刑，路傍安身，有金木資生，亦主福慶。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933275684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大驛徃來，最不宜見，縱有金水亦㐫，餘土尢不爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933292068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午、辛未路傍土，","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933308452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097546706223139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路傍土者，大地連途，平田萬頃，禾稼頼以資生，草木由之暢茂。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933308452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃火煖土温，長養萬物之土也，故須假水爲先，乃灌漑滋潤之論次第尤宜水化爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933324836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更得金來相𦔳，則禾稼成實。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933341220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚午見甲申，辛未見乙酉，爲禄，若無衝破，主早貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933357604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天上水雨露相滋，庚午喜見丁未，辛未喜見丙午，爲官貴禄合之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933373988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澗下庚午見丁丑，貴禄交馳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933390372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未見丙子，化水逄生大溪。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933406756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯爲雷，能發生此土，又乙庚合化，故皆主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933423140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長流大海二水，以其不能澆灌此土，故最忌之，主㐫夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933439524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火逢霹靂，庚午見巳丹，貴禄交穿；辛未見戊子，印貴朝陽，皆吉","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933455908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097513739173951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933455908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上火就位相生，太燥則土反不能生物，有水潤之始得。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933472292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若獨見主夭，爐中火亦燥，亦主妨壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933488676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燈頭有屋土，方應造化名超凢入聖，不然亦㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933505060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見木可以發生，然有貴人禄馬則吉，刑煞衝破則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933521444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只有庚寅木此。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933537828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土逄之，大好大林不能勝載。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933554212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逄土位，見丙辰、丙戊、辛丑、辛未皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933570596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若庚午見辛未，辛未見庚午，爲二儀貴偶，無有不貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933586980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"釵釧砂中二金，可以滋𦔳淸水，金水並見，大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933603364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命己見水，無金運，遇此金亦福。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933619748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑海金可爲山論，若得天河淸水助之，庚人大好，妙選有金馬嘶風格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933636132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以庚午、甲午生人，得辛巳時，有馬化龍","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933652516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097546706206755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"駒格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933652516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以午生人見辰時，有哨風猛虎格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933668900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以庚辛生人，得辛巳、乙巳，俱以貴論，而水火土金似不相拘。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933685284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申己酉大驛土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933701668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大驛土者，堂堂大道，坦坦平途，九州無所不通，萬國無行不至。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933718052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃位屬坤方，德乃厚載，輪天轉日，負海乘山之土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933734436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤼵生萬物，以木爲基。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933750820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申長生之土，德厚無疆，見三四木，皆能滋生。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933767204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉自敗之土，术多則竊氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933783588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大林合中逢衝主夭，别木則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933799972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更以禄貴𠫭之，井泉、澗下二水，清貴不燥。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933816356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊申見丁丑或乙酉，己酉見丙子或甲申，謂之官貴主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933832740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天河丙午而己酉","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933849124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097498438385691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得之，丁未而戊申得之，亦爲貴禄，主福長流。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933849124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申見癸己，巳酉見壬辰，亦吉，多逢則不寕静。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933865508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大溪乙卯，爲東震發生之義，单見亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933881892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海水對穿，土不能勝日，時遇主夭，得山稍輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933898276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内戊申見癸亥，戊癸合申亥，爲地天交泰，反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933914660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火見太陽霹靂，謂之聖火，最能發生此土，如逄水𦔳，主顯達。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933931044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘凡火，再逄木生之更燥，主㐫夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933947428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行見土，惟路傍最宜，屋上、壁上、砂中，縱先得木，亦爲冺絕。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933963812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城頭有水，稍吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933980196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命若有金，清秀吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164933996580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"釵釧得辛亥，金泊得壬寅、戊申遇之，柱中更加水𦔳，乃地。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164934012964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天交泰水遶山𤨔，大格主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164934029348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉見庚戌，癸卯稍次。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164934045732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097522001707062"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂金造化亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164934062116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劒金，須候木得用，不然無益。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164934078500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌丁亥，屋上土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164934094884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屋上土者，埏埴爲林，水火旣濟，葢蔽雪霜之積，震凌風雨之功。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164934111268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此土瓦也，非木無以架之，故以木爲根基。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164934127652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平地爲上，大林次之，餘取天干化木亦吉，只怕衝破。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164934144036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此已成之土，不宜見火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164934160420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爐中丙寅最㐫，丁卯稍可，太陽霹靂，可取相資。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949315647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山下山頭有木，生之則禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949332031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燈頭丙戌見乙巳爲上，丁卯見甲辰次之，謂之火土入堂格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949348415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若柱中木多，亦不爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949364799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水宜天河、井泉、澗下皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949381183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如先得平地木，成格大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949397567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"溪流無木多夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949413951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若丙戌而得","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949430335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097546706337827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳，丁□而得甲寅，則又别論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949430335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再看日時所成造化何如。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949446719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大海無山，則不宜見土，土見路傍，如丙戌得辛未，丁亥得庚午，陰陽互見，更假木爲基，主貴，壁土亦宜，餘則汨没。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949463103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若缺木而三刑聚，縱是二土亦㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949479487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂土獨丁巳不妨，金惟劒鋒、釵釧最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949495871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁見壬申，天干化木，地支乾坤清夷。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949512255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙見辛亥，天干化水，地支丙入乹戸，皆大貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949528639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若丁亥見庚戌，丙戌見癸酉，則不爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949545023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泊金有粉餙之用，亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949561407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘金無用，當以貴祿𠫭詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949577791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子丁丑，□下水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949594175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
