{"lines":[{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澗下水者，山環細浪，雪湧飛湍，相連南北之流，對峙","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949610559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097522001739830"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離之□，此水清澄，喜見金養，砂中劒鋒二金，最宜釵釧。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949610559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戍、丁丑不宜以丑戍相刑，辛亥見丙子，則丙辛化水尤貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949626943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘金以祿貴𭆞之，取其資生，惡其衝破，見木一位不妨，二三則主勞苦，亦以貴人祿馬𠫭之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949643327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命中見土，主人多濁。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949659711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元若木或化水，則主清吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949676095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂中屋上二土，其氣稍清，路傍大驛，則濁甚矣，主財散禍生。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949692479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰戌丑未土局，其㐫尤甚，以水濁土渾故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949708863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火見太陽，雖炎，中間有旣濟、未濟之論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949725247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霹靂就位相争，最所不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949741631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若二火並臨，無金資𦔳，主荒滛。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949758015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有金别論，山下山頭亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949774399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若並臨時日，則嫌命中遇水，反成","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949790783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097546706272291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漂蕩。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949790783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見天河爲引凡入聖，見大海爲福貴朝宗，皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949807167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨丁丑見壬戌，則丑戌相刑，丁壬滛合，主風聲不雅。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949823551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大溪性急，長流不静，皆不爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949839935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵此水須以金爲主，而無火土夾雜，再得甲寅乙卯之水，則源遠流淸，眞君子人也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949856319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅、乙卯大溪水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949872703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大溪水者，驚濤薄岸，駭浪浮天，光涵萬里之寛，碧倒千山之影，最喜有歸有養，遇坎則爲有歸，得金則爲有養。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949889087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所𭒡者，日月時中，有申酉衝動，或辰巳風吹，主飄𣴑井泉水淨而止。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949905471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澗下有丑爲艮，天河沾潤，大海","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949921855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1846","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097505446789172"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝□，此四水皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949921855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長流有風，獨不宜見。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949938239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此水以清金爲𦔳養，惟釵砂最宜，鑞金亦清，若有釵金對衝，則不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949954623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海中雖無造化，甲子屬坎，乙丑爲艮，乃歸源之地，亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949971007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泊金最微，不能相生，豈有超顯之理。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164949987391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劔金雖化於大溪，却忌卯雷巽風，主性不定。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950003775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行有土，皆爲無益。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950020159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屋上城頭壅阻，此水路傍稍可，亦不爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950036543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壁上獨辛丑爲山，大驛，惟己酉有合，戊申則衝，庚子則刑，皆不爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950052927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火見太陽，雖假照燿，霹靂尤忌相逢。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950069311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若二火互見，主貧卑。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950085695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見别論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950102079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木見此水，徒被漂蕩，惟桑柘木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950118463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子有坎，癸丑爲山，爲水遶山環之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950134847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内甲寅人見","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950151231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1862","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097546706321443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子吉，乙卯人見癸丑吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950151231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘木以禄貴𠫭之，尤忌衝破。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950167615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰癸巳長流水長流水者，混混無窮，滔滔不竭，就下必納於東南，順流自歸於辰巳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950183999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此水喜金生養，金要白鑞釵釧，以天干有庚辛眞金，地支辰巳，就位相生，戌亥爲歸源之地，劒鋒純是金水，泊金，水木居東，皆以吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950200383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海中砂中無取，嫌土蹇涸，而土有隄防之用。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950216767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六土之中，取庚辛、丙丁爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950233151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳無用，遇火則相刑，而有旣濟之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950249535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内壬辰喜見丁卯、丁酉，癸巳喜見戊子、戊午，以天干","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950265919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1871","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097498438336539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合化故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950265919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燈頭癸巳尤喜見甲辰，山頭壬辰尤喜遇乙亥。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950282303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化龍歸禄，取義更佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950298687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢木雖漂泛而桑柘癸丑爲山，楊柳癸未爲園，年時得此水圍之，爲水遶花堤，大貴格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950315071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"松栢石榴，天干有金相生，大林平地，雖嫌有土，而癸巳見戊辰，壬辰見己亥，俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950331455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水爲同類。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950347839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澗下則丁壬合化，天上則雨露相資，井泉大溪無益。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950364223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海乃衆流所歸，而壬辰之龍，得癸亥，則龍躍天門，春夏秋生爲吉；或龍潜大海，則冬生乃宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950380607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中須先得金爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950396991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又壬辰爲自印之水，再見壬辰則刑，刑則自害，見戊戌則衝，衝則泛濫，主㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950413375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳自絕之水，名爲涸","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950429759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1883","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097546706370595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流，若遇丙戌、丁亥、庚子、辛丑之土，其涸可待。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950429759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中如得三合生旺之金生之則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950446143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午丁未天河水天河水者，亂灑六野，宻沛千郊，淋淋瀉下銀河，細細飛來碧落。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950462527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃天上雨露發生，萬物，無不頼之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950478911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"銀漢之水，土不能尅，故見土不忌，而且有滋潤之益。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950495295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天上之水，地金難生，故見金難益，而亦有𣷉秀之情。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950511679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺太過，則爲滛潦，反傷於物；𣦸絶太多，則爲旱乾，又不。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950528063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能生物，要生三秋得時爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950544447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水喜長流大海内丙午宜癸巳、癸亥，丁未宜壬辰、壬戌，陰陽互見尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950560831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950577215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1894","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097576548597823"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"溪乙卯爲雷，井泉己酉爲貴，俱以吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950577215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火喜霹靂，爲神龍之火，與此水相濟，而倐忽變化，雲行雨施，豈有不貴？","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950593599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爐中火旺，大海水旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950609983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如柱中得二火二水，上下相濟，謂之精神俱足，大貴格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950626367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燈頭有風，山頭有貴，皆以吉論，又須以别水濟之方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950642751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天上就位，相尅則忌見之术。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950659135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"石榴、楊柳俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950675519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大林有巽，平地有亥，亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950691903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"松栢石榴，遇丙辛合化，亦以吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950708287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙選有靈槎入天河格，是取𣦸絶無根之木，柱無土培，則漂流天河是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950724671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土雖不能尅，而柱逄庚午辛未，就位和尅，土壅水滯，或水又冬生，則水結池塘，必主濁濫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950741055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘士如砂中","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950757439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1907","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097536342147109"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屋上皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950757439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城頭大驛無用，壁上地支對衝，亦瓌造化。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950773823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水金雖不能生，獨辛亥釵金却屬乹天，水在天上，只此最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950790207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘金亦取天千有庚辛、壬癸者爲用，甲乙無益，再以禄馬貴人𠫵之，始得妙選。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950806591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以水生人，得庚子、壬子，爲雲騰雨施，生春則旱，夏則潦，冬則寒，獨三秋最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950822975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇甲辰、乙巳、庚辰、辛巳，柱中有壬爲雲，有辰爲龍，爲風雨作霖。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950839359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生冬月，是爲霜凝薄露。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950855743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時喜遇寅卯，温和之氣，可觧斯凍，俱貴格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950872127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申乙酉井泉水井泉水者，寒泉淸冽，取養不窮，八家鑿之以同飮，萬","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950888511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1917","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097559423254578"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"民資之以生活。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950888511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此水生於金而出於木，故喜見金爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950904895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂中有土性，與之最宜，釵釧清秀次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950921279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鑞金與釵金相衝，故不宜再見劔鋒。","logicSentenceId":"7577379164950937663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉太旺，恐有泛濫之災。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247111210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"海金無取。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247127594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑爲艮，山下出泉亦吉，此非木不能岀，譬之桶論，故見木皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247143978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如見平地大林，須假劒金削之，方可取用。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247160362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桑柘、楊柳無用松栢，則互換歸禄，此其最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247176746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸谷陰陽互見則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247193130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霹靂名爲入聖，太陽號爲顯照，二火相見最吉，但不宜並有則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247209514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸土路傍砂中最吉，屋上有天門生水之源亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247225898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城頭壁上典此水，則無干涉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247242282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大驛就位相尅，水爲土掩，則井渫不食，","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247258666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1932","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097546706354211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須有木去之方可。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247258666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水喜大海爲引凡入聖，天上澗下長流，亦不爲災。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247275050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大溪甲寅、乙卯爲吉，如甲申見乙酉，乙酉見甲申，官星互換最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247291434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如二水在年時，二木在月日，謂之水遶花堤，乃貴格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247307818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌、癸亥大海水大海水者，總納百川，汪洋無際，包括乾坤之大，升沉日月之光。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247324202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此水原有清濁，以兩般分論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247340586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戍有土氣爲濁，癸亥干支純水，而納音又水，故清。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247356970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌人嫌山，以土氣太盛，有金清之，方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247373354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥最喜見山，然後海水之性始安。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247389738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澗下丁丑爲山，天河與海，上下相通，柱","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247406122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1943","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097522001805366"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中有木爲槎，則乘槎入於天河，極爲上格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247406122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長流、大溪等水，畢竟皆歸於海，以海水不擇細流，故能成其大也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247422506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰爲龍，歸大海尤吉，中間又分陰陽互見，干支合化方可。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247438890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井泉則有所制，與海不通，故不喜見之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247455274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸金獨海中第一，以壬戌、癸亥喜見甲子、乙丑，砂中亦得餘金，又當以貴人禄馬𠫵之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247471658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火喜天上，與海水相爲照耀，最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247488042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霹靂己丑爲山，戊癸合化，柱得木火旺地亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247504426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山下山頭覆燈。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247520810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸火不宜見木，惟壬子、癸丑、壬午、癸未俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247537194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大林有風衝動，水性不安，平地厚載。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247553578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則就位相得。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247569962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"松栢石榴，若無土制，則漂泊無定。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247586346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土愛","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247602730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1957","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097559423320114"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路傍大驛，惟此二土，足以振之不泄。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247602730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况癸亥見戊申，爲天關地軸大格，日時遇此𫝗土，總有風雷，亦不爲害。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247619114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城頭己卯，須資艮則吉，加逄霹靂，則雷火變化，海水洶湧，亦主貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247635498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六十甲子納音取象，其十干有可以爲金，有不可以爲金者，雖因所値之數不同，而五行類化類從之妙，其理亦不可不知。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247651882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲乙、庚辛、壬癸，此三行者，可以爲金，而丙丁、戊己不與焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247668266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛元金，固爲本家之物，壬癸非金也，又胡爲金？","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247684650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以金水相生之理，而水亦可以爲金，故世有水碧金明之物。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247701034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙之木，其質堅強，","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247717418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1966","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097522001821750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世有木化爲石者，可以例見，故此二者可以取象爲金，與本家之物同也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247717418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁屬火，燥剛不同；戊巳屬土，柔剛不同，與金相反，自不可以金論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247733802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳、庚辛、壬癸，此六干者，可以爲木，而甲乙、丙丁不預焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247750186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以丙丁元火，所以焚木，自不可取；甲乙原木，胡不取之？","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247766570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知五行中，金還金，水還水，火還火，土還土，獨木則變，以木資火、水土之性，假合而生，脉絕而枯槁，則還水也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247782954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灼之爲火，則還火也，腐之爲土，則還土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247799338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故不用木，所以脫體而化神也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247815722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲輪環，所值之數，五行錯綜，所得之理，自可以黙識矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247832106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡木皆水所生，其津液卽","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247848490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1976","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097559423287346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水也，故壬癸可以爲木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247848490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛之質，其堅與甲乙同，故甲乙可以爲金，而庚辛可以爲木。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247864874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"互換交通，其理亦無二也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247881258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁、甲乙、壬癸取象爲水，以壬癸原水也，丙丁其化也，甲乙之津液卽水也，戊巳之土，所以尅水。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247897642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛之金，所以燥水，氣有異也，自不可以水論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247914026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙、丙丁、戊巳取象爲火，以丙丁原火也，戊巳其化也，甲乙之生燃，卽火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247930410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸之水，所以尅火，庚辛之金，所以燥火，類不同也，自不可以火論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247946794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁、戊巳，庚辛納音屬土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247963178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳原土也，丙丁之火，化而爲灰，灰卽土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247979562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛之金，混於土中，乃土之精氣所結，故皆可以爲","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247995946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1987","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097536342163493"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165247995946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若壬癸之水，潤下不凝，甲乙之木，散上不止，自不可以土論。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248012330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"究其取象，有輕重，有大小，有剛柔，有氣味，有體質，有功用，各各不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248028714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此又兼地支方隅之位，旺相休囚不同，而天干之所值，或從本象，或從化象，或從别象，天人交𥁞其理，生尅互成其義，此金所以有海中、沙中、金泊、白鑞、劔鋒、釵釧之别，而金之象無餘藴矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248045098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘木火水土，可以例見。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248061482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此納音取象，所以爲造化之妙也歟？","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248077866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：五行之中，惟水火不宜太旺，旺則不可救藥，故丙午丁未，配以天河水，以水能制火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248094250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戈午己未，謂之天上火，以戊巳葢其上，則火不熖也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248110634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1996","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097522001854518"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午未在天之中，丙丁屬火，皆午未旺鄉，故歴代遇此二年皆不靖。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248127018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以理論，而非原取象之義，然亦不可不知。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248143402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再按納音取象，出自黄帝，故諸術家皆宗之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248159786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自徐大升作定眞論，有婁景以前未知金在海中之論，而元之星士遂有納音空自失天眞之說。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248176170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故今之談命者，只論正五行，而納音不取焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248192554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知納音之理，取象之精，此正造化之所以爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248208938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡論人命，尤不可不推究而體察之，以盡其微也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248225322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今陰陽家論先天老五行，而不取洪範五行，目爲㓕蠻經，以其顚倒陰陽，反易水火太和周視作陰陽定論，乃深闢之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248241706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西蜀羅靑","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248258090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2006","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097596605775924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霄作陰陽辨疑，以洪範五行出自八卦，斷不可不用，又闢周氏之見爲誣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248258090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"噫，何前後無定說也耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248274474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余見納音五行，卽洪範五行之義，不可舉一廢一。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248290858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"談命者本之以五行爲經，𠫵之以納音爲緯，庶足以盡命數之理，而造化無餘蕰忿論曰：自天地開闢，而干支之名卽立，相傳出自天皇地呈，而錯綜爲六十甲子，則自伏羲造甲暦始也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248307242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣名用暦，則年月日時皆以六十甲子紀之，而天地之始終，日月之運行，四時之寒暑，陰陽之變化，皆不能易。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248323626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三反以定，自黄帝以六十甲子納音取象，於是五","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248340010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2013","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097559423336498"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行各有所屬，而金木水火上之性情形質，功用變化，悉𥁞其藴，而易自在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248340010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故以此而測兩儀，則天地不能逃；以此而推三光，則日月星辰不能變；以此而察四時，則寒暑不能易；以此而占人事，則吉㐫禍福，壽夭窮通，舉不能外，而造化無遁情矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248356394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之儒者，但知八卦畫自伏羲、文王重之爲六十四，周公作爻辭，孔子作繋辭，以易更四聖而後成，謂之經，目五行家爲九流，其亦不思甚矣！","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248372778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈以五行家専論生旺而昧正理，委天命而棄人事，與易道不合耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248389162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼！","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248405546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支出自上古，甲子本之羲皇，音象傳自皇帝，是數聖人","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248421930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2020","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097522001870902"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，豈在文王、周公、孔子後耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248421930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若天地開闢而干支之名不立，則不能錯綜爲甲子。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248438314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無六十甲子，則不能錯綜五行，何以紀曆成歲，而一年有三百六十日，歲有十二月，月有三十日，日有十二時，孰從而明之？","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248454698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孰從？","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248471082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而知之，而舉世渾渾沌沌，如在洪濛之中，何以立兩間，𠫭三才而成世界也耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248487466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以百姓日用而不知，終身由之而不察者是矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248503850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易道雖微，不過因天地定位，山澤通氣，雷風相薄，水火不相射，取象以畫八卦，其理自不出干支甲子之外，而别有所創置也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248520234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼！","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248536618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支錯綜而爲六十八卦，錯綜而爲六十四甲子，以數","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248553002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2030","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097576548663359"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納音，以理取象，乃五行之正也，而八卦之體已僃。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248553002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦仰觀俯察，遠取諸物，近取諸身，爲六十四卦，三百六十四爻，亦一年之數也，而干支之用以行。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248569386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支本天地以爲經，八卦道陰陽以爲緯，經緯錯綜，徃來變化，而天地之藴奥，鬼神之情狀，人事之吉㐫，盡在其中，而其義微矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248585770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世之儒者，又烏可鄙五行爲九流哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248602154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論五行五行者，徃來乎天地之間而不窮者也，是故謂之行。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248618538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北方陰極而生寒，寒生水；南方陽極而生熱，𤍠生火；東方陽散以泄而生風，風生木；西方陰止以收而生","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248634922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2037","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097546706403363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燥，燥生金；中央陰陽交而生濕，濕生土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248634922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其相生也，所以相維，其相尅也所以相制，此之謂有倫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248651306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火爲太陽，性炎上，水爲太陰，性潤下；木爲少陽，性騰上而無所止；金爲少陰，性沉下而有所止。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248667690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土無常性，視四時所乗，欲使相濟得所，勿令太過弗及。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248684074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行之性，各致其用，水者其性智，火者其性禮，木者其性仁，金者其性義。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248700458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟土主信，重厚寛愽，無所不容。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248716842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以之水，則水附之而行，以之木，則木托之而生。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165248733226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金不得土則無自出，火不得土則無自歸，必損實以爲通，致虛以爲明，故五行皆賴士也，推其形包，則水黒、火赤、木青、金白、土","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263888403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2046","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097559423352882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄，此正色也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263888403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及其變易則不然。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263904787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常以生旺從正色，當生旺則正氣全可","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263921171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2050","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見正色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸絶從母色，","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263921171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2052","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水者木之母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"从絶則黑。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263921171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木者火之母，𣦸絕則青；火者，土之母，𣦸絶則赤；土者金之母，𣦸絶則黄。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263937555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行𣦸絶，則氣歸根，見母之色。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263953939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人遇","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263970323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2057","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"苦楚而呻吟母者，乃其義也。成形。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冠帶，從妻色，","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263970323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2059","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"少壯之年，及衰老之際，仰妻之時也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病敗從鬼色，","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263970323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2061","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"病敗之地，是鬼旺之鄕，受尅則氣歸鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺墓從子色，","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263970323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2063","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺爲傳墓，爲歛藏，故色在於子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其數則水一、火二，木三，金四土五，生旺加倍，𣦸絕减半。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263970323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以義推之，夫萬物負陰而抱陽，冲氣以爲和，過與不及，皆爲","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263986707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2066","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097559423369266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乖道。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165263986707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故高者抑之使平，下者舉之使崇，或益其不及，或損其太過，所以貴在折衷，歸於中道，使無有餘不足之累。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264003091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽財官印食、貴人驛馬之微意也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264019475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行運亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264035859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識其微意，則於命之說，思過半矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264052243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2072","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金喜木象土生，空亡煆煉，忌木旺火旺、墓敗等火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水寒金銷，刑煞尅害。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264068627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金以至陰爲體，中含至陽之精，乃能堅剛，獨異衆物。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264085011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若獨陰而不堅，氷雪是也，遇陽則消矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264101395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故金不煉不成噐。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264117779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聚金無火，難成脫朴之名。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264134163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金重火輕，執事繁難；金輕火重，煆煉消亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264150547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金極火盛，爲格最精。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264166931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金火全名","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264183315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2081","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097576548679743"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鑄印，犯丑字卽爲損摸。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264183315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金火多名乗軒，遇𣦸衰，反爲不利。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264199699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大火煉金，幸功名而退速；純金凑水，遇富顯以嬴餘。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264216083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金能生水，水旺則金沉；土能生金，金貴則土賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264232467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金無水乾枯，水重則沉淪無用；金無土𣦸絶，土重則埋没不顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264248851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩金兩火最上。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264265235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩金兩木財足，一金生三水，虛弱難勝；一金得三木，頑鈍自損，金成則火滅。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264281619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故金未成噐，欲得見火；金已成噐，不欲見火。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264298003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金到申酉己丑，亦可謂之成也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264314387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜西比，不利南方，生於春月。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264330771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘寒未𥁞，貴乎火氣爲榮，性柔體弱，欲得厚土輔𦔳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264347155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水盛増寒，難施𨦟銳之勢；木旺損力，反招剉鈍之危。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264363539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2094","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097536342212645"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金來比取，扶持最喜，比而無火，失類非良。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264379923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏月之金，性尚在柔，形未執方，尤嫌𣦸絶。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264396307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火多而却爲不厭，水盛而滋體呈祥，見木而助鬼傷身，遇金而扶持精壯。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264412691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土薄而最爲有用，土厚而埋没無光。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264429075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋月之金，當權得令，火來煉煆，遂成鍾鼎之材；土多培養，反爲頑濁之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264445459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見水則精神越秀，逢木則琢削施威。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264461843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金𦔳愈剛，剛過必缺；氣重愈旺，旺極則害。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264478227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月之金，形寒性冷，木多則難施琢削之功，水盛而未免沉潜之患。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264494611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土能制水，金體不寒。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264510995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火來取士，子母成功。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264527379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜比肩聚氣相扶，欲官印温養爲利。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264543763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097505446854708"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264560147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜𤥨削生扶𦔳火土培玍旺，地靣有黨成林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌𥤧折，飄落空亡，動揺𣦸絶，枯槁自焚，耗泄濕爛。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264560147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木性騰上而無所止，氣重則欲金任使；木有金則有惟高惟歛之德。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264576531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仍愛土重則根蟠深固，土少則有枝茂根危之患。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264592915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木頼水生，少則滋潤，多則漂流。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264609299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌乙亥木之源，甲寅乙卯木之鄉，甲辰乙巳木之生，皆活木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264625683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申乙酉术受尅，甲午乙未木自𣦸，甲子乙丑金尅木，皆𣦸木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264642067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生木欲火而秀，丙丁亦然；𣦸木得金而造，庚辛必利。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264658451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生木見金自傷，𣦸木得火自焚，無風卽止，其勢亂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264674835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇水返化其源，其勢𥁞也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264691219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木相","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264707603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097546706436131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"等，格謂斵輪，若向秋生，反爲傷斧。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264707603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是秋生忌金重也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264723987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰木重火，舌辨能言。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264740371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於春月，餘寒猶有，喜火温燠，别無盤屈之拘；藉水資扶，而有舒暢之美。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264756755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春初不宜水盛，陰濃則根損枝枯；春末陽氣煩燥，無水則葉摘。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264773139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"根乾是以木火二物，旣濟方佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264789523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土多而損力，土薄則財豐，忌逄金重，傷殘克伐，一生不閑。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264805907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"設使木旺，得金爲良，終身獲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264822291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏月之木，根乾葉燥，盤而且直，屈而己伸，欲其水盛而成滋潤之力，誠不可少；忌其火旺而招焚化之憂，故獨爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264838675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜土在薄，不宜重厚，厚則反爲災咎；惡金在多，不可欠缺，缺則不能琢削。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264855059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重重","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264871443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2131","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097522001903670"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見木，徒以成林；疊疊逄華，終無結菓。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264871443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋月之木，氣漸凄凉，形漸凋敗。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264887827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初秋之時，火氣未除，猶喜水土以相滋；中秋之令，果已成實，欲得剛金而修削。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264904211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霜降後不宜水盛，水盛則木漂；寒露節又喜火炎，火炎則木實。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264920595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木多有多材之美，土厚無己任之才。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264936979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月之木，盤屈在地，欲土多而培養，惡水盛而亡形；金總多不能尅伐；火重見温燠成功，歸根復命之時，木病安能輔𦔳。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264953363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟忌𣦸絶，只宜生旺，水","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264969747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜淸潔寛逺相生，火濟潤下西北。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌空亡，泛濫尅害，木多氣寒，枯涸𣦸絶、焦燥等土。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264969747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2141","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097576548728895"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天傾西北，亥爲出水之方，地陷東南，辰爲納水之府，逆流到由而作聲，故水不西流。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165264986131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之性潤下，順則有容。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265002515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順行十二辰，順也，主有度量，有吉神扶𦔳，乃貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265018899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逆則有聲，逆行十二辰，逆也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265035283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八格者，主清貴，有聲譽，忌刑衝則横流；愛自𣦸自絶，則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265051667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水不絕源，仗金生而流遠；水流泛濫，頼十尅以堤防。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265068051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火均則合旣濟之美，水上混則有濁源之㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265084435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四時皆忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265100819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火多則水受渇；忌見土重，則水不流；忌見金𣦸，金𣦸則水囚；忌見木旺，木旺則水𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265117203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沈芝云：水命動摇，多主濁濫，陰人尤忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265133587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口訣云：陽水身弱窮陰水，身弱貴生於春月。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265149971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097536342261797"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性濫滔滛，再逄水助，必有崩是之勢；若加士盛，則無泛漲之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265166355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜金生扶，不冝金盛；欲火旣濟，不要火多。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265182739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見木而可以施功，無土而仍愁散漫。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265199123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏月之水，執性歸源，時當涸際，欲得比肩。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265215507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜金生而𦔳體，忌火旺而太炎。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265231891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛則耗盜其氣，土旺則尅制其流。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265248275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋月之水，母旺水相，𫟚瑩表光。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265264659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得金𦔳則能清澄，逢土旺則𭒡混濁。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265281043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火多而財盛，太過不宜；木重而妻榮，中和爲利。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265297427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重重見水，増其泛濫之憂；叠叠逄土，始得清平之意。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265313811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月之水，司令專權，遇火則増煖除寒，見土則形藏歸化。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265330195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金多反曰無義，术盛是謂有情。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265346579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土太過尅制水","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265362963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2167","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097505446871092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265362963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水泛漲，喜土爲堤。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265379347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265395731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2171","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜和煖生助空亡火上高，土照水濟遠。忌局促急燥、清冷水，重木雜黨，枯木敗𣦸水之木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"炎炎眞火，位鎭南方，故火無不明之理；輝光不久，全要伏藏，故明無不滅之象。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265395731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火以木爲體，無木則火不長熖；火以水爲用，無水則火太酷烈，故火多則不實，太烈則傷物。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265412115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"术能藏火，到寅卯而方生，火不利西，遇申酉而必𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265428499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生居離位，果斷有爲；若居坎宫，謹畏守禮。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265444883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金得火和，則能鎔鑄；水得火和，則成旣濟。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265461267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇土不明，多主蹇塞；逄水旺處，决定爲榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265477651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木𣦸火虛，難得永","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265494035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097505446887476"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"久；縱早功名，必不久長。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265494035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春忌見木，惡其焚也；夏忌見土，惡其暗也；秋忌見金，金旺難尅制；冬忌見水，水旺則滅形。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165265510419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故春火欲明，不欲炎，炎則不實；秋火欲藏，不欲明，明則燥；冬火欲生，不欲殺，殺則暗。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570072639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於春月，母旺子相，勢力並行。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570089023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜木生扶，不宜過旺，旺則火炎；欲水旣濟，不愁興盛，盛則沾恩；土多則蹇塞埋光；火盛則傷多爆燥。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570105407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見金可以施功，縱重叠妻財，猶遂夏月。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570121791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之火，𫝑力行權，逄水制，則免自焚之咎；見木𦔳，必招夭折之患。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570138175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇金必作良工，得土遂成稼穡。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570154559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金土雖爲美利，無水則金燥土焦，再加火助，太過傾危。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570170943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋月之","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570187327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097576548778047"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火，性息體休，得木生，則有復明之慶，遇水尅，難迯隕滅之災。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570187327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土重而掩息其光，金多而損傷其勢。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570203711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火見火以光輝，縱叠見而轉利。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570220095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月之火，體絶形亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570236479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜木生而有救，遇水尅以爲殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570252863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲土制爲榮，愛火比爲利。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570269247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見金而難任爲財，無金而不遭妻害。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570285631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地雖傾，水火難滅，","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570302015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2199","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"士喜生扶，堅厚疏通，生金，忌崩頺木重水多空亡氣寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金重虛淺。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570302015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之土，散在四維，故金木水火，依而成象，是四時皆有用。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570318399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所忌者，火𣦸酉也，水旺子也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570334783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢土頼火印，火","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570351167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097536342294565"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸則土囚，土喜水財，水旺則土虚。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570351167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土得金火，方成大噐。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570367551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土高無貴，空惹灰塵。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570383935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土聚則滯，土散則輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570400319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未，土之正位，分陰分陽，土則不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570416703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰有伏水，未有匿木，滋養萬物，春夏爲功；戌有藏火，丑有隱金，秋火冬金，肅殺萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570433087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故土聚辰未爲貴，聚戌丑不爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570449471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是土愛辰未而不愛丑、戌也明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570465855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若更五行有氣，人命逄之，田産無比，晚年富貴悠悠。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570482239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若土太實，無水則不和喿，無木則不疏通；土見火則焦，女命多不生長。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570498623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土旺四季，惟戌土困弱。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570515007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊多爲人好闘，多瞌睡；辰未人好食，丑人淸省。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570531391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑有艮土有癸水，能潤而膏。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570547775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命遇此，","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570564159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097536342278181"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主能卓立。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570564159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於春月，其勢虛弱，喜火生扶，惡木太過，忌水泛濫，欲喜比𦔳，得金而制木爲祥。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570580543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金若多，仍盜士氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570596927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏月之土，其勢燥列，得盛水滋潤成功，忌旺火煆煉焦赤。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570613311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木助火炎，生尅無良；金生水泛，妻財有益。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570629695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見比肩蹇滯不通。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570646079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如太過又喜木襲。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570662463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋月之土，子旺母衰，金多而耗盜其氣，术盛而制伏純良，火重重而不厭，水泛泛而非祥，得比肩則能𦔳力，至霜降，不比無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570678847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月之土，外寒内温，水旺財𧯽，金多子秀，火盛有榮，木多無咎，再加土耶尤佳，惟喜身強足壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570695231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐大升曰：金頼土生，土多金理；土頼火生，火多土焦；","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570711615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097522001952822"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火頼木生，木多火熾；木頼水生，水多木漂；水頼金生，金多水濁，金能生水；水多金沉，水能生木；木盛水縮，木能生火；火多木焚，火能生土；土多火晦，土能生金；金多土變，金能尅木；木堅金缺，木能尅土；土重木折，土能尅水；水多土流，水能尅火；火炎水𤍠，火能尅金。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570711615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金多火熄，金衰遇火，必見銷鎔；火弱逄水，必爲熄滅；水弱逄土，必爲淤塞；土衰遇木，必遭傾陷；木弱逄金，必爲砍折。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570727999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"強金得水，方挫其𨦟，強水得木，方泄其勢；強木得火方化其頑，強火得土方止其熖，強土得金，方制其害。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570744383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斯言簡而盡也。","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570760767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097576548810815"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通會卷之一終","logicSentenceId":"7577379165570777151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097559423402034"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097576548876351"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2239","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097522001985590"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097625961693195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通㑹余二丹心卷之二，","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221250099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097576548827199"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通會卷之二。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221250099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"育吾山人著","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221266483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論河圖及洪範五行館。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221266483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古者庖羲氏之王天下也，則河圖以作八卦，故序軌","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221282867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤、坎離、震、巽、艮、兊之名，設天地、日月、風雷山澤之象。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221282867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"係辭曰：天地定位，山澤通氣，風雷相薄，水火不相射。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221299251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦相錯，八卦成列，而二十四位同行乎其中。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221315635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迨夫","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221332019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以陰陽消息驗之，八卦之變。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221332019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲本屬木，納卦於乾，乾","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221348403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與坤交，以地之上下二爻交換，軒之上下二爻化辰","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221348403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎象，甲隨坎化，故屬水也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221348403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木屬木，納卦於坤，坤與","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221364787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾對，以乾之中爻交換，坤之中爻化成離象，乙受離","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221364787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606483345459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221364787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化，故屬火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221364787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙本屬火，納卦於艮，良與兊對，以兊之","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221381171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下爻交換，艮之下爻化成離象，丙受離化，故屬火是。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221381171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁本屬火，納卦於兊，兊與艮對，以艮之上爻交換，爲","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221397555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之上爻化成乾象，丁受乾化，故屬金也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221397555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚本屬金，結","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221413939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦於震，震與巽對，以巽之下爻交換，震之下爻化滅","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221413939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤象，庚受地化，故屬土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221413939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛本屬金，納卦於巽，巽與","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221430323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震對，以震之上爻夜肇，巽之上爻化成坎象，辛受㸃","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221430323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化，故屬水也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221430323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬本屬水，納卦於離，離與坎對，第坎之","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221446707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中爻交換，離之中爻化成乾象，壬受郭化。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221446707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本堂屬金，","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221463091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納於離火，火熖金銷，不能退立，而自附於離火立焉，","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221463091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097611881447435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故屬火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221463091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸本屬水，納卦於坎，坎與離對，以離之中","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221479475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻交揆，坎之中爻化成坤象，癸受坤化，故屬土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221479475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221495859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八干納卦之變，如亁坤上下二爻交者，取象於否、泰","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221495859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之義，故曰天地定位。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221495859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震艮以上爻交於巽兊，巽兊以","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221512243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下爻交於震、艮者，取象於咸、恒、損益之義，故曰雷風。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221512243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相薄，山澤通氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221528627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離以中爻交於乾坤，乾坤以下爻交","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221545011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於坎離，取象於旣濟、未濟，故曰水火不相射是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344819221545011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629713418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有變不變。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629713418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤本乎金土而不變者，乃陰陽之祖","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629729802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宗，衆卦之父母也，退身於休明之地，老亢而不變也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629729802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故坎、離震兊位乎四正，金木水火而不變者，以子午","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629746186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097559423434802"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉四位，各専四旺之地，宣布四時之令，而氣化行","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629746186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焉，故不變也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629746186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮、巽用變者，艮土易位於坎、震東北之","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629762570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"界，處身於衰丑病寅之間，思於更相代立，自然成山","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629762570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而化木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629762570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽本易位於震離東南之界，立身於衰辰","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629778954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病已之間，不能自立，反歸於水。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629778954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰爲墓地，並與辰皆","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629795338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629795338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥本屬水，因金以生，乘代金立，故亥屬金也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629811722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629828106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本屬木，因水以生，乗代水立，故寅屬水也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629828106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已本屬火，","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629844490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因木以生，乘震之衰，代震之立，故巳屬木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629844490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申本屬","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629860874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金，水生於申，金𦔳水勢，故申屬水也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629860874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、戌、丑未五方","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629877258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五土之神，分爲四季，作造化甄陶之主，爲厚載之質。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629877258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097611881545739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本不可變，因土以生，木附於土，奪土一半爲水。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629893642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水動","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629910026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土静。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629910026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌陽之動也，故屬水；丑未陰之静也，故屬土。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629926410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化氣五行所取之由，大率類此。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629942794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天地交而萬物通，","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629959178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下交而德業成，男女交而志氣同，古徃今來，未有","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629959178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不交合而能成其造化者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629959178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰病代謝，未有不自繼","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629975562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禪乘代，而能致化機之運者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629975562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故洪範大五行所以","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629991946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：乙丙離壬爲炎火，乾亥兌丁從革鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975629991946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑坤庚未","logicSentenceId":"75773449756300
