08330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"稼穡，震艮四位曲直裝，甲子寅申巽辛地，辰戌皆同","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630008330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潤下行。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630008330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡看人命，如遇甲乙、丁、庚、辛、壬癸干，居於亁","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630024714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮巽坤之郷，又當以所變者而論之與。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630024714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干化氣，六","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630041098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097576548859967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十納音、納甲，相𠫭互看，不可只以河圖正五行論命，","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630041098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而曰子平法如此。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630041098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此世之談命者，所以多不准也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630057482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論天干陰陽生𣦸","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630073866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：十干有陰陽剛柔生𣦸之分，其說然否？","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630073866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：十","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630090250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干五陽五陰，陽者爲剛，陰者爲柔，易曰：分陰分陽，迭","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630090250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用柔剛，是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630090250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其生𣦸之分，如母生子，子成而母老𣦸，","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630106634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理之自然。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630106634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦曰：陽生陰𣦸，陽𣦸陰生，循環逆順，變化","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630123018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630123018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630139402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木乃十干之首，主宰四時，生育萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630155786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在天爲雷爲","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630172170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍，在地爲鿄爲楝，謂之陽木。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630172170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其禄到寅，寅爲離上","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630188554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097611881529355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之木，其根巳㫁，其枝巳絶，謂之𣦸木。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630188554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸木者，剛木","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630204938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，須仗斧斤斵削，方成其噐。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630204938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生於亥，亥爲河潭","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630221322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"池沼之水，名曰𣦸水。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630221322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故𣦸木放𣦸水中，雖浸年久，","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630237706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不能朽壞。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630237706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如杪椿之木，在於水中，則能堅固。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630254090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630270474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離水至岸而遇癸水，癸水者，活水也，爲天地間雨","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630270474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露，日晒雨淋，乾濕不調，遂成枯朽，則能生火，火旺","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630270474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而木必焚矣，故有灰飛烟滅之患。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630270474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且午屬離火，火","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630286858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頼木生，木爲火母，火爲木子，子旺母衰，焉有不終","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630286858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之理？","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630286858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲木𣦸於午。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630303242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云木不南奔，正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630319626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630336010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：甲乃陽剛蠢木，原無根葉枝荄，若成噐得用，必","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630336010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097505446920244"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藉乎金，宻藏不壊，必頼乎水。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630336010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火初得配，遂成文明","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630352394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之象。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630352394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"使火𮞪多，兼遇南方，化成灰炭，反致其害矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630368778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢甲木不以春秋而爲榮悴，觸物變化，亦無定形。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630385162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須看火、金、水何如，又看化合何如，不可執一。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630401546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630417930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木繼甲之後，發育萬物，生生不已。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630417930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在天爲風，在地","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630434314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲𣗳，謂之陰木，其祿到卯，卯爲樹木，根深枝茂，謂","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630434314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之活木。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630434314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"活木者，柔木也，懼陽金斫伐爲患，畏秋至。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630450698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木落凋零，欲潤土而培其根荄，利活水而滋其枝","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630467082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葉。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630467082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"活水者，癸水也，即天之雨露，地之泉源。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630483466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潤土者，","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630499850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097596605825076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六陽消盡，一陰復生，故稻花開於午時，乙木生於","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630499850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午地，十月建亥，亥乃純陰司令，壬祿到亥當權，𣦸","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630499850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水泛濫，土薄根虛，有失培養，故乙木𣦸於亥。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630499850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630516234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水泛木浮，正此謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630516234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：乙乃枝葉繁華之木，大","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630532618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜陽和煦照則發榮，不利陰冷𢡖刻則耗枯。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630532618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水多","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630549002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則傾頽其根荄，金旺則戕剥其生意。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630549002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如身衰火多，","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630565386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼行南方，而禍不淺；西行土重，𦔳煞傷身，不克從","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630565386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，爲禍尤深。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630565386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢活木，連根之木也，豈棟鿄之比哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630581770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火麗乎中天，普照六合，在天爲日爲電，在地爲爐","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630598154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲冶，謂之陽火；其祿在己，巳爲爐冶之火，謂之𣦸","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630598154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097611881562123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630598154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸火者，剛火也，喜𣦸木發生其熖，惡金土掩息","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630614538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其光。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630614538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸木者，甲木也，甲禄在寅，寅乃陽木之垣，木","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630630922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盛火生，隱於木石之間，非人用之，不能生發。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630630922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故五","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630647306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽皆出乎自然而爲先天；五陰皆係乎人事而爲","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630647306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後天。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630647306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火生於寅，其理甚明。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630663690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如太陽之火，自東而","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630680074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"升，至西而没，且酉屬兊，兊爲澤，己土生金，金氣盛，","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630680074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掩息丙火之光，不能顯輝，豈無晦乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630680074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故丙火生於","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630696458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅而𣦸於酉。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630696458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：火無西向，正此謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630712842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日：丙火，","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630729226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽之象，上下化光，無所不照。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630729226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然不以浮水之木","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630745610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097596605841460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲母，不能生有熖之火；不以濕水之土爲子，陽火","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630745610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所不產也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630745610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱遇江湖𣦸水，不合不衝，則波濤弗致","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630761994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝激，焉能爲尅火之害。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630761994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其所忌者，乃繁華之木，浥","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630778378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水不能生火，而反能晦火之光。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630778378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如五星太陽，以木","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630794762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"炁爲難之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630794762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火繼丙之後，爲萬物之精，文明之象，在天爲列星，","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630811146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在地爲燈火，謂之陰火。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630811146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其禄到午，乃六陰之首，内","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630827530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有乙木，能生丁火。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630827530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙爲活木，丁爲活火。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630843914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"活火者，柔","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630860298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630860298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁喜乙木而生，乃陰生陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630876682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如世人用菜油、","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630893066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔴油爲燈燭之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630893066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫油乃乙木之脂膏也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630909450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於酉","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630925834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，四陰司權，燈火則能惲煌，列星則能燦爛，故丁","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630925834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097559423467570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於酉，至於寅地，三陽當合陽火而生，陰火而退，","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630925834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如日東升，列星隱耀，燈雖有熖，不顯其光，故丁生","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630925834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於酉而𣦸於寅也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630925834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：火明則滅，正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630942218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630958602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火陰柔，要得時遇局，方能輝光燦爛，雖頑鈍之","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630958602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金，亦在其所煅煉。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630958602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若失時䘮局，卽韜光晦跡而烟","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630974986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無存，雖微𦕈之金，亦不能制。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630974986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然木臊雖少，猶足以","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630991370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發火之機；木濕雖多，亦難以致火之眀。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975630991370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要看其中","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631007754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"強弱，不可泥於一偏。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631007754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土洪濛未判，抱一守中，天地旣分，𫝗載萬物，聚於","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631024138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中央，散於四維，在天爲霧，在地爲山，謂之陽士。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631024138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631040522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097611881578507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄在己，巳爲爐冶之火，煆煉成器，叩之有聲，其性","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631040522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛猛，難以觸犯。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631040522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜陽火相生，畏陰金盜氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631056906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽火者，","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631073290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631073290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙生於寅，寅屬艮，艮爲山，山爲剛土，卽戊","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631089674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土也，頼丙火而生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631089674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於酉地，酉屬兊金，耗盜戊","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631106058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土之氣，乃金盛土虛，母衰子旺，又金擊石碎，豈能","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631106058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"延壽？","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631106058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故戊土生於寅而𣦸於酉。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631122442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：土虛則崩，正","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631138826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631138826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

icSentenceId":"7577344975631269898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才皆不可缺。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631269898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此土如亁坤中一媒妁，陰陽失此，豈","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631286282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能配偶？","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631286282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故於四行無不在，於四時則寄旺焉，乃眞","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631302666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631302666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜丁火而生，畏陽火而煉，其祿到午，午中丁","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631319050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火能生己土，被乙木盜其栽培之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631319050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於酉地，丁","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631335434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火而生，丁火旣生，己土亦能生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577344975631335434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至寅用事，木火","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517558322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"司權，煅炼己土，遂成磁石，反失中和之氣，豈有不","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517558322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097611881594891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"損之理？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517558322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false} {"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故巳土生於酉而𣦸於寅。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517574706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：火燥土裂，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517591090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正此謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517591090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：己土廣厚，其象如田疇，不貴多合","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517607474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生扶，惟喜刑衝有用，此固生物之體。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517607474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茍失令淺薄，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517623858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及天時不利，不但難施鎡基之力，亦不能埋劒戟","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517623858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之金。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517623858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘再兼行金水旺處，則身愈弱，尤爲不利。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517640242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517656626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢火土生成，則稼穡有生生之妙矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517656626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金掌天地肅殺之權，主人間兵革之變，在天爲風","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517673010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霜，在地爲金鐡，謂之陽金。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517673010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其祿到申，申乃剛金，喜","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517689394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土而生，畏癸水而溺，長生於己，巳中戊土能生","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517689394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金，乃陽生陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517689394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已爲爐冶之火，煆煉庚金，遂成","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517705778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097611881627659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鍾鼎之器，叩之有聲，若遇水土沉埋，則無聲也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517705778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517722162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂金實無聲。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517722162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於子地水旺之鄉，金寒水冷，子旺","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517738546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母衰，亦遭沉溺之患，豈能復生？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517738546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

arginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097576548909119"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"望其有用也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517886002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金繼庚之後，爲五金之首，八石之元，在天爲月，月","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517902386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃太陰之精，在地爲金，金乃山石之礦，謂之陰金。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517902386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其祿到酉，酉中己土，能生辛金，乃陰生陰也，謂之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517918770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柔金，爲太陰之精。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517918770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於中秋，金水相停，會合含光，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517935154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圓融皎潔，邵子有云：八月十五翫蟾光是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517935154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517951538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於子，子乃坎水之垣，坎中一陽屬金，外有二陰屬","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517951538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土，土能生金，子隱母胎，未顯其體，得子水蕩漾，淘","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517951538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去浮砂，方能出色，此乃水濟金輝，色光明瑩。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517951538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517967922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳地，己爲爐冶之火，將辛金煆成𣦸噐，亦被己中","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517967922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606483427379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土埋没其形，不能變化，豈得復生？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517967922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故辛金生於","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517984306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子而𣦸於巳也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144517984306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云土重金埋，正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518000690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日：辛","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518017074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金濕潤，非頑鈍堅剛之物，使遇火炎煆煉，性質反","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518017074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷，安能成其美用？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518017074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只宜水土資扶，優柔浹洽，以潤","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518033458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其體。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518033458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原火太繁，喜行西北，使去火而存金。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518049842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如金太","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518066226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寒，亦要丙丁，使和金而去冷。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518066226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若坐禄通根，卽身旺","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518082610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之地，縱加厚土，亦不能汨没，所以非陽金比也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518082610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水喜陽土而爲堤岸之取，畏陰木而爲盗氣之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518098994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在天爲雲，在地爲澤，謂之陽水；其祿在亥，亥爲池","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518115378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606483509299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沼存留之水，謂之𣦸水。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518115378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸水者，剛水也，頼庚金而","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518131762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518131762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚祿到申，能生壬水，乃五行轉養之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518148146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於卯","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518164530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，卯乃花菓𣗳木，木旺於卯，則能尅土，土虚則崩，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518164530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故堤岸崩頺，而壬水走泄，散漫四野，流而不返。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518164530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":fal pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財多身弱，值此必能集福；身旺","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518295602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606483460147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財輕，遇此反受其災，縱強壯少年，亦不能勝此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518295602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水繼壬之後，乃天干一週陰陽之氣，成於終而反","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518311986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於始之漸，故其爲水，清濁以分，散諸四方，有潤下","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518311986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"助土之功，滋生萬物之德。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518311986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在天爲雨露，在地爲泉","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518328370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉，謂之陰水，其禄到子，子乃陰極陽生之地，辛生","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518328370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚𣦸之垣，癸爲活水。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518328370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"活水者，柔水也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518344754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜陰金而生，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518361138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畏陽金而滯。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518361138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲陰木行其根，則能疎通隂土；陰土","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518377522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣通於地脉，則能流暢。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518377522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二月建卯，爲花果𣙞木，木","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518393906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺土虚，癸水安得通達？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518393906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於申地，三陰用事，否卦","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518410290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"司權，天地不交，萬物不通，申中坤土庚金，遂成圍","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518410290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606483476531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堰，使癸水不能流暢，困於池沼，無所施設，豈再生","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518410290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518410290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故癸水生於卯而𣦸於申。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518426674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云水不西流，正謂","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518443058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518443058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：癸水雨露，陰澤之潤也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518459442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若根通亥子，則","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518475826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盈科集流，以成江河，枉無坎坤，失其生旺之本，終","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518475826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲身弱。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518475826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局有財官，雖我所用之物，不可遇之太過。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518492210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申子辰全，則水歸聚一家，暗衝寅午戌火爲用，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518508594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反爲上格。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518508594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若明用寅午戌火，須表裏不弱，得之乃","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518524978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518524978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或生於深夏，得用財官，不失其倚之宫，主大富","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518541362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，運道再行西北，不爲太過之嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518541362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰：五行長生之理，與萬物亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518557746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如日之初出時，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518574130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097505447018548"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"光明可觀，至午離官，光明愈甚。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518574130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月之初出，巧若娥眉，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518590514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至望光明圓潔。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518590514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人之生也，自少至壯，自老至𣦸，常","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518606898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518606898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之初生也，嬰孩啼笑而己，至壯，賢愚方辨，萬","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518623282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物皆一同。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518623282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木生亥，亥令屬水，甲木居焉。木旺於春，至寅臨官歸祿曰：木得垣，至午則𣦸丙火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生寅，寅令屬木，丙火居焉。火旺於夏，至巳臨官歸禄，丙火得垣，至酉則𣦸。庚金生己巳申，戊士，庚金居焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金旺於秋，至申，臨官歸禄。庚金得垣，至子則𣦸。壬水生申，申令屬金，壬水居焉。水旺於冬，至亥，臨官歸禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬水得垣，至卯則𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土生於寅，寅中有火，戊土生焉，三陽之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518639666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，土膏以動，萬物發生，是戊生於寅也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518639666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土旺於四季，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518656050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土有如母子相生，所以戊隨丙臨官，歸禄於己，巳","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518656050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨丁臨官，歸禄於午。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518656050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土生於寅，己土生於酉明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518672434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097505447034932"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以戊生申，己生卯，何不以壬戊歸禄於亥，癸巳歸","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518688818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄於子？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518688818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後人妄作擬土歌，有戊巳當絕在巳懐之句，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518705202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以戊生申酉沐浴戍冠𢃄，陰陽間隔，謬戾甚矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518705202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518721586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行長生，有母而後有子，歸母成孕之說也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518721586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨土一","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518737970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行，分體用，厚德載物，居中不用者，土之體也，散於四","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518737970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"維，各旺四季，土之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518737970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體生於巳，乘父母之禄，用生","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518754354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於申，維父母之位，故水土生申，陰陽家之說；土生於","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518754354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，醫家之說。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518754354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考五星書，申爲陰陽宫，故水土俱生申","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518770738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤位。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518770738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水土原不相離，而土隨水源之說，亦爲有理。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518787122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518803506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行有一生，獨土長生於寅，又生於申，一物而有兩生。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518803506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606483492915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以坤、艮土之方位，坤屬西南，土至此而得朋，故曰利","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518819890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亨。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518819890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子曰：坤之厚重，積土成功，上生於此者然也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518836274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"復言戊土生寅，寄祿於巳者，隨母得家之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518852658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518869042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土無正位，生物多方，又何疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518869042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再考周視作陰陽定","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518885426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論，有云：乙木生於午，癸水生於卯，辛金生於子，丁火","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518885426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於酉，以爲陽𣦸陰生。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518885426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知冬至卽子水旺時，春分","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518901810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽乙木旺時，夏至卽丁火旺時，秋分卽辛金旺時，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518901810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518901810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離巽兊，卽子午卯酉之正位，位者時之定在，時者","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518901810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位之妙用，曷𡮢逢生於𣦸絕哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518901810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：果如所謂，則乙","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518918194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木何由生耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518918194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假云在亥，亥中止有甲；甲木何由生耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518934578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假云在卯，卯中止有乙。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518950962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試辨以火土金水之例曰：陰","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518967346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097611881660427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽相爲一體。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518967346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孔子曰：太極生兩儀。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144518983730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"周子曰：陽變陰合","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519000114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而生水火、木、金土。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519000114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子曰：萬物各具一太極。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519016498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三言","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519032882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，皆五行之樞紐。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519032882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽萬物各具一太極之說，則木之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519049266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲物，亦具一太極者可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519049266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽太極生兩儀之說，則","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519065650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分甲、乙，而甲爲陽之動於先，乙爲陰之静於後，可知","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519065650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519065650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽陽變陰合之說，則甲之爲一變，而乙之爲一合，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519082034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然後能生木者又可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519082034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非謂甲是一木，而乙又别","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519098418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲一木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519098418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫甲乙相須而爲一木，則甲固不必旺於","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519114802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，而卯自不能不爲乙以旺於後；乙亦不必生於亥，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519114802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097673139224630"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而亥自不能不爲甲以生乎其先，推而至於丙丁相","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519114802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須爲火，戊巳相須爲土，庚辛相須爲金，壬癸相須爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519114802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，豈不了了然哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519114802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子曰：陰氣流行則爲陽，陽氣凝","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519131186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聚則爲陰，非眞有二物相對也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519131186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡氏曰：東方寅卯木、","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519147570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰土生於亥，南方巳午火、末土生於寅，西方申酉金、","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519147570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍土生於巳，北方亥子水丑土生於申。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519147570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：金木水","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519163954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土各有一陰一陽。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519163954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲便是木之陽，乙便是木之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519180338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144519180338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙以質言，甲以氣言。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530141193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰主翕，凡聚歛成就者，乙爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530157577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之也；陽主闢，凡發暢暉散者，甲爲之也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530157577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀此，亦見甲","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530173961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不必主，乙不必生之說矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530173961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其言足以破前說之偏，而","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530190345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097596605906996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有合古人原論十干之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530190345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再考廣錄，甲是木之幹。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530206729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙是木之根，丙火之宿，丁火之光，戊土之剛，己土之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530223113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柔，庚金之質，辛金之刃，壬水之源，癸水之流，是甲乙","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530223113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一木而分陰陽，非𣦸木活木，岐而二之也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530223113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣一木皆","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530239497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同𣦸同生，故古人只有四大長生之說。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530239497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今分陰陽爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530255881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二，所以有陽𣦸陰生，陽生陰𣦸之辨。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530255881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考陳摶甲木乙","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530272265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"草，丙火、丁灰，戊土、己砂、庚金、辛石、壬水癸泉之說，是","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530272265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦分而爲二也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530272265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不分，則官煞、食傷、印綬、枭神、刼敗、","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530288649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比肩，何以一物名而爲二，而吉㐫禍福逈不同耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530288649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530305033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命者當以前說爲是。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530305033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097505447051316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論地支","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530321417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地支之用，不比天干，動静不同，圓方逈異。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530321417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然五行所","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530337801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屬則一，而所處之地不一。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530337801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如在年則有在年之論，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530354185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在月則有在月之論，在日時則有日時之論，其陰陽","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530354185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輕重剛柔，豈可泥於一體？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530354185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今當以月提爲主，所藏所","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530370569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用，要見何神，所耗所嫌，要係何物。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530370569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡四柱之神，較量","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530386953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淺深而用","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530386953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子十二支之魁，溪澗江洋之水，乃戊土旺地，然必過","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530386953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大雪之期，一陽來復之後，方能成旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530386953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金所生，亦","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530403337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必於陽回水暖而後能生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530403337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"典午相衝，與卯相刑，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530419721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097673139257398"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與申辰三合，若申子辰全㑹起水局，卽成江海𤼵","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530419721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"波濤之聲也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530419721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑雖隆冬，有冰霜之可怯，但天時已轉二陽，是以丑","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530436105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中己土之暖，能生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530436105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金養地，豈只深藏？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530452489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見戍","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530468873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則刑，見未則衝，庫地最宜刑衝，不爲無用。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530468873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見己酉","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530485257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合，會起金局。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530485257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人命生於丑月，而日時多見水","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530501641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木，必側行巽離之地，而土方不衰耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530501641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅建於春，氣聚三陽，有丙火生焉，寅刑己，巳合申，並","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530518025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺而爲貴客。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530518025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺於卯，庫於未，同類則爲一家。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530534409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至午。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530550793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則火光輝，而有超凡入聖之美；見申則寅受衝，而","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530567177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097611881709579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有破祿傷提之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530567177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱火多，則又不可入南方","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530583561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火地，語云木不南奔是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530583561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木仲春，氣禀繁華，雖用金水，不可太過。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530599945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若干頭庚","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530616329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛叠見，地支不可見申酉，恐有破伐之害；地支亥","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530616329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子重逢，干頭不可見癸壬，主有漂流之傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530616329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見酉則","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530632713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝木必落葉；見亥未則合木必成林。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530632713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若時日歸於","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530649097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金重，大運更向西行，患不禁也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530649097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰建季春，爲水泥之濕，而萬物之根，皆頼此培養。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530665481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530681865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至此雖衰，而有乙之餘氣；壬至此雖墓，而有癸之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530681865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"還魂。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530681865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見戍爲鑰，能開庫中之物。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530698249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若三戍重衝，破門","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530714633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097596605923380"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非吉，日時多見水木，其運更向西北，則辰土不能","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530714633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"存矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530714633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳當初夏，其火増光，是六陽之極也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530731017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金寄生，因頼","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530747401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊母，戊土歸禄，乃隨火孃。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530747401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見申則刑，刑中有合，翻","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530763785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲無害；見亥則衝，衝而必破，便爲有傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530763785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若運再行","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530780169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東南生發之地，便成燒天烈熖之勢矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530780169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月炎火正升，入中氣，則一陰生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530796553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚至此爲無用，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530812937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳至此爲歸垣，見申子則必戰尅，見寅戍則越光","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530812937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530812937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行東南，正是身強之地，若入西北，則休囚喪","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530829321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530829321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097625961742347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未當季夏，則陰深而火漸衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530845705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未中有乙木，有丁火，是","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530862089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藏官藏印，不藏財也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530862089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無亥卯以會之，則形難變，只","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530878473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作火土論；無丑戍以刑衝之，則庫不開，難得官印","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530878473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"力。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530878473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中無火，怕行金水之運；日時多寒，偏愛丙丁","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530894857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530894857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢用神之喜忌，最當分曉，不可毫髪誤也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530911241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申宫水土長生之地，入巳午則逢火煉，遂成劒戟；見","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530927625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子辰則逢水淬，益得光鋒。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530927625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"使木多無火，金終能勝。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530944009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若土重堆埋，金却有㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530960393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢申乃頑鈍之金，與温柔","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530976777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珠玉不同故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530976777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉建八月，金色白，水流清，若遇日時火多，運更愁東","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530993161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097625961758731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去；若遇日時木旺，運亦怕南行。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144530993161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱見水泥，應爲有","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531009545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用；運行西北，豈是無情。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531009545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然逄己丑三合，亦能堅銳，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531025929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈可以陰金爲温柔珠玉而泥論哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531025929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍乃洪爐之庫，鈍鐡頑金，頼以煉成。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531042313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見辰龍則衝出","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531058697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水，而雨露生焉；見寅虎則會起丙火，而文章出","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531058697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531058697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然火命逢之，則爲入墓，寕能免於不傷哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531075081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥地六陰，雨雪載塗，土至此而不煖，金至此而生寒，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531091465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其象若五湖之歸聚，其用在三合之有心。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531091465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
