{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干分配天文","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531189769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木爲雷。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531189769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雷者，陽氣之噓也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531206153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木屬陽，故取象於雷","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531222537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531222537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"稽諸月令，仲春之月，雷乃發聲，甲木旺，卽其驗","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531238921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531238921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况雷奮於地，木生於地，其理又無不同者。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531255305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邵子","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531271689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：地逢雷處見天根。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531271689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽木之生，孰非天根之動爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531288073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606483542067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531288073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是甲木至申而遂絕，以雷聲至申而漸收也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531304457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命屬甲日，主喜值春天，或類象，或趨乾，或遥巳，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531320841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或拱貴，俱大吉，運不喜西方。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531320841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：木在春生，處世","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531337225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安然必壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531337225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木爲風，乙木長生在午，敗在已，在午而生者，葢乙","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531353609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲山林活木，至夏來而暢茂，詩所謂千章夏木青。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531353609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531369993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其敗已云何？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531386377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已乃巽地，巽爲風，木盛風生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531402761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風生於木而反摧木，猶之火生於木而反焚木，其","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531419145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取敗也固宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531419145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂乙木爲風者，木其所自生云爾。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531435529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人乙日建生者，在秋令大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531451913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋令金旺，乙木能","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531468297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097673139273782"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化能從，而盤根錯節，非利噐無所裁成，逢亥必𣦸，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531468297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其落葉歸根之時耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531468297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙爲日，說卦傳曰：離爲火爲日。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531484681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日與火皆文明之象，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531501065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以丙火爲日之各不易焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531501065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽朝出而夕入，陽","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531517449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火寅生而酉𣦸，而又何異乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531517449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬騏眞寳賦以丙日","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531533833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑時爲日出地上之格，有旨哉！","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531533833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有旨哉！","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531550217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡六丙生","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531566601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬夏，不如春秋，春日有垣萬物之功，秋陽有燥萬","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531566601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物之用，冬則陰晦，夏則炎蒸，宜細推之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531566601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火爲星，丙火𣦸而丁火遂從生焉，在天之日薄而","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531582985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星廻也，類如是。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531582985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星象惟入夜故燦爛，陰火惟近晦","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531599369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606349176867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故輝煌。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531599369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁不謂之星而何？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531615753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞寶賦云：陰火時亥，富","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531632137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴悠悠。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531632137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觧者以此爲財官印之三奇，亦可矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531648521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531664905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥在北方，是爲天門，又星拱北之說乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531664905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡丁日生","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531681289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人，喜遇夜，喜遇秋，如星光之得時也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531681289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又喜行身弱","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531697673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，如石裏所藏屬丁火，石雖在水，卽時取擊，亦自","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531697673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有火。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531697673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其丁巳一日，多尅父兄妻子，葢財忌比刼，兄","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531714057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屈弟下。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531714057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳中有戊土，傷官也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531730441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土爲霞，土無専氣，依火以生；霞無定體，借日以現。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531746825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知丙火之爲日，則知戊土之爲霞矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144531763209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是霞者，日之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626610202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘也，則𥁞而霞將滅没，火熄則土無生意，故謂之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626610202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097559423516722"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霞也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626610202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大撓氏演納音五行𧰼，以戊午爲天上火，意","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626626586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢如此。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626626586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊土日主愛四柱帶水，則爲上格，霞水","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626642970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相映而成文彩也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626642970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更喜年月干見癸癸，則爲雨雨。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626659354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後霞見而覩文明也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626675738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已土爲雲，己土生居酉，酉，兊方也，其象爲澤。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626692122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先正曰：","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626708506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天降時雨，山川出雲。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626708506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則雲者，山澤之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626724890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已雖","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626741274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屬士，以此論之，則其謂之雲也亦宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626741274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲巳合而","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626757658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化土，其氣上升而雲施，雲雷交而作雨，其澤下究","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626757658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而土潤，此造化之至妙至妙者與！","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626757658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡身主屬己土，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626774042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴坐酉貴，春生貴見甲，坐亥者不可見乙木雲升","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626774042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097673139322934"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天，遇風則狼藉而不禁也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626774042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金爲月，庚乃西方陽金，何以知其配月乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626790426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：五行","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626806810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之有庚，猶四時之有月也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626806810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚不待秋而長生，然必","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626823194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋而始盛；月不待秋而後有，然必秋而益明。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626823194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以色","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626839578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言，月固白也，其色同矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626839578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以氣言，金生水也，潮應月","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626855962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，其氣同矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626855962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古甲子以庚爲上章，見其與日平明","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626872346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626872346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：金沉在子，見其與月沉波也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626888730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三日月見庚","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626905114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方，見月初生，與庚同位也，故曰庚金爲月。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626905114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人庚","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626921498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日生者，四柱有乙巳字出，謂之月白風淸。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626921498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋爲上，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626937882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬次之，春夏無取。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626937882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606349160483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金爲霜八月辛金建祿之地，是月也，天氣肅，白露","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626954266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲霜，草木黄落而變衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626954266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故五行陰木絶在此地。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626970650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626987034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木經斧斤之斬伐，未有能生焉者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144626987034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斧斤以時入","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627003418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山林，嚴霜以時殺草木，揆之天道，参之人事，信乎","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627003418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金之爲霜矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627003418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：霜常避日，丙與辛合，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627019802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627036186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦相尅之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627036186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火惟尅金，故相合而水斯化；霜","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627052570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟避日，故相遇而氷以消，亦爲水也，是之取耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627052570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627068954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛人坐卯未透乙，大富；坐亥透丙，則貴愛。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627068954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬生","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627085338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水爲秋露，春亦有露，何獨擬之以秋？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627085338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢春露，雨露","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627101722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣濡之露；秋露，霜露旣䧏之露也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627101722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露一也，春主生。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627118106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097559423533106"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋主殺，功用不同，有如此。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627134490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然吾以壬爲秋露也，葢","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627150874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露屬水，而壬水生於申，水本能生木者，水旣然在","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627150874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此而生，木何由於此而絕？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627150874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故知壬之爲露，秋露也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627167258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬日生秋，見丁火最顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627183642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁爲星河，壬爲秋露，一","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627200026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洗炎蒸，象緯昭然矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627200026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水爲春霖，癸水生卯月，號曰春霖，葢陰木得雨而","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627216410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627216410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然至申則𣦸，七八月多乾旱也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627232794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且卯前一","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627249178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位，是辰辰，龍宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627249178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯近龍宫而水生，龍一𡚒遂化","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627265562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲雨焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627265562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯爲雷門，雷一震而龍必興焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627281946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𮗚此則癸","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627298330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水其春霖矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627298330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸卯日透出巳字者，有雲行雨施","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627314714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097625961824267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之象，其人必有經濟才也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627314714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏吉，秋冬不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627331098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627347482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日生逢己巳鄉，煞星須要木來降。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627347482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然名利升","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627363866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高顯，争奈平生壽不長。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627363866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二支分配地理：","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627380250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子爲墨池，子在正北方，屬水，色象墨，故有墨池之象。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627380250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命逢子年生者，時喜見癸亥，謂之水歸大海，又","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627396634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之雙魚逰墨，必爲文章士矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627396634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午爲烽堠，午正位於南，屬火土，其色赤黄，名之曰烽","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627413018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堠者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627413018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又午爲馬烽堠，乃戎馬兵火之處所也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627429402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午生人時利見辰，眞龍出，則几馬空矣，謂之馬化","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627445786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097596605988916"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍駒。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627445786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯爲琼林，卯係乙木，居位正東，於時爲仲春，萬物生","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627462170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焉，色若琅玕之青，故曰琼林。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627462170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯年遇巳未時者，是","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627478554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲兎入月宮之象，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627478554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉爲寺鍾，酉屬金，位近戍亥。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627494938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍亥者，天門也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627511322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鍾，金屬","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627527706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627527706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寺鍾敲則聲徹天門。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627544090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又酉居正西，寺則西方佛","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627560474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"界也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627560474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉見寅吉，謂之鍾鳴谷應。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627576858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅爲廣谷，寅乃艮方，艮爲山，戊土長生，於是而廣谷","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627593242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之義著矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627593242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然寅宫有虎，寅生人而時戊辰者，謂之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627609626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎嘯而谷風生，威震萬里。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627609626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097673139339318"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申爲名都，坤爲地，其體無疆，非名都不足以喻之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627626010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627642394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627642394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"都者，帝王所居。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627658778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申宫壬水生，又與艮山對，是","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627675162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水遶山環也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627675162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命愛申年亥時，乃地天交泰。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627691546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳爲大驛，大驛者，人煙凑集，道路通逹之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627707930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳中有","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627724314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火、戊土，是其象也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627724314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又巳前有午馬，故曰大驛。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627740698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627757082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生喜得辰時，蛇化青龍，於格爲千里龍駒。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627757082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥爲懸河，天河之水，奔流不囘，故曰懸河。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627773466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卽天門，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627789850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又屬水，非懸河之象乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627789850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥年建生日時見寅、辰二","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627806234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字，是乃水拱雷門。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627806234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰爲草澤，左傳日：深山大澤，龍蛇生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627822618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫澤，水所鍾","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627839002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097673139372086"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627839002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰在東方之次，爲水庫，故爲草爲澤。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627855386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰逢壬戌、","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627871770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥，卽龍歸大海格。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627871770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍爲燒原，戍月在九秋，草木盡萎，田家焚燒而耕。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627888154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627904538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍屬土，是以稱名燒原。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627904538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故戌與辰地皆貴人所不","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627920922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627920922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍生逢卯，號曰春入燒痕。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627937306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑爲柳岸，丑中有水，有土、有金，岸者，土也，所以止水","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627953690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故謂柳岸。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627953690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰柳色黄金嫩是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627970074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑人時見巳","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627986458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未，乃月照柳梢，極爲上格。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144627986458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未爲花園，花園屬之未，不屬之卯，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628002842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯乃木旺，自","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628019226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成林麓。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628019226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未乃木庫，如人築墻垣，以護百花也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628035610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以百","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628051994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097625961857035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"花言，未中有雜氣耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628051994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未年入雙飛格最妙，如辛未","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628068378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見戊戍，兩干不雜是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628068378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：十干之所取象，有自其配合言之，有自其生尅","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628084762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言之，又有自其方位，自其時令，自其始終言之不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628084762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628101146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：予各舉其一隅而爲言也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628117530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善學者類而推之，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628133914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則十干各有消息盈虚之機，各有聲應氣求之妙矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628133914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斯道也，造化自然之道，豈予一人之私言哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628150298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：十","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628166682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二支辰、戍丑未居四隅，乃對待之體，所謂支屬地地。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628166682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能静而不能動也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628183066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳居中央，乃流行之用，所謂干","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628199450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屬天，天能動而不能静也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628199450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故地支四土，非加益也，以","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628215834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606349193251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其有専氣耳；天干二土，非加損也，以其無定位耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628215834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"使","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628232218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支無分數之差，何以成變化而行鬼神乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144628232218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天元","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769216558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之數有十，予旣分配以天文；而地元之數十有二，予","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769216558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又分配以地理。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769216558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則所謂牵強與？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769232942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殆非也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769249326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔者聖人","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769265710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作易，於八卦之象，逹取諸物，近取諸身，重復明之，而","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769265710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有所不置。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769265710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支之理，一易書之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769282094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"術家者流，語數","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769298478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而違理者多矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769298478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予故表而出之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769314862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦云：論用神，論日主，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769331246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各有所宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769331246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取地脉，取天元，是或一道，葢必兼此妙焉，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769347630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然後爲至也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769347630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，是亦一得之愚而已。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769364014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又天元之分","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769380398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"配循其序，地支則舉其四生四敗、四庫之位而錯綜","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769380398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097625961873419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之者，亦有見也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769380398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者合前說而觀之，思過半矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769396782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醉醒子曰：大哉干支生物之始，本乎天地萬物宗焉，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769413166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有陰陽變化之機，時候淺深之用。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769413166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故金木水火，土無","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769429550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主形，生尅制化，理取不一。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769429550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如𣦸木，偏宜活水長濡；","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769445934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬若頑金，最喜洪爐久煉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769445934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽火忌林木爲讐，梁棟","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769462318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"材求斧斤爲友。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769462318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火隔水不能鎔金，金沉水豈能尅木。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769478702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"活木忌埋根之鐡，𣦸金嫌葢頂之泥。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769495086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙欲成一塊，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769511470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須知穿鑿之功；壬癸能逹五湖，葢有併流之性。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769511470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"樗木","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769527854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不禁利斧，珍珠最怕明爐。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769527854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弱柳喬松，時分衰旺；寸金","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769544238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丈鐵，氣用剛柔。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769544238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隴頭之土，少木難疏；爐内之金，𣺯泥","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769560622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097596606021684"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反蔽，雨露安滋。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769560622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"杇木城墻，不産珍金。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769577006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劒㦸功成，遇火","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769593390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄕而反壞；城墻積就，至木地而愁复。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769593390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丙春生，不雨","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769609774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不睛之象；乙丁冬産，非寒非煖之天，極鋒抱水之金。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769609774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最鈍雜爐之鐡。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769626158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙遇金強，魂歸西兊；庚辛逢火旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769642542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣散南離。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769642542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土燥火炎，金無所頼；木浮水泛，火不能生。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769658926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九夏鎔金，安制堅剛之木；三冬濕土，難隄泛濫之波。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769675310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輕塵撮土，終非活木之基；廢鐡銷金，豈是滋流之本。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769691694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛能令金自缺，土虛反被水相欺。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769708078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火無木則終其","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769724462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"光，木無火則晦其質。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769724462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木秋生，拉朽摧枯之易也；庚","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769740846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金冬𣦸，沉沙墜海豈難乎。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769740846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凝霜之草，奚用逢金；出土","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769757230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097596606054452"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之金，不能勝木。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769757230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火未熖而先烟，水旣徃而猶濕。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769773614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769789998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水寒不流，木寒不發，土寒不生，火寒不烈，金寒不鎔，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769789998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆非天地之正氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769789998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然萬物初生未成，成久則滅，其","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769806382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"超凡入聖之機，脫𣦸囘生之妙，不象而成，不形而化，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769806382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同用不如固本，花繁豈若根深。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769806382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如北金戀水而沉","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769822766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形，南木飛灰而脫體，東水旺木以枯源，西土實金而","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769822766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虚己。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769822766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火因士晦皆太過，五行貴在中和理。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769839150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求之求之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769855534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勿苟言，掬𥁞寒潭須見㡳。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769855534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論地支屬相","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769871918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：地支有屬相，而天干則無者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769871918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：天干動","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769888302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097673139388470"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而無相，地支静而有相。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769888302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢輕清者，天也，重濁者，地也，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769904686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重濁之中乃有物焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769904686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故子屬䑕，丑屬牛，寅屬虎，卯屬","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769921070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兎，辰屬龍，巳屬蛇，午屬馬，未屬羊，申屬猴，酉屬鷄，戍","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769921070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屬犬，亥屬猪。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769921070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此十二屬相，亦有奇偶之分，盛衰之用。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769937454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇者，䑕、虎、龍、馬、猴、犬一則屬陽，六獸之足皆单；偶者","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769953838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛、兎、蛇、羊、鷄、猪二則屬陰，共獸之足皆雙。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769953838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟蛇無足，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769970222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又何取義？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769970222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢已在月乃純陽之月，在時乃純陽之時，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769986606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數則偶而時則陽，故用蛇以象之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144769986606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇乃陰物，不用其","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770002990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足而象巳著，疑亦諱言乎陰之意爾。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770002990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况亦有雙頭者。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770019374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可驗十二相，卽三十六禽中，取其首者擬之，自有陰","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770035758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097625961906187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之别，单雙之分，此造化之所以爲妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770035758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：十二","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770052142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屬相，各有所缺者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770052142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：天傾西北，地不滿東南。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770068526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地尚缺，獸體豈全？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770084910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故鼠少光夜出，牛無牙唇吻，虎","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770101294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無項，和身而轉；兎缺唇無雄，龍𧇊耳角聽，蛇無足快","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770101294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行，馬怯膽，常立不眠；羊無朣，𣦸不閉目；㺅無脾，喜食","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770101294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果物；鷄無腎，淫而無節；犬無胃，食穢善呼；猪無觔，常","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770101294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眠少立。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770101294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此係陰陽不僃之意，亦與造化相應，惟人獨","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770117678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會其全，此其所以貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770117678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王充論衡曰：五行之氣相賊","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770134062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害，含血之蟲相勝服。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770134062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木也，其禽虎，戍土也，其會犬，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770150446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、未亦土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770150446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑禽牛，未禽羊，不勝土，故犬與牛、羊爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770166830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606483574835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎所服。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770166830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥水也，其禽豕，巳火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770183214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其禽蛇，子亦水也；其","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770199598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禽鼠，午亦火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770199598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其禽馬，水勝火，故豕食蛇；火爲水所","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770215982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害，故馬食鼠屎而腹脹。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770215982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然亦有不相勝者。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770232366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午馬也，子","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770248750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼠也，𮠕鷄也，卯兎也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770248750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水勝火，鼠何不逐馬？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770265134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金勝木，鷄","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770281518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何不啄兎？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770281518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥豕也，未羊也，丑牛也，土勝水，牛、羊何不","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770297902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺豕？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770297902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳蛇也，申侯也，火勝金，蛇何不食獼猴？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770314286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獼猴畏","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770330670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼠者也，齧獼㺅者，犬也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770330670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼠，水，獼猴，金也，水不勝金，獼","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770347054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㺅何故畏鼠？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770347054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌土也，申㺅也，土不勝金，㺅何故畏犬？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770363438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二辰之禽，以氣性相克，則尤不相應。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770379822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡含血之","logicSentenceId":"75773451 {"lines":[{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論人元司事","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770412590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫一氣渾淪，形質未離，孰爲陰陽？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770412590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太始旣肇，裂一爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770428974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三，倐忽乃分。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770428974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天得之而輕清爲陽，地得之而重濁爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770445358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770445358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人位乎天地之中，禀陰陽冲和之氣，故此輕清者。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770461742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲十干主祿，謂之天元；重濁者爲十二支主身，謂之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770478126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地元。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770478126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地各正其位，成才於兩間者，乃所謂人也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770494510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770510894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支中所藏者，主命謂之人元，名爲司事之神。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770510894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以命術","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770527278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言之，爲月令用神。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770527278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：用神不可損傷，日主最宜徤","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770543662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770543662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月建寅，寅中有艮土用事，五日，丙火長","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770560046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097656299126784"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生五日，甲木二十日。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770560046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二月建卯，卯中有甲木用事七","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770576430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日，乙木二十三日。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770576430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三月建辰，辰中有乙木用事，七日，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770592814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水墓庫五日，戊土一十八日。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770592814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四月建己，巳中有戊","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770609198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土七日，庚金長生五日，丙火一十八日。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770609198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五月建午，午","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770625582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中丙火用事七日，丁火二十三日。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144770625582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且春之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782012425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用木，秋之用金，固一定之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782012425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若雜揉寓處之神，占","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782028809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用幾日，則本宫主氣之數，未𡮢不缺而𧇊矣，則何以","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782028809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見春木夏火，一氣流行，各旺七十二日之數耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782028809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以四","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782045193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"季配五行之用，乃主有納客之數，客無勝主之理。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782045193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782061577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主氣之司權，自有初、中、未三氣之淺深，用之者特宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782061577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"較量輕重言耳，又豈可以三五七日爲限哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782077961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其說足","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782094345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以破淵源之誤。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782094345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又支中所藏，止以月論年、日時，不論","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782110729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606483607603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命，重提綱，厥有旨哉！","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782110729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論四時節氣，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782127113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立節中氣，其春秋有分而不言至，夏冬有至而不言","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782127113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782127113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及夫雨水、驚蟄以降，二十四氣，分屬有名，亦必有","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782143497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以爲名者。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782143497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何言乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782159881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四立者，四時之節氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782176265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑之終，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782192649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅之始則爲節，月之半則爲中。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782192649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二分者，陰陽相半之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782209033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782209033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二至者，至有二義。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782225417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子
