{"lines":[{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至者，介乎巳、午亥子之間也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782258185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至亥，陰極，故曰子。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782274569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子者止也，陽於此生，故亦曰至。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782290953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至巳，陽極，故曰午。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782307337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午者忤也，陰於此生，故亦曰至。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782323721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自秋分水始涸，立冬","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782340105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097656299159552"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水始冰。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782340105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至水泉動，大寒水澤腹堅，爲今之雨水者，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782356489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先是爲露、爲霜、爲雪，皆水氣凝結，以至於寒之極。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782356489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782372873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則暑氣順行，而又爲暑之始也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782372873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况天一生水，人物之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782389257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生，皆始於水。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782389257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春屬木，木生於水，立春後繼以雨水，宜","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782405641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782405641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦氣正月爲泰，天氣下降，當爲雨水；二月大壯，雷","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782422025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在天上，當爲驚蟄。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782422025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先雨水而後驚蟄，亦宜也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782438409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驚蟄者，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782454793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物出乎震，震爲雷也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782454793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清明者，萬物齊乎巽，巽爲風","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782471177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782471177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽潔齊而曰清明，清眀乃潔齊之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782487561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣹬雨，三月中，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782503945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自雨水後，𡈽膏脉動，至此又雨，則土脉生物，所以滋","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782503945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五榖之種也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782503945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小滿，四月中，先儒云：小雪後，陽一日生","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782520329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097673139421238"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一分，積三十日生三十分，而成一畫，爲冬至。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782520329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小滿後","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782536713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰生亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782536713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫四月，乾之終，謂之滿者，姤初六羸豕孚","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782553097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蹢躅，坤初六履霜堅冰至。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782553097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羸豕喻其小，蹢躅喻其滿。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782569481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"履霜喻其小，堅冰喻其滿。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782585865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易言於一陰旣生之後，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782602249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暦","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782602249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言於一陰方萌之初，慮之深，防之預也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782602249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小雪後有大","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782618633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雪，此但有小滿無大滿，意可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782618633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至若三月中糓雨，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782635017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五月中芒種，此二氣獨指𣹬麦言，𣹬必原其生之始，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782635017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穀種於春，得木之氣，殘於秋，金尅木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782635017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麦必要其成","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782651401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之終，麦種於秋，得金之氣，成於夏，火尅金也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782651401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六月節","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782667785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小暑，六月中大暑，夏至後暑巳盗，不當又謂之小。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782667785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782684169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097641816277001"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知易曰：寒徃則暑來，暑徃則寒來，寒暑相推而歲","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782684169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782684169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通上半年之半皆可謂暑，通下半年之半，皆可","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782700553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂寒。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782700553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月暑之始，十二月寒之終，而曰大暑、小暑者，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782716937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不過上半年之辭耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782716937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六月中，暑之極，故謂大，然則未","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782733321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於大，則猶爲小也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782733321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七月中，處暑也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782749705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月，暑之終，寒之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782766089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"始，大火西流，暑氣於是乎處矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782766089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處者，隠也，藏伏之義","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782782473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782782473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白露八月節。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782798857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寒露九月節。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782815241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋本屬金，金色白，金氣","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782831625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寒，白者露之色，寒者露之氣，先白而氣始寒，固有漸","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782831625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782831625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九月中霜降，露寒始結爲霜也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782848009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立冬後曰小雪、大","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782864393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雪，寒氣始於露，中於霜，終於雪。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782864393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霜之前爲露，露由白","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782880777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097641816309769"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而始寒，霜之後爲雪，雪由外而至大，皆有漸也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782880777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至小","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782897161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寒、大寒，豳風云：一之日觱發，二之日粟烈。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782897161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觱發風寒，","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782913545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故十一月之餘爲小寒；粟烈氣寒，故十二月之終爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782913545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大寒也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782913545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵合而言之，上半年主長生，曰雨、曰雷、曰","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782929929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風，皆生之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782929929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下半年主生成，曰露、曰霜、曰雪，皆成之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782946313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782946313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下半年言天時，不言農時，農時莫急於春夏也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782962697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782979081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"儒云：變者化之漸，化者變之成。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782979081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立春雨水後，寒氣漸","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782995465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變，至立夏則寒盡化爲水矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144782995465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然曰小暑大暑，其化固。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783011849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有漸也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783028233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立秋處暑後，暑氣漸變，至立冬則暑氣盡化","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783044617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲寒矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783044617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然曰小寒大寒，其化亦有漸也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783061001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：日月運","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783077385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097671591526409"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行而四時成，以其有常也，故聖人立法以歩之；陰陽","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783077385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相錯而萬物生，以其無窮也，故聖人指物以候之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783077385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貫","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783093769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六氣終始早晏，五運大小盈虛，原之以至理，考之以","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783093769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至數，而垂示萬古，無有差忒也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783093769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：五日謂之候，三","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783110153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"候謂之氣，六氣謂之時，四時謂之歲。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783110153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：日爲陽，月","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783126537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲陰，行有分紀，周有道里，日行一度，月行十三度而","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783126537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有奇焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783126537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故大小月三百六十五日而成歲，積氣餘而","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783142921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盈閏矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783142921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：日常於晝夜行天之一度，則一日也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783159305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"共","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783175689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三百六十五日四分之一，而周天度，乃成一歲。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783175689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常五","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783192073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰一候應之，故三候成一氣，卽十五日也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783192073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二氣成一","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783208457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097641816293385"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節，節謂立春春分，立夏夏至，立秋秋分，立冬冬至，此","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783208457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四節也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783208457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三八二十四氣，而分主四時，一歲成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783224841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783241225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言分者，以六氣言之，則二月半初氣終而交二之氣；","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783241225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八月半四氣𥁞而交五之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783241225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以四時之分言之，則","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783257609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽寒暄之氣到此可分之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783257609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晝夜分五十刻，亦","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783273993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽之中分也，故經曰：分則氣異，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783273993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬夏言","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783290377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至者，以六氣言之，則五月半司天之氣至其所在，十","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783290377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一月半在泉之氣至其所在。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783290377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以四時之令言之，則陰","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783306761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽至此極至之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783306761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至日長，不過六十刻，陽至此","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783323145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而極；冬至日短，不過四十刻，陰至此而極，皆天候之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783323145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606349226019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未變，故經曰至則氣同，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783323145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天自西而東轉，其","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783339529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月五星循天從東而西轉，故白虎通曰：天左旋，日","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783339529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月五星右行。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783339529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月五星在天爲陰，故右行，猶臣對君。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783355913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783372297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日則晝夜行天之一度，月則晝夜行天之十三度","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783388681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有奇者，謂復行一度之中，作十九分，分之得七。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783388681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大率","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783405065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月行疾速，終以二十七日，月行一周天，是將十三度","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783405065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及十九分之七數總之，則二十九日計行天三百入","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783405065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十七度有奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783405065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"計月行疾之數，比日行遲之數，則二十","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783421449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九日，日方行天二十九度，月已先行一周天三百六","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783421449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十五度外，又行天之二十二度，反少七度，而不及日","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783421449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097625961955339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144783421449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽家說謂日月之行，自有前後遲速不等，固無","logicSentenceId":"7577345144978931762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常凖，則有大小月𥁞之異也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144978931762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":0," {"lines":[{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閏月之紀，則無立氣、建","logicSentenceId":"7577345144978997298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方皆他氣，但依曆以八節見之，推其所餘，乃成閏，天","logicSentenceId":"7577345144978997298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"度畢矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144978997298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故經曰：立端於始，表正於中，推餘於終，此之","logicSentenceId":"7577345144979013682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345144979013682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論日看命之法，以時爲低昻。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046040614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時有八刻，初正之氣不","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046056998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046056998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初者，其朔氣也；正者，其中氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046073382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故用時之法，毎用","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046089766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其正。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046089766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若癸爲子下四刻，艮爲丑下四刻，以其得天干","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046106150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之正氣焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046106150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若初則帶先時之氣，未占後時之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046122534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况夜","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046138918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"半不分，其日頓差，子亥中間，厥時難定，除初初正四","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046138918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刻，餘六刻之間，或陰晴倐忽，寒煖逈别，人之生時，果","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046138918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606349307939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得其當也耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046138918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余姑就授時曆分之，要在智者宻察而","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046155302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳問之，庻無誤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046155302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論太陽躔次，太陰納甲及出入㑹合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046171686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳摶曰：日，陽中之陽，人君之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046188070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其德至剛，其體至","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046204454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徤，其行天，所以分晝夜，别寒暑，一日一周天，而在天","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046204454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲不及一度。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046204454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一歲之積，恰與天㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046220838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故日有三道。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046237222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中道","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046253606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，黄道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046253606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北至東井，去極近，南至𪺮牛，去極逺，東至","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046269990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"角，西至婁，去極中，通中道、南道、北道，爲三道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046269990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
