577345145046433830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八月秋分，中氣後八日躔辰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046450214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽星之次，其應巽艮坤乾。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046450214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九月霜降，中氣後九日","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046466598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097671591591945"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"躔卯大火之次，其應乙辛丁癸。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046466598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十月小雪，中氣後","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046482982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七目躔寅拆木之次，其應甲庚丙壬。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046482982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月冬至，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046499366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中氣後四日躔丑星紀之次，其應艮巽坤亁。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046499366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046515750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月大寒，中氣後六日躔子玄枵之次，其應癸乙丁辛。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046515750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月陽中之陰，后𡚱之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046532134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其德至柔，而其體至順，其","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046548518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行天，所以佐理大陽。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046548518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驗之夜景，以爲消息。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046564902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月本無光，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046581286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麗目而有明，以不明之體言之，則純陰而象坤。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046581286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晦朔","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046597670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之時也，越三十日，不及日三十七度強，而哉生眀，始","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046597670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"資日之明而有光，因謂之朏，陽之初生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046597670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昏見於庚，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046614054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震三之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046614054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"越八日，不及日九十八度強，而資日之","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046630438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097712146284580"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"半明，因謂之弦，乃陽將半也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046630438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昏見於丁，兊三之𧰼也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046646822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"越十五日，不及日一百八十二度半強，與對望，資日","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046663206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之全明而大圓，因謂之望，言三陽具俻也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046663206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昏見於甲，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046679590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亁三之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046679590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又三日，不及日二百一十九度強，而哉","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046695974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生魄，與日之望偏，而陰魄始生，因謂之魄，謂陰復萌","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046695974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046695974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晨見於辛，巽三之𧰼也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046712358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又五日，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046728742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不及日之二百八","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046728742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十一度強，而半晦半資日之明，因謂之下弦，謂月生","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046728742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之半也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046728742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晨見於丙，艮三之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046745126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又六日與日之四百","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046761510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九十分強，則不及𥁞三百六十五度四分之一，而與","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046761510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日交㑹，日之明全不能相資，復晦而不明，因謂之晦，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046761510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097656299388928"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𥁞没於乙，坤三之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046761510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其行天之度，一日之行，得三","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046777894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百度十九分度之七，在天爲不及二十度十九分度","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046777894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之七，在日爲不及十三度十九分度之七。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046777894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"積二十九","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046794278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日九百四十分日之四百九十九，而與日會於辰次","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046794278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，所以爲一歲。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046794278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二㑹，得三百五十四日九百四十","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046810662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分日之三百四十分，而與天會，是爲一歲也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046810662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故月有","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046827046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九行。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046827046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九行者，乃黒道二。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046843430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立冬冬至，出黄道北，赤道二；","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046859814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立夏夏至，出黄道南，白道二；立秋秋分，出黄道西，𡉉","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046859814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道二；立春春分，出黄道東，并黄道共爲九行也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046859814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故立","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046876198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春春分，從靑道分在甲度，立秋秋分，從白道分在庚","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046876198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606349422627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"度；立冬冬至，從黒道分在壬度；立夏夏至，從赤道分","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046876198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在丙度。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046876198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其日月會合之辰，三合所照之方，是爲天德、","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046892582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月德之星。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046892582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故三月建辰，其三合申子辰，日月會於酉，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046908966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出於庚，入垣於壬，故天德月德在壬。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046908966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六月建未，其三","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046925350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合亥卯未，日月會於午，出於丙，入垣於甲，故天德月","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046925350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"德在甲。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046925350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九月建戌，其三合寅午戍，日月會於卯，出於","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046941734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲，入垣於丙，故天德月德在丙。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046941734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月建丑，其三合","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046958118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑，日月會於子，出於壬，入垣於庚，故天德月德","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046958118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在庚。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046958118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢子午日月之終始，卯酉日月之門戸出没，故","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046974502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其分多而有太陰、太陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046974502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人命遇日躔之次，四大","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046990886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097656299405312"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉時，及天月二德生，謂之聚一月德秀，多貴顯仁慈。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145046990886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再納甲卦氣，則富貴悠悠，與日月同體矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047007270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余又疑納","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047023654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲之說，易不言及，而𠫭同契言之，術數之家據以爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047023654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙理。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047023654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不思月之本體，未有𧇊缺，以其受明有時故名，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047040038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而其圓者未甞不在也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047040038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若納甲於卦，其八卦分有陰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047056422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽連斷，一定不易，惡可與之相配，以月昏見於庚爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047056422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震之象，見於丁爲兌之象也耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047056422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離二卦，中實中虛，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047072806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驗之太陰則不類，乃以戊巳納焉，未免穿鑿。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047072806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考青嚢","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047089190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經：甲、乙壬癸𨽾於陽，而陽中四枝繫焉；庚、丙丁辛隸","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047089190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於陰，而陰中四枝配焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047089190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳摶註云：此言納干配支之","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047105574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097742852767778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法，聖人所以入用之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047105574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾，陽體也，居於九宮，卦陽","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047121958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而數奇也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047121958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲得天三之陽，天干陽首，亁稱乎父，故納","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047138342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干於甲。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047138342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤陰體也，居於一宫，卦陰而數偶也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047154726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙得地","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047171110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八之陰，天干陰首，坤稱乎母，故納干於乙。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047171110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乾坤父","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047187494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047187494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納干於東，以東者物生之地也，故亁坤秉其權焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047203878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮陽穉也，居於六宫，卦陽而數奇也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047220262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙得天七之陽，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047236646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮爲少男，故納干於丙，此坤卦之一變也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047236646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兊陰穉也，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047253030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居於四宫，卦陰而數偶也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047253030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁得地二之陰，兊爲少女，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047269414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故納干於丁，此乾卦之一變也，故少男少女納干於","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047269414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南，以南者物化之地也，故艮、兊司其化焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047269414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震陽長也，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047285798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097742852751394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居于八宮，卦陽而數偶也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047285798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚得天九之陽，震爲長男，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047302182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故𥾔干於庚，此乾卦之再變也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047302182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽陰長也，居於二宮，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047318566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦陰而數偶也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047318566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛得地四之陰，巽爲長女，故納干於","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047334950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛，此坤卦之再變也，故長男長女納干於西，以西者。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047334950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物成之地也，故震、巽專其令焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047351334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離，陰用也，居於三宫，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047367718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦陰而數奇也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047367718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬得天一之陽，離爲中女，故納干於","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047384102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬，此乾卦之四變也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047384102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎，陽用也，居於七宫，卦陽而數","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047400486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047400486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸得地六之陰，坎爲中男，故納干於癸，此坤卦","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047416870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之四變也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047416870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故中男、中女納干於北。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047433254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以北者，物藏之地","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047449638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故坎離司其任焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047449638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己得天五地十之成數，爲天","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047466022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097641816375305"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地之中氣，故中處而尊居皇極，無可配納，化成於四","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047466022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之季，而致養於坤，以坤質土也，火金之交也，故附","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047466022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麗焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047466022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢其陰陽以數相從，孤𮶑以卦而定。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047482406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至若地支","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047498790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十有二辰，納卦之法，則四行分配，而附麗於四正之","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047498790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047498790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎以水體，申子辰，水之垣也，故納坎從水。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047515174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離以火","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047531558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體，寅午戍，火之垣也，故納離從火。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047531558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兊以金體，己酉丑，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047547942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金之垣也，故納兊從金。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047547942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震以木體，亥卯未木之垣也，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047564326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故納震從木。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047564326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此陽支從陽干，陰支從陰干也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047580710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於是五","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047597094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣生成，八卦翕合，聖人者因其至理而消息之，以爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047597094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙用，使天陽地陰，一闢一闔，一造一化，生成無方，其","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047597094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606349389859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幾微矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047597094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丹經歷術納甲之說，無出老子載營魄、抱一，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047613478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能無離乎一章。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047613478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其以日月言者，謂日以其光加於月","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047629862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魄而爲之明，如人登車而載於其上也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047629862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月未望而載","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047646246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魄於西，旣望則終魄於東，其遡於日乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047646246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言月之方生，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047662630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則以日之光加被於魄之西，而漸滿其東，以至於望","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047662630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而後圓。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145047662630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及旣望矣，則以日之光終守其魄之東，而漸","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167675419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𧇊其西，以至於晦而後𥁞。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167675419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢月遡日以爲明，未望則","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167691803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日在其右，既望則日在其左，故各自其所在而受光。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167691803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以卦納之，似非實論。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167708187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論五行旺相休囚𣦸，並寄生十二宫，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167724571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097673139486774"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盛德乘時日旺，如春木旺，旺則生火，火乃木之子，子","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167724571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乘父業，故火相木用水生，生我者父母。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167724571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今子嗣得時，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167740955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"登高明顯赫之地，而生我者當知退矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167740955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故水休休者，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167757339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"美之無極，休然無事之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167757339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火能尅金，金乃木之鬼，被","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167773723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火尅制，不能施設，故金囚火能生士。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167773723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土爲木之財，財","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167790107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲隠藏之物，草木發生，土散氣塵，所以春木尅土則","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167790107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167790107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏火旺，火生土則土相，木生火則木休，水尅火則","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167806491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水因，火尅金則金𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167806491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六月土旺，土生金則金相，火生","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167822875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土則火休，木尅土則木囚，土尅水則水𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167822875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋金旺，金","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167839259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生水則水相，土生金則土休，火尅金則火囚，金尅木","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167839259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097712146333732"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則木𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167839259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬水旺，水生木則木相，金生水則金休，土尅","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167855643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水則土囚，水尅火則火𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167855643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀夏月大旱，金石流，水土","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167872027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焦；六月暑氣増，寒氣滅；秋月金勝，草木黄落；冬月大","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167872027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寒太冷，水結冰凝，火氣頓减，其旺其𣦸，槩可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167872027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167888411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四時之序，節滿卽謝；五行之性，功成必覆。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167888411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故陽極而","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167904795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"降，陰極而升，日中則昃，月盈則𧇊，此天之常道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167904795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167921179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生天地，勢積必損，財聚必散，年少反衰，樂極反悲，此","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167921179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之常情也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167921179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故一盛一衰，或得或失，榮枯進退，難逃","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167937563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此理。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167937563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：人雖靈於萬物，命莫逃乎五行。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167953947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斯言𥁞矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167970331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行寄生十二宫，長生沭浴，冦带臨官，帝旺衰病","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167986715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097712146366500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸，墓絶胎養，循環無端，週而復始。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145167986715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"造物大體，與人相","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168003099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似，循𤨔十二宫，亦若人世輪廻也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168003099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命提要云：五行","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168019483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寄生十二宫，一曰受氣，又曰絶，曰胞。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168019483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以萬物在地中，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168035867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未有其象，如母腹空，未有物也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168035867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二曰受胎，天地氣交。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168052251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氤氲造物，其物在地中萌芽，始有其氣，如人受父母","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168068635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168068635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三曰成形，萬物在地中成形，如人在母腹成","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168085019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168085019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四曰長生，萬物發生向榮，如人始生而向長也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168101403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五曰沐浴，又曰敗，以萬物始生，形體柔脆，易爲所損，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168117787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人生後三日，以沐浴之，幾至困絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168117787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六曰冠帶，萬","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168134171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物漸榮秀，如人具衣冠也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168134171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七曰臨官，萬物旣秀實，如","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168150555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097729368080399"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之臨官也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168150555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八曰帝旺，萬物成熟，如人之興旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168166939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168183323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰衰，萬物形衰，如人之氣衰也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168183323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十曰病，萬物病，如人","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168199707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之病也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168199707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十一曰𣦸，萬物𣦸，如人之𣦸也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168216091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二曰墓，又","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168232475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰庫，以萬物成功而藏之庫，如人之終而歸墓也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168232475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168248859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓則又受氣包胎而生。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168248859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡推造化，見生旺者，未必便","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168265243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作吉論；見休囚𣦸絶，未必便作㐫言。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168265243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如生旺太過，宜","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168281627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乎制伏；𣦸絶不及，宜平生扶，妙在識其通變。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168281627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以胎","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168298011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生、旺庫爲四貴，𣦸絶、病敗爲四忌，餘爲四平，亦大槩","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168298011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168298011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論遁月時","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168314395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097606349439011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫命以年爲本，爲父，月爲兄弟僚友，日爲主，爲妻，爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168314395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己身，時爲子孫，爲帝座，爲平生榮辱之主首。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168314395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：年","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168330779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲根，月爲苖，日爲花，時爲實。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168330779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故苖無根不生，實無花","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168347163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不結。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168347163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以遁月從年遁時，從日遁月。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168363547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽甲己之年，正","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168379931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月起丙寅，二月丁卯，順行十二月。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168379931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168396315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己之年丙作首，乙庚之歳戊爲頭。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168396315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛之歲尋庚上，丁壬壬位順行流。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168412699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有戊癸何處起，用寅之上好追求。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168429083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遁時如甲子日子時生人，卽甲己還加甲，便知子時","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168445467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097712146382884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃甲子，丑時乃乙丑，順行十二時。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168445467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168461851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己還加甲，乙庚丙作初。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168461851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛從戊起，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168478235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬庚子居。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168478235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸何方發，壬子是直途。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168494619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右起月時之法，取天干合數，陰陽之配也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168511003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣取合數，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168527387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自生化數，月則取生，時則取尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168527387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲己化土，火生","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168543771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土，故月起丙寅；木尅土，故時起甲子。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168543771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月遁起寅，人生","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168560155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於寅之義，東作方興之時也；時遁起子，天開於子之","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168560155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"義，一陽方生之候也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168560155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"究而言之，則皆相生而轉，循𤨔","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168576539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無端焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168576539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢上古暦元年甲子月甲子日，甲子時，甲子","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168592923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097718630662180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳起甲子，祖於此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168592923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有甲子，則乙丑、丙寅順布十","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168609307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二宫，陽生陽，陰生陰，相同一位，同類爲夫婦。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168609307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是起月","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168625691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之法，不外起時之中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168625691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論年月日時","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168642075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡論人命，年月日時，排成四柱，遁月從年，則以年爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168642075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本；遁時從日，則以日爲主。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168642075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法以年看子平，以日看","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168658459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本此。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168658459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人本木而得卯月以乗之，主金而得酉時以","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168674843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乘之，谓之本主乘旺氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168674843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如本水而得甲申、丙子、壬戌、","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168691227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥月，主火，而得丙寅戊午、甲辰、乙巳時；本木而得","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168691227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥辛卯、甲寅、庚寅月，主金而得辛巳、癸酉、庚申、壬","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168691227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097673139519542"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申時，謂之本主還家；本木而得癸未月，主金而得乙","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168691227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑時；本水而得壬辰月，主火而得甲戌時，謂之本主","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168691227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"持印。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168691227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四位如此，更吉神徃來，㐫煞廻避，謂之本主得","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168707611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168707611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本勝於主者，多得祖蔭；主勝於本者，當自卓立。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168723995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168740379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主兩強，富貴雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168740379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱中更抑揚歸中，無太過不及，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168756763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方作好命。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168756763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有一位不及，必主蹇滯。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168773147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然諸家命術皆云：","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168789531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好年不如好月，好月不如好日，好日不如好時。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168789531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大率","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168805915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以年則統乎一歲，月則該乎三十，而時日爲得之，獨","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168805915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知得日時之吉而月不應，反爲無用。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168805915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况用神多取","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168822299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸月，是月又可輕乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168822299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唐李虛中獨以日干爲主，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168838683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"却以","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168838683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1838","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097729368064015"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月時合看生尅制化、旺相休囚，取立格局，譬之衡","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168838683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焉，年如衡鈎，綰起其物；月如綱紐，提起其物；日如衡","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168838683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身，星雨不差，𫒳分輕重，分毫加减。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168838683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此𤼵前賢所未發，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168855067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故今術家宗之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168855067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然古人論命，分三主，定三限，以年與","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168871451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月管初主，月與日管中主，日與時管末主。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168871451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其法與星","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168887835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暦家分三主同。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168887835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若初主星當生年，得力則初主好，不","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168904219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得力則初主蹇滯，中、末主同。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168904219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三限以生月爲初限，管","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168920603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十五年；生日爲中限，管二十五年；生時爲末限，管","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168920603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五十年。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168920603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若初限值禄馬貴神，不犯空亡截路，交退伏","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168936987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神，便於初限進逹；中限如初限，便當中年成立；末限","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168936987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1855","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097742852816930"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如中限，便當晚年享用。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168936987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是四柱中分三主，三限可見","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168953371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當均重也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168953371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：年爲太歲，主人一生禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168969755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如當生太歲，是金是","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168986139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木，要日月時相生相應，造化和順，則根基牢固，一生","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168986139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卓立成就。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145168986139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若支干五行不順，反尅衝破爲傷，本主無","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169002523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽，被刑带煞，及生月日時者，主損本氣，破傷祖業，六","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169002523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"親冷淡蹇滯之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169002523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月爲運元，行運從月建起。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169018907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169035291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時是本生年之福，宜歸運元生旺處，以扶𦔳之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169035291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故官","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169051675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印貴人、禄馬財星，宜在運元生旺處爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169051675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日時是","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169068059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本生年之禍，宜歸運元剥尅處以潜濟之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169068059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故土多窒","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169084443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1874","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097671591641097"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"塞，宜歸運元疏通處；水多泛濫，宜歸運元歸宿處；火","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169084443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多暴露，宜歸運元晦息處；金木太強，宜歸運元沉潜","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169084443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169084443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或運元集生時之福，或運元發福於生時。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169100827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日者，三","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169117211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之會，帝王之象；時者，近侍之臣，以親帝座。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169117211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而時日","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169133595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有君臣慶㑹，天地德合，或年月日時四位納音生旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169133595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，或四位祿馬福貴之氣聚於時上，謂之四位，集","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169149979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福於帝座；或時倒掲旺氣秀氣散在諸位，而諸位乘","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169149979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㑹之氣者，謂之帝座，發福於四位。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169149979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫集福於帝座，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169166363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則以純厚忠信爲心；發福於四位，則以聰明端直自","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169166363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169166363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若近侍之臣，切忌土火金氣太旺，不能久任。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169182747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水木","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169199131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1891","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097671591657481"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清奇，多是翰林。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169199131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月發福處，不要生時破壞；敗壞處","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169215515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仍要生時解釋。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169215515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由是論之，年月日時均重，而時爲尤","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169231899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169231899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命貴賤壽夭，窮通得喪，只在生時之辨。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169248283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時分八","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169264667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刻，有初正末氣不同，須細察之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169264667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：節氣有立春在","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169281051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月末，却在十二月生，得明年春氣，占兩年氣候","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169281051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，謂之垂帶貴人；有二月而得三月節氣，却在交氣","logicSentenceId":"7577345145169281051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之時，餘剰中生者，謂之無後貴人。","logicSe "logicSentenceId":"7577345145406898186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子曰：老幼","logicSentenceId":"7577345145406914570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愼勿坐強，壯實惟宜趨旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145406914570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺雖吉而未必吉，衰滅","logicSentenceId":"7577345145406930954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖㐫而未必㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145406930954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"達此者始可論運。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145406947338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋人自生至老，必","logicSentenceId":"7577345145406963722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從微以至少壯，十歲之時，方當少年，惟可行胎養生","logicSentenceId":"7577345145406963722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沐浴冠帶處；三十四十，當陽強齒壯之時，可行旺處；","logicSentenceId":"7577345145406963722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五十六十天癸枯竭，只可行衰敗𣦸絕。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145406963722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反此者謂之","logicSentenceId":"7577345145406980106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生運背，三限驅馳。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145406980106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直饒晩入旺郷，已非符叶。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145406996490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407012874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097742852898850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命中五行衰者運宜盛；五行盛者運宜衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407012874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰者復行","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407029258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰運，是謂不及；不及則迍蹇沉滯；盛者復行盛運，是","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407029258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂太過，過則擊作成敗，要歸於中而巳。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407029258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子云：年","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407045642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖逄於冠帶，尚有餘災；運初入於衰鄉，猶披尠福。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407045642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407062026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氏註云：年運或初離沐浴暴敗之地，順行至冠𢃄，未","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407062026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可便以爲福，尚有衰敗之餘災也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407062026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或自旺地而行，初","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407078410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入衰鄉，亦不可便以爲禍，猶披旺鄉之尠福也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407078410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行運","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407094794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以有前後五年之說。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407094794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壼中子曰：將徹不徹，寕有久","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407111178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"否之殃；欲交不交，尚有幾殘之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407111178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢言運行在衰絕。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407127562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之處，將入吉庆之地，必於臨離之時，更有重撓。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407143946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運在","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407160330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097774041661481"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉慶之地，將入衰絕之處，必於初入之時，更有重福。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407160330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：吉運未到先作福，㐫神過去始爲殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407176714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃火未熖","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407193098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而先烟，水旣徃而猶濕之理，當更詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407193098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：陰男陽","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407209482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女，時觀出入之年；陰女陽男，更看元辰之歲。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407209482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢言陰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407225866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男陽女稟氣不順，故大運時觀出運入運之年，而有","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407225866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㐫之變。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407225866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽男陰女禀氣雖順，不以出入之年爲應，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407242250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不可遇元辰之厄會。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407242250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子云：元辰犯運，仲尼困","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407258634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳蔡之饑是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407258634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡大運行有益處，爲吉泰之運，亦不能常爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407275018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須候太歲行年，更於生旺和合，方可發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407291402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若大運至","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407307786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097774041628713"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉鄉，却遇逐年太歲，小運到刑害之鄉，亦主細累浮","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407307786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾，但不爲重害也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407307786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若大運行迍蹇㐫禍之地，逐年太","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407324170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲又見刑衝，小運不和，衝擊𣦸絕，方主發禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407324170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若小運","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407340554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與太歲到生旺祿馬、貴神一切吉神，其年却有小慶，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407340554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過去則否。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407340554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經云：凡推命之禍福，須先度量基地","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407356938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚薄，然後定灾福。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407356938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命有十分福氣，行三四分惡運，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407373322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"都不覺㐫，福力厚故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407373322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若五六分惡運，只浮災細累","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407389706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而已，至七八分惡運，方有重灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407389706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命有五分福氣，行","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407406090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三四分惡運，爲甚㐫；若四五分惡運，則須𣦸，葢基地","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407406090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不牢故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407406090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若大運曽歷𨓺本命長生處者，謂之氣盛","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407422474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097718630711332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之運，雖歲運來衝尅者，爲禍不重，運氣強故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407422474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未經","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407438858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生，而嵗運刑衝尅破，則便爲灾，蓋氣未僃，運弱故","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407438858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407438858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若曽過旺相，而逢𣦸絶，如命不吉，爲災亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407455242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407471626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行代謝之順道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407471626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱𣦸於此，亦須令疾而終。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407488010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若方","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407504394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經長生，歷於敗地，其中有刑尅惡煞與命相符而見","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407504394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，則五行之氣反戰，故有㐫惡而終。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407504394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡行運長生，主有創建作新之事。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407520778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"到臨官帝旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407537162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主興盛快樂，發福，進財生子，骨肉之慶；到衰病之鄉，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407537162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多退敗破財、疾病等事。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407537162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

ntenceId":"7577345145407668234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢貴爲君道，馬主遷動故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407684618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡子丑寅卯辰巳四柱陽多，人行運至午未申","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407701002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉戌亥上，乗陰氣而發。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407701002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午未申酉戌亥四柱陰多，人","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407717386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行子丑寅卯辰巳運，乗陽氣而發，二者陰陽均恊。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407717386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407733770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰人陽發者快，陽人陰𤼵者遲。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407733770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097671591772169"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日：凡水命，四柱有土，至火運，本是財運，𨚫反爲鬼","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407750154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，以火生土，土尅水，是財化爲鬼，轉福成禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407750154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱有","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407766538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金，至土運，是鬼運，却反爲吉者，以土生金，金生水，是","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407766538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化鬼爲𦔳氣，反禍爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407766538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如水命人，柱有寅午戌，或","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407782922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納音火，更行寅午戌，皆爲好運。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407782922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱有金有火，固","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407799306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407799306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若行水運，則分擘其福，卽爲不好運。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407815690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱多","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407832074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土，却行木運，名𠙵損氣，主駁雜，雖有救，亦多辛苦歇","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407832074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滅。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407832074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407848458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：丁丑人行丁未運，名曰將凢入聖，以假爲眞，不","logicSentenceId":"7577345145407864842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以退神論。","logicSentenceId":"757734514540 {"lines":[{"lineId":"2293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若雜而不入","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408077834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2294","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097743007957018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"象者，不發，發亦不久。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408077834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如五純象，亦有太過之象，仍詳","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408094218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當生月令得地，然後看行運得地不得地而言，不可","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408094218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以遇祿馬貴人爲得運，遇空亡、陽刃、刼煞爲失運也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408094218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡行運，看納音年庚金木、水火土，是何命人如。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408110602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土命而行西南方，爲西南得朋之慶。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408126986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木命而行東方，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408143370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火命而行南方，金命而行西方，水命而行北方，皆爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408143370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得地。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408143370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看所行之運，納音與命相孚，同類最爲上吉，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408159754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408159754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"con
