{"lines":[{"lineId":"2317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古語云：傷寒換陽，行運換甲。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408274442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"換過是人，換","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408290826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不過是鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408290826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲戌接癸亥，是火土接水，丑交寅，辰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408307210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交巳，未交申，戍交亥，東西南北，四方轉角，謂栘根接","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408307210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408307210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更遇換甲格，㐫者多𣦸，善者亦災，老人大忌，後生","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408323594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"差慢。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408323594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若寅卯辰、巳午未、申酉戌、亥子丑，一氣相連，皆","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408339978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非接木之說，總遇接甲，亦無大禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408339978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲乙傳寅卯","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408356362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運，名曰刼財敗財，主尅父母及尅財敗財争闘之事。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408356362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097671591804937"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁巳午運各傷官運，主尅子女訟事囚繫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145408372746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛申","logicSentenceId":"7577345145519996979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉運七煞官鄉，主得名發越，太過則災病惡疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145519996979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520013363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子生氣、印綬運，主吉慶増産；辰戌丑未、戊巳財運，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520013363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主名利皆通。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520013363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃𣦸法，須隨格局喜忌推之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520029747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干旺宜","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520046131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰運，正所謂干弱則求氣旺之藉，有餘則欲不足之","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520046131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"營，須要通變，更兼流年諸神煞推之，其驗如神。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520046131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論小運","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520062515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫大運司十年之休咎，小運掌一歲之災祥。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520062515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是小運","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520078899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，補大運之不足而立名也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520078899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人以男起丙寅，女起","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520095283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申者何？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520095283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢元氣之所孕，始於子，立於巳，子者字之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520111667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097671591837705"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"始巳者包之始。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520128051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自子推之，男左行三十而立於巳，女","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520144435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右去，積二十而合之己。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520144435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳正陽也，陰實從焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520160819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故聖","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520177203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人因是而制禮，参天兩地，自然之數紀也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520177203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自己而壬","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520193587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，男十月毓於寅，女十月毓於申，申爲三陰，寅爲三","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520193587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，故年運起焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520193587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日生於甲，月生於庚，日月東西，夫婦","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520209971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520209971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲統於寅，庚統於申，是故陰陽之合以正，将","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520226355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以順性命之理耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520226355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此小運所以男起丙寅順行，女起","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520242739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申逆行，一定而不可易也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520242739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觧者謂：男子陽火元氣","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520259123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起戊子三十丁巳，十月至丙寅，此木生火；女子陰水","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520259123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元氣起庚子二十辛巳十月至壬申，爲金生水。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520259123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此其","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520275507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2367","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097742852948002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520275507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎通謂：男三十，筋骨堅強，任爲人父；女二十，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520291891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肌膚𠑽盛，任爲人母。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520291891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合爲五十，應大衍之數，以生萬","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520308275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520308275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽奇而舒，故三終；陰偶而促，故再終。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520324659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"參天兩地之","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520341043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道，此其理也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520341043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或者以甲子旬如上起甲申旬，男起丙","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520357427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍，女起壬辰；甲午旬男起丙申，女起壬寅；甲辰旬男","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520357427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起丙午，女起壬子；甲寅旬男起丙辰，女起壬戍，則非","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520357427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人原立起年運之義矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520357427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之談命者，只以大運爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520373811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用，殊不知小運亦有𦂳關。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520373811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大運雖吉，其小運不通，未","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520390195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可便言吉利。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520390195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如大運雖㐫，其小運却吉，未可便作㐫","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520406579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520406579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此小運又名行年，不可不究。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520422963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醉醒子以爲男女小","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520439347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097742853062690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運皆由時生，而行之逆順亦以年定。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520439347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如陽命陽年，甲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520455731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子時生，墮地卽行，乙丑二歲，丙寅一位，一年週而復","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520455731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"始。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520455731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰命陽年，逆行亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520472115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡮢試用之屢驗，亦要與大運","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520488499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及柱中用神日主較量吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520488499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

"logicSentenceId":"7577345145520619571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑於本命。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520619571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖太歲如君也，大運如臣也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520635955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如君臣和悅，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520652339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其年則吉；若値刑戰，其年則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520652339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"2425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何則？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520750643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下凌其上逆也，其㐫决不能免。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520767027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若五","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520783411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行有救，四柱有情，如甲日尅戊年，四柱元有庚申金，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520783411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2429","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097788025438243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或大運中亦有將甲木制伏純粹，不能尅戊土，爲有","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520783411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"救。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520783411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：戊巳愁逢甲乙，干頭須要庚辛是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520799795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如大運","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520816179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"并四柱中有一癸字，與戊相合，爲有情，經云：壬以癸","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520816179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妹配戊，㐫爲吉兆是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520816179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若二字俱全，其年㐫反爲吉；","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520832563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有一字者㐫半，二字俱無，㐫莫能觧。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520832563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：五行有救，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520848947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其年反必爲財。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520848947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱無情，故論名爲尅歲是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520865331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520881715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞太歲、征太歲之說，經云：生時相逢眞太歲。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520881715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520898099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子生人，又見甲子年，謂之眞太歲。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520898099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又各轉趾煞，要大","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520914483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運日主與太歲相和相順，其年則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520914483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若值刑衝破害，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520930867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與太歲互相戰尅則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520930867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸巳日逄丁亥流年日，干","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520947251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097788025454627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支衝尅太歲，曰征運，干支傷衝太歲，亦曰征太歲干。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520947251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支衝日干，支亦日征，其年則㐫，災禍未免。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520963635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如甲子","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520980019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流年，又是甲子運，謂之歲運并臨，獨羊刃七煞爲㐫，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520980019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印綬亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520980019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：歲運併臨，災殃立至。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145520996403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此指羊刃","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521012787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521012787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如甲子日見甲子太歳，謂之日年相併，如君","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521029171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子得之，謂之君臣慶㑹，其年利奏對，有靣君之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521029171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521045555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當省土人得之，有登薦仕進之象。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521045555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又要與歲君帝座","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521061939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和恊，方爲奇特。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521061939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是常俗小人遇之，最爲不善。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521078323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521094707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時相和，爲災稍輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521094707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"2469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉無官事擾，定主見重喪，此之謂歟。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521127475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更加以勾林、元","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521143859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097743007989786"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡、咸池、孤害、宅墓病𣦸、官符、䘮吊、白虎、羊刃、暴敗、天","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521143859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厄，諸㐫煞併臨，禍患百出，甚者𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521143859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲日見戊年","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521160243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲，甲又生寅卯亥未，年月日時，又重見甲乙字，併","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521160243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅戊年，柱中無庚辛、巳酉丑金局制木，丙丁火局焚","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521160243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木者，大㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521160243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一命戊辰、戊午、戊戌、甲寅，羊刃倒戈，遇","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521176627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申年四月，項生惡瘡，頭將墮𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521176627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又一命乙丑、乙亥、","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521193011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申、乙巳，運行辛未丙寅年，日干之壬尅太歲之丙，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521193011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日支之申庚尅太歲之寅，甲又寅刑己，巳刑申，申刑","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521193011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，行辛未運，合太歳之木局傷官，皆不爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521193011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其年甲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521209395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月火旺戰尅，故𣦸非命。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521209395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵日犯歲君，在五陽干","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521225779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2487","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097761756479525"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則重，在五陰干則輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521225779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日干是天月德，太歲是用神，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521242163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則無咎而反有獲。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521242163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若天衝地撃，柱中原有，流年再遇，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521258547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦無大咎。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521258547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若太歲尅當生時，或時尅太歲，亦主有災，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521274931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨚫以子位㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521274931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總論歲運。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521291315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫太歳者，年中天子，一歲諸神煞之尊，統正方位，廻","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521307699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"送六氣，遷運四時，以成嵗功，至尊無上。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521307699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人遇尅衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521324083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壓伏，皆爲不祥之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521340467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運者，恊和二十四氣，般運一生","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521356851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休咎，扶持四柱，輔弼三元。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521356851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運與流年二者相爲表裡，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521373235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃人命禍褔𣦸生所係。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521373235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲用天元，運用地支，凡行好","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521389619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097774041710633"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運而日干傷流年天元，爲禍輕；若行不好運，及脱財","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521389619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官運，而日干傷歲干，爲禍重。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521389619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是己發之命，禍患立","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521406003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521406003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行不好運，未可便言衰絕，大要知己發未發，其","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521422387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣數已過未𨓺言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521422387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行運以生月爲運元，最怕行運","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521438771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與太歲衝尅，若嵗運衝月，必禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521438771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若歳運與日相對，謂","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521455155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之返吟；歲運壓日，謂之伏吟，二者不利六親，非橫破","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521455155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財，不爲吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521455155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡歲運吉㐫，當生天元，或支中原無官","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521471539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星，天元有正官，或原有偏官，制伏太過。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521471539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運遇天元官","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521487923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星，亦可發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521487923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運支無財而運干是財，亦可發財；運支","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521504307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無煞而運干是煞，亦足爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521504307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097774041727017"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：晦氣者，乃不明之象，昏昧之道也，卽甲、己、乙、庚","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521520691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之例，以合則晦也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521520691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干與時干不宜與太歲天元合","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521537075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，則名爲晦氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521537075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又要分日干合太歲，如甲日己年之","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521553459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"例；太歲合日干，如己日甲年之例。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521553459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲合己災重，己合","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521569843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲災輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521569843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲位近者災重，遠者災輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521586227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如歲在日前五辰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521602611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而遇合，謂之太歲入宅，晦氣臨門，主災厄。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521602611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神白經曰：","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521618995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論晦氣，日輕時重，更看人元旺，則主門户眷屬之災；","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521618995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸絕併衝，主身災。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145521618995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在地支六合相合，謂之鴛鴦合，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532579886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有用，主好事相近。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532579886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若干支俱合，主添進人口，得吉神","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532596270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同位，士人宜見官奏薦文書之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532596270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若相憎，則有離别","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532612654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2543","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097788025520163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之苦。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532612654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有相刑之位，更處休囚，主本身災禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532629038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在六","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532645422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害之位，主小口有疾，或奴婢走失之惱。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532645422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在日時，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532661806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532661806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓之位，主門戶不寕，及陰人爲撓，若有懷姙，必産後","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532661806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有不寕之象，利生女，不利生男，生男母子有一失。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532661806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532678190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君與大運合亦同論。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532678190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：大運不宜與太歲相尅相衝，尤忌運尅歲與日","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532694574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犯同，主破耗喪事，有貴人、祿馬解之，稍吉，八字有救","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532694574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532694574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：歲衝尅運者吉，運衝尅歲者㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532710958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格局不吉","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532727342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者𣦸，歳運相生者吉，禄馬貴人相合交互者亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532727342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532743726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"審細推，無有不驗。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532743726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2562","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097788025471011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論進交退伏","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532760110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：以十干爲四候，十五日爲一候，十二日爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532760110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進神候，外三日爲交退伏神候。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532760110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲子爲第一進神，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532776494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則丙子、丁丑、戊寅爲交退伏神；己卯爲第二進神，則","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532776494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯、壬辰、癸巳爲交退伏神；甲午爲第三進神，則丙","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532776494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午、丁未、戊申爲交退伏神；己酉爲第四進神，則辛酉、","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532776494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌、癸亥爲交退伏神。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532776494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"値進神則發跡亨快；值交神","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532792878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則庻事不諧；値退神則官資降黜；值伏神則所作留","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532792878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滯。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532792878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：進神四座兼奇特，貴煞相扶爲福力。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532809262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532825646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532842030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中子云：順太歲而行曰進神，逆太歲而囘曰退神。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532842030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532858414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2579","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097788025503779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進神則文章頴銳，遇退神則智識暗昧。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532858414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廣信集則又","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532874798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以甲、乙、丙丁子丑寅卯爲進，丁丙、乙甲卯寅丑子爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532874798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"退。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532874798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若干支俱退者，主稱意，中有不稱意者隨之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532891182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532907566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌得甲寅爲進，得乙巳爲退，不在本旬者慢是，只有","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532907566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進退而無交伏，恐非是。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532907566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諭十干合","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532923950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫合者，乃和諧之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532923950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如陽見陽，二陽相競則爲尅；陰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532940334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見陰，二陰不足則爲尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532940334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟隂見陽，陽見陰爲合，亦如","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532956718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女相合而成夫婦之道。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532956718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：一陰一陽之謂道，偏","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532973102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽偏陰之謂疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532973102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145532989486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097729368162319"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東方甲乙木畏西方庚辛金尅，甲屬陽爲兄，乙屬陰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533005870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲妹，甲兄遂將乙妹嫁金家，與庚爲妻，所以乙與","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533005870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚合，乙雖嫁與庚爲妻，春來木旺金囚，不畏金尅","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533005870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙，遂歸本家就甲，然不免在金家懐胎，歸木家產。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533005870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木色青，金色白，是以春來園林木青，葉開白花。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533022254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南方丙丁火畏北方壬癸水尅，丙屬陽爲兄，丁屬陰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533038638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲妹。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533038638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙兄遂將丁妹嫁水家，與壬爲妻，所以丁與","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533055022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬合，丁雖嫁與壬爲妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533055022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏來火旺水囚，不畏水尅","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533071406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁，遂歸火家就丙，然不免在水家懷胎，歸火家産。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533071406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水色黒，火色赤。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533087790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小滿後，桑椹孰當有赤。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533104174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2611","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097788025536547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中央戊巳土，畏東方甲乙木尅，戊屬陽爲兄，己屬陰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533120558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲妹。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533120558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊兄遂將己妹嫁木家，與甲爲妻，所以甲與","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533136942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己合，己雖嫁與甲爲妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533136942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六月土旺木囚，不畏木尅","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533153326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己，遂歸土家就戊，然不免在甲家懐胎，歸戊家産。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533153326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西方庚辛金，畏南方丙丁火尅，庚屬陽爲兄，辛屬陰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533186094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲妹，庚兄乃將辛妹嫁火家，與丙爲妻，所以丙與","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533186094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛合，辛雖嫁與丙爲妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533186094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋來金旺火囚，不畏火尅","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533202478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛，乃歸金家就庚，然不免在火家懐胎，歸金家産。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533202478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火赤金白。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533218862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋中棗熟，有半赤半白之狀，楓葉丹。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533235246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2626","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097743008022554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北方壬癸水，畏中央戊巳土尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533251630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬屬陽爲兄，癸屬陰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533268014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲妹。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533268014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬兄乃將癸妹嫁土家，與戊爲妻，所以戊與","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533284398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸合，癸雖嫁與戊爲妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533284398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬來水旺土囚，不畏土尅","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533300782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸，遂歸水家就壬，然不免在戊家懐胎，歸壬家産。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533300782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水黒土黄，嚴冬霜雪，草木𣦸而黄出。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533317166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲與己何名爲中正之合？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533333550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲，陽木也，其性仁，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533349934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位處十","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533349934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干之首，己陰土也，鎭静淳篤，有生物之德，故甲己","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533349934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲中正之合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533349934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶此合，主人尊崇重大，寛厚平直。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533366318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533382702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶煞而五行無氣，則多嗔好怒，性梗不可屈。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533382702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙與庚何名爲仁義之合？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533399086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙，陰木也，其性仁而太柔；","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533415470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2645","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097761756528677"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚，陽金也，堅強不屈，則剛柔相濟，仁義兼資，故主","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533415470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人果敢有守，不惑柔侫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533415470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"周旋惟仁，進退惟義。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533431854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533448238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺，則骨秀形清。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533448238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若𣦸絕帶煞，則使氣好勇，體貌","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533464622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不揚，自是非人。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533464622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己乙庚之合，婦人不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533481006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙與辛何名爲威制之合？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533497390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙，陽火也，煇赫自盛；辛，陰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533513774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金也，尅刃喜煞，故丙辛爲威制之合，主人儀表威","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533513774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肅，人多畏懼酷毒，好賄喜滛。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533513774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若𢃄煞或五行𣦸絕，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533530158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則寡恩少義，無情之人，婦人得之，與天中大耗咸","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533530158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"池相併者，貌美聲卑，三合夭冶而滛。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533530158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁與壬何名爲淫慝之合？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533546542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬者純陰之水，三光不照；","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533562926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2663","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097729368195087"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁者藏陰之火，自昧不明，故丁壬爲淫慝之合，主","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533562926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人眼明神嬌，多情易動，不事高潔，習下無志，躭歡","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533562926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姻色，於我則吝，於彼則貪。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533562926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若五行𣦸絕，或带煞，見","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533579310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池大耗，天中自敗，有淫汚家風之醜。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533579310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"親厚小人，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533595694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"侮慢君子，貪婪妄作，必勝而後已。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533595694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人淫邪奸慝，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533612078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易挑易誘，多招玷辱。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533612078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或年高而嫁少婚，或年㓜而","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533628462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"配老夫，或先賤而後良，或先良而後賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533628462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊與癸何名爲無情之合？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533644846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌陽土也，是老醜之夫；癸，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533661230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰水也，是婆娑之婦。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533661230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老陽而少陰，雖合而無情，主","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533677614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人或好或醜。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533677614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊得癸，則嬌媚有神，姿美得所，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533693998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子娶少婦，婦人嫁美夫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533693998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若癸得戊，則形容古樸，老","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533710382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2683","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097761756577829"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相俗塵，男子娶老妻，婦人嫁老夫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533710382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經取戊得癸合，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533726766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少長無情是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533726766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或闘十干必隔六位一合，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533743150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余答曰：天地之數，各","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533759534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不過五，上五位爲生數，下五位爲成數，生數與成數","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533759534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相遇，然後合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533759534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天一生壬，地二生丁，天三生甲，地四生","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533775918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛，天五生戊，地六成癸，天七成丙，地八成乙，天九成","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533775918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚，地十成己，天一數見，地二數然後合，所以必隔六","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533775918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533775918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：天數五，地數五，五位相得而各有合是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533792302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533808686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行要論云：天一生水，其於物爲精，精者，一之所生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533808686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2698","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097743008104474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地二生火，其於物爲神，神者，二之所生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533825070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天三生木，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533841454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其於物爲魂，魂從神者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533841454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地四生金，其於物爲魄，魄","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533857838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從精者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533857838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天五生土，其於物爲體。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533874222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體者，精神魂魄具","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533890606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而後有者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533890606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自天一至天五，五行之生數；自地六至","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533906990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地十，五行之成數。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533906990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以竒生者成而偶，以偶生者成而","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533923374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竒，其成之者皆五五天數之中，所以成於物也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533923374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道立","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533939758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於一，成於三，變於五，而天地之數具矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533939758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其十也，偶之","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533956142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而己。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533956142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：一六同宗，二七同道，三八爲朋，四九爲友，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533972526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五十同途，闔闢奇偶是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533972526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金者貴乎得中而不偏。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145533988910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一甲得一己，各乘生旺，是","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534005294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2719","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097774041776169"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂得中而不偏。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534005294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲太旺，己太柔，两不相稱，是謂太","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534021678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨓺不及。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534021678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若一己合两甲，两甲合一已，是謂陰陽偏枯。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534038062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如婦多夫少，夫多婦少，相争相妬，皆亂之道也，故曰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534054446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏則亂。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534054446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子云：一氣偏枯，老爲俗物是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534070830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元變","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534087214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化書云：天干合陽得陰合，福慢，陰得陽合，福𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534087214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534103598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得己合爲財，已得甲合爲官。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534103598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽干遇陰干合，止得干","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534119982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合之福；陰干遇陽干合，又得正官合輔爲而里福，故","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534119982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𦂳慢不同，餘干𬾋推。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534119982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：干合更得支合，在一旬内。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534136366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲戌見己卯、甲辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534152750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見己酉之類，謂之君臣慶㑹；在兩旬内，如甲子見己","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534169134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2737","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097743008088090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，甲午見己未之類，謂之夫妻聚㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534169134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢世事有本國","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534185518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之君，未𡮢有異國之臣，所以在一旬内見，方曰君臣","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534185518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慶會。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534185518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仍要别其陽爲君，陰爲臣，君位致上，臣位致下，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534201902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方是。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145534201902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反此則悖。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666797577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世事有本郡之夫，𨚫有他郡之妻，所","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666813961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以各旬互見，謂之夫妻會聚，又名天地得合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666813961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見是","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666830345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，又須要和氣貴神相助，方爲有用。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666830345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內有衝破受傷，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666846729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合中有刑煞，皆爲不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666846729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"御製言談云：合中𢃄祿，定是","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666863113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公侯；合處相傷，反爲無補。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666863113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666879497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論十干化氣","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666895881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"復陽子曰：十干合而化者，陰陽之配，夫婦之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666895881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666912265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2757","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097761756626981"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六則合，遁三則化，以五子餘數，至巳上得合，旣合，遁","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666912265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎綂龍，龍主陽德，司天而成變化者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666912265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子者，坎之位，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666928649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天一生水，媾精之象，胎娠陽中，故男子從子左行，三","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666928649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十至巳，陽也，故三十而娶；女子從子右行，二十至巳，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666928649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰也，故二十而嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666928649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人事合五行之造化，詎可𨓺於","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666945033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此期哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666945033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東𡈼子至丁巳六數，故丁與壬合；丁壬化木，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666961417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲德綂龍。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666961417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南戊子至癸巳六數，故戊與癸合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666977801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸化火，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666994185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙德綂龍。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145666994185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2771","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097788025569315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667010569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子至乙巳六數，故乙與庚合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667026953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚化金，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667043337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚德綂龍。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667043337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中甲子至己巳六數，故甲與己合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667059721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己化土，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667076105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊德綂龍。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667076105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北丙子至辛巳六數，故丙與辛合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667092489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛化水，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667108873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬德綂龍。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667108873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己之歲，戊德綂龍，以土司化黅天土氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667125257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以有妬化之說。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667387401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲己見乙，乙庚見辛，丁壬見","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667403785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙，戊癸見壬，丙辛見丁，所謂妬花。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667403785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自戀其生，遂成一","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667420169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家之好，愛戀親情，何能從化？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667420169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故化𧰼須歸一方穏。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667436553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667452937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬化木，柱中見癸，並子雖強成木，不成眞物，是化","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667452937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而不化也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667452937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：大凡化氣，只取日干而言，配合之神，或年月與","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667469321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2825","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097788025618467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時皆可用。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667469321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但要日辰得旺氣於時，若不得月中旺氣，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145667485705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只時上旺氣亦可。","logicSenten {"lines":[{"lineId":"2965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯爲四陽，戌是五陰，四五得九數；辰","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668304905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲五陽，酉爲四陰，五四得九數；巳爲六陽，申爲三陰，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668304905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六三得九數；午爲一陰，未爲二陽，一二得三數。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668304905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668321289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午、未各得三者，三生萬物，餘皆得九者，乃陽數極也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668321289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡮢問論甲乙者，如何子與丑合？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668337673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆莫知其故。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668354057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因徧覧","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668370441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"群書，以觀大運，乃知壬亥之間，日月十二辰交㑹之","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668370441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所，凡月之㑹朔，日之璧於此，位謂之㑹，劣謂之集。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668370441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668386825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2976","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097718630875172"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二月之辰，如玄枵、星紀之類，與之同在焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668386825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一歲十二","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668403209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹，太陰太陽，隔液坎離之妙，此生萬轉圖，而放會合","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668403209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得可見也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668403209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月建丑，是時玄枵同在壬亥之間，以","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668419593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄枵在子之辰，此其所以爲子丑之合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145668419593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月建寅，是","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679380530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時娵訾在壬亥之間，以娵訾在亥之辰，此其所以爲","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679380530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅亥之合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679380530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二月建卯，此時降婁在壬亥之間，降婁戌，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679396914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故卯與戌合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679396914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三月建辰，此時大鿄在壬亥之間，大梁","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679413298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，故辰與酉合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679413298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四月建已，是時實沈在壬亥之間，實","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679429682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沈申，此巳與申合之數。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679429682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五月建午，是時鶉首在壬亥","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679446066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之間，鶉首在未。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679446066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六月建未，是時鶉火在壬亥之間，鶉","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679462450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2995","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097718630858788"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火在午，此午與未合之數。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679462450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"i {"lines":[{"lineId":"2997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七月建申，是時鶉尾在壬","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679478834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥之間，鶉尾在已，故巳與申合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679478834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八月建酉，是時壽星","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679495218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在壬亥之間，壽星辰，故辰與酉合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679495218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九月建戌，是時大","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679511602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火在壬亥之間，大火卯，故卯與戌合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679511602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十月建亥，是時","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679527986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"析木在壬亥之間，析木寅，故寅與亥合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679527986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月建子，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679544370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是時星紀在壬亥之間，星紀丑，故子與丑合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679544370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得日月","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679560754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會同之數，則其相合之用，如日月彌漫六合矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679560754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679577138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢六合，造化豈不美哉！","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679577138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀周禮春官之屬曰太師樂。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679593522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其所掌之職，乃奏黄鍾，歌大吕，舞雲門，以祭天神。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679609906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679626290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鍾子，大吕丑，取其子丑之合，以召天地之和氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679626290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奏","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679642674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3016","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097774041841705"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太簇，歌應鍾，舞咸池，以祀地祗。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679642674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太簇寅，應鍾亥，取其","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679659058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅亥之合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679659058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奏無射歌夾鍾，舞大武，以享祖先。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679675442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無射戌，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679691826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾鍾卯，取其卯戌之合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679691826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奏。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679708210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姑洗歌南
