{"lines":[{"lineId":"3026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姑洗辰，南吕酉，取其西辰之合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679740978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奏。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679757362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夷則歌仲吕，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679773746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舞大𮑮，以享先妣。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679773746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夷則申，仲吕巳，葢巳與申合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679790130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奏𬎼","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679806514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賔，歌林鍾，舞大夏，以祀山川。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679806514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蕤賔午，林鍾未，葢午與","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679822898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679822898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成王、周公之制作也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679839282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因取乎律吕相合，然後可","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679855666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格三才之體，其理微哉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679855666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廣録云：寅午徃來，有甲己土","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679872050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，子巳徃來，有戊癸火氣，己酉徃來，有丙辛水氣，卯","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679872050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申徃來，有乙庚金氣，亥午徃來，有丁壬木氣，皆在祿","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679872050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3041","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097788025700387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679872050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子巳午、亥，亦謂之隔六合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679888434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢一陽至六陽，一陰至","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679904818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六陰，更得天干納音，有交渉尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679904818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫合有合祿、合馬、","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679921202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合貴之說。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679921202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子云：是從無而立有，謂見不見之形","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679937586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679937586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從無立有，喻如甲生人，以寅爲禄，不見寅而見亥，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679953970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之合祿；寅生人以申爲馬，不見申而見巳，謂之合","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679953970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679953970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲、戊、庚人，以丑未爲貴，不見丑未而見子午，謂之","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679970354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679970354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經日：明合不如暗合，拱實不如拱虛。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145679986738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680003122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元變化書云：子合丑福輕，丑合子福盛，寅合亥𮂊","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680019506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清，亥合寅福慢，戌合卯福虛，卯合戌福厚，辰合酉福","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680019506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，酉合辰大利；午合未福慢，未合午大利。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680019506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己合申福","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680035890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3061","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097824700399653"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慢，申合巳官氣盛。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680035890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲午、辛未，只是身旺，却命祿弱。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680052274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙未、壬午，雖禄弱粗得。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680068658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：男子忌合絕，女人忌","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680085042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680085042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論支元三合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680101426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考暦家，申子辰初之氣，俱起於漏下一刻，己酉丑初","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680117810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，俱起於二十六刻，寅午戌初之氣，俱起於五十","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680117810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一刻，亥卯未初之氣，俱起於七十六刻，氣皆起於同","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680117810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刻，是天地自然之理也，故謂之三合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680117810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或以三合者，如","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680134194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人一身之運用也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680134194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精乃氣之元，氣乃神之本，是以精","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680150578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲氣之母，神爲氣之子，子母互相生，精氣神全而不","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680150578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3076","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097788025716771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散之爲合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680150578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢謂支屬人元，故以此論之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680166962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申子辰，申","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680183346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃子之母，辰乃子之子，申乃水生，子乃水旺，辰乃水","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680183346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庫，生卽産，旺卽成，庫卽收，冇生有成有收，萬物得始","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680183346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得終，乃自然之理，故申子辰爲水局。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680183346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若三字缺其一，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680199730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則化不成局，不可以三合化局論。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680199730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天地間道埋，兩","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680216114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則化，一陰一陽之謂也；三則化，三生萬物之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680216114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680232498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉丑、寅午戌、亥卯未皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680232498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行不言土者，四行皆頼","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680248882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土成局，萬物皆歸藏於土故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680248882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

tenceId":"7577345145680347186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680363570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此例。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680379954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡六合、三合入命，主人形容姿美，神氣安定，好生惡","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680396338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸，心地平直，周旋方便，聰慧踈通。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680396338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如相生合者，舉事","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680412722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多遂，更有福神來徃，則福愈厚。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680412722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生平易，多藝多才，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680429106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言和貌悅，不較是非，福祸扶持，人多見憐。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680429106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如相尅合。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680445490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，難事而易悅，多是定計，動多招損，更有㐫煞相𠔥，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680461874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097851841773603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"横事勾連，驚暴之災，不致深咎。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680461874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸絶合者，主人有爲，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680478258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未𡮢遂意，威武不重，精神俗陋，招人鄙薄，志卑氣窄，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680478258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愛小人，惡君子，習下自賤，一生少得稱懐。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680478258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與建祿合","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680494642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，多横財意外名望之福。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680494642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正印貴人合，得天恩貴人","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680511026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"提携之福。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680511026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神合，衣祿豐餘，飮食厚。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680527410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元辰大耗合無","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680543794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禮貌，言清行濁，厚於賤人，侮慢君子。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680543794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池併奸惡𥝠","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680560178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通，不良貪汚之行。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680560178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與官符併，多招刑獄詞訟，旁𪺮暗","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680576562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昧是非。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680576562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天空併動無成實，賤人欺詒，婦人大忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680592946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合中","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680609330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶煞，咸池玷行，淫聲，大耗必致淫奔。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680609330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中有貴格者，自","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680625714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賤而貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680625714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大率合吉神則吉，合㐫神則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680642098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉井云：合","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680658482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3138","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097718630924324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，非只泥三合六合，如酉字有力，或多見能用，寅字","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680658482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦切。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680658482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又看巳宫，却被壞了，酉中辛，寅中丙，方取。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680674866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680691250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦看暗干與明干合氣，相干取用，名爲勾引恩讐，又","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680691250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲牽綰得失，又爲顧盼人我，又爲呼應前後，又爲夫","logicSentenceId":"7577345145680691250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦有情，又爲行藏同道。","logicSen 661211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子、卯一刑也；寅、巳、申，二刑也；丑、","logicSentenceId":"7577345145789677595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未戌三刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145789677595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：三刑之法，以數起之。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145789693979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皇極中天，十爲煞數，積數","logicSentenceId":"7577345145789710363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至十，則悉空其數。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145789710363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天道惡盈，滿則覆，故數自卯順至","logicSentenceId":"7577345145789726747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子，子逆至卯，極十數而爲無禮之刑；寅逆至己，巳逆","logicSentenceId":"7577345145789726747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至申，極十數而爲無恩之刑；丑順至戌，戌順至未，極","logicSentenceId":"7577345145789726747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十數而爲恃勢之刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145789726747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七則衝，十則刑，六則合，一，理之","logicSentenceId":"7577345145789743131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3339","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097729368375311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自然也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145789743131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然寅、巳、申何以謂之無恩？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145789759515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3342","lin {"lines":[{"lineId":"3370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺，主人精","logicSentenceId":"7577345145790005275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神，意氣雄豪，眉粗面濶，以直攻人。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145790005275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸絕形露痩小，精","logicSentenceId":"7577345145790021659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神乖佼，是非賤佞，樂禍幸災。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145790021659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入貴格則公清平正，人","logicSentenceId":"7577345145790038043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多畏懼；入賤格，則多犯刑責，暗昧之災，婦人得之，妨","logicSentenceId":"7577345145790038043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3376","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097815313580084"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145790038043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子卯何以謂之無禮？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145790054427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子屬水，卯屬木，水能生木，則子","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924288521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水爲母，卯木爲子，子母自相刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924288521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又卯爲日門，子爲陽","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924304905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之所生，日出於卯，子卯角立，無欽卑之道不恤，所以","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924304905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相生，逓相刑害，故曰無禮。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924304905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：子中獨用癸水，癸用","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924321289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土爲夫星，而敗於卯，所以子刑卯。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924321289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯中獨用乙木，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924337673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙用庚金爲夫星，而𣦸於子，所以卯刑子。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924337673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二家因","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924354057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫見刑，女命見之，尤爲不良，故曰無禮。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924354057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺主人威","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924370441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肅，面無和氣，氣強性暴，太察不容。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924370441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸絕則侮慢忽畧，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924386825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狹劣刻剥，少孝弟，害妻子，吳越六親。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924386825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入貴格，則多掌","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924403209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097851841839139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兵權，不利近侍，位居不久；入賤格，則悖逆㐫暴，多招","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924403209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924403209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰午酉、亥何以謂之自刑？","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924419593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂寅申己亥，有寅、巳申互","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924435977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相刑，内有亥無刑；辰戌丑未有戌丑未互相刑，内有","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924435977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰無刑；子午卯酉有子卯互相刑，内有午、酉無刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924435977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924452361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以此四位謂之自刑，葢無别物相加 {"lines":[{"lineId":"3415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人主淫蕩㐫折之災。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924550665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此刑有四等名目，而獨曰三刑者，取四衝、四極、四庫","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924567049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各缺其一，則欹而不正。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924567049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三者各自相推，不齊用心，故","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924583433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云三刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924583433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三車一覧以寅、巳、申爲恃勢，以三宫中各","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924599817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有長生臨官之勢，丑、戌、未爲無恩，以三位皆屬土，比","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924599817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和爲兄弟，其說亦通。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924599817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡見刑，不可便以㐫論，須看五行中有無吉辰旺相、","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924616201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星、印綬、貴神、德福等物，有此諸吉，相扶相助，刑不","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924616201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲害，而反爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924616201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無諸吉相助，更帶亡刼、天中、羊刃","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924632585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097815313596468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"等煞，以惡濟惡，禍不可言。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924632585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：三刑怕金。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924648969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷遺文","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924665353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：君子不刑定不發，若居仕路多騰達，小人到此必","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924665353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲灾，不然也被官鞭撻。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924665353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子云：八字無格以扶持，","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924681737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九命有刑而駁雜，或作閭巷之軰，或爲市井之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924681737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924698121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此論，可表君子得之吉，小人得之㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577345145924698121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，爵禄也。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007483432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當得勢而享，乃謂之祿。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007499816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自始分十干，十二支時，便以甲乙配同，寅卯居東，丙丁配同，巳午居南；庚辛配同，申酉居西，壬癸配同，亥子居北。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007516200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干就支神爲禄，謂禄隨旺行，所以甲禄寅，乙禄卯，庚禄申，辛禄酉，壬禄亥，癸禄子，丙禄巳，丁禄午，戊寄己，巳寄午。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007532584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂巳午乃火旺之鄉，子隨母得禄之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007548968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内有辰戍丑未，辰戌爲魁罡，名日邉鄙惡地，禄元不寄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007565352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未乃天乙貴人出入之門，禄元避之，所以四宫無禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007581736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰四","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007598120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097851842002979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"季有雜氣，爲祿不專，故不取。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007598120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲禄寅，如甲見丙寅，甲土尅丙水，爲財，爲福星禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007614504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅火土相生，爲伏馬禄，俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007630888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅謂之破禄，半吉半㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007647272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYi {"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯爲截路空亡，主㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007712808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯進神禄，辛卯破禄，又爲交神，半吉半㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007729192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯帶太乙庻禄，雖貴終貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007745576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙禄巳見己巳，九天庫祿主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007761960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳截路空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007778344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳伏貴神禄，半吉半㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007794728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳𦔽馬禄，丁巳庫禄俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007811112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097833701507108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁禄午見庚午，截路空亡㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007827496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午爲德合禄，甲午爲進神禄，俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007843880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午喜神祿，交羊刃，半吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007860264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午伏羊刃禄多㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007876648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊禄巳見己巳，九天庫禄主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832007893032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳截路空亡。","logicSentenceId":"757732983200 {"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁木受氣，辛水沐浴，主姦滛事，值喜神吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008155176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉進神禄，辛酉正禄俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008171560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬禄亥見丁亥貴神合禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008187944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥天德祿，己亥聒禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008204328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥同馬鄉祿，俱大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008220712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨癸亥大敗祿貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008237096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸禄子見甲子進神禄，主登科進達。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008253480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子交羊刃，禄帶福星，貴有權。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008269864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子伏羊刃合貴祿半吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008286248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子印祿吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008302632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子正羊刃祿㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008319016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097815313662004"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有生成禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008335400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙人得用寅、乙卯之類，有名位禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008351784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人見丙寅之類，有真禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008368168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人見丙或己，乙人見己或午之類，皆爲貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008384552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有進退真禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008400936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰見丁巳，戊午見丁巳，丙辰見癸巳，丙午見癸巳，癸亥見甲子，癸丑見甲子，壬戊見癸亥，于子見癸亥，進則平易，退則艱難，更帶福神，可作貴命，怕重見。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008417320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有禄値會合，甲禄寅而得庚戌之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008433704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有食神帶禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008450088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬食甲而得甲寅，癸食乙而得乙卯，戊","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008466472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097815313711156"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食庚而得庚申，己食辛而得辛酉，主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008466472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有食神合禄，甲食丙，得丙申、丙寅，乙食丁，得丁未、丁卯；庚食壬得壬辰、壬子；辛食癸，得癸巳、癸丑，八位俱主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008482856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有禄頭財，爲絪縟煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008499240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人見戊寅，乙人見己卯之類，主人富有鷇望。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008515624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有禄頭鬼，爲赤口煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008532008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人見庚寅之人見辛卯之類，主口舌刑責。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008548392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有旬中禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008564776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申見庚寅，戊午見丁巳之類，主清華要職。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008581160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097851842035747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有天禄貴神，如丁人禄在午，遁至午上，得丙字，而丙貴在酉亥得辛酉，辛亥，則辛貴復見於午之類，入格極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008597544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有干支合禄，如甲禄寅得甲寅己亥，乙禄卯得乙卯。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008613928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌之類，主官職崇重，有互換貴禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008630312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅見甲申日時之類，有朝元禄，如寅人見甲日時之類，或朝於胎中尤貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008646696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有朝元夾合，如癸巳見戊辰、戊午，兩戊與癸合㚒己戊禄巳之類，主封爵。","logicSentenceId":"7577329832008663080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有禄入禄堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965859864591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理愚歌云：禄入禄堂須大拜。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965859880975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李虚巾以","logicSentenceId":"7577329965859897359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097892828479528"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人得甲戊，以甲爲歲干，則甲之本位逪至戌，謂之禄堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965859897359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛壬有二位，𨐋有辛卯辛丑，壬有壬寅壬子，五行無尅，諸位相𦔳，發福必大。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965859913743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人云：禄前二辰爲背，禄後二辰爲向。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965859930127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沈芝取建向近合四字爲貴，建不如向，边不如合，四字中得兩字者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965859946511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲禄寅，以寅爲建，丑爲向，卯爲近，亥爲合，餘唯此，餘皆一位。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965859962895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌三合、六合上見刑見鬼，以用戌言，鬼在丑上則可畏，以丑刑戌，在未則不忌，以戍刑未，以乙酉言，鬼在巳上爲害，以三合相會，在辰則减福，以六合相親。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965859979279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097824700530725"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫建祿者，主人肌厚氣實，體格不清。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965859995663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三生安逸足財利，生正則然，衆絕則氣濁神慢，孳孳儒生，吝嗇猥鄙。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860012047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與元辰併，因摴蒱得財，復因此敗；與官符併，因官門得財，或多争訟。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860028431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與刼煞併，好賤技小啇不義橫財；與天中併，多遺失破財；與禄鬼倒食併，多因賒貨牙儈得財，至久不通，惟財是念之人。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860044815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：庫者，禄之聚，如甲乙在未，丙丁在戍，戊巳、壬癸在辰，庚辛在丑。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860061199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲乙亥多而得未，乃禄厚豐足之人。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860077583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合者，祿之横。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860093967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲禄寅而得亥，謂之明合；無寅得亥，謂之暗合。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860110351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖非見禄，亦曰見禄，多主儻來","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860126735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097847119003699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之福。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860126735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱者，禄之尊。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860143119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲禄居寅，不見寅而見丑卯在兩𠊓拱之，謂之虛拱。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860159503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲人見寅，又見丑卯在兩傍，謂之實拱，然拱實不若拱虛，主大富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860175887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"几人命帶禄，或吉或㐫，或貴或賤，未可全靠，便爲吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860192271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙妙旨云：君不見祿馬貴人無准托，考究五行之善惡。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860208655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元羸弱未爲災，地氣堅牢足懽樂。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860225039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源髓歌云：禄馬更有多般說，自衰自𣦸𠔥敗絶。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860241423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無吉煞加𦔳時，定知破祖多浮劣。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860257807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可見先論五行，後看禄馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860274191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要生旺，禄馬怕衰絶。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860290575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"司馬季主云：禄多馬少，便主神勞；禄少馬多，能操善負。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860306959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洞玄經：日：","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860323343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097815313776692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位生火，以圓融之，然後陰中陽動而生。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860323343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未，木屬也，金藏其中矣，遇巳位生金，以槖籥之，然後動者静而歛者散。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860339727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑，金屬也，木藏其中矣，遇亥位生木，以敷榮之，然後歛者散而屈者伸。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860356111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由是水火木金，錯綜徃來，因時動静，内外相感，互爲利用，進則與時偕行，退則與時偕極。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860372495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則古之強名驛馬者，皆此例也。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860388879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是特舉其一隅而巳。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860405263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茍以三隅反，則理歸一揆，不必執寅午戌申、申子辰寅，然後爲馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860421647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡水中火騰，火中水降，陰陽交泰，剛柔變通，皆爲馬類。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860438031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希尹曰：古人謂當行更易，變動奔衝徃來之際，惟驛馬爲然。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860454415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火局在","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860470799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097847119020083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申，水局在寅，金局在亥，木局在巳。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860470799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢五行之氣，當其相反處，乃始衝激，故火馬必在水長生處，水馬必在火長生處，木、金亦然，此其義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860487183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐子平以財爲馬，亦是因古人之義，取尅處而名之耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860503567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經云：驛馬生旺，主人氣韻凝峻，通變趨時，平生多聲望，成絕則爲性有頭無尾，或是或非，三生少成，漂洎不定。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860519951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與祿同鄉，則福力優游，與煞相衝併或孤。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860536335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神吊客、丧門併者，離郷背井之人，或爲僧道，或爲啇賈。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860552719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶倒食禄鬼者，二生慳吝機倖，過賤市墨態。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860569103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與食神衝併者，聲譽人也。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860585487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行年遇馬與病符同，主病驚與。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860601871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097824700563493"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲以寅禄，庚壬本非駕祿，可以興騰，有時乎無用。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860618255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可見命之見禄，要簡不要繁，要祿干不返傷本主，不犯梟神爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860634639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡命帶禄，最怕犯衝，謂之破禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860651023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲以寅祿見申，乙以卯禄見酉，則氣散不聚，貴人停職剥官，衆人衣禄不足。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860667407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源髓歌云：破印破財併破祿，破馬少魯爲我福。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860683791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是嫵衝也。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860700175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕落空，謂之閒禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860716559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲辰旬空寅卯，却得寅爲甲之禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860732943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人云：資財聚散禄居空，胎裏生時怕遇逢。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860749327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤爲奴多乞食，飄飄身自從西東。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860765711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沈芝云：禄入空亡何所知，虚名虚譽足","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860782095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097920951287848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堪𭉕。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860782095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是嫌空也。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860798479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵命入格合造化，亦不專在禄上論金轝轝者，車也。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860814863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金者，貴之之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860831247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬之君子居官得禄，須坐車以載之，故金轝常居祿前二辰，如甲子人禄在寅辰爲金轝是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860847631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞乃祿命之旌旗，三才之節鉞，主人性柔貌愿，舉止𣺯克。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860864015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人逢之，不富卽貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860880399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子得之，多妻妾陰福相扶持。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860896783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生日生時遇之爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860913167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨肉平生安泰，得賢妻妾子孫茂盛。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860929551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如皇族多帶此煞，常格得之，身在無氣中生，主作贅。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860945935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫虛局云：禄前二辰號","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860962319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097892828495912"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金舉，遇此之人福最𣧞。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860962319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏主聰明多富貴，一生清泰亦無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860978703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字金書云：驛馬前辰居二位，此名金舉在其中。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965860995087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於此處併行運，到老爲官轉自通。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861011471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是又以馬前二辰爲金轝，若人命官貴夾擁，金轝引從，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861027855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若金轝見福貴併將星者，妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861044239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論驛馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861060623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"後一辰爲攀鞍，喻人乘馬須加鞍也，故論馬要攀鞍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂驛馬者，乃先天三合數也。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861077007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天寅七午九戌五，合數二十有一，故自子順至申，凡二十有一，而爲火局之驛馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861093391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未之數，四六與八合爲十八，故自子順至邑，凡十八，而爲木局之驛馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861109775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木火陽局也，從子","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861126159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097847119069235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一陽順行，金水陰局也，從午一陰逆行。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861126159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰之數，七九與五合爲二十有三，故自午逆至寅，凡二十有一，而爲水局之驛馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861142543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑之數，四六與八合爲十八，故自午逆至亥，凡十有八，而爲金局之驛馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861158927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此法之所由立也。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861175311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或以馬有傳受之氣，有代勞之功，如人病不能赴，待子來接，故病處見子爲驛馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861191695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：驛馬者，五行有爲待用之氣強名也。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861208079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽倚伏，氣令循環，猶今之置𨜚傳命，迎來送徃，氣藏如驛，氣動如馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861224463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌，火屬也，水藏其中矣，遇申位生水以發越之，然後陽中陰動而化。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861240847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰，水屬也，火藏其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861257231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇寅","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861273615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097804408471564"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官符同，主官事驚恐。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861273615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入宅舎，主口舌驁恐。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861289999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但以嵗申吉㐫言之，寅午戌生人馬在申，而五陽干乘之，見甲甲截路空曰馬，丙申大敗馬，戊申福星伏馬，庚申逢天闗馬，壬申大敗馬，","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861306383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又名劣馬，主平生奔走，財帛歇滅。如壬申用申、丙申、戊申，四馬多疾，再沉再起，招是。招非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上巳酉丑申年月日時發應。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861306383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰人馬在寅，而五陽干乗之，見用寅正祿文星馬，丙寅福星馬，戊寅伏馬，庚寅破禄馬，壬寅截路馬，以上亥卯未寅年月日時發應。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861322767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑人馬在亥，而五隂干乗之，見乙亥天德馬，","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861339151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097824700596261"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"劣馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以馬中支生干，主汨没無成，徒自聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861339151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又名絶馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥天乙馬，","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861355535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是馬臨官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥旺祿馬，","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861355535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是长生馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥正禄馬，","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861355535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"叉病馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥大敗馬，","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861355535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又臨官馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上申子辰亥年月日時發應。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861355535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未人馬在巳，而五陰干乗之，見乙巳正禄馬、丁巳旺氣馬，己巳尤天禄庫馬，辛巳截路馬，","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861371919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云疽，貴人半吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳天乙伏馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861371919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云値貴人吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上寅午戌巳，年月日時發應。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861388303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡柱中帶馬，若不值空𬼽破敗，交退伏神，須榮貴互禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861404687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"共天乙貴神同其馬位，更得諸煞相併，官秉大權，貴居廊廟，時爲上貴，日爲中貴，月爲常庻。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861421071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庫馬主少","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861437455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097815313842228"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年之喜，莊馬資壯歲之榮，生馬老方得遂，而官卑任遑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861437455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如木生亥，狂卯庫未，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861453839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子云：生馬未必有馬，背禄未必無禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861470223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看其旺庫，不問背生，妙在消息盈虛也。","logicSentenceId":"7577329965861486607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：驛馬者，三命中發用喜慶之神，若人遇之，君子常居榮位，小人主豐贍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487071232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犬小運行年至此，主得官及遷攺之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487087616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小還及行年合驛馬，並主遷官得禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487104000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子人，驛馬在寅，小運及太歲至亥，亥與寅合之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487120384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又馬有十二：一曰效叚，謂己酉丑人得壬亥，亥卯","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487136768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097815313809460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未人得丙巳，申子辰人得用寅，寅午戌人得戊申。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487136768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二曰蹶蹄，謂四柱雖帶驛馬，而生日值空亡之神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487153152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三曰拆兄，謂胎月帶驛馬，而日時帶沐浴者是。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487169536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰全見寅爲馬，是三人騎一馬，謂之拆足。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487185920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若亥卯未全見馬，總有官貴，終成下賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487202304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若三辰坐者，少年雖泰，後還窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487218688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四曰無糧，謂生日伹馬，馬食太歲。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487235072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子人得王寅曰，而時更落在空亡者，是五日不出廳厩，謂胎月帶馬，不見貴及不見禄堂，反入空亡者，是。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487251456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六日嘶風","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487267840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"缺七曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"趨途，謂驛馬雖有，祿在空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487267840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八曰䭾屍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487284224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二驛馬惟䭾屍最㐫，見禄卽屍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487300608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487316992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097815313858612"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬中己酉丑生，人馬在亥，乙丑人，丁亥己巳人，乙亥癸酉人，癸亥乙丑人，得亥馬，忌寅月日時，己巳人得。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487316992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥馬忌申月日時。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487333376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉人得亥馬，亦忌寅月日時。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487349760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有一在此，名日䭾屍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487366144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦如亥卯未是用午旬中乙未人，辛己、巳亥人，己巳、癸卯人，丁巳乙未人得巳馬，忌寅月日時；己亥人得巳馬，忌申月日時；癸卯人得巳馬，亦忌寅月日時，皆䭾屍也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487382528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘旬凖此。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487398912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九日食蒭，謂驛馬尅其時。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487415296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令驛馬屬金，生時得木，此類謂之食蒭。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487431680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十日乘軒，謂胎月生日帶禄馬，假令甲申人得庚寅甲寅時，及庚寅胎月，是。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487448064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十一曰乘貂，謂有天","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487464448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097804408504332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地得合，見太歳生月目時見貴人驛馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487464448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令丁亥生人，四月壬寅日己酉時，月坐馬，酉係費人，是十二日無轡，謂貴神空亡，禄在絶鄉者是以上十二驛馬，當以意消息，灾福自見。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487480832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欵叚則平生坎珂，止作選人，無糧不食天俸，不出廐則不歷任所，拆足則永失，蹶蹄則復起，無轡則一生孤寒，食蒭則官可六品，嘶風徒有虚聲，趨途謾勞求禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487497216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乗貂則帶職，乘軒則三公，䭾屍則得宫卽亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487513600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有干支合馬，如申子辰馬在寅，甲寅見己亥合，丙寅見辛亥合，主官職崇重。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487529984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097804408520716"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬頭帶劔，謂驛馬上見庚辛，或納音見金，主名振邉疆。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487546368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬驟天庭，謂木人得亥，而見辛亥，又馬上干逢得祿。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487562752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如六壬人生居寅午戌之位，於甲上遁得戊干，戊之禄在己巳，係天庭，復見已，得酉合之爲是，主官居極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487579136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬後二辰，爲九地馬，王職近王廷。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487595520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有天馬貴神，乃歲中不見驛，五虎遁至馬上，㸔得何干，其干見天乙，而天乙所坐之干却復見貴於馬上是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487611904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴不下三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487628288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097847119085619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有一本繋雙馬，寅午戌多見丙申，用子辰多見庚寅。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487644672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑多見己亥，亥卯未多見癸巳，馬上干尅支，主多驚險。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487661056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇四馬聚於時，或年上主封爵。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487677440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又驛馬下生人月日時支干得御䇿全併尅身者，是貴馬前一辰爲御，後二辰爲策。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487693824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲子金命，正月辛丑日卯時生，以子人馬在寅，逢祿，又本命于與生日丑在馬後篇策，卯時在馬前爲御。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487710208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又馬是丙寅火，能尅甲子金，故主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487726592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有有驛有馬者，主位至公侯。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487742976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干爲馬，支爲驛。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487759360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妒戊戌人馬在申，而得庚申支干俱屬金，到申臨官，戊戌","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487775744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097824700612645"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支干俱屬土，到申長生，本命及驛馬支于背馬有氣，是有驛有馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487775744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如壬午人，驛馬在戊申，戊士臨申，長生，本命，壬水到申亦長生，午火到申爲衰鄉，本命干旺支衰，是有馬無驛。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487792128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如丁丑人，驛馬在辛亥，金臨亥爲病郷，本命丁火到亥爲絶，以丑士到亥爲臨官，本命干衰支狂，驛馬于亦衰，是有驛無馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487808512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或以寅午戌見庚無申，見申無庚之類，爲有馬無驛，有驛無馬亦通。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487824896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬尅身者，取驛馬之辰，能制生月。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487841280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅午戌人馬在申，申屬金，能制寅卯月木。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487857664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲子人在辰戌","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487874048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097892828528680"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未月生是也，主官禄易求，任宦無滯，少年亨快，爲官清顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487874048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常人遇之小富。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487890432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬財庫，取驛馬所尅之辰入墓。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487906816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如馬在申，申屬金，金尅木，术至未爲庫之例。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487923200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王平生游歷四方，廣得資財，有英𤫊貫馬乃五行眞氣之長生，下遇驛馬，主持節按部之使。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487939584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有南方離明馬，謂未馬、己丑馬，亥辰馬、寅戌馬申辰戌丑未係土之位，以生處爲馬，故辰戊丑未人飛在午，爲南方離門之馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487955968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇此者愛子午相衝爲飛。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487972352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097847119134771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬見鞭策入格，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077487988736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有驛馬清濁。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488005120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子得丙寅，禄馬同鄉，又丙爲食神，乘長生馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488021504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑得丁亥，爲天乙天官，乘臨官馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488037888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乘長生臨官馬，或带食禄貴氣，則遇一當百。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488054272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乘病絶空亡馬，更值破敗交退伏神，則遇而不遇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488070656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱爲官粗濁𤰞賤，非清要之職。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488087040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日：凡看驛馬，有四專名位，生旺病絕、駞寶、啣花，及倒食互換不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488103424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中間好惡榮辱，須於歲運鞭䇿細詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488119808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四專者，如申子辰馬在寅，寅逢甲寅，甫遇庚申，巳逄丁巳，亥遇癸亥是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488136192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名位者，乃馬中逢食神，如甲","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488152576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097833701572644"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見丙、乙見丁之類，馬上得食是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488152576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四生者，辛巳、甲申、己亥、丙寅，綱音自生是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488168960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四病，乃自來自絕，娟年納音屬金，金絕在寅是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488185344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"駞寳者，乃甲子見戊寅，馬頭帶天財，或納音尅馬爲財，如食神之類，如用寅人見丙申、甲申見丙寅日時是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488201728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞花者，乃納音臨官遇馬，如庚申、壬子、戊辰綱音皆木，遇寅馬臨官之地是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488218112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又生成馬、名位馬與前論禄同，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488234496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人遇馬，喜專正而𭒡空亡，駁雜爲不逹；惡來絶而喜逢食見財爲有益。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488250880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"啇買多愛駞寳，婦女最怕啣花，駞寶則富，啣花則滛，啣花更忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488267264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木人値庚寅，乙亥見","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488283648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097833701589028"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳，丁卯見丁己，巳未見己巳，尤重，男多滛蕩，女多𥝠情。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488283648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運中遇者同前斷。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488300032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：驛馬最怕干神倒食，如乙酉見癸亥爲驛馬，却被反食於我，所謂乙癸不同科是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488316416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鞭策發時看互換。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488332800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰人馬在寅，或太歲在申，衝動寅，卽太歲爲鞭策，小運在申，卽小運為鞭䇿，多主動。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488349184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更㸔申與寅互換如何。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488365568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚申遇甲寅，庚申屬木，寅則臨官，甲寅屬水，申則長生之類，相和則吉，相尅則滯。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488381952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如兩互換，無氣則空動，或失意，有氣卽主財。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488398336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四馬朝元，好則榮貴，惡則破家失業。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488414720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如爲僧道，好逰脚，小兒老人不利見","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488431104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097920951320616"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，小見十二歲以前、三嵗以上，或馬遇小運太嵗衝，或臨宫馬遇，多主驚病顛撲之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488431104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老人五十以上，或運與太歲乘之，主氣虛腰痛脚痛之患。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488447488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦如老人祿遇病，多吐食之類，少者見之，多發病。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488463872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢老少並不堪乗馬，以馬在五行中爲動躍之神故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488480256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總論祿馬，禄爲飬命之源，馬是扶身之本，二者最喜相見。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488496640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如寅午戌馬在申，甲禄在寅，甲干寅上遁見丙，申上遁見壬，則以丙爲天祿，壬爲天馬，在日時上交互見之，謂之天禄天馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488513024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又甲人遁至戌，見甲戊，謂之活禄；甲","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488529408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097824700645413"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子人遁見丙寅，謂之活馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488529408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如寅午戌在申，而時于得庚，亥卯未在巳，而時干得丙；申子辰在寅，而時干得甲，己酉丑在亥，而時干得壬。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488545792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以日支求時干，以時干求日支，互換得之，謂之祿馬交馳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488562176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如甲禄在寅，申子辰馬亦在寅，却是甲子、甲申、甲辰生，而時得丙寅，帝座上㑹禄馬，謂之禄馬同鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488578560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如禄前馬後，如辛巳人得戌日時，乙亥人得辰日時，辛禄在酉，馬在亥，乙禄在卯，馬在已，不見禄馬，而禄馬藏於其中，謂之夾祿夾馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488594944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷遺文：日時居日禄，當得路於靑雲；五馬交馳，可致身於黄閣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488611328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子云：皆禄逐馬，守窮","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488627712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097833701605412"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"途而恓惶。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488627712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬同鄉，不三台而八座。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488644096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"韓𭏤命書有孤孀禄馬之說。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488660480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子見丙寅，庚午見壬申，此雖禄馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488676864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同鄉，殊不知甲子乃一陽，乙丑二陽，丙寅三陽，純陽無陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077488693248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午乃一陰，辛未二陰，壬申三陰，純陰無陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077549985827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二者謂之孤孀。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550002211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬雖同鄉，亦不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550018595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理愚歌曰：禄馬飛天無刑尅，旺相中生須至貴林開。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550034979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日馬在長生須富學，禄逢帝旺足錢財。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550051363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還剌𣦸兼流役，是帶懸針刼煞來。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550067747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：禄若臨時馬不來，此人只是有錢財。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550084131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生耻話招賢士，𣦸絶關門誓不開。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550100515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳諸說，見禄馬兼有，又乗生旺爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550116899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097920951304232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙者，乃天上之神，在紫微垣聞闔門外，與太乙並列，事天皇大帝，下逰三辰，家在己丑斗牛之次，出乎己未井鬼之舎，執玉衡較量天人之事，名曰天乙也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550133283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其神最尊貴，所至之處，三切㐫煞隠然而避。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550149667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
