{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通玄經云：先天坤在北方子位，陽貴起先天之坤，乃從子上起甲午，甲德在子，甲與己合，不取甲德而取合氣，故巳爲貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550166051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽貴順行，則乙德在丑，乙與庚合，庚以牛爲陽貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550182435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙德在寅，丙與辛合，辛以虎，丁德在卯，丁與壬合。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550198819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬以兎辰乃天羅，貴人不臨，故戊跳辰，德在己，","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550215203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097824700710949"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊與癸合，癸以巳午與子對衝，名爲天空，貴人有獨無對，故己德跳午在未，已與甲合，甲以羊，庚德在申，庚與乙合，乙以侯，辛德在酉，辛與丙合。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550215203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙以鷄戍乃地網，貴人不臨，故壬跳戌，德在亥，壬與丁合。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550231587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁以猪子，乃先天起貴之所，貴人不再臨，故癸跳子，德在丑，癸與戊合，戊以牛。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550247971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此，則甲、戊、庚牛、羊六辛逢馬、虎明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550264355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後天坤在西南申位，陰貴起後天之坤，乃從申上起甲干，甲德在申，甲與己合，己以侯。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550280739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰貴逆行，則乙德在未，乙與庚合；庚以羊，丙德在午，丙與辛合，辛以馬，丁德在巳，丁與壬合。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550297123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬以蛇辰，乃天羅，貴人不","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550313507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097804408553484"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨，故戊跳辰，德在卯，戊與癸合；癸以兎寅與甲對衝，名曰天空，貴人有獨無對，故己德跳寅居丑，己與甲合，甲以牛，庚德在子，庚與乙合；乙以䑕，辛德在亥，辛與丙合；丙以猪戌，乃地網，貴人不臨，故壬跳戌，德在酉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550313507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬與丁合，丁以鷄申，乃後天起貴之處，貴人不再臨，故癸跳申，德在未。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550329891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸與戊合，戊以羊。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550346275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以此推之，則甲、戊、庚貴人之居丑未，而於先後起陰陽者亦明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550362659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然必皆起坤者，貴人家在己丑，出乎己未，先後俱屬土，乃坤卦二五黄中之合氣，干之配支，德氣相合，出於目然如此。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550379043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其曰陽貴陰貴，乃冬至用陽，夏至用陰，","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550395427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097847119151155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非晝夜之說。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550395427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"據此說，天乙是十干之秀氣，非天上之星也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550411811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余聞一術者云：日出於寅，衆星皆落；日沉於申，衆星皆出。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550428195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故晝貴起於寅，夜貴起於申，數至丑未，是天乙之家舎，十干見天乙爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550444579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲祿寅，以寅加寅，順數至丑，卽爲本家，故甲貴在丑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550460963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙祿卯，以卯加寅數至子見丑，故乙貴在子。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550477347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙禄巳，以巳加寅數，至戌見丑，戌爲惡弱之地，天乙不臨，則進一位，故丙貴在亥。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550493731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁祿午，以午加寅數至酉見丑，故丁貴在酉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550510115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寄位於艮，故戊亦以寅起，與甲同。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550526499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己寄位於坤，以未加寅數至申見丑，故己貴在申。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550542883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚祿申，以申加寅數至","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550559267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097897513566218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未見丑，故庚貴在未。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550559267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛禄酉，以酉加寅數至午見丑，故辛貴在午。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550575651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬禄亥，以亥加寅數至辰見丑，辰爲惡弱","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550592035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/7452657674410852404/7453003948195053603/1-1735299094718.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=nvCrivDhAQPibwFkGaC2xBeYdXQ%3D","uri":"read/7452657674410852404/3/ref/1kms4bwbkyxvt/1-1735299094718.webp","fontType":3,"components":"丶㇇㇏","variants":"","charPicId":"7453050480885809188"},"logicSentenceId":"7577330077550592035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，天乙不臨，則進二位，故壬貴在巳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550592035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸禄子，以子加寅數至卯見丑，故癸貴在卯，夜貴以申起，一如寅法。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550608419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見未與見丑同是貴分有定位，而甲、戊、庚牛羊之歌，則泥而不通矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550624803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此說就以天星論，尤爲有理。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550641187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今六壬選擇諸術，或分陰陽，或分晝夜，葢本此二說。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550657571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子云：貴人分治晝夜，各自專權，以晝生遇晝貴，夜生遇夜貴爲得力。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550673955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或以子後爲晝，午後爲夜，或以日出爲晝，曰入爲夜，皆是臆說。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550690339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不若只以寅申分陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550706723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097897513533450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至後用陽貴，夏至後用陰貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550723107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命一陽生後遇陽貴爲得力，一陰生後，遇陰貴爲得力。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550739491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三車一覧則以甲陽木乘少陽之氣，生乎東方，至巳而用事畢矣，故退藏於未而爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550755875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚陽金，乘少陰之氣而生乎西，至亥而用事畢矣，故退藏於丑而爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550772259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊陽土，冲和中央，播於四時，甲因之萬物生，庚因之萬物成，則生成之理畢矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550788643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙乃陰木，已乃陰土，二位無氣，失類而無所居，必待申子生旺水土滋養充實，補𦔳不足，此二者喜見中子而爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550805027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁之火，當盛夏，至酷而害萬物，性熄於酉，藏於亥，以西北成濟之氣而和，此二者","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550821411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097804408619020"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以酉亥陰氣和而爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550821411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸之水，至窮冬，則其性嚴而殺萬物，惟嗇於卯，潜於巳，以東南温燠之氣而和，此二者以己卯陽氣和而爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550837795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛乃陰金，執方，不能自化，須假寅午生旺之火，剉剛革而成形爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550854179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廣録云：甲陽木，戌陽土，庚陽金，皆喜土位。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550870563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未者，土之正位，丑者土安静之地，所以牛羊爲■。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550886947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細分之，甲尤喜未，庚尤喜丑，各歸其庫也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550903331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子、戊寅、戊午喜丑，丑者火。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550919715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人胎養之鄉，戊辰、戊申，戊戌喜未，未者，木人之庫，土人生旺之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550936099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙者陰木，己者陰土，陰土喜生旺，陰木愛陽水，所以鼠猴爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550952483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然乙尤喜子，子者水之旺","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550968867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097804408635404"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄊；巳尢喜申，申者，坤之正位。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550968867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁屬火，火墓在戌；壬癸屬水，水墓在辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077550985251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌魁罡之地，貴人不臨，故尋寄火貴於酉亥，寄水貴於卯巳，皆歸根復命之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551001635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛陰金，喜陽火生正之地，故以馬虎爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551018019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更宜以納音互換推尋，須比和，則其貴爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551034403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若丙火得酉火至此，庻焉足貴哉！","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551050787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：論天乙貴，須就五行喜忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551067171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如田人有戊有庚，得癸未乙，五遇二言而带印爲上，遁見丁丑、辛未者次之，乃三陽喜在印庫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551083555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙人得戊申庚子生旺之土，己人得甲申丙子生栣之水，此陰木陰土喜於財","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551099939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097804408651788"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551099939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁得丁酉乙亥，壬癸得乙卯癸巳，此水火不嫌以絕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551116323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛得丙寅、丙午，此陰金不𭒡鬼勝，得二爲上，得一次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551132707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫虚局以此爲貴人，入廟遇者，主金紫貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551149091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寳鑑又以五虎元遁至貴人本位上，見所遁之干爲入廟，不犯空亡駁雜，主清貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551165475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字金書論貴神又分優劣，卽前六十甲子吉㐫，其歸要與禄馬同窠，不犯交退伏神，支干相合爲吉，緊要在月日時支干相合。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551181859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"林開論：天乙相合，如甲子見己未，無庻絕衝破空亡，更有福神，取至貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551198243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如犯上忌减力，又多難無福。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551214627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551231011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097833701638180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見己丑，不犯上忌，更有福，取此爲次格，有威絕减力，有衝破空亡，風塵吏也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551231011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未見庚寅，不犯上忌，有福，取爲第三等，來絕减力，行破空亡，平生多難，卑冗官耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551247395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟論貴合貴食：如甲得己丑己未，戊得癸丑癸未，庚得乙丑乙未，乙得庚子庚申，已得甲子甲申，丙得辛酉辛亥，丁得千寅壬辰，如此類謂之貴合。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551263779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲食丙，乙食丁，内丁貴在酉亥，甲得丙寅、丙辰，乙得丁酉丁亥，庚食壬，辛食疾，壬癸貴在卯巳，庚得壬申壬成，辛得癸卯癸巳，如此類謂之貴食。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551280163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有貴合則官多稱","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551296547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097892828561448"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"意；有貴食則禄多稱意。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551296547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二者兼之，官高祿重。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551312931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命提要以天乙在貴神六合上，如甲、戊、庚在子午，則子合丑，午合未，乙己在壬巳，丙丁在寅辰，壬癸在中戌，辛在未亥，皆主大福。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551329315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇兩合以上尤貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551345699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寳鑑有天乙扶身，取貴人夾擁太歲。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551362083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬寅人得甲寅，曰時壬貴在卯，甲癸在丑，夾擁乎寅。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551378467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申人得戊申，准此入貴格，别無刑衝，主二生少病，早年享福。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551394851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常格得之，終身無刑獄之災。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551411235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有千夾貴神，如甲、戊、庚人得丑未，日時上却帶甲戊庚一字，主顯異。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551427619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097897513582602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指南有夾貴逢六合，如壬癸人見辰而得癸酉合，丙丁人見戌而得丁卯合，取前後各有天乙貴，更祿馬臨身，主大富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551444003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫虛局有活禄貴人，乃貴人干上轉干支，再就生時胎月。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551460387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲逢寅午，乙辛丑未，丙酉亥，丁申子，戊癸侯䑕，庚壬兎蛇，己卯己，曰時兼全樂之，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551476771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一命戊戌甲子、辛巳、丙申是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551493155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有福星貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551509539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一命壬子、癸卯、庚戌、庚辰，壬騎龍背，又貴在卯，已得辰，是福星扶貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551525923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有貴人擁馬而前，視刃主懽貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551542307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097897513598986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳希烈曰：干爲天乙之將，支爲貴人之帥。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551558691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如丑未生人月日、時得甲、戊庚，是遇正天乙。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551575075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子人十二月。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551591459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生是遇貴神己巳日乙亥時，是遇兩天乙，合貴人之命觀之，若在太嵗本干四貴華葢上遇天乙者，宰輔之命也；若在四平位遇兩天乙，亦爲待從清華之命；若四忌上遇兩天乙，常調之官也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330077551607843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡貴人命，若丑未人甲、戊、庚中惟得兩字，于申人得乙巳全，酉亥人得丙丁全之類，更得太歲下禄爲正官正印者，其福加倍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053302307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沈芝云：凡生月日時遇天乙貴人相間四字全者爲極貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053318691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如酉亥有丙丁之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053335075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"說者舉魯公命己亥、丙","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053351459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097897513730058"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、乙酉、丁丑，是相間四字全。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053351459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予謂時不值忌神，所以至宰相。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053367843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若酉月生己禄到酉爲敗忌，雖四字全，必不至大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053384227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人皆以貴人主福，不言福力厚薄。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053400611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今各隨位約而分之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053416995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲人遇丑，庚人遇未，各在禄庫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053433379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊人遇丑未是土支；己人遇申，是與生旺同位。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053449763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上四神，生日生時遇之，帶正官正印，上下合正天乙，本家天乙貴神合者，福力加倍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053466147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙人遇申絶忌，却有暗合；遇子敗忌；丙丁遇亥絶忌，丁有暗今，遇酉𣦸忌；壬癸遇巳絶忌，癸有暗合，遇卯𣦸忌；辛人遇午敗忌，遇寅絶忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053482531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上六貴神皆與忌神同位，生月日時遇之，可得","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053498915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097906955091979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二三分福力。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053498915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若與驛馬同位，及帶正天乙本家禄正官正印，干合有輔，取者加倍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053515299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"據此分是貴人忌來絕，而不思丙丁、壬癸正以來絕爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053531683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經曰：天乙貴遇生壯則形貌軒昂，性靈頴悟，理義分明，不喜雜術，純粹大噐，身藴道徳，衆人欽愛。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053548067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成絕則執抝白是，喜逰近貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053564451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與刼煞併，則貌厚有威，多謀足計；與官符併，則文翰飄逸，高談雄辨，與建禄併。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053580835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則文翰純實，濟惠廣逰君子人也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053597219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若落天中，或與天中合，或與天中連珠，當有伶倫之態，好謳吟伎藝人也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053613603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097911929454631"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：天乙貴，三命中最吉之神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053629987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人遇之，則榮功名早達，官祿亦易進。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053646371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如三命皆乘旺氣，終登將相公侯之位。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053662755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大小運行年至此，亦主遷官進財。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053679139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三切加臨至此，皆爲古兆。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053695523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡貴人所臨之處，大槩喜生旺無衝破，道理順，不落空亡，天千納音偕和，更得禄馬而晝夜不苛，或年時工換貴，如甲午人見辛丑時，丙中見己亥之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053711907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或四干併在一支上見貴，如丑未生而得甲、戊、庚之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053728291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或四位天干通聚貴，地支爲五行聚貴，更遇天月二德爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053744675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理愚歌云：貴人或落空亡裏，禄馬背違如不値。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053761059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寳鑑云：貴人無氣，雖有如無。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053777443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"林開云：貴","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053793827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097906954944523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人成絕，爲鄙吝煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053793827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洞玄經云：貴人嗔則卤來。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053810211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可見命中有貴，不可就爲吉論，要當細詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053826595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論三奇珞琭子曰：奇爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053842979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇者，異也，謂物以貴爲奇也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053859363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙、丙、丁出於貴人，干德配支之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053875747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽貴甲德起子，則乙德在丑，丙德在寅，丁德在卯，三干相連而無間。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053892131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰貴甲德起申，乙在未，丙在午，丁在巳，三間相聮而無間。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053908515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以其隨貴人在天，故曰天上三奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053924899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干惟此爲異，餘則或間羅網，或間天空，或不重臨，又不相聮，不可以爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053941283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寳鑑謂：古人以正月爲歲之始，曰出於乙，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053957667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097892828594216"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故以乙爲曰奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053957667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老人星見爲瑞，見於丁位，故以丁爲星奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053974051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月照夜到丙位而天下明，故以丙爲月奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078053990435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲、戊、庚亦以爲天上三奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054006819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以甲、戊、庚俱臨丑未，乃貴人家在斗牛之次，出乎井鬼之舎，先後天起貴而三干。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054023203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"適臨之與别干不同，其理亦通。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054039587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三車一覧以甲爲陽木之魁，戊爲陽土之君，庚爲陽金之精，地有此三物爲奇，謂之地三奇，其說則鑿。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054055971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙經以辛壬癸爲水奇，謂之人間三奇，其說無據。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054072355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但辛壬癸天干連珠，謂之三台，亦爲難得。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054088739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫虚局又有四奇之說。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054105123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫奇，奇數也，四則偶矣，謂之奇可乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054121507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇要順布，不欲倒亂。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054137891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054154275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097906954928139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙、丙丁、甲戊、庚天干年月曰時，順布爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054154275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廣録又以乙人丙月丁時，是乙生丙丁，秀氣下降，主平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054170659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乙時丙曰丁年，是秀氣上達，反爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054187043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似又不論順逆。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054203427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲、戊、庚却以順者爲貴，逆者福慢，亂者不壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054219811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣清則貴，氣濁則富。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054236195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：五行各有奇儀，須分逆順。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054252579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日月倒亂，得順，三奇亦不謂倒。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054268963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命有三奇要得體得地，不欲失時。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054285347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙丙丁夜生，甲戊庚晝生得體。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054301731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丙丁柱有亥，則三光有所依附；甲戊庚柱有申，則三物有所慿藉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054318115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或乙丙丁得丑寅、卯未午巳，甲戊庚得丑未全，皆爲得地。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054334499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇再遇三合，如乙丙丁得金木局，甲戊庚","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054350883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097847119200307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得水火局，又遇六儀。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054350883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子句戊，甲戌旬己，甲申旬庚，甲午旬辛，甲辰旬壬，用寅旬癸，俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054367267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子云：重犯奇儀，藴藉抱出羣之器。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054383651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遁甲曰：順布三奇，逆六儀。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054400035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命出甲子、甲申二旬，而遇甲戊、庚，是重犯奇儀也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054416419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命遇三奇，主人精神異常，襟懷卓越，好奇尚大，慱學多能。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054432803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶天乙貴者，勲業超羣；帶天月三德者，卤災不犯；帶六儀者，才智出類；帶三合入局者，國家柱石；帶官符刼煞者，噐識宏遠；帶空亡生旺者，脫塵離俗，富貴不滛，威武不屈。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054449187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"値元辰成池，衝破天羅地網者。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054465571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲無用論三奇太歲不帶而月曰時帶者，孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054481955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054498339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097906954960907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順十干神乙丙丁，神童反第播聲名。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054498339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時祿馬公卿煞，換武除文佐聖明。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054514723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順十干神甲戊庚，兼得長生兩府名。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054531107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然無禄兼無馬，只是財中蓄積人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054547491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇須是重逄貴，方是榮華福壽人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054563875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只有空奇無貴地，貧窮下賤被欺陵。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054580259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丙丁、甲戊庚，上局相生生復生。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054596643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不是蓬萊三島客，也應金殿玉階行。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054613027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲識嵓廊官赫奕，名仙多誕癸壬辛。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054629411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇玉籍傳消息，輕薄時師莫與評。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054645795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合諸詩，觀三奇喜忌見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054662179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論天月德夫德者，利物濟人，掩卤作善之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054678563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天德者，謂周天","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054694947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097920951500840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有三百六十五度二十五分半，除十二宫分野，每宫各占三十度，共計三百六十度外，有五度二十五分半，散在十二佐宫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054694947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲庚、丙壬、乙辛、丁癸，乾坤艮巽，謂之神藏煞没，每宫各得四十四分，所以子午卯酉中有甲庚、丙壬，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054711331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子中有壬，卯中有甲，午中有丙，酉中有庚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未中有乙辛丁癸，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054711331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑中有癸，辰中有乙，未中有丁，戌中有辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申己亥中有乾坤、艮巽，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054711331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅中有艮，巳中有巽，中中有坤，亥中有乾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此十二位宫，能囘㐫作善，乃曰天德也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054711331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月德者，乃三合所照之方，日月會合之辰，申子辰㑹酉，出庚人垣於壬；亥卯未㑹午，出丙人垣於甲；寅午戌會卯，出甲入垣於丙；己酉丑會子，出壬","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054727715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097948180807714"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入垣於庚。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054727715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故壬甲丙庚謂之月德，而辰、未、戌丑四月天德亦同屬焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054744099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢日月照臨之官，凡天曜地煞盡可制服，故可囘㐫作吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054760483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子云：天德陽之德，正月起自乾。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054776867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之前一辰亥上順行，乃正月亥、二月子、三月丑、四月寅、五月卯、六月辰、七月巳、八月午、九月未、十月申，十一月酉、十二月戌。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054793251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月德陰之德，正月起自坤。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054809635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之後一辰未上順行，乃正月未、二月申，三月酉、四月戌、五月亥、六月子、七月丑、八月寅、九月卯、十月辰、十一月巳、十二月午。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054826019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五星論天月德木後說，而以前爲天月德，貴人干支之分也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054842403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：貴神在位，諸","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054858787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097892828626984"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞伏藏，二德扶持，衆㐫解散。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054858787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命中帶卤煞，得此二德扶化，卤不爲甚。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054875171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須要日上見，時上不犯尅衝刑破，方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054891555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人得之，三生安逸，不犯刑，不逢盜，縱遇卤禍，自然消散。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054907939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與三奇、天乙貴同併，尤爲吉慶。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078054924323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或財官、印綬、食神變德，各隨所變，更加三倍之福。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078468096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入貴格，主登科甲，得君寵任，或承祖陰，亦得顯達。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078484480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入賤格，三生温飽，福壽兩全，縱有蹇滯，亦能守分固窮，不失爲君子。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078500864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命得之，多爲貴人之妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078517248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命鈴云：天徳者，五行福德之辰，若人遇之，主登台輔之位。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078533632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有月德併者尤好，縱有卤煞，亦主清顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078550016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子平賦云：印綬得同天德，官","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078566400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097897513631754"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑不犯，至老無殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078566400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是天德勝月德也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078582784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考大綂暦，有天月徳合，乃五行相契之辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078599168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月德合，如正月丙與辛合，二月甲與己合，三月壬與丁合，四月庚與乙合，餘照此天德合。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078615552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月丁與壬合，二月坤與巽合，三月壬與丁合，四月辛與丙合，餘照此有月空。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078631936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅午戌月壬，亥卯未月庚，申子辰月丙，己酉丑月甲，有月厭，正月戌，二月酉，三月申，四月未，五月午，六月巳，七月辰，八月卯，九月寅，十月丑、十二月子、十二月亥，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078648320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097847119233075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有月煞，寅午戌月丑，亥卯未月戌，申子辰月未，已西丑月辰，有歲干德，甲己、甲乙、庚庚、丙辛、丙丁、壬壬、戊癸寄戊，亦取甲庚丙壬爲干德。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078648320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月干徳與歲干德同。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078664704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有天赦曰：春戊寅，夏甲午，秋戊申，冬甲子，乃天四時專氣，生育萬物，宥罪赦過。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078681088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人命聚三月，徳秀合空，及四大吉時生，更遇天赦曰，尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078697472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此外又有天喜神，春戌夏丑，秋辰冬未，遇者主歡欣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078713856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有旌德煞，如寅午戎，丙日時，亥卯未，甲日時，申子辰，壬日時，己酉丑，庚曰時。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078730240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097897513664522"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有旌鉞煞，如寅午戌寅時，亥卯未亥時，申子辰申時，己酉丑巳時，又寅午戌見辛，亥卯未見己，申子辰見丁，巳酉丑見乙，亦謂之旌德。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078746624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：一神主旌德，五世不貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078763008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内有旌鉞煞，將相及三公德鉞相㑹，不貴卽富。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078779392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有一種旌鉞煞，寅卯辰人見癸酉，巳午未人見癸卯，申酉戌人見戊子，亥子丑人見戊午，乃四時専主誅戮之神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078795776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庶人主徒配，尅本命，主惡𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078812160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有一種三公煞，寅午戌人，壬子、己酉丑人丙午，申子辰人乙卯，亥卯未人，辛酉，乃坐四方専氣，來尅","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078828544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097847119249459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生年，爲五行毒氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078828544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庻人犯之，主非横惡久。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078844928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若旌鉞更與三公煞㑹同一位，主殊貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078861312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之談命者，論月德，而諸煞不論，自是偏見，因並及之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078877696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論太極貴","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078894080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一名科名星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極者，太初也，始也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078894080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物造於初，爲太極，成也，收也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078910464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物有所歸，日極造化，始終相保，乃日太極貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078926848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙木先造乎子，坎水𦔳而生，後終乎午，離火焚而从。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078943232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁火先喜出乎震，卯也，後喜藏乎兌，酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078959616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛金得寅，乃金生乎艮，見亥，乃金廟乎乾。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078976000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸水，先得申而生，後得巳而納。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078078992384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079008768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：地䧟東南，四瀆俱流，巽位皆有始。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097906954993675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理愚歌云：四庫全時爲至貴，位班上列據權衡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079008768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命入，更有福氣貴神扶，豈不爲美。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079025152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有文昌貴：甲人蛇口乙猪頭，丙狗丁龍戊向侯巳午。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079041536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅辛未貴，六壬卯位，癸逢牛，有文譽貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079057920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用子人，見壬戌丙寅，禄前禄後一般神，必作公卿冠世人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079074304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立性天聰名譽播，富貴榮華事業新。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079090688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有文星貴，甲馬乙蛇丙戊侯，酉臺丁巳亥辛求，庚逄戌狗壬逄虎，十位文星癸兎逰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079107072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097833701687332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有天印貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079123456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子在寅中，乙逄亥亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079139840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉戊申位，丙戌巳羊宫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079156224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛馬蛇足，癸卯與壬龍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079172608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此號天印貴，榮達受皇封。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079188992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論學堂、詞舘","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079205376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"魁星科名附","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫學堂者，如人讀書之在學堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079205376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詞舘者，如今官翰林，謂之詞舘，取其學業精專，文章出類。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079221760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生乃學堂之正位。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079238144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如金命見辛巳，金長生在巳，辛巳納音又屬金是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079254528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官乃詞舘正位，如金命見壬申，金臨官在申，壬申納音又屬金是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079270912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘以類推。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079287296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壷中子云：文星入命，天班馬之無才。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079303680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註云：乙亥、丁巳爲文星，是取木火","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079320064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097937162436646"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生臨官之義，重木火者，發烟紅縁，文章之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079320064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或以納音論，火包而不包，惟乙亥得之；土包而不包，惟丁巳得之，恐未然。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079336448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞東叟謂：年月日時有甲乙、丙丁分處，四位相連不斷，青赤爲文章。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079352832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲寅、乙亥、丁酉、丙申、甲子、丙寅用寅、丙寅之類，主文彩異衆。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079369216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寳鑑則以木金火全，赤白成章。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079385600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙寅見己亥、辛巳，取丙寅火、己亥木，辛巳金，皆坐長生之地，主詞翰秀頴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079401984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以中子辰全見丙，如丙子人丙寅月丙辰日丙申時，丙爲眞水，申子辰水之正位，干支全見之，有金則貴，無金亦主學海波深。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079418368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷要訣又云：戊巳重重兩","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079434752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097911929372711"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位帶旺𠔥元祿。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079434752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊子人見戊午、戊戌、己未、己酉，主文章燦爛。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079451136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸家說：有學堂會禄，如金長生巳臨官申，甲乙人得。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079467520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之水土長生申臨官亥，丙丁壬癸人得之，木長生亥臨官寅，戊巳人得之，火長生寅臨官巳，庚辛人得之，又名官貴學堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079483904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以官貴長生之位爲學堂，官貴臨官之位爲詞舘也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079500288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有學堂會食，如甲食丙得丙寅，乙食丁得丁巳，丙食戊得戊申之類，兼官印驛馬，其福厚，遇禄貴竒德，其氣清；值刑尅衝破，其氣濁。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079516672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸則科名巍峩，厚則","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079533056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097892828659752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官爵榮顯，濁則福禄微薄，官職𤰞賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079533056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有生處見尅，如甲乙人辛亥，丁丙人壬寅，戊巳人甲申，庚辛人丁巳，謂之官星學堂，主登科甲，入侍從。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079549440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有納音見帝旺之位，而逄天乙貴處其上，如己酉人得丙子庚子日時，壬午人得辛卯日時之類，謂之學堂會貴，主清貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079565824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡學堂詞舘，切不要犯空亡及衝破支干納音，不要見尅，方爲得用。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079582208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祝勝經云：甲辰丙寅，學堂不眞，或止富䕃，官職𤰞貧，讀書修學，空有虛名。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079598592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言學堂怕落空也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079614976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三車云：學堂無氣，惟利師儒。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079631360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言學堂要乘旺","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079647744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097906955026443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079647744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理愚歌云：學堂如更朝驛馬，位極勲高壓天下。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079664128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言學堂要有馬也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079680512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：生來禄馬真學堂，若同詞舘主文童。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079696896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇中不遇人誰會，不遇衝尅福禄昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079713280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：文星聚處人中瑞，聲華獨冠英雄軰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079729664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"降生不遇真學堂，才學豈能爲振萃。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079746048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言學堂脂行破受尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079762432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况人命入格合造化，又不在學堂、詞舘而得。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079778816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子平云：學堂者，天地陰陽清秀之氣，五行長生之神，乃甲見亥、乙見午等例，或月時一位見者卽是，不必𠔥全，更帶天乙貴，如丁日酉時或酉月之類，讀書人遇之，主聰明智巧，高科文翰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079795200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更引用得地，無尅壓之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079811584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097911929389095"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神及逢徳秀，冠世儒業，與命中財帛印食相爲表裏。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079827968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：生氣學堂，冠世，文章富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079844352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：學堂不必專論宫星，文童不必專論印綬。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079860736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人以長生學堂，取生氣就學之義，不必專論日干，但柱中帶寅申巳刻，便爲有學。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079877120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此四宫聚天地閒至清之氣，其中有四驛馬、四刼煞，皆是生發之意。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079893504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉爲四敗，其氣濁；辰戌丑未爲四庫，其氣雜。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079909888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如月候到寅申己亥，便不寒不熱，風氣自然清雅温和。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079926272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占年月者，最有力。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079942656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干自得長生，却不喜在月令。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079959040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如月令見之，運順行，便交沐浴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079975424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如八字不帶學堂，到五七歲，却交日干長生運，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079991808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097911929405479"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有文學。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078079991808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖非通儒，却未至全不識字。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078080008192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若八字不見，最忌五七嵗交敗庻二運縱有嚴師，也難訓化。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078080024576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命帶二樣學堂，俱怕自刑尅壞，但有刑衝破損，讀書便不成。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078080040960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重見雖不妨，一衝終不純粹。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078080057344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：人命不喜十分則盛，財是厚濁之物，一見便要貪好，喪人心志。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078080073728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中若先有官星，以抑禀氣之偏，亦性情執古，不能通變。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078080090112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財盛而無官星，便渾濁不清，縱富貴亦愚。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569201664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌云：五行生處爲學堂，陰陽順逆要推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569218048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"引莊有倚文學貴，如逄尅壓不爲良。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569234432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註云：學堂上帶鬼，爲尅壓。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569250816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡有科名命，自是五行清粹學堂驛","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569267200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097937162289190"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬生旺於金水之上，三奇華葢，類萃於日時之中。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569267200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或刑衝生旺，水火相生，福神聚時，天元不戰，皆主清譽巍科。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569283584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：甲辰一旬十二位，謂之魁星，一旬中又取出甲辰、丁未、庚戌、癸丑四位，以甲木旺於東方，丁火旺於南方，庚金旺於西方，癸水旺於北方，取逐方旺氣加。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569299968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於辰戌丑未之上，以爲眞魁星。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569316352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人命甲辰至癸丑一旬俱在日時上，無不及第，兩三位者，必中前名。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569332736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：丁亥、辛卯、庚戌爲魁星，日時遇者，多占觧省、殿魁。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569349120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又四柱内兩見干合，謂之嵗首星。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569365504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子生人在子，以命","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569381888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097937162305574"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建之月，謂之歲窠，主詞學豐瞻，科名顯赫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569381888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又寅申、己亥四位大愛，本年遁起四位爲魁星。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569398272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸巳人從寅上遁起，用寅、丁巳、庚申、癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569414656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如丁卯人從寅上遁起，壬寅、乙巳、戊申、辛亥是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569431040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘准此例。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569447424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命金士乘秀氣，金木乗秀氣，火木乘秀氣，水木乘秀氣，皆主科名。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569463808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀氣者，月令中秀氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569480192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡支干有氣，乘月令秀氣，皆主及第之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569496576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌曰：日旺提綱，火明木秀，金白水清重叠士金旣濟，水火逓互，丙丁根苗，天乙相極，金水是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569512960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又木春生逄食傷，財印兩輕官煞重，煞重身輕逢印綬，魁星官煞分明奇，亦登科","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569529344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097937162469414"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之命，及第之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569529344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壼中子云：馬兼財合，秦廷献一鶚之書；官共禄迎，禹門透三汲之浪。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569545728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"註云：行年驛馬與見生驛馬衝而不合，又見天財、文星之類，其人必發，合則必不發也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569562112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇官與禄則須成，不遇官與禄，止發而已。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569578496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：凡舉人了當年，大要太歲與月建相和作福，其餘甲、戊、庚、乙、丙丁之類，皆不定，只以行年太歲與本生月建𠫭而推之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569594880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：須是大運在官位。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569611264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又太歲帶正印，或正天乙，或本家禄，是及第之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569627648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論正印正印者，乃五行之正庫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569644032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金命見乙丑木、癸未火、甲戌","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569660416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097897513697290"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水土，壬辰、丙辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569660416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言談云：生逢正印，必拜玉堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569676800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙選云：五行入垣，官居五府。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569693184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可見得本家正印爲貴本。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569709568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主同德爲上，帝座爲中，胎月爲下，主人重厚魁梧，功名昭著。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569725952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本家印又得貴格扶之更妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569742336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若木得水印，火得木印，多兼他權外財。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569758720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若身尅印，或印尅身，廢而復興。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569775104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若水人得火甲，火人帶水印，次於本家印，然須本主有旺氣方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569791488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若尅破别無福救助，或空亡，只作清閑僧道，無成舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569807872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若五行有清氣，則絶世高人；有煞則貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569824256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有貴人夾印，如丙丁火命，以甲戌爲正印，却得酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569840640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097892828692520"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾之，酉亥乃丙丁貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569840640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸水命，以壬辰爲正印，如得卯巳夾之，卯已乃壬癸貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569857024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有華葢卬，如亥卯未得癸未之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569873408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有文章印，如戊寅見癸未，辛巳見甲戌，庚申見乙丑，癸亥見丙辰，乙亥見壬辰，乃納音尅身，干神復制。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569889792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午得癸未，庚子得乙丑，丁酉得壬辰，己卯得甲戌，辛酉得丙辰，干神制，支神合之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569906176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸印要逄庫墓，若生莊扶取，互換禄馬貴人併相合者，至貴之命，最忌刑衝破害，三合、六合上見鬼，如甲戌日得癸酉時，則减力。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569922560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水命人得本家印無益，得木","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569938944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097920951517224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印損氣；得土印，支干有交渉者，名官印；無交渉者，名鬼印。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569938944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有年時見印，名鳯凰啣印，如虞尚書癸末、甲寅、戊午、丙辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569955328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有福聚印，如年月日時胎，五位俱無氣，衰敗，得正印偏印，俱在此印上，或庫或旺，雖有煞神，至是受制，此之謂福聚印。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569971712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有禍聚印，如癸巳人帶壬辰印，柱多逄水，俱墓於辰，則癸巳受煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078569988096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以己爲命，己火遇多，則本命病，此之謂禍聚印。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570004480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097906955206667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有破福成禍印，如水人得水印，或月日時胎，多帶士來，本家印見鬼盛，是謂破福成禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570020864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有帶煞印，印中見貴煞，如壬子見壬辰、丙辰，子至辰，謂之華葢，壬人見辰爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570037248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若印中反尅本命，無福神徃還，名帶煞，主㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570053632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有臨空印，乃印落空亡，支無六合，見官貴至賤而無成也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570070016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有自刑印，如庚戌人帶乙丑金人，見金印固好。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570086400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑戌相刑，以金刑金，此類不如無，雖有少福，亦終賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570102784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘准此推。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570119168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097892828725288"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡論印，更得眞五行與納音同氣尤妙，但主少安逸，不利六親，難爲子息。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570135552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論德秀夫德者，本月生旺之德；秀者，合天地中和之氣，五行變化而成者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570151936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：德者，陰陽解㐫之神；秀者，天地清秀之氣，四時當旺之神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570168320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故寅午戌月，丙丁爲德，戊癸爲秀；申子辰月，壬癸戊巳爲德，丙辛、甲巳爲秀；己酉丑月，庚辛爲德，乙庚爲秀；亥卯未月，甲乙爲德，丁壬爲秀。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570184704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人命中得此德秀，無破衝尅壓者，賦性聰明，温厚和氣，若遇學堂，更帶財官，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570201088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝尅咸力。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570217472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097911929503783"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論刼煞亡神：刼者，辱也，自外奪之之謂刼；亡者，失也，自内失之之謂亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570233856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼在五行絕處，亡在五行臨官，俱屬寅申己亥來，絶在巳申子辰，以巳爲刼煞，巳中戊土刼水也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570250240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火絕在亥寅午戎，以亥爲刼煞，亥中壬水刼火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570266624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金絶在寅，巳西丑，以寅爲刼煞，寅中丙火刼金也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570283008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木絕在申，亥卯未，以申爲刼煞，申中庚金刼木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570299392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌云：刼煞爲灾不可當，徒然奔走利名塲。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570315776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須防祖業消亡盡，妻子如何得久長。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570332160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：四位逢生刼又來，當朝振業逞儒魁。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570348544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若兼官貴在時上，梗直名標御史臺。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570364928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：刼","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570381312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097906955059211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神包裏遇官星，主執兵權𦔳聖明，不怒而威人仰慕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570381312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須令華夏悉安榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570397696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：刼煞原來是煞魁，身宫命主不須來。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570414080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若爲魁局應當來，煞曜臨之不必猜。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570430464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是無星居此位，更於三合細推排。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570446848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天盤加得㐫星到，命似風燈不久摧。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570463232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水生木，申子辰，以亥爲亡神，亥中甲木洩水也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570479616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火生土，寅午戌以巳爲亡神，巳中戊土洩火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570496000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金生水，己酉丑，以申爲亡神，申中壬水洩金也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570512384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木生火，亥卯未，以寅爲亡神，寅中丙火洩木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570528768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌云：亡神七煞禍非輕，用盡機闗一不成。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570545152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅子刑妻無祖業，仕人猶恐有虚名。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570561536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：命宮若也值亡神，須是長","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570577920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097937162338342"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生遇貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570577920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時日更𠔥天地合，匪躬蹇蹇作王臣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570594304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：皆言七煞是亡神，莫道亡神禍患輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570610688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命若還居此地，貧窮蹇滯過平生。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570627072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫星惡曜如臨到，大限渾如履薄氷。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570643456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合更須明審察，煞來夾拱必難行。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570659840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞一十六般：","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570676224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一名大煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉則聰慧敏給，才智過人，事不留行，胸羅萬象，高明爽迅，武德横財，卽生壯與與貴煞建禄併也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570676224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫則昏濁邪俊，毒害性重，宿疾刑徒，兵刀折傷，執拗内很，貪奪無情，卽庻絶與惡煞併也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570692608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若元辰空三，爲盗金神，庚辛併好，刓刻彫鏃。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570708992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡金火併爲打鐡屠","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570725376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097892828758056"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹、捕獵籠養之人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570725376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若刼煞尅身，更帶金神羊刃同尅，主車馬顚覆之災。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570741760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生時得之，子孫愚薄。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570758144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞聚寳，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570774528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"我尅他也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二名瓊珠。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570774528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞，歲尅刼有力，與日主和諧者，主富裕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570790912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞宜權，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570807296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"臨官空亡，空亡准十日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夜推臨官准十日。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570807296","marg
