inNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一名冠裳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078570823680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞爲人衣冠齊楚，光顯貴人，况生旺日辰乎。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695030836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞嘉謨，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695047220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身不尅於煞，煞却不得其位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一名紀綱。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695047220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞主強煞弱，日有他位之貴者，動容不妄，中禮安常。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695063604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097911929536551"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞奏號，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695079988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴人同到。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三名旌旗。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695079988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞刼坐，貴人貢功。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695096372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日主者，凡事變難成易，人自欽仰，福氣異常。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695112756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞呈瑞，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695129140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眞長生位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一名冕旒刼煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695129140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞在長生位，有曰主之財官等祿，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695145524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞爲霖","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695161908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"羅文貴人，一名塩梅刼煞時帶此刼煞與。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗君，干支互換見貴，更日辰有情，名利顯赫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695161908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞生上，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695178292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下生其上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三名庫堂刼煞，時帶此煞，自家生壯，取年者一重最吉，仍喜兩頭衝破。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695178292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年時干合支下帶煞，主破家蕩業，更與日家不情官。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695194676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然刼煞類争，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695211060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火人火類煞，一名闘争刼煞，無制無馭，則。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097906955124747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲屠沽巫醫，有制有馭，則爲福壽貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695211060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又看日辰吉㐫何如増减斷。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695227444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞造意，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695243828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"我去生他。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一名提孩刼煞，藏去生煞，猶母生子，若孤刑來併，主喪家尅子，或被兒女耗財，兼尅𥨸日主無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695243828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞非良，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695260212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞來尅我。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一名貪玩刼煞，主非義取財，因財害己，或貪悋遭禍等事。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695260212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲日辰㐫煞者，必然，爲貴氣者庻幾。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695276596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞毁焚，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695292980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"破宅煞尅歲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一名醫桑刼煞，此兼領破宅之神，來尅歲，不獨無屋可居，貧當甑釜生塵，更無","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695292980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097911929471015"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神剋竊者，無救。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695292980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞酣慾，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695309364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合起我羽他強。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一名風流刼煞，日時犯有合、单合、雙合、不降不尅日辰，竟無好意思相援者，主酒色破家，不知亷耻，生平酣飮嗜音。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695309364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞輕盈，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695325748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞逢𣦸絶，我去生他又合起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三名管絃刼煞，主嬌態美姿，春風花柳，日爲活計。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695325748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以日辰不絕，福神無援故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695342132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞黨衆，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695358516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞雙來尅歲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三名天牢刼煞，縱貴亦天，或軍旅亡於他郷，否則爲盜干音或又尅窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695358516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰更入空絶者無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695374900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097937162371110"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨚫煞暴厲，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695391284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下刼雙全，又尅羊刃，重重來合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一名刀鎗却煞，主㐫暴惡𣦸，千音尅𥨸日主决難免。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695391284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞空閑，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695407668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孤寡同到。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一名烟霞刼煞，此煞與孤寡刑隔四位，内犯二者，兼𣦸絶之氣尅𥨸日主，非僧則道，以水火象分之，水多爲道，火多爲僧，若是俗人，孤寒之甚，貴氣交加者，庶幾。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695407668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神十六般，一","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695424052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"名官符，一名七煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉則峻厲有威，謀畧𥮅計，見事如神，事不露機，兵行詭計，始終争勝，言事折辯，壯年進用，卽生旺與貴煞併也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695424052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097999519186980"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内則褊躁性窄，顛詐狂妄，浮蕩是非，酒色風流，官府獄訟，疽㾿氣血，氣不謙下，失勢失下，兵刑責難，卽處絕與惡煞併也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695440436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若貴人建禄併，專㺯筆硯，撰餙文詞，因公起家，干涉官利，或爲胥徒，併火尅身，則語吃無氣，多腰足疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695456820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神富藏，三名亡神貴驛。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695473204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃嵗去尅煞，亡神受歲之尅，我勝於彼，方是受降。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695489588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或鴛日主財官貴氣，或來生𦔳日主，主大富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695505972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神長生，三名珪玉亡神，亡神在長生位，兼帶日辰别位，貴禄飛騰早發。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695522356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097937162403878"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神臨官，三名軒冕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695538740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神，亡神入臨官位，却落空亡，反吉干音。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695555124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又能生曰，雖主乘軒戴冕之貴，亦有二三分酒色。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695571508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神鑾輿，三名鼎鼐，亡神臨時座，却見年時耳換。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695587892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人來徃，干神𦔳日主者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695604276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神自如，一名規矩亡神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695620660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞居弱地，歲入強宫，雖不尅煞，煞却不得其位，其煞來降。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695637044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"另有日辰貴氣者，主賢能謙謹，中正公勤食祿之人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695653428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神生本，一名父母亡神，亡神生歲兼生在，只宜一重。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695669812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有財官等貴，係屬日辰者，主精神富聚。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695686196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097948180742178"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神義門，一名羅綺亡神，貴人同到日時，見此煞，干支不壞，日者有福榮華。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695702580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神錦里，一名兒女亡神，歲去生他，遇孤隔刼煞，則卤帶禄貴則吉，三重爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695718964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又與日辰相綂，兼推吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695735348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神未降，一名停力亡神，此乃歲與煞同氣，如木人見木煞，竟無相尅相降，日無綂攝。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695751732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人貴氣，只是屠行牙儈、巫醫、丹青之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695768116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神妄作，一名擄掠亡神，此煞下反尅嵗，𥨸日之氣，主非理取財，語言狂安，乃巫醫藝術，談天說地之","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695784500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097897513762826"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695784500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神嘯宅，一名溝壑亡神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695800884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神若爲破宅，煞兼尅竊，嵗與日無情，主謀拙計窮，爲生乞丐，𣦸無棺槨。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695817268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神舞羣，一名鼓樂亡神，其煞不降不尅，却有合起之神，主閙羣叢祖，花酒立身。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695833652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無日家貴氣，准上亡神薄惡，一名貿血亡神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695850036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡刼俱全，年時干合音尅其歲，必主遭刑，不然惡病，尅𥨸日辰，無貴氣者，定驗。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695866420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神迷溺，一名花柳亡神，此神单來合煞之氣剛，我却柔弱，定主歌謳花酒度日，更引日家㐫煞，衣食","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695882804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097906955157515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艱難，亡於勞天。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695882804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神乖張，一名枷鎻亡神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695899188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神日時有兩重，又帶合，必是剌靣彫青，徒配胥吏，尅𥨸日主者愈重。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695915572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有眞亡刼，寅午戌人見癸巳、癸亥，己酉丑人見丙申、丙寅，申子辰人見丁亥、丁巳，亥卯未人見壬寅、壬申，獨者主㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695931956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有刼頭見財，如寅午戌人，甲干己亥之例，己酉丑人，乙干戊寅之例，是刼煞上見干財，主蓄積大富，吞併不顧，𢡖毒害物，遇兩重者，反主貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695948340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有刼頭見鬼，如申子辰人，甲干辛巳之例，亥卯未人，","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695964724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097989008080946"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙干庚申之例，是刼煞見官鬼，主無官，縱有，須因事罷難，得入侍從，庻人多被刼。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695964724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平生聚散。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695981108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有刼煞相合，如甲寅値己亥，丙寅值辛亥，戊寅值癸亥，庚寅値乙亥，壬寅值丁亥，甲申値己巳，丙申植辛巳，戊申値癸巳，庚申値乙巳，壬申值丁巳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078695997492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十位在日上謂之旌旗煞，在時上謂之英雄煞，主武。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696013876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有分刼聚刼分刼，如甲子人得己巳月己巳時，是子。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696030260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一刼寄於兩巳，而兩已分受，爲災反輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696046644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聚刼如用子人，得丙子月己巳時，是子兩重會刼一巳，而一巳獨受，致害反重。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696063028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097897513795594"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日：刼煞主煞，生氣主生，若有生氣兩重而刼煞一重，則是生氣強於刼；刼煞兩重而生氣一重，則是刼強於生。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696079412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣多者從生氣言，刼煞多者從刼煞言，不可槩論。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696095796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱逄生，交互見之，主作臺諫將帥之職，亡神准推。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696112180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵二煞全要以身尅煞，不要以煞尅身。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696128564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日煞尅妻，婦尅夫，時煞尅子，此外有天煞、地煞、歲煞、刑煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696144948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天煞在刼煞前二辰，地煞在刧煞前五辰，是辰戌丑未也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696161332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗煞在刼煞前三辰，亦是寅申己亥也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696177716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑煞在刼煞前七辰，與將星同位，是子午卯酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696194100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上四煞，俱主有權，不尅身不爲","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696210484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097920951549992"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾，尅身則爲灾，重與亡刧同。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696210484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶金土爲武臣，水木爲文臣，文臣帶土金爲煞者，亦主兵權。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696226868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論羊刃","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696243252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"對宫曰飛刃，又日唐符。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三車云：羊言剛也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696243252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刃者，取宰割之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696259636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿過則刃生，功成當退，不退則過越其分，如羊之在刃，言有傷也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696276020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故羊刄常居禄在一辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696292404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希尹曰：陰陽萬物之理，皆惡極盛。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696308788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當其極處，火則焦滅，水則湧竭，金則折缺，土則崩裂，木則摧折。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696325172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故既成而未極則爲福，巳極則將反而爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696341556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"極盛之地，十干中正處是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696357940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯者，甲之正位，爲陽木之極；辰者，乙之正位，爲陰木之極；午者，丙之正","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696374324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097948180774946"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位，爲陽火之極；未者，丁之正位，爲陰火之極；酉者，庚之正位，爲陽金之極；戌者，辛之正位，爲陰金之極。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696374324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子者，壬之正位，爲陽水之極；丑者，癸之正位，為陰水之極。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696390708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當其極處，其氣剛烈，暴戾不和，所以禄前一辰爲羊刃，對衝爲飛刃，旣盛而未極，則温柔和暢，故刃後一辰爲禄也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696407092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壼中子云：凡人有禄，必賜刃以衛之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696423476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此其義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696439860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一行命書云：羊刃重重又見祿，富貴饒金玉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696456244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洞玄經云：官印相𦔳福相資。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696472628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是羊刃帶禄，更有官印相資，尤作吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696489012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如專羊刃，主眼露性急，㐫暴害物，親近惡黨，生旺稍可，成絶尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696505396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在五行敗者逢之，多患","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696521780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097999519055908"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瘵瀝，或瘴癘金刃之災，不論貴賤，多冗雜勞廹，少得安逸。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696521780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙經云：六甲生人逢乙卯、丁卯爲眞羊刃，若重犯，主殘疾，官禄失退，敗散，在晩年。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696538164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘卯爲偏刃，則輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696554548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廣信集有刃頭財，如甲人見己卯之類，謂之銷鎔煞，主財帛歇滅。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696570932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常人以屠沽刀鋸等事爲業，或因被盜而致命者。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696587316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有刃頭鬼，如甲人見辛卯之類，謂之持刃煞，主人不令終，雖入貴格，亦不可測。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696603700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用乙人見之尤𦂳，多腦疽發背而終。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696620084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097999518990372"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金書命訣有羊刃相蝕，如甲寅虎兎、甲戌狗兎之類，見所蝕年月稍可，日時至危。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696636468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見兩重，更値空亡，設非相蝕，亦犯流配，至老主不善終。","logicSentenceId":"7577330078696652852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沈芝源髓有朝元羊刃，如卯年日時有甲字之類，主㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185764386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日干在時上作刃，主痕疾，不然卽子息帶，亦主子少時。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185780770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千就曰：支作刃，主妻惡來，禀性不良，不然是軍人或帶痕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185797154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𢇻年干臨時支作刃，多主父母惡來，更天煞在上，决定無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185813538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若胎中羊刃，更帶刑年，主出不善，或父母惡从，及賊陰人，年干就日支作刃，主父母惡庻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185829922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘照年月日時分位推之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185846306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古詩","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185862690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097897513828362"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云：或時藏刃入於胎，日刃或朝時上來，更若支干相刑尅，妻身姙産定應災。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185862690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人之命若如此，敢斷須憂生産厄。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185879074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是相刑羊刃，爲福最重。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185895458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又連珠刃，如庚戌、辛酉、戊午、己未、丙午、丁未、甲辰、乙卯、壬子、癸丑，皆卤象也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185911842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金𦂳木慢，女命犯之，定尅夫害子，不貞潔。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185928226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理愚歌云：倒懸羊刃又同行，形骸不免填溝壑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185944610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：飛刃倒戈終見乖，小人得此便爲災。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185960994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡截路河相見，此身安得出塵埃。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185977378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：羊刃更兼倒戈，必作無頭之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079185993762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是羊刃帶諸惡煞尤㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186010146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097937162518566"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人行運最怕羊刃，主作事稽遲，無士農、工啇背厭之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186026530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：運行羊刃，財物耗散。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186042914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186059298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寳鑑有攬轡澄清格，謂貴人乘馬而前視羊刃，猶馬頭帶劒之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186075682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令庚午人得乙酉或己西日時帶甲申，爲入格，午馬在申，庚禄在申，乙巳貴在申，庚羊刃在酉，却乙巳貴人乘甲申，爲驛馬，而前視羊刃，故曰攬轡澄淸。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186092066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格多爲清嚴之官，若更有吉類，多爲酷吏，能制奸宄。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186108450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干平以甲、丙、戊、庚、壬五陽干有刃，乙、丁、巳、辛、癸五陰干無刃，惟見傷官，與羊刃同禍，是指陰陽之陽，非牛羊之羊，其義見","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186124834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097937162534950"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後論陽刃格中。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186124834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論空亡一","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186141218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"名天中煞，對空卽孤虛煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空對實亡對有言。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186141218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神白經云：空亡空亡幾多般，十干不到作空看。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186157602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洞玄經云：遁窮而亡生，故以甲旬盡處日空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186173986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢有是位而無禄日空，有支而無出日亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186190370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子旬遁至酉，而十干足，所以無戌亥。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186206754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘五干例見，是爲空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186223138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然空而有實，亡而有存，所以未可便爲㐫論。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186239522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子論空亡云：五陽令用二陽，五陰令用一陰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186255906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲子、丙寅、戊辰、庚午、壬申，則用戌不用亥。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186272290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186288674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯、己巳、辛未、癸酉，則用亥不用戌，陽分陽年，陰分","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186305058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098033660690470"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰年。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186305058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又說：甲子至戊辰，以戌爲空亡，己巳至癸酒，以亥爲空亡，分上下五年，中間又分。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186321442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子至戊辰，見壬戌爲重，見戊戌之類爲輕；己巳至癸酉，見癸亥爲重，見乙亥之類爲輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186337826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子生甲戌時，此時上正見差輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186354210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己巳生癸亥時，亦時上内犯最重。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186370594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指迷賦云：禄入空亡，必分前後之辰，所以表陰陽之分，明輕重之等也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186386978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字金書云：甲寅旬壬癸落空亡，甲辰旬甲乙，甲申旬丙丁，甲戌匀庚辛。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186403362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以地支二位而論，天干或謂十惡大敗，犯此日生者，主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186419746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然人命見空亡而合格者多。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186436130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洞玄經云：淵淨而性侗無氣","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186452514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"空二多謂之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098033660674086"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"淵浄格圓機而自立，一家禄馬貴官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上見空亡，爲九","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186452514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"流格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辭，有童而賁名學堂見空亡，性無爲而湛如。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186452514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186468898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𣦹自絶，見空亡，美質可愛。貴人多，見空亡，則可愛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功名可珍，","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186468898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"華葢多見空亡則可功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"優游恬淡無累，雕鏤華藻有功，","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186468898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"休囚旺相，有吉神而見空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"抱越人之才，挾敢斷之果。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186468898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神煞暗指空，二雖超，人無福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳此亦有吉處。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186485282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡帶此煞，生旺則氣度寛大，動招虛名，長大肥滿，多意外無心之福；𣦸絶則一生成敗飄泊，但在我有氣之地，則不能爲神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186501666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌支干與天中相合，是謂小人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186518050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097920951484456"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得位則奸詐譎詭，靡所不爲。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186534434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若爲我所尅，是謂天中受殃，反爲特達之福。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186550818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如戊午火人見甲子金之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其神性無常，與官符併，則佞媚多文，與刼煞併，則狡勇；與亡神併，則飄蓬；與大耗併，顛倒糃突，與建禄併，一生破散；與咸池六害併，多卤暴卒。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186567202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟夾貴、華葢、三奇、學堂併者，大聰明脫俗之士。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186583586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫空亡不言，太歲見生，曰旬中空亡，極鑒。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186599970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若太歲與日互換空亡，更不佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186616354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以實爲空，則實可映空；以空爲空，無所映實，故帶互換空亡者，災深。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186632738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲子年壬戌，曰甲子之正空亡在壬戌，其壬戌乃甲寅旬，甲寅","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186649122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097937162567718"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬中空復在子，主三生財物耗散，大破家宅。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186649122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186665506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若曰時互換，時𦂳曰慢。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186681890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若曰犯而時却刑害衝破，時犯而曰却刑害衝破，亦主有福，未免坎坰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186698274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：天中二煞，不可全以㐫言。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186714658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如柱有惡神惡煞，禍聚之地，全要空亡觧之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186731042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有空亡，不宜見合，合則不能空矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186747426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若禄馬財官福聚之氣，全怕空亡，散之，有空亡，却喜見合，合則不能空矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186763810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無衝無合無刑，謂真空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186780194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四孟太毒，只作小伎巧術人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186796578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又甲子旬水土，甲戌旬金，甲申旬火土，甲午旬火土，用辰旬木，甲寅旬水土，爲真空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186812962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：響之有聲，莫","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186829346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097920951533608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非虛中也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186829346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以大人之命，要有虚中之德，空亡自旺有用，乃大聲大應之器。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186845730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月日時三位俱空亡者，不害爲大貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186862114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若值兩位，雖有官不大。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186878498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：凡命值空亡，時上見，多拗性，爲事高而虛，更遇華葢，决主少子；日上見，多庻出，或妻妾間離，遇偶合，則多滛蕩。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186894882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌云：胎裏生逢怕遇空，遇空時節自昏蒙。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186911266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"饒君十歩有九計，不免飄飄西復東。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186927650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是胎中忌見空也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：建禄臨空虛有各，平生向學老無成。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186944034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢馬貴來相救，縱得官時又復停。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186960418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是建禄忌見空也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098033660624934"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：甲寅戊午及庚申，丑上天中最不仁。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186976802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本分生來當受禄，因逄五鬼遂衰貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079186993186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以甲寅水見辛丑，土爲鬼來尅命，戊午見丁丑，庚申見乙丑，同是空亡，忌尅命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187009570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：六旬後兩號天中，見合長生旺不㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187025954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加臨衝尅兼刑禄，官職陞騰位更隆。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187042338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己酉丑人，丁丑月癸未日戊午時，午未空亡，而戊癸之火旺在午，反爲貴格，是火虛有熖也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187058722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：印綬之星中見空，順臨墓庫福重重。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187075106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還夾貴歸元位，帶煞須爲給事中。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187091490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲午癸西、丙子壬辰時","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187107874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097999519039524"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖空，却與癸酉作六合，又庫墓夾貴，所以入格。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187107874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是水空則流也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187124258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：金空則響，火空則明，水空則清，术空則折，土空則崩。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187140642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187157026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日：人命空亡本不好，若運衝刑，反爲虛煞，士人遇之，飛聲走譽。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187173410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲申、丁丑、乙亥、甲申，行壬午運，作當路；乙未、乙酉、乙丑、丁亥行辛巳運，作監司，大振聲望。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187189794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若壬寅爲空亡，壬申同類衝之，則不動，此爲最毒。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187206178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有截路空亡，正如人在途遇水，不能前進，不可以濟，故曰截路。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187222562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只以日取時見之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187238946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲巳日遁十二時","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187255330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097999519154212"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中，申酉上見壬癸，故甲己見申酉，乙庚見午未，内辛見辰巳，丁壬見寅卯，戊癸見戌亥，此二時上俱遇壬癸爲水故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187255330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此空亡非但命見不吉，凡出人求財、交易、上官嫁娶，百事皆忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187271714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有四大空亡，六甲中甲辰、甲戌二旬，金木水、火、土全，内甲子、甲午旬獨無水，甲寅、甲申旬獨無金，此四旬者，五行不全。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187288098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子、甲午旬生人見水，甲寅、甲申旬生見金，謂之正犯。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187304482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如當生年中不犯，行運至水金處，亦謂之犯。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187320866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶得，主一生蹇滯，不問貧賤富貴，皆夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187337250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三處重遇，瞬息爲期。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187353634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子云：顔回","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187370018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097999519121444"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭折，只因四大空亡，正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187370018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洞微經有五鬼空亡：甲己人見巳午，乙庚寅卯，丙辛子丑，丁壬戌亥，戊癸申酉，限至斯郷，主食有尅害空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079187386402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙人見午，丙丁申，戊己巳，庚辛寅，壬癸酉丑，主尅害妻子，有破祖空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668109364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙、丙丁同上。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668125748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳人見戌，庚辛子，壬癸寅，遇者主破祖業，須併論之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668142132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論元辰","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668158516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"屬毛頭星，三，名大耗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元辰者，别而不合之名。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668158516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽前陰後，則有所屈，屈則於事無所伸；陰前陽後，則直而不遂，於事暴而不治，難","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668174900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098033660723238"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與同事，故謂之元辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668174900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以陽男陰女，在衝前一位支辰；陰男陽女，在衝後二位支辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668191284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲子生男，與甲午對衝，卽乙未爲正；乙丑生男，與乙未對衝，卽甲午爲正。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668207668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘干午未半之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668224052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以爲卤者，當氣衝之地，左皷則風煞在右，右皷則風煞在左。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668240436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故陰陽男女，取衝前衝後不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668256820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若歲運臨之，如物當風，動揺顛倒，不得寧息，不有内疾，必有外難。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668273204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖富貴崇高，勢位炎盛，大運逢之，十年可畏，立朝定當竄逐，居家必罹卤咎。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668289588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有吉神扶持，不免禍福倚伏，尤忌先吉後西，發壯之後，欲出，末出之際，禍不可逃。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668305972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命遇之，主形貌陋朴，靣","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668322356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097911929569319"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有顧骨，鼻低口大，眼生威角，斷凸臋高，手脚強硬，轂音沉濁。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668322356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生狂則落魄大度，不别是非，不分良善，顛倒鶻突。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668338740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦹絕則寒酸薄劣，形貌猥下，語言渾濁，不識羞辱，破敗坎珂，貪飲好情，甘習下流，與官符併，多招無辜之撓。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668355124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶刼煞，則不循細行，動招危辱，窮賤無耻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668371508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人得之，轂雄性濁，奸滛私通奴賤，鬼魅爲慿，不遵禮法，一生多災，雖生子𫼡而不孝。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668387892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常術䑕忌羊頭歌，未分男女，不足憑也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668404276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子以宣父畏其元辰，林開以元辰惡煞，爲災甚重，有互換遇者，尤爲不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668420660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然遇合，又以吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668437044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洞玄經云：元辰遇合而大亨是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668453428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廣信","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668469812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097989008130098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集取巫伋恭政，己卯甲申、己巳甲戌，滕康樞宻乙丑壬午、乙丑壬午二命，豈不犯元辰？","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668469812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李吉甫曰：大凡貴命須逄煞，卽得君王横升拔林，開一偏之見也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668486196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐子平云：元辰者，命中元有所害之辰，如甲見申庚、乙見酉辛之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668502580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生歲月日時原有七煞，己爲所害之辰，歲運復遇，謂之犯元辰，爲害尤重，元無則輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668518964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然元辰一煞，與亡刼、羊刃、空亡同類，觀珞琭子消息賦自見。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668535348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雪心賦云：元辰水去，亦指神煞之名，是古人之說是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668551732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論暗金的煞，","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668568116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人選擇家以月取，謂之紅煞，曰汎■，皆㐫，出行尤忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097999519236132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三煞乃先天數之四衝也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668568116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫子午之數各九，卯酉各六，總爲三十。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668584500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自子順行，極三十而見已，是爲四仲之正煞；寅申各七，己亥各四，總二十有二。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668600884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自子順行，極二十二而見酉，是爲四孟之正煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668617268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰八各五，丑未各八，總二十有六。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668633652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自子順行，極二十六數而見丑，是爲四季之正煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668650036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是起於數者然也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668666420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡神煞皆起於數，與禄馬同類。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668682804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此一煞而有三名，一曰吟呻，二曰破碎，三曰白衣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668699188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉在巳，寅申己亥在酉，辰戌丑未在丑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668715572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳者，金生之地，巳中臨官之火，金氣臨尅，主杖楚刑獄呻吟之災，故曰吟呻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668731956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉者金旺之地，煞物當","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668748340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443633064053440551"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，又有辛金相𦔳，萬物當之，無不破碎，主支離流血之災，故曰破碎。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668748340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑乃金之庫墓，居四季而臨鬼門，主妨害䘮服哭泣之事，故曰白衣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668764724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行中惟金能煞物，故總名曰暗金的煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668781108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其神生旺，主人寛量大器，决斷有爲，形容清峻，若不夭喪刑傷，須有癩病癱痪；𣦸絕則𢡖害尅毒，形容紅白，巧言令色，笑𫟚藏刀。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668797492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與官符併，則横來官災；與刼煞併，則横來𣦸喪；與白虎羊刃併，則流血傷殘；與貴人建禄併，則稍慢，五行旺相。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668813876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉神相救，入貴格則無害，入賤格，再值一切㐫神則愈匈。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668830260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日金生處，主大風灘痪之疾；金旺處，主水蠱","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668846644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097999519203364"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毒藥之病；金墓處，主尅子惡𣦸","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668846644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/7452657674410852404/7453003948195053603/1-1735299094718.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=7fnc%2FnfDpg7KK344WTCRyi2gxDw%3D","uri":"read/7452657674410852404/3/ref/1kms4bwbkyxvt/1-1735299094718.webp","fontType":3,"components":"丶㇇㇏","variants":"","charPicId":"7453050480885809188"},"logicSentenceId":"7577330079668846644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憂。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668846644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶三刑德貴，主有高官、持兵權。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668863028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵此煞不吉，人命逄之，固所不宜；歲逄之，亦主孝服哭聲，盜賊侵擾，口舌破耗。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668879412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小兒犯此湯火之厄，不然身有痕疤破綻之象。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668895796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：謬捩無過於刑害，有時而吉；乖違莫甚於衝破，未必皆㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668912180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668928564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論災煞","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668944948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一名白虎煞，余見申子辰，全遇午方是白虎，與災煞微不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"災煞者，其性勇猛，常居刼煞之前，衝破將星，謂之災煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668944948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申子辰將星在子午，却去衝子；寅午戌在午子却去衝，己酉丑在酉卯却去衝，亥卯未在卯酉，却去","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668961332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097911929618471"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝，是災煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668961332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神白云：類水逄星照，虛空怕日煙。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668977716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛夏蠋戰，木不引雞眠。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079668994100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱交加見，福少禍連綿。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669010484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞主血光横威，在水火，防焚溺，金木杖刃，土墜落蕰疫，尅身大卤。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669026868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有福神相取，多是武權，亦如刼煞之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669043252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要見官星印綬，生莊處爲住。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669059636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神白經云：災煞畏乎尅，生處却爲祥。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669076020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669092404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論六厄，厄者，遭乎難者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669108788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常居馬前一辰，刼後二辰，威而不生，謂之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669125172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰水局，水从在卯，寅午戌火局，火處在酉，亥卯未木局，木威在午，己酉丑金局，金以在子，","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669141556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098192155066431"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以爲厄。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669141556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有救護、有扶持，逢生旺𠔥貴氣相𦔳則吉，究竟一生蹇滯。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669157940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子云：六厄爲剥官之煞，李廣不封侯。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669174324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669190708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論勾絞","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669207092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一名瓜牙煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾者，牽連之義；絞者，覊絆之名。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669207092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二煞𡮢相對衝，亦猶亡刼。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669223476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽男陰女命，前三辰爲勾，命後三辰爲絞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669239860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰男陽女命，前三辰爲絞，命，後三辰爲勾。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669256244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲子陽命人，卯爲勾，酉爲絞，乙丑陰命人，辰爲絞，戌爲勾之例。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669272628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌云：爪牙煞去命三辰，大忌金神羊刃臨。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669289012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾煞尅身無福救，必遭蛇虎傷其身。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669305396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞大忌金神、白虎併","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669321780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098025527885843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則㐫，牛馬、犬畜等傷，亦是不獨虎狼也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669321780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不尅身，與福同宫者不用。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669338164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵此煞儿命遇之，身若尅煞，多心路計巧，主掌刑法之任，或爲將帥，專行誅戮。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669354548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞若尅身，主非命而終。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669370932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小人逢之，非橫災禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669387316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行年至此，亦主口舌刑獄等事。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669403700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：值兩位全者，災重，一位者輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669420084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：有鬼則災重，無鬼則災輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669436468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論孤辰寡宿","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669452852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"及隔角煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先賢有云：老而無夫曰寡，幼而無父日孤。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669452852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此其義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669469236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰謂星辰，宿謂星宿，指其神也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669485620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命犯此星辰，則孤寡如是。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669502004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如亥子丑逐方三位，進前一辰見寅爲孤，退","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669518388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097989008146482"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後三辰見戌爲寡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669518388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又過角爲孤，退角爲寡，其餘三方皆依此推，乃陰陽惆悵之義曰夫寅爲春始，辰爲春末，巳爲夏始，未爲夏末，申爲秋始，戌爲秋末，亥爲冬始，丑爲冬未，皆陰陽枝離之神，四時代謝之方。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669534772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三車云：造物中以生我者爲母，尅我者爲夫，我尅者爲妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669551156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子丑屬北方水位，水用金爲母，金絶於寅，是母絕也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669567540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用火爲妻，火墓在戌，是妻墓也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669583924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉戌屬西方金位，金用火爲夫，火絶在亥，用木爲妻，木墓在未。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669600308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已午未南方火位，火用木爲母，木絕在申，用水爲夫，水墓在辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669616692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯辰屬東方木位，木用水爲母，水絕在已，用","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669633076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098033660772390"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金爲夫，金墓在丑，是取母絕爲孤辰，夫墓妻墓爲寡宿，其義尤切。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669633076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子云：骨肉中道分離，孤寡猶𭒡於隔角。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669649460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉門集云：寅申己亥爲魚，辰戌丑未爲隔，進者爲陽不利父，退者爲陰不利母。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669665844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：在陽宫妨父，在陰宫妨母。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669682228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅卯辰人，巳爲孤，丑爲寡，寅辰爲陽之位，丑巳爲陰之位，男女生命見之，雖親生兒女，多不和順。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669698612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬氏云：男命生於妻絕之中，而逄孤辰，平生難於婚偶；女命生於夫絕之位，而遇寡宿，屢嫁不能偕老。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669714996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辛丑人得庚寅，寅爲丑孤辰，丑爲寅寡宿，寅、丑互爲孤寡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079669731380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隔角，言丑、寅中有艮卦，隔乾、坤、艮、巽四猶","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735218228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098025527902227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之角也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735218228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經云：凡人命犯孤寡，主形孤肻露，面無和氣，不利六親。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735234612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生狂稍可，來絕尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735250996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬併放蕩他鄉，空亡併㓜少無倚，喪弔併父母相繼而亡，一生多逄重䘮疊禍，骨肉伶仃，即寒，不利。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735267380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入貴格，贅壻婦家，入賤格，移流未免。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735283764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷遺文云：連屬不言孤寡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735300148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如亥得寅戌，寅得丑巳，或支干朝㑹，包褁貴人，雖犯孤寡，不以孤寡論。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735316532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廣録云：井欄斜衝，是孤辰寡宿，更天干帶倒食，謂之井欄倒食。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735332916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若巳午未人再生夏三月，是帶兩重孤寡，主尅妻害子，少六親，不聚財，多生女，更帶諸㐫","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735349300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097948180873250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，主不令終。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735349300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子云：慿陰察其陽禍，歲星莫犯於孤辰；恃陽鑑以陰災，天年忌逄於寡宿。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735365684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢言小運太歲不可犯之，陽以孤辰爲重，陰以寡宿爲重。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735382068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚云：子午卯酉有𣦸氣，辰戍丑未四墓之鄉，人或値之，孤中孤也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735398452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常以寅卯辰居午，巳午未在酉，申酉戌逢子，亥子丑臨卯，此是孤辰隔角。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735414836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735431220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以寅申己亥爲天地之角，今隔此四位，故日孤辰，或以寅。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735447604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日丑時巳日辰時，甫日未時，亥日戌時，名惆悵煞，主谷嗟不足，雖富貴亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735463988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子玷責，庻人刑徒，不獨孤寡巳也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735480372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若戌日子時，丑日卯時，辰日午時，未日酉時，","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735496756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098033660821542"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"互換看之，君子主癰疽致命，庻人血光致庻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735496756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時損尅妻子，胎年損尅父母，名血光煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735513140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沈芝又以子人見亥，亥人見子，丑人見戌，戌人見丑，寅人見酉，酉人見寅，卯人見申，申人見卯，辰人見未，未人見辰，巳人見午，午人見巴，各兩位依次數之，日時遇着，定主孤寡少失六親。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735529524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年時犯，若不過房，必尅父母。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735545908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此又二說。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735562292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論天羅地網羅網之說，其義甚明，然何以戌亥爲天羅，辰巳爲地網？","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735578676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天傾西北，戌亥者，六陰之終也；地䧟東南，辰巳者，六陽之終也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735595060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽終極，則暗昧不明。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735611444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姬人之在羅","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735627828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098192155050047"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"網，此其義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735627828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子云：龍蛇混雜，偏不利於辰生；備犬侵凌，但獨嫌於亥字。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735644212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍爲辰，蛇爲巳，辰人得己，巳人得辰，皆曰龍蛇混雜，男命則不妨，惟女命破婚害子，薄命抱疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735660596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰人得巳重，巳人得辰輕，謂龍生蛇穴者退，蛇生龍穴者進。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735676980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猪爲亥，犬爲戌，戌人得亥，亥人得戌，皆曰猪犬侵凌，女命則不妨，惟男命則迍滯齟齬，妨祖尅妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735693364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌人得亥輕，亥人得戌重。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735709748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂犬入猪羣則進，猪入犬羣則傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735726132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸書亦云：龍蛇混雜，常防婦女憂危；猪犬侵凌，每慮丈夫厄難。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735742516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是男順天羅，女怕地網。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735758900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中間又分火命人有天羅，水土命人有地網，餘金","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735775284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098025527951379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木二命無之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735775284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命帶此，多主蹇滯，更加惡煞相併，五行無氣，必主惡來。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735791668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行運至此亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735808052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如戌年戌月。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735824436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初一曰：生者犯三年天羅；十五日生者，犯十五年天羅。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735840820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若更生時是戌，増成三十年天羅，或戌年亥月，或亥時、戌曰，交互見之，謂之重犯，則災不能歇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735857204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地網如上說。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735873588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若天羅地網重併，爲害尤重。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735889972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理愚歌云：生時地結與天盤，争使親闈得久安。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735906356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲辰命見甲戌，甲戌命見甲辰，只此二辰生人，是就羅網中言之也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735922740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論十惡大敗十惡者，譬律法中人犯十惡重罪，在所不赦。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735939124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大敗者，","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735955508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097981038886952"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬兵法中與敵交戰，大敗，無一生還，喻極匈也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735955508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲旬中十個曰值祿入空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735971892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲辰、乙巳，甲以寅爲祿，乙以卯爲禄，甲辰旬以寅、卯爲空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079735988276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬甫者，壬以亥僞禄，甲子旬以亥爲空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736004660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘如丙申、丁亥、庚辰、戊戌、癸亥、辛巳、乙丑等曰，皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736021044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命中犯者，當以日上見之爲是，其餘不論。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736037428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况犯者未必皆匈，若内有吉神相扶，貴氣相輔，當爲吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736053812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元白經曰：十惡都來十個辰，逐年有煞用區分。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736070196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚戌年見甲辰曰，辛亥年見乙巳日，壬寅年見丙申日，癸巳年見了亥日，甲辰年見戊戌日，乙未年見己丑","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736086580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098192155082815"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日，甲戌年見庚辰日，乙亥年見辛巳日，丙寅年見壬申曰，丁巳年見癸亥日，葢以年支干衝日支干無禄爲忌，餘悉無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736086580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"釋敎玄黃經又以甲己年戊辰月戊戌日，壬申月癸亥日，乙亥月丙申日，丙子月丁亥日，乙庚年辛巳月壬申日，甲戌月乙巳日，丙辛年壬辰月辛巳日，戊戌月庚辰日，己亥月甲辰日，戊癸年己未月己丑日，丁壬年無如人命用己年三月、七月、十月、十三月生，恰遇此四日。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736102964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
