{"lines":[{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又分别甲子句生恰遇壬，由甲辰旬生，恰遇乙己，在日上見方是，其說尤的。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736119348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098025527934995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有四廢日，春庚申，夏壬子，秋甲寅，冬丙午，三暦㑹同，又添辛酉、癸亥、乙卯、丁未。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736135732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廢者，囚來無用之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736152116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命帶此，作事不成，有始無終。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736168500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有天地轉日，春乙卯、辛卯，夏丙午、戊午，秋辛酉、癸酉，冬壬子、丙子，乃干支納音俱專旺於四時之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736184884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命値此日，生於四季，更本命又到此，在成功不退，物過則損，主天折。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736201268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄微賦云：韓信被誅，只傷天地轉煞是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736217652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如顔子己丑、辛未、丙午戊子夏生，見丙午，加以本命又到此，狂雖亞聖，造化太極，至庚申年壽止。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736234036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又一命丙戌、丁酉、辛酉、己未秋生，而遇","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736250420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097948180840482"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉，雖本命是土，丑，甲年庚戌月壽止。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736250420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵造化最喜中和，太過不及，皆不爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736266804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上四曰乃過遇來囚，謂之不及。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736283188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地轉曰乃過遇徤旺，謂之太過，非中和也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736299572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若桂中不及有生扶，太過有制，抑，不在此論。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736315956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論干支諸字，雜犯神煞古人製字，各有取義。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736332340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𥚞字之訓爲木白斃水，土絶於已，故汜字之訓，說文以爲窮瀆。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736348724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圯字之訓爲岸圯及覆。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736365108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火衰於戌，故威爲滅；金衰於丑，故鈕爲鍵閉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736381492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"草核爲亥，术根於艮，金遇十爲針，白遇十爲皁，水遇十爲","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736397876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098025527967763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"汁之類，是可以不論平。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736397876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲乙十干，子丑十二支，古人製字，必有深義。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736414260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試以字形言之，甲丙丁壬辰字，謂之平頭煞，若見三四帶空亡者，定爲僧道。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736430644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命書云：人命犯甲乙丙丁，一路無閒，主䧟害，男尅妻，女尅夫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736447028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用癸未申酉屬破字，甲癸酉必損眼，未申患心腹疾，更看時入害鄉，干神受制者不虛。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736463412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辛卯午申屠懸針。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736479796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行元無氣，不值德神，定是軍人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736496180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命纂局云：甲辛三四號懸針，眼疾還多嶮厄臨。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736512564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"被刑帶煞須徒配，多是爲軍剌靣人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736528948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌庚戌屬杖刑，鋒刃倒戈，若■羊刃蝕神，定犯徒流惡𣦹。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736545332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙己丑巳屬闕字，曲脚煞，犯多","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736561716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098192155099199"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，必有闕唇穿耳，支體不全。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736561716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無德合，五行無氣，榖帛不𠑽，寄食他門。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736578100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命書云：己巳、乙巳、丁巳，人命日遇，主尅頭妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736594484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李九萬云：凡己酉丑三合全，天干帶己字者，主唇齒不全之疾，一生招人唇吻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736610868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱有己巳者，各曲脚煞帶多，主養他人爲子，不然養於他人爲子。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736627252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙壬寅西爲聾啞字，若犯多者，及胎中受害，時蝕於日，必患聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736643636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又酉日戌時生，亦主此患，及頭靣惡瘡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736660020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是時破日也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736676404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌日：平頭必是爲僧道，破字終須失眼明。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736692788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶煞懸針須剌靣，徒流多是杖刑併。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736709172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"饑貧不幸逄空缺，相貌無知不十成。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736725556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟是相遭聾啞字，空亡無","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736741940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098192155131967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣定來精。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736741940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還曲脚多多帶，父子須敎兩姓生。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736758324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又壬癸人得酉字，或酉人得壬癸字，水從酉爲酒，遇吉因酒成家，㐫則破家或醉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736774708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庻乙字爲披頭，若重見者，或師巫，或倡優，併天乙、天德爲高官。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736791092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戊二干若在寅卯上，名仇讐晦氣，主招謗怨，多與人競。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736807476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳、癸三干全，非四肢眼目破傷，則中年後犯刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736823860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙、庚三干全，主失明，或少年班瘡損眼。","logicSentenceId":"7577330079736840244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙癸二干不可同見丑字，主富貴少壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188203060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁辛二干不可同見巳字，主傷父母。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188219444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：乙癸同牛，寸陰難保；丁辛二千，父母多傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188235828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛二干不可見己，丁壬二干不可見午申，名曰類應，主平","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188252212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098192155148351"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生歇滅。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188252212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙辛二干不可同夫，庚壬二干不可同戌名。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188268596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：反傷，主富貴中夭壽，小人刑戮之災。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188284980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：乙辛逄未是天牢，四位同宫禍患遭。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188301364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚壬遇戌須徒配，災咎來時不可逃。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188317748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總論諸神煞，神煞古有百二十名，其說穿鑿支離，造化恐不如是。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188334132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"除羊刃、空亡、刼煞、災煞、大煞、元辰、勾絞、咸池、破碎、羅網、衝擊、天空、懸針、平頭、倒戈等煞，命中切要者，已僃論於前矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188350516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兹以諸星家考驗有理，復僃叔於左。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188366900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自縊煞，此煞取五行反繫處，如戌人己巳人戌辰","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188383284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098033660870694"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人亥亥人辰，寅人未，未人寅，卯人申申人卯午人丑丑人午子人酉酉人子是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188383284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌相尅，天元是墓，更有天中官符大耗者，定㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188399668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水溺煞，此煞取丙子、癸未、癸丑，上帶咸池、金刃、羊刃，葢丙子納音水，又子爲水旺之地，未爲井宿之居，丑爲三河之分，更納音尅身，决不可免。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188416052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌云：刼煞尅身名顚墜。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188432436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神羊刃防同位，要知自縊最㐫神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188448820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳辰亥併寅未，子酉一例爲㐫煞，卯申丑未依前是。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188465204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犬忌空亡𠔥墓鬼，官符大耗仍須避。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188481588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子癸未併癸丑，咸池金煞羊刃畏。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188497972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行更若來尅","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188514356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097981039050792"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身，三庻懸梁一溺水。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188514356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掛劒煞，此煞取己酉丑申，四桂純全者是，或重帶己酉丑亦是。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188530740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更犯官符、元辰、白虎、金神等類，五行刑尅本命者，主㐫暴殺人，或反爲人所殺。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188547124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：己酉丑申金氣全，從革局多名掛劒，元亡金虎併。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188563508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅身縱不殺人身，豈免。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188579892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天火煞此煞取寅午戌全，而天干有丙丁，五位中全不見水者是，有水則非。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188596276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年運至火氣生旺處，當防火災。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188612660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：寅午戌全號天火，不見丙丁猶自可。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188629044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五位都無一水神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188645428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生狂臨年災厄火余命寅午。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188661812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098192155181119"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌全月干有癸，行戊午運，戊癸化火甲戌年，甲戌月，遂遭火災","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188678196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"育吾自記。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭屠煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188678196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞除子日午時，午日子時外，自餘丑日亥時，亥日丑時，寅日戌時，戌日寅時，卯日酉時，酉日卯時，辰日申時，申日辰時，巳日未時，未日巳時，依次逐兩位數之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188694580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子犯者，主異疾、腸風脚氣；小人折損肢體，重犯者主徒配夭刑煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188710964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞取子丑人，乙時寅人，庚時卯辰人，辛時巳人，王時午未人，癸時申人，丙時酉戌人，丁時亥人，戊時取時刑尅本命，犯者遭刑有疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188727348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097989008179250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雷霆煞：正七二八子寅方，三九四十辰午當，五十三申六二戌，必主雷轟虎咬亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188743732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：正七下加子，二八在寅方，三九居辰上，四十午位傷，五十三申位，六十二戌方。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188760116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月起子，順行六陽位。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188776500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞人命遇之，如逄禄貴吉星臨壓則吉，好行陰𨽥，爲法官，掌雷霆行符勅水之人，或成佛作祖之軰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188792884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇羊刃、的煞、飛亷等會，命限必㐫，主墮於天眞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188809268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雷傷虎㗖，天譴瘟疾，或溺水囹圄處吞陷煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188825652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猪犬羊逄虎必傷，侯蛇相會樹頭亡，犬逄子子遭徒配，兎趕蛇歌走遠鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188842036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䑕見犬來須惡𣦹，","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188858420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098025528000531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬牛遇虎定相戕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188858420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"免侯逢犬難廻避，龍來龍上水中殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188874804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人若值臨時日，三合爲災仔細詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188891188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以年支爲主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官符煞取太歳前五辰，是日時遇之，平生多官災。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188907572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更併羊刃，乃刑徒之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188923956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若官符落天中，多邪誕不實，名妄語煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188940340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病符煞取太歲後一辰是，犯者多疾病，行年遇之亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188956724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸符煞取病符對衝，是月時日犯之，無貴神觧，故㐫惡短折。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188973108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丧吊煞一名積關煞，取命前二辰爲䘮門命後二。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080188989492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097981039149096"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰爲弔客，其或太嵗㐫煞併臨，大小運限，必圡禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189005876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古詩云：五官六𣦸十二病，三喪十一弔來臨。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189022260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可見此十二宫一太歲歌，不惟命犯不吉，流年尤㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189038644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月有羊刃來佐㐫煞臨時，則横闗也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189055028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌云：横關一煞少人知，月禄㐫神又及時。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189071412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有吉星重叠至，不遭刑戮也傾危。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189087796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喪門即地此，弔客即天狗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅墓煞，命前五辰爲宅，命後五辰爲墓，怕宅墓受歲刧等煞來破本命之宅，主呻吟。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189104180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日刑煞，以本生日上数，甲子本日干住，陽干順數，陰于逆數，若在命官主極刑，三合主徒配，對官主","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189120564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097981039034408"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189120564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流血煞以本生月起，子，順𢿘至本年住，若在命宫三合、對宫主癰疽，庻人徒配，婦人産厄。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189136948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劒鋒煞，甲子旬過劒辰鋒戌，甲午旬劒戌鋒辰，甲寅旬劒午鋒申，甲申旬劒子鋒寅，甲辰旬劒申鋒午，甲戌旬劒寅鋒子，隨在各宫㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189153332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如第七宫損露子，第四宫損田宅。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189169716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戟鋒煞正月起甲，二月乙、三月戊、四月丙、五月丁、六月己、七月庚、八月辛、九月戊、十月壬、十一月癸，十二月己，逐月旺干加臨日時，帶兩重者㐫，更與","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189186100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098249398992923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸針相見，主决配傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189186100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浮沉煞","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189202484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"血刃月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從戌上起子，逆行至本生年住，却從年宫數，看在何宫，只在則帛宫各串錢，主冨蓄，餘皆㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189202484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲、乙、巳、庚、壬人犯之稍輕，丙、丁、戊、辛、癸人犯之，重在寅午戌、申未年中，此煞多主水厄，仍各隨宫分論災。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189218868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如在田宅，則主破祖，餘宫類推。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189235252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破煞，此煞卯與午，丑與辰，子與酉，未與戌，皆相破，惟寅申、己亥原破，却三合，故不取。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189251636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犯者主小年災滞，財産耗散，兼身有折傷之災。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189268020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"返本煞，五行無貴氣，下尅上爲返。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189284404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：五行庻絕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189300788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098192155197503"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"併來時有格，如閑福不隨。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189317172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更忘日時尅年主，定無官貴切須知。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189333556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子金命得戊午日，又胎月日時多帶寅巳，犯者定主孤立，或富或貴，一㽵便尅，傷伎母尊長。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189349940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽煞女屬陰而喜陽，命得戊午旺火爲正陽，男屬陽而喜陰，命得丙子旺水爲正陰，是陰陽和暢。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189366324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故男得丙子，平生多得美婦人；女得戊午，平生多逄美男子。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189382708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日上遇之，男得美妻，女得美夫，大忌元辰咸池同宫，不論男女皆滛。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189399092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如男得戊午，多婦人相愛；女得丙子，多男子挑誘。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189415476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更㸔有無貴賤消息。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189431860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097989008277554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"薩慾妨害煞壼中子云：老醉秦樓十二，直縁重犯八專；少亡楚甸八千，應是叠逢九醜。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189448244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢言八專爲滛慾之煞，九醜爲妨害之辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189464628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八専，乃甲寅、乙卯、己禾、丁未、庚申、辛酉、戊戌、癸丑是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189481012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日上有不正之妻，時上有不正之子，女人犯者，不擇親疎，犯多者尢𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189497396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九醜乃壬子、壬午、戊子、戊午、己西、己卯、乙酉、乙卯、辛酉、辛卯是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189513780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人犯者，主産厄，男犯多醜不令終。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189530164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤鸞寡鵠煞，古歌曰：木火逢蛇大不祥，金猪何必強猖狂。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189546548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土㺅木虎夫何在，時對孤鸞舞一場。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189562932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃乙","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189579316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098025528115219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳、丁巳、辛亥、戊申、甲寅，又丙午、戊午、壬子等曰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189579316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男尅妻，女尅夫，陰陽差錯煞，乃丙子、丁丑、戊寅、辛卯、壬辰、癸巳、丙午、丁未、戊申、辛酒、壬戌、癸亥十二曰也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189595700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女子逄之，公姑寡合，妯娌不足，夫家冷退。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189612084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子逢之，主退外家，亦與妻家是非寡合。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189628468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其煞不論男女，月日時兩重或三重，犯之極重，只日家犯之尢重，主不得外家力，縱有妻財，亦成虚花，久後仍與妻家爲仇，不相徃來。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189644852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官遇刼，名桃花煞，主好酒色；","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189661236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098033660936230"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"返吟遇裊，名短壽煞，主傷妻子。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189661236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花紅艷煞，亥卯未在子，己酉丑在午，寅午戌在卯，申子辰在酉，爲桃花煞；甲乙逄午、丙寅、丁未、戊子、己辰、庚戌、辛酉、壬巳、癸申，爲紅艶煞，女命最忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189677620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上諸煞，凡言尅身，謂㐫煞下納音尅生年，太嵗納音臨身，謂㐫煞帶太歲納音於本位也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189694004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗納音爲身，若身被尅被臨於𣦸敗絶位，便遭不測之災。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189710388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若但在身有氣處，被尅災重，被臨則輕，惟太嵗納音尅煞則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189726772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人命己入貴格，𦂳要處帶煞，有福神取之，則","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189743156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098192155213887"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名爲權柄，無福神助之，又煞氣乘旺，逓互徃還，或刑尅本，主下賤惡庻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189743156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：一切福神所居之位，則欲生壯，生旺則榮貴；一切煞神所居之位，則欲威絶，庻絶則善終。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189759540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：凢福神欲令得旺氣，忌有敗之者；凡㐫神欲令得衰氣，忌有𦔳之者。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189775924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：相衝相破，三合六合，命中有之，卽求五行相得何如，或禍中生福，福中生禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189792308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如𣦹絕復生，空亡受破，相尅相成，則禍中生福；反此則福中生福。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189808692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命書云：道途賤吏，豈無驛馬攀鞍；市井慱徒，亦有三奇夾貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080189825076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子平云：君子格中也犯七煞陽刃，小人命内亦有正印官星。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674742272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由是觀之，言卤神","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674758656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098249398845467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞不可拘定，輕重較量，要在通變。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674758656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵㐫煞所居于神不宜帶眞鬼，尅傷本身，雖見官星，尚變爲鬼，况是眞鬼，其爲災禍明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674775040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申己亥，四宮互換，神煞當年同榜拜丹墀。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674791424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文業雖齊禄不齊，生以榮枯于百様，爲緣煞局有高低，","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674807808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞局十二宫中皆有之，寅申、己亥爲最，以亡神刧煞、貴人長生、禄馬同位故也。人命逄吉神多則吉。㐫煞多則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞中包煞方爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674807808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不在年干在日時，帶贵自生方是吉，力停争戰又非宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674824192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098249398861851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞中包煞，是長生，帶貴則變煞爲生，無吉則煞無變，非一煞占二官也。不在生年干頭及生年納音。全在日時見煞，煞自長生，方可伯吉。如一命庚子、壬午、辛巳、辛卯、癸酉胎子午卯酉蛇頭，開口因位。全破碎在巳子人劫煞在已，是四位教聚於辛，曰金自長生。又一命乙巳、乙酉、己未壬，由是壬申爲亡神聚貴，又自壯爲權，故皆大貴。力停，則戊午、丙子之類，兩退皆明，各自爲主，相對相尅，謂之戰不。勝者争，故林開曰：力停争戰，寡不敵衆，受降者得福。此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自生自旺自臨官，分散英靈氣不完。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674840576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因弱三強方是福，迭爲賔主便分權。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674856960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四往自只要一位長生專旺，方可聚斂精神。若年月生旺，日時又用旰，謂之分散英靈，反主不貴。如癸亥、戊午、丙弓、己亥，四位各自生旺，送爲賔主，心性雖巧，员一術士如一命壬寅、王寅、庚辰、辛巳。衲音三位金同，长生於時，是聚歛精神，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097989008212018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"談命先須挑煞局，星辰要看主宫星。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674873344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩般強弱能分别，禍福何愁斷不靈。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674889728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞局不多元百個，亡神刼煞皆爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674906112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄禄貴及長生，反煞爲權聲譽描。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674922496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無禄貴是奸頑，不非不急足機關。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674938880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更帶三刑作僧道，難和骨肉必傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674955264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生甲申並己亥，辛巳宜堪見丙寅。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674971648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沙漠揚威奸膽破，調羮鼎鼐廟堂人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080674988032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申己亥喜長生，胎元湊足最爲榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675004416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四方四馬人聲價，𬗃紫拖朱居帝京。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675020800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098192155263039"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申、己亥、辛巳、丙寅，四位爲眞長生，如是亡刧，更帶禄馬、貴人同到，必主揚威沙漠。如一命乙酒乙酉、乙西、甲申，四水皆生於申，三貴又聚於由，自得長生，又在旬内，故大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞神和主兩長生，富貴榮華莫與京。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675037184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有貴人兼帶合，定知金殿玉階行。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675053568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神煞自得長生，年頭納音又隨神煞同長生，在於日時，謂之真長生，又謂之生處逢生，如壬寅見辛。己乙酉見甲申之類，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡是有權須帶煞，權星須用煞相扶。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675069952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行俱善無權煞，卽得權星命又。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675086336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675102720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"造物不能雨全，所以神煞主權，又不免刑尅多孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"座亡神性樸宻，兩座亡神須决脊。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675102720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三座亡神生不","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675119104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098192155279423"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生，狴犴不亡終惡疾，","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675119104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亡神重於刼煞，以■過也。如王子、丁不、辛亥、己亥，兩重亡神，决配貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一重刼煞福胚胎。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675119104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩重刑法盜資財，三重凶狠人頑惡，生不生兮命惡推。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675135488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刼一重若帶貴，或自生旺，主發達，縱尅我亦無害。若三重协絕無氣，必是賊徒，主惡𣦹，如辛丑丁酒。乙未、戊寅，犯官司，後大發，如辛田。戊戌、丁亥、壬寅，讀書及第，改官就禄，丁亥合起貴人故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有煞方能始煞財，我尅他時是福媒，煞自受降財自至，不須禄馬貴人來。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675151872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人命有亡、刼二煞始能然。財大要我去尅煞爲吉，煞來施我爲禍。若甲子見己巳福，見乙巳貧之類。是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098249398911003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡說貴人能壓煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675168256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡刼多時依舊貧，自衰竊氣難慿貴，煞㐫貴善又無功。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675184640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛亥、庚寅，甲申、丙寅，縁亥寅六合，合起吞啖，亡刼爲卤，故生修讀竟，中風不第，若無貴人，决然。惡𣦸。又己巳壬申、甲寅壬申，剌配吏也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行不用多神煞，刼煞臨官須早發，煞自爲權三兩重。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675201024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"撈瘵身亡兼骨熱，重逢帝旺亦如然。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675217408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七傷五勞下九泉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675233792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生刼重重人早𣦸，臨官帝旺尚遲延。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675250176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛未、辛丑、壬申、戊申，早發而嘔血癆病。甲戌、庚午、戊辰、戊午，亦病纒身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月逄德禍必輕，煞來尅我也無迍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675266560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時亡刼貪盃","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675282944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097981039132712"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酌，只喜長生及貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675282944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日時帶亡切全者，主貪酒色成疾，只宜藝術。九流。月日逄天月德，縱有禍亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申己亥若逄全，長生不遇命難延。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675299328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謀高膽大終遭辱，結果應無莫怨天。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675315712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如韓平原壬用辛亥、己巳、丙寅，如此大貴，不免斬首，常人必無結果。又禇冲夷翰林命，甲历丙寅壬午辛亥丁日，胎，辛巳年被禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼孤二煞怕同辰，隔角雙來便見迍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675332096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑合見寅辰見巳，戌人逄亥未逄申。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675348480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初年必主家豪富，中主賣田刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675364864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及身。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675381248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喪子丧妻還尅父，日時闘奏不由人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675397632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑見寅爲例，謂之刼帶孤辰，主刑尅孤貧，僧道九流人，庻幾一命。癸未庚申、丙申己亥，中年退散喪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098025528033299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身違配一命，己未壬申，又見申時，却有貴人不妨，但刑尅父母無子。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675414016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼孤帶貴長生兼，便主威權福壽全。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675430400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不長生逄貴氣，也應白手置庄田。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675446784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛丑見丁亥、壬寅者，爲官，見戊寅，先犯官司，後富。縁丁亥是臨官，又合貴力重故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古老三命分強弱，刼煞亡神最㐫惡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675463168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聚衆攻身大不祥，不食卽夭塡溝壑，","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675479552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"聚衆乃亡刼回、八寡、隔角、破田破宅、大耗懸針等類，如己卯見庚申，癸卯見丙申，尤是縁勉主也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神刼煞不宜全，莫敎得黨尅生年。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675479552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羅紋不戰也㐫惡，生𣦹榮枯在目前。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675495936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如癸酉、辛酉、壬寅、壬宙，被牛觸山旨，病五日而後𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098249398943771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡是㐫神莫尅年，尅年便主禍連綿。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675512320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞神各自分輕重，我尅他兮煞變權。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675528704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㐫神惡煞宜尅山，吉神貴人宜尅入。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大富大貴慿煞權，煞宜居後主宜先。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675545088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"单逄亡刼天元秀，定亂安邦作大賢。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675561472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如一命癸酉、庚申、丙子丙申，酉爲主在前，申為煞在後，庚申煞受制，丙申鬼病金旺，所以大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最㐫卯酉見寅申，卯見申兮煞帶針。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675577856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破宅破田併大耗，離居離祖更孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675594240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全見寅申必破家，平生造屋愛奢華。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675610624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"設居富貴應無久，祖業非官火炬花。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675627008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097989008293938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命宅禄宅不宜同亡刼，卯酉生人不宜見寅申，謂之破宅煞。若亡刼、懸針、大耗、隔寡在其上，見全寅。申者愛造屋費，若非官司抄没，必主燒毁，先富後貧。如乙酉、癸未、庚寅、甲申，女命纔嫁夫，火燒其屋。因訟賣盡田園而離祖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午生人一例推，己亥那堪在日時。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675643392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅主更𭒡他有黨，耗財破產决無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675659776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如戊午、癸亥、癸巳、甲寅文，甲寅胎，是煞得黨，三次投軍，後作丐者。戊午、癸亥、癸巳、丁巳，一士制二水。火復臨官，富足而孤離祖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上宫亡刼主刑妻，破碎臨官一例推。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675676160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅後依前婚室女，千生音助歲必低。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675692544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日爲上官，時爲帝座，如見亡刼大敗、臨官帝旺，皆主尅妻。天十助生納音又生，主冉婚室女，不然，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098025528082451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以妾爲妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人禄馬上宫加，妻必賢能内克家。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675708928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有食神兼帶合，腰如楊柳百如花。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675725312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上宫見禄馬，或貴人食神，必主妻賢内𦔳，更𠔥六合合起，主得貌美成家之妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡刼孤寡凑同辰，六親尅害必然真。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675741696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日上逄之妻愚樸，時上逄之子未真。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675758080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更與三刑同位到，若非僧道主孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675774464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亡刼本孤，更值孤寡，三刑同位，决然難爲。六親日上尅妻，時上尅子，必然妻愚子國。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡處公門休帶煞，若逄亡刼便遭刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675790848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"計孛火羅臨四正，千里徒流枉喪身。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675807232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098249398976539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡處八門，不宜見亡刼、日時全見，必主配𣦹。如隔見有合，亦主徒流。更火、羅、計、孛守四正者，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬嫵衝宜六合，煞神忌合喜刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675823616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞神遇合爲匃煞，禄馬刑衝吉反㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675840000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲子、乙亥、己亥、己巳，是合煞被人殺。以如己亥、丙寅、甲寅、庚左、甲寅與己亥爲雙合，若更剋身，則早以今却不尅五十二歲坐獄而來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"单逄刼煞或亡神，間有咸池及貴神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675856384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醫卜巫師或牙㑹，隨縁度日免孤刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675872768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日時单見一位，户刼，無貴人，生壯而逄从絶之地，主貪盃好色，術藝、人力可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囘頭破碎煞非隹，煞反朝元禍不賒。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675889152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉丑兩宫攅煞轉，孤尅重重壽不遐。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675905536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098025528131603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酒命人見寅、申口、亥日時，丑命人見辰、戊丑、未曰時，謂之囘頭破碎，主狹星命。天受■者，不滿三十。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉若逄蛇，受氣長生必拜府，煞神以絶租欑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675921920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聚宜作屠行賣肉家，","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675938304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如命庚子、壬午、辛巳、辛卯，自中𫷭拜麻，面又出之，縁煞氣太重，如己卯、丁卯、乙卯、辛巳，殺𢔪屠户。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㑓魚犨女主雙生。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675938304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命人寅申孛計侵，男女兩途逢朔望，望𨓺一子一爲隂。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675954688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑隔角更空亡，華葢重併主過房。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675971072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必是䨇生或庻出，不然重拜兩命娘。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080675987456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳爲䨇女，亥爲雙魚，以蛇有两頭，魚有比目，故名。命帶己亥，寅、申戌立命，反火、羅、計、孛坐命，華益併。於空亡三刑孤隔，多是䨇生，不然庻出過房，或克害殳母兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098306550448169"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䨇辰一煞最刑傷，干帶同干支帶䨇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676003840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六害倂逢亡刼煞，叢林之内禮空王。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676020224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重拜偏生倂寄養，男當鰥寡女居孀。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676036608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只爲重犯雙辰煞，更有平頭二例詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676052992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"䨇辰者，于支两位是也，多主孤尅。如癸亥、癸亥、丙申、丙申，謂之亡刼，皴辰煞，是二長老，如乙亥、丁亥。己卯、丁卯，是一奴婢。如己亥、乙亥、丁酒巳西，是一𨓺房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寡宿孤辰不可當，犯全送老没兒即。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676069376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"共活却宜三两姓，好爲僧道守空房。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676085760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合空合刃合咸池，空土聰明刃狼愚。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676102144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合刃羅絞身惡效，官刑若免主顚痴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676118528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有大六合小六合，大三合、小，三合華葢、𧰤合单，內合外、合合順合反合合空亡、三入奸巧、合羊刃、更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098306550464553"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"羅紋重叠互換，主惡𣦸。如乙酉、庚辰、庚辰、乙酉，非犯法徒刑，必破相有疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池不合也風流，合起奸滛老不羞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676134912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有合更𠔥來尅我，腸風消渴病爲仇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676151296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池主腸風，干尅及納音尅，主消渴。如庚辰、己丑、辛巳、丁酉，一生最滛，以己酉丑三合合起桃花也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干頭帶合力還輕，三合應須辨淺深。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676167680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順合也還觀反合，吉㐫禍福要詳明。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676184064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如天干合，地支不合，爲单合。戌命人時日見寅午，為反合，禍福一般斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡刼不宜眞六合，有合還宜有貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676200448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不遇貴人𠔥尅主，他不殺人人殺身。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676216832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亡刼切不宜合，亦不宜尅主。如壬戌、癸卯、己亥、己巳，雖不合，却有己之陰士尅壬之陽水，地支逄衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098302385504290"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"故主大㐫。又己壬申，天干地支六合合起巳刑申，酒色破家。一女命，壬申年見己巳日爲娼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合貴之中更帶官，少年平步上雲端。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676233216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合禄干頭𠔥得祿，三宫釣起福人看。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676249600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辛未巳亥、丙午戊戌，謂之合貴，又謂合官，少年請舉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676265984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辛未、辛丑、甲午丙寅，早年入仕，縁爲丙寅勝也。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676282368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人尅入最爲佳，禄馬如斯皆可誇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676298752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"微尅更𠔥逄六合，管敎富貴享榮華。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676315136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡貴人禄馬宜尅我，謂之尅入，有尅而又帶合，斯至妙矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676331520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于午卯酉四宫互換神煞咸池四位五行中，徧野桃花聞嫰紅。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676347904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女遇之皆酒","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676364288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097989008310322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色，爲其嬌艶美春風。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080676364288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉占中天，咸池羊刃煞相連。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687325236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田庚壬丙人相遇，慷慨風流醉管絃。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687341620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡是咸池多性巧，更主風流貌比華。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687358004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性急又𠔥多業藝，是非林裏反成家。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687374388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池三煞號𤎉貞，逄水妖嬈主亂滛。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687390772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沐浴進神仍見貴，必敎傾國與傾城。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687407156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池煞，乃天之廉貞星也。凡命遇之，最不宜見水，主好滛。如更在沐浴之郷，逢進神，傾國傾城貌也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒揷桃花色更鮮，日時月裏反朝年。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687423540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風流倜儻人奸妬，性巧聰明賢不賢。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687439924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098297595609124"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如卯人見寅午戌月日時，酉人見申子辰月日時，反朝於年，謂之倒揷桃花。王人性巧，聰明，性急，不能容与，多賢淑而有不賢處也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錯亂咸池藝術人，休囚帶鬼最爲真。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687456308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡生旺心偏巧，能武能文罵鬼神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687472692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池主藝術，如在莊宫，必術藝精奇高秀之士。如空曰：帶鬼無氣，𣦸絕必村巫或粗工。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃咸池在曰時，心靈性巧事多知。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687489076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺宮性𢚩敗宮緩，宿疾風流兼有之。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687505460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如用戌人見明，謂之咸池羊刃，又庚申見酒，庚辰見酒之類，主人多學多能，未免帶疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池爲性本邪滛，申子辰逄癸酒金。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687521844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子水人情色重，恐躭花酒病傷心。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687538228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098025528180755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時日咸池三兩重，名爲歲煞反招匈。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687554612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暴亡水火離卿威，咀呪瘟黄不善終。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687570996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歳煞者，卽咸池，在日時，主父惡威，屬火主火處，屬水，主水𣦹，屬士主藴庻，屬木主打以，屬金主刃𣦸。各以五行推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日上咸池帶壯神，陰錯陽差華葢并。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687587380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻家惹禍無裝醜，若不刑離誘外人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687603764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"託日上咸池，更有陰錯陽差，華葢破碎字，其上皆主妻不■，因妻稷醜受辱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人天上號文星，互換年時福氣深。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687620148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱羅紋重叠見，重逄生莊侍楓宸。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687636532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天乙貴，乃天上至尊星也，若年與時上互換見之則吉，更得生旺有氣爲上。如丙申、己亥、辛未、己亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097948180906018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛巳、丙午、壬寅，俱互換見貴，前命有氣，爲■相，後人爲大守。又蘇東玻學士，丙于辛王癸亥己卯水臨官於亥，大抵五行，第一貴者，福氣爲官，併根互換貴人；第二貴者，權煞爲官，不可拜相。第三貴者，秀氣而己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人六合有陰陽，陰貴逄陽喜異常。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687652916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見羅紋無有氣，少年天府姓名香。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687669300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"羅紋貴人年時互換是也。甲見丑僞陽貴，未爲陰貴，如甲寅、辛未、癸未、戊午，合起陰貴，得女人財力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進神白虎無羊刃，歲煞懸針破碎同。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687685684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誰識陰陽真造化，乾坤感應自相通。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687702068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土午卯酒有四個進神，四個羊刃，四錮白虎、歲煞、咸池將星，兩個懸針破醉，乾坤造化，各主福福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進神不可例言奇，中間妙理有誰知。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687718452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進禄貴官方是","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687734836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098302385520674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，敗家時日進咸池。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687734836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛未見甲子，是進咸池，主孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進針進耗皆無益，羊刃咸池尤不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687751220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"設逢天乙貴人臨，起倒無成貪酒色。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687767604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛未見甲午，是貴而帶懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進神入命本無益，翻作耗神尤不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687783988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄暴敗與咸池，賣盡田園躭酒召，","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687800372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"進神懸針羊刃在日上，主用離𣦸别。三妻之命，在時無子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進神羊刃必遭官。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687800372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日上屢敎歌鼓盆，時上號爲埋子煞，三刑同到入軍門。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687816756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不入軍門身惡殞，遲早須當運","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687833140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097981039198248"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限論。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687833140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"進神羊刃，更帶懸針，暴敗三刑，必主因公得罪，入於軍門，不然惡𣦸，如甲子、庚午、庚午、己卯四十四。歲㐫𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎胎神氣象豪，木人癸酉便聲高。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687849524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更逢羊刃兼飛刃，馬殺時人口似刀。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687865908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅本如逢在日時，娶妻糊塗又刑妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687882292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焦牙爆齒仍多口，方許和鳴福壽齊。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687898676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎煞，卽五行胎神是也，如庚申、庚寅之木，見癸酉日時之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰錯陽差因孝娶，外祖兩重或入贅，不然决要尅其妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687915060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或者殘房來作婿，","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687931444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098306550513705"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽差陰錯不風流，花燭迎郎不自由。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687931444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不是寒房因孝娶，殘房入舎兩家仇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687947828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人逄者亦依然，眞假公姑或續絃。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687964212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"否則有刑多寡合，外家零落是前縁。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687980596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰錯陽差煞最㐫，日時年月莫相逄。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080687996980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孛星若也臨高位，自作媒人兩三重。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688013364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如丁亥、丁未、壬戌、癸卯，頭妻偏生女，半年而𣦸，復娶一妻。如丙子、庚寅、丁丑、丙午，亦娶三妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰錯陽差理更微，桃花帝旺莫相隨。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688029748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惹起官司因婦女，不因外祖便因妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688046132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡錯差㑹，桃花煞在帝旺之位，准上文。如庚午、己丑、辛𫑗、戊子三次招女人官司，如辛亥、壬辰、辛酒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097981039181864"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰，因女人官司破家，如癸亥、戊午、丙子、己亥，因女人起事，其驗如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時羊刃貼身隨，必主生離以别妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688062516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"互換懸針攅一處，駝腰狗背免流笞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688078900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女子逄之必天傷，投河自縊𣗳頭亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688095284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逄天月德來救，免得凌尸威血光。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688111668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日時羊刃主剋妻，若來尅身，主生離一妻𣦸二。如丙午生妻，見用午之類，爲贴身。年月日之刃聚於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時或三處刃聚於日，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688128052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙寅丙申壬午戊，","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688144436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲十八割頸乂女命丙寅甲午丁庚煞，雖亥免，午爲有日，自縊凌口却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"早生産𣦸，終見血光。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688144436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古言羊刃只宜男，不怒而威性不𡭔。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688160820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寛摽剛無人梗槩，官敎富貴享安康。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688177204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098306550530089"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如一命庚戌、乙酉、乙酒、乙酉，帶三重旺氣，羊刃不併，華葢、咸池、懸針之類，主有權，作從化得局看所。以大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狼飡鯨飮是如何，羊刃重重亡刼多。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688193588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"計孛火羅臨四正，只圖醉飽任風波。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688209972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四正十午耶酉是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞無多不易論，看他攅聚看他分。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688226356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分開禍福皆分散，聚煞攅㐫命不存。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688242740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲戊、丁卯、癸𫑗、丁巳，一生富足無子，謂之分散；不合太多，壽不滿五十。加丙寅、𡈼辰，因于甲午，謂之攅㐫聚煞，貧賤早天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日中羊刃兼華葢，只利妻先嫁一人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688259124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卒急寒房方免","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688275508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098302385487906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍，貌如太美便風瑴。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688275508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六巳生人見未口，若己亥、巳𫑗巳未人得之，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞神最喜落空亡，㐫煞空亡大吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688291892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬贵人還减福，如逢相衝另三詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688308276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡生旺必聰明，𣦸絕嘍羅語不真。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688324660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犯盡空亡空裏發，空門藝術九流人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688341044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"空亡遇相衝則不空，宜生旺，忌𣦸絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人禄馬事非虛，神煞權高首位居。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688357428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬煞神如得貴，禹門汲浪化龍魚。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688373812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人禄馬在句中，不帶空亡不帶衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688390196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自旺自生𠔥帶","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688406580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097989008375858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，桃花浪裏變魚龍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688406580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚𣦸絕均無益，衝擊空亡皆减力。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688422964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任是侯門將相見，只可隨縁度終日。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688439348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙申、己亥、辛未、己亥，是貴人，上帶長生，又煞在旬内，所以大貴。如己亥夷作庚午、壬午，祿太多，而逄𣦸絕，所以爲道人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乍月日時共一旬，還同兄弟三家人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688455732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若兼禄馬同旬内，金㮄揚名顯二親。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688472116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行四柱皆在本旬，遇禄馬官貴則言，遇羊刃破碎，則内秀而不實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲人性快是如何？","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688488500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺臨官馬更多。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688504884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"待物接人多慷慨，咸池疎爽更𭧖羅。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688521268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098297595658276"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾絞三刑亡刼併，爲人狡猾更沉吟，日時年月如重見，内藴機關似海深。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688537652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲申生見乙亥、辛巳之類，主人奸巧，作事多詐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平頭二路占天干，羊刃懸針煞闘攅。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688554036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相尅相衝無在氣，披毛帶角畜生看。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688570420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天干一路是平頭煞，如丙干、丁未之類，地支重叠帶羊刃、懸針聚一位，傷主命，必傷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872379670569/1-3aec2174becb5f15.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=No1H%2BqpBWGCYGtxsDtjdc1CaKZs%3D","uri":"read/HY2705/17/ref/1ktleuilxgqor/1-3aec2174becb5f15.webp","fontType":1,"components":"戈𢆶夕","variants":"幾","charPicId":"7456690872379670569"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不然，畜生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊庚多者定披毛，重叠元辰命不牢。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688586804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"計孛火羅如守照，馬羊猪犬數難逃。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688603188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱刑胎父必傷，當於母腹便身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688619572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊庚隔角平頭煞，背指青天壽不長。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688635956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1831","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098201462145074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1832","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡四柱刑胎者，早尅父，不吉。更有幅角平頭，三刑空亡，五行無氣，多是畜生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未四宮互換神煞辰戌丑未爲四印，戊己得之偏主信，甲乙若逄鄙且貪，丙丁或遇多貧病，庚辛格號母生兒，聚煞丑宫多短命。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688652340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊巳屬土，遇四印爲本宫，主信。甲乙逄之，爲財，財己入庫，主人貪鄙。丙丁得之，竊氣，不貧，則天庚辛。爲子歸母腹，或四位不全，在𣦸絕之地，主人勾絞使術數，或聚煞丑宮，多天折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天罡大煞占辰宮，大吉原來在丑中。","logicSentenceId":"757733008068866872
