4","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小吉煞常居未上，河魁在戌定其踪。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688685108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知四柱四般煞，難定浮生吉與㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688701492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1838","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098297595691044"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1839","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人命辰戌丑未全，更有别煞，主孤尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱四衝皆有刃，三刑華葢一般同。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688717876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄丑未干頭貴，金谷園中富貴翁。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688734260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1842","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戊丑未四位，華葢、羊刃、飛刃、墓庫、三刑，若全帶妒，甲辰、甲戌、卒未、巳丑之類，未有不享福者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌重見戌未見未，丑重見丑辰見辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688750644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上叠逄華葢煞，男女空亡寂寞春。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688767028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有羅火孛與氣，若臨身命一般論。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688783412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢清閑藝術人，休囚生旺兩般論。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688799796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文章醫卜兼師術，九流僧道日時真。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688816180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1848","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"華葢喜於自墓及相生，乃可亨清困之福。否則僧道九流，如庚辰之類，不能自莫，見是忖巫粗藝人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1849","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098201462161458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢咸池𠔥帶鬼，不爲巧匠便爲師。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688832564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼少五行兼有氣，不頂黃冠便着緇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688848948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓庫逄華福壽基，六親孤尅似華夷。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688865332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰妻時子分輕重，官不封侯定可知。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688881716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1854","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲戊、甲戍、己未、甲戌，是墓庫逄華葢，主享福眉壽，未免尅父毋，刑妻子。尅我者重，合我者輕，爲官。不至封侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前言丑位怕逄寅，戌人嫌亥未嫌申。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688898100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰人嫌巳爲孤刼，禄貴臨兹是福神。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688914484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1857","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刼、孤二煞更帶長生，逄貴祿尤好。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土旺辰戌并丑未，凡命逄之多性執。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688930868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛刃三刑同位","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688947252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1860","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098297595707428"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見，性惡性剛無性急。","logicSentenceId":"7577330080688947252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀之外貌似温和，怒髪衝冠柰觸何。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291304994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不刑妻併尅子，因親氣血不調和。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291321378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1864","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌丑未屬土，所以性執不拘。单逢雙逄，但有羊刃、飛刃，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃四宮三兩重，首聾瘖瘂或腹風。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291337762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑同位來傷主，不配應當不善終。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291354146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1867","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"既多羊刃，又有三刑，同來傷主，不但刑妻子，且不善終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛刃比和便主權，爲人公議寡於言。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291370530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛方正大多欽仰，聲勢肥家遠近傳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291386914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1870","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如帶羊刃，不要尅我，仍不要他旺在強地，他弱則隆我爲福，他強我弱則𩈮。如甲寅水見辛卯木之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1871","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098302385537058"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1872","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶來飛刃并三刑，㐫狼強梁不可親。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291403298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好殺好欺仍好武，只宜他敗我生成。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291419682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑尅重重好𨓺房，古言辰戌是魁罡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291436066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破祖離家方吉利，只宜藝術與牙郞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291452450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1877","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰爲天正，又爲地網，戌爲大魁，又爲天羅，辰戌日時，末有不孤者也。中未年只宜守己，如相尅，只宜。藝術空門人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰能合酉酉衝卯，辰卯之中六害生；末來合午午衝子，子未之中一般情。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291468834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不是迵房隨母嫁，或爲僧道或孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291485218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1880","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098297595723812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1881","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上名暗六害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行鬼煞看輸嬴，闘戰伏降分重輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291501602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他弱我強還得福，鬼強我弱便爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291517986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼多只利術醫卜，空裏營謀事事成。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291534370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼占強宮居旺地，洛陽花發又殘春。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291550754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1886","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼煞皆不尅身，及占強宫，要分戰闘伏降。如鬼多，只宜九流敗官鬼多，身居強位，纔發又不如意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無鬼不能成造化，無煞安能身有權。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291567138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只怕鬼多兼煞衆，㐫多吉少便爲愆。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291583522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼強不可例言㐫，鬼伏他家受制功格曰：伏降神内保，恭謙富貴福興隆。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291599906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1890","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴人祿馬主温和，神煞主猛烈，命中無鬼，不成造化，無煞不成懽柄，但恐多則分秀氣，不爲吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1891","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098249399042075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他來尅我我居强，我占強宫又不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291616290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼敗本強身富貴，名高仍目壽延長。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291632674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母生子廣母當虛，母占強宫又不虞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291649058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母旺子衰分四季，九重城𫟚任安居。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291665442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1896","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如金人見土爲母，見水爲子，如庚戌、乙酉、乙西、乙酉、丙子胎，是金生四水，母生子廣，却喜于衰母旺。而不爲害。况金生八月，是得令之秋，煞不得地而身得地，子不能𥨸母之氣，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母分四季産嬰孩，子旺強官母却衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291681826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏月木人逢火旺，家徒四壁免㐫災。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291698210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1899","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡上生於下，乃脱氣不吉，如木命逄戊午之類。况是夏月火復得時，乃子旺母衰，不貧則夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隔角三刑尅害多，直須離祖號行窠。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291714594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自爲自立方奇","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291730978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1902","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097948180971554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"特，骨肉仍敎内不和。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291730978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身體髪膚因父母，賢哲保身無毁傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291747362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進退存亡能覺悟，吉人㐫變作禎祥。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291763746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1906","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"右十二宫神煞，古人所重，然必以主本旺相休囚，五行生尅制化，本之以財官印食，𠫭之以責人禄。馬，然後看神煞輕重較量可也。若專論神煞，則誣矣。故取應天歌以爲三命之一𦔳云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戰闘伏降刑衝破合，戰闘爲祥力兩停。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291780130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩邉相制始爲榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291796514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻相稱仍和顧，平歩青雲萬里程。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291812898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知戰闘福千鈞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291829282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱相停力不分。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291845666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沙漠宣威聲萬里，詞塲筆陣掃千軍。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291862050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1913","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443097948181020706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1914","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此戰闘爲福格也。凡五行不戰則體常爲主，遇戰闘則迭爲賔主。己巳癸酒，庚寅、辛巳，大林木惧癸。酉劒金日爲主，主乃庚寅旺木，曰巳林木，依附庚寅，自立爲主，癸酉勢孤，不能敵也。又有辛巳金爲之輔主自立爲主。己巳主弱而疾，寅強，癸酉金剛，辛巳又弱，強弱相等，兩邉力停。我尅者，爲夫受尅。者爲妻。夫妻剛柔相濟，所以戰闘之中反得福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行遇戰主多更，相對相衝便闘争。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291878434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闘若不嬴翻作禍，力停須看兩相登。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291894818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑衝戰闘論輸嬴，四柱偏頗力不停。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291911202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚腹有災防溺水，鼠牙莫近恐遭刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291927586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1919","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此戰闘爲禍格也。一命壬午、己酉、己巳壬申，楊木生秋月，白帝司權，金得勝之時，木極衰弱。己申𮠕皆佥局。况壬申金得士以滋其勢，己巳又合起壬中，爲禍傷身，故三十八歲濟水而成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1920","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098201462210610"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上宮刑月月刑年，鬼在休囚勢自偏。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291943970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝座若還仍尅曰，逓相闗鎻福滔天。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291960354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1923","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此伏降爲福格也。如乙巳、甲申、乙酉、己卯、乙酉敗水生於甲申，而尅乙巳之火，火却不得其位而水。反勝鬼得其黨，謂之鬼嘯。却喜己卯土先破乙酒水，復制甲申，互換相制，不能爲禍，反爲吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏降爲福下刑年，帝座居強獨主權。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291976738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心廣體胖膺百福，子孫榮貴慶雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081291993122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1926","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲子、丙寅、甲申、辛未，是土制水，水制火，火制金，皆反爲福，必主簪纓累代、福壽人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼來攻我鬼居強，我弱之時勢莫當。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292009506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼煞兩般俱有氣，不空有合最爲殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292025890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼逄專旺擅強梁，身弱名爲我反降。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292042274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇空亡應免","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292058658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1931","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098100987592719"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍，如無援救命難長。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292058658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1933","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此伏降爲禍格也。如一命辛未、辛卯、辛卯、己亥，鬼在強宫，却喜甲申旬金空亡，故雖不能富貴亦無。災禍未滿，五十而𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母被鬼傷子來救，子報母𡨚排左右。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292075042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破其鬼賊衝其刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292091426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破鬼衝刑爲福壽，","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292107810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1937","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此衝破爲福格也。如戊午、癸亥、癸巳、丁巳、癸巳之絶水，歸於癸亥，冬月水勝之時，而尅戊午無氣之火况巳爲破禄，亥爲破宅，合主貧賤。今喜丁巳土就身尅，退癸巳衝破癸亥，乃子來救母，一生富足。人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼煞來刑要帶衝，交相衝破却爲功。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292107810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文章獨歩誇王粲，富貴雙全比石崇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292124194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1940","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098306550579241"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1941","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如乙亥、乙酉、癸巳、癸亥，衝破其鬼，反爲福，一生富而好禮，名冠鄉聞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破其禄馬破其庫，破了吉神無救𦔳，神煞相殘破宅同。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292140578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作丐人間無限數，墓庫中爲禄馬殘，更衝命宅三般般。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292156962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無吉曜居強正，活計猶如一范丹。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292173346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1945","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此衝破爲禍格也。如鬼尅我，謂之傷殘吉神，格無救取。如戊作癸亥，與己甲寅又甲寅胎，三水歸依。癸亥而尅戊午之火，破丁禄宅，命宅乃溝壑亡神，醫桑刼欿三欠投軍後作丐餓而𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑煞落空兼有制，刑不入身為福㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292189730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同宮相制主得援。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292206114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得援附主爲祥瑞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292222498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1949","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此制刑爲福格也。如甲子、甲戊、田寅、丁卯、甲戌鬼落空亡，吞吹寡宿空亡，甲寅水尅退丁卯之火，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1950","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098201462226994"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1951","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"敢傷甲子之金，乃主得其援，反爲福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制刑得援要空亡，不尅身兮福禄昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292238882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金玉滿堂人富貴，心年高折桂枝香。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292255266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1954","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚寅、癸未、壬戌、乙巳、甲戌，胎甲戌、壬戌同宫，水火相争，又喜甲戌歸於乙巳，不能刑於癸未、壬戌。勢孤，刑而不入，故主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戰闘刑衝爲大敵，敵得勝時方是吉，投身如在鬼賊中。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292271650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"横來家亡刑憲及，","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292288034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1957","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此惹刑爲禍格也。如辛酒、辛丑、癸酒、壬子、癸酉、辛酒，同宫戰闘，刑於本身，就家降鬼，爲鬼所制，被人。殺𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惹刑爲禍最非良。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292288034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"停力同宫盡闘傷，身若就降降鬼","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292304418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1960","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098100987609103"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賊，難逃家破更身亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292304418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1962","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"力停者，二位不能刑二三位刑一位，乃眞刑也。如辛酉、辛丑、己丑、乙丑，得巳丑之火，以救其禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十般六合少人知，自古神仙不泄機。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292320802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬貴人旬内合，合中添福福無涯。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292337186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1965","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此六合爲福格也。十般六合，己觧前。如甲寅、辛未、癸未、戊午，此爲小六合，合起貴人，而得陰人之𦔳。致富貴福壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合爲祥一例推，合中増損爲咸池。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292353570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功名擬向爲霖用，不謂雲行雨不施。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292369954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1968","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如眞得秀，戊戌、壬戌、壬申、癸卯，金不能勝，而木反勝，合中不喜咸池増損，又且尅身，咸池雖人聰明。畢竟是减福。又壬申傷木，柱無士救，是爲合中減福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1969","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098306550612009"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合來神煞便爲㐫，神煞如何三様同。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292386338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各煞各宫專禍福，鬼神催使不由人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292402722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1972","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此六合爲禍格也。如己亥、丙寅、甲寅、辛未，甲與己合，寅與亥合，合起亡神，吞𡹖孤辰，故主枉以於獄。平日喜訟之迴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合爲災不可當，官符亡刼三般詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292419106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迷花戀酒并籠養，好訟終身桎梏亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292435490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1975","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"加庚子、丙戌、乙酉、丁亥，合咸池、羊刃，平日不如人，而好武，好籠養，歌舞酒色，三十一坐獄。贞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺旺中生福慧，旺裏反宜鬼相制。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292451874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得制方爲福壽人，一重方可爲祥瑞。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292468258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1978","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此生旺爲福格也。如甲寅、癸酉、壬戌庚子，其父爲太平宰相，可謂腹中藏貴煞，胎裏呌官人。是生阳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1979","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098249399058459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1980","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中得鬼制是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生㽵爲祥在曰時，鬼來制御却相宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292484642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花直透三層浪，桂子高攀第二枝。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292501026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1983","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如乙酉、乙酒、壬辰、庚子，然庚子土自旺，又帶鬼尅身相制，是生旺鬼制之福，故主早年登第。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行生旺不宜多，三兩重逄禍必過。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292517410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺裏若還無制御，傳尸撈瘵面閻羅。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292533794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1986","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此生旺爲禍格也。如丁亥、辛亥、己亥、甲子，同宫戰闘，非惟貧賤，又且脛瘵，十六歳威","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生帝旺見重重，變福爲災反不中。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292550178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得鬼制他方减禍，縱饒富貴也招㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292566562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1989","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如巳未、辛亥、甲午、辛未，是少年廸功郞出身，未改官而亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1990","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098306550661161"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處中得母絶逄生，富貴榮華别様新。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292582946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亷簡直温無燥暴，朱衣元是黒頭人。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292599330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1993","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此𣦸絕僞福格也。如金人見戊寅爲絕處逢生，見庚子爲威中得母，見庚午爲敗中有救，皆僞福矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人言來絕最爲㐫，起來爲生福反崇。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292615714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深畧沉機人謹重，康寕福壽足盈豐。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292632098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1996","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命來中得母，絕處逢生，敗中有救，主人沉機謹厚，而享大福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以絶那堪鬼更傷，鬼居強位豈能當。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292648482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還禄宅皆衝破，失業亡家成異卿。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292664866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1999","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此來絶爲禍格也。如己亥、庚午、庚午、壬午，非惟木來於午，而禄𣦸於午，賣盡田園，小於道路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"从絶重重鬼更逢，禄宫命宅併刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292681250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還四正無吉","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292697634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2002","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098100987641871"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曜，定主伶仃别祖宗。","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292697634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2004","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如戊午、壬戎，癸亥、癸亥，非惟火絶在亥，而且破命宅祿宅忘，是離祖人也。干支戰闘，降伏刑衝破合乃神煞中之最要者，故併反之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通會卷之三終","logicSentenceId":"7577330081292714018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2006","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098201462259762"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2007","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098306550693929"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木屬陽，乃棟鿄之材，喜生秋冬，遇申子月爲吉，柱見庚辛，譬斧鑿之論，主名利。","logicSentenceId":"7585511910755303474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行申酉辰戌丑末鄉，大能發越，見辛官尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636463625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌寅午戌合局，及透丁火傷官，乃辛苦勞力，作事無成之命，運逢亦不順。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636480009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若合局丁透，柱有辰戌丑未，干上露戊巳，再行財運，傷官生財，却發大福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636496393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木屬陰，爲生氣之木，遇春生而花葉茂盛，亦喜生航","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636512777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098302385602594"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於小春之令。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636512777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄亥卯未、申子辰二局，更行北運，雖透丙丁庚辛亦不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636529161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所忌寅午戌火，己酉丑金多傷殘，再行南運，主夭無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636545545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636561929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙貴乎木得宜，曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春從南徃秋歸北。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636561929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"要知金水旺爲奇，冬夏西行發福基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日生人，身坐巳門丑申戌金鄉，運行宜土金分野。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636578313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生寅卯辰，不結木局，宜時引歸士金分野大貴，行運亦然，則官長逺。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636594697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生己酉丑申月時，引歸亥卯未寅取貴，非此時者，乃過與不及，却要運行水木局分野，否則貧儒。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636611081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中原有財星，怕比刼分奪，原無則","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636627465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098100987691023"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用不畏。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636627465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如木得金而成器，仁者有男；金得木而成材，勇者必仁。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636643849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是乃剛柔相濟，陰陽相停，運行却喜財官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636660233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有木無金，則庚辛𧇊而義寡；有金無火，卽勇而無禮則亂。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636676617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金太盛而無水則枯，木太多而無金則繁，是金木各不一也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636693001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏陰偏陽，難名之命，縱遇財官，亦不發達。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636709385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲日詩日：建禄於寅是旺鄉，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636725769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅上甲木坐禄，金絶土𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官兩背見辛未時，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636725769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"取貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋臨傳送鬼刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636725769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂申中甲絶庚爲煞，秋生鬼旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌中坐禄心懷善，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636742153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌中辛有餘氣，戊士正位，身坐財官，身被火焚心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多懐","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636742153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"善見丙寅時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，辰位藏財性亦良。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636742153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰中戊巳入慕身，坐財庫，水氣發生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性多善，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636758537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"良見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅時，遣千喜己財，天有赦溩幄底匕，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636758537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098100987674639"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午中己土建旺，丁火傷官，有財無官，夏生僞天赦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子雖沐浴日無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636758537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木子上雖沐。浴子中癸禄旺，坐生氣印綬，冬生僞天赦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有吉爲㐫㐫爲吉，更看天時好細詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636774921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲曰：用辛爲正官，庚爲偏官，戊巳爲財，如年月時中透出戊巳辛字，生三秋四季及金土局，財官有用；如不透此三字，只生三秋四季及金士局，亦作財官論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636791305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見甲乙奪財，丙丁傷官，名利艱難。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636807689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生春夏及火木局，財官無氣，雖得滋𦔳，名利亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636824073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行西方四季，金土分野向宫臨財之運，不喜東南本火傷官敗財之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636840457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱庚辛俱見，謂之官煞混雜，無去留制伏，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636856841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098297595838500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636856841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如只有庚，不見制伏，當作鬼論，分身鬼強弱，定其吉㐫壽天。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636873225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若制伏得中，作偏宫論，太過反不爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636889609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看日干於所生月内有力無力、有𦔳無𦔳，分節氣淺深輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636905993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行身旺鬼衰運，忌身衰鬼旺運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636922377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六乙日詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𫑗宫得地禄榮昌，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636938761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𫑗上金絕土𣦸，乙不坐禄，財官無氣，庚辰時主貴。或。類作木局，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未上逄財是正鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636938761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未上乙木本局有己土爲財，丁火傷官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥内壬居不失，局","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636955145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥上乙木𣦸，喜壬莊爲生氣印綬，不丑失木，局見丙子王午用申時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官庫從夫古，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636955145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑金局從夫，化金爲福，身坐財官偏印爲丑中有己士辛金癸小餘氣故。也已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上金宫有化良。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636955145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳爲金局，須化金爲福，但身坐正財，男十尅妻，女主妨夫。見壬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098297595854884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水者輕。更㸔天時併合局，吉㐫禍福細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙曰：用戊爲正財己偏財，庚爲正官，辛偏官，若年月時上透出戊巳庚字，生三秋四季及金士局，財官有用；如不透此三字，生三秋四季及金土局，亦作財官論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636971529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見甲乙奪財，丙傷官，名利艱難。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383636987913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生春夏及火木局，縱有財官無氣，雖得滋𦔳亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637004297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行西方四季，金土分野向宫臨財，忌行火木之地，傷官敗財，怕官煞混雜，有煞無制鬼論，制太過不及，皆不爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637020681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更詳日十，於所生月内有無力助，分輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637037065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜忌同上。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637053449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098297595871268"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁丙火屬陽，乃太陽之正氣，能生萬物，喜生春夏月問，自然成就，精神百倍。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637069833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更遇天月二德，行東方運大妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637086217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖見壬癸水不妨，惟忌戊士透露，减其分數。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637102601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犬運嵗君相犯，官府刑獄，破財䘮服，生於秋冬，更遇夜時，地支再合水局，非僕卽從，一生離别孤獨，貧夭殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637118985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火屬陰，爲凡火，可制萬物，金銀銅鐡，不得丁制，不能成器。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637135369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜生夜間己酉丑月令爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637151753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月逢寅，乃天德印元，更得卯字最好，忌壬癸水，如口生，多尅妻子，遇南方運，剥官退職，行西北方運貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637168137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098306550726697"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁詩日主火爲根，金水二星是福源。日行運若臨西與北，縱然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴不週全。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637168137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁口自坐申子辰亥水位，又引歸金時，如生寅午巳月，爲水火旣濟大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637184521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏五月忌三合火局，火炎水乾；冬子月忌三合水局，水盛火滅，水火相停，斯成旣濟大運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637200905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜金水分野，却忌過與不及，偏陰偏陽，苖而不秀。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637217289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生申子辰亥月，須要寅午戌巳時取貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637233673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非此時者，行木運方好。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637250057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"杏則虛名不貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637266441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六丙月詩日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居寅有秀壽偏長。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637266441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅上金絶水𣦸，財官俱背，丙火長生，獨食神生旺，故。主有壽，見己亥辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卵辛","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637282825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在午刑衝身亦強。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637282825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午上火旺之地，謂之司刃，喜刑衝破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098302385651746"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"害爲午中金敗，癸絶財官俱背，男妨妻，女妨夫。見癸水乙木者申輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上鬼強通月吉，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637299209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申中庚爲財，壬爲煞，身坐財官，見庚寅時貴。癸巳金神化氣貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子中禄旺得時昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637299209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十中","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637315593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有辛生癸旺，身坐財官，見癸巳庚寅時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰臨官庫冬生忌，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637315593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰上身坐官鄉，爲壬癸入。墓庚寅時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌𠊓財鄉夏不良。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637315593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌乃墓地，中有辛金餘氣，身傍財鄉，夏生財官無氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"消息盈虛玄妙理，要精休旺說行藏。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637331977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六丙日用庚辛爲財，癸正官，壬偏官，若年月時中透出庚辛癸字，生秋冬金水局中，財官有用。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637348361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如不透此三字，生秋冬金水局中，亦作財官論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637364745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見丙丁奪財，己爲傷官，名利艱難。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637381129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生九夏四季，火土局中，縱有財官無氣，雖得滋𦔳亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637397513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行西北金水分野，向官臨","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637413897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098297595887652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財之運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637413897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若柱中壬癸俱見官煞混雜，無制反賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637430281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如有壬無癸，不見制，當作鬼論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637446665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要分身鬼強弱，定其吉㐫壽夭，制伏得中，作偏官用太過，反不爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637463049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更詳日干於所生月内，有力無力、有救無救，分節氣淺深輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637479433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行身輕鬼衰之運，忌行身衰鬼旺之，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637495817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894659911743/1-dcf361506e2d322b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Ra2rBjYr%2B6h8BRgVc95VbEyWXqI%3D","uri":"read/HY0707/14/ref/1kob6sxm4ri1x/1-dcf361506e2d322b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"乡卽","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690894659911743"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334383637495817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六丁日詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉上臨財學業精。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637495817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉上丁火，長生學堂，責人身坐財官，見壬寅時，貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥中坐貴向官榮，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637512201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥上日貴，中有壬旺，身坐官鄉，見壬寅時貴。己巳爲金神化氣貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太衝無氣財宫背，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637512201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯山水𣦸金絕，財官俱背無氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小吉迎祥印綬生。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637512201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未中有木餘氣財，官雖背印緩生身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳近火宮身旺相，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637528585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"南方火旺之地，財官受制，謂巳。中丙火奪財，戊士奪官故也，男妨妻，女妨夫，有戊者重，用寅者輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑中金庫禄榮豐。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637528585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098358845014079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑中庚辛入墓，有癸水餘氣，身少財官，見辛亥時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生吉㐫如何定，月氣時中見重輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637544969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六丁曰：用庚辛爲財，壬爲正官，癸爲偏官，若年月時中透出庚辛壬字，生秋冬金水局中，財官有用；如不透此三字，生秋冬金水局，亦作財官論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637561353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見丙丁奪財戊傷宫，名利艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637577737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生九夏四季，火土局中，縱有財官無氣，雖得滋𦔳亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637594121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行西北及金水分野，忌傷官敗財運，怕官煞混雜，有煞無制鬼論，制太過貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637610505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更詳日干於所生月内有無力助，分輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637626889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜忌同上。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637643273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098302385668130"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳戊土屬陽，乃隄岸城墻之土，止能拒水，不能種養萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637659657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡城隄不有刑衝破害，人民得安。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637676041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜甲乙木以煞化印之地，忌行西方運，縱發而當破當憂，要火生扶，嫌水尅制。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637692425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳重犯，名利兩失。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637708809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛庚叠逄，作事進退。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637725193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己土屬陰，爲田地山園之土，可以種養萬物，要刑衝破害，卽耕鑿之論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637741577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜生春夏辰巳之鄉，乃官印之地，更不值傷官損印發福，主爲人好置造，田園豐盈，行東北方運尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637757961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更𠔥亥卯未木，决主富貴，人物穏厚，大寛小急。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637774345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"值辰戌丑未，乃背禄逐馬，及刼財、刑傷破","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637790729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098100987740175"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耗，訟服不一。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637790729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊巳日干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/NA02838/7471665189398511642/1-1742058733670.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0gXz2OpArYvAUv6GB5sxBH3TShk%3D","uri":"read/HY4765/11/ref/1kvb91u0h7mrk/1-1742058733670.webp","fontType":1,"components":"一丨一一㇀丨㇀丿一乚一丨丨","variants":"尋","charPicId":"7482082673238769716"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水木柱中原，有還爲福。詩曰：運臨北野及東方，德潤身兮富潤屋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳日生，坐下亥卯寅位，爲勾陳得位，運行宜水木分野，生亥子月，要引辰戌丑未已午時。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637807113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生辰戌丑未已午月，要引亥子時爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637823497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢土得木而疏通，木頼土而培養，若木重而土少則崩，土重而無木，乃頑濁無用之土。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637839881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日丑年月，西方不吉，南方大顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637856265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六戊日詩日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子坐財鄉亦是祥，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637872649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子中癸旺，自坐財鄉，見乙𫑗時貴。丁巳時爲金神化。氣貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離南有破却輝光，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637872649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊午謂之日刃喜刑衝破害午中無水木財官俱背然南離火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098249399107611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺生四五月，印綬雖破，却有輝光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在於申位，財神莊","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637872649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申上壬生甲絶，有財無官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637872649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生寅宮禄鬼昌，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637889033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅上火生土秀氣鍾無甲木當權，身坐偏官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰上兼財居正位，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637889033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰中壬癸人墓乙木有餘氣，自坐財官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌中依火是專郷。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637889033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌上戊爲魁罡。財官俱背，柱中不見財官僞，上喜身莊，重叠忌刑衝，財官旺。若入别格，年月時中見財官，喜水木分野運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中有用或無用，月令如何要忖量。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637905417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六戊曰除戊戌僞魁正，其財官喜忌，論於日下，其餘戊子、戊午、戊申、戊寅、戊辰五日，用壬癸爲財，乙正官，甲偏官，若年月時中透壬癸，乙字生春冬水木局中，財官有用，不透此三字生春冬及水木局中，亦作財官論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637921801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見戊巳奪財，辛傷官，名利艱難。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637938185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生三秋四季，","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637954569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098201462308914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及金土局，財官無氣，雖得滋𦔳亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637954569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行東北方水木分野，向官臨財之運，忌行四季西方敗財傷官之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637970953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若柱透甲乙，官煞混雜，無制反賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383637987337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無乙有甲無制，當作鬼論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334383638003721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要分身鬼強弱，定其吉卤。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494105960457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽天制伏中和，作偏官用太過，反不爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494105976841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更詳日干於所生月内有力無力、有救無救，分節氣淺深輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494105993225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜身旺鬼衰運，忌身衰鬼莊運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106009609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六己日詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉中財禄兩相背，","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106025993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酒中水敗，木𣦸，財官兩背。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯遇偏官要力停。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106025993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𫑗中乙木專權，身坐偏官須己土，司令得地，方是力停巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位豈能𧇊小信，","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106042377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳中永絶，木病丙旺，財官無氣，印却生身，丙寅時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥中終是得高名。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106042377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥中身坐財官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098201462325298"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主命邂禇扣","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106058761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見丙寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時貴，未臨官庫時通貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106058761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未上有官無財，乃有木無水見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"两寅時貴，丑坐財鄉月𦔳榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106058761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑上有財無官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見丙寅時貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106075145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日用壬癸爲財，甲正乙偏官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106107913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年月時邊壬癸，甲字生春冬水木局，財官有氣，如不透此三字，生春冬水木局，亦作財官論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106124297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見戊巳奪財，庚傷官，名利艱難。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106140681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生三秋四季，及金土局中，縱有財官無氣，雖得滋筯亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106157065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行東北水木分野，忌傷官敗財運，怕官煞混雜，有煞無制鬼論，制太過貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106173449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更詳日干於所生月内有無力𦔳，分輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106189833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜忌同上","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106206217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098383394324521"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106206217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金屬陽，乃金銀銅鐡之類，禀太陽而成，要見丁火。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106222601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制之方能成器。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106238985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如見丙火，遇而不遇，喜行東南火木之運，明亮金得制。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106255369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如值寅卯，臨於甲乙，及己午未官星印元得氣之鄉，皆是發越。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106271753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟居西北方，爲金沉水底，是不能成噐。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106288137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金屬陰，乃水銀、硃砂、赤碧、珍珠之類，秉日精月華秀氣結成，最要金淸水秀，土氣豐厚地方，並西北方運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106304521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如行辰戌巳東南運，五行四柱，不見丁火爲妙，見則不能成其噐，如珠墜爐之喻，秀而不實，尤恐寅午","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106320905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098100987756559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌成局煞旺，要身強，乃當其旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106320905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱有亥卯未，更見丙丁透，行午未運發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106337289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑成金局，爲温厚造化，行東方運，大吉，不宜南。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106353673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛日主號金干木火詩相生福自曰專。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106370057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月時中如㑹合，東西運歩定居官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106386441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛日生，坐下寅午戌，巳火又生寅午戌月，要引金土時貴，秋三月及季冬，或十一月引木火旺時，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106402825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行木火分野，忌過與不及，偏陽偏陰，則苖而不秀。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106419209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若通火月氣，非己酉丑申時不貴，運金土則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106435593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比肩三合成金局，金盛火微，喜行木火之運，故金非火不","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106451977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098383394373673"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能成其器，火無金無以顯其用。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106451977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金火相停，方爲乘軒衣冕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106468361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若火太炎而無士，則金必敗，有土則爲鑄印之象，","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106484745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883372154934/1-5539d41b23f643ee.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=tmbBjHdGkRRV6KYHr93vvFSRuQw%3D","uri":"read/HY1521/13/ref/1kxjkc2765fka/1-5539d41b23f643ee.webp","fontType":1,"components":"金勹𦈢","variants":"鋾","charPicId":"7456690883372154934"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334494106484745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鎔革化而成噐，大人之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106484745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火多金少，金盛火微，皆㐫暴之軰。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106501129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六庚曰詩日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居申建旺壽延長。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106517513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申上日德自坐建祿身莊，故主壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅上雖絕反主昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106533897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅中甲丙生旺，身坐偏官偏財，胎生元命，喜身旺化鬼爲官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰是魁星多榮勇，","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106550281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辰鬼正身坐財郷，謂辰中乙木餘氣，柱中不見財官，爲上喜重叠，身旺忌刑衝，財官旺。若入别格，年月時見財官，喜行火木分野之連。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌爲魁宿亦心剛。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106550281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚戌鬼罡，身坐七煞。謂戌中有旺丙，不宜重見丙丁，爲身衰鬼旺，五月用則發早退早，喜身旺，忌刑衝，財官旺，若人别格喜行。水運忌行火運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午宫有禄何憂困。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106566665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午山自坐官印謂午中丁巳金，雖敗何憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于上","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106583049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098383394422825"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雀無形，不是艮","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106583049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子上木敗，火滅庚𣦸，謂金沉水底，不見其形財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官無","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106583049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"氣喜通身旺，月柱有了。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火頡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106583049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須看天時分貴賤，柱中通變細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106599433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
