{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申、庚寅、庚午、庚子四日，用甲乙爲財，丁正官，丙偏官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106632201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年月時透甲乙丁字，生春夏火木局中，財官有用；如不透此三字，生春夏火木局，亦作財官論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106648585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見庚辛奪財，壬癸傷官，名利艱難。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106664969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如生秋冬，金水中財宫無氣，雖得滋助亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106681353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行東南木火分野，向官臨財之運，不喜行西北金水分野，傷官敗財之運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106697737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若柱有丙丁，官煞混雜，煞無制反賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106714121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無丁有丙無制作鬼論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106730505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098383394390057"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要分身鬼強弱，定其吉㐫壽夭，制伏得中，作偏官論，制過反不爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106746889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更詳日干於所生月内有力無力、有𦔳無𦔳，分節氣淺深輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106763273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行身旺鬼衰運，忌身衰鬼旺運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106779657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六辛日詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉中坐禄最爲強，","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106796041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉中木絶，火𣦸財官兩皆然。辛建禄最強，見戊子丙。申時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥上身臨沐浴鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106796041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛金生子，亥上沐浴，財生官絕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未位暗丁身尅剥，","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106812425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未中木爲財，丁爲煞，己爲倒食，尅剥傷身，喜身旺化鬼爲官，見丙申時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑中藏癸食榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106812425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑中有癸，爲食，無火木財官，雖背亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯臨財地衰無懼，","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106828809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯上身坐。財官謂木旺生火，見戊子時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳坐金局𣦸不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106828809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己上身坐官印，謂丙戊，建禄在乚辛。雖𣦸地有倚，見戊子時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相𣦸囚分月氣，更㸔有用細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106845193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098249399123995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日用甲乙爲財，丙正官，丁偏官，柱中年月時透丙乙丙字，生春夏及火木局中，財官有用。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106861577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如不透此三字，生春夏及火木局，亦作財官論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106877961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見庚辛爲奪財士傷官，名利艱難。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106894345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生秋冬及金水局，財官無氣，雖得滋𦔳亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106910729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜東南火木分野，向官臨財，不喜西北金水分野，傷官敗財之運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106927113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怕官煞混雜，有煞無制鬼論，制太𨓺不福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106943497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更詳日干於所生月内有無力𦔳，分輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106959881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜忌同上。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106976265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸壬水屬陽，乃甘澤長流之永，能滋生草木，長養萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494106992649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098358845063231"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨喜春夏生人，秋冬値令，則無生意。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107009033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見寅午戌官星，得生𦕈之氣，名譽自彰。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107025417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金局生八月，名利兩遂。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107041801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水局生三月，爲天德主貴，地支亥卯未，行南方運發財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107058185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水屬陰，乃大海無涯之水，不能生長萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107074569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一云雨。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107090953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露潤澤之水，滋亞萬物，喜春秋間，運行巳午戍地，發福非常。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107107337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌辰戌丑未運，成敗地支亥卯未合，傷旺益財，無寅甲亦發名利。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107123721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如見己土亹未月，更帶三刑，平常衣祿，初中未濟，終末榮發。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107140105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若五行有救，身旺運喜財官，亦主貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107156489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩壬癸日生水爲主，根基惟在火與土溩通㑹囷可","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107172873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098100987822095"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：春秋來徃發財官，冬夏東行爲得所。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107172873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日生，坐下辰戌丑未已午爲玄武當權，運行宜火土分野，週與不及，偏陰偏陽，則貴而不實。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107189257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生四季巳午月，引亥子時，或冬生引辰戌丑未已午時，俱貴，非此時虛名虛利。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107205641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜金水分野，生匜爲榮，無金則水絶，忌比肩刼財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107222025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬十一月三合結局，水漲横泛而土崩，故水無土則濫，土無水則乾，土得水而受潤通氣，水得士而成隄爲河，二者不可偏倚，若更氣運得宜，無不貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107238409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其刑合拱合等格，不在此論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107254793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六壬日詩日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅宫旣濟最爲奇，","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107271177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅上水火旣濟，身坐財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食生","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107271177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺見士寅時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言子","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107271177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098100987838479"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位，衝刑反是宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107271177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子日刃飛天禄馬喜，刑衝破害二中巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絶丙胎財官無。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107287561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"氣取午中丁巳。故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申上逢生多秀麗，","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107303945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申中士敗，火病財官俱背𨚫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水長生爲學堂士。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107303945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"聰明秀麗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰中建祿却卑微，","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107320329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰魁罡柱中，不見財官，喜重叠壓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏忌","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107320329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無士制","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107320329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禦則所。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖是","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107320329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"文秀平生於功名中歇滅，若財官生旺，别入他。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格，柱中見財官忌傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107320329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"破運喜火土分野運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午爲禄馬同鄉斷，","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107336713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午爲禄馬同卿，身坐財官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲人怜恻有謀斷見","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107336713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬寅時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107336713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌作財官，雙美推","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107353097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王戌日德，身坐丙戊，爲財官名支。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武當權。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107353097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡引用分野，與辰、午同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"造化窮通各有異，柱中配合要須知。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107369481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日除壬辰爲魁罡，財官喜忌論於日下。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107385865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅、壬子、壬申、壬午、壬戌五日，用丙丁爲財，己正官，戊偏官川柱透丙丁巳字，生九夏四季火土局中，財官有用，命通。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107402249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098358845095999"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如不透此三字，生九夏火土局，亦作財官論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107418633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見壬癸奪財，乙傷官，各利艱難。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107435017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生春冬及水木局中，財官無氣，雖得滋𦔳亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107451401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行南方四季，火土分野向官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107467785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨財運柱見戊巳，煞官混雜，無制反賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107484169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無己有戊，不見制伏，作鬼論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107500553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要分身鬼強弱，定其吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107516937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制伏得中，作偏官論，制過不福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107533321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更詳日干於所生月内有無力𦔳，分節氣淺深輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107549705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行身旺鬼衰運，忌行身衰鬼旺運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107566089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六癸日詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯爲日貴坐學堂，","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107582473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸卯爲日貴，坐長生學堂，食神建旺，雖財官無氣，亦吉巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建財官最吉祥。","logicSentenceId":"7577334494107582473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳爲口貴身坐財□□生曰：謂巳中丙戊建禄，庚金長生，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098302385717282"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁巳時，貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未上鬼傷因質朴，","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621277746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未上身坐偏官偏財，喜身旺化鬼爲官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥中官背却榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621277746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥中丙戊俱絕，財官俱背，却喜亥多衝。巳中丙戊飛夾□癸，爲財官禄馬之貴。若得癸亥時，並衝方合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉宫得救方無咎，","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621294130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉上癸水衰敗，財官無氣，要通身旺月爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑位雖衝不作殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621294130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑中羊刃，有官無財，己土專位，七煞喜衝破刃祕，不爲灾咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憂不憂兮喜不喜，月間休旺要𭆞詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621310514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日用丙丁爲財，戊正官，己偏官，若四柱透丙丁戊字，生九夏四季火士局，財官有用；若無此三字，生九夏四季火土局中，亦作財官論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621326898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見壬癸奪財田，傷官不利。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621343282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生春冬水木𭕔中，財官無氣，喜行南方四季財官之運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621359666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怕煞官混雜，有煞無制鬼論，制太𨓺㐫，","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621376050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098100987871247"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更詳日干於月令内有無力𦔳輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621376050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜忌同上論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621392434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

IdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，次宜日時帶諸不見之形貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621589042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如年日時三宫皆不遇，其命可知。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621605426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行運身旺喜財，身弱喜旺，通忌比刼。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621621810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日，壬爲旺，癸爲建禄，只是身強，柰名利二者却被月令銷鎔𥁞了，頗宜時帶偏官貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621638194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬日戊巳時，","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621654578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098383394488361"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日己午時是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621654578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次宜日時帶諸不見之形貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621670962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如年日時三官皆不遇，其命可知。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621687346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜行偏官，忌正官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621703730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621720114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"交丑未是丑，丑初只是癸，須是坐了丑丑中月，方有己辛。小寒上旬上七日，癸水餘氣旺，或丑日丑時，冬春生作水用，下八日作辛金用，大寒節𣅜是己土正位，或夏月、四季月作土。用秋生作金用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日得丑月，爲雜氣官貴，喜官星透干不透，要","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621720114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690881489600575/1-1011683f14689c3f.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=4VDhedQdrlvBE8om%2B35Q5UtH0bY%3D","uri":"read/NA00364/4/ref/1kulavb0a8ta7/1-1011683f14689c3f.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𰆊又頁","variants":"䪲","charPicId":"7456690881489600575"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334523621802034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜時偏官貴及帶日時諸不見之形，依然發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621802034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時偏官，庚日丙時巳時，辛日丁時午時，運喜行合偏官，忌正官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621818418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日爲雜氣印貴，喜透印見官及刑衝，忌甲伏運宜行官印之地，忌財傷印。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621834802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘同前論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621851186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098358845112383"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621867570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乾、坤、艮、巽，四維在地，月令在天，不管四維。𦆵立春便有寅有甲，不必拘泥於艮時辰論分。野則有之，餘巳申亥同此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日得寅，建禄，乙日旺相，月令中無格可取，只利得身旺年久，頗宜帶時偏官及日時諸不見之形貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621867570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時偏官者，甲日庚時申時，乙日辛時酉時，如年日、時三宫，無格可取，終身可知。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621883954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有偏官者，喜行合偏官運，忌正官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621900338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁日爲印貴，喜坐官露官，再露印星，忌露財，宜行官印運，忌財傷印。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621916722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日爲偏官貴，兩陽相攻，喜身旺，忌身弱偏官有合","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621933106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098100987887631"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫制，無合要制。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621933106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜身旺，合制，忌身弱正官及再行煞鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621949490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日爲正官貴，陰陽和合，喜坐露財，再露官星，三合六合，身旺，忌七煞傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621965874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官愛明合，身旺喜行財官，身弱喜旺，忌七煞偏官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621982258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛日爲財，喜財多露，身旺，忌坐刃透比，身弱不遇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523621998642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯日難爲財運，身旺喜財，身弱喜旺，忌刼同。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622015026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日爲長生財，喜財透干，忌伏藏，如柱無財透，便不是長生財，只是傷官背禄，月令頗宜時上偏官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622031410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日戊時己時，癸日己時午時，須及年日時諸不見之","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622047794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098338209054746"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622047794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如三宫皆無格，難言好命運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622064178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺喜財，身弱喜旺，忌身弱正官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622080562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月，","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622096946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"交𫑗未是𫑗𫑗，初只是用，須是坐了𫑗𫑗中方是乙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲曰得卯旺相，乙日得卯建禄，甲乙生卯月，諸格無取，只利得身強命長，頗宜帶時上偏官，及諸不見之形貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622096946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏官者，甲日庚時申時，乙日辛時酉時，若年日時三宫無此，其命平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622113330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原帶偏官，喜合，忌正官運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622129714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁日爲印，喜露官印二星，忌天財運同。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622146098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日爲正官，喜坐財露官，三合六合，身旺，忌煞傷官，愛多合運，身旺喜財官，身弱喜旺，忌七煞傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622162482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098383394521129"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日爲偏官，喜身旺有合，無則要制，忌身弱無合，及露正官運，喜忌同。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622178866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛日爲財，喜透自旺不坐。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622195250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯日難爲財，忌坐刼露比運，身旺喜財，身弱喜旺，忌刼比。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622211634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同𡈼癸日爲長生財，喜坐露財，如柱無財，便不是長生財，只是傷官背禄，月令頗宜帶時上偏官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622228018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬日戊時己時，癸日己時午時，須是帶諸不見之形貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622244402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運身。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622260786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺喜財，身弱喜旺，帶偏官者，喜合偏官，忌刼財、正官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622277170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622293554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"交辰未是辰，辰初只是乙，須是坐了辰，方有壬癸水。清明上旬七日半，乙木餘氣旺或辰。日辰時作乙木論，下八日作癸水論。穀甫節皆是戊上正位。若秋生辰日辰時作水論。四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098201462374450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"季作士用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日生辰月，爲雜氣印，喜見官星，及印露，不露要衝，旣露怕衝，忌見財多傷印運喜忌同丙丁日爲雜氣官，喜官透，不透要衝，見財，身強發福，忌官伏無衝及煞傷運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622293554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身強喜財，官弱喜旺，忌煞傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622309938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同戊巳曰爲雜氣財，喜財露旺，不露，要衝，忌財伏無衝，坐刃比肩不坐。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622326322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子辰日難爲財運，身旺喜財弱喜旺，忌刼。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622342706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同庚辛日爲餘氣財貴，清明後七日半有乙木餘氣，方","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622359090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098338209071130"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可發。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622359090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如月初生，無比刃奪財，皆可發。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622375474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨓺期則辰中無利無害，平平。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622391858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如日時帶諸貴格，亦發運有餘氣財，身旺喜財地，忌身弱刼地財衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622408242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日爲自庫，只是身強少疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622424626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令無貴可取，頗宜時上偏官及日時諸不見之形貴，依然發福，勿拘月令運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622441010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如時偏官者，喜行合制，忌行正官傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622457394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己月甲乙日得己月爲財貴，不生於己午日，難爲財，亦名長生財貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622473778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土露則財星愈光，丙火露則傷神益壯，喜身旺財露，忌坐刃露比運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622490162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺喜財，身弱喜旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622506546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098415312945152"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日建禄，丁旺相，丙子生巳月，無可取用爲福，只是身旺年長，頗宜時帶偏官及日時之貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622522930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又丙丁巳月，亦是長生財，貴要財露，如不露，只是傷官背禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622539314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令是長生財，喜行財運，帶偏官，喜合運，忌刼財、正官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622555698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳日爲印，亦爲建禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622572082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何以别之？","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622588466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只年月時露丙火爲印，丙不露。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622604850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有壬癸字者，只是建禄印綬貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622621234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜露官星，及行官印之地，忌傷官印。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622637618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如建禄時，宜带偏官，喜自身強，旺運宜合偏官，忌正官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622654002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日爲偏官，貴印與同宫，喜身旺合制，有合莫制，忌身弱無合，正官運亦同論，忌再見偏官，全無制多夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622670386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098383394570281"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨庚申日則不然。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622686770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何者？","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622703154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳中有土能生金，金旣長生，又自坐禄，何夭之有？","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622719538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看壬露無丙，癸露無丁，甲露戊衰，乙露已病之機何如？","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622735922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日爲正官，辛爲天德，喜官再透，及財露官愛多合及三合六合之地，忌坐七煞傷官運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622752306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身強喜財官，身弱喜旺，忌七煞傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622768690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日爲偏官，喜身強偏官，有合莫制，忌身弱露官運喜身旺，合偏官，忌身弱旺官，全無制伏，多夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622785074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日爲正官，喜露財官，三合、六合，身旺，忌七煞傷官，官愛多合，運喜身旺及官印之地，弱則喜印忌煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622801458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098415312994304"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月甲乙日得午月爲財貴，亦爲長生財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622817842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己土露則財愈顯，丁火露則傷益壯。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622834226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜身旺，忌刃比運，身旺喜財，身弱喜旺，忌比刼。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622850610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日旺相，丁日建禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622866994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁人生五月，無可作福，只身旺年長，頗宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622883378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時帶偏官及日時諸不見之形貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523622899762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又丙丁生午月，是長生財貴，要財露，如財不露，只是傷官皆禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734523950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令帶偏官者，喜行合制運，有長生財者，喜行財運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734540334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳日爲印，亦爲建禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734556718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何以别之？","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734573102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月時于露丁爲","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734589486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098201462390834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印，喜透官印，忌財無印，作建禄論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734589486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日正官星，身弱喜旺，忌七煞傷官，歲運傷爲福之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734605870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日偏官，喜身旺合制，有合莫制，亦利土出火藏，忌身弱無合及正官運喜身旺，合偏官，忌正官再見偏官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734622254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日正官正財，喜身旺，三合、六合，忌七煞傷官，官愛多合運，身旺喜財官，身弱喜旺，忌七煞傷官，歲運傷爲福之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734638638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日爲偏官，喜身旺偏官，有合莫制，忌身弱無合。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734655022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734671406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098338209103898"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官運喜忌同未月，","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734671406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"小暑上旬上七日丁火，餘氣旺，或未日未時，春生作木用，下八日作乙木庫用，大暑節皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是己土正位，若夏生作火，秋生作士，用。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734671406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日見末，爲自庫，月主身強少病，但無一物可用，爲福頗宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734687790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時偏官及月時帶諸貴格，不必拘。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734704174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令運喜合偏官，忌正官再見偏官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734720558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁日雜氣印，喜官及印露，不露要衝，忌印伏無衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734736942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與財運，喜官印，忌傷官，歲運傷爲福之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734753326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳口雜氣官貴，喜身旺，與財及官透不透宜衝，官愛多合，忌官伏無衝，兼煞混傷官運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734769710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺喜財，身弱","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734786094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098415313027072"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜旺，忌七煞傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734786094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運歲傷爲福之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734802478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛日雜氣財，喜身強財透，旺不透要衝，忌財伏無衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734818862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃、比肩運，身旺喜財，身弱喜旺，忌比刼，歲運傷爲福之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734835246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日爲餘氣財，如遇小暑七日後生，則不爲雜氣長生財貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734851630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小暑七日半生，有丁餘氣，謂之禄馬同郷，無傷官，無奪財，頗能發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734868014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如過期生未中無物可取，主平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734884398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜官透財露，身旺，忌七煞傷官運，身旺喜財，官弱喜旺，忌七煞傷官，同申月。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734900782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098383394537513"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日申月爲偏官，喜身旺合制，忌身弱。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523734917166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉月甲日，酉月爲正官，喜身旺露官見財，三合六合，忌七煞傷官，官愛多合運，身旺喜財，官弱喜旺，忌七煞傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735097390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日得酉月爲偏官，喜身旺有合莫制，有制莫合，忌身弱正官運亦如之，再忌見七煞運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735113774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098383394553897"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁日爲財，喜身旺露財宫，三合六合，忌刑衝破害、比肩刼財運，身旺喜財，身弱喜旺，忌刼奪。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735130158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳日爲長生財，如柱中不帶財露，便不是，只是傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735146542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令頗宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735162926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時帶偏官及諸貴格，偏官格喜合制運，身旺喜財，身弱喜旺，忌刼財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735179310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日爲旺相，辛日爲建祿，月中無物可取，只是身旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735195694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年長頗宜時帶偏官及日時諸貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735212078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有偏官喜合或制，忌正官運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735228462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸口爲印，喜露官透印，忌財運亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735244846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

arginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運身旺喜財，身弱喜旺，忌刼奪。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735392302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥月甲乙口得亥月爲印，喜露官透印爲福，忌財運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735408686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日爲偏官，有合莫制，有制莫合，喜身旺，忌身弱，正官歲運同。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735425070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁日爲正官，喜透財露官，身旺，忌七煞傷官，多合運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735441454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳日爲財，要財露身旺，忌羊刃比肩，身弱運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735457838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098415313059840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛日爲長生之財，如柱中全無財露，只是傷官背禄，月令頗宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735474222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時帶偏官，日時諸貴格，喜財露自旺，忌無財，身弱運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735490606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日，壬爲建禄，癸爲旺相，福無可取，只是身旺年久頗宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735506990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時帶偏官及口時諸貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735523374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如得時偏官運喜行合，偏官忌正官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735539758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論五行時地分野吉㐫按王氏所謂二氣者，陰陽也；五行者，金木水火土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735556142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時者，春夏秋冬也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735572526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地者，冀、青、兗、徐、揚、荆、梁、雍、豫也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735588910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天有陰陽，行於四時，地有五行，具於九州。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735605294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正朱子所","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735621678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098201462439986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂五行質具於地，氣行於天，故天有春夏秋冬，地有金木水火，皆以時地相爲用也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735621678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之談命者，但知論陰陽五行，而不知𠔥論方隅與晝夜陰晴，所以有年日月時同，而貴賤壽夭逈異，便謂五行無據，啟世人不信命之疑，亦誣矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735638062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗟夫！","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735654446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生天地，莫迯五行。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735670830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九州分疆，風氣異宜，陰晴寒暖，理難一律。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735687214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人禀天地靈氣以生，一時得氣，各目不同，所以貴賤壽夭，難以八字拘也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735703598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且以甲乙寅𫑗屬木，生於充青，爲得地，春令爲得時；丙丁巳午屬火，生於徐、揚，爲□字，夏令爲得時。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735719982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳辰戌丑未屬土，生於豫州，爲得地，四季月爲得","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735736366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098401987625012"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時；庚辛申酉屬金，生於荆鿄爲得地，秋冬爲得時。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735736366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸亥子屬水，生於冀、雍，爲得地，冬令爲得時。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735752750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况書夜陰晴之間，有寒有暖；陰陽造化之内，有喜有忌，生尅制化。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735769134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690877886906380/1-93e73f4651144ce7.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=dpXo0%2BCos%2F077%2Fx5iXq7JZniOY0%3D","uri":"read/NA10937/8/ref/1kp8p8fijqsy1/1-93e73f4651144ce7.webp","fontType":1,"components":"扌𠨐","variants":"抑","charPicId":"7456690877886906380"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334523735785518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"揚輕重，妙在識其通變，不可執一論也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735785518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論木：正春木令木也，晴則花葉𢾾榮，雨則寒其萌蘖。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735801902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月生者，雖三陽交泰，寒氣未除，見火則生意藹然，富貴無敵，火多泄其元氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735818286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人晝生者疾，火土同𥌬，富而且貴，有土無火，僅足衣資而己逢金折傷之患，得火制之爲福，見水不爲子母相生。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735834670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢初春之木，𦆵有","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735851054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098302385799202"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生意，見水則寒，反不爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735851054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冀雍生者，貧寒，男濫而女滛也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735867438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二月之木，生意暢茂，遇土培","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735883822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894692401163/1-448a7e6b774415b6.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=xkp8fpVzeLC4Hjp16f8uaqkPqsw%3D","uri":"read/7444523052097863690/9/ref/1knsgs728qc62/1-448a7e6b774415b6.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土十𠃊⺝","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690894692401163"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334523735883822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲隹，火土同行，富貴而壽，火盛亦泄其氣，葢花木始含英，而真陽發散故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735883822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890909696011/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oHXZ2rzZQJN3rsN0YkmpzWLbkZ8%3D","uri":"read/NA06436/6/ref/1koerp3k2g56a/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp","fontType":1,"components":"六𠃔","variants":"兗","charPicId":"7456690890909696011"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334523735900206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青人富貴無虞，徐揚人美中不足，干支有壬癸亥子者，咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735900206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見水生之太𨓺，情性流蕩，離祖遷居，土金水㑹，夭折無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735916590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賤貧則壽，逢金伐之，旺處遭傷，斨其生意，豈天地生物之至仁耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735932974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先正有云：春木雖旺，不宜逄金者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735949358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三月之木，正條逹長茂之時，春陽和照，萬紫千紅，雨","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735965742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098401987641396"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水浸","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735965742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690879727861771/1-68e0a1672d374c59.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ckx95c1dI5dGKACn3DGCJWw9oy0%3D","uri":"read/HY0710/1/ref/1kodrli0okeue/1-68e0a1672d374c59.webp","fontType":1,"components":"氵爫正一","variants":"淫","charPicId":"7456690879727861771"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334523735965742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"根株揺動，見土則根深蒂固，福夀綿延；見火則木通火明，文章秀發；逄金伐木，荆鿄生者㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735965742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚之人，富貴，喜火土，忌金水，運喜東南西北，不利。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735982126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏木病已𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523735998510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午墓未者，葢南方火盛，泄其眞氣故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523736014894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰雨則吉，亢晴則忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523736031278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四月木未甚衰，火未甚旺，見㣲火則枝葉茂繁，蔭庇發福；值盛水則水神飄蕩，男女滛奔。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523736047662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見土利就名成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523736064046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土同躔，干支有壬癸亥子者，富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523736080430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄金尅之，灾訟不免。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523736096814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523736113198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五、六月之木，喜雨水，夜生尤奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523736129582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"值此者，富貴而壽久","logicSentenceId":"7577334523736145966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098415313207296"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盛。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523736145966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無水者貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931656238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏令炎威火盛，爍石流金，木有枯槁之患。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931672622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人干火多者，有瘋癆熒燎之㐫，或水制，或夜生，或陰雨，天，化㐫而爲吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931689006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得土以培其根，得水以達其□，若水土同行，非惟富貴，且壽考康寜矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931705390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見金不能尅木，火旺金柔，有子復仇故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931721774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若小暑以後，土多亦忌，葢衰木不能尅旺土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931738158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兗、青生者爲財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931754542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵夏木喜水，與他時不類。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931770926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋三月之木，惟欲晴雨得宜，亢旱則物皆枯槁，滛雨則物不收成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931787310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初秋之時，炎威未退，不宜與火同行。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931803694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰雨生者最妙，","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931820078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098415313125376"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見金雖有剥刻之𭒡，然火氣尚炎，金氣未盛，不爲害也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931820078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處暑以後，荆梁生者忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931836462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水同行，化㐫爲吉，逄土培桓，利就名成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931852846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水盛無土，冀雍飄蕩無居，徐揚人反㐫成吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931869230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八九月之木，正凋零之時，畫火同躔者，貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931885614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢秋陽燥裂，术皆枯落故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931901998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或夜生，或陰雨，或水觧之方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931918382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兖、青人文章富貴，見水有漂流之患，葢秋水非滋木之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931934766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冀、雍人","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931951150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872336662539/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0wB3MaaB1Wen3n7YFjpkgMtRTi4%3D","uri":"read/HY1059/6/ref/1kob4lj19t5vw/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"尢丶","variants":"尤","charPicId":"7456690872336662539"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334523931951150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌，得土栽培，根基穏厚，見金反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931951150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢金司令，則萬物摧落，旣無長養以遂其生，又未歸根以復其命，所可借者在一金耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931967534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟無金制以成其","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931983918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098358845210687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"器，則爲天地間一朽木。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523931983918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此所以仗斧斤之力，𠠇削成器，而爲棟梁之用，正所謂斧斤以時入山林，林木不可勝用也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932000302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣運宜徃東方，南方冬木正肅殺之時，復命歸根，微有小春生意，以見造化無終窮之理。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932016686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰碩果不食者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932033070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於晴明者最佳，","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932049454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883221651495/1-5c5ef78974cd5e72.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=yZBpfHEIdvqDERIs1dQ%2BLDn8YSE%3D","uri":"read/HY0893/13/ref/1kow22zmyceus/1-5c5ef78974cd5e72.webp","fontType":1,"components":"亻十𠃊⺝","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690883221651495"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334523932049454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰雨則凝氷積雪也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932049454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十月之木，遇火貴而有壽，葢氷寒土凍，仗火以温暖其根故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932065838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土輔運，富貴雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932082222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見金雖無害，其根本，未免骨肉参啇，得水則有滋𦔳之意。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932098606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人利就名成，冀雍人貧寒孤尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932114990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098415313141760"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若子丑月之木，喜火融之，與土同躔，位登台鼎，見水㐫尅，葢冬水令也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932131374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木，寒木也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932147758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬木遇水而寒，無火温之，則氷凝凍合，而生意摧折矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932164142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤者壽，富貴者夭，見金雖傷不害。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932180526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢木任冬令，歸根者斧斤無所施，凋零者劉削可成器，所以見金而無咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932196910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐、揚、兗青生者，有隕自天，荆鿄豫人雖忌，亦不𨓺枝葉之傷耳，其本根則自若也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932213294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支得丁丙相制者，𨚫能富貴，豈獨免𥚍而己。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932229678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣運宜徃南方，冬木喜南奔也，東方次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932246062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論火，三春之火，其氣温然而始著也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932262446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晴則借木而明，雨則","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932278830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098358845243455"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濕木而晦。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932278830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月㣲陽之火，隠於木中，雖有可親可愛之意，但氷霜之氣未消，遇木生之，則陽氣發揮矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932295214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄金爲財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932311598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐陽人富而好禮，金木同行，官居鼎鼐。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932327982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄金值水，天折無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932344366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荆鿄、冀雍之人，","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932360750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872336662539/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0wB3MaaB1Wen3n7YFjpkgMtRTi4%3D","uri":"read/HY1059/6/ref/1kob4lj19t5vw/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"尢丶","variants":"尤","charPicId":"7456690872336662539"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334523932360750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甚見土盜泄微陽，浮薄卑賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932360750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二月見木，敗處逄生，术秀火明文章，富貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932377134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但不宜有水，葢濕木不生，無醈火也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932393518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穀雨之後生者，微水無㐫，葢土司時术，主令化匈而爲吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932409902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兗、青、徐揚生者，富貴何疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932426286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土與金，正月同論，但辰月土差旺耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932442670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏令之火，陽氣之極，草木爲之焦枯，江河爲之枯涸，","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932459054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098201462456370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□□","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932459054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"□金□不。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□陽","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932459054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"□泄雨則水濟其威，方得中和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反應","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932459054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690887285850124/1-e6ba5c1424712073.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=2uM9Z01of3DJJb9rq3jYj4CT7tw%3D","uri":"read/HY0851/29/ref/1koeorlys1tlm/1-e6ba5c1424712073.webp","fontType":1,"components":"艹阝亼丅云","variants":"蔭","charPicId":"7456690887285850124"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334523932459054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"芘發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932459054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四月火勢漸盛，逄日争光，未能全其忠愛，雖富貴亦主夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932475438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧寒者壽而多子，孤獨艱幸。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932491822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見金名成利就，逄土有權有謀，遇木富而好禮，㣲水濟木，其貴不可言也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932508206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五、六月生者，火炎之極，得水制之，則都將相。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932524590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟冀雍生人，水不宜盛，葢旺火投於盛水，不能不傷故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932540974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得土制木觧，則富貴𨓺人矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932557358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見土畧洩其盛而有權衡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932573742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之貴，又好施惠及人，但施恩而反怨耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932590126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢火能生土，亦能燥土故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932606510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見木生𨓺，反傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932622894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青、兗、徐揚人，根基雖","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932639278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098358845259839"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富，難免夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932639278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冀、雍、荆、梁人，富而益富，遇金爲財，火爍金流，反有破財蕩家之患。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932655662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水土同行，名成利就，日戰月刑，忠孝有𧇊，㐫禍孤尅，夜生减輕，氣運宜徃西北南東，大忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932672046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋初之火，炎威未退，土傳生氣，水不能尅，反主貴榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932688430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見木𦔳之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932704814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐、揚、兗、青人，干支火多者，雖富貴而壽不永。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932721198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見金爲財，富貴豪侈，逄土則息，顯達非常。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932737582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八九月失時之火，見木生生，之意無窮，富貴無敵。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932753966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木同𨇠，官居宰輔。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932770350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有金無木，主弱敵強，不免有争𢸬之事。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932786734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冀、雍、荆、梁人，因財致禍，典土同𨇠，泄其眞元，孤","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932803118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098415313174528"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑冷退，得木𦔳之，斯爲美矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932803118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見水㐫夭，運喜東南西北忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932819502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月之火，人多親之，晴霽則明，陰雨則㓕，故見水爲㐫，术生爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932835886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有水無木，輕者疾，重者夭，雖生富厚之家，不免冷退。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932852270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐、揚、兖、青人，得水制之無咎，逄土泄之，弱中又弱，蹇滯終身。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932868654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小寒之後，旺土晦其光明，定主昏愚瞽目。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932885038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見金爲財，青、兖、徐、揚人主富。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932901422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荆、梁、冀、雍人，𦔳難爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932917806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂金之子水也，克其母子，則乘勢報仇，無木觧之，有刀兵獄訟之厄，腫痢没溺之㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932934190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支木盛者减輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932950574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵冬火喜木，忌水，運宜東南西北，大忌","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932966958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098338209185818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論土。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932966958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土值春時，土膏脉起，萬物含生，木氣發泄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932983342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前哲所謂病寅𣦸𫑗墓辰者，良有以也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523932999726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雨則陰凝，土濕而萌甲不舒；晴則凍釋，陽和而生意發越。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933016110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故春令之土，一接陽氣，就能發育萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933032494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月之土，尚有霜寒，遇雨則凍，遇水則氷，值木則病。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933048878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟得火以温之，則榮華莫比，逢金制木，亦名利兩成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933065262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二月之上，正木盛土崩之時，遇木同躔，有脾胃腸風、痔漏之灾，輕者疾，重者夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933081646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人干支有火，而値晝晴者無咎。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933098030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見火同𨇠，位登台鼎，見水則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933114414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冀、雍、青","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933130798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890909696011/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oHXZ2rzZQJN3rsN0YkmpzWLbkZ8%3D","uri":"read/NA06436/6/ref/1koerp3k2g56a/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp","fontType":1,"components":"六𠃔","variants":"兗","charPicId":"7456690890909696011"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334523933130798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098358845308991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人，土渾水濁，終有水湧士潰之危。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933130798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢水生旺木而傷土也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933147182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"値此者貧寒疾夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933163566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚、豫人，干支火者反吉，見金以泄土氣，難免灾衒。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933179950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三月之土，漸有生意，葢土旺季月故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933196334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有火温燠，則陽氣𤼵舒而生物茂矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933212718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見木非疾則夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933229102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚、豫人無害，水木同度，貧薄無聊。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933245486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冀、雍、","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933261870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890909696011/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oHXZ2rzZQJN3rsN0YkmpzWLbkZ8%3D","uri":"read/NA06436/6/ref/1koerp3k2g56a/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp","fontType":1,"components":"六𠃔","variants":"兗","charPicId":"7456690890909696011"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334523933261870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青人","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933261870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872336662539/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0wB3MaaB1Wen3n7YFjpkgMtRTi4%3D","uri":"read/HY1059/6/ref/1kob4lj19t5vw/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"尢丶","variants":"尤","charPicId":"7456690872336662539"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334523933261870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甚見金制木，反㐫成吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933261870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜南方，西方次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334523933278254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土旺長夏，火盛土生之故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057485363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰雨則濕養萬物，故見水爲吉；亢旱則田疇龜折，故遇火爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057501747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孟夏之土，炎氣未盛，終喜火以𦔳之，逢木則疾天無","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057518131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098338209202202"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疑，見水爲財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057518131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
