{"lines":[{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人富足，見金遇木則貴，逄水則貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057534515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五六月之土，見火則燥，而萬物焦枯。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057550899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人干支火盛者，有火焚風血之災，輕者危，重者𣦸，或陰雨，或夜生，雖災不甚。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057567283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冀雍人干支有壬癸亥子者，富貴非凡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057583667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見水滋養萬物，主富貴文章。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057600051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見木疏通，其性多聰明特達，遇金無用。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057616435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢火盛金衰，不能制木，所以金無用也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057632819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣運宜行西北，最忌南方，葢夏土逄火太燥故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057649203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土逢秋令，金氣盛旺，泄土而氣薄矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057665587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晴雨須要得宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057681971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七月之土，火氣未除，土性尚燥，喜水滋之，則萬物實矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057698355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若火太盛，亦有燥土之嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057714739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得水濟之爲妙，逄木爲","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057731123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098440134869003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057731123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐、揚、荆、梁人無忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057747507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八、九月之土，見木則不能尅，此萬物凋零之時。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057763891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057780275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺子復母仇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057796659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荆、梁、徐、揚人，富貴而壽，見金泄氣太甚，西北人不免有冷退怯弱之患。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057813043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見火𦔳之，文武名高，君子小人皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057829427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見水爲財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057845811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐、揚、豫人，富而無敵。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057862195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冀、雍、荆、梁人，水過盛者，反主貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057878579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月僅可運，喜火土之鄉，水木金方有忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057894963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土於冬也，正天地肅殺之時，寒亦至矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057911347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖一陽下生，土脉未温，値水雪則氷寒土凍，見火日則寒谷回春。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057927731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十月之土，惟喜火以温之，則土脉陽和，而萬物歸根","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057944115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098415313223680"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057944115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見木則㐫，逢金則滯，遇水則主孤寒。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057960499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐、揚人干支火多者可富。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057976883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子、丑之月，寒氣之極，火日融和，功各成就，見木最忌，見火觧之爲吉，見水則陰氣愈甚，水寒地凍，輕者疾，重者夭，見金亦主貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524057993267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運南方最佳，北方大忌論金。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058009651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春日之金，木旺火相，非金得氣時也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058026035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絕寅胎養於卯辰者，葢造化無終極之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058042419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以春令之金，晴明吉，陰雨則滯，正宜遇土以生之，謂其將絕而有生意耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058058803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月之金，見木爲財，木神太旺，僅足衣資，土氣尚寒，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058075187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098338209218586"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未能生𦔳，藝術顯名而己。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058075187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火若同躔，男女重婚重嫁，見火遇土，富貴非常；逄水泄之，孤寒懦弱。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058091571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二、三月之金，見土則生生之意無窮，主人富貴而壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058107955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄水泄其元氣，亦主貧薄無情；見火則囚，金遇鬼，貧夭無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058124339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土生水制爲吉，見木而有困滯之灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058140723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢春木盛旺，以微弱之金而欲制之，是猶以嬰兒而禦強敵，其不格也明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058157107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犯此者，必有求榮反辱之虞，官訟争攘之事，謂其仁義相刑故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058173491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荆、鿄、豫人逄之主富。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058189875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐、揚人干支土多者，貴顯，氣運，土鄉最吉，金鄉次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058206259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏月火盛，金至柔也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058222643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晴則日爍金流，雨則水滋金潤，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058239027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098441892249641"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故夏令之金俱宜見土，主人有出將人相之權，金馬玉堂之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058239027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見火則火炎金爍，貧夭居多，雖富而天","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058255411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690879727861771/1-68e0a1672d374c59.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ckx95c1dI5dGKACn3DGCJWw9oy0%3D","uri":"read/HY0710/1/ref/1kodrli0okeue/1-68e0a1672d374c59.webp","fontType":1,"components":"氵爫正一","variants":"淫","charPicId":"7456690879727861771"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524058255411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058255411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見木爲財，荆鿄、豫人多主富貴，遇水孤寒，葢弱金不能生水故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058271795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若與火土同行，則富貴康寜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058288179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜土金，木火，最忌秋金肅殺，萬物凋零，茍縱而不抑，則生生之意絕矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058304563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晴則火煆金堅，雨則水潤金明故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058320947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七、八月之金得令，其性剛強，仗火以制其威，則有玉帶金魚之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058337331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢頑金無火，不能成器故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058353715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見水泄其旺氣，金白水淸，多主詞林清貴，水火俱無，則主夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058370099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098440134967307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見木爲財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058386483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人富而且貴，遇土則隠彩埋光，雖有財而不發，孤者多。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058402867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：秋金埋土而反旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058419251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄木而貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058435635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚、","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058452019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890909696011/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oHXZ2rzZQJN3rsN0YkmpzWLbkZ8%3D","uri":"read/NA06436/6/ref/1koerp3k2g56a/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp","fontType":1,"components":"六𠃔","variants":"兗","charPicId":"7456690890909696011"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524058452019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青人見之尤隹。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058452019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九月生者，金氣稍退，遇火夜生爲奇，晝生少利，逄木則尅，反應骨肉参啇，見水濟之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058468403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冀、雍人不免冷退，徐、揚又何忌焉？","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058484787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄土亦晦，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058501171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890909696011/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oHXZ2rzZQJN3rsN0YkmpzWLbkZ8%3D","uri":"read/NA06436/6/ref/1koerp3k2g56a/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp","fontType":1,"components":"六𠃔","variants":"兗","charPicId":"7456690890909696011"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524058501171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青人富貴居多。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058501171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豫人因滯運，喜東南西北忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058517555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月天氣嚴肅，金伏藏之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058533939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖金之生也，胎於春，生於夏，旺於秋，至冬而𣦸者，謂其畏寒無生意也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058550323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晴明則金清水秀，雨雪則水冷金寒，所以冬月之金，得火融之，然後可以奪其寒氣，則富貴非常矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058566707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098440134934539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初冬之金，見火則爲傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058583091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人干支無土，日生者貧夭，夜生者孤寒，遇土則衣禄豐足，見水木俱不利矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058599475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑月生者，亦喜火以温之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058615859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人無火亦喜，遇土得火爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058632243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冀雍人有土無火者，孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058648627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢寒土非生金之資也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058665011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見水則寒，西北人賤貧疾夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058681395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人干支有火土者，福壽康寧也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058697779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇木爲財，主富享閑中之福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058714163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890909696011/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oHXZ2rzZQJN3rsN0YkmpzWLbkZ8%3D","uri":"read/NA06436/6/ref/1koerp3k2g56a/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp","fontType":1,"components":"六𠃔","variants":"兗","charPicId":"7456690890909696011"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524058730547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青人則有妻孥犯分之事，葢衰金不能制木故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058730547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荆鿄、豫人則吉，運喜東南西北，最忌論水。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058746931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098441892298793"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春月之水，孰不謂其病寅𣦸卯墓辰，爲至弱矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058763315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知水爲陰氣，生申旺子，秋冬之時，其氣翕聚未散，故水常涸。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058779699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春至陽氣上蒸，陰氣下降，故雨露旣濡而水生發，此水勢之常耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058796083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星家以活水生於卯者，良有以也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058812467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晴則春水溶溶，雨則汪洋泛溢。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058828851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月生者，水有寒氣，見火則氷融凍釋，富貴雍容，得金相𦔳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058845235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚生者最佳，逄木無火，則水冷木寒，未有生意。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058861619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇土尅水，亦主貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058878003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土制金生，衣資豐贍。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058894387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二三月之氷，浩無邉際，見土則有隄防，晝則富貴，夜則流移。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058910771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於𬆭雨後者，或主滛邪㾝憊之疾，葢土渾","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058927155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098440134950923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水濁故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058927155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見火則水火相刑，灾訟不免。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058943539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇金生水，泛溢無情。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058959923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人干支得土者無咎，見木泄之，能施惠及人。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058976307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890909696011/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oHXZ2rzZQJN3rsN0YkmpzWLbkZ8%3D","uri":"read/NA06436/6/ref/1koerp3k2g56a/1-6d9a0a2a3f3b7769.webp","fontType":1,"components":"六𠃔","variants":"兗","charPicId":"7456690890909696011"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524058992691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青人生於二月中旬者，木氣正旺，盜其元神，則生風怯之疾，得金取之無患。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524058992691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏水失令，逄火則乾涸矣，所以忌睛而喜雨也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524059009075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初夏之時，水猶泛濫，得土止而不流，則福氣深厚，但不宜與火同行，葢火盛則土燥而水涸。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524059025459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人干支無金水者，疾夭也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524059041843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄水利就名成，金若生之，反主孤尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524059058227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢夏令金衰母弱，不能生子，而反傷於母也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524059074611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荆梁、豫人值之則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524059090995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098441892282409"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五六月之水，正能滋𦔳萬物，喜土同行。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524059107379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生時更值陰雨者，主富貴文章。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112011290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見火則有涸水之嫌，輕者疾，重者夭，得水濟之，㐫中反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112027674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見木亦主富貴豪雄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112044058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兗、青人泄其","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112060442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876069953572/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=WtDNKjuD2E4COzgmQ5BpiMW4kSg%3D","uri":"read/HY0653/23/ref/1kob7zqcc89x2/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp","fontType":1,"components":"上丄⺝八","variants":"與","charPicId":"7456690876069953572"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524112060442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣非佳，逢金氣弱，無力生水，不可例以母曜論之，反主孤尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112060442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支有金水者，吉，運喜金水火鄉，最忌水生秋令，正水清秀之時也，晴則清澈無瑕，雨則潦水渾濁。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112076826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七月之水，正能滋實萬物，不宜與火同行。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112093210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚火多者，貧夭無依。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112109594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金爲母曜，適當其時，子母相生，文童清","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112125978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098440135032843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112125978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土來同處，化禍爲祥，木若聮行，亦當貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112142362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八九月之水遇令星，則福壽難量。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112158746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金火同躔，則功名炬赫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112175130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見木終被疏泄，不免先成後敗。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112191514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火若同垣，恩金失力，雖有治民服衆之德，未免痰疾刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112207898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見土雖㐫不㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112224282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢秋令金最能化難爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112240666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚、豫人，干支土多者，亦困滯終身，運利西北，東南失宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112257050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月司令之水，寒氣嚴凝之時也，雨則氷凝，晴則凍釋，故冬三月俱喜火以温之，則富貴無虞矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112273434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見金子母相生，徐揚人金紫玉堂之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112289818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冀雍人水冷金寒，雖相生而反貧薄，得火同行爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112306202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄土金，骨肉参啇，冀","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112322586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098338209251354"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雍人頼以隄防，而無泛溢之患也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112322586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇木，水寒木凍，棋無生意，貧夭無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112338970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人，干支火多者，富壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112355354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"术土同垣，制煞反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112371738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月生者，貴顯，運喜南方，東方次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112388122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論甲乙：甲乙春生寅𫑗月，喜逄金火是榮名。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112404506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫將水土推爲用，曲直類趨另一評。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112420890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙生正二月，其木專旺，遇金用金，是木要成材，定見金也。遇火用火，是木火通明之象也。水士此二月休𣦸，難爲用神。若成趨乾、曲直、類象等格，雖無金火，亦可功名。用金不宜見火，用火不宜見金。水用金者，尚宜水印，用火，最嫌水金相戰。且如甲木遇申庚，柱有己酉丑辛字扶其金旺，皆吉如金。旣輕遇火而行火地，難以金爲用。若辛字虚立干支，别無金位，只是常人。甲日丙透，不遇梟煞，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098440135000075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得寅辰二字，多兼以身旺行火地，皆主富貴。桂不忌丁，惟怕丙，如有去配之神，亦不執定，四柱無官專用食傷，身旺行火地，亦主利名。如水火金互相攻戰，更無去配，乃下命也。獨步云：甲乙生春月。庚辛干上逢，離宫推富貴，坎地却爲㐫。是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙夏生四五月，庚辛帶水却爲宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112437274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土神未月連金用，不透傷官貴可知。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112453658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙夏生，乃食傷，與財爲用，如火土不露，只是金水運行，金水得宜。如甲用庚壬有恨，行東則吉。若丙丁庚辛互露，行西不吉。專用丙丁，不遇金水，柱有比肩，行東大發。如戊巳透千，更無水佐行西，雖云：向禄以不吉論，乙見壬庚，兩露干頭，行西富背，若是火透行東𤼵，遇火無水，反焚其主。故甲乙二日在夏，宜用比肩，用火上不宜見金水，用金水不宜見火。十如庚申、壬午、乙𫑗、戊寅、庚辰、壬午。乙未、壬乍二命用金水。丙辰、乙未、甲申、己巳、丙寅、乙未、甲申、乙丑二命用火土，皆吉命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098441892347945"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙秋生兩様言，乙多金貴甲单尊。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112470042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩干飛臨無射月，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112486426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊内有財官要印存。甲水秋生，不宜金多，見印則吉，不宜水多，多則𣴑。乙不忌金多，得印則貴，俱忌火土傷官壞印。如甲生八月，正官忌丁𫑗火局，運順行，不妨貴。柱有壬𰤌子辰之水，雖有火，行南亦吉。如用土𠔥官人墓。名利難進。甲生九月，宜比肩及亥𫑗未佐之，或得一金一火，人格無破，皆爲吉論。若亥申庚、己酉丑類不遇丙丁戊巳，别是一用，或趨乹胞胎煞印，皆可言吉。柱戊巳透，要身旺行旺方可，不宜再露。火金用金，不宜見火，土用火土，不宜見金。如只用金辛虛露，别無地支之金，只是平常。乙日九月戌中原有戊辛丁，得遇己酉丑庚辛，申辰須見壬癸亥子之印，方妙。丁火配制無妨，如専用戊，内無破，只以富斷。若金火互相攻戰，及兩干只是火局，又行火地，乃驅馳不足之命，如丙申、戊戌、甲午。乙亥狀元，尚書，是甲趨乹，又地天交泰。己亥甲戊。乙亥癸未，官給事，己運𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098440135016459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙冬生木本枯，若逄金土反宜乎。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112486426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金多成格爲官印，用火","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112502810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872336662539/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0wB3MaaB1Wen3n7YFjpkgMtRTi4%3D","uri":"read/HY1059/6/ref/1kob4lj19t5vw/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"尢丶","variants":"尤","charPicId":"7456690872336662539"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524112502810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𭒡水土𢾾。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112502810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙冬生，本印無金火、土，則不足持印之美，柱多申酉、庚、辛、巳丑，乃擬煞印、官印格，作上命論。如甲只一辛乙只一庚，干支別無金透藏，又不有金地官露無根，虛名虛利。如得丙丁，戊巳食傷兩旺行東南運發達，若壬丙相見，丁癸相持，皆不吉。用壬癸印，行丙丁，巳午方梟，遇食刑戰，不吉。用申酉官。煞，若水太盛，亦不作吉，當細詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生春季夏間來，丙火干頭作壽胎。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112519194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊本是財壬是印，運臨酉地雨風摧。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112535578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生三月，與夏間，以丙戊壬爲用神，行酉地，向禄本吉，豈知是壬丙戊敗𣦸之地，有此爲用運行其中皆不作吉論。□辛亥、丁酉、甲辰、丙寅，是貴命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098392252678182"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生秋月主逄財，印綬官星併帶來。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112551962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運轉南方名利顯，傷多只恐子星乖。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112732186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲日生七八月，官煞印綬多，又見戊巳土財，運行南傷煞之地，官貴太𨓺，宜行剥削之方，乃得中和。主進爵加禄。但火金交戰，頼財生貴，子終有損。經云：木嗣併絕於南，子息則損，縱有别生，如癸酉辛。酉、甲申、戊辰、巳未、癸酉、甲寅、己巳二命倶行南運，雖進職，無子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申酉月煞官俱，莫要猜疑作混看。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112748570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干上再逢庚字透，地支煞黨總一般。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112764954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申日生八月，莫言官煞混柱中，辛庚多，總作煞論，遇甲扶身及制煞皆吉。若火多無水，盗氣不吉。如遇己酉丑時，亦非金神，皆以煞論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生八月禄當時，最怕卯丁來破之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112781338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誰信北行終富","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112797722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098441892331561"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，運南有水亦能支。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112797722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生八月，辛官得時，柱遇𫑗丁，水局本畏，如順行運經北地，其火遇制，不能害金，不可言𫑗丁玷之。不貴。若原無水破，帶病行東南，則眞不吉。如柱有壬癸子辰亥水，下不遇土行南，亦能發達。若此月柱無火土用印，再行水地，盜𥁞金氣，亦不爲吉，勿執官印之各。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅庚透夏春生，煞淺身強最有情。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112814106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃如逄時月下，却將高貴反常評。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112830490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲寅日生春夏，柱遇庚金，煞淺身強，本吉。緑春夏庚金力輕，遇乙刃，與煞暗合，自旺無倚，不作吉論。若庚金有根，或别有庚字，不在此諭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申春月喜重庚，壬乙相逄人帝庭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112846874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無乙只宜名利淺，丙丁玷破作常評。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112863258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098464646348835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲日春生，庚金多遇有乙壬亥丑取貴，無乙則減。若遇丙丁重戰，金力輕，不勝火尅，乃不足之命須。有印去配方可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌干支三兩重，火金却喜格中逢。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112879642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無金火復行水，此命終須主困窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112896026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生九月，若有兩三重甲戌干頭宜一丙，或一庚一戊，得地支申辰，可言成人。如干支無金火，又行。水地則無用，倘運得火鄉，可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690887298269203/1-a502dd40fff26905.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=LyoFTriFWaAiX0pEitPiU02mZEA%3D","uri":"read/HY1425/9/ref/1koleu91mxb1k/1-a502dd40fff26905.webp","fontType":1,"components":"䒑犭𨾏","variants":"獲","charPicId":"7456690887298269203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其福。若身弱上火多，亦不足之論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日如逄乙亥時，庚金透出喜乙妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112912410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁若也無相混，歲運申庚名利齊。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112928794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲日逢乙亥，時趨乾格，喜柱有庚合乙，故忌見丙丁害庚及泄主之氣。歲運遇申庚，主功名，忌行主。𣦸，用敗火焚之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098338209300506"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生季月乙巳時，壬癸推他作印奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112945178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土相逄名利遂，水金運底更多非。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112961562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生季月，有財官等物，時遇乙丑、己巳，宜見壬癸印助，非金神忌水之論，逄士火則發財金水之方。不利别月及癸酉時，忌見壬癸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日無他丑巳時，金神格也定非疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112977946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤黄運遇成名利，水木之方又不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524112994330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲日他處，别無取用，遇乙丑、己巳，乃金神格，宜行火士運，忌入金水方衝拆作不吉，論主稱意中亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生冬月亥午多，以亥破午反中和。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113010714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局中更得申庚用，定主功名掇顯科。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113027098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午冬生遇子時，格全印綬喜同支。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113043482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫言𣦸敗爲無","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113059866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098464646365219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用，柱有酉辛貴莫疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113059866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生冬月，亥午字多，謂之兩門遇貴。甲木𣦸午，庚金敗，午本塞否之象，遇亥子共支，甲木生亥，乹天。庚方否而反忝。如甲午日生子時，莫言金逄𣦸敗，得酉金𦔳之，皆富貴之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日冬生水盛期，高明不遇嘆支離。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113076250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歳時如得辛庚見，運入東南夢叶羆。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113092634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木冬生本印，遇金土則有用，若柱得辛庚、己酉丑，有一字，或得行西方，發逹，名利如火士多互見。則兩用不専，顧此失彼，亦不稱情。若只見丙丁火，戊巳土，輕微得遇，東南之地，忽然發蹟，忌見金水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲在春生乙在秋，煞官重叠福優游。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113109018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲秋春乙如多遇，有印須知亦貴儔。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113125402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木春生，官煞多，要印𦔳之則吉。乙木秋生，官煞多，遇印亦富貴。若甲生秋，乙生春，官煞少，富貴多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098441892364329"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則不貴，無印尢不利。如庚申、甲申、甲申、庚午，煞重木𣦸，無印困窮。庚寅、庚辰、甲申、壬申、甲日春生。煞多有印，富如丁酉、癸𫑗、甲申、壬申，甲木春生，煞純有印，貴。如乙酉、乙酉、乙酉、壬午，乙木秋生。純煞有印貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙春逄金火期，分行南北利名宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113141786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火宜南地金宜北，反此而行兩不時。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113158170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙生正二月，金爲用神無火戰，宜行北地，主名利。火爲用神無水金重戰，宜行南地，則可名利。如原火局行南方，木被火焚，故用金見火人火方，用火見水人水地，乃平常之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙生炎火土敷，西行營利貴難圖。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113174554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行東遇刼成家業，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113190938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883221651495/1-5c5ef78974cd5e72.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FUIRNLv0J1yiSF0eOezpaRrzdiI%3D","uri":"read/HY0893/13/ref/1kow22zmyceus/1-5c5ef78974cd5e72.webp","fontType":1,"components":"亻十𠃊⺝","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690883221651495"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524113190938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水西通甲怕枯。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113190938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木夏生，遇火土露，本爲用神，行西見金，乃捨去火土用金，金遇原火交戰，亦不能爲用，乃來而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098392252727334"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"來去而不去，只是營利之輩，莫言見貴禄，便□富貴。若行東則吉。原有壬癸水生，不足破用。如甲日遇火土重，遇水生，行南與西，俱不爲吉。乙日遇官印，虚露西地，吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生春月見金強，酉丑亥逄大吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113207322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錯節盤根喜琢削，如行南地反爲殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113223706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙木春正旺，錯節盤根，非金強不成噐，故宜琢削。如柱有庚辛、巳酉丑，爲官煞混，宜丁火制煞。歲運見丑酉亥爲吉，如生巳月，逆行辰𫑗寅亦吉。若行火木旺地，傷去其官不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生卯月見金功，運得水金去火通。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113240090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子酉中應許貴，火臨相聚格還空。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113256474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰辛巳時中遇，乙巳逄牛總一同，水金運底成功業，木火相逄反落空。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113272858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098440135098379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙生卯月，用金，不宜見丙火在干，引領支中之火，及木相㑹，皆壊格局。宜行金水之地，去火木則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日春冬時遇辰，再逄辛巳一般諭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113289242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如行印地分榮貴，只怕丙丁損用神。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113305626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日春冬遇庚辰辛巳時，只是一用，遇壬癸子辰之印，可言富貴，混則富，若見火多損用，乃小人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日春生用丙丁，水金不遇妙南行。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113322010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜西北𠔥歸墓，身旺無梟水地平。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113338394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙木春生身旺，以丙丁爲用，柱無金水，行南地發福，怕逄水金，及會木人墓。若身用此，行北不妨透。士不忌水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙逢辰巳午未時，就裏藏","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113354778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876069953572/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=OLGcYEdGxH24kFB%2FwFYRCB7VHuE%3D","uri":"read/HY0653/23/ref/1kob7zqcc89x2/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp","fontType":1,"components":"上丄⺝八","variants":"與","charPicId":"7456690876069953572"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524113354778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未易知。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113354778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得土金皆有用，只恐旺處更無依。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113371162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098401987723316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙木不拘提綱，得辰巳午未時，行人金地，或入火士，便爲有用。若人亥𫑗末，地柱原有一二字㑹成。木局全不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏生乙木遇壬庚，運向西方禄自榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113387546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丙若無局内見，讀書應許有功名。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113403930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙生夏月，遇庚壬二字，行西方擬貴，若見丙丁主平常。如庚壬有根，行旺金，歲運是讀書秀才必中。如坐己丑日，得壬癸印，亦吉，酉日不堪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙曰秋生官最強，喜逄辛煞反榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113420314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇牛宜見𭒡南火，微水扶持入廟廊。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113436698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日秋官本庚宜見煞則利，無煞雖办名，未若煞而易成。若官煞互見，遇印綬則無𭒡，孤庚無煞，則名利進退，或白身異路之擬。今世達官多用煞，故煞勝官，若遇丙火及士無印人南不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098338209316890"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日如逄辛煞多，見丁相擊，無柰却。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113453082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺金去火翻爲吉，靑赤交持名利薄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113469466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日金多見丁火相戰，不吉。丁丑時不忌。原有丁火，再行見丁，制伏太遍，運行去火旺金之方，又吉。若入火木會旺之地，用神雖倚，乃虛名虚利，柱中見丙，皆不利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙𫑗坐禄見財官，庚辛帶水利名看，不論何月時辰巳，丑午相逄亦類觀。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113485850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日逄丑辰巳午時，俱財官煞印、食神之奇，四時皆作一用，伹金水互見，乃功名之象，若庚被丙傷。辛被丙合，無實用不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生己酉丑月中，最喜時支一様逄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113502234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬再來年月𦔳，千紅萬紫感春風。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113518618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098464646529059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日生己酉丑月，更逄己酉丑時，柱中若得印佐，或行印地，皆主富貴。古歌云：六乙生逄己酉丑局。中切忌財星守，若還行運到南方，𬋩取其人壽不久。又云：乙木生居酉，切勿逢己丑，富貴坎離宫，貧。窮申酉，守如癸𫑗辛酉，乙酉、丁丑，此命平常七十三人。𫑗地𣦸二子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生亥月時遇丙，年月逄丁作三奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113535002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐丑𠔥戌引從貴，如專己酉另詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113551386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙生亥月印綬，如乙丑日丙戌時，天干三丑引戌從，作大貴㸔。若乙酉則無前引，乙奇地巳則支衝。亥，大减分數。此煞印格，亦有輕重𠫭詳。水多則喜土制，如孟重侍郞，乙亥、丁亥、乙丑、丙戌，崔棟御史。日干乙酉不□，然官止七品，乂無子，可例見也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木生春旺弟嫌兄，誰道無情反有情。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113567770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或火或金成一用，不逄金火格多評。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113584154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098440135114763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木一春本旺，財官俱絶，更遇比刼無情。如遇金或火爲用，反頼比肩之功，可以論褔，無金火平常。如甲得庚辛申、己酉丑亥，一用，宜水。又如丙丁火無金水破，比肩旺食反吉。趨乹格亦宜比肩，又是。一用如生三月，别有取用，亦賴比肩。又乙日遇金，局無丙透，又是一用；遇丙丁身旺無水，又是一用。𩔗象一格，亦宜比肩，兄弟成則貴，衝拆不論此格，木生三月，亦有金土之用。其甲乙得庚辛官虚露。比刼分奪，合又無别金，亦無别情，不吉。古歌云：陰木生逢己酉丑，生於子月貴難成，再行金水傷殘。害，運轉南方，還福清。如丙午、癸巳、乙亥丙子，是丐者；辛巳、庚子、乙丑、丁𫑗是平人，丁酉運跌𣦸。王戌辛亥乙亥丙子𭒡辛字𫑗，運不如甲，合寅丙辛貴，由貢而擢御史，無子。古歌日：乙木逄陽遇子多名爲聚貴福重峩。局中最怕南離地，官煞來衝無柰何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木生夏月節枝横，此地財傷要刼生。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113600538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暢茂繁華根未盛，刼多用重兩宜情。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113616922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098510041317388"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木在夏生火士之時，若干頭，再見火士，最要刧多生火火生土，爲財，以此比肩多，能任莫言比肩多。反分其財也。古歌云：术逄壬癸水漂流，日主無根枉度秋。歳運若行財旺地，反㐫爲吉佐王侯。如甲寅、庚午、乙𫑗、戊寅、乙未、壬午、甲子、丙寅，二命比肩，所以皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論丙丁。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524113633306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁正二印當春，壬癸多逄格最嗔。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267200521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不忌淨財宜見化，遇辰月愛子連申。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267216905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁春月，以木爲印綬，水爲官煞，丁壬合化最宜。若見官只用官，見煞只用煞，不宜混雜，怕水多不能生火，徒有印名。或一壬二壬，一癸二癸，得去配，亦不爲害。不忌干頭虚金，行南俱吉，柱原金水多。又行北地，更無去配，皆不足之論。行南稍吉。如官煞原淺，行北亦吉。若原金遇衝擊提綱，伐木壞印。則㐫。生三月本是傷官，又宜金水之用，如㑹申子，全主𤼵逹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098440135131147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁夏月本炎蒸，富貴須慿别象稱。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267233289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水相逢渾有頼，用傷格破作高僧。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267249673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁夏生，丙有炎上倒衝類象等格，丁有飛晶、禄等拱格，如合不破，皆主富貴不成。前格或見一壬。亥癸及申子辰全運行西方，以富貴論。有戊巳爲用，梟煞相征，行西亦發丁，忌行寅戌，丙亦嫌墓𫑗。酉亥運吉，亦傷尅不成之困。如非格局，又無用神，及有用破壞，皆主不吉，多避穀休糧之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690889039659044/1-f5e8cddf011acec1.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=UnFAHCgSFwiWcsAmbJm3Q8nopew%3D","uri":"read/HY0684/1/ref/1kp495xr3er6v/1-f5e8cddf011acec1.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土匕車","variants":"輩","charPicId":"7456690889039659044"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁秋月總爲財，丁可通融丙忌哉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267266057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日怕逄兼怕刃，運行南地細推排。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267282441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁秋生，金得時令，俱作財論。若金水太盛，火能任，獨丁丙火怕逄煞，官多弱甚，無制則傷。如丙生七月遇煞地，或透煞官，宜見戊巳爲壽星，再行官貴發逹，怕逄子辰𫑗地。八月丙𣦸，若用多則秀而不實。如壬水得制，或𫑗辰時從化，得陽字多行旺地亦可，但不宜甲木併比肩相見，九月近冬時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098392252776486"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴不多，或辰巳時是一貴格，亦不要官煞多，若類炎上格亦貴。若遇庚辛爲用，四柱不宜見官煞戊。巳爲用，不宜見甲乙壬癸，如用壬亥，别是一格，其中更怕官煞及水土相戰。丁生七月，遇官煞及財。重宜行南則吉，不用木印。若生新秋遇刼，重逆行南不吉，順則可。若無官煞，遇戊士，或支遇子辰㑹。水行南北皆吉，惟忌子午寅運，未有咎。遇壬寅時，雖作化木論，以金地無木，情不能化故也。八月棄命就財宜財格，己酉丑全爲美，丁酉爲主，不利官星，比肩、印綬無忌，行南亦吉。忌寅午子嵗運九月。遇煞官，或近冬界從化，但忌士木。如用庚辛，行木地，富貴，亦忌子運午運，用戊巳，宜行弱地，若水木。在内亦爲不足。大抵丙丁二火，內怕弱，丁怕旺，宜細詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁冬月用當垣，從化都宜不帶根。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267298825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞當時嫌日旺，無生清用便爲恩。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267315209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁冬月水，當時官煞旺。若從化作上命㸔。如丙生此際，遇壬癸，干透相連，或申子辰會柱有辛則。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499463249932"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化有戊巳則制，皆主功名。遇丁傷辛，有壬透不妨，遇甲是梟，有庚制方去。丙生子月財官，柱無壬亥。及坐申，皆以財官論，怕衝刑破壞，及分官日弱，乃秀而不實。其煞格忌日主休囚𣦸敗之地，及煞旺。去食拆合拆化之方，丙生丑月，有戊巳爲用，宜身旺，怕木壞之。丑爲財庫，如透辛庚，不宜見官煞，要日主徤旺則吉，破用主弱則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日秋生官煞多，無生得化致中和。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267331593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有生無制皆言弱，兩地財名坦復波。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267347977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"内生八月，官煞多宜食制合化，俱士口，怕人，子辰𫑗鄉，如無制合，遇梟食，縱行旺地，不吉。如九月近冬。遇時上一位貴格，逄梟偏印，月有戊食，運人身旺寅辰方吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申四月戊飛來，萬頃田園主富哉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267364361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕梟神同透干，平生辛苦命安排。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267380745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098392252760102"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申日生，四月，得透士食神坐禄，主富。若遇壬煞甲食，如用壬見戊，莫言食神制煞，四月水涸遇旺。戊去之不吉，柱得水局，或壬亥一二字方可。忌行日弱及壬丙敗𣦸休囚之地，若士多，雖是辰時，主旺用旺，皆不作上命㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙臨申位遇時辰，春夏生人煞最循。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267397129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水運逄雖阜澤，辰壬酉亥子申分。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267413513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申日遇壬辰時，申辰㑹煞。春夏火旺相，不以㐫論。秋冬水旺相，火受水制，仝頼食神制煞，主險中。求各發逹，險中全仗主強，辰壬酉，亥子申耶，皆主休敗之地，吉㐫宜細詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙生冬月喜逄辛，格内土來作吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267429897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上不妨壬字見，有丁合化俱無嗔。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267446281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙生冬月，喜見辛化，宜土制爲食，乃吉時月煞，不以爲害。若有丁尅辛，時遇壬合，則丁不暇害辛，各。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098464646397987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"全其化歲運逢丁，尅傷妻子，輕者稍可，重者尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙坐三支寅午戌，月逄火局總皆同。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267462665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格成炎上多名利，土富嫌臨水戰功。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267479049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙坐寅午戌，日，及生月，又得局全，不遇水破，卽炎上倒飛類象從旺，見士亦吉，忌見水類飛，失局失。垣則㐫。如丙寅、甲午、丙戌、乙未、庚寅、戊寅、丙戌、甲午二命合格，富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙己相逢本是傷，官星就見又何妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267495433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火時上旺宜金水，時夏惟寅宜另詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267511817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙生季月，内有戊巳，或透或不透，不透從士無中生有，得寅、午戌時俱入格，土透亦吉，不忌官星。如遇刃及照象、虎人、中堂等格，非傷妻，則少子，官煞重遇則禍。如遇煞，以煞論，此格最喜比肩。如六月□寅宜另詳之，不宜卯未□乙而反傷正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690885209899047/1-0c70f3eed55e9a79.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2F9TTF67CUwhTNwVx7GFziDrgF94%3D","uri":"read/HY0888/2/ref/1kp49wdf5pw6a/1-0c70f3eed55e9a79.webp","fontType":1,"components":"冂丨","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690885209899047"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098392252792870"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生十月得寅時，化象成都富貴推。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267528201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若再丁來曁辰戌，戊分官貴庻人期。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267544585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁生亥月，遇寅時，成正化格，富貴。若再見丁則分官，見辰則官人墓，見戌字，戊癸乃拆合傷官，遇申。酉乃破木之用，此等皆壊格，不吉。如無此玷，乃大富貴。行午、巳、申、酉地，吉中主㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬化木卯羊寅，無破提綱利祿新。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267560969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官旺且宜身旺地，兎逄","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267577353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868209336339/1-a904fefeecbcbf07.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FQxRWxEbDHgeQzyqZKZXlwbPh3Y%3D","uri":"read/HY0785/2/ref/1kp44yll34011/1-a904fefeecbcbf07.webp","fontType":1,"components":"八𠃔","variants":"兑","charPicId":"7456690868209336339"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524267577353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變虎愁坤。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267577353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁壬十月，官印俱時，乃正化，其寅、𫑗未偏垣，寅忌行申，𫑗忌行酉，未忌行寅，餘亦忌戌子、午、巳運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁日秋生格最隹，無根有煞兩榮華。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267593737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有根無煞行南域，好似良瓊玷缺瑕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267610121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁日陰柔宜弱柱，官輕行南不士。若遇土官，煞輕行北大發，柱無比印行兩地皆吉。若七八月寅時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098441892413481"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不作化㸔，九月化煞化木，宜近冬界及行木地，吉，忌午申寅巳。秋月柱中用煞透戊巳，忌行寅午子。運九月用戊巳，忌見甲乙，若六月界作七月推，更無金水，逆行不吉，順行則可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁𫑗秋冬煞疊昌，休來印綬𦔳身強。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267626505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"美乎亥子𭒡重火，火木如來反主傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267642889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁𫑗一日，乃煞印之源，能任官煞之多，柱多亥子，及運遇之，皆吉。若比肩印生，反不爲利。行金水大發行比刼，及原有士神，子申運㐫憲如高文都薦丁亥、癸𫑗，丁耶庚子，柱多亥子煞印爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生最怕午離間，金水無逄名利難。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267659273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運徃","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267675657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868209336339/1-a904fefeecbcbf07.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FQxRWxEbDHgeQzyqZKZXlwbPh3Y%3D","uri":"read/HY0785/2/ref/1kp44yll34011/1-a904fefeecbcbf07.webp","fontType":1,"components":"八𠃔","variants":"兑","charPicId":"7456690868209336339"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524267675657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西成利祿，如行東地半愁顔。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267675657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁生五月，日元自旺，若遇金水不成，飛晶拱祿。戊己不透，只支土爲用，行西則土生財官，亦堪利禄。行東原無格局，而用士，士受木尅，竟無倚頼，其主自旺，只宜人静及營托可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098401987739700"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁根石竹水源胎，金水鄉來道利開。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267692041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌方行補，弱官傷職掌","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267708425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690866440028172/1-4b9ce29fff36c8d3.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=gK0%2BqlUMRyA0H%2FlTIFiCd%2BvJrgg%3D","uri":"read/HY0707/14/ref/1kob6sxm521b9/1-4b9ce29fff36c8d3.webp","fontType":1,"components":"广𪢴从","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690866440028172"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524267708425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267708425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁火，房日之源，太陰之餘也。逢酉則明，遇寅則㓕，行弱陰則明，行旺陽則昧。今人取火，截竹擊石，得之。如行弱地，反見麗明，行旺地，不吉。惟化格則是木用木忌行金地。如生秋冬，忌行午及元地。命有土木忌行申子，非化木，亦忌寅申，夏生忌寅戌，春生木用，雖午晦昧，原有煞官，又爲吉論。木印忌西所忌之方，輕則非，重則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁日蛇提酉丑逄，水金運底利名通。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267724809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中原有尤爲上，寅戌行來起戰鋒。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267741193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁生四月，或丑酉日，或得金局，行西富貴，遇金水土亦吉。兩行俱是有情之地，惟寅、午戌及子中有。戰，倘傷枝葉，或非咎也，𨓺此又吉。如甲子、己巳、丁酉、庚戌、癸未、丁巳、丁巳、戊申，俱行戊子運，㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098401987772468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生卯月卯寅提，雖化壬兮本木枝。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267757577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木火却當官煞旺，酉申運底動離悲。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267773961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁生寅𫑗，遇官化及煞，乃印之本行，北方官煞當其旺地，主功名𤼵財。若行申酉，雖是財官反傷木。印不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁日逄辰時戊申，傷官時内有生壬。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267790345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星若出干頭上，㑹水相征禍始侵。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267806729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁生三月傷官，如干上見煞，地支巳有水局，戊若字及水透局，全發逹，行子申酉地，傷官見官、水土。相戰，輕則非灾，重則破滅，稱意中亡。如癸丙辰、未宁卯、戊申、戊子、丙辰、丁𫑗、戊申，合此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳居蛇弟襲兄，寅申月令喜壬庚。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267823113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩行運用尊榮貴，相擊提綱禍始成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267839497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098441892446249"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁己巳巳二日丁日申月，己日寅月，得壬水透干，原本有地未全得用神倚頼，則成富貴，再見此運。三刑全，輕則杖配，晦駁，重則危㓕。原有煞刃者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872336662539/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=sEiJIKWnn6zXF4lzYqPU7xsaNFU%3D","uri":"read/HY1059/6/ref/1kob4lj19t5vw/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"尢丶","variants":"尤","charPicId":"7456690872336662539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㐫。如順行不遇財官，乃屠宰奔趨，亦無大咎。如享富貴中有大險。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁戊傷官要見財，原無偏喜運重來。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267855881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄寅戌雖爲咎，誰信子申更主灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267872265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁日遇戊傷官，喜見庚辛，申己酉丑爲財，柱無宜行財地，丁生夏月用戊，冝行金火，方利名至寅戌。主旺一停，或尅戰晦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690866318098468/1-804fbfd41e1f95f8.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=lduNAKPUy6Oc0D%2FSSNutktFPTjo%3D","uri":"read/HY0747/2/ref/1kp7y6ea96ek3/1-804fbfd41e1f95f8.webp","fontType":1,"components":"氵凵〢一冖巾","variants":"滯","charPicId":"7456690866318098468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"行子申一戰。丁生七月用戊金木伏中，行午戌寅停節子寅運防禍九月不遇甲寅得戊，透清者貴，互用者富。丑壬中行大吉，運遇甲乙，亦可言富貴。忌寅午，如流年㑹煞㑹傷。基之地，禍福響應，□長者發久，短者易聚散。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論戊巳","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267888649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499463315468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳當春官煞強，火金相見主榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267888649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支財透無臨刼，運向財鄉田舎郎。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267905033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊生正月，透官煞，只以煞論。柱得水，行南則吉，火雖印亦不宜多，多則燥。土行火地，遇午刃旺甲𣦸。是木遇火盛，用亦被焚；土燥木虛，官煞有名無實。若金水多，行此地則吉。若金水多無印，行北方亦㐫生二月正官，要日干有財，行南可功名禄利，遇甲則從煞論。柱有財不忌印旺行南吉若偏正印。多無財，行北亦吉。若財遇印，多行午地，引領原火，火土燥水不能制盜木之氣，羊刃無情，雖得富貴。未免災咎，重則危甚，俱忌刑衝。巳生正月，乃官，再透丙火，官印兩行俱吉，忌午戊運及衝提之方。遇子丑亥戌時，合化，遇乙，是煞，遇印無水，行北亦吉。若水金多見，再行金水不吉，行南發逹，生二月。是煞最宜透出官煞爲美。有財無印，順行功名，逆行北不吉。若印多原無水，行北亦吉，大抵宜行木。火忌行金水，行午戌酉運，亦宜有灾傷。戊生三月，遇有壬癸申子，柱無煞刼，行金水方𤼵福。如遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098338209349658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刼財便發，亦尅妻損子，反覆見甲寅時是一格，可云富貴。却忌壬癸，喜見庚金，如遇財局，兼遇庚金。不見梟大發，見煞遇梟不吉。巳生三川，最宜財官，全乎一格，或是傷官生財，及丑亥，俱擬富貴用。財亦吉。若遇庚辛巳酉丑，金不見火木行金水方皆利禄。如時上一位貴，格局清者，可發科目。又云：戊巳正月，干見金局，及透金，最不宜見木，在柱，遺患。後行患旺地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690885452922891/1-d8ba0304780aae04.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=m2o57x%2FOTc4pCOEPxOJ9AGBVoGo%3D","uri":"read/HY0710/1/ref/1kodrli0thedm/1-d8ba0304780aae04.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土亠𭾱","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690885452922891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用用煞，不忌見金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳當時夏日期，土焦宜水乃相滋。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267921417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木金得格成其器，印綬輕時怕水瀰。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267937801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊巳夏生當垣，印又生扶土過，宜微水滋澤，其間俱要金水作用。若用印怕財，行財鄉不吉，且如戊。日午月戊寅日甲寅時，戊午時乃木用，富貴可言。六月木庫用甲乙，須透天干甲寅時功名。餘甲則否遇乙，亦不宜混煞，清者取貴，濁者不利。俱宜微水，不爲壞印。如用金四月遇庚辛，巳酉丑亥多則可用見壬水，或水局破月丙火，行金水地，利禄人也。若無水，更遇甲丙，𣅜不吉。五六月金氣輕伏，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499463331852"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"可言用，須多方取。如六月用在七月，近秋作六月推者，遇金多順行，亦可言用行遇金水方發財。戊生夏若遇偏財，時上及金𦔳之，行西方發財。若露丁火無財印綬論，遇壬癸乙字及化格，富貴怕衝。提再人財方巳日四月，得庚辛酉丑申全，日支又居酉丑，不見甲乙𫑗未丁字行西北，大發，忌入戌。寅二運若戌于丑亥時，以官印煞印論，行官煞方皆吉。五月生遇木，行東方，可言名利，用金絕木宜。水如絕木，得金局，行人北方亦吉。六月遇官煞，行東方，可擬富貴，西行次之，亦怕人旺，用金水近秋。則可連，宜順行，反則不吉。大抵戊巳二干，用金水，不宜露見火木；用火木，不宜露見金水，中間又有拱禄、拱貴格，宜細詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳秋生本泄氣，少宜壬癸怕多逄，如専金用來青。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267954185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤縱有財名亦酌中。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267970569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊巳秋生，本用金水，遇火則害用，遇木則害身。如此日生，遇庚辛壬癸，身旺雨行，功名人也。若遇癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098441892479017"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化合不利水地火地則吉，丁乙不忌。若全金用性，怕丙甲不吉。如遇丙辰時，宜壬透制，及有寅字或支隠甲丙，遇庚壬，在干屏之行北，發達一度人。寅午運二仇旺起不吉。若歲月丙居申子辰上，雖無壬透子丑辰巳運，于得壬癸庚辛，去玷會用爲財名。如無此西行，亦頗可遂意。若丙有庚及申露，或隠寅無制，𬧔蹬人也。運入午寅，重則危，輕則病，非尅傷。若丙年丁月連見，及丙甲俱見，小人如無所忌兩行發達，亦忌丙甲歲運大利。辰巳子丑運，若歲時遇丁作印綬，逄癸丑正化傷丁，則貴。如兩癸。争合宜行戊地，兩戊争合，宜行癸地。若辛露怕見乙，俱忌財多，有官亦𭒡丁辛在内，雖不爲害，迤逓。害地不吉。若印旺俱人，怯瘋之病，尅妻害子。若生九月遇甲寅時，則是一格，宜臨冬首，如庚申時近。冬無玷破，及火木，亦福，亦有化印格之擬。己士七月見𫑗未日，又見甲戌、甲子、乙丑、乙亥時，互見官。煞富貴不宜透庚，如庚居寅午戌上，亦無害，此非正氣官煞，惟忌財多。若用金水，不宜見木生八月。遇丑亥時，叠見乙，多，皆富貴。甲戊甲子時，亦要煞混方吉，以虚官無實用也。若壬申癸酉時，則是一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098392252825638"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用不宜見木，九月生亥𫑗未遇巳時亦可言吉清者貴。遇合不宜露煞，從合亦貴，坐煞亦妙，惟涀不吉。若庚申、辛酉等金爲用，宜見官印，亦主利禄。受木破者不吉。忌行火木及午寅運。如用官煞，行戌午運及木用人墓，用金敗印者，忌行午寅木火歲運如得時上一煞，身弱不戰尅者，許登黄甲戰争。者，稱意中亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳冬生財利濵，柱中金水喜相親。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524267986953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水金得局空梟煞，貴比班超富季倫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268003337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊巳冬生遇化，則是一格，不忌官星，更怕梟煞，若棄命就財，又是一格。戊日庚申時，無火木，遇甲子。辰無火木，主大冨貴。若戊申日遇金水，或壬癸時，亦是化格，不忌乙木。如此者大貴，畏行衝提折□。若遇甲寅時作煞論，可許功名。年月見甲及金相攻不吉。遇庚辛金爲用，原作丙辰之玷，行壬癸子。丑辰甲重則巳，及遇申酉方，亦當稱意。一度行寅午戌丙危，輕則費患尅傷。己日遇子戌丑亥時，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499463348236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一、用見𫑗未，忌透金水，若申酉時爲用，亦可言貴。不忌中忌乙，亦忌火木中行。如戊日合得水局，𣓪。命就財合禄化火，四格無煞破，皆富貴。巳日從木亦吉。巳日丑月透金，傷官及用財，二格行金水。申酉巳辰万吉用，時上一貴亦可言功名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日申時金水生，更兼水局禄財成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268019721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無梟煞來侵格，職位崇高莫與京。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268036105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊日秋冬金水旺局，遇庚申時合禄格，不遇梟煞之玷。及戊申日，主大富貴。夏生有水，木金制合，亦主大富貴，享用春生難言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊干合化在秋冬，遇癸逄壬化始通。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268052489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火地財名功業就，最嫌梟煞兩相逄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268068873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合化格：見壬癸爲然，行火地𠮷，見兩戊亦不妨，怕丙甲己，其丁乙輕無害。如丙辰時水多壬鮮不甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098401987788852"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日如逢甲寅時，却從煞格莫拘疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268085257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運宜木火通名利，金水屏干入是非。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268101641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊日寅時，生春夏宜制則貴，生秋最怕庚露木衰，乃秀而不實。冬陽近木進氣，制稍無忌，亦不宜多。行火木運，功名。如傷官合財格，此寅時爲戰不志。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申辰子日時同，金用壬連水有功。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268118025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰巳丑申爲美運，午寅丙甲土貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268134409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊日生，如坐申子辰及時，亦遇天干庚辛透出，富貴。運行庚申辛酉，子辰丑巳之地，可云遂意若行。寅午戌，丙甲不吉，甚則𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日秋冬兩様之，偏財時見最爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268150793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官歲月𭒡梟","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268167177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098441892511785"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，丑亥不如子戍時。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268167177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊日秋冬，冝見偏財爲羙。丑亥二時，天財入化格貴，有玷折不反。子戌二時，偏財爲吉，忌煞官多與。前同戊巳，秋冬遇庚辛透爲用，行金木方發財，支宜申酉己丑，壬癸申子辰俱吉，遇丙時有水制刅。吉，行金水地不妨，忌梟丙申有根。行人子丑辰巳申酉運俱稱意。丙甲午寅運不吉，戊巳日如用次。則從木論，官煞清行，吉乃富貴，用金水，忌甲丙寅、午戊歳運，輕則耗非，重則危殆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳臨卯位透官星，木火重逢事業成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268183561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順得南方人富貴，水多金重更無情。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268199945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己卯日生耶，或寅亥未月遇申透從火木旺，乃白手成家。如遇金水重重渗洋，日主金重破木，怕行。□戌子運及流年時主之地，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己生季月旺身時，不遇官煞旺何爲。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268216329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命有財官如被","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268232713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098441892528169"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼，運行金水水鄉奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268232713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己生辰戌丑未月，不遇官煞，空旺不吉。若之遇財奪秀，而官不實，行木金水地，倚運亦癸，过此仍旧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日逢乙亥時，豈宜丁火柱中期。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268249097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行木火","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268265481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872336662539/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=rN2cpsKTNAxewMtIimQxASnEB8s%3D","uri":"read/HY1059/6/ref/1kob4lj19t5vw/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"尢丶","variants":"尤","charPicId":"7456690872336662539"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524268265481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堪𣻌，金水重逄不是竒。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268265481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳見重亥，丁爲己梟，亥中壬水，渗洋不利，宜入火木則吉。若行金水，迪争戰，不條不化，加在秋冬，入東南則發，午中一咎，辰丑戍宫一疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
