{"lines":[{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己生辰戍旺根，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268281865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/HY2189/7442287950848589878/1-1738231994299.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=PjZNtzGKG28nKCppVnqsYeuayDM%3D","uri":"read/HY2189/2/ref/1kq45a3rb16vf/1-1738231994299.webp","fontType":1,"components":"艹千大","variants":"","charPicId":"7465643365863931956"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524268281865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木破重重芽未衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268281865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制運更愁驅煞起，煞鄉無謂就降猜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268298249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己生三，凢遇財官，本是一吉，若見煞多，安身□弱，煞嗔身，身官和，可言冨責，清者堪登科甲。若名制鄉擊驅其煞不吉，行八煞旺方，亦奠以旺煞諭。若支遇𫑗木，更入火木則吉，行金水，不冝忌煞入墓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098463744573467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"及午戊辰，土燥焚木，歲運如逄，輕則傷尅，重則危殆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己生夏月用辛庚，遇水西行事業成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268314633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉丑喜連申子吉，如逄木火病非生。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268331017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳生夏月，火藏木泄，若得庚辛透壬癸，及有申子酉丑運，人金水地𤼵財，但見木一位，便破格。忌午。寅戌運，此乃無中生有之奇，行金水吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日如逢戌子時，節當官旺煞何疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268347401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁火印來相援，木進何愁金坐支。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268363785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳日遇甲子、甲戌時，合化宜𫑗未，日支不謂官煞混。若官旺，或兩甲兩己俱是富貴，若被拆合分金。無配及庚申金有根，皆不吉。若金坐寅午戌，局中有木，不忌，亦宜丙丁火印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳坐卯未逢𫑗月，天干透乙身更衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268380169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棄命相從翻富","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268396553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098392252891174"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，如行旺制便生灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268396553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己卯己未日，更坐𫑗月，又透一煞，乃棄命格，不宜丁巳重見，若遇制地旺地，是非競起，不遇所忌，發。逹功各","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日如逢丑寅時，身衰宜印貴無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268412937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行來木火愁金水，四季生人各另推。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268429321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己日用時煞，春不須印，亦同棄論。若非春月純陰俱偏，亦不忌梟。秋生遇乙多最宜，亦要正印，冬怕。水多，行人火木俱吉。如遇丑辰午戌運，專㸔歲會碍此運有咎，非尅傷爲忌。身弱煞旺，吉若財多，更透金水，及用人墓，稱意中亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日加逄戌子時，財官叠見最相宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268445705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生季月多財禄，身旺用衰作别推。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268462089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098463744671771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己生辰戌丑未月，日本旺，若叠見用，或財利禄之人。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268478473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如化土生正月，坐𫑗未更吉，怕制合及寅破忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268494857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"行午戌辰丑鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己丑甲戌、己丑甲子，二品武職。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268511241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午甲戌、己巳甲戌，富貴清高。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268527625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午甲戌、己巳甲子巨富納貴辛巳壬辰：己巳甲戌富貴輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268544009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日秋生本用金，干頭却喜木森森。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268560393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙連三四皆爲吉，遇甲相成入翰林。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268576777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己生秋月本金時，若不露庚辛爲用，見一二乙字，乃煞食前煞後，遇丙亦吉。行火木地，富貴若座下。未𫑗更遇兩甲，亦主功名。若庚辛巳露，甲乙再見，互梋攻㨻反害忌行木火，稍遂金水宜詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳得位號高強，木火雖宜忌火昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268593161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱若無金作梗，一生名利入嵓廊。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268609545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098510041284620"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"勾陳爲土，得位乃逄木之謂。如戊寅、己巳、巳未己亥日，更坐亥𫑗未寅月，方是柱有火，不怕庚辛遇。木火運主功名，若火大旺，焦土焚木，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論庚辛：庚辛春月正逄財，最忌干頭比刼來。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268625929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞要分𭒡混雜，身強用吉乃康哉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268642313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛生正二月，本財遇官煞，只宜獨見，不宜混雜，要身強用吉爲貴。庚生正月，財旺煞生，透煞，只宜煞不宜再見官星。無壬癸戊巳並見日主旺，連行吉地，可言功名。若身坐子午，遇丙透又逄丁位。無戊巳壬癸，運行子戌午方爲咎，若多遇合衝刼，財多身弱，秀而不實，又怕寅午戌及梟食歲□殃。禍速至。如庚坐辰，遇丙或丁，不會火木及刼，則吉。二月同論。二月庚辰日連庚辰時，或庚辰月及間寅字乃是大格，否則又宜丙丁爲官煞遇印之論。此口亦有用傷官者，須細詳之。若庚生春遇乙乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098464646430755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚合化另是一論，大怕身輕財多，身弱，遇刼及水局，水多盗氣，火局銷鎔，驅馳病弱之軰。辛生正二月或透一丙，不宜壬戌、癸亥、壬子、壬申歲運及柱中傍位，再見有丁，却不忌壬運，兩行俱吉若官。煞互見，無去配作混雜論。如遇地衝，刼財太重，行火地亦可，水地不吉，兩月不遇火，亦是營利之徒。清者微名，難作貴論，若寅午戌時，成一妙也。若水多原本是財，生煞見水，屏火不生，皆不爲貴。中亦有沽名吊譽者，太泄困乏。若刼財多，入南頗可，帶火則發。若無水刼，經行亥戌稍可，酉申不遂。若丙合辛只一不遇破，富貴。壬辰時亦有一用，其餘被胡官煞及金破水泛，俱作下論，運行火木之鄉，頗宜再入金水，無望。辛生三月是印格，喜木火，亦有傷官格論，稍不忌水，餘忌如之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛夏月兩分評，遇煞逄官各有情。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268658697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚遇亥壬煞喜制，辛逄丙合利名成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268675081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛夏月，兩千不一。庚生回月，本煞，五六月或遇巳丙及寅、午戌皆煞，得壬亥、癸水制之，無官混格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098392252923942"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"局清者貴，次者富。混壞减論，無制平平。五月午多見，巳亦煞，皆要亥子壬癸制伏，戊巳佐𦔳，皆擬富。貴無則患難困乏，六月同論。辛生四月，乃正官格，遇丙合官，遇丁爲煞，俱作貴論，行西北得時用。官忌壬亥，再行見攻衝，必禍。用煞不忌，得巳午未時爲妙。歲運同五月，煞印在支，亦不宜透，透則宜制，如辛亥日巳午未時亦吉，遇壬無害，旋入金水之地，欠隹原無水，行水亦無害。如辛未、辛卯、辛己等日遇己午未時，行入財宫，方堪甲第魁選，有玷减論六月宜火木，宜向火木運行，忌壬水旺。地不妨癸水，若不遇火木，遇水土刼自旺，更行金水，官煞混雜，太𨓺無制，俱不吉。運忌丑酉亥，乃官。煞投墓，輕者非破尅傷，重者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872336662539/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=rN2cpsKTNAxewMtIimQxASnEB8s%3D","uri":"read/HY1059/6/ref/1kob4lj19t5vw/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"尢丶","variants":"尤","charPicId":"7456690872336662539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛秋月太身強，𫑗未逄支乃吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268691465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚遇午寅宜見水，辛遭丙衆喜非常。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268707849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚金七八月遇煞最吉。坐寅午戌見官煞，宜逄壬癸及印，行南運吉，無行南太𨓺，不宜。九月遇官煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098392252940326"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"清者富貴，亦宜壬癸水。若火局火盛無救，行水遂意，行午寅運，則災生。秋絕無火木氣不吉。若用王癸爲引領，無戊巳破，行水地，亦擬財名。辛金，七八月遇丙二三則吉，行水地發財。若孤立一丙，乃小人也。如無丙遇丁，則不宜重，以煞多則咎。如無火氣，坐亥𫑗未，得甲乙木局，行南大發，午未時可。擬貴九月遇丙合不遇丁，乃是一格，可云富貴。亦忌壬亥，如有戊巳救亦吉。若用煞，只宜煞，怕官混。行火旺運生禍，有官㑹木成局，行火木運𤼵逹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛冬月作傷官，丁丙無逄金水寒。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268724233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙相連分上下，稱心更要識悲歡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268740617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛生冬月，遇官煞，皆擬富貴。如庚生亥子，遇兩官兩煞，一官一煞，俱主利禄。飛禄夾丘，亦吉。如無。官煞宜見財星，原無行財官煞運亦美。若金水自持，更無格局用神，及無木者，貧寒。辛金二煞清者。富貴。若丑亥時乃飛禄，如遇丙亦吉，若虚露丙，亦不濟事。如辛𫑗、辛未日，得木局，及寅午戌時引火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098463744606235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"縱無干火，行火木地亦發。若梟多無火木隠露，行火木不吉。丑月乃印也，遇一煞則吉，官輕者宜行。官旺方若木局行木火，亦主白手成家，士重則埋，水多則沉，宜細詳之。兩干無火木，更無格用，則不。成噐。其夾丘飛禄，怕行官煞方。若己酉丑局無格，遇辰巳時，行水地金地，亦作上命論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚生四月己多逄，壬癸透干作制功。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268757001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南比兩行皆富貴，却嫌戊甲在其中。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268773385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚生四月，遇巳午，多宜見壬亥，如遇丁混有癸，𣅜主功名。如透丙或見戊甲，及官混無癸，破之又無。壬亥减論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛七八比肩來，格局無成又没財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268789769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水用北行爲利禄，逢財争競一時災。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268806153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此乃用水，庚日壬午癸未時，辛日壬辰癸巳時，外己丑己亥時，皆比肩，更無火木，以自旺日爲用，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098392252956710"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逄戊巳，行水地發逹。若行木，及見甲乙，柱原比肩多，庚辛無財，遇財争奪，不可以見財爲吉論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金坐午又爲提，丁巳齊明兩可宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524268822537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支無丙來雜混，水絕肩多作富推。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524338503730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午日生，五月透丁巳，官印俱明，𤼵逹利名。若午多壬午時亦吉。如遇丙煞不利。若從煞格，宜水制。之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己丑庚午庚午丁丑巨富。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524338520114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚居子午月逄寅，官煞相淆干上評。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524338536498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午運中愁咎起，戊壬若遇暗囘明。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524338552882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚子庚午生，寅午戌月，遇煞在柱混淆，更見財多，無水土扶濟，乃弱論。再行子午則灾。若遇壬癸、戊己反爲吉論，如辛丑、庚寅、庚子丙戌，身弱行子，亥運顚困，癸卯、甲寅、庚戌、丙戌，此亦不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金冬月本元疲，壬癸多逄盜日脂。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524338896946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁若來庚更","logicSentenceId":"7577334524338913330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499463381004"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暖，逄温都作利名推。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524338913330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚生冬月本弱，又遇水，多盜氣，須得丙丁火照，乃可謂吉，如無火見財亦可。此言金水傷官，宜見官。煞可以成就功名，終不大就，以本原疲也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚生寒月丙雙存，便是功名利禄人。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524338929714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行運柱中攻戰闘，却愁稱意没荆蓁。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524338946098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚生秋冬，逄兩丙爲夾煞，其勢急矣。名彰乃煞之用，吉者甚吉，㐫者甚㐫。若運行撃觸，煞起及㑹衝。刑之地，其㐫不可當，多不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚逄寅午巳提綱，遇亥同壬利禄昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524338962482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火透干無水制，不堪回首嘆凄凉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524338978866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚生寅午戌巳月，遇壬亥字，功名發財。若丙透無水制，及無印支離，惆張之八。如坐寅午戌，忌丙丁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499446505482"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙寅、丙午、丙戌歲運，輕者悲傷訟耗，重則患難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子秋冬水局全，井欄义格理誠淵。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524338995250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中無火方成貴，青赤交持未是便。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339011634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚子日乃中堂，㑹申辰衝寅午戌中財官干是庚用，地支水局及比肩多方是。若格不全，金水多，則是傷官，如逄丙火煞論，毋執此格言遇丙破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日都宜丑亥時，癸壬相見亦相宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339028018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙逄亦許居名利，土重財多反壞之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339044402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚秋冬遇丑亥時，乃一用，如遇壬癸透，亦吉。本是水用，以火爲副用，且不嫌相見，若士重木多不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚逄壬癸在秋冬，有子生財各利名。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339060786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時歲木星相合見，金方發達見梟平。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339077170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098464646561827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚日秋冬無火，用水爲導引，𠔥癸木乃傷官生財，亦有夾丘之格。壬午丁亥癸未時，或庚寅日庚辰。時庚申日壬午時，怕行午運，此是寅辰日，俱忌辰時戊土入庫，及戊歲運不吉，動傷枝葉，是非顚倒。咎禍不測，有子傷子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未辛卯坐支財，最宜丁丙向干來。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339093554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月生寅卯甲乙透，富比陶朱不用猜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339109938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛未辛𫑗坐財，喜透丁乙爲民，宜寅耶。午未亥月，如用丙，忌丁壬。亥宜火木旺地，不宜水金旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/NA06663/7402466672025534473/1-1735476160980.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=6afzEOotsMjxHf3f%2BUYJf71yl1k%3D","uri":"read/NA06663/1/ref/1kobi7gpwmzag/1-1735476160980.webp","fontType":1,"components":"乡良阝","variants":"鄉","charPicId":"7453809206375514131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"秋。冬煞旺根，不宜入南，寅午戌妙，亥日人吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日提綱戌巳寅，貴乎丙火擢元神。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339126322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再財庻利官加爵，最怕相逄見亥壬。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339142706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛日生人，己戌月透丙，是一貴格，主功名富貴。若遇亥壬壊格，雖得巳戊破之，格亦不清。加逄寅午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098464646578211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌時又云吉，怕丁混。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金寒月兎猪羊，局㑹財成富貴詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339159090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無火莫言金水冷，全陰福禄怕梟傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339175474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛生秋冬，以卯爲尊，若局全亥未，主發財吉，飛禄又是他格，柱丑亥多衝，巳爲禄馬，如全陰化柱中。無火不可以金寒水冷言之，但忌無格梟煞。此以辛癸潤澤□木，遇士則黨，須行木地則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金最喜赤青逄，丁乙相逄名利通。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339191858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青赤不加名利改，水金相見落殘紅。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339208242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛日宜弱，喜火木，忌金水，春夏遇火木，兩行皆吉，惟酉魁則否。若原刼多行財，則内原財遇比行亥。戌運可入酉，亦㐫，用丙忌壬亥，怕癸屏之，成則富貴，破則困滯。秋冬原有火木，重者入南不吉，破丁。乙又不吉，五陰之干，顚倒而人不知，不宜身旺，須中和則可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098464646463523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛衰春夏行西可，官煞秋冬南地㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339224626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木火畏逄金水破，秋冬要火木重鎔。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339241010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛日春漫衰甚，火木遇遭，原無水刼，行西亦士。若幸不弱，𭘧刧水行金亦不吉。秋冬有火，木亦宜入。南若以火木爲□，怕金水破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日如逄内甲壬，相生相益又相征。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339257394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東南運底宜名利，西北無成向酉傾。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339273778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛日見丙、甲、壬三物，乃壬生甲，甲生尅丙，又壬丙爲征行西北，乃歸致之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/NA06663/7402466672025534473/1-1735476160980.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=6afzEOotsMjxHf3f%2BUYJf71yl1k%3D","uri":"read/NA06663/1/ref/1kobi7gpwmzag/1-1735476160980.webp","fontType":1,"components":"乡良阝","variants":"鄉","charPicId":"7453809206375514131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用此如斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日東南丁酉時，火方名利却相宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339290162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金強水旺𧇊財禄，西北風寒葉自飛。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339306546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛生春夏丁酉時，則是一格，行火木方，功名發逹。柱原刼水，又行金水，乃𧇊財禄，所謂火木盛早成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499446521866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"入西北惆悵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日秋生怕煞肥，冬生水火喜東離。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339322930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤青月令𭒡行水，無火傷官恨酉西。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339339314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金水傷官，宜見官也。夏無傷官之名，乃官印遇水，反破正官，春亦忌之，水無益，用木生官，水則盗氣。濕木則火難明，官不能生。惟秋冬金水之時，乃云金水傷官，喜見官煞亦同，論財亦可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日如逄寅午時，戌亥卯未亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339355698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火明木秀財名就，事不偕兮金水依。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339372082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛日若得寅午戌、亥卯未時，俱是一吉，宜木秀火明俱吉。若金水行人丑辰運銷金絶墓及申酉亥。之方擬其非耗病傷丁煞重則𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論壬癸","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339388466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098463744655387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸春生喜會財，干支得土亦奇哉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339388466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無財營獲難成利，木遇金多成斷荄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339404850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸生正二月，用木，喜見比肩及食傷透干，不畏官煞，最妙見財，切忌金重反壞木用，如浮金無害。壬生正二月，遇寅辰午戌干透一甲、二甲得全□寅辰多清者貴，有寅風無雲者富，火局亦富。南行不忌戊，𠔥庚透丙甲亦宜得丑亥時爲妙。若金重，忌財輕，木少，行西北，不吉。二月寅午戌辰日。遇戊巳、庚辛己，是一貴格，行南北俱吉，透甲爲用□見梟遇丙屏之亦吉。三月有煞印之名官印。一格成則富貴，若寅辰午戌日干遇一甲兩甲，乃冨。風雲騎龍虎則貴。但怕申酉衝刑，運若刼旺無火土陰陽交混，旺金尅木，又無火屏驅馳命也。癸□生正月□時，刑合格忌庚申已得亥丑辰時。又是一格，比肩行，南北俱吉，忌官煞、財印透，行南不吉。如秉中和，入□□□富貴，切忌金多又遇財。官煞印不吉二刀。寅時貴格，不忌浮土浮金，亦不忌庚申，或近三月，庚字□陰，亦可擬貴。若辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499463430156"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己卯時行吉亦發，不甚忌士。若金局再人水金之地，不吉。三月有官煞爲用，遇辰、巳、午、未時，是一。格申酉時亦是一格，俱忌甲木，若無根土多，亦不爲害，透木亦嫌。甲寅時比肩不忌，原有官煞忌行。官煞方此，春月俱宜比肩，及見火土，𣅜主富貴。忌庚申辛酉，會金折木。若浮金不忌，辰月不忌見。金正二月原無比肩，有財官多忌行財官運，謂之太過，傷妻尅子，一度重則變俱忘。申子行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸生炎論旺賒，若逄梟印盛無涯。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339421234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有根壬子㱔成美，癸水無根作大家。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339437618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸生夏，以火士爲用，不宜此刼。夏月水衰官煞旺，但得印綬，則成士夫君子。食傷爲財官之忌。惟刑合從彼論，不忌寅上之甲，若得己配，則吉。王子壬寅、壬午、壬戌日生四、五月，遇戊、庚、辛一透，可。擬貴偏官偏印，貴高，財足正官印次之，刼刃財名反覆。若甲丙透不足，得己配頗遂，怕丙丁丁從化。亦吉。五月忌衝官，庚戊透從煞不忌。惟壬申日不喜財官，丙甲透成煞印可也。六月傷官一格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499463446540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㑹全者，貴富，亦宜正印。壬寅、壬午、壬辰、壬戌日，遇官印、煞印一格，清者貴，淆者次。壬子㑹傷爲合，亦可擬貴癸日四五月，若就財富貴，遇申酉辰、巳、午未、丑𫑗時，皆作吉論。刼多不吉，仝陰大吉化火。大富貴，煞印亦然。六月有煞印，一格貴。如丙辰、丁巳時，又辛巳二時，俱主功名。甲寅時刑合格怕。庚申重刑，宜亥卯未全富貴，忌戊巳戌用食傷，比肩多行東方大發財。木用怕金，土用宜金。又壬日。六月得寅辰午戌，日支千透戊巳，富貴可擬。趨艮亦吉，遇丁多反覆。㑹甲宜木火，忌徃金行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸生臨旺九秋，功名火土遂情求。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339454002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無火土猶行北，幾度歡娛幾度愁。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339470386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸生秋乃印，其作用要火土。火土秋月不時，雖冬無害。如無火士行北，既在中秋，逄生太過，乃不足之流，壬生七月，歲月俱寅，又得辰戌，時得戌申，以煞印論，順行富貴，子位欠吉，行南破印，若止。一丙孤棲申子辰上行南無害。順行怕寅八月遇戊字及戊申時，順則貴，逆則富，亦有原無火遇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098464646610979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刼行火亦貴，不忌丙。九月煞印、官印又是一格，其地自有煞印，若得全陽，及遇庚富貴，若近冬生。更坐辰午寅戌，干遇甲木，主大富，清者貴。若丑亥寅辰時，干支遇煞則吉，若遇重木，金木交争及刑。衝者㐫。癸日七八月遇庚申時合禄，七月遇火，火土行北亦吉。忌寅、丙衝提㑹火之地，見火返南。則破。若辰巳時土多，兩行皆吉。八月遇戊巳丙丁及地支火土，行北富貴，但子少，返南，有子又怕。傷印衝提若癸巳日或亥巳日時比肩，多得申酉印，行北功名，但財不聚，怕遇衝提刑地，七八月原。無戊士，如逄甲及原有甲申行戌寅，乃傷官，見官亦言稱意。中有純陰，成格亦吉。若水不相持，陰陽混雜則㐫。此兩干七八月最宜士火爲妙。癸日九月不妨。比肩忌亥日時，乃隠甲害戊。若土多則富申庚辛時，巳辰午未𫑗，但得一格俱吉，若通寅申，縱有利名，立見反覆。此月人冬令，甲寅時得干從刑合格論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸時垣比刼逢，運歸旺地反成功。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339486770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逄火土從他","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339503154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098401987805236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格，食木飛刑又不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339503154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸生冬令，再行旺地，飛天禄馬，禄從旺則吉，怕逄火土。如壬生十月、十一月遇比刼，多是飛禄格。忌官塡實。若水局從旺，如全陽得甲丙行東南，大發富貴，見丁合化，亦吉。如遇戊乃煞，宜庚辛爲印。不宜見甲，如用地支，宜寅午戌辰俱有火士，主功名輕重言之。如巳辰丑亥時，一用俱喜行東南方。清者貴，混者次，此身旺宜任也。丑月官煞多，或遇丙丁，宜行酉地吉偏官偏印，及寅、午戌辰日時。食傷之類皆可論吉。癸水十月全陰，乃飛祿。亦有乙𫑗時，食傷爲用，行東南發福。巳未時乃煞庚。申辛酉時，乃合禄飛禄，遇印亦可名利。見戊官印，己煞印，忌行丙丁官煞，多貴小富，宜行土金旺地。但子少十一月，亦有飛禄食木之用，乃刑合、□丘等格，遇申酉時，亦宜巳煞，清者貴，次者富。壬癸混刼主用乏。如癸巳、癸丑、癸亥、癸酉，多互，卽財宫煞印，不忌飛玷，亦有士多，卽煞印非邀己格兩月。同論十二月全陰，卽煞，非飛禄也。先正所謂無煞方重用，有煞用難重。如遇官則化，見己從煞，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098463744720923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宜印透爲吉，怕壬陽混刼，金水交争。其癸干冬月甲寅時，無印，土金透刼亦奇，運宜東南方乙𫑗時。宜火土全陰，行東南發逹，忌庚申辛酉，在干丑月無合禄格。申時酉時乃煞印，忌財方有刼小畏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸秋生比刼多，無財財地柰貧何。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339519538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支有土𠔥逄火，雨後桃夭春己𨓺。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339535922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此比肩多，原無財，行財地。比肩争財不士。若干支有火士雖少，比刧頼刼蔽印，初行貧乏行財地𤼵。財，但不久耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬生己月戊丙該，煞印相逄大用材。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339552306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日臨期應擬富，只愁原𭘧食傷來。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339568690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬寅壬戌日，生於巳月，巳中有丙、戊、庚三偏奇爲用。癸日遇此，乃三正奇，皆富貴之擬，忌比刼及甲。字癸日遇乙𫑗時乃破士，甲寅時乃壞土，不吉，土多亦不妨。大抵士中生㐫，甚則危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499463495692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬生七月印屬申，火木相逢便是春。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339585074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無刼有官多士慶，刼來相伴主薄貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339601458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金爲水毋，秋金太旺，無土則流，故宜見財官爲羊，運宜順行，柱無火土及梟食相持，遇南行運則吉。行北不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬坐申辰子亥中，比全水局甲無功。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339617842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東南北地皆名利，金再相逄又是空。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339634226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬日坐冬申子辰全，日干本旺，若得辰時，或干支别透寅甲食神，財行東南大發，見庚戊争征不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339650610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872336662539/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0wB3MaaB1Wen3n7YFjpkgMtRTi4%3D","uri":"read/HY1059/6/ref/1kob4lj19t5vw/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"尢丶","variants":"尤","charPicId":"7456690872336662539"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524339666994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利風雲㑹，富貴愁逄丙甲申。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339666994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此二月散生，柱，宜見庚戊透辛亦吉。若干支煞多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872336662539/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0wB3MaaB1Wen3n7YFjpkgMtRTi4%3D","uri":"read/HY1059/6/ref/1kob4lj19t5vw/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"尢丶","variants":"尤","charPicId":"7456690872336662539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉，怕逄丙與甲，黨煞壊印及官星混，夏月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872336662539/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0wB3MaaB1Wen3n7YFjpkgMtRTi4%3D","uri":"read/HY1059/6/ref/1kob4lj19t5vw/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"尢丶","variants":"尤","charPicId":"7456690872336662539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申夏月赤黄時，干遇財官不是奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339683378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌若來成一妙，豈期丙甲兩相依。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339699762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此日夏月不喜財，官多，原有根也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬騎龍背喜風雲，財局之中亦自欣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339716146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇甲全陽名利客，戊庚一見要詳分。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339732530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098510041366540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬騎龍背，以辰寅爲風雲多者主富貴。若寅午戌財局亦吉，柱透甲最妙，如遇庚、戊，乃壊格，若戊申。時以煞論，當細詳之。如己丑、戊辰、壬辰、庚子、甲子年中舉，卽尅殳，戊辰年煞重，二月𣦸，是見庚戌。壊格，如壬辰、甲辰、壬寅、庚子，大貴，是透甲全、寅辰，妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬臨午位禄馬同，疊見財官富貴翁。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339748914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春喜見金不𢙆木，如逄子月土成功。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339765298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午日丁巳爲用，春生本忌木害官，若遇庚辛巳酉丑則不忌。子月得士多則能制。癸子雖衝午丁。自若也。若生夏月，財官多者，皆貴。癸己巳未、壬午、己酉貴。癸己巳未、壬午、庚子、丙辰，狀元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸居金局巳辰時，月值𫑗寅水木滋。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339781682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最喜煞官來人格，平生各利自相宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339798066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸日逄己酉丑，梟印也。生春月，以木爲用，亦不相𡧱，遇官煞則爲吉。辰、巳二時，乃財官也，格中忌破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098520170528802"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁二引用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日如逄己酉丑，時利庚申南地走，木火功名比刼𭒡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339814450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官人格命少有。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339830834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸酉、癸丑、癸巳，此三日生遇庚申，時，宜火木方行吉相此肩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日多財春夏間，若成棄命福難攀。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339847218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干頭官煞來相混，猶事驅馳不解閑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339863602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸日生，春夏遇財多，乃棄命就財，若遇庚辛、戊巳，又從煞印之論。四者怕相混，以財印有相征之忌。若戊巳爲用，又是他格，庚戊又是一用，辛巳又是一用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸生春夏食傷提，比刼重逢尅子妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339879986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如得干支存火土，更行南地禄財齊。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339896370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098520170561570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸生春，以木爲用，氏刼多，更無火土藏透，乃尅妻子不堪之命，行此尤爲不吉。若得火土爲佐及陽干多甲透，并行南地，其子更多。此乃無中生有，而□難知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日如逄巳未時，煞星更怕戊來持。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339912754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如或制𥁞行財地，不是人間富貴兒。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339929138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸日未時，乃煞見戊，要從化，又𭒡巳□，所以不宜。戊巳俱透，須宜制，又怕太𨓺，秀而不實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥多肩九月生，金水運底最無成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339945522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若行南地無寅甲，富貴功名斷可成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339961906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥日生，九月，見比月，多行金水地，不吉，行南方及火土皆吉。惟怕寅、甲、戊申。戊土忌寅申。如得南行，不忌，再行水地，不吉。若非亥日遇寅甲有比肩亦吉。如甲寅時近十月，作戌月推，乃作木論。如遇庚申字火土多，不忌亥寅。甲行火土旺，亦可名利。如己未時煞不畏寅。甲亥、戊午時，畏甲，不畏亥寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499446571018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸生秋月水金明，火土相逄便有情。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339978290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比刼可圖南地禄，赤黄順北有功名。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524339994674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"秋生比刼多火土少，行南有禄，雖有財，名不實。原見火土多，行北不吉。癸亥庚申，癸亥乙卯，南貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸生秋月印生身，丙火相逄亦不嗔。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524340011058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有土許成名利客，若逄寅甲䘮青春。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524340027442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸遇丙，不𭒡破印有土，乃壬見巳午及戊巳辰戌丑未，俱吉。若干支有寅甲遗患，雖印格成亦無功。名行運再遇寅甲衝印銷印，變攺忽然，其㐫不測。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸居羊兎甲寅時，刑合格中最是奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524340043826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行運只𭒡申午地，㑹青枝上利名期","logicSentenceId":"7577334524340060210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸日寅時，乃刑合傷官，宜春亥卯未月，要木局全則貴。行木局及歲運，木秀利名可期，午戌亦富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098463744753691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"忌戊庚申及戍戊，重運，不吉。甲子丙寅、癸丑甲寅行申中休致。丙子辛𫑗癸亥，甲寅行申休官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲坤黄數五，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524340060210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火生土旺以下専重納音取用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人戊癸本非殊。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524340060210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或加從革應相呼。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524340076594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四位土支逢一二，祿厚權清出帝都。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524340092978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用眞火生眞土，有戊無癸，以子代之；有癸無戊，以己代之。子已乃土成實之地。己酉丑福元旺水生。焉辰戌丑未四土若逄一二位，爲成實之格。子己代戊癸，甲人有戊癸合戊子癸巳，辰戌丑未最貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲漢秀氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524340109362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火中見水，暗金官神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人見火爲孤獨，水若相逢却至清。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524340125746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見丙來加子午，定向初年達縉紳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642132018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木見火傷，金得水制也。丙子丙午，乃水中有火，火中有水，木人得之，乃五行至清之氣。木得火多則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499463528460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"馳騁，聰明，好學勤禮，立身孤獨。如得旺水，主財薄淸貴。論日甲人，以金爲福，火盛則傷金，見水則火。殆五行要有制，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690877886906380/1-93e73f4651144ce7.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=5R4UzGM8kBHSIquegtqjpb7vr9c%3D","uri":"read/NA10937/8/ref/1kp8p8fijqsy1/1-93e73f4651144ce7.webp","fontType":1,"components":"扌𠨐","variants":"抑","charPicId":"7456690877886906380"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則轉禍爲福。又甲㑹丙子、丙午旺水，中合起辛未、辛丑，本家眞官，天乙貴人無中。設象，乃五行清華之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福禄歸根。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642148402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火土生官，忌木反元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙相逄土最精，不逄木辱足珠珍。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642164786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌兩位如逄火，少步青雲日益新，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642181170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土能生金，爲木之官，無木傷土，福禄日然渾𫝗辰戌之位，卽其中逄火能生無窮之士。土旣渾𫝗金自然壯，乃無中之有也。論曰：辰戌乃魁罡之地，土旣鍾毓，更得干音，火神滋養，則氣數明爽，子子孫。孫，相爲羽翼，福祿𫝗矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690887285850124/1-e6ba5c1424712073.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=9st7CIS1rBJgNyNsp8F11q4EEd0%3D","uri":"read/HY0851/29/ref/1koeorlys1tlm/1-e6ba5c1424712073.webp","fontType":1,"components":"艹阝亼丅云","variants":"蔭","charPicId":"7456690887285850124"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524642181170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𦔳清奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642181170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"敗金逄旺土，官神益壯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499446603786"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁蛇己酉金偏慕，縱逄火盛不爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642197554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見甲來加子午，雲路峥嶸早歲通。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642213938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金生在巳，却逄丁巳；金旺在西，却逄己酉。正胎中逄父母，轉見生旺，雖有火蔵，未能柰何，葢本源深。𫝗也。以丁己、巳酉二位土神，能化其毒，不傷於金。然甲子、甲午二金帶一路𣦸敗之氣，旣有丁己巳酉，壯其本源，故陰陽得中，金𥙍之德，挺持可知，又何敗之有？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地有餘：","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642230322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木加火盛，官神銷鑠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰甲戌皆炎火，木作干神本自生。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642230322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重遇木神駢輔翼，虛名雖有不遷升。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642246706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲屬木，加辰戌土，納音火，是干分帶木，卽本位自能發揚天地有餘之氣，不得外加木，若木多則又傷辰戌之土，不能爲福。五行中如此理","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872336662539/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0wB3MaaB1Wen3n7YFjpkgMtRTi4%3D","uri":"read/HY1059/6/ref/1kob4lj19t5vw/1-e86e73510fb1c52b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"尢丶","variants":"尤","charPicId":"7456690872336662539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用消詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098520170594338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破散離業","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642263090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木生火旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌本是火潜藏，术𤼵其神轉更忙。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642263090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又值木臨寅午戌，蕩除家業遠離鄉，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642279474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲戌本是伏藏，火要安静，却以木發起，何益？五行當生卽生，當伏卽伏，反此爲禍。况火到戌亥，以四時推之，自不可發露，所以破財。論日甲戌本木中宿，火，見木則火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868252540964/1-32bc290381cd0616.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=zWW7irF87UPzPDVBf8N8S0JfhDI%3D","uri":"read/HY2998/8/ref/1kwar0j0kmsyv/1-32bc290381cd0616.webp","fontType":1,"components":"火戈亠丷百","variants":"熾","charPicId":"7456690868252540964"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若更臨寅午戌宫，木得火局，則焚傷飛馳，不得歸元，所以流移鄉井，事多歇㓕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭横無依。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642279474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禄位逄火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申人寅重莫逄火，見火平生多坎珂。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642295858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然禄馬不陞遷，又恐天年多擵","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642312242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868457488423/1-a9b75eec70460393.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=t1p1YEgwpFoxPyW7nEkHB8NKVSY%3D","uri":"read/HY1521/13/ref/1kxjkc27664ui/1-a9b75eec70460393.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土羅","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690868457488423"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524642312242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅爲火生之地，寅旣重，若又見火，火更有氣，庚辛受制，所以觸事迍𨗍。人皆言甲禄在寅，不知一火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098463744835611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"便能爲害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642312242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四眞金太陰化氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642328626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙之人遇丙辛，從魁大吉要傳名，傳送更加逄太乙，便是中書爕理人，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642345010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙陰金，故生其水母，生了爲親。若遇己酉丑生其子，有丙無辛，以酉代之；有辛無丙，以巳代之爲秀。實之氣，故貴。論曰：三位子母俱旺，福㑹之慶。己酉以攝丙辛，乙遇丙辛合丙辛巳𮠕丑爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滋蔭返元。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642345010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙生人正月内，蛇窠逄土少年榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642361394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見剛金臨煞位，必主兵權定塞塵。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642377778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙人正月，以戊寅高阜之土，乙庚之氣絶處逄父母，故喜見之。丁巳乃蛇窠之土，金神生處逄父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098510041382924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又乙人見庚辰，乃羊刃煞，然而五行壯旺，更加此煞，須領兵刑之任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼作截福六乙怕逢丙丁盛，如無救𦔳定成㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642394162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若值五行多水數，陽土相臨主大隆。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642410546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁若盛，金神不能發生，乙人所以不喜見之。若四柱中見水，可以制火，要得一位陽神之土扶持。如戊寅、戊申之類，五行又却還元。珞琭子云：當憂不憂，頼五行之救𦔳。良有以也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙水乹龍之數一，六丙生人不見丙，巳來同甲格最清。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642426930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉若加并太乙，名標金榜世傳名，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642443314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水之類，火之屬，得木而生焉。甲己土合，壯其丙火，士旺金生，有甲無己，以未代之；有巳無甲，以寅代。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098463744851995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之，此爲反陰滋陽之理。水加木而清，丑爲大吉，巳爲太乙，丑乃金神墓地，故生丙水，爲秀實也。寅未代甲己丙人，有甲己未寅、𫑗己丑，貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福禄還藏。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642443314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙人從革火爲良，又乘巳位旺青揚。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642459698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更得炎宫干木火，定知早逹，佐朝堂，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642476082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙人喜見己酉丑金位，如無己酉丑日時中有金神，亦得用，得己，乃爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876069953572/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=WtDNKjuD2E4COzgmQ5BpiMW4kSg%3D","uri":"read/HY0653/23/ref/1kob7zqcc89x2/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp","fontType":1,"components":"上丄⺝八","variants":"與","charPicId":"7456690876069953572"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官之貴。巳午二位干逄木。乃爲丙人之福。火人得從革局，乃爲尅財生官之象。若得己巳之類，則火人禄氣純全，更寅午戌三位干頭得丙甲二字，其火人得地無水，而仕路氣愈見強壯，陰陽書所謂優游，抑有自也。有水則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892566003751/1-31ba5a57a97dfb3a.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=N7g8lypvA3JjigsGIdWzIwBrass%3D","uri":"read/NA06813/37/ref/1kntaadyg1jbu/1-31ba5a57a97dfb3a.webp","fontType":1,"components":"扌貟","variants":"損","charPicId":"7456690892566003751"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄旺興元。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642476082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六丙生人火數多，更加一木最相和。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642492466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛明清徤多榮","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642508850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499446620170"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，金神更壯早巍峩。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642508850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙本自旺盛，一木足矣，多爲過。雖是一木，若得地尤奇絕。所以五行之神唱在顯煥清越，不可週也。丙人得木𦔳，其鋭可知。須要一位金來𦔳其氣，則生火人官禄基如比，豈不早年享福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中央奪福","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642525234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥子見水，被士所破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙人見子休逄土，福破中央奪將去。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642525234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又加火向辰戊中，决定傷殘終敗露，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642541618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見子則官神得位，逄土則水不能勝，終被所奪也。論曰：魁罡之地，土在鍾毓，更若火盛，如甲辰、甲戊。之類，土氣強壯，水氣消渴，爲害甚矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"截根無蔭","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642541618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生處逄鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内寅爲禄火長生，甲寅相遇不光榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642541618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓦妻害子無兄","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642558002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098555905998858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟，到老孤貧謾逞能。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642558002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逄鬼，於受氣處被","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690877886906380/1-93e73f4651144ce7.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=5R4UzGM8kBHSIquegtqjpb7vr9c%3D","uri":"read/NA10937/8/ref/1kp8p8fijqsy1/1-93e73f4651144ce7.webp","fontType":1,"components":"扌𠨐","variants":"抑","charPicId":"7456690877886906380"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"塞，終爲害也。此爲生地見鬼，鬼卽強壯，丙火不能舒爽。五行獨立，宜於順生最嫵逆制終孤竭矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煙滅灰飛。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642574386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火木臨巳午，無水救𦔳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁巳午皆逄木，炎上威風勢猛強。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642590770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更若五行無水制，𦆵逢稱意必傾亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642607154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁巳午，皆火之地，若逄木，則益炎盛，須得水制，旣相比和，又有官神，方是有應，若一味炎盛，豈能長久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神爲鬼","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642623538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"于音火，土多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙人見戊加申于時人皆謂食神重。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642623538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見火神有生","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642639922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098463744868379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位，一生孤蹇禄難逢。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642639922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙人見戊，又逢火旺土壮，尅丙人之官，所以無宫。土主於中，旺於子午頭帶戊，丙人會，以為食神名。之兆。□既成實，不必更見。火大旺則土強，内人之官蔑然，雖少年見禄，終不爲乆長計。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火父木成數三，六丁戊癸本來髙，如加己亥勢雄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642656306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894578663460/1-c9b70ea04fa30a59.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=i3XRF3OQjQ8clxYJd2IdPe4ruLE%3D","uri":"read/HY2696/6/ref/1ksfz9e7klidb/1-c9b70ea04fa30a59.webp","fontType":1,"components":"亠〢二冖口𧰨","variants":"豪","charPicId":"7456690894578663460"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524642672690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰宫金水壮，位到公侯，佩玉袍","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642672690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁生戊，癸爲子，如萌芽有癸無戊，以己代之；有戊無癸，以子代之，皆爲秀實之氣，造化之功，可貴爲已乃戊癸之源，亥乃成實之地，爲貴。子巳代戊癸丁生人有戊癸、戊子、癸巳申子辰，金水清貴逢火。土猶爲禍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛活清秀。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642672690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水盛忌土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499463544844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁人爱遇北方水，忽見食神再續來，局内不逢於𡈽數，木神加護至三台，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642689074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁人見水，官神得地，又遇金來生官，自然顕赫。北方乃亥子正位，壬癸旺鄉，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690874371440679/1-e2166576adcdd8f6.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=z%2BfbUjXFGPEqVUWHNibemX0jiHQ%3D","uri":"read/HY1033/1/ref/1koee5rwr750k/1-e2166576adcdd8f6.webp","fontType":1,"components":"辶𡕖","variants":"逢","charPicId":"7456690874371440679"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金生育不絶。甲子辛亥之類是也。若無土損其氣清，又得木神護禄，所以基本牢壮。此是財官印之說。見水是官官宜。居北方旺地，又得金財以生之，木印以䕶之，所以基本牢壮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄基成實。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642689074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子午逢金怕土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金加子午多㐫暴，若是丁人又喜逢。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642705458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更㸔五行無土數，定扶聖主掌陶鎔。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642721842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"□金加子午，帶死敗，故㐫。甲子、甲午之𩔗是也。然人午上見金，則是爲財，子上見金，則生官。若無□犯分則氣清禄厚。又云：在午見金則禄旺；在子見金，□生出丁官，見士則傷水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098520170627106"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄氣差遲","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642738226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬多不如亥子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁見壬亥未是奇，亥子相逢正得時。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642738226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽被土來争旺位，謾有","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642754610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890917527593/1-e03974a3989ecf78.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=r2wHl5ldi6WUjOrgKrJWtVCnmZM%3D","uri":"read/HY2175/3/ref/1krfu08f8upf8/1-e03974a3989ecf78.webp","fontType":1,"components":"声耳殳","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690890917527593"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524642754610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華，亦差遲","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642754610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬不得地，遇而不遇，雖無壬而得水正位，官神旺處，自然壯也。水士混雜，終是土勝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破相孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642754610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六丁忌見土長生，損妻害子強爭能。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642770994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有虛名難了逹，亦憂田宅乏興營。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642787378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六丁人以水爲福，官也。土長生，傷官大旺，則奪却水之位，有呼無應，其格𤰞下。若見尅傷，則觸事𧇊。損六丁人以水土爲官鬼，水土𣅜生於申，就位爲土所損。𡈼癸無依，金生元被害，可貧賤矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊火數二，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642803762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098555906015242"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六戊生人逄曲直，丁壬相合主清才。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642803762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從革位中𠔥一二，决須名譽少年魁。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642820146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眞火要亥𫑗未旺，有丁無壬，以亥代；有壬無丁，以未代，本元壯則爲福遠，戊癸丁王，合貴也。眞火愛寅午戌土壯火炎，官有力。天數乘三，子生其父，己酉丑多逄則貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淵源滋養。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642836530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金生水神，滋木之官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六戊生人見水深，更逄申子旺生金，須知名譽當騰逹，少主清華入禁林。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642852914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命巳有水，主官，更得金在申子水之鄉，則金又生水，甲乙自然有氣，五行要不斷，若有金無水，又能害木，水深則木強，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相爲慶㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642869298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土壯合水生，木官顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499446685706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申本是戊人強，癸亥當頭貴顯揚。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642885682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但得五行金不人，名清望重，佐朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642902066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊寅火生處逄士，戊申土生，故強。癸亥水生出甲乙，故奇。有金則傷矣。寅申土成體地，本源旣壯，又須借木神踈爽之，更得癸亥就位，滋養其神明之德，清徤非常。若無金神返制五行，决恬然無害爲。福厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金火相持。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642918450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊人不貴南方火，見火須還帶旺金。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642934834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有金無火終成咎，有火無金亦不新。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642951218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊人不貴南方火者，戒其太𨓺盛，若無火，則金得勢來侵木，無金有火亦無用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干鬼爲映。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642967602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲傷戊元，有金可救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098510041415692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊人有甲終無益，帶水拖泥不似初。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524642983986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得庚金并水局，縱能財禄亦微餘。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643000370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逢甲不如見乙，爲陰陽和順，甲能傷戊，若加水，甲益壯，終有害也。若庚金制之，猶庻幾甲陽火之神。戊人得之，陰錯陽差，若得庚金，又復制甲，旣又得水，則爲戊人財廪之神，五行互有得失故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己五數","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643016754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876069953572/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=WtDNKjuD2E4COzgmQ5BpiMW4kSg%3D","uri":"read/HY0653/23/ref/1kob7zqcc89x2/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp","fontType":1,"components":"上丄⺝八","variants":"與","charPicId":"7456690876069953572"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524643016754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土，六己相逄已用功，乙庚相會禄高封。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643016754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"炎上火神加一二，符壓兵權静塞衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643033138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"已乃火生旺之地，己人遇寅午戌，爲造化之功。一庚爲土之子，生於巳，爲實有乙無庚，以申代之，有庚無乙，以卯代之，得此方爲貴格。如寅、午、戌三宫，一位二位爲貴。申𫑗代乙庚，庚卯乙申用巳炎上。火而清貴顯逹也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098401987887156"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"包成合禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643049522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅午戌，懼旺水損元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己人正月正爲魁，更於寅午戌相陪。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643065906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局内不逄眞火數，定知文武佐功來。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643082290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙辛爲眞火，數巳人見丙寅，爲食神之魁，葢火生土，又得寅午戌炎上之火氣接濟，若無水損禄天元有滋養，榮名厚利，何患無矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀特逄生。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643098674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金生水旺，滋木旺金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己相加已是功，申子辰位甲須豐。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643115058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更得金神同水化，定知名譽至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643131442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申子辰水之位，就中見甲，則木乗水旺氣，爲福基甚厚。金同水地，則水益壯旺，甲自然發生此五行。陰陽消息，不必見其形而黙㑹之可也。若只見金而無水，金無所歸，便傷甲乙之木。惟有水地，則自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098520170692642"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生出水，不必見水，深，且詳之論日，若見水加亥卯未上，禄元有所養，爲福無窮矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚四金陽之數，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643147826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊癸丑未，火士爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643147826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876069953572/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=WtDNKjuD2E4COzgmQ5BpiMW4kSg%3D","uri":"read/HY0653/23/ref/1kob7zqcc89x2/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp","fontType":1,"components":"上丄⺝八","variants":"與","charPicId":"7456690876069953572"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524643147826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數少人知，戊癸相逄遇者稀。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643147826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大小吉神逄一二，名播中華，福禄輝，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643164210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876069953572/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=WtDNKjuD2E4COzgmQ5BpiMW4kSg%3D","uri":"read/HY0653/23/ref/1kob7zqcc89x2/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp","fontType":1,"components":"上丄⺝八","variants":"與","charPicId":"7456690876069953572"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎數用，有子生焉。戊癸乃火之眞數，爲庚金之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876069953572/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=WtDNKjuD2E4COzgmQ5BpiMW4kSg%3D","uri":"read/HY0653/23/ref/1kob7zqcc89x2/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp","fontType":1,"components":"上丄⺝八","variants":"與","charPicId":"7456690876069953572"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官。有戊無癸，以子代之；有癸無戊，以己代。之，方爲秀實之氣。戊癸化火，能生二吉，丑未爲大小吉。二吉旣旺，能𦔳庚金，乃爲至貴。子己代戊癸。庚金生巳，戊癸之火，𤼵用丑未，貴矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲譽遠馳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643164210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚人巳午逄剛木，學問過人世所稀。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643180594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但無金神并水屬，少馳聲譽掌樞機。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643196978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499446702090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火正南方，官神得地，更逄剛木，滋養無窮，所謂本源深而氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690889022177316/1-de577592eed99ed7.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=W6S41scq984AoCdru1%2B%2Fzz1gXTs%3D","uri":"read/HY0747/2/ref/1kp7y6ea257nt/1-de577592eed99ed7.webp","fontType":1,"components":"壯丶","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690889022177316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若見金神并見水，水又生起便制其。火雖得正伍，終被消爍，此有木無金水，然後爲貴。論日火加巳午，官星得地，若使納音帶得木來火。聚南方高明豁逹，所憚者水耳，稍無犯分，則挺特山羣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643213362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690865995284499/1-4b8e40e06593b50d.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=mYQC4DIo440QMbgT5k4TUhARchc%3D","uri":"read/HY0945/11/ref/1kohp15pghczw/1-4b8e40e06593b50d.webp","fontType":1,"components":"厶大丶𰛅","variants":"參","charPicId":"7456690865995284499"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524643213362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成慶。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643213362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見土木火，禄元有𦔳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚人愛得土來親，火數相乘位顯倫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643229746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏季中生月屬，又加木屬主光榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643246130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金得土扶，禄元有藉，更加火臨辰未，兩月中其福愈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"
