","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690889022177316/1-de577592eed99ed7.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=W6S41scq984AoCdru1%2B%2Fzz1gXTs%3D","uri":"read/HY0747/2/ref/1kp7y6ea257nt/1-de577592eed99ed7.webp","fontType":1,"components":"壯丶","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690889022177316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"葢火生三月，木墓六月，所謂源遠相𠫭發福。有自，其爲氣也，妙在適其用耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄鬼孤害。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643262514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚火禄向甲申，水數才多不可逄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643278898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643295282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883221651495/1-5c5ef78974cd5e72.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=yZBpfHEIdvqDERIs1dQ%2BLDn8YSE%3D","uri":"read/HY0893/13/ref/1kow22zmyceus/1-5c5ef78974cd5e72.webp","fontType":1,"components":"亻十𠃊⺝","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690883221651495"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524643295282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神重叠","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643295282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098401987919924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見，到頭辛苦禄難崇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643295282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚人以火爲福，却遇甲申，更有别位，見金神，則生出水，水有汗漫不絕之狀。丙丁如此，無以發生。又何禄之有，終難顯逹。珞琭子云：過而不遇禄馬之說，要在窮䆒，曲𥁞其理，方知禄馬歸着。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛天之水數，天數當先號六辛。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643311666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜逢親子係丁壬，天魁合㑹功曹。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643328050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盛名逹朝堂，職位清","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643344434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛數，乹天之子，天乙生水，木數合之，乃陰從母生，其子有丁無壬，以亥代之；有壬無丁，以未代之，故。爲秀實之氣。天魁戍，功曹寅也。亥未代丁壬，有丁壬亥未用寅午戌之勢，爲貴盛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"威高志遠。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643344434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛要得火相親，帶水須慿見木神。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643360818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文中却作武中","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643377202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098510041448460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎，武禄還須静塞塵。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643377202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水能生木，木生火，展轉相生，無有窮盡。辛金得火，六氣相親，若見水則有損，五行若又見木，水却隨木化不傷於火，辛人如此，豈不快哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先㐫後吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643393586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛人卯酉值非善，又逄水屬主遲矇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643409970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見火神當勝位，定知烜赫衆難同。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643426354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛以丙爲官，以火爲福，卯酉乃火𣦸敗之地，更加水損，何由得福？五行若得火神位，寅午戌卽還元。如此，則轉禍爲福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄氣退休。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643442738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛人火居西北地，無木相扶仕禄艱。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643459122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱得少年膺爵","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643475506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098401987936308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命，亦須衰蹇見休官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643475506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火居西北，無氣之鄉，文無木來𦔳，豈免迍剥。火在水鄉，終難顯達。得木衛䕶，猶且庻幾，稍若闕此，終當偃蹇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬爲眞木數三，六壬逄火自然光，丙辛交㑹勢堂堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643491890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太衝還共登明㑹，必是金門紫綬章。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643508274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬爲陽木，數當三，用周天火數，當其二數，二三合五，乃受己之數，爲壬之官。水數生木，乃母生其子。有丙無辛，以酉代之；有辛無丙，以巳代之，爲秀實之氣。太衝爲卯，登明爲亥，乃木乘旺之氣，爲醖籍。己酉代丙辛，壬人有丙辛。丙酉辛巳，以火用於木氣爲眞數人格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相呼集福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643524658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098501690425378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬己亥不爲官，忽逢水數禄須還。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643541042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更値五行多火局，定期高宦逹金鑾。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643557426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己亥爲生成之木，下殘切土，干頭己土，所以不爲壬人之官。若五行帶得火數多，己亥之木又隨火。化藏己官之土，却得還元，不必更見水。葢水能生木，木能尅土，卽爲壞官故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火奇續貴六壬丑未𠔥申子，四位如逢火數奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643573810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更值五行多土局，少年名位雍旌旗。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643590194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑未土成實之地，申子乃土旺之鄉，干立𭘧得火來，五行中更加士多壬人，福禄自然顯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894767751204/1-13068bc82071e3d2.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Nh9ByHv%2BNzs2I0K%2FCDNjNDNmQSk%3D","uri":"read/HY1496/5/ref/1kowaj6a9jeba/1-13068bc82071e3d2.webp","fontType":1,"components":"䒑者","variants":"著","charPicId":"7456690894767751204"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"豈不早。年享快。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反㐫成慶。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643606578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499446718474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬若逄繁剛木，須得干音𭘧火來。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643622962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是寅宫并午位，必作朝中將相才。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643639346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲辰、甲戌，皆干音火木，更又𢈏寅、壬午，俱來資𦔳，火旺則土盛，氣數純仝，福基自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690889022177316/1-de577592eed99ed7.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=W6S41scq984AoCdru1%2B%2Fzz1gXTs%3D","uri":"read/HY0747/2/ref/1kp7y6ea257nt/1-de577592eed99ed7.webp","fontType":1,"components":"壯丶","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690889022177316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天鬼相交。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643655730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬最怕干頭戊，或加辰戌主傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643672114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不見甲來爲救應，定主身中帶不安。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643688498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬人見戊爲干鬼，若加魁罡之地，則禍患之端。五行若有甲干陽木，又能尅戊土，卽有所救，不然，鬼氣太重，壬人所懼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸爲眞火數二，六癸生逄曲直加，如臨甲巳最爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643704882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更加傳送還爲","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643721266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098520170709026"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，禄仕千鍾福壽遐。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643721266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曲直亥𫑗未之氣也。癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690866033754131/1-9d7a3b2b3ab25a8a.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=jVCGgiMv6j5tyZtHLgYjVaRFe98%3D","uri":"read/NA06436/5/ref/1koehi49qsa3p/1-9d7a3b2b3ab25a8a.webp","fontType":1,"components":"阝亼丅云","variants":"陰","charPicId":"7456690866033754131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火須逄木而生甲巳者，土合火之子數，陰從母生，其子爲成。有甲無己，以未代之。有巳無甲，以寅代之，乃爲貴氣。傅送者乃甲巳生處，甲巳、未寅爲秀實之氣。癸人有甲巳旺。中帶木氣，爲清奇之格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"互相福應六癸人生多亥子，不逄土數自光榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643737650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得土加寅巳上，不須亥子卽爲清。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524643754034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥子乃水㑹之地，癸人□上，聚成一氣，不必見土，見土則水争強，反爲不好。若寅巳上却見士神，癸人之官又不必見，亥子見之，則土争雄，反爲交雜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天鬼爲滯。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883763226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098555906064394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸人逄已是殃，不逢甲數𥁞乖張。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883779610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫敎丑未乘於火，定知貧賤永無糧。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883795994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸人以戊爲官，見己，爲陰陽失序，反爲鬼。五行中若得甲木之氣觧救，尚可免迍駁。若見己丑、己未。之類，夾攻之癸人福氣藐然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滋蔭福元。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883812378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木逄癸亥正長生，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883828762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690887285850124/1-e6ba5c1424712073.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=9st7CIS1rBJgNyNsp8F11q4EEd0%3D","uri":"read/HY0851/29/ref/1koeorlys1tlm/1-e6ba5c1424712073.webp","fontType":1,"components":"艹阝亼丅云","variants":"蔭","charPicId":"7456690887285850124"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524883828762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"益根元必大亨。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883828762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有金臨西北位，定主清華禄自存。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883845146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木生在亥，就其位，得癸亥之水，滋養爲生中逄生喜會，最更得西北帶金，生出水來，木轉壯健源深。逹遠，禄福崇峻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變鬼爲官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883861530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098520170725410"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木人最怕逄壬申，若逄癸酉禍増新。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883877914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但得水臨西北地，返作清逹顯赫人。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883894298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬申癸酉，乃劒鋒金，乘臨官旺地，尅木，甲乙最怕之。忽若亥子上見水神，化藏金毒金雖承天將之。利，終不能害木。大抵福欲乘之，鬼欲制之，然後可觀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破禍成福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883910682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木逄辛亥不長生，不逄火制禄難存。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883927066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火神與木俱繁盛，何慮功名事不成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883943450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木生在亥，却於生處逄金，謂之生地見鬼，得火救之，金不敢用事，木乃出焉。此謂通變，自有輕重。五行須明勝負，不可一途取軌。火木繁盛，金自銷爍，雖是辛亥作禍，得火與木繁盛，始免金生煞若非辛亥見火木䌓多俱旺，又不便也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098549354577932"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼氣臨官，木人怕見火神興，無水相臨主禍迎。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883959834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更被金來加局内，一生","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883976218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690866234179625/1-8dd4916cca4b0555.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=144MTUuCGiXBB0mEOJcuoy7YPW4%3D","uri":"read/HY2726/4/ref/1kr0r17b9slcr/1-8dd4916cca4b0555.webp","fontType":1,"components":"阝人丅口从","variants":"險","charPicId":"7456690866234179625"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334524883976218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難不安寜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883976218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木人火盛，則灰飛烟㓕，得水可制火局不見水。又如從革金局，其神銳利，甲乙之木，窘氣可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"根源渾厚。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524883992602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火人日月時遭水，須逄曲直乙爲干。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884008986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得炎宫金納地，定知食禄是清官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884025370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火人月日時帶水神，則火無發露。若亥𫑗未上，干頭帶陰木，水却又來生木，木又生火，火生不絶火。神得地，更若寅午戌上納音見金，又却來尅木，木神受制，生出火官，五行脫體還元，乃爲高上之福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兌宫生鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884041754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098555906097162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火神敗地莫逄金，見水加來愈不禁。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884041754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不見傷殘併夭折，定須愛病肺連心。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884058138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火敗地本自衰微，逄水則金不能爲財，而與水爲鬼。論日火至敗地，見金則生出水來，力旣不能勝。安得不傷殘也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迍蹇多災。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884074522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆火須防水在寅，平生迍坎謾勞神。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884090906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"資財必竟難𠑽溢，到老身孤背六親。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884107290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火神稍衆，於生地却見水，如甲寅之類，何以堪？然火神旣多，須得少木資之，則有不窮之象，稍多於此終爲害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣數淳厚","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884123674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098549354610700"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土人土重火炎揚，職位清華禄益強。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884123674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火加巳午逄諸土，盛德高風處處彰。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884140058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土數旣重，必藉火扶持，爲生生不窮之意。若更見火加巳午，火旺之地，土又強壯，設或見水，終不能勝火，土，得爲財廪之氣矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五木成煙。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884156442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土人藉木爲文曲，四位之中𭘧火來。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884172826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重見木神臨巽地，高甲陞名福慶開。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884189210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土無火，不能通爽其氣；术無土，不能安植其根。二者相須，皆不可闕。五行中若帶火來，又於巳士見。木，展轉生育，聚成一體，氣數壯實，火神有所倚藉矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"救𦔳减福，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884205594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098549354594316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土人強位逄諸火，更加火旺生災禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884205594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就中若見水神波，縱免灾殃還坎珂。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884221978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火數旣旺且多，併來生一土，其氣大叚燥，忽見水返來制火，五行雖有救觧，終不爲吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"基本衰弱。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884238362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土人若重嫌己酉，區區終是謾勞生。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884254746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水近土傍猶見禍，賣𥁞田園無地耕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884271130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己酉乃土水敗地，重重見之則困，若相陵，終不爲福。葢水能勝於火矣。司馬季主日水逄沐浴如逄土土到衰鄉水不如。土到酉宫眞敗地，却逄癸酉禄盈餘，二氣各有勝負爾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滋蔭成官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884287514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金多逄土不爲灾，切忌金神帶水來。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884303898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木逐火神生旺","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884320282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098501690458146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土，發榮名位足資財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884320282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"只怕生旺被鬼所制，金多又自帶旺火，不爲害，自己寡弱，則尅我者始得志也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天盗離鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884336666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金遭乙巳大乖張，术數來逄主夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884353050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"便使水多難脚制，定殘骨肉遠離鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884369434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金生處見乙巳火，被火截住，加以木來扶火，之勢益壯，金自銷爍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源遠流清。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884385818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水人見木爲本利，得火相逄㐫害至，更無火木見金神，决主少年登顯第，","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884402202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金爲水本源，木得水滋深，爲利用，見火却生火，則反傷於金。五行巾若無水火，但得金氣發露，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098549354643468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生出水禄，自然清徹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無救成㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884402202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水人切忌戊申寅，截斷根源主禍頻。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884418586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局内不逄金發露，半生波却受艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884434970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申、戊寅，乃土成實之地，水人生處受制，病處見鬼，故日截斷根源。五行中若見魁罡，則鬼氣無以化藏水神如此，可謂困矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長鬼爲殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884451354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水人大怕火炎揚，寅午相逄轉更𢗅。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884467738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見丙加辰戌位，定知夭折見悲傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884484122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅午乃火生旺之地，炎熾可知，水神如此則竭矣。五行若見魁罡，如丙辰、丙戌之類，轉衰䘮矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098549354659852"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通㑹卷之四終","logicSentenceId":"7577334524884500506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098555906228234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098501690490914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098520170774562"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098555906179082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通會卷之五育吾山人著。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826058303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論古人立印食、官財名義。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826074687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐子平論格局，獨以印食、官財四者僞綱，其立名之","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826091071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"義何？","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826091071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢造化流行天地間，不𨓺陰陽五行而己。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826107455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826123839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行交相爲用，不過生尅制化而已。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826123839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今指甲乙爲例，","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826140223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以曰干論。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826140223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙在五行屬木，甲陽而乙陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826156607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人命","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826172991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得甲乙生，謂之曰主屬我。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826172991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生我者壬癸水，我生者丙","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826189375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火，尅我者庚辛金，我尅者戊巳土，而十干𥁞之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826189375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生我者，有父母之義，故立名印綬。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826205759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印，蔭也。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826222143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綬，受也。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826238527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826254911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母有恩德，蔭庇子孫，子孫得受其福。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826254911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝廷設官分","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826271295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098549354692620"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"職，畀以印綬，使之掌管。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826271295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官而無印，何所慿據？","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826287679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人無父","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826304063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母，何所怙恃？","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826304063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其理通一無二，故曰印綬。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826320447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我生者，有子","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826336831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫之義，故立名食神。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826336831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食者，如䖝之食物，葢傷之也。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826353215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䖝","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826369599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得食物則飽，人得食則益，被食則損。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826369599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"造化以子成而","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826385983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"致養，卽人子致養父母之道也，故曰食神。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826385983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅我者，我","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826402367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受制於人之義，故立名官煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826402367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官者，官也，煞者，害也。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826418751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826435135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廷以官與人，此身屬之公家，任其驅使，赴","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826435135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690866306072612/1-01cb1ba87025513f.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=qufkRCwv%2F48p%2Bm53VZESVGGBmEs%3D","uri":"read/HY1132/12/ref/1kubzybaw84dl/1-01cb1ba87025513f.webp","fontType":1,"components":"氵易","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690866306072612"},"logicSentenceId":"7577333961826435135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蹈火不","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826435135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敢有違，至於葢棺而後已，是官害之也。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826435135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人夢棺則","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826451519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得官，亦是此義，故曰官煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826451519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我尅者，是人受制於我之","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826467903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"義，故立名妻財。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826467903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人成家立産，須得妻室内助，故曰","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826484287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098501690540066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826484287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是四者術家立名之大義。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826500671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然生近乎身，尅隔乎","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826517055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位，造化喜生惡煞，乃自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826517055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中間陰陽從類，陰","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826533439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽配合，各有至理存焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826533439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生我我生，如壬生甲，癸生乙，","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826549823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲食丙，乙食丁，是陰生陰，陽生陽，陰食陰，陽食陽，爲","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826549823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽各從其類，故甲喜。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826549823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬生妖木滋方水中，則多年","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826566207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826566207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892645203980/1-1bb047dc1d2dfb3f.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=NeLcYBJT%2BhRIJvYWUr1MDlpOeK4%3D","uri":"read/HY1289/3/ref/1kw46dnm9xfzd/1-1bb047dc1d2dfb3f.webp","fontType":1,"components":"王衣罒一","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892645203980"},"logicSentenceId":"7577333961826566207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不喜。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826566207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸生成木被雨水淋漓，不踰年則朽。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826582591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲喜。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826598975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食丙，以丙能制庚煞，而甲始得安其身，不喜食丁，以","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826615359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁能傷官，而甲不得成其材，此其義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826615359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅我我尅，如","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826631743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛尅甲，庚尅乙，甲尅己，乙尅戊，是陰尅陽，陽尅陰，陰","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826631743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"匹陽，陽匹陰，乃陰陽配合之理。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826631743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲見辛爲正官，見","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826648127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098549354741772"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚爲偏官，官喜正不喜偏，掌印佐貳，職有不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826648127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲見","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826664511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己爲正妻，見戊爲偏妻，妻貴正，不貴偏，敵體侍立，分","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826664511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則有别，此其理也。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826664511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至若官怕傷，被傷則禍；財怕刼，被","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826680895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼則分；印怕財，貪財則壞；食怕梟，逄梟則奪。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826680895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其理與","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826697279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人事無二，學者明於人事，斯可以言造化矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826697279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826713663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"展轉生尅，皆子爲父母復讐之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826713663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲乙生丙丁爲","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826730047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子，甲乙畏庚辛，頼丙丁尅制之。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826730047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁生戊巳爲子，丙","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826746431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁畏壬癸，頼戊巳尅制之。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826746431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳生庚辛爲子，戊巳畏","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826762815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙，頼庚辛尅制之。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826762815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛生壬癸爲子，庚辛畏丙丁，","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826779199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頼壬癸尅制之。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826779199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸生甲乙爲子，壬癸畏戊巳，頼甲","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826795583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098499446751242"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙尅制之。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826795583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地支十二，其理亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826811967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖動静不同，力圓有","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826828351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"異，而生尅一也。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826828351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試言之，北方亥子水，生東方寅卯木，","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826844735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東方寅卯木生南方巳午火，土寄壯於火，生西方申","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826844735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉金，西方申酉金，生北方亥子水。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826844735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然亥子間丑三位，","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826861119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而後接寅卯；寅卯間辰一位，而後接巳午，巳午間未","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826861119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一位，而後接申酉，申酉間戊一位，而後接亥子土立","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826861119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四維，五行均頼，故己酉合丑爲金局，申子合辰爲水","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826861119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局，亥卯合未爲木局，寅午合戌爲火局。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826861119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金生水，水生","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826877503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木，木生火，火生土，土生金，相生而無間也。","logicSentenceId":"7577333961826877503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑爲金庫，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114784299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生亥子而尅寅卯辰爲水庫，生寅卯而尅巳午未爲","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114784299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098520170807330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木庫，生巳午而受金尅；戌爲火庫，尅申酉而受水制。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114784299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東南主生，西北主殺，此天地之大機也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114800683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且辰戌丑未，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114817067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奠安四維，金木水火，咸頼之以生藏。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114817067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：成言乎艮，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114833451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終言乎坤。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114833451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此士之功用，在五行爲尤大也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114849835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合干支而","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114866219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總言之，甲生亥以午，乙生午來亥，就禄於寅卯，是甲","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114866219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙寅卯同也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114866219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙生寅庻酉，丁生酉庻寅，就禄於巳午，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114882603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是丙丁巳午同也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114882603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚生巳庻子，辛生子从已，就禄於","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114898987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉，是庚辛申酉同也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114898987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬生申庻卯，癸生卯來申，就","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114915371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿於亥子，是壬癸亥子同也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114915371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊生寅威酉，己生酉成","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114931755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，就祿於巳午，與火同位，子隨母旺之義，而辰戌丑","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114931755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098555906195466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未乃其正位也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114931755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由是天干地支，相合配偶，生尅制化，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114948139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五相休囚，其名爲印、爲梟、爲食、爲傷、爲官、爲煞、爲財","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114948139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲刼，刑衝破害，虛邀暗合，而變化無窮矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114948139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐子平識","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114964523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破此理，故只論財官印食，分爲六格，而人命之富貴","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114964523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤、壽夭窮通，舉不外是。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114964523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘格局，不𨓺自此而推","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114980907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114980907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論正官喜","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114997291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身莊印綬食神，以財爲引，逄官㸔財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"忌身弱偏官傷，官刑衝泄氣貪合入莫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一曰正官，二曰禄神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官者，乃甲見辛、乙見庚之例，陰陽配合，相制有用，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114997291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098520170823714"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成其道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004114997291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故正官爲六格之首，止許位多則不宜","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115013675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正宫，先看月令，然後方㸔其餘。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115013675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以五行之氣，惟月令","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115030059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當時爲最。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115030059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况四柱各眉年限，年管十五，失之太早，時","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115046443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𬋩五十後，失之太遲，故只此月令爲正。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115046443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘格例此。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115062827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115079211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日生西月，乙生申巳，丙生子，丁生亥，戊生卯，己生寅，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115079211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚生午，辛生寅己、壬生午未丑，癸生辰巳戌月，皆爲","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115079211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正氣宫星，更天干透出，如甲見辛酉，乙見庚申之例，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115079211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之支藏干透，餘位不宜再見。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115079211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又須日主徤","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115095595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892809191465/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l9PxsAtYVVsYGFu9U3szWJfDA3o%3D","uri":"read/HY1123/8/ref/1koelguof5d03/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丅上王","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892809191465"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334004115095595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得財","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115095595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印兩扶，柱中不見傷煞，行運引至官鄉，大富大貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115095595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115111979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌刑衝破害、傷官七煞，貪合㤀官，刼財分福爲","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115128363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098501690556450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破格。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115128363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲生酉月，見卯爲衝，酉爲刑，午爲破，戌爲害，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115144747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙爲合，乙爲刼，丁爲傷尅，庚爲混雜，須是官星純一，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115144747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行和粹，方以正官論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115144747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見前忌，柱中雖有物，去之","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115161131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不純粹。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115161131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若官星結局，又有財資扶，非行身","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115177515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892809191465/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l9PxsAtYVVsYGFu9U3szWJfDA3o%3D","uri":"read/HY1123/8/ref/1koelguof5d03/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丅上王","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892809191465"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334004115177515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地不","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115177515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發，官止一二，無財有印，身弱無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115177515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱皆歸背祿，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115193899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜推歲運向背財官旺地何如。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115193899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財官滿日，日主衰","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115210283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，不能負荷，徒勞無用。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115210283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運至財煞旺鄉，多染癆瘵。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115226667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115243051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有七煞，行運復遇，便是徒流之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115243051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：甲生酉月，辛","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115259435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金正禄，若見丁傷，支中無局，時引歸衰敗𣦸絕之地，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115259435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有制合去之，衰絕之火，豈能傷其旺禄？","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115259435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若時引官","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115275819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098501690572834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星，臨衰敗𣦸絕之位，反引丁火歸生旺之鄉，或臨煞","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115275819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，降官失職，禍生無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115275819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時爲歸息之地，吉㐫全在時","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115292203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"消息。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115292203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日主用神太盛，宜時以節制之；日主用神漸衰，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115308587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜時以補𦔳之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115308587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中雖有㐫神，時能節制，亦不能爲","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115324971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115324971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此看命之要法也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115341355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：甲生丑月，内有辛金，又値","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115357739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉時，已是重犯。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115357739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若天干復透辛多，更行西方，力不勝","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115374123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任，變官爲鬼，旺處必傾，多致災夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115374123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須有合制方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115390507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115406891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自身乘","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115406891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892809191465/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l9PxsAtYVVsYGFu9U3szWJfDA3o%3D","uri":"read/HY1123/8/ref/1koelguof5d03/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丅上王","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892809191465"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334004115406891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲寅、乙卯等日，更有印生𦔳，官星雖多，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115406891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不爲害。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115406891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生戌月，雖坐火庫，若不成局無黨，不能","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115423275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲害。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115423275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以辛刃在戊戌中，有","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115439659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892809191465/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l9PxsAtYVVsYGFu9U3szWJfDA3o%3D","uri":"read/HY1123/8/ref/1koelguof5d03/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丅上王","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892809191465"},"logicSentenceId":"7577334004115439659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊生辛，如透庚混雜，戌","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115439659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098549354774540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月無氣，畧有制合，亦不爲慮。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115439659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：几用官，日干自坐，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115456043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財印終顯，如甲子、甲辰之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115456043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自坐傷煞，終有節病，如","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115472427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午、甲戌、甲申之類，須斟酌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115472427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日取官星，不必專泥","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115488811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令支辰或月干，或年日時支干只一處，有，不曽損。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115488811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷，皆可取用。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115505195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故經云：明干有氣，明干取；明干無氣，暗","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115521579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中取。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115521579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若明干無氣，引歸地支，或有𦔳托，運行得地，亦","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115537963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不減月内官星之福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115537963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡論官星，畧見一位，食神","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115554347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐實，便能損局。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115554347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟月令隱禄見食，却爲三奇之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115570731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115587115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要看官食虛實何如。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115587115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若官星坐實，合神畧虛，隨官𦔳","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115603499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，合神坐實，官星漸弱，□□合神，謂之貪合㤀官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115603499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115619883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098660771987519"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日：正官格要行印鄉，卽是逢官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115619883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看印柱中原有印，隨","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115636267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印輕重、日干強弱，以觀所行之運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115636267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱印輕，要補","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115652651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其印；身旺官輕，要補其官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115652651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行傷官運，卽是背禄；行身","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115669035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺運，卽是逐馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115669035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭云：背禄逐馬，守窮途而恓惶。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115685419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115701803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞運，卽是煞來混官；行墓運，卽是官星入墓。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115701803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：煞","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115718187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官混雜，不貧則夭；旺煞投墓，住壽難延。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115718187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以正官格，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115734571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只喜向禄臨財，如此消詳，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115734571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命鈴云：凡禄、","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115750955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命、身三等官，各禀五行，率以其性推之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115750955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如以金爲官，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115767339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主職位清峻，多掌刑獄錢榖之任，决斷明敏。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115767339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇行年","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115783723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲在丑爲官庫，主喜，亦取旺相休囚、有氣無氣言","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115783723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098549354807308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115783723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以木爲官，主品秩清高，和俗守愼。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115800107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇行年太歲","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115816491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在未爲官庫，以火爲官，主官序炎赫，爲性猛烈，用刑","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115816491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㮇酷，亦主發歇不常。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115816491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇行年太歲在戌爲官庫，以水","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115832875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲官，王，職卑位下，級陞序進，謙和得衆，矜恤孤寡，亦","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115832875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有道性。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115832875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇行年太歲在辰爲官庫，以土爲官，主，官序","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115849259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穏當，難侵犯，厚重質直，法令分明。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115849259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇行年太歲在辰","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115865643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲官庫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115865643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡五行之官，各隨其性則吉，若失其性，則主","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115882027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲官不久。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115882027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□□癸丑木命人以土爲禄官，木爲命官，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115898411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金爲身官，皆以三命尊卑、五行休壯言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115898411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄命、","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115914795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身三","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115914795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"等官庫，如甲子金，甲爲禄，屬木，木被金尅，故爲祿官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115914795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098510041497612"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金墓丑，是□□□□也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115931179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命與身官庫倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115947563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西蜀知命","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115963947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者云：凡人□□□□四干迭相，官印足者主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115963947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歴觀","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115980331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大命，遇兩印者頗多。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115980331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如吕吉甫學士，壬申己酉、丁巳","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115996715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子，壬與己，庚與丁爲官，壬與庚，己與丁爲印。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004115996715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"章子","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116013099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚相公丁亥、戊子、丁未、壬寅、己卯胎，戊與乙，壬與己，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116013099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁與壬爲官，乙與壬，戊與丁爲印，少遇雨官者，又須","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116013099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四貴華葢上遇正官者大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116013099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦一偏之見也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116029483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116045867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看官星，有天官鄉，取月干制歲干。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116045867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如六甲年正月建","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116062251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅，五月庚午，六力辛未，庚辛金能制甲木，戊癸卽","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116062251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相帶而行。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116062251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲癸人在午未，乙丙人在辰巳，丁戊人在","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116078635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098510041513996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯，己庚人在戌亥，辛壬人在申酉，若人遇之，當食","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116078635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天禄，貴處朝倫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116078635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有地官郷，取月建制歳干。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116095019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如歲干是","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116111403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙屬木，七八月見申，屬金，金能制木，甲乙人在申","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116111403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，丙丁人在亥子，戊巳人在寅卯，庚辛人在巳午，壬","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116111403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸人在辰戌丑未，若人遇之，主早承休蔭，官序易陞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116111403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有眞官鄉，取命前三辰月干與命干合。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116127787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙子人二","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116144171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月生，爲命前三辰是辛卯，丙與辛合，故丙子二月生","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116144171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人爲眞官中生之類，君子遇之，職居近侍；小人遇之，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116144171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦主富豪。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116144171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姫劉行素御史丙子辛卯、丙子辛卯，正合","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116160555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此說。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116160555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：□□以甲見辛爲官，不知眞五行尅納音","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116176939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098555906244618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲眞官，此最𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116176939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福神干頭自見官而得合者爲上，有","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116193323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸神來朝者最隹。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116193323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲寅生，納音水得己亥，甲己爲","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116209707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真土，是納音見眞五行尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116209707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不見太歲，本干尅，","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116226091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116226091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於曰月時上見乙庚亦是，若止見庚，謂之偏官，比之","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116226091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全者减力。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116226091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又不見乙庚，止見乙巳、乙丑、乙酉，餘位中","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116242475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多見申，不見申，止得三五分力。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116242475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116258859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如己酉、己","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116275243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯見丁壬，壬子、壬午見乙庚，雖納音見眞，五行尅爲","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116275243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，柰本干同受尅，故不作眞官，而作眞鬼㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334004116275243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天官貴人，","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689790982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂官本所居之地，出本旬遁見。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689790982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲人以辛爲官星，","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689807366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本旬遁得辛未，乙人遁得庚辰，丙人遁得癸巳之例。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689807366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干官星坐天乙貴人，如甲人見辛未，丙見癸巳，謂","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689823750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之貴人，頭上戴官星，更得印綬、禄貴全見，天元清秀，","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689823750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098629268668451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不反傷，納音尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689823750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有反傷衝尅，不順無氣，則天官惡","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689840134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而吉去矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689840134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三名官貴堂格：","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689856518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元坐禄","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689856518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：金若遇火，有重權防禦剌史臣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689856518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚午、庚寅、庚","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689872902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊、辛巳、辛未等日，水若遇土，入官局，可沾侍郞禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689872902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689889286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午、壬戌、癸巳、癸丑、癸未等日，木若遇金，主傷衰化","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689889286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，爲權勢若雷，如甲申、甲戌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689889286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙巳乙酉，乙平等日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689905670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇水，主兵權爲將，鎮三邊。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689905670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙申、丙子、丙辰、丁亥、","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689922054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑等日，土若遇木，爲正禄八座三台福，如戊寅、戊","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689922054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、己卯、己未、己亥等日，此卽白虎持世等格，要日主","logicSentenceId":"7577334064689922
