{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生月帶禄，支坐財官，生時得地，","logicSentenceId":"7577334064690003974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方爲真貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064690003974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午日是禄馬同鄉，更逄庚戌時爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064690020358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬","logicSentenceId":"7577334064690036742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自坐禄，有庚辛制甲乙，使壬得己土爲官貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064690036742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊辰","logicSentenceId":"7577334064690053126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：辰中乙木，爲戊之官，春生貴重，秋生虚譽無禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064690053126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

dList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真官催官","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693788708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己丑得甲寅，辛丑得丙寅，命前一辰之類，爲真宫，","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693788708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098629268815907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不貴卽富。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693788708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚辰見乙卯，戊子見癸丑，自下而上，名","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693805092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"催宫之類，主功名發越。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693805092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞㑹墓","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693821476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲乙人見辛丑，丙丁人壬辰、戊巳人乙未，庚辛人","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693821476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌，壬癸人戊辰，以官煞居墓地，君子主科用，武人","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693821476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戰功，常人藝業出俗。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693821476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三台拱帝座，","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693837860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專論納音。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693837860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如水人得甲寅，又得己亥日時，甲寅水見","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693854244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己土，乃是真官，甲真土復 {"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上俱官星分出。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693919780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論偏官","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693936164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜身旺印綬，合煞，食制羊刃，比肩逄煞，㸔印及刃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以食爲引，忌身弱財星，正官刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"入墓一日偏官，二日七煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三日五鬼，四日將星，五日孤極星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏官者，乃甲見庚、乙見辛之例，猶二男不同處，二女","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693936164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不同居，不成配偶，故謂之偏。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693936164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以其隔七位而相尅戰，","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693952548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故又謂之七煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693952548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬小人多㐫暴無忌憚，若無禮法控","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693968932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制之，不多不戒，必傷其主，故有制謂之偏官，無制謂","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693968932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098629268832291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之七煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693968932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如日主徤旺，有印綬𦔳化，卽經云：煞見印而","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693985316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯；煞𦔳印生，有財星生扶，卽經云：逄煞者財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064693985316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如身強","logicSentenceId":"7577334064694001700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞弱，有財星則吉；身弱煞強，有財引鬼盗氣，非貧則","logicSentenceId":"7577334064694001700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064694001700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有食神透制，卽經云：一見制伏却爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064694018084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本有陽刃","logicSentenceId":"7577334064694034468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"配合，即經云：煞無刃不顯，逄煞看刃是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064694034468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又時上偏官二","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816078884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位強，日辰自旺喜非常。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816078884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有財有印多財禄，定是天生","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816095268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作棟梁。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816095268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又時逄七煞是偏官，有制身強好命看制遍","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816111652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行煞旺運，三合得地發何難。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816111652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又生逄七煞在時中，","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816128036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定作邉臣立大功。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816128036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制禦帶合無忌破，兵權赫奕鎮威。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816144420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風又：元無制伏運須見，不怕刑衝多煞攅。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816160804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是身衰","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816177188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟煞旺，定知此命是貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816177188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又時逄七煞本無兒，此理","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816193572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098650022133769"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人間仔細推。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816193572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲月時中如有制，定知有子貴而遲。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816209956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上七煞","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816226340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經日：年逄貴氣，不用制伏，喜日主徤旺，羊刃相合，柱","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816226340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中帶財，更行財運，發福清秀，最忌身衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816226340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢七煞乃小","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816242724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之象，旣居祖宗之位，如朝廷老臣，祖父老僕，□主","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816242724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徤旺，老僕則𥁞力以事幼主。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816242724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日主衰弱，不能與小人","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816259108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲主，何肯𥁞力事之，反成害己之物。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816259108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年干見此，必主","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816275492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出身寒微。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816275492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱行運有情，主寒門生貴子。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816291876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若煞旺身","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816308260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰，衝刑太過，必主貧窘，至重者帶疾遭刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816308260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：歲煞","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816324644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一位不宜制，四柱重見却宜制。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816324644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日主徤旺，制伏畧多。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816341028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098570494001171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□行煞旺地，制伏太過，或煞旺身衰，官煞混雜，歲運","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816357412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如之，禄碌之軰。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816357412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若制伏不及，運至身衰煞旺郷，必生","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816373796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍患。","logicSentenceId":"7577334064816373796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一命戊戌庚申，壬午癸卯，戊與癸合，卯與戌合，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065204822057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬坐午支，財官俱僃爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065204822057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌云：歲德壬來見戊年，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065204838441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財莊身強禄自然。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065204838441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有物去煞留官者，卽以正官論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205870633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡看去留，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205887017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要詳柱中官煞，孰重孰輕，天干透者易去，月支所藏","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205887017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者難去，須傷官食神去官煞之物，衆而有力，方𦆵去","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205887017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205887017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五陽日食神，能去煞，又能留官；五陽日傷官，但能","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205903401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去官，不能留煞，必須得羊刃合，方成去官留煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205903401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205919785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用日生人，甲以辛爲官，庚爲煞，若宫重煞輕，得丙食","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205919785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一位，剋去庚金，與辛相合，此謂去煞留官，有情而貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205919785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若煞重官輕，得丁火傷宫，尅去辛金，再得乙木羊刃，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205936169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與庚相合，此謂去官留煞，有情而貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205936169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五陰日食神能","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205952553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去煞，却不能留官，日主自能留之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205952553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五陰日傷官，能去","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205968937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098588609167398"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，又能留煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205968937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如乙日生人，以庚爲官，辛爲煞，若官","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205985321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重煞輕，得丁食一位，尅去辛煞，則乙與庚合，此謂去","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205985321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞留官，有情而貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065205985321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若煞重官輕，得丙火傷官，尅去庚","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206001705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金，來合辛金，此謂去官留煞，有情而貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206001705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元理賦云：去","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206018089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞留官當論貴，去官留煞主威權。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206018089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：官星七煞交","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206034473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"差，却有合煞爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206034473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206050857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合煞有二義，有合去、合","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206067241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206067241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合來是去官留煞，合去是去煞留官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206083625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令六甲生","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206100009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人，透辛正宮，又透庚七煞，是官煞交差，柱中却有乙","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206100009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木合庚七煞，有丁火尅辛官星，此是去官留煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206100009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206116393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己生人，透出甲正官，又透乙七煞，是官煞交差，柱","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206116393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098694620102696"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中却有庚尅甲正官，來合乙七煞，是去官留煞，上是","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206116393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃合煞，此是傷官合煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206116393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如甲以辛酉爲官，庚申","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206132777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲煞，若甲巾日，以申爲煞，又有酉爲官，縁申乃水長","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206132777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生之地，煞化印生𦔳甲木，柱中雖有酉金，却有午丁。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206132777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字傷尅，去官留煞，值此，主平生心志巧妙，不受福德，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206149161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不信任他人，常勞役自己。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206149161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如六庚生人，柱透丙煞，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206165545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又透丁官，是官煞交差。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206165545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若柱有壬尅丙，又來合丁，是","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206181929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫煞留官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206181929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦云：合官星不爲貴，合七煞不爲匈。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206198313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢言","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206214697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合官是柱中閑神，合去官星，所以不爲貴；合煞是柱","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206214697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中閑神，與七煞合，所以合官忘貴，合煞忘賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206214697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日主","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206231081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098694620119080"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支與官煞合，則爲合官爲貴，合煞爲賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206231081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書云：明煞","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206247465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合去，五行和氣春風；暗煞合來，四柱刑傷害已是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206247465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不分别日主與閑神，何以有合來合去之辨？","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206263849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢合","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206280233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去之法，如年月相合，去之，不論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206280233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月時相合亦去。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206296617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日與","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206313001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年合不可去，以日與年爲要。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206313001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘作閑神論也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206329385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經日：官","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206345769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞兩停，喜者存之，憎者去之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206345769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢言柱中正官七煞兩","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206362153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"均相停，有物生扶㑹和者，其力專，宜存而留之；有物","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206362153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破損傷害者，其力散，宜棄而去之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206362153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星有生扶，煞星","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206378537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有破害，則去煞留官；反是則去官留煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206378537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若兩停俱無","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206394921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扶合而有破害，當斟酌柱中有力一字爲用神，若是","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206394921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098668296568866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉神，則以吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206394921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若兩停俱有扶合而無破害，卽是官","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206411305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞混雜，反爲貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206411305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日年月日時，或有四位官，四位","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206427689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，當以明者用之，藏者捨之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206427689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明見官則存其官，明見","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206444073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞則存其煞，宜仔細分别。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065206444073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若兩停無輕重，察其生𦔳，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502617636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向時者用之，背時無助者棄之，去留不清，乃爲混雜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502617636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲生七月，上旬爲煞得令，縱有丙火，亦不能去。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502634020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502650404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：去留二格，最宜身旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502650404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若身果旺，雖無物去煞，亦能","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502666788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化煞爲官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502666788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲見庚爲煞，甲坐寅禄旺，甲木自抱火","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502683172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣制煞，不須再見丙丁。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502683172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲生秋令，却要丙丁制之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502699556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱原無制，運到制地方發。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502715940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如丙日畏壬，丙坐巳午，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502732324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098694620151848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或丙下抱上，則壬不能爲害，丙化煞爲官，須行身旺","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502732324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運可。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502732324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：地支天干合多，亦云貪合忘官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502748708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢言曰主","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502765092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元地支、人元與當生歲月時中，支干明暗重重相","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502765092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，有情貪戀合神雖有官星，則財來盗氣，官來尅身，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502765092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反為不利，官將不成，財將不遂，故曰貪合忘官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502765092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502781476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫神有物合去則反㐫爲吉；吉神有物，合去則反吉","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502781476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502781476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㐫神煞，看局中喜忌何神，不可執一。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502797860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502814244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奥㫖","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502830628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦云：陽日食神，暗合官星，陰日食神，竊侵印綬。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502830628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀此","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502847012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則知，四柱無官印則喜食神，有官印則忌食神。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502847012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502863396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪合忘煞忘官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502863396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如六癸生人，干頭透出己字爲煞，再","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502879780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098660772085823"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"透甲字，是己家合神，合去巳字，不爲煞矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502879780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此謂貪合","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502896164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忘煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502896164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚申、甲申、甲子乙亥，年上庚字傷甲，得亥上","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502912548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙字，合庚去煞，柰月令又有申不清。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502912548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二申煞重，不能","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502928932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𥁞合，所以只爲吏命。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502928932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如六壬生人，千頭透巳字爲","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502945316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，再見甲透，是己家合神，合去巳字，不爲官星，此謂","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502945316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪合忘官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502945316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辛丑、丙申、甲戌、己巳，甲日透出辛字，正","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502961700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是官星，柰因丙火合去，所以發貴不清。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065502961700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推天元變化書有反鬼作官，如丁未、甲辰、癸丑、癸亥","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503387684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098660772134975"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩鬼反爲生氣，滋𦔳中木，旣甲木旺則丁亦旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503387684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又納","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503404068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"音從下生至火，旣火莊水人得財盛，上下皆有用矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503404068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尺璧云：凡尅干者不得地，干却得地者，多鬼化儒官","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503420452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變官爲鬼如甲戌納音，火見丙辛水爲眞官，若得丙","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503420452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申、辛酉，或辛未、辛丑皆好。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503420452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得辛卯係甲羊刄，變官","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503436836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503436836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若别有福神救𦔳，則爲右職無氣胥吏之軰。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503453220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503469604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申人，納音是成噐之金，見火則壞，故壬申人見戊","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503469604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸者，乃變官爲鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503469604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又壬屬木，木至申爲絕鄉，木絕得","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503485988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火則灰飛烟滅，此爲尢因。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503485988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若癸酉雖是成噐之金，然。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503502372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本干自帶癸之官，故不爲鬼，見戊尤好，當消息之","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503518756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098694620168232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503518756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正財","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503535140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜身莊印綬食神，逄財㸔信，以食爲引。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"忌身弱北肩，羊刃空絶衝合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一日財犀，二曰天馬星，三日催官星，四日壯亢神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正財者，乃甲見己、乙見戊之例，受我尅制，爲我之妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503535140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬人娶妻，妻齋財嫁我，我必精神康強，而後可享用。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503551524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若衰微不振，雖妻財豐厚，但能目視，終不得用。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503567908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故財","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503584292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要得時乘旺，不偏正，混亂，不重叠，多見自家曰主有","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503584292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"力，皆能發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503584292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財多身弱，柱無印𦔳，財少身強，柱有","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503600676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比刼，太過不及，皆不爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503600676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：傷妻叠叠，財輕身旺","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503617060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"館兄多。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503617060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：財多身弱，反僞富屋貧人。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503633444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭云：大爰","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503649828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098668296601634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元羸弱宫，吉不及以爲滎。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503649828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱鄧通鑄錢，終身不富","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503666212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而餓來。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503666212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503682596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月令得財局，身衰，逄印資𦔳，當作富","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503698980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503698980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如先見印，却怕見財，獨歩云：先財後印，反成其福；","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503715364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先印後財，反成其辱是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503715364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用財不宜明露，柱見比刼，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503731748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則宜透出，使人共見，則不能奪。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503731748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦云：財宜藏，藏則豐","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503748132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚，露則浮蕩。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503748132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503764516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡財格喜見宫星顯露，别無傷損，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503780900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或更食生印𦔳，日主徤旺，富貴雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503780900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如干支見煞，亦","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503797284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能享用，卽逄財看煞之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503797284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大怕梟奪則不能生，刃刼","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503813668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則不能享，庫逄空則不能聚。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503813668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲生午月，見壬傷，丙","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503830052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯破乙奪；乙生巳月，見癸傷，丁亥破甲奪；壬生戌月，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503830052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098709610479628"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子旬戌落空千之類，餘以例推。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503830052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：財爲養命之","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503846436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065503846436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

nceId":"7577334065566842943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566842943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干例推","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566859327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨庫墓","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566859327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：納粟奏名，財庫居生旺之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566859327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰爲土財庫，生","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566875711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於秋，莊於冬；丑爲火財庫，生於夏，莊於秋。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566875711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未爲金財","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566892095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庫，生於冬，正於春。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566892095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌爲水財庫，生於春，旺於夏。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566908479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566924863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金以木爲財庫於未，辛未曰生，是臨財庫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566924863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日生未","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566941247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，亦是身臨財庫，生各月，謂之財庫居生地；生春月，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566941247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之 {"lines":[{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566957631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098709610594316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：六辛坐未休嫌弱，土透天干反有功。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566957631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺何愁金","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566974015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水旺，傷提方見壽元終。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566974015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火旺於未，辛坐未，是謂衰","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566990399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弱。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065566990399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛以卯中乙木爲財庫於未，若得四柱天干透土，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065567006783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藉印生身，變弱爲強。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065567006783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖金生水，水生木，則庫旺甚，吾","logicSentenceId":"7577334065567023167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木能任爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065567023167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若提綱是卯，行酉運衝提，方損壽元。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065567039551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛","logicSentenceId":"7577334065567055935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生坐未，夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065567055935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十無土以身弱論，是財庫居生狂，亦要身","logicSentenceId":"7577334065567072319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自莊也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065567072319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元坐財，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065567088703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚辰辛卯日，春生甲乙木爲財，喜戊巳印生身，壬","logicSentenceId":"7577334065567088703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸食生財，忌庚辛金刼奪，切不可歲逄官煞，卽春月","logicSentenceId":"7577334065 "logicSentenceId":"7577334065892687891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：偏財好出，亦不懼藏，惟怕分奪，及落空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065892704275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有一","logicSentenceId":"7577334065892720659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於此，官將不成，財將不住。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065892720659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如財弱，必待歴旺鄉而榮","logicSentenceId":"7577334065892737043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財盛，無徃不利，但恐身勢無力，不能勝任。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065892737043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財格，主","logicSentenceId":"7577334065892753427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098709610627084"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人慷慨，不甚吝財，與人有情而多詐。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065892753427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是得地，不止","logicSentenceId":"7577334065892769811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豐財，亦能𫆅官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065892769811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以財盛自生宫，運行莊相，福禄俱臻，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065892786195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三遇官鄉，便可發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065892786195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如柱中原帶官星，便作好命㸔。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065892802579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若兄弟軰出，縱入官鄉，發福必渺。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065892818963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專財","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893785619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃丙日見丙申時，甲日見己巳時，丙之禄在巳，丙旣","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893785619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098588609298470"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐申，引巳刑出庚金，丙日尅之爲財，己與申合，兩干","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893785619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆丙，是爲專財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893785619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行官旺，財神不背，大發財官，忌行","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893802003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官刼財、衝刑破禄之運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893802003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日己巳時，要身財俱旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893818387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生木旺月喜土多，生土旺月喜木多。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893818387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893834771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893851155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、戊辰、丙申、丙申、癸酉、庚申、丙子、丙申二命專財格","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893851155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893851155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古詩云：專財丙日見申時，運至官鄉福更奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893867539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須登","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893883923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"象簡金𩵋貴，福壽雙全事事宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893883923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棄命從財","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893900307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨歩云：棄命從財，須要會財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893900307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄根氣，命損無猜。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893916691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893933075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁生酉月，柱多庚辛，日干無氣，只得棄命相從運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893933075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098660772216895"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入北方財官旺地，乃爲入格南行災。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893949459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌云：日干無","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893965843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣滿盤財，棄命相從是福胎。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893965843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運旺財官皆富貴，如逄","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893982227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"根𦔳反爲災。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893982227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日坐天財，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893998611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊巳土尅水爲財，水墓辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065893998611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌云：年干尅下","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894014995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是天財，尅墓之鄉正庫開。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894014995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財入庫時多糓帛，家豪金","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894031379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物積成堆。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894031379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如畢狀元己巳、癸酉、庚辰、甲申是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894047763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏正財合論","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894064147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精紀。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894064147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有生成財如甲乙見戊巳土爲財，申子辰上坐","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894080531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玍旺庫，戊申、戊辰、戊子，支干成合是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894080531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命入貴","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894096915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098694620233768"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格，除貴外，須主大富，仍多歷錢榖之任。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894096915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不入貴","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894113299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格，又無福神𦔳，亦是富豪百姓。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894113299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若自生自旺，甲人","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894129683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見戊午、己亥之例，主富，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894129683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有生合財，如甲人見戌，癸巳人見癸、戊庚人見甲己","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894146067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"等類，主成立富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894146067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有子母財，如本命人見火、月土、日時之類，主平生多","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894162451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見喜事。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894162451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有類財煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894178835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌人見乙庚，己酉丑人見丁壬，申子","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894195219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰人見戊癸，亥𫑗未人見甲己，一名幽微煞，主名","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894195219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利並行。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894195219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098694620250152"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有財㑹煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894211603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌人見辛丑，己酉丑人見乙未，申子","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894227987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰人見丙戌，亥𫑗未人見戊辰，此妻財聚㑹之神，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894227987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇者主富足，及有美妻横財，却妨妻人毒藥害命。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894227987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有名位財乃食神中見庫，如戊子火人見庚戌，戊食","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894244371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚火庫在戌，尅金爲財，逄此者，一生受禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894244371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有長生財，如甲用戊巳爲財，見戊申，癸用丙丁爲財，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894260755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見丙寅之例，此類多得外財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894260755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：術者多以甲見戊、乙見己類爲財，不知甲己見","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894277139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛，丙辛見戊癸等類爲眞財，生居有氣旺相之位，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894277139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主富盛。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894277139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又納音本干自見眞五行，如乙亥人，月日時","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894293523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098668296781858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中見庚，乙亥納音火，乙庚眞金，干頭自是財也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894293523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此名。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065894309907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天財主富足優逸，若納音反制尅干頭，如丁卯火，却","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905270847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能制乙庚金，此名鬼財，主一生得世財，或爲豪猾胥","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905270847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吏起家。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905270847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅、戊申得丙辛，乙酉、乙𫑗得戊癸，准此。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905287231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905303615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶辰戌丑未，主爲藝術，大獲世財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905303615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：禄命身三等財庫，如甲子金，甲爲禄，屬木，木尅","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905319999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土，故土爲禄財，土墓在辰，是爲禄財庫也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905319999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子爲命，屬","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905336383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，水尅火，故火爲命財，火墓在戌，是爲命財庫也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905336383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905352767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲身，金尅木，故木爲身財，木墓在未，是爲身財庫也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905352767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主財産豐盈，少年辛苦，漸老成，遂","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905369151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098704950607923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有歲制月建，如甲乙人在辰戌丑未，丙丁人在申酉","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905369151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"等類，若人遇之，主職位崇高，印綬顯赫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905369151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若身衰不","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905385535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能尅財，如壬寅金見戊辰木、丁卯火、癸酉金之類，","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905385535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不能尅制，翻成損氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905385535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905401919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論印綬","logicSentenceId":"7577334065905418303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1828","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜食神、天月德，七煞逢印 {"lineId":"2126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬忌行來絕地，最怕財晤落財鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204000262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運月支重臨","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204016646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098660772249663"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹，即主斯人定喪亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204016646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2130","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綬生人旺氣繩，官煞多遇","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204033030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉精神。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204033030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印行以絕並財地，無救終爲泉下人。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204049414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2134","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又丙丁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月多官煞，四柱無根怕水郷。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204065798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濕木不生無熖火，身","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204082182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榮除是到南方。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204082182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2138","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙人用卯月爲正印，若四柱官以多，則水太旺，木雖生於水，而隰木又不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"能生火，故喜南方身旺，渾如丙人，𫑗月行子運，雖爲官運，反足以壞印。觀此印緩利官運之說，不可執泝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinY {"lines":[{"lineId":"2219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胞胎逄印綬，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204655622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：胞胎逄印綬，禄享千鍾。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204655622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚寅、辛卯、丙申、乙西","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204672006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"等日時月令，逄印綬之地，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204672006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：時日胞胎格，月","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204688390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通，印綬逄煞官印運𦔳，職位列三公。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066204688390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棄印就財","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211455017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098704950738995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：棄印就財明偏正。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211455017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬忌財，此理甚明。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211471401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正印居","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211487785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令者，决不可見財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211487785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若居年時月令見財，只用財格，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211504169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜印生身，敵財爲福。","logicSentenceId":"757733406621 {"lines":[{"lineId":"2239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論倒食","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211569705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2240","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一名吞滔煞，一名退神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒食，卽偏印之謂，一名吞啖煞，食神最忌見之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211569705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211586089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生丙火爲食，火能生土，僞甲之財；財旺生金，爲甲之","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211586089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，食神生旺，材官僃矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211586089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今甲見王爲倒食者，壬正則","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211602473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098764220334134"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅了丙火，丙被尅去，不能生土，甲無財矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211602473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬合起丁，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211618857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷甲之辛，甲無官矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211618857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬尅去丙，庚煞得安，來傷甲木，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211635241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生災矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211635241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂用食忌見者此也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211651625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命帶倒食，福薄","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211668009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天壽，若有制合，如甲日見壬辰、壬戌，辰戌中有士制","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211668009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁合，乙日見癸未、癸丑丑未中有巳制癸丙日見甲","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211668009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申，丁日見乙巳、乙酉，戊日見丙子、丙申、丙辰、巳日見","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211668009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥，庚日見戊寅、戊辰，辛日見己卯、己亥，壬日見庚","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211668009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午、庚戌，癸日見辛巳、辛未，此等偏印，不能爲食，害有","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211668009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅制故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211668009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中身旺，財官俱生，可取爲福𦔳身。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211684393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽日","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211700777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄之，能暗合傷官生財；陰日逄之，能暗合財星柱中。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066211700777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

34066224807999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2551","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098734373765130"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我所生自家之物，傷𥁞則能生財，財旺則能生官，造","logicSentenceId":"7577334066224807999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化展轉有情。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066224807999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如月令在傷官，四柱作合結局皆在傷","logicSentenceId":"7577334066224824383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位，無衝無破，不見一㸃官星，謂之傷𥁞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066224824383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有月支傷","logicSentenceId":"7577334066224840767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，時上傷官，四柱無官星，亦謂傷𥁞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066224840767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更身旺財旺，或","logicSentenceId":"7577334066224857151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印旺，名標金㮄，一品貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066224857151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格主多材藝傲物，氣高","logicSentenceId":"7577334066224873535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心險，無忌憚，多謀少遂，㺯巧成拙，常以天下之人不","logicSentenceId":"7577334066224873535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己，而人亦憚之惡之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066224873535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官無財，主貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225381439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢生財氣","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225397823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，卽食神傷官；盜財氣者，卽七煞官星。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225397823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以傷官要","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225414207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見財，不要見官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225414207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如印生午月，水不南奔，身勢太柔，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225430591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈可再逄金制，金能盜土之氣，所以不要見官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225430591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣無","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225446975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098704950804531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星，而柱却無一㸃財可恃，雖聰明機巧，不𨓺虛名","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225446975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虛利。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225446975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：傷官無財可倚，雖巧必貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225463359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225479743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

inYin":null},{"lineId":"2590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱傷官多而見官者，不宜復行傷運，一位無","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225627199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225627199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：傷官格務要傷𥁞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225643583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若柱見傷官，而官星隠顯，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225659967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷之不𥁞，歲運再見官星，官來乗旺，再見刑衝破害，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225659967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2595","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098760160460852"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刃煞尅身，身弱財旺，必主徒流𣦸亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066225659967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行有救亦殘。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526027818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526044202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱無官，而遇傷煞重者，運入官郷，歲君又遇，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526060586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不目疾，必主災破。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526060586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：傷官叠見，正官必爲師冕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526076970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：四柱傷官，運入官鄉必破。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526093354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：傷官復行官
