{"lines":[{"lineId":"2606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日：五行傷官，惟火人土傷官，土人","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526142506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金傷官，忌見官星。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526142506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若金人水，水人木，木人火不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526158890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526175274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火以水爲官，以土爲傷，水畏土尅土，得水無益。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526175274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土以","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526191658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木爲官，以金爲傷，木畏金尅金，得木無益。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526191658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以火土","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526208042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官格，忌見官星。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526208042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金以水爲傷，以火爲官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526224426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水雖尅火，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526240810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若金寒水冷，不得火温，難以濟物；况水得火成旣濟","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526240810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2618","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098760160362548"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之功。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526240810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水以木爲傷，以土爲官，木雖尅土，若水泛木浮，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526257194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不得土止，難以存活。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526257194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况木得土成栽培之力。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526273578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木以火","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526289962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲傷，以金爲官，火雖尅金，若木䌓火熄，不得金削脫，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526289962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難以通明。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526289962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况金得火成噐物之象。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526306346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以金、水木傷官","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526322730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格，不忌官星。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526322730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故經云：傷官火土宜傷𥁞，金水傷官要","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526339114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見官，木火見官官有旺，土金官去反成官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526339114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有水木","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526355498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官格，財官兩見始爲歡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526355498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526371882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：傷官傷𥁞，亦有","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526388266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不作福者；𠏶官見官，亦有不作禍者。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526388266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一命丁未、丁","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526404650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未、丙午、丙午，丙日坐午，日主自旺，有二午、二丁、二未，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526404650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官俱傷，雖傷官傷𥁞，柰四柱火氣太肚，𥨸氣又重，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526404650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2639","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098760160477236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行東南火旺之鄉，無一㸃財氣，身空旺無倚，至貧","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526404650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之人，切不可見傷官傷𥁞身旺，便作好命看。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526404650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如甲","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526421034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日生人，柱有辛爲官，又有丁傷官，若生秋月官旺，雖","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526421034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄丁火，或居亥子之上，或見午伏壬癸之下，則丁不","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526421034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能傷官，終爲有官爵之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526421034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運遇剥官印綬俱吉，忌","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526437418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身衰敗運，切不可見傷官格，有官星，便不作好命看。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526437418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：人命原有些小傷官，不能損貴氣，或運入官鄉，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526453802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官自旺強徤，或入印運，制伏傷煞，或有財生𦔳，或從","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526453802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化人於别格，不失爲好命，怕再行傷地，病而不起者","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526453802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有之，否則文書口舌，官事破財，殃禍踵至。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526453802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱元有財，","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526470186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2653","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098760160395316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又行財運，亦可成就功名利禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526470186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一行官煞地，或財衰","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526486570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敗𣦸絕地，卽失財禄，非官訟，則喪服重併。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526486570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：四柱","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526502954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官，惟年干傷官最重，謂之福基受傷，終身不可除","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526502954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526502954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月支更有甚於傷身七煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526519338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲日生人，以辛爲","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526535722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，見丁卯年生寅午戌月，是傷官重犯，叉有卯爲刼","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526535722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刃，名背禄逐馬，主爲人退悔，反傷祖蔭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526535722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行官鄉，流","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526552106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年再見，或煞旺身弱運必禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526552106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月令眞正傷官，又見","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526568490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526568490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲日生午月見辛未時，午中丁火傷𨐋；乙日","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526584874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生巳月見庚，或甲申時，巳中丙火傷庚；丙日午月見","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526584874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子癸巳時，午中己土傷癸之例。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526584874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大要日主徤旺，再","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526601258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2672","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098734373797898"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨傷官運，可發名利。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526601258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日主微弱，運歷財官鄉，禍不可","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526617642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526617642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：傷官，如甲日見丁，喜壬合癸破；乙見丙喜辛","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526634026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合壬破，丙見己喜甲合乙破，丁見戊喜癸合甲破，戊","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526634026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見辛喜丙合丁破，己見庚喜乙合丙破，庚見癸喜戊","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526634026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合己破，癸見甲喜己合庚破。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526634026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬祺云：傷官元辰無官","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526650410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星，又行傷官運，此爲𥨸氣太𨓺，卽一水叠逄火位，名","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526650410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲散氣之文，非貧則夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526650410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜身旺及官鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526666794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官見官，再","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526683178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剥再滯，運入官鄉，局中反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526683178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽傷官傷𥁞，却喜見官","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526699562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526699562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官若帶財，見印禍不輕；傷官若帶印，官煞不爲","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526715946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526715946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官多者，宜行印，卽食多用印；傷官少者，又行印","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526732330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2691","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098705260970023"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄕，卽梟神奪食。","logicSentenceId":"7577334066526732330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官若帶印，不宜逄財，傷官若帶官。","logicSente ll,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生丙，本爲泄氣，丙生戊，爲甲偏財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004391487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財是天禄","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004407871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自然之財，不勞己之心力，享見成福禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004407871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲丙有父子","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004424255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之道，如子旺相，生起財禄，以奉其父母，豈不安享？","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004424255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004440639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲見庚爲煞，見戊爲財，其食神丙火，能制伏庚煞，使","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004440639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不得尅傷，甲木能生戊財，使爲甲木所用。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004440639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命遇財","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004457023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2828","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098704950853683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞之地，食神旺相，煞被食制，不敢爲禍，財被食生，兄","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004457023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"裕不竭。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004457023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故食神一名壽星，一名爵星，艮有以也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004473407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004489791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要日主食神俱生旺，無衝破，主人財厚食豐，福量寛","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004489791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弘，肌體肥大，優游自足，有子息，有壽考。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004489791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱見財食，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004506175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在歲月上，祖父蔭業豐隆；在日時，妻男獲福，怕母子","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004506175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱衰絕，兩皆無成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004506175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故經云：食神宜食生食旺，不可食","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004522559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰食絕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004522559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：食神生旺，勝似財官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004538943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004555327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：食神大","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004571711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌偏印，爲倒食，主爲人有始無終，容貌欹邪，身材𤨏","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004571711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小，心性局促，多慾無成。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004571711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲見丙爲食，柱中有壬","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004588095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作甲木偏印尅制，丙火不能生戊土，不能制庚金，使","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004588095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2847","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098705261002791"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木受制退財，豈不窘乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004588095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元理賦云：食神制煞逄梟，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004604479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不貧則天。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004604479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一行云：五行休廢遇奇救，災禍必輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004620863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004637247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"消息值平和，福德増重。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004637247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄倒食之神，决主財多耗","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004653631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004653631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日陽日食神暗合官星，陰日食神暗合正","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004670015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印，官印不要明顯，但得食神純粹，主貴而有禄，富而","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004670015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004670015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神只宜一位，不宜太多，恐𥨸本元之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004686399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004702783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一木叠逄火位，名爲散氣之文是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004702783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神多者宜行。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004719167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印運食少者，不宜是梟神奪食，故食喜旺禄相𦔳，月","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004735551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"令建禄最佳，時禄次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004735551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更逄貴人，運行食𥚞生旺之","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004751935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，大發福禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004751935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌身衰梟旺，柱中雖喜見財，亦不宜多，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004768319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2868","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098743139926051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多則不清，不過一富翁而己。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004768319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神重見，變爲傷官，令","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004784703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人少子。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004784703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有或帶破抝性，又不可入墓，卽是傷官入","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004801087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓，住壽難延。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004801087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌空亡，更有官煞顯露，爲太醫師巫、","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004817471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"術數九流之士。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004817471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若食神逢尅，又遇空亡，則不貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004833855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再行","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004850239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸絕，或梟運，則因食上氣上生災，翻胃噎食，缺衣食，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004850239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忍饑寒而己。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004850239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：甲日食丙，柱中無壬癸亥子方好。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004866623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如有水氣，丙自受制，屈伏於人，己身不能卓立，豈能","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004883007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生物以養其父？","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004883007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無此制，又要生旺向禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004899391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙生夏","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004915775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月，運歷東南，火土俱旺，其甲用財必厚。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004915775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生三春，甲","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004932159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，丙火雖得生，不知戊巳氣薄，須歷南方火土俱旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004932159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2888","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098831173976064"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方許發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004932159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如庚以壬爲食，運歷北方水旺之地，𤼵","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004948543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財必厚，東方木旺之鄉，發福必𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004948543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細論之，庚以壬爲","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004964927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食，長生於申，當斷申地福重，暴敗在酉，壬水至酉，便","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004964927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不爲隹。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004964927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以壬生甲木，爲庚之財，卽自生分發身之財，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004981311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非婚配正妻之財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004981311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲至酉地，爲木困金鄉，壬水自敗，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004997695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木豈能𦔳養其父？","logicSentenceId":"7577334067004997695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當斷此運平平，行至戌運，如干遇","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005014079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬甲，亦只㫁其半吉半㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005014079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄戊可㫁其有災，見庚可","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005030463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁其微福，亥運當言其大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005030463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十運癸水傷官傷重，泄","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005046847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本身之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005046847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又庚𣦸於子，甲敗於子，當斷生禍身災。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005063231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005079615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至丑，庚金之庫，水旺之鄉，又有己丑𦔳庚甲冠帶成","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005079615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2908","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098705261035559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之地，可㫁此十年𤼵。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005079615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅運亦吉，卯運有災，餘例此","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005095999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005095999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：食神忌梟，亦有不畏者。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005112383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己亥不畏丁倒食。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005128767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁與壬合化木，而壬禄在亥；丙午不畏甲，倒食。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005145151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲與","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005161535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己合化土，而己禄在午。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005161535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳不畏癸，倒食戊癸化火，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005177919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳亦火。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005177919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005194303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己不畏辛，倒食丙辛化水，癸貴在巳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005210687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005227071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲衆陽之首，不畏戊，倒食戊，陽氣歸源之數，見戊作","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005227071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜神論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005227071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已不倒食，辛陰器初發散之源；庚不倒食，壬，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005243455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽氣初發散之源。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005243455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛有丁不畏己，倒食，爲丁養育辛","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005259839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005259839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况有丁處，便有己土，陰陽干渉，得清福之𦔳，故","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005276223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛人切要丁，但從寅遁至辛人本禄位，方知用丁","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005276223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2930","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098764220465206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005276223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更月是金家巳土，火裏長生，故知要火爲文貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005292607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金無父母，借火處有父母之氣故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005308991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：十干以隔","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005325375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一位爲食神，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005325375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希尹日：甲己化土，故食丙辛；丙辛","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005341759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化水，故食戊癸；戊癸化火，故食庚乙；庚乙化金，故食","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005341759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬丁；壬丁化木，故食甲己。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005341759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化氣相尅而食食神者，十","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005358143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干福禄之㑹，君子得之顯達豐贍，小人得之周旋給","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005358143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005358143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在福聚之地，則官崇禄𫝗，在禍聚之地，則職𤰞命","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005374527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"薄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005374527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如以甲子論，食丙子爲福星之貴，食丙寅爲長生","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005390911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之祿，又爲禄馬同鄉食神、學堂之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005390911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰爲正印，丙","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005407295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午爲自刑破命，内申爲尅身破禄，丙戌爲身衰破空","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005407295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2948","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098831174025216"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，餘千例推。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005407295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇生旺庫印、天乙、天官、華葢、文星、學","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005423679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堂、官印、禄馬之類，爲福聚之地；遇尅破、空亡、惡煞、刑","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005423679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害、休敗𣦸絶，爲禍聚之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005423679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有華葢正印，雖少増培，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005440063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無學堂驛馬，雖多减半。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005440063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清貴之家，驕奢之族，以是别","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005456447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005456447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：甲乙食丙丁，加寅卯巳午之上；丙丁食戊巳，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005472831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加辰戌丑未之上；戊巳食庚辛，加巳午申酉之上；庚","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005472831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛食壬癸，加申酉亥子之上；壬癸食甲乙，加亥子寅。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005472831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯之上謂之食神，見生旺，更帶禄馬旺相，文爲兩制","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005489215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩省，武爲建節防團，無亦主財帛豐厚。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005489215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神與禄全","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005505599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見，四柱順當爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005505599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指迷賦云：食神一處，當用一代於","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005521983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2965","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098831173992448"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三；若遇休閑，三重不逮於一。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005521983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食分三二，財如落葉秋","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005538367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風；梟遇一重，福若朝菌暮落。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005538367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神若遇空閑，大抵難","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005554751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迯憔悴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005554751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理愚歌云：子返哺時逄子建，更值貴人喜相","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005571135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見，建官又在貴人鄉，鳯閣鸞臺歷華𨕖。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005571135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"返哺者，年月","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005587519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時皆自下食上，見天乙官印吉煞，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005587519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子云：","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005603903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神𭒡倒，爭啜爭哺，忽併臨之，乏漿乏乳。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005603903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有餘則食","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005620287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前方丈，不足則簞食豆𡙡。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005620287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：犯倒食在命，多被人","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005636671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"撓。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005636671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重叠帶者，在幼兒則言乏乳，在老人則言缺食。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005653055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005669439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食而有餘者，富貴；爭食而不足者，貧賤有餘如甲人","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005669439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得兩丙，三丙不足，如三甲兩甲止有一丙之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005669439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005685823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2986","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098764220530742"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡生時干倒食年干者，曰吞，主尅子；日時俱食，主頭","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005685823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靣帶破，并尅母，𣦸後無子送終。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005685823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若吞中逄吞，如甲人","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005702207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見壬日時又逄庚字，主貧𣦸溝壑。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005702207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有干合觧則緩。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005718591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005734975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歩云：食神生旺，勝似財官，濁之則賤，清之則垣，重則","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005734975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不足，擬作傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005734975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜氣無用，分詳多端。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005751359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相心賦云：食神","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005767743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善能飮食，體厚而好謳歌。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005767743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口訣云：食神帶旺賢奥旨","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005784127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦云：月令值食，身徤旺，善飮食，姿質豐肥。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005784127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱有吉","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005800511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曜相扶，堆金積玉，聲名顯着。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067005800511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：食神旺處刼財多，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067016761407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更逢偏印尅食神，非壽夭，須知吃化。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067016761407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幽微賦云：食神","logicSentenceId":"7577334067016777791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相，老壽彌高。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067016777791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元理賦云：食居先，煞居後，功名顯逹。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067016794175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"按此格卽天厨","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076169782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神，不必作合禄看。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076169782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王崇古尚書不犯甲丙寅卯，録","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076186166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於前。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076186166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高燿尚書，甲戌庚午、戊辰、庚申年，雖透甲月，庚","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076202550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制之，不犯寅卯丙字，皆純粹二命較之，高、甲、戊、庚三","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076202550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3315","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098819635478538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076202550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王禄馬同鄊，又天關地□，乹坤清夷，所以官皆一","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076218934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"品，而王有邉功，享用優裕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076218934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又張光遠長史，與王公止","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076235318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月癸未，不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076235318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是食格惟建禄身旺最貴，不專秋冬生，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076251702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王公得之，所以功名遠甚。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076251702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然張有學善詩，亦美士也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076268086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅鸞天印","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076284470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂丙食戊而得戊戌，辛食癸而得癸丑，壬甲辰、乙丁","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076284470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未日時得之，主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076284470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墨池涌泉","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076300854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂辛巳得癸巳、癸亥，如陳朝議辛巳壬辰、癸巳癸亥","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076300854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076300854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推此類，丙寅愛戊寅，戊申愛庚申，己巳愛辛亥，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076317238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098821321670719"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午愛壬申，甲戌愛丙寅，壬辰愛甲申，皆同此格，主","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076317238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076317238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專印合禄，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076317238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃六癸日申時。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076317238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"te {"lines":[{"lineId":"3336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：暗合愁刑擊，明逄怕尅衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076333622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正朝","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076350006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丹闕趨，專印合禄宫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076350006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢癸日見庚申時，庚與戊同宫，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076366390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虚合巳中戊土，癸日得官星，庚暗合乙木，爲癸日之","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076366390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爵星，丙戊同宫，爲癸之財，三奇俱全，忌戊己巳午，及","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076366390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙尅庚寅衝申，則减分數。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076366390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運同喜行身旺印旺，金","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076382774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之運大發，忌入火鄉，格純無壊朝官宰輔之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076382774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076399158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胡𢡟功𠫭將，丁酉甲辰，癸酉庚申，是此格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076399158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：専","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076415542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098705261248551"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印是逄癸日，庚申暗合蛇宫，財官隠隠在其中，祿運","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076415542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時臨𤼵動又。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076415542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時遇庚申癸日生，此爲專印合官星。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076431926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076448310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞不逄無丙火，印身食運顯功名。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076448310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3354","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干癸水，時庚","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076464694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申，生在秋冬富貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076464694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌寅來衝貴氣，若生春夏惹","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076481078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾迍。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076481078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"按專印合禄，雖非食傷，分出與食同格，故並論","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076497462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076497462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論陽刃","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076513846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3362","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"前論羊刃煞，與此𠫭看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽者，陰陽之陽，刃者，刀刃之刃，卽禄前一位，言，旺越","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076513846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其分，故險。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076513846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𥨸詳甲人見卯，卯中有乙木，乙爲甲弟，能","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076530230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刧其兄之財，衝去酉中辛官，合其庚妻，庚乃甲之七","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076530230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3367","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098819635494922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞刼財，衝官合煞，所以至㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076530230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟甲、丙、戊、庚、壬五陽干","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076546614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有刃，乙、丁、巳、辛、癸五陰干無刃，故曰陽刃。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076546614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟見傷官，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076562998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與陽刃同禍，故乙見丙亦謂之刃，以丙傷其庚官，合","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076562998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛煞尅其乙木，陰金尅陰木至毒，所以㐫與陽刃同。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076562998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃有三：有刼財刃，甲見乙是也，不利財官格，有護","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076579382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿刃，甲見卯是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076579382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大利歸禄格，有背禄刃，乙、丙是也，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076595766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大利去官留煞局。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076595766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜忌篇云：刼財陽刄，切忌時逄。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076612150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076628534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運併臨，災殃立至。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076628534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨陽刃以時言，重於年月日也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076644918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076661302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"令甲日生人，時上見乙卯，此是真刃，命中旣逄陽刃，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076661302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷妻破財，災殃已胚胎矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076661302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流年歲運，再遇羊□，是謂。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076677686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098743139991587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"併臨見己酉，是衝歲君，見亥未戌，是合歲君。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076694070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽凡㐫","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076710454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞也，太嵗㐫神也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076710454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲得吉神相扶合則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076726838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若陽刃","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076743222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫煞來衝合歲君，是謂攅㐫聚煞，其禍難免。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076743222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：陽","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076759606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刃衝合，歲君勃然𥛒至。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076759606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076775990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中間亦要詳辨。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076792374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076808758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元淺薄，遇此誠然。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076808758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命旺秉氣深厚，或有天月德及","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076825142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赦文觧救，止有浮災，亦無大咎。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076825142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰柱原有刃，見衝","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076841526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或合，歲運再臨，衝合大㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076841526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若歲衝合而運不衝合，運","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076857910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝合而歲不衝合，其禍减半論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076857910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日日干無氣，時逄","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076874294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃不爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076874294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言生日天元臨𣦸絕衰病暴敗之地，不","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076890678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通月氣，不能勝任財官。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076890678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄陽刃，能刼財化煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076907062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076923446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3411","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098705261281319"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄力弱財重，得弟分任，則可勝其財而爲我用，所以","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076923446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不作㐫論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076923446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫身弱見財官，固喜陽刃分財合煞；若見","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076939830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食傷，身弱脫氣，亦喜陽丒扶持；若見印綬，則非日于","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076939830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無氣矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076939830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先言忌陽月者，身強力能任財，故不喜刼奪；","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076956214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後言喜陽刃者，身弱力不任財，故不忘刼奪。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076956214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"義各有","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076972598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076972598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格與傷官相似。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067076988982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命徂之主，眼大鬚黄，性剛心","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077005366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高，無惻隠慈惠之心，有刻剥不恤之意，多帶宿疾，貪","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077005366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暴不足，進退狐疑，偏生庻出，離祖𨓺房，尅父傷妻，或","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077005366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見三刑，或自刑，魁罡全發跡邊疆。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077005366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如更無情，或臨財","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077021750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，主㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077021750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若刑害俱全，類皆得地，又有救神，貴不可言。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077038134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3429","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098845757603859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又口陽刃格，大槩不宜財鄉，怕衝起。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077054518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊日刃在午，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077070902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌行子正財運；壬日刃在子，忌行午正財運；庚日刃","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077070902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在酉，忌行卯正財運。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077070902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨甲日刃在卯，行巳午並辰戌","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077087286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未財運不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077087286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌酉運内日刃在午，行申酉、庚、辛丑","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077103670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財運不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067077103670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌子運是陽刃所忌之財，戊刃午見子財。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381665798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬刃子見午財，庚刃酉見卯財，皆衝之財，故忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381682182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381698566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲刃卯不忌戊己巳午之財，且忌酉官矣；丙刃午不","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381698566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌庚辛，申酉之財，且忌子官矣，可槩謂忌財乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381698566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若天","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381714950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千生官之財，正爲用神，方且喜之，豈可爲忌？","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381714950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心鏡云：","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381731334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃重重又見財，富貴饒金帛。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381731334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381747718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：甲、戊","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381764102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098821321687103"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚見刃逄衝，發禍多騐；壬丙逢凡，見子午衝，多無禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381764102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以丙見子，壬見午，俱爲正官，反作貴氣論也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381780486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：甲","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381796870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以己爲妻財，四柱却有卯乙巳土受傷，不能扶甲，故","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381796870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主剥䘮妻子，歲運復臨刼刃旺相，誠所不免。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381796870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如别位","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381813254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄庚辛酉申，庚能邀乙爲妻，卽成眷屬，不爲甲之七","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381813254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381813254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛輔甲爲貴，能尅破乙煞，反㐫爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381829638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：甲以乙","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381846022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妹妻，庚㐫爲吉兆是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381846022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘干例此。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381862406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：六甲日逄乙","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381878790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯㐫，辛卯吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381878790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申丁卯不爲刃，申中有庚合，卯中乙","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381895174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木爲財，若有財露亦㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381895174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火傷官，乙木奪財，歲運併","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381911558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨，災禍不免。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381911558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉日見庚辰時，非刃，乙坐庚下，酉中","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381927942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098831174074368"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金制辰中乙木。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381927942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子日見甲午時，非刃，子中癸水","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381944326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅午中丁火。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381944326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥日見丁未時非刃，亥中壬水合丁。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381960710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午日見乙酉時非刃，午中丁火制辛。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381977094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午日見庚","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381993478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子時非刃，午中己士制癸。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067381993478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳日見戊戌時非刃，巳","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382009862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中丙火合辛。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382009862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳日見癸丑時，非凡，己中戌土合癸。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382026246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上諸日遇者，不宜見刑衝破害，無則以好命斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382042630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：陽刃者，天上之卤星，人間之惡煞，喜偏官印綬，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382059014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌反吟復吟，魁罡三合，大率與七煞相似。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382059014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故陽刃喜","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382075398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見七煞，七煞喜見陽刃，兩㐫互相制伏，猶正官喜正","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382075398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印，善類合善類爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382075398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：煞無刃不顯，刃無煞不威。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382091782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3487","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098845757571091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞刃俱全，常人無有，更身旺不見傷官爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382108166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命元","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382124550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有煞刃，歳運又逄，或有刃無煞，歳運逢煞旺之鄉，俱","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382124550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發大禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382124550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命有刃，有印無煞，歲運逄煞，反轉成厚福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382140934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3493","lineNum":0,"l {"lines":[{"lineId":"3503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：赤黄馬獨卧，黒䑕守空房，男妨妻，女妨夫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382222854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382239238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三日也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382239238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不喜刑衝破害，三㑹六合，要有七煞相制，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382255622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098821321637951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再行官印鄉，便爲好命。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382255622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦云：日刃大忌衝合，喜官煞","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382272006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相制。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382272006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合刑者㐫，遇印者吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382288390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有煞無刃，施爲有勇無威；","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382304774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有刃無煞，作事濁而不顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382304774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無煞遇煞，𥨸恐禍患相侵；","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382321158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有刃遇刃，須忌災危相犯。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382321158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刃生身𣦸，其年難作吉推。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382337542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺官傷，此歲不作㐫㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382353926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：戊午日歲月見火多，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382370310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則以印綬論；壬子日月時見子多，則以飛天祿馬論；","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382370310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午見午多，亦以倒衝禄馬論。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382370310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取財官入格，故日刃","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382386694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不爲大㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382386694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格當推提綱。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382403078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月令合財官印綬，或合","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382419462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他格，或從化類，當以他格斷，不可拘以陽刃。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382419462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又自刃","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382435846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有三口：癸丑、丁未、已未，因坐下比肩陽刃飛刃有四","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382435846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3528","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098819635527690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日：丙子、丁丑、戊子、己丑，因坐下衝出陽刃，與前日刃","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382435846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜忌大同。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382435846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上陽刃與時上陽丒最重，年上主破敗","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382452230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祖基，不受父母産業，平生施恩反怨，時上主尅妻，壬","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382452230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晩無結果，四柱再逄，手足災疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382452230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月上稍輕，日上又輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382468614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命月日干支帶財多，日干衰弱，時帶陽刃無害。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382484998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382501382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶七煞，時帶陽刃，日主有氣，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382501382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如月帶陽刃，時上","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382517766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"微帶官星，力不能制，亦㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382517766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大率陽刃最壞造化，旣是","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382534150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好命，却帶刃刼，制按如法，須𨘣他發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382534150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後遇歲運併","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382550534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨，或在刑合之位，依舊有禍刃格。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382550534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福自福，禍自禍，兩","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382566918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不相掩也。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382566918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：五陰干見五陽干爲敗財，雖不尅妻，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382583302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3547","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098743140024355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦主財帛消耗，陰𥝠口舌，或小人相侵。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382583302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲時見官煞，","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382599686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或坐或透，皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382599686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱逄之，遇敗財受刑亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382616070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱行","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382632454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞財運亦妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382632454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若柱中元無官煞，歳運再逄敗地，因","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382648838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爭競，兄弟分居，遇此大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382648838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘同刃斷。","logicSentenceId":"7577334067382665222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
