{"lines":[{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生夏令，只以傷官論，生七八","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532140072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月貧下。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532140072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如得庚申月運北地，却以官論，生四季有財","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532156456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庫，喜水局，傷宫、食神，南運亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532156456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡月令見財官印旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532172840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽以財官取用，不以午衝子爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532172840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如合鼠貴柱，有未","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532189224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合午，畧有損壊，富而虛名。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532189224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相心賦云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙䑕貴遇午","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532205608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝而赤貧如洗。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532205608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"真寶賦云：鼠貴帶食，蚤爲藩省薇垣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之相","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532221992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"詩曰：乙才生臨丙子時，要無午破卯刑之四桂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不逄申酉丑，管敎年少拜月墀。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532221992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又六乙䑕貴在生時，","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532238376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞官衝破不相宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532238376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月中通得真三木，方可當元利。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532254760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532271144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098903911727123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竒","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532271144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又乙日生人，得子時，各爲鼠貴，最爲奇切。嬿午字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來衝破，辛酉庚申總不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532271144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又六乙生人時遇子，既帶","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532287528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星復用此，庚申辛酉馬牛欺，一位逄之爲丐子。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532287528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532303912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙曰：時逄丙子旬，官星不要月中存。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532303912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丙能生扶羊","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532320296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刃，丙得刑庚至貴神。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532320296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其格不宜逄刃午，於中亦憚見","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532336680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532336680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若推歲運如其理，無破清閑享福人。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532353064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"西江月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532369448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日生逄丙子，名僞䑕，貴幽玄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532369448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無衝無破福周全，印食","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532385832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身莊多顯子，多名爲聚貴，畧逄衝破有愆。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532385832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生春印地","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532402216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福滔天，歲運金鄉尅戰。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532402216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日禄歸時","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532418600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443632877201457206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜忌篇云：日禄歸時，文官星號，青雲得路。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532418600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格有七，","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532434984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：甲寅、丁午、戊己、巳午、庚申、壬亥、癸子，日主之禄歸","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532434984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於時位，喜日干坐眹，印綬生月，透財元傷食，天月二","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532434984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"德，主大富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532434984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌刑衝破害，空亡來絶，及刼財分禄，倒","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532451368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食作合，官煞尅制，雖可取用，亦不純粹。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532451368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運同。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532467752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532484136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口見己卯時，是時上偏財；丙日見癸巳時，是官星顯","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532484136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露；辛日見丁酉時，是時上偏官。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532484136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不作歸禄格㸔四柱","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532500520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何如。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532500520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月有官星，或天干透財官，只作財官論。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532516904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若時","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532533288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支歸禄，年月時支亦有禄，謂之聚福歸禄，又謂五行","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532533288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532533288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若曰禄歸時，時禄歸曰，謂之五換禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532549672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年禄歸","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532566056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098905996279835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，時禄歸年，如甲申見庚寅，乙酉見辛卯，壬午見丁","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532566056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，癸亥見壬子等類，俱主大貴享福。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532566056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若重見祿位，如","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532582440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲口寅時，又生正月，財官俱弱，只作建禄看。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532582440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月日","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532598824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元同而止有時禄，謂之分禄，便爲無用，若各自歸。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532598824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿，却又不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532615208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格有七法：一曰青雲得路，如戊子甲","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532631592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、乙亥己卯，柱中無一㸃官星，身旺得局，有印生取，","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532631592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖子刑卯祿，不能破局，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532631592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又壬午庚戌、壬子辛亥，","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532647976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺印𦔳，登戊辰進士，爲刑部，則中作雜氣格論尤","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532647976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532647976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故丁丑運戊辰科，丑刑辰衝故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532664360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二曰官星坐禄，","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532680744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙申、丙申、丙申癸巳，丙以癸爲正官，生七月，金鄕","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532680744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098812585115682"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有托，運行西北，官生旺之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532680744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙臨申無氣，三丙相倚，","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532697128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝寅長生，癸官臨已，用神坐貴，得財官𩀱美，故少年","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532697128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及第，中年拜相。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532697128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三曰歸禄逄二德，如辛亥、辛卯、甲寅","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532713512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅，甲專禄而得丙寅爲食㑹禄，甲爲月德月令，辛","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532713512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯爲甲正官，辛逢二月無氣，二寅中丙合去二辛，止","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532713512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有二寅爲甲之禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532713512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月德逄歸禄，乃平章輔國英雄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532729896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532746280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日歸禄逢印綬，如丁未壬子、甲子、丙寅，二于印旺，丁","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532746280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬化木，引至寅時，木旺，運逢官煞，丙丁制合，不能損","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532746280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532746280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又壬寅、丙午、甲辰丙寅，日禄歸時，不逄官煞，","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532762664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用丙爲食，喜生寅旺午，午中己土爲財，年干印綬，庫","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532762664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098905996296219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺於日，所以承祖蔭受職，富貴成名。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532762664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又丙戌、癸巳、戊","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532779048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午、丁巳，柱無一點官星，丙丁印戊，日時禄互換，午戌、","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532779048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳俱是火地，印綬生身太旺，運行西方，食神傷官之","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532779048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，生財，癸與戊合，化成火象，所以少年登第，官至三","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532779048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"品。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532779048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五曰歸禄逢傷官，大忌見官。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532795432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬辰□□、己亥庚","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532811816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午，巴坐亥，有甲爲官，得巳衝去，有乙爲煞，得庚合化，","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532811816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲真金傷官，用壬爲財，坐庫歸禄日下，運行南方，身","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532811816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壯西方金莊，傷官去煞，生出財氣有用，英靈秀實之","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532811816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532811816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六日歸禄逄煞，如甲申、丙寅、戊申丁巳，戊坐申。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532828200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自生年干透甲爲煞，歸禄於寅，二申制之，戊歸禄，時","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532844584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098812585132066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地無官混雜，所以掌握兵權，威鎭邊疆。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560532844584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱禄拱貴、","logicSentenceId":"7577325560533090344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱禄拱貴，塡實則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560533090344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱，向也，夾也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560533106728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄是臨","logicSentenceId":"7577325560533123112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官之禄，貴是官星之貴，或指天乙貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560533123112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱禄有五日","logicSentenceId":"7577325560533139496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五時，癸亥、癸丑、癸丑、癸亥拱子禄，丁巳、丁未、已未、己","logicSentenceId":"7577325560533139496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳拱午禄，戊辰、戊午拱己禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560533139496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱貴有五日五時，甲申、","logicSentenceId":"7577325560533155880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443633014049013810"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌拱酉，乙未、乙酉拱申，是官貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560533155880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅、甲子拱丑，戊","logicSentenceId":"7577325560533172264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申、戊午拱未，辛丑、辛卯拱寅，官貴兼天乙貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325560533172264","mar enceId":"7577325561081561088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中甲木，暗邀己土爲壬官星，寅中丙火，暗邀辛金爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325561081561088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬印綬，怕午合申衝，忌財官塡實，喜身㽵地歲運同。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561081561088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經獨取壬午、癸巳二日，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082036224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以壬癸所坐正財正官，餘則或偏或正，不純一故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082036224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類推之。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082052608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌、乙丑二曰，喜金土月分富貴，但金氣不","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082068992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可太多，恐傷身盜氣，若無官貴，必發財富。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082068992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申、丁丑","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082085376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二日，生金木月貴，惟忌土重，若會起土尅官，主富。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082085376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082101760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥日宜生四季月，或有倚托相生爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082101760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅曰喜見","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082118144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火，宜生冬至後一陽生火正之時主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082118144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得金剛火","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082134528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"強，錬成鋒刃之器，秋生逄火尤佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082134528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

"lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火見寅戌得局，己土丑中得位，皆有氣運，行南方禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082183680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬莊相此，得三個丑字，變爲三奇，禄馬飛天，無合有","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082200064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098930222497827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，故亦大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082200064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙午、甲午、壬戌、丙午，壬生五月，日干","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082216448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無氣，火太旺，當以丁壬從火，運行西方官旺之地，此","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082216448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化象之美。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082216448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098901298593843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二德扶身","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082314752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天月二德，乃日月㑹合照臨，有何陰昧邪暗敢容其","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082314752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間，故奸盗息，惡獸潜，神明扶邪鬼遁。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082314752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此天地德秀之","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082331136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，化㐫爲吉之神。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082331136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命帶之，犬爲福德，更禄馬貴人、","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082347520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬相扶，或二德就爲財官印食，合諸貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082347520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再遇三","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082363904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇五行生旺，無傷尅破壞，官榮禄顯，一生不遭㐫横。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082363904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若犯傷破，作事無成，命不合格，貧賤𠒋惡，見此亦有","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082380288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"救觧。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082380288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天德宜月將相扶。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082396672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月丁喜亥將，忌見癸","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082413056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷丁。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082413056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二月坤宜戌將，忌寅破；三月壬宜酉將，忌戊傷；","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082429440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四月辛宜申將，忌丁傷；五月乾宜未將，忌己破；六月","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082429440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098926783332415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲宜午將，忌庚傷；七月癸宜巳將，忌己傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082429440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八月艮宜","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082445824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰將，忌申破。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082445824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尤月丙宜卯將，忌壬傷；十月乙宜寅將，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082462208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌辛傷；十一月巽宜丑將，忌亥破；十二月庚宜子將，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082462208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌丙傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082462208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月德寅午戌月丙合辛，忌壬傷；亥卯未月甲","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082478592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合己，忌庚傷；申子辰月壬合丁，忌戊傷；","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082478592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑月庚","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082478592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合乙忌丙傷，若犯此忌，不成德合矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082478592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二德以天德爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082494976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重，月徳次之，變財官印綬，則加二倍福力，或日干就","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082494976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082494976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"秘訣云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天月二德臨日，主三生無險無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082511360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082527744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇將星，名登相府。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082527744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼谷云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一德扶持，衆卤解釋，男逄","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082544128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平步青雲，女值福壽俱全。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082544128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"玉鑒云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦逄生氣，天德合","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082560512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098903911776275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在世長年。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561082560512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineTyp {"lines":[{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443632872478588963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇眞貴","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652887587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：若遇三奇眞禄馬，名聞達天下。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652887587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日逄禄馬旺，興","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652903971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隆，一舉便成名。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652903971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲生酉丑未月，乙生巳申月，柱有","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652920355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸或亥子財官印𠔥全，爲三奇之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652920355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌傷官七煞、","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652936739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼財、刑衝破害，運喜財官印身旺之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652936739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人遇之，主","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652953123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明好學，神童狀元，有節操，有道義。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652953123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇分内外，天","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652969507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干明露爲外，地支暗藏爲内外奇，主勞而成富貴，安","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652969507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處，常有未寕之象，以天干常動故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652969507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘月令財官衰","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652985891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敗，或運行衰地，卽爲貧困之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561652985891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如左鑑郞中，己卯癸","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653002275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、甲午辛未，是天干三奇，但日干衰而財官旺，印又","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653002275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098901298642995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，恐不大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653002275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若内三奇地支暗會財官，爲眞禄眞馬，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653018659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得天干扶合，不逄衝尅月令，通財官生旺之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653018659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辛","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653035043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生巳月，官印俱建禄，更得財旺，曰主健強，貴當二品。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653035043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男遇三奇逄生旺，定居三品之尊。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653051427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如張居正閣老。乙酉辛巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛酉辛卯月令，官印建禄，日主坐禄自旺，年乙財引歸時，卯健祿，是日主財官印俱坐禄。四月天德在辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛乙互換歸禄，所以少年拜相，位爲少師。六子父毋兄弟俱全，子與弟癸酒同中，一子翰林，前朝閣臣寵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"任，無與爲比。又譚論尚書庚辰、甲申、丁未丙午，財官印俱在月令，丁未八専又歸禄於時，身旺而得三奇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"平生以軍功顯貴至一品。又日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生仲秋，干支有壬癸戊巳日。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653067811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主乘莊，亦主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653084195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若干支又逄申庚，官煞混雜，柱得","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653100579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙合庚，或旺丙尅制，亦可取用，終不清純。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653100579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生季夏","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653116963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098905996476443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"季冬，空抱才德，難以成名。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653116963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生丑月，丑中有辛爲田","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653133347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官，有己正財，有癸正印，四柱月令，三奇有氣，或結","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653133347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成局，曰主徤旺，畧帶印生𦔳，爲帶印聚貴最佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653133347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘以","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653149731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"例推。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653149731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官食全僃，亦爲三奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653166115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以取食者，以甲","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653182499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食丙，丙能生己，爲甲之財，合辛爲甲之官，要月令及","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653182499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時引旺爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653182499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人遇之，主權貴縱輕，亦財帛豐盛。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653198883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但三奇會食，只以偏印爲忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653215267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇宜順逄，更一","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653231651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬内合見最貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653231651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子日見己巳，辛未、乙丑日見戊","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653248035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，庚辰、丙寅日見辛卯，癸巳、丁未日見庚戌，壬子、戊","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653248035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日見己亥，癸卯、己未日見壬申，甲戌、庚辰日見乙","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653248035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098901298659379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酒，丁亥、辛巳日見乙未，丙申于午日見丁未，己酉癸","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653248035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𫑗日見丙辰、戊午。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653248035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上三奇順逄，二旬内遇，爲真祿","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653264419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，更有印𦔳身，主爲公侯。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653264419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日甲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄酉子巳，乙遇申","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653280803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午亥，丙臨子卯申，丁喜亥酉寅，戊見卯亥午，己逄寅","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653280803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子巳，庚遇午及寅，辛臨巳並卯，壬喜午並酉，癸見巳","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653280803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與申，爲地三奇又名内三奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653280803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財印不可相傷，故正官","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653297187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正耳，會偏財也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653297187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人遇此，無衝破帶生正，必然處世","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653313571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"英雄，科甲高第，官至卿相。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653313571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇之貴，須要詳審","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653329955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印爵，有何生取，有何傷損，但有一忌，便是奇貴","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653329955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有損，逐類斷其禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653329955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如財早被刼，歲運再逄比刼，斷，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653346339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098982932299830"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此年傷妻破財，或因妻奴，官非破耗。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653346339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官貴明𦖢有","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653362723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷，歲運再逄傷損之神，㫁此年剥官退職，印星有損，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653362723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破耗鎡基祖蔭。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653362723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運臨𣦸絕之地，再逄破壊之神，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653379107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653379107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見重禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653379107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但凡看命，要察柱中何者爲用神，何者爲𦔳。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653395491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官貴爲用，忌見𣦸敗破壞。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653411875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見用神被傷，相𦔳者","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653428259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有救，雖㐫不𣦸，再相𦔳者，亦有阻尅，日主又衰，其𣦸","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653428259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653428259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"詩日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印綬號三奇，文將英雄武將威。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653444643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心性","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653461027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忠良綱紀大，滿門受蔭定光輝，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653461027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又財官爵印號三奇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三者兼全罕遇之。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653461027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年少科名魁衆彦，功勲葢世壽期","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653477411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頥。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653477411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又印禄飛來就馬騎，資財官職兩相宜。旺中更爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元暗禄","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653510179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格取庚寅、乙巳、丙申、己亥四日。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653510179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚日取丁火爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653526563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官，年月時中不見丁，則無官矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653526563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜庚自坐寅，寅中","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653542947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有長生火氣，庚自剋出爲官。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561653542947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲禄在寅，木乃火之母，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710641186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母子有相繼之理。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710641186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗月時中喜有戊巳滋𦔳。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710657570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元四","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710673954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱見乙丁更佳，見丙煞，宜得壬癸亥子制之。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710673954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳日","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710690338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐長生之金爲官，戊禄爲財，柱喜再見庚戊引透，要","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710690338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸印生𦔳，忌辛金七煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710690338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其巳中原帶丙火旺，須壬","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710706722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥子去其火氣方美。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710706722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙巾日喜庚辛財、癸水官，甲","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710723106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098963266863130"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙印，忌戊巳傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710723106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日坐亥中，長生甲木爲官，忌","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710739490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710739490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚逄寅位禄權歡，丙丁逄之壽必端。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710755874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"口。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚遇寅而值丙，主旺無危。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710772258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙臨申位，逄陽水，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710788642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難護延年；己入亥宫，見陰木，終須損壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710788642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙入巽","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710805026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，各爲不絶，是掯此四日也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710805026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞淵尚書，庚子甲申、庚","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710821410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅丙戌，潘潢尚書，丙辰、丙申、丙申、壬辰，一都憲，辛巳、","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710821410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑、己亥、丙寅一副使，丁亥、壬寅、己亥、乙亥一知縣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710821410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子、丁卯、乙巳、丙子數命，此日生","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710837794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄元三㑹","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710837794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710837794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲日見己酉丑，喜壬癸印生𦔳，忌亥卯未衝","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710854178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098930222743587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710854178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚煞丁傷，陽干遇之不純，柱中有制，取偏官可也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710870562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日見申子辰，喜甲乙印，忌壬煞巳傷，寅午戌衝尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710886946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日見亥卯未，喜丙丁印，忌甲煞、辛傷，己酉丑衝尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710903330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日見寅午戌，喜戊巳印，忌丙煞、癸傷，申子辰衝尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710919714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日見寅午戌，喜庚辛印，忌戊煞、乙傷，申子辰衝尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710936098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格大要身旺印滋，運行官印，身旺之鄉，必𤼵富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710952482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄有三㑹，乃甲見寅而得寅午戌，乙見卯","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710968866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而得亥卯未，又謂之得一分三，是指臨官之禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710968866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄元互換，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710985250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格止有四日。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561710985250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申、丁酉、丙子、庚子、戊申日見乙卯","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711001634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098982932316214"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，戊取卯中乙木爲官，乙取申中庚金爲官，互換成","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711001634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其貴禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711001634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中喜壬癸爲財，生𦔳乙木官星，運臨官旺","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711018018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉，便是貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711018018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌見甲煞、辛傷，寅酉衝，丁酉見壬寅，丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711034402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子見癸巳，庚子見丁亥，喜忌與前同推。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711034402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一命癸亥、","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711050786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌、丙子、癸巳互換禄旺，各臨宫貴，無刑衝破害，故","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711050786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711050786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又己未、辛未、丙子、癸巳合格大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711067170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法論禄元互","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711083554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"換，如戊午見丁巳之例，是取臨官之禄，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711083554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬移換。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711083554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格柱中有禄、有刃，有官有印，不就木身者，遇衝尅","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711099938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則變化。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711099938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有天干地支衝尅，或年月日衝尅，或日時干","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711116322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098930222776355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅支衝者，當彼此互換爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711116322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以天千常動，地支静，故","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711132706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地支因衝尅以動天干也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711132706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子日見庚午時，壬子","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711149090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日見丙午時，便當以庚子日甲午時，丙子日壬午時","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711149090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取用，論禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711149090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午日見丙子時，癸亥日見丁巳時，當","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711165474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作丙午、丁亥論。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711165474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟丁酉遇癸卯，却不移換，縁丁生於","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711181858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，癸生於卯，各就天乙貴人貪生故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711181858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以三命先","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711198242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立主用，乃虛中之奥旨，禍福貧賤，載在方册，無不悉","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711198242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僃。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711198242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今人徃徃用之不騐，惟不知前說之理故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711214626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711231010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳癸酉、丁卯癸卯，二卯一酉，丁癸相尅，此因地支卯。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711231010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𮠕衝撼動天干，一丁夾二癸之中，似難展歩。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711247394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁乃太","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711263778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098982932348982"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲己之母，巳見癸尅丁，子來救母，反傷癸酉水，癸避","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711263778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己占卯，丁却譲癸居卯，乃就兒居酉，各逄貴地，所以","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711263778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711263778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又甲午、甲戌、戊辰、壬子、甲戌，衝尅戊辰，戊奪壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位居子壬歸辰位，爲壬騎龍𦙼戊得子，日時俱財官","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711280162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙美。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711280162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又丙子、丙申、庚辰、壬午，兩丙似乎煞重，喜得壬","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711296546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午時衝尅丙子，壬奪丙位居子，丙去奪庚居辰，庚避","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711296546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙，却居午上，各得官印俱全，且七月丙不能尅壬水","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711296546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲德，助庚有力，所以合成造化之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711296546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰水局，亦爲旣濟，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711722530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賦云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火旺得水，以成旣濟之功，須","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711722530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火相停，不致偏枯方是。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711722530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申、丙辰、丁酉、丁丑，得身","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711738914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有托，生氣相扶，財官旺相俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711738914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有以丁未日時，各朱","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711755298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雀折足，大不利，六畜亡散𣦸傷，或患瘡疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711755298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有甲乙則","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711771682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561711771682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"詩日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎元財官","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712099362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098901298741299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賦云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行絶處，卽是胎元，生日逄之，名曰受氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712099362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712115746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽干陰干受胎之位，非月前三位胎神也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712115746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申、乙酉、","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712132130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子、丁亥、戊寅、己亥、庚寅、辛卯、壬午、癸未，十月生人，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712132130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切不可遽言身弱遇鬼，但有依托，便爲貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712132130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲木","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712148514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以金爲官，水爲印，又有戊土爲甲之財，遇此日生，但","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712148514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要身旺，財官有氣爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712148514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字雖不入格，富貴亦有盈","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712164898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712164898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九干例推：","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712181282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胞胎逄印綬，禄享千鍾。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712181282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見胎元日，","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712197666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尤以得印生爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712197666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令正印最妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712214050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"詩日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行絕處是","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712230434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎元，胎裏財官禀氣先。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712230434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不是月前三位取，須於日下","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712246818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"採幽玄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712246818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098963266928666"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"還魂借氣","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712263202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行自𣦸絕而有救，逓相還者，如木絕在申而遇甲","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712263202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申，金絕在寅而遇戊寅之類，最吉，有福神次之，無則","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712263202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰藉陽生。","logicSentenceId":"7577325561712263202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五陰日逄陽長生，不可以陽生陰𣦸論。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176208930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙見午爲炭","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176225314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柴之木，無亥不能生。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176225314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲申、庚午、乙亥、丙子得亥生","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176241698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉，石精之火，無寅不能復眀。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176241698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊子、甲寅、丁酉、甲","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176258082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰得寅，生己卯，糞壤之土，無申不能生物，如辛亥、庚。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176258082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子己卯壬申得申生辛，見子爲流沙之金，無已不能","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176274466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099013248745512"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176274466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己巳、辛未、辛亥戊子得巳生癸卯，脂膏之水，無","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176290850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申則爲凝結。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176290850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬寅、戊申、癸卯、癸巳，得申生","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176307234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"獨步云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，叩己亥四生之局，此古人所以只論四長生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176307234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176323618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命入格，更年通月氣者，大貴，大忌官煞混雜，貧苦。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176323618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176340002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日：玉陰日誕喜陽生，若是年文福最亨。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176340002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月氣得通須","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176356386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大貴，惟嫌官煞主孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176356386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生處聚生，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176372770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生處聚生，五馬諸侯之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176372770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格遇印綬生身，又","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176389154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"引日長生之地是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176389154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱有官星尢貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176405538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌尅申之辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176421922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙卯、丁亥、丙寅、庚寅，木火相生，引身生旺之地爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176438306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098901298774067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176438306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"詩日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生處聚生福最佳，印綬引旺福無涯。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176454690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生復","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176471074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"到長生地，五馬諸侯富貴家。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176471074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏元貴煞","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176487458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格如甲日官在酉，見丁酉，丁伏辛禄，煞在申，得丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176487458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申，丙伏庚煞，財在午未，見甲午、乙未，木伏己土，不敢","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176487458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176487458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見庚午，甲畏庚，不能就己財。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176503842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲用辛官，見丁","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176520226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，是官在傷下，見辛巳，是官在煞上。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176520226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若火神有托，官","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176536610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受制，甲卽不得辛官之力矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176536610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生金在月，柱有壬癸","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176552994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制合，亦能爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176552994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見丙爲食神，丙禄在巳，丙受水制伏，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176569378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則甲不得食矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176569378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄丙旺相則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176585762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見庚爲煞，庚禄在","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176602146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1845","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098901298790451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申，若丙申，是庚在丙下，受丙尅制，不能起而爲煞，化","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176602146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞爲權，作貴取用。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176602146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳爲財，柱見甲寅、乙卯，是財被","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176618530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼制，不得共財，須月令財通氣生旺方可。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176618530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見甲午財","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176634914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"被分奪，得兩午自能發。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176634914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見戊午、壬午是父母祖財，見","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176651298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午，是財生煞，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176651298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午富而不貴，爲燥土不能生","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176667682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金，官又被伏故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176667682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1856","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"詩日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八專禄旺","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176716834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八専口見前，或又添丙午、丁巳、戊辰、戊午、己巳、乙丑、","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176716834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子，而無丁未六十甲子，獨此干支同類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176716834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内甲寅、乙","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176733218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1864","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099013248942120"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯、庚申、辛酉四日自専祿旺爲正。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176733218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙宜亥卯未寅","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176749602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月成木局，庚申宜己酉丑申月成金局，爲秀氣，純而","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176749602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不雜，主爲人聰明有壽，平生少病，多好酒色。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176749602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱有官","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176765986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，雖身強不畏，但混雜則禄不得專，終爲有𥚍。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176765986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176782370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶財印食爲福，運行專祿旺鄉，財印食旺之地，皆發","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176782370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176782370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怕比肩刼財，枉無財食，官印多孤，或爲僧道。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176798754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1875","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1876","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干與支同，損財傷妻，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176815138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1878","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺無倚，定爲僧爲道","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176815138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176815138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若只一位禄，運行身旺財食印旺之地，亦主發","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176831522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176831522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若併叠三四位禄而無財官，又取衝起對宫財福","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176847906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176847906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或月時帶官有氣，以身旺逢官，尤爲貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176864290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌衝","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176880674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1887","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099013248876584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑散我旺氣，縱貴，亦多生病。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176880674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如朱文公庚戌丙戌、甲","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176897058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅庚午専禄，得火局爲食，二庚爲煞，居火旺庫，木秀","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176897058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得地，化煞爲權，宜成大儒。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176897058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

nceId":"7577325562176978978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日生亥卯未月，時逄寅卯；丙丁日生寅午戌月，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176978978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時逄巳午；戊巳日生巳午月，時逄辰戌丑末；庚辛日","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176978978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生己酉丑月，時逄申酉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176978978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日生申子辰月，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176995362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時逢亥","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176995362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子，得此爲主，本得地歸方就局，倚勢自強，主人身徤，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176995362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生自要安居遠害，退身避位，名輕利薄，去塵脫俗","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176995362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562176995362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲乙人在寅卯，丙丁人在巳午之類，爲五行","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177011746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不雜，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177011746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1916","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五音不雜，無滛慾之性，各居祿位故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177011746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
