":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛日見己酉丑局，須帶丙丁巳午一二位，方成其","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177241122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"器，但不可火多。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177241122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辛巳、辛酉、辛丑三日，不喜，五月生，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177257506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"被火所傷，宜八月，或水土養育，食神、印綬爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177257506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1953","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"詩曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎但逄己酉丑，格呼從革名偏厚。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177273890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁巳午少逢","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177290274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，貴氣煉成官最久，又金居從革貴人欽，造化清高","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177290274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福最深。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177290274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱火來相混雜，空門藝術謾經綸。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177306658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1959","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098926783414335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潤下","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177323042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日見申子辰，全忌引卯巳𣦸絶之地，三刑四衝","logicSentenceId":"7577325562177323042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之鄉。","logic {"lines":[{"lineId":"2343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天干順食奇，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784759843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地支夾拱少人知。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784759843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩干不雜須還貴，一世生成造化","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784776227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2346","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098982932594742"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"稀。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784776227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棣蕚聮芳","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784792611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此象如年月干同，日時干同，兩甲兩乙之類，地支亦","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784792611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同，遇寅卯二位尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784792611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一名二曜珍格，又謂鳯凰戀祿。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784808995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲年乙月、甲日乙時之類亦是。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784825379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若火年火月，木日","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784841763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木時，干支納音相類，謂之父子同類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784841763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又甲申年見甲","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784858147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申時，爲首尾公孫同類，皆此格也。","logicSentenceId":"75773 {"lines":[{"lineId":"2373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸般貴氣雖合格，六","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784989219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格大綱難去得，更看向背運辰行，不可一途而取，則","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784989219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞喜不喜。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562784989219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如六甲生人，以庚辛爲官，戊巳爲財，生寅、卯、午、亥子。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785005603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月金絶敗病𣦸，不能爲官；土神春𣦸冬囚，不足爲財。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785021987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱遇八字元有辰戌丑未、申酉，財官，福禄亦薄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785038371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785054755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2380","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099077576753188"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官旺地，轉吉，忽遇比月，或財官衰地，有始無終。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785054755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785071139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時見財官，聞喜也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785071139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月損尅，不喜也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785087523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2385","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見官昔","logicSentenceId":"7577 {"lines":[{"lineId":"2393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯不榮昌，巽離乹坎月同論，徒有官名不顯彰，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785136675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當憂不憂。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785136675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲日生逢申庚，本爲七煞當憂，若春月身旺金囚，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785153059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲月日時見丙丁，或寅午火制，或有卯乙合去，是當","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785153059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099077576785956"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憂不憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785153059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乙逢秋無氣，或見丙在水上，却不能制","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785169443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合庚煞，餘例推。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785169443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙寅戊戌、壬戌癸卯，壬見戊，七煞","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785185827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當憂，得癸卯時，癸合去戊爲壬，以癸妹妻戊，壬以己","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785185827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲官，卯爲傷官，却喜戍中辛金制之，卯與戌合，不能","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785185827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785185827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九月辛旺乙衰，傷官七煞皆無，運行東北，尅得","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785202211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2406","lineNum":0, {"lines":[{"lineId":"2425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785267747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺日時枯，正旺之間福必殊。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785267747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兒孫老去皆無立，中","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785284131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未途中一餓夫。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785284131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源濁流清，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785300515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月財官，用神敗絕或空亡，早年艱苦。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785300515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時却引財","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785316899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官用神生旺之地，必主中未榮華。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785316899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令運元主初年。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785333283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得失日主中年，時爲結果，月令力輕，日時引旺，故主","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785349667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先貧後富詩","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785349667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2436","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源濁流清月令輕，出身寒賤早平平。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785349667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099030776823849"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時生旺過年月，晩歲財名福禄盈。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785366051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建禄不富","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785382435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建禄乃甲生寅月，乙生卯月之類，月爲父毋，人從父","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785382435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母生身，如人從宅中而出，故月令爲門戶大運，離了","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785382435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令，故曰出門行限運高低。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785382435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生寅月，禄旺寅中甲","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785398819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木比肩先禄旺占財。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785398819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人財物在父母家内，先有大","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785415203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"哥收管，其弟不能别求名利，外又不遇財禄，專用見","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785415203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成有數之物，日漸支消，豈能豐富。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785415203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運再遇比刼，如人","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785431587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再兄弟兄有分之人，𥮅分家財在前，我已𨓺用，無財","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785431587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分與，必致詞訟争奪破財，棄妻失子，離父之象也，故","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785431587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099077576851492"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建禄不富。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785431587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸亥、丁巳、丙寅甲午，建禄長生寅午，合","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785447971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局愈旺，雖有壬癸官煞，己午戊巳傷尅去了，日主太","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785447971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，無官可倚，無財可托，所以貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785447971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又戌申、甲寅、甲辰","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785464355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯月令建禄，辰爲財庫，戊爲偏財，申爲甲煞，儘好","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785464355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不合，見丁卯時，傷官刼財，甲以辛爲官，被丁傷，以戊","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785464355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲財，被甲乙奪用申爲煞，被寅丙衝尅，丙火爲食，被","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785464355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申壬衝尅，財官食俱傷，所以貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785464355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又丁巳、丙午、己未","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785480739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰，月令建禄，日主坐刃，刼財太重，本身比肩俱各","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785480739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶刃，行壬寅運，戊巳奪壬，財印相傷，寅巳相刑，寅刑","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785480739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄元無位，己丑年衝起羊刃，被刑而𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785480739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2466","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"詩日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建禄生","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785497123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2468","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098963267108890"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嫌門戶中，難招祖業值財豊。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785497123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻奴破敗重重，見却","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785513507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長年白髪翁。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785513507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從化若還成别格，自然名利兩從容。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785529891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背禄不貧","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785546275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背祿，乃甲乙見丙丁，丙丁見戊巳之類，官遇休囚，又","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785546275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"被傷尅，不知食神傷官，却能生財，運至財鄕，必然發。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785546275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逹假令壬癸生寅卯月，戊己失時，又被傷𥁞，正二月","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785562659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木旺火相，暗中有財，運至財鄉必發。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785562659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見甲乙寅卯，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785579043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在壬癸亥子上，濕木不能生熖，非特財薄，反自招禍，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785579043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見七煞主灾滯。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785579043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2481","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：十千背禄，歲時喜見財星。又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怛㸔財命有氣，逄背禄而不貧，又","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785595427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2483","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云背禄逄財若遇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2484","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099061772714034"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時富豪無相並。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785595427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬子、壬子、丁未戊申日，丁用壬爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785611811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，有戊傷去，喜時支申中庚金爲財，十一月金雖𣦸","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785611811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，頼丁壬合化，癸水旺氣，能尅未中丁火，丁見壬","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785611811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從其夫化木，利於水生，是南方火化爲東方木，受北","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785611811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方水資養，所以不貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785611811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背禄逐馬","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785628195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背禄者，甲以辛爲官爲禄，甲生春夏，金絶則無官矣，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785628195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故爲背禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785628195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}], {"lines":[{"lineId":"2494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逐馬者，甲以己土爲財爲馬，被乙及亥卯","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785644579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未刼奪，甲無財矣，故爲逐馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785644579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘例推。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785660963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬子、壬子、丁","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785677347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未、乙巳，丁取壬爲官禄，壬亥月建禄，丁生子月，癸旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785677347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2499","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098963267125274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是煞，壬禄巳𨓺爲背。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785677347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向者有禄，背者無禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785693731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁取庚爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785710115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爲馬，子月庚𣦸，此爲背禄逐馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785710115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄煞運行刼地，亦","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785726499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不發福，無根元故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785726499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2506","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子云：背禄逐馬，守窮途。而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恓惶與此不同，觧見賦中。","logicSentenceId":"75773255627 {"lines":[{"lineId":"2508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏草遭霜，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785759267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏巳炎極，至後則一陰發生，爲暑退寒生之漸，金伏","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785759267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水生之候。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785759267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用乙生夏至後十日内，遇壬癸亥子爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785775651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺印，庚辛申酉爲旺官，不逄衝刑尅壓，必大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785775651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785792035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生夏至後十日内，遇壬癸亥子爲官，逄生，庚辛申酉","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785792035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲財，有氣，大忌見傷官土局，㐫橫夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785792035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢一陰初生，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785808419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2517","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099077576867876"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其氣甚微故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785808419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此象用丙日生於六月，坐下寅午戌","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785824803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火神，見壬癸、甲乙爲官印，戌己透尅，運行官印及身","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785824803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺鄉大貴，忌火敗地不禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785824803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲戌庚午、乙未丙子生，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785841187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至後十日内，用金水有氣，貴爲都憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785841187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又乙酉癸木，丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785857571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子癸巳，明透官印，不逄傷尅，支下巳未火旺，又禄元","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785857571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"互換，故主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785857571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬逢𭵴火，","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785873955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至氷成水凍，盛寒時也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785873955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至後則一陽發動，煖氣初","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785890339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生，有火得用。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785890339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙日坐亥卯未，支神生於至後，見丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785906723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁，無壬癸透尅，合象天順帝丁未壬子、乙未丙子，月","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785906723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099061772730418"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上雖透水，丁壬合化，只以木論，所以貴爲天子。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785906723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785923107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至後，木相火出，若庚辛生人，在至後十日，逄丙丁爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785923107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官有氣，須要柱有寅字爲生火之源，方成大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785923107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785939491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁明露，日逢庚午辛巳亦貴，大忌申子辰水局傷","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785939491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，主殘疾盲目。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785939491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月不同，若見七煞，多𣦸於水。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785955875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785972259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日生於至後十日，千見丙丁，承一陽爲財有氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785972259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785988643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日生於至後十日，干見甲乙，承一陽爲官有氣，見丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785988643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁爲印有氣，合此局富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562785988643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜財印地逄生旺鄉生","logicSentenceId":"7577325562786005027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍，甚者夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577325562786005027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚午戊子、庚寅、戊寅、庚寅自坐丙煞，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350614016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得子中癸水制之，化煞爲權，乗一陽之氣爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350614016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又壬","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350630400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099030776873001"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、壬子、庚午戊寅，庚坐午，官印兩全，雖辰子會水，寅","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350630400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午亦㑹火，力停不降，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350630400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2555","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"詩日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸庚辛北地寒，更","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350646784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居西北亦如然。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350646784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見丙丁逄至後居官，定入紫微垣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350663168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㑹㐫㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350679552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假甲日生人，見子辰全㑹起申庚爲甲七煞，乃㐫㑹","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350695936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350695936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱有丙或乙合制，是化煞爲權，若無須日主得令，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350712320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方免生禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350712320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生子辰水候，化煞爲印貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350728704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日生人，見子","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350745088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，合起申庚，甲日見己丑，合起酉辛，俱飛天祿吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350745088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350761472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日生人，見卯未，㑹出亥壬爲七煞，柱有戊丁合制，其","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350761472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞爲權，若無須日主得令，方免生禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350761472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生卯未旺月，化","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350777856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443098963267141658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞爲印貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350777856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁日見卯未，合起壬水，丙日見申辰，合起。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350794240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水俱飛天禄吉，餘例推𥨸詳吉㐫會，如命喜財官、","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350810624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印食、禄馬、貴人，值大小運歲君俱合㑹，决主大發富","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350810624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，謂之吉㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350810624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命忌七煞、傷官、羊刃、亡刼，而大小運、","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350827008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流年俱合㑹，决主大發㐫𱵔，謂之㐫㑹，非專指三合","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350827008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹起一物言也，其理尤長。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350827008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2580","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"詩日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㑹㐫會要推詳，吉","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350843392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會相逢最吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350843392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是㐫神三合起，破財剥職主灾殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350859776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱暗帶，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350876160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2585","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱之中逢暗帶，有榮有辱。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350876160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子年丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350892544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月暗帶乙丑，爲正印，爲貴人，爲引進神，爲偏禄元，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350892544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2589","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099013249024040"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以有榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350892544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲子年壬戌月，暗帶癸亥，爲亡神，爲正","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350908928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空，是以有辱。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350908928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時同看，四柱暗帶切於正帶，卽慿暗","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350925312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶以言貴賤吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350925312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夾煞□墓，决主㐫𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350941696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行拘聚","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350958080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行相尅，此理之常；内有拘聚，此理之妙，乃相生法","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350958080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350958080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然必陰陽太旺，方能拘聚。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350974464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如木旺則能拘火，火旺","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350990848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則能拘土，土旺則能拘金，金旺則能拘水，造化展轉","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350990848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相生，更爲有情。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563350990848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假日干是土，生於卯月，衰弱，干支有","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351007232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，財煞太重，日時但得一未字，未中暗藏。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351007232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳則以","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351023616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水拘木，以木拘火，以火拘土，火土扶身勝任，財煞决","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351023616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2607","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099077576884260"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2608","lineNum":0,"lineType {"lines":[{"lineId":"2621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己化","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351138304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土見戊辰，三元歸本期爲眞。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351138304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚金時見庚辰造化","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351154688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351154688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但看柱中無相害，惡煞亦難侵。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351171072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛水逄見壬辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351187456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最爲美。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351203840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支辰若不値天魁，此是人世不世才。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351220224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬木","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351236608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2630","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099077577015332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰來見，獨爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351236608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"那知得此是魁星，遇者須敎享大","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351252992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351252992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸火後見丙辰爲妙理，三元來徃少相妨，值者","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351269376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡸁紳入朝堂，此是天機眞造化，黄金白玉買無價。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351269376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351285760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄生旺庫扶持，富貴功名滿天下。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351285760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此正化也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351302144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大槩化","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351318528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣以日干爲主，合年月時干皆可化。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351318528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如天干無而地","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351334912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支遇正祿代之，甲不見己而見午，巳祿在午之類，亦","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351334912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可化。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351334912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但要成局，仍要旺氣聚於時，方可，兼得月氣尢","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351351296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351351296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或日得旺，自足以化。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351367680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有干支自化，却要運行化","logicSentenceId":"7577325563351384064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣旺鄕，不然無用。","logicSentenceId":"757732 {"lines":[{"lineId":"2956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從象","logicSentenceId":"7577325563415068672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2957","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099061772894258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫從者，夫妻相從之意也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563415068672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論引用之氣，夫乘旺則婦。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563415085056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從婦乘旺則夫從官。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563415101440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞者，夫也，財者，妻也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563415117824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"借夫妻之","logicSentenceId":"7577325563415134208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名，以取人之禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563415134208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙日生己酉丑申之位，是婦從","logicSentenceId":"7577325563415150592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫；庚日生亥卯未寅之位，是夫從婦。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563415150592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇其從，卽從","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883290659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其地支専氣言之；若歸其本，卽從其本言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883290659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2968","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"玉井云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但從其有氣，或黨多，亦從","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883307043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2970","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：自身無氣，從局變象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在支三合所屬同也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883307043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：從中有貴有賤；從中顯貴得時，位列三公；從中","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883323427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𮕩敗失時，孤貧奔走。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883323427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲戌、丁卯、庚申、己卯，庚申金","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883339811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自旺，生卯月，卯時，木極旺，是妻乘旺而夫從之，主因","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883339811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2976","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099139694428196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻得財，或就妻得財。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883339811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚申、戊寅、己酉、丙寅，己日見","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883356195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月時二寅甲是正官，乃夫旺妻從之象，雖庚甲欲損","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883356195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，寅有長生丙火制之，甲用酉中辛金爲正官，夫星","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883356195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得官，甲禄歸寅，故嫁夫貴顯，三台之命婦也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883356195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2982","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

eIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂干支相停者，化是看日時合化不合化。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883454499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2998","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"玉井。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2999","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五氣有化象，須要純一清潔，化而或返，有貴有賤；","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883470883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化而不化，或壽或夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883470883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3002","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"通玄論云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙旺庚從庚旺，乙從","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883487267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日，主無氣，化有氣，方可用，若各無氣，不可用。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883487267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883503651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬化木，生於春則夫從妻生，生於冬，則妻從夫生，是","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883503651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂化也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883503651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲寅、己巳、甲戌壬申，謂甲己化土，得土局","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883520035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生在申","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883520035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3010","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又甲戌、甲寅，癸㔾戊午，戊癸化火，生於寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":nul {"lines":[{"lineId":"3016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883552803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3017","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"玄虛道人日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類屬從化格判旺衰照伏拱","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883569187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遥局分明暗。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883569187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3020","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"荆山居士觧云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲乙日干見地支，寅","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883585571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯辰全者爲類，見亥卯未全者爲屬；乙日見己酉丑","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883585571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或申酉戌之類爲從，甲日見己，乙日見庚之類爲化。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883585571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類屬要身旺而從化要衰也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883601955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁日四柱皆火，而時","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883618339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支得卯木，謂之木火相照。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883618339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日四柱皆水，而時支","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883634723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得一金，謂之金水相照。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883634723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬生午月，水無根，乃棄命以","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883651107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從午中丁火，丁與壬合如夫婦，此伏象也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883651107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此說伏照","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883667491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不同，其理無異。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883667491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上八法，乃看命定格之大關鍵，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883683875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3034","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099139694444580"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須細推之。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883683875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再考諸家貴格，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883700259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地德合：","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883700259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3038","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3039","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690896505012235/1-8b49ef1a6d0b55ad.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=IqQr5l57BnLFSfbpwd08m1cDKxE%3D","uri":"read/NA06530/5/ref/1kpj5xu5w0f1v/1-8b49ef1a6d0b55ad.webp","fontType":1,"components":"扌上月","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690896505012235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3040","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"南正貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干爲天之清氣，支爲地之厚載。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883700259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天合者，得賢人之心，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883716643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本乎天者親上；支合者，得衆人之心，本乎地者親下。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883716643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支俱合，是爲天地德合，如甲子見己丑，戊戌見癸","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883733027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883733027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時合爲上，日合次之，若年與月相合，日與時","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883749411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相合，尢爲福𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883749411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如張舜臣尚書乙卯丁亥、戊寅癸亥，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883765795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"林見素尚書辛未丁酉、己卯甲戌是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883765795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君臣慶會，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883782179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干爲君之象，支爲臣之義，干支俱合，在一旬之内見","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883782179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3052","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152298459176"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，是謂君臣慶㑹，如甲戌見己卯，戌辰見癸酉之類","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883782179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883782179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時合爲上，日合次之。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883798563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年與月合，日與時合，爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883814947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𩀱鴛德合尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883814947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上二格，前論合化已言，但未提作","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883831331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883831331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3060","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古歌云：甲人己巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"到甲申，乙是庚辰乙酉親，丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883847715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須辛卯及丙戌，丁下壬寅丁亥乘，戊生癸亥戊寅日，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883847715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛用丙申辛巳迎。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883847715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬逄丁未𠔥壬午，癸注戊午癸未","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883864099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883864099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己因甲戌來己卯，此是榮華福壽齡。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883880483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中若更加他","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883896867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格局，定主侯王宰相眞。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883896867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如虞尚書癸未甲寅、戊午丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883913251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，蔡學士甲申戊辰、己巳庚午，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883913251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魏丞相己卯、甲戌、乙","logicSentenceId":"7577325563883913251","marginNoteIdL
