ntenceId":"7577325563884011555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凌相都憲，乙未庚辰、壬寅、辛亥，王一","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884027939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夔狀元，乙巳戊子、丙申丁酉，翁萬逹尚書，戊午己未、","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884027939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳、丁巳是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884027939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩干不雑，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884044323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3090","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099139694477348"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時連占兩干，純一而不雜也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884044323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子、乙亥、","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884060707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戊、乙丑、甲乙兩字不亂，又丙寅、丁酉、丙辰、丁酉、丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884060707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁兩字不亂之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884060707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3095","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賦云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干頭相類，銅臭官𤰞。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884077091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884093475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人得乙，乙人得甲，謂之偏禄，多無科名。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884093475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合聚集，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884109859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3100","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"各龍鳳三台格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時胎，或干辰帶三位一同，或支辰帶三位","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884109859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一同，或納音帶三位一同，葢取一生二，二生三，三生","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884109859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物盈數之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884109859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如三丁、一癸、三壬、一戊、三庚、一丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884126243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之類，切忌建旺太𨓺中又太𨓺，惟土金不然。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884126243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如三金","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884142627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得土，三土得火，或三戊、三庚、三辛，建旺不碍。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884142627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其支辰，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884159011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099061772927026"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如三寅一申爲馬，三亥一寅爲合之例。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884159011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納音三位，如","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884175395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子、乙丑、壬申，則金得地之類方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884175395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行俱足，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884191779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時胎帶金木、水火、土，或眞氣，或納音，而三","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884191779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元有氣，又謂之全逄五庫，如甲子、戊辰、丁巳、丁未、已","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884191779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未胎之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884191779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須是相生不𣦸絶福神逓互乘之，方","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884208163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884208163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如自𣦸自絶而無救，不入格。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884224547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3120","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行俱足，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884240931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不論胎，乃取當生眞氣而圓之，𦶩眞氣卽當年之主。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884240931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昧者添胎月一辰，納音則誤。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884257315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李廷相尚書，辛丑甲午、","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884273699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申、戊戌、乙酉胎，何洛文翰林，丙申、辛丑、壬子、辛亥、","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884273699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3126","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099139694510116"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰胎是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884273699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六位相乘，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884290083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時胎，再加年日禄馬，或命宮合起十二支","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884290083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神，更天干五位合全十干爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884290083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子、丁卯、戊寅、辛","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884306467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、戊午胎，巳上安命之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884306467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余命壬午、癸丑、庚寅、丙戌、","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884322851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰胎，禄馬在申是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884322851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"育吾自記。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聚精㑹神，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884339235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淮南子目：精神者，所受於天，而形體者，所禀於地。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884339235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884355619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲火，坎爲水，火爲日，水爲月，日月運行於天，以成四","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884355619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，此天之精神也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884355619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水爲精，火爲神，精爲氣之母，氣爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884372003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3142","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099139694493732"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神之子，一氣周流，而長生不𣦸，此人之精神也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884372003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884388387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命或干支，或納音，二水二火，各乘旺得地，無他物以","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884388387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜之，相合相濟，則英靈之氣與天同運，不但貴顯出","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884388387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人，抑且壽命悠久。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884388387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李東陽閣老，丁卯丁未、癸亥、己未，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884404771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊一清閣老，甲戌、丙子、壬午、丁未是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884404771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神藏煞没，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884421155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂甲庚、丙壬爲陽干之吉㑹，生於孟月尤隹。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884421155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙辛丁","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884437539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸爲陰干之貴德，生居季月最好。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884437539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六㐫神至此而潜","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884453923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藏，四惡煞遇兹而伏没。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884453923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如年月日時四位，四干分明，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884470307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不論刑害衝破，皆爲吉氣，更加𬓈馬官印尤吉，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884470307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賦云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3159","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099067426603035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽奇陰耦最豪英是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884470307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行墓煞有四：寅午戌","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884486691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月煞在丑，丑爲金墓，故大吉爲煞到乹没。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884486691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未月","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884503075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞在戌，戌爲火墓，故河魁爲火煞到坤没。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884503075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰月","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884519459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞在未，未爲木墓，故小吉爲木煞到巽没。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884519459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑月","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884535843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞在辰，辰爲水墓，故天罡爲水煞到艮没。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884535843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命如生","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884552227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌月，日得丑而時得亥，則煞没。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884552227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙㐫將有","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884568611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六：騰蛇、朱雀屬火，在亥，壬子癸爲墮水投江，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884568611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎屬","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884568611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金，在巳丙午丁爲燒身；玄武屬水，在坤、艮，辰戌丑未","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884568611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲折足，皆受制尅而勝，則是六神藏也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884568611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽玄武當權","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884584995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"等煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884584995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099113375137803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬交馳，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884601379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅午戌馬在申，而時干得庚；亥卯未馬在巳，而時","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884601379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干得丙。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884601379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申子辰馬在寅，而時干得甲，己酉丑馬在","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884617763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，而時干得壬。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884617763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如年月日時四位，干支互換得之，年","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884634147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月不見，而日時五見尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884634147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌衝破空亡，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884650531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"趕禄欄馬，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884650531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲戌生人，甲禄在寅，得丁丑以趕之，戌馬在申，得","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884650531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉以欄之，不必求正禄正馬，而禄馬自來，此格極","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884650531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，所謂禄不趕不發，馬不欄不住是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884650531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集福發福，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884666915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099067426619419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽四位集福於帝座，帝座發福於四位，已論前年月","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884666915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時中。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884666915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王昺侍郞壬子壬子、乙酉丁丑，吳遠都憲，戊","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884683299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅甲寅、壬寅、戊申是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884683299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支雙連，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884699683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂甲午見乙未，丙申見丁酉，戊戌見己亥，上下相連","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884699683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884699683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子見乙丑，庚午見辛未，甲庚貴，丑未，乙、辛","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884716067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，子午一各，二儀貴偶，此爲連珠福神，能壓衆煞，更","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884716067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加禄馬十分之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884716067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若連珠進退，如丙寅見丁卯，同氣，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884732451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是各退氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884732451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯見丙寅，退一辰，却是進，乃眞氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884748835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天干連珠，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884765219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099117351403558"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時胎得甲、乙、丙、丁、戊，或己、庚、辛、壬癸，甲合","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884765219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己，乙合庚，丙合辛，戊合癸，又謂十干連珠格。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884765219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若納音","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884781603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連珠，四位相承，自上生下，或自下生上，亦是。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884781603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有倒𡸁","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884797987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連珠，如丁未人得丙午時，辛丑人得庚子時之類，有","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884797987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正印連珠；壬午人得癸未時，甲子人得乙丑時之類，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884797987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有懸印連珠；乙亥人得甲戌時，癸巳人得壬辰時，丁","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884797987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳人得丙辰時之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884797987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一路連珠，早擅四方","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884814371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之譽。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884814371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彭僉憲丁卯戊申、己亥庚午，黄華卿甲戌丙子。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884830755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于庚中是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884847139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地支連茹，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884863523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099117351419942"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時胎得子寅辰、午申戊，地支各間一位，或","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884863523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑寅卯辰相連之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884863523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3227","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賦云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拔茅連茹兮，愈堅愈固，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884879907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：得連茹者富。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884879907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是干支之别也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884896291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若天干地支俱連，","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884912675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴雙全，如英國公丁巳、丙午、丁未、戊申、誠意伯劉","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884912675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑜、庚子、戊寅、庚辰、壬午是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325563884912675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年隔二位，月隔時日","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424355892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一位，如子年卯月、己日未時之類，謂之貴人局，主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424355892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行正印，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424372276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子生人得乙丑時，丙寅生人得甲戌時之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424372276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424388660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無衝破、空亡、𣦸絶，更有福𥙍互爲之𦔳。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424388660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行入庫，取","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424405044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲上格。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424405044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲乙未、丙丁戌之類，年月日時皆有，謂五","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424421428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099139694575652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行逢庫，主兩府台輔之貴，或落空亡，亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424421428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄庫逄財，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424437812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲干之墓處，謂之禄庫。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424437812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄庫中得帶地財或納音爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424454196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財，不惟貴而主富。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424454196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無則職雖顯，家貧，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424470580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿庫空","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424470580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虛，嚢空職重是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424470580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福㑹相迎，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424486964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此十千所生反所尅，如甲生丙尅戊之類，乃食神逄","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424486964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財也，不犯他干，仍帶貴氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424486964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人胎月日時遇之，主衣","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424503348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食豐足，官爵崇高。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424503348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大小運行年至此，亦有遷官進財","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424519732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424519732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3260","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152298491944"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生𣦸相聚，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424536116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚辰、辛巳、庚午、辛巳、甲戌、乙亥、甲子、乙亥、壬寅、癸","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424536116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯、壬辰、癸卯、丙申、丁酉、丙戌、丁𮠕，是陽𣦸陰生，如甘","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424536116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苦同受之意。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424536116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂庚生於巳，辛𣦸於巳，甲生於亥，乙","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424552500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸於亥，壬𣦸於卯，癸生於卯，丙𣦸於酉，丁生於酉，是","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424552500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不相離也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424552500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若金則金生，木則木生，貴賤不相入則否。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424568884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一旬包褁，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424585268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃甲子見癸酉，甲寅見癸亥之類，月日胎俱包年時","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424585268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424585268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四位、五位、七位包俱同旬。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424601652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四綂三十","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424618036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六位，大衍虛二。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424618036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中間干支得用，與年時財官印食或","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424634420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099117351469094"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬貴人者，皆大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424634420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱順布，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424650804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂時次日，日次月，月次年，先後不亂是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424650804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行一旬，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424667188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時胎共出一旬，如甲子、丙寅、己巳、庚午之","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424667188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類，帶生旺六合，無破敗則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424667188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又年月日時胎各占一","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424683572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬，謂之五福集祥，亦大格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424683572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須福神逓互相乗，無破","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424699956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敗，方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424699956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人黄樞","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424716340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂戊巳二字，而帶辰戌丑未全，如戊戌、己未、己丑、戊","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424716340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099117351534630"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，或貴集丑位，而此曰生爲入格。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424716340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3291","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古歌日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四鎭之星","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424732724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福自強，更看權煞在何方。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424732724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數重貴禄兼生旺，不作公","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424749108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"侯便作王。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424749108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如明太祖戊辰壬戌、丁丑、丁未，土居四季，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424765492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未順陰陽貴全，所以爲創業天子。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424765492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四衝得位","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424781876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四衝得位，與四位純全微不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424781876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂寅申己亥欲自生，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424798260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或互換生，子午卯酉欲自旺，辰戌丑未欲自墓，方取。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564424798260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3302","lineNum":0,"lineTyp ent":"經云：六合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙鴛，坐槐庭而布政是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564425207860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲寅、丙寅、甲寅、丙寅，名","logicSentenceId":"7577325564425224244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙飛蝴蝶格，此格極貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564425224244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴氣衝和。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564425224244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁亥土人，得甲辰、丙辰時，爲陰陽六辰，自然清貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564425240628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更天干納音稍有和氣，富貴極盛。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564425257012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"引從包承，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564425273396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居年前日引，年後曰從。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564425273396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子人，以前三辰爲引，則","logicSentenceId":"7577325564425289780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅、丁卯爲引；以後三辰爲從，則壬戌、癸亥爲從。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564425289780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千神","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437102632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一字而支神相應，前有貴擁，後有馬乘，中有建禄者，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437102632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是夾禄夾貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437102632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令巳未人己巳月己未日己巳時，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437119016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四巳干神二字不雜，己貴在申，故曰前有貴擁，未有","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437119016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099117351600166"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬在已，故曰後有馬乗，貴踰三品之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437119016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若丁巳、丁未","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437135400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則正夾禄，辛卯、辛丑則正夾貴，當從落㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437135400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3527","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437151784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴夾持人少得。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437151784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊午人得丙午日時，戊禄在巳，夾","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437168168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在後，戊貴在未，夾在前。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437168168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如己末年辛未月己未日","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437184552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未時，葢己禄在午在後，巳貴在申在前，禄與貴人","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437184552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾扶其身，不須帶别支神，乃爲貴命，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437184552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3535","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前遮後擁，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437184552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人中仙乃禄馬夾貴在本命前後是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437184552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3538","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"理愚歌日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437200936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲持綱入帝朝，貴星不與賤星交。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437200936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將軍須是貴煞褁，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437217320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宰相多應禄馬包。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437217320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡貴人格，須要五行中無一位駁。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437233704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜徃來更生旺有氣，帶福神於其上，四位貴，却不是","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437250088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3545","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152298524712"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437250088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3547","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古歌云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好年不如月，好月不如時。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437266472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡禄馬、官貴、六合、華葢、金舉、文星、貴人、正印、庫食、□","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437381160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3566","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099139694690340"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"德之類，皆謂之福神，逓互相還爲格。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437381160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無𣦸絶、衝破","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437397544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡，有五行旺氣福神𦔳之，主爲將相。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437397544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此而又有","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437413928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞神，卽少達歷重任。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437413928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有𣦸絕，無衝破空亡，只在格","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437430312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上㸔之，又須尊者吉方可。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437430312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干神主本爲重，凡干神作","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437446696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺臨官，或作福神，皆是吉位，而納音𣦸絶，兹爲尊","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437446696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉卑㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437446696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若納音旣𣦸絶，更有衝破空亡，卽不成就，不","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437463080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨓺一簿尉州縣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437463080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱他位有福𦔳之，亦不𨓺一多難京","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437479464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝官耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437479464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若空亡衝破，更有三刑六害，必是一孤獨貧","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437495848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭，或僧道併無成舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437495848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更觀五行輕重消息。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437512232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乘生旺","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437528616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者，特達之士，只消一件可作大乘生旺之氣，須兩","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437528616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099067426750491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"件可也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437528616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四時攝聚：","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437545000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅、丙寅，木火攝聚於寅，丁巳、辛巳，金火攝聚於巳，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437545000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申、甲申，金水攝聚於申，壬申、戊申，水土攝聚於申，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437545000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥、乙亥，水木攝聚於亥，遇者主清要顯達。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437545000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月令","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437561384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不得地，亦𮂊。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437561384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3594","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神白經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水聚於申，火木聚於寅，水","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437577768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木聚於亥，火土聚於巳，全在日時，徃徃有福。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437577768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若更四","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437594152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時有氣逢生，十有九貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437594152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"致一凝神。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437594152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人得抱一之眞，則無所不達；鬼神含得一之靈，則","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437610536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3601","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099117351632934"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變化無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437610536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而陰陽之理，精神之運，歛散抑揚於一者，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437626920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以爲致一之命，乃間世賢輔、出羣大貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437626920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如年","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437643304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月日時胎五位，納音四木一水、四金一土之類，一見","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437643304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於時，或一金四水土，一水四金土，一見於年，各有旺","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437643304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，發越一路是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437643304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五位中，年胎、月俱丑，而日上或時","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437659688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上見一寅之類；年胎月時俱是戊巳，而日上見一丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437659688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437659688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或天乙、天官、文星、天德徃來，見於四位，爲福貴","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437676072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，獨胎一位，無福貴之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437676072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬、官印、貴德㑹於帝","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437692456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"座，三合於日時上帶本家一值禄馬，四位倶乗旺氣，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437692456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨於時上帶一路𣦸絶之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437692456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或四位俱帶𣦸絶之氣，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437708840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3618","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099154647105551"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨於日或時上帶一路生旺之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437708840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四位或甲乙、或丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437725224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"了，或庚辛，或壬癸，而日上或時上見一真官，諸如此","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437725224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類，須徃來㑹合，歸於一者，方成此格。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437725224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若自生旺一路","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437741608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見福貴，自𣦸絕一路見福貴，亦是","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437741608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虛中精實。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437741608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之年時上下，如天地覆載，而運日月於太虛之中，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437757992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此虛中精實之格，最爲奇妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437757992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖美惡相雜，喜憎相半，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437774376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無不併包而兼容之，真大器逺業之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437774376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年與時上下","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437790760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乘生旺之氣，惟日一路帶衰敗𣦸絶之氣；或上下乘","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437790760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金玉剛柔之德，惟月日上一路建水火變通之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437790760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437807144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3634","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099067426799643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下俱带天乙、天官、文星、禄馬，並互換見諸吉神，獨","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437807144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日位無祿馬貴氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437807144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或年月時得寅午戌生旺庫，三合","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437823528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純全，獨日上一位帶三合衰敗𣦸絕之氣是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437823528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入此","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437839912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格者，曠世無忌，休休有容，富貴不能滛，威武不能屈。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437839912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如陳以勤閣老，辛未戊戌丁卯辛亥申時，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437856296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行狀元乙","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437856296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未、乙酉、甲辰、乙亥，其說註蘭臺妙選，是此格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437856296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功奪造化，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437872680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月曰胎，俱在𣦸絶無氣之郷，而得一時在自生自","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437872680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之地是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437872680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令本命屬金，年月日胎俱無氣，而得","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437889064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉，属火而得戊午，屬水而得丙子，屬土而得庚子，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437889064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3649","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099067426816027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屬木而得辛卯，皆納音自旺之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437889064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或辛巳、丙寅、己亥、","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437905448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申、戊申，皆納音自生之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437905448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若大小二運，行年太歲，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437921832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只以生時較量灾福，葢不生不旺，則不能成人故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437921832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功侔造化，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437938216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本命納音生居無氣之地，却得救𦔳，而徃來復旺於","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437938216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本位是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437938216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令辛酉人得癸卯，癸卯人得辛酉，葢辛","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437954600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉之木困於金鄉，却得癸卯，金復旺於酉，而木復旺","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437954600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於卯，徃來互換，故爲吉㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437954600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3661","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉失位之木，惟對","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437970984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以癸卯，則剛柔相濟，得之者文明俊敏，决取巍科。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437970984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437987368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前朝穆宗丁酉癸卯、癸卯辛酉，嚴嵩閣老庚子己卯、","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437987368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3666","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099183180955684"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯辛酉，是此格也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564437987368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内陽外陰，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438003752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如年時納音屬金水，日月屬火木，金水爲陰，火木爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438003752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438003752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又年時屬水，日月屬木，水遶花堤，乃外陰内陽俱","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438020136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438020136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：不拘內外，只要成象爲妙，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438036520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼎足鎡基。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438036520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼎足之義，謂之三合見三奇，三合見一馬合，三合見","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438052904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本干，三合帶本家，俱以得生旺爲貴，切忌以金當寅","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438052904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午戌之類，須旺中損壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438052904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合見三奇，乃乙、丙丁或甲、","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438069288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊、庚在年月曰時，而地支三合之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438069288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合見一馬，乃","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438085672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3681","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099113375236107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰而得寅馬、己酉丑亥馬之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438085672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合見馬合，乃","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438102056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌見巳合申之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438102056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合見本干，乃甲乙人得亥","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438118440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯未，丙丁人得寅午戌之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438118440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合帶本家，如寅午戌","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438134824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火命，得丙寅、戊午、甲戊帶本家火，亥卯未得巳亥辛。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438134824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯、癸未帶本家木之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438151208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又三合寅午戌馬在申，有申","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438167592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而缺寅；亥卯未馬在巳，有巳而缺亥；申子辰馬在寅，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438167592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有寅而缺申；己酉丑馬在亥，有亥而缺巳。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438167592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各三合馬","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438183976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"換頭支也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438183976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱揖闕門","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438200360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闕門乃年對處。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438200360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本命甲子以己巳、辛未爲拱揖，虛午","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438216744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3698","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099189992488987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲闕門；本命乙丑，以庚午、壬中爲拱揖，虚未爲闕門，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438216744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438216744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考諸書尤重子午，餘稍輕，以子午爲端門","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438233128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝座故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438233128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽命見天官合，陰命見天官印綬，在日時","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438249512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱揖二位者，如甲以己爲天合，辛以丙爲天官，壬爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438249512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438249512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或二天合、二天官、二印綬夾輔闕門亦貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438265896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"資以天德、天乙尤貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438265896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡拱二位，虛夾一位，兩干同類，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438282280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方爲眞拱。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438282280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有拱將、拱官、拱座、拱貴、拱印不同，不特拱","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438298664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門巳也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438298664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱將乃月將，拱官乃官星，拱座乃時爲帝座，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438315048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱貴乃天乙貴神，拱印乃甲戌、乙丑、壬辰、癸未爲本","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438315048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家印，只須不破爲貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438315048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3715","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"林開云：坐實不如拱，虛明合不。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3716","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099183180972068"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如暗㑹是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438315048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱有七十二格：拱刃、拱害、拱馬、拱學堂、","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438331432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱飛刃、拱刼煞，拱亡神、拱鬼、拱旺、拱破，拱孤辰、拱寡","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438331432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宿、拱岩廊、拱合、拱君臣合。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438331432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡拱須詳煞神輕重，分高","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438347816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"低，言禍福貴賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438347816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲子見甲寅，乙丑見乙卯，丙寅見","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438364200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰，丁卯見丁巳，戊辰見戊午，己巳見己未，庚午見","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438364200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申，辛未見辛酉，壬申見壬戌，癸酉見癸亥，命前二","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438364200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰有用必貴，無用平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438364200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二各金章格，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438380584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍躍天門。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438380584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥人得壬辰日時，壬辰人得辛亥日時。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438396968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如見丁亥，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438413352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲正入格，天門在西北處乹位，得壬辰水，正印而六","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438413352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3732","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099154647121935"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍在御，見亥，所以爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438413352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得丁亥，則干神合壬，禄在","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438429736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，入此格者，有潤澤生民，濟世功業，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438429736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎卧龍閣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438429736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申人得辛卯日時者，爲正入格。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438446120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎家在庚申，而","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438462504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯重重見之，則爲龍閣，故曰虎卧龍閣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438462504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得此者，主","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438478888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴有聲譽，彈壓名臣，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438478888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲行雨施。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438478888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"3743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午丁未人得戊子己丑日時。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438495272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子己丑人得丙午","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438511656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未日時。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438511656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢丙午丁未，天河水，戊子己丑霹靂火，子","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438528040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午居陰陽之正位，今全見之，陰陽合乃雨。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438528040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己入貴","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438544424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099154647154703"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格，而更得此，主膏澤及民，有衝破空亡，亦不失爲州","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438544424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縣之職，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438544424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清肅憲臺。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438544424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑人皆得乙字者是。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564438560808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令乙丑人得乙酉月乙","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894117903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日，得乙酉時，爲正人格，金主刑乙，眞金，己酉丑金","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894117903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之正位，上干全見之，多爲臺諫之任。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894117903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若胎月中見驛","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894134287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，則任憲司之職，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894134287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風雲慶㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894134287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格一至三日得甲，或寅，四至六日得乙，或卯，七至","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894150671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九日得丙，或巳，十至十二日得丁，或午，十三至十五","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894150671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3762","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099154647138319"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日得戊，或己，十六日至十八日得己，或午，十九日至","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894150671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十一日得庚，或申，二十二至二十四日得辛，或酉，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894150671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十五至二十七得壬，或亥，二十八至三十日得癸，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894150671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或子。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894150671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須將三日一分干，十干日内細推㸔。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894167055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙逄寅","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894183439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894183439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重蔭重官。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894199823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重蔭者，如甲人逄癸又見庚；重官者，如甲人逄辛又","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894216207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見丙。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894216207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢甲以癸爲蔭，癸以庚爲蔭，甲以辛爲官，辛以","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894232591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙爲官。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894232591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲人逄兩辛，不用此論","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894248975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"包褁旗旌","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894248975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3777","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099154647187471"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命中刼煞曰旗，亡神曰旌，二者相見，方爲旌旗，獨","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894248975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇一位，則非包褁者，乃貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894248975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如庚辰、丙戊、庚午、丙","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894265359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子，刼煞在巳，亡神在亥，庚辰、庚午拱己上刼煞，曰包","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894265359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"褁旗；丙戌、丙子拱亥上亡神，曰包褁旌。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894265359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘格類此。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894281743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894298127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇旌旗全官，雖𤰞，亦作小監司，或爲帥將，如帶刃身。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894298127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅煞多斬，人煞尅身，必刃來傷𣦸，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894314511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴所成。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894314511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲人生亥卯未，甲辰得辛亥、丙寅己亥，甲寅得辛","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894330895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未、丙子己亥，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894330895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞體守位。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894330895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3791","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099189992521755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁人得壬，而在寅卯辰、亥之中，或見丙、辛，各在旺","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894347279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，别位無丁是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894347279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虛一待用，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894363663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四主本干相連，卽跳一字，如甲、乙、丙、戊跳丁一字是","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894363663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894363663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得之者，穏歩青雲。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894380047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四主本支相連而重一字，如","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894396431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子子丑寅，乃頭重尾輕，主夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894396431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假音得時，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894412815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如土人生夏季，或居申子辰中，運四季，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894412815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寶義制伐，四事顯朝","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894412815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尊生卑口寶，𤰞生尊曰義，上尅下曰制，下尅上曰伐。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894412815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3804","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099154647171087"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以此四者，胎月日時，上下相生相尅，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894429199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行不雜，九命相養，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894429199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂三元各處一方，帶本位禄而和。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894429199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及三元各居旺庫，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894445583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而納音干支相生育也，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894445583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主旺本成㑹於一方。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894445583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子土得丙戌月、丁丑胎、庚辰日、癸未時之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894461967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894478351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝破，却㑹在本氣之方，更有禄馬尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894478351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月官德合，暗逄支禄，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894494735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁亥得壬辰、壬戌，甲人得丑未亥之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894494735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用刑者有時，守刑者不亂。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894511119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3817","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099189992538139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅刑巳而生在春，制尅有用。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894527503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸巳刑戊申而無","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894543887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁干者，是。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894543887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生元命，支干四柱應以上諸格，雖主本無氣，亦主","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894560271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各聞挺特出羣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894560271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三元有地而貴，四柱逓合而榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894576655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三元","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894593039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱有用，得地，必富貴清顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894593039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎月日時交互相合而朝","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894609423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命，卽是榮貴清顯之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894609423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但忌空亡𣦸絶相衝爲破壞。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894625807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若入格命，更得福集帝座，須歷清華之選。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894642191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有刑破，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894658575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迤逓减退言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894658575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有天中相衝，相刑帶煞，多是右職。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894674959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更天中相刑衝，主多停替。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894691343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
