","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余𡮢","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894789647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂天下之大，兆民之衆，如此，年月日時生者，豈無其","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894789647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人，然未必皆大貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894789647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要之，天生大貴人，必有𡨋數氣","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894806031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3884","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099183181021220"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運以主之。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894806031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日時，多不足慿。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894822415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余紀縉紳與凡民命","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894838799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同者，不能悉數，姑就縉紳論，如黃懋官侍郞，與申价","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894838799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"副使命同，黄𣦸於兵禍，申𣦸牅下，申先黄𣦸，官之大","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894838799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小，又不論也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894838799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱衡與李庭龍命同，朱發科壬辰，李發","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894855183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"科癸丑，朱官至尚書，李止大𠫭，壽又不永，其子孫之","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894855183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多寡賢否，又不論也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894855183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬宷與饒才命同，萬舉進士，官","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894871567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至卿貳，饒止舉人，官至太守。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894871567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然饒多子，而萬則少，又","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894887951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬以謫戌𣦸，而饒則否，其壽夭得䘮又難論也。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894887951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三河","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894904335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王且齋兄弟同産，而功名先後亦自不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894904335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况天下之","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894920719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大，九州之廣，兆民之衆，其八字同者何限，又烏可以","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894920719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3902","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099113375301643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"例論耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894920719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余記小說，說一走卒，與魯公命同，魯公遇朝","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894937103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廷有大恩𠖥，則此卒受大責罰；魯公有小喜慶，則此","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894937103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卒有小譴責，其相反有如此者。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894937103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又染家生子，與魯公","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894953487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命同，前後差六十年。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894953487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"術者以鲁公之命証之，其家大","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894969871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜，謂他日必貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894969871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自孩童時，恣其所爲，後遂酗酒逰蕩，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894986255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醉𣦸於水，年止十九。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564894986255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又記樂善録太學二士人命同，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895002639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又同發觧過省，約就相近逰宦，庻彼此得知灾福。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895002639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895019023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一人任鄂州敎授，一人任黄州敎授。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895019023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未幾，黄州者𣦸，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895035407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄂州者爲治後事，祝曰：我與公生年月日時同出處。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895035407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同公先捨我去，使我今𣦸，已後公七日矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895051791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有靈，宜","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895068175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3921","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099113375334411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"托夢以告。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895068175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其夜果夢云：我生於富貴，享用過當，故𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895084559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公生於寒微，未得享用，故活。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895100943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後鄂官至典郡，豈非有","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895117327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所警惕，享用不過之所致乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895117327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又吾郡有顔守芳生員，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895133711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與厰民袁大綱命同，顏貧𡊮富，顔多子，𡊮僅二子，顏","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895133711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在而𡊮己𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895133711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顔讀書守禮，有危疾而能自保，竟歲𧴨","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895150095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出身，袁則反是。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895150095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合是數人觀之，散所生之家不同，而","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895166479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各人所習之業又異。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895166479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其保身愼修，克儉長年，在吾人","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895182863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自求多福耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895182863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若曰我命該富貴長壽，而不修德進學，","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895199247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驕恣不法，豈命之所以爲命也耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577325564895199247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子平說辯今之談命者，動以子平爲名。子平何所取義？以天開於子，子乃水之專位，爲地支之首，五行之元，生於天一，合於北方，遇平則止，遇坎則流，此用子之意也。又如人世用秤稱物，以平爲凖，稍有重輕，則不平焉。人生八字爲先天之氣，譬則稱也，其年爲鈎，時爲權，月爲提綱，日爲銖兩。八字以日爲主，中有財官印食旺相，日干亦坐旺相之地。如鈎綰物，與權相應，其命則富而貴。如財官印食旺相，日千乃值於休囚，如以鈎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152491298842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綰重物，與權自不相應，其秤則不平，其命賤而貧。如財官印食休囚，日干值於旺相，亦若鈎綰輕物，與權白不相應，其秤自不平，其命亦蹇滯。設使三物無氣，日主休囚，非貧賤，則夭亡，此用平之意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天太過，後天减之；先天不及，後天補之，先天、後天無太𨓺不及，然後爲能平焉。運限者，後天也。且如先天八字，日干旺相，太過者，宜行休衰之運，發泄其氣；如日干休囚，不及者，宜行旺相之運，生扶其氣。二者則能發福發財，遷轉亨通，譬醫家補瀉之法耳。若日干旺甚，仍行旺運，日干太衰，又行衰運，則皆太過不及，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152491282458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍生灾，蹇滯不通矣。旺運者，轉也，十年一轉，窮通可知。皆由大運之興衰，以驗歲君之禍福。是故觀貴賤榮枯者，觀於子平可見矣。觀子平者，觀先後天之論可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"按此說子平二字，誠爲有理。但子平係徐居易之字，今之談命者，遠宗其法，故稱子平。考濯纓筆記：子平姓徐，名居易，子平其字也，東海人，别號沙滌先生，又稱蓬萊叟，隱於太華西棠峰洞。子平之法，以人所生年月日時，推其祿命，無有不中。其源葢出於戰國珞琭子，世有元理消息賦一篇，謂其所作。然觀其文，殆後人僞撰，非珞琭之本眞也。珞琭同時有鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099189992603675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"谷子，漢有董仲舒、司馬季主、東方朔、嚴君平，三國時有管輅，晋有郭璞，北齊有魏定，唐有袁天綱、僧一行、李泌、李虛中之徒，皆祖其術。泌𡮢出逰，得管輅書天陽訣，又得一行所授銅錶要㫖，占人吉㐫極驗。泌以是傳之李虛中，推衍以用之。珞琭以年，虛中以日，其法至是一變。五代時有麻衣道者，希夷先生及子平軰，子平得虛中之術而損益之，專主五行，不主納音，至是則其法又一變也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子平没後，宋孝宗淳熈，有淮旬術士，號冲虛子者，精於此術，當世重之。時有僧道洪者，宻受其傳，後入錢塘，傳布其學。世俗不知其所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152298623016"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由來，直言子平耳。後道洪傳之徐大升。今世所傳如三命淵源、定眞論等，皆其所著，以是本書變易𥁞矣。觀五行精紀、蘭臺妙選、三車一覧、應天歌等書，與淵源淵海不同。葢觀文察變，治历明時，皆隨其時而攺革，故雖百年之間，數術之說，亦不能不異。矧自大升之時，上距子平已三百餘年，其法不知經幾變矣。或謂大升得子平之眞傳，觀繼善等篇，不外明通賦，但更易其詞，而元理消息一賦，則大升之獨得也。今人推命之術，又元人復推子平、大升二家之法而演繹。爲之者顧今之談命者，動稱子平，而莫知其原。余故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099154647269391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"解子平二字而詳辯之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099183181070372"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論性情相貌夫貴賤關乎八字，性情應乎五行。善惡仁義、禮智信，心之所主；喜怒哀樂、愛惡欲，情之所生。東方震位，木號青龍，名曰曲直，五常主仁，其色青，其味酸，其性直，其情和。旺相主有博愛惻隱之心，慈祥愷悌之意，濟物利人，恤孤念寡，直朴清高，行藏慷慨，丰姿秀麗，骨格脩長，手足纎膩，口尖髪美，面色青白，語句軒昂，此則木盛多仁之義。休囚主瘦長髪少，抝性偏心，嫉妬不仁，此則木衰情寡之義也。𣦸絕則眉眼不正，慳吝鄙嗇，肌肉乾燥，項長喉結，行坐不穩，身多欹側。遇火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099183181103140"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色帶赤，見土則色帶黄，逢金則色帶白，見水則色帶黒。其餘四行例見。火屬南方，名曰炎上，五常主禮。其色赤，其味苦，其性急，其情恭。旺相主有辭譲端謹之風，恭敬謙和之義，威儀凛烈，淳朴尊崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面貌上尖下濶，形體頭小脚長，印堂窄而眉濃，鼻準露而耳小，精神閃爍，語言急速，性燥無毒，聰明有爲。太過則聲焦面赤，揺膝好動，不及則黄瘦尖楞，詭詐妬毒，言語妄誕，有始無終。土屬中央，名曰稼穡，五常主信。其色黄，其味甘，其性重，其情厚。旺相主言行相顧，忠孝至誠，好敬神佛，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099154647302159"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爽期信。背圓腰濶，鼻大口方，眉清目秀，靣肥色黄，度量寛厚，處事有方，太𨓺則執一古朴，愚拙不明；不及則顔色憂滯，靣偏鼻低，聲音重濁，事理不通，狠毒乖戾，不得衆情，顛倒失信，慳嗇妄爲。金屬西方，名曰從革，五常主義。其色白，其味辛，其性剛，其情烈，旺相則英勇豪傑，仗義疎財，知𤎉耻，識羞惡，骨肉相應，體徤神清，靣方白净，眉高眼深，鼻直耳紅，聲音清亮，剛毅果决。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太過則好勇無謀，貪欲不仁；不及則慳吝貪酷，事多挫志，有三思，少决斷，尅薄内毒，喜滛好殺，身材瘦小。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099154647351311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水屬北方，名曰潤下。五常主智。其色黒，其味鹹，其性聰明，其情良善。旺相則機𨵿深遠，足智多謀，學識𨓺人，詭詐無極，靣黒光彩，語言清和；太過則是非好動，飄蕩貪滛；不及則人物矮小，行事反覆，情性不常，膽小無畧。此雖五行之喻，實與人事相干。以上五行情性，参以命中所遇吉㐫神煞斷之。大抵生旺者主長大，𣦸絶者主矮小，若有煞臨，不在此限，又從煞上斷。若有尅，則從所尅之五行斷。又槩取日時上納音，㸔有尅無尅，并神煞所臨有氣無氣，斷其形狀性情，無有不騐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099154647318543"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日推人性行，只在曰時上㸔，本五行，不論納音。命若入格而逢生旺，主天性明白，遇物不逆，動必應機，言語聲高，豁達大度，臨事能斷，公平不疑，犯難不畏，平生不以財物爲吝，好施與，不𥝠己，奢泰歡樂，多情尚義，防有不善終之患。若命入貴格，而逢𣦸絕者，主爲性寡合，機深意宻，多疑多忌，動拘禮節，謹顧行止，修飾儀貌，常自檢約，不妄設施，防有陰謀之患。若小人之命，己入賤局，而逢生旺者，主性氣無常，不自檢束，爲事不顧危亡，好鬪争，恃強壓弱，親近惡黨，不事家業，必竟不得善終。𣦸絶則爲性滛邪，動必巧僞，畜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099113375399947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縮執抝，舉動修餙，専弄言詞，好自矜衒，臨事無斷。少。是多非，一生無立。宰公要訣云：智高量遠，葢因水處深源；篤信守仁，祗爲土成山岳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仁慈敏厚，木成甲乙之方，性速辨明；火應丙丁之位，譽高義重，因金歸合庚辛。處於中者，正性不移；或盛或衰，性情變易；水乘衰敗，性昏無頼；土力太微，蔽執寡用。木歸蹇地，太柔而治事無規；火數未興，小辨而太傷無决；金當淺薄，雖義而有始無終。是五行得地失地，太𨓺不及，皆能爲㐫也。子平賦云：美姿貌者，木生於春夏之時；無智識者，水困於丑未之日。性質聰明，蓋爲水象之秀；臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099154647367695"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事果决，皆因金氣之剛。五行氣足，體必豐肥；四柱無情，性多頑鄙。指迷賦云：文章明敏兮，定須火盛，威武剛烈兮，乃是金多。木盛則懷惻隠之心，水多則抱機巧之智。至土之性，最重爲貴。廣信集云：凡命五行生旺者，好事華飾，胷中無物，亦主好色。火命尤𦂳。𣦸絶相尅墓者，多好禪道，歸根復本也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"張白先生云：自絕五位五般情。金主義，自絕則寡義；木主仁，自絶則不仁；水主智，自絕則失智；火主禮，自絕則無禮；土主信，自絶則寡信。凡五行如先生旺後𣦸絕，則爲多鄙。壺中子云：言詞狡猾誕，時合値六虛。六虛住處，曰謾語","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099113375432715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神。凡人得之，心好撰餙，虛詞重併遇者必狡猾，平生妨尅尊親，漂流他國，作事多虛聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論疾病，先知五臟六腑所屬干支：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲膽乙肝丙小𮌝，丁心戊胃己脾郷。庚是大𮌝辛屬肺，壬係膀胱癸腎藏。三焦亦向壬中寄，包絡同歸入癸鄉。又曰：甲頭乙頂丙肩求，丁心戊肋己屬腹。庚是臍輪辛屬股，壬脛癸足一身由。又曰：子屬膀胱水道耳，丑爲胞肚及脾鄉。寅膽髪脉并兩手，卯本十指内肝方。辰士爲皮肩胷類，巳面咽齒下尻肛。午火精神司眼目，未土胃腕膈脊梁。申金大腸經絡肺，酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152298672168"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中精血小腸藏。戌土命門腿踝足，亥水爲頭及腎嚢。若依此法推人病，岐伯雷公也播揚。又曰：午頭巳未兩肩均，左右二膊是，辰申卯酉雙肋寅戌腿，丑亥屬脚子爲陰。又曰：乾首坤腹坎耳儔，震足巽股艮手留。兊口離目分八卦，凡看疾病此推求。夫疾病皆因五行不和，即人身五臟不和也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢五行通於五臟，六腑通於九竅，凡十干受病屬六腑，十二支受病屬五臟。丙丁巳午火局南離，主病在上；壬癸亥子水局北坎，主病在下。甲乙寅卯屬震，主病在左；庚辛申酉屬兊，主病在右；戊巳辰戌丑未屬坤艮，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099183181168676"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病在脾胃及中脘。諸風暈掉，眼光日昏，血不調暢，早年落髪，筋青瓜枯，屬肝家。甲乙寅卯木受𧇊，主病故也。諸痛膿血，瘡疥，舌苦瘖瘂者，屬心家。丙丁巳午火受𧇊，主病故也。浮腫脚氣，黄腫口臭，翻胃，脾寒膈𤍠者，屬脾家。戊巳辰戌丑未土受𧇊，主病故也。鼻塞酒齄，語蹇氣結，咳嗽喊者，屬肺家。庚辛申酉受𧇊，主病故也。白濁白帶，霍亂瀉痢，疝氣小腸屬腎家，壬癸亥子受𧇊，主病故也。甲乙見庚辛申酉多者，内主肝胆驚悸勞瘵，手足頑麻，䈥骨疼痛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外主頭目眩暈，口眼歪斜，左癱右痪，跌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099154647384079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"撲損傷。遇丙丁火多，無水相濟，則痰喘咯血，中風不語，皮膚乾燥，内熱口乾。女人主血氣欠調，有孕者墮胎，小兒主急慢驚風，夜啼咳嗽，面色青黯是也。丙丁見壬癸，亥子多者，内主心氣疼痛，顚痫舌強，口痛咽啞，急慢驚風，語言蹇澁，外主潮𤍠𤼵狂，眼暗失明，小腸疝氣，瘡痍膿血，小便淋濁，婦女主乾血氣，經脉不調，小兒主痘疹疥癬，面色紅赤是也。戊巳見甲乙，寅卯多者，内主脾胃不和，翻胃隔食，氣噎蠱脹，泄瀉黄腫，擇㨂飮食，嘔吐惡心，外上右手沉重，濕毒流注，胸腹痞塞。婦人主飲食不甘，吞酸虛弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099183181201444"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"呵欠困倦。小兒主五疳五軟，内𤍠好唾，面色痿黄是也。庚辛見丙丁，巳午多者，内主膓風痔漏，糞後下血，痰火咳嗽，氣喘吐血，魍魎失魂，虛煩勞症，外主皮膚枯燥，肺風鼻赤，疽腫發背，膿血無力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦女主痰嗽血産，小兒主膿血痢疾，面色黄白是也。壬癸見戊巳，辰戌丑未多者，内主遺精盗汗，夜夢鬼交，白濁虛損，寒戰咬牙，耳聾晴盲，傷寒感冒，外主風䖝牙痛，偏墜腎氣，腰痛膝痛，淋瀝吐瀉，怕冷惡寒，女人白帶鬼胎，經水不調。小兒主耳中生瘡，小膓疼痛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099113375449099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夜間作炒，面色黧黒是也。賦云：筋骨疼痛，盖因木被金傷，眼目暗昏，必是火遭水尅，土虚逢木旺之鄉，脾傷定論；金弱遇火炎之地，血疾無疑。又云：木逢金尅，定主腰肋之灾；火被水傷，必主眼目之疾。心肺喘滿亦千金火相刑，脾胃損傷。葢因士水戰尅支水，千頭有火遭，必腹病心朦；支火干頭有水，遇，則内障晴肓。炎上煩焦蒸土曜，頭秃眼昏；潤下純濕，無土制腎虚。耳閉熒惑乘旺臨離巽，風中失音；太白堅利合兑坤，兵前落魄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：心受病，口不能言；肝受病，目不能視；𦜉受病，口不能食；肺受病，鼻不能嗅；腎受病，耳不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152298704936"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聼。各從所主，以證虚實。金鬼不宜針剌，火鬼切忌艾傷。土不用丸，木須忌散。金爲福，西地求醫，木來生，東方用藥，水絶須當針剌，药宜金石回生；土弱欲得火炙。𡬶醫徵姓無厄。火鬼煎剂能治；水鬼丸散偏宜。噫人病百端，理無二焉。望聞問切，乃醫家之妙用；生尅制化，為術土之玄微。若能𠫭究根源，標本不離斯法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰：康泰生於和合，疾病起於刑傷。究五行衰旺之理，推百病表裡之詳，内應五臟，外屬四肢。且如木氣休囚，両鬂消疎而不髪；火臨𣦸絕，雙瞳昏暗而無光。火中隠土，少水制則心神老惚；木下藏金，無木收土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099193314377782"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腿足損傷。甲乙兊生，逢壬癸醉鄉而𣦸；丙丁坎育，遇庚辛溝港而亡。水盛木浮，多生泄痢；土重金埋，常病氣高，諸風掉眩。乙木旺而辛金衰，疼癢瘡瘍；丁火盛而癸水弱，痞塞腫滿。只因己土太𨓺，憤欝病痿；葢爲辛金不及，耳目聰明。癸水旺，寒邪拘縮。腎經虛。甲乙能傷，戊巳無救而缺唇；丙丁善尅，庚辛少制而瘖瘂。火中有土，項生瘰𤻤之灾；水中有土，腹患蠱腫之病。用神受制而被刑，亡於棒杖；上下逢鬼而無救，𣦸作懸梁。四柱重衝，多㐫而他鄉䘮體；五行衰敗，不足而瘟疫亡身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水敗腰駝，莫用軒岐之法；金刑龜背，安施","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099246049361935"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盧扁之方。庚辛氣秀，西方見木而亡於兵刃；甲乙敗絶，坤南無水而骨飛肉颺。辛巳丙申遇刑，臂虚而人。生六指：己卯戊寅逢敵，胃弱而常病瘡疽；乙未甲午逢金，人多鱉頭；癸卯己丑相刑，病生腰膝；甲申乙酉，幼年多病肝經；辛卯庚寅，晩年勞傷䈥骨。丙火上炎，丈夫毎忌於身心；丁火下濕，女人虚癆而血産。金土臨寅卯，病肺喘脾寒；戊巳值敗，火患脾因宿塊。庚辛見火相刑，女人須憂白帶；丙丁俱向離方，婦人切忌血崩。羊刃則砭肱而灸股，懸針則剌面以文身。日時衰敗，大患難瘳；干支刑害，小疾不療。氣相得而安和，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099189992652827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣相逆而灾殄。病症不離於六脉，𣦸生難越乎五行。細究興衰，萬不失一。古歌曰：戊巳生時氣不全，月時兩處見傷官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必當頭面有𧇊損，膿血之瘡苦少年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日主加臨戊巳生，支辰火局氣薰蒸。衝刑尅破當殘疾，髪秃那堪眼不明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又丙丁日干五行衰，七煞加臨三合來。升合日求衣食缺，耳聾殘疾面塵埃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸重重叠叠排，時辰設若見天財，縱然頭面無㿀癩，定主其人眼目灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又丙丁火旺疾難防，四柱休囚辰巳方。木火相生來此地，啞中風疾暗中亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日：人之生也，受氣於父，成形於母，五臟和平者無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152298721320"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疾；尅戰太過不及者主疾。内經云：東方實，西方虛，瀉南方，補北方。東方實者，木太過也；西方虛者，金不及也。瀉南方者，火太過也；补北方者，水不及也。是以五行太過不及，皆主疾也。若水升而火降，火降而金清，金清而木平，木平而土不及尅，五臟各得中和之氣，疾病何自生焉？人之四柱内外上下五行和者無疾，或相戰尅，太過不及，皆爲疾也。陰陽書：金剛火強，自刑其方，木落歸本，水流趨東，所以論三刑，刑則殘害，言太𨓺而身疾也。若只取不及爲疾，必有一偏之失。凡五行有𣦸絕而成疾者，水𣦸絕，多腎氣腰足攻注，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099183181217828"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滑泄，便溺不利之疾。火𣦸絶，主膓氣結塞，驚悸徤忘，精神不安之疾。木𣦸絶，虛風目濇眩暈筋急，爪甲枯顇，喜怒顚倒，擇飮擇食之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金𣦸絕，主氣虛，喘急咳嗽，皮毛焦燥乾嗇，骨節疼痛，涕泪大腸泄痢便血之疾。土𣦸絕，主面黄减食，隔噻吐逆，肢體怠惰，喜卧嗜睡，多思足慮，耳聾神濁，徤忘少喜，動作之疾。有相尅而成疾者，金火相尅，生旺則瘍瘡癱瘇，𣦸絶則癆瘵嘔血。土木相尅生旺，主疲悶昏眩風麻，小腸疾痛。瘇𣦸絶，主吐食癥塊，疽癖積滯之疾，或主中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099183181250596"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風。金木相尅生旺，主肢足骨節不完，眼目之疾；𣦸絶主氣虚精脫，勞瘵癱瘓之疾。水土相尅，主脾濕泄瀉中滿，痰嗽不利之疾。有相生而生疾者，火木相生，生旺則上盛隔壅，目赤頭風；𣦸絶則傷寒作狂悶亂疾。火土相生，生旺則胃實，死絶則唇焦紅，氣熱結，大便不利。金水相生，生旺則氣滯，𣦸絕則精滑。水木相生，生旺則嘔吐胃虛，𣦸絶則精敗，傷寒痁瘧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金土相生生旺，則多虛無肌肉，𣦸絕膓鳴䖝作。凡水、土木相逢於無氣之處，主蠱氣腸脹吐逆之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099189992669211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡金、水火相逢於無氣之地，主痢疾。金主大肠，水火守之，陰陽不和也。凡水逢土多，主翻胃疾。土多而無木氣疏之，主聾聵疾。葢腎水不流則爲翻，胃氣不通則爲聵也。又曰：凡論殘疾病症，先論日干，次詳月令，然後通年。時看之，傷官主殘疾，煞重亦然。乾卦在亥，亥爲天門，六辛生人，得此日，此時多主盲聾。亥屬腎，腎通耳，丙火遭水尅也。子位坎宫，傷宫，煞重相刑，主下部疾。寅宫艮土，主𦜉胃面色痿黄之疾。若戊巳生人，甲乙爲刑旺之煞。二月乙木，子卯相刑，刑剘子中卯木爲煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099232627589159"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，亦主下部疾。辰屬震，此月帶傷官，少年主多驚疾。葢震者，動也，輕則主驚脾胃疾，重則主足疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震長男子，二月水生木者亦如此。巳爲巽，傷官煞重，主婦人血氣不調勞疾。午爲離，爲目，傷官煞重，主失明頭風之症。申屬坤，爲衆陰，傷官煞重，主腰脚䈥骨之疾。傷官傷𥁞者，不在此論。酉爲兊，屬口齒不全之疾。戌爲火庫，主下血痔漏之疾。丑未傷官，亦主脾胃。傷官煞旺者，年年病瘟。主用上下戰尅，五行無救助，主身體不完，頭面殘傷。賦云：申中無氣遇寅戰，頭目偏斜。乙丙有刑遇辛傷，毎朝發禍炎。火盛水而滅，眼目多昏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152491364378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虛；土旺水而崩，肚腸蠱腫。丙中藏土，人多火眼，已到震方，定主缺唇。土受木制，乃多脾胃之灾；木被金傷，筋骨疼痛之患。水土相刑，無救助，定有失歩之虞。金火相刑爲鬼煞，多應上喘之疾。壬癸戊巳相扶，難聼音樂；丙丁壬癸相隨，乍辨青黄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時來尅日，肢體難完。水若遇刑，頭面易損。若上下鬼尅，都臨𣦸墓。土臨甲乙，死於呕吐之中；火局庚辛，絶在心氣之病。水東腎虛臨身，金北骨勞加體，木南風氣爲災。更看空亡五墓，元辰七煞，如遇𣦸絶，難保性命。又曰：凡一切諸煞，亦有主疾者。刼煞主小腸，又主耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099246049427471"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聾咽喉疾。官符主腰脚疾；咸池主酒色勞𤷈，膿血便溺疾。大耗主暗昧，或贅疣疾。飛𤎉名天瞽，支干無氣，主無目。凡禄主因食致疾，須帶煞尅身方是。凡命見眞衝氣散，或眞刑氣散，多是癈疾之人。甲辰、甲戌、乙丑乙未，土木交加，主癱痪之疾；丙申丁酉，金火交加，主血筋所傷；戊子己亥，水土交加，主脾胃之疾；庚寅辛卯，金木交加，主筋骨勞嗽之疾。癸巳壬午、丙子丁亥，水火交加，主頭面目疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神經曰：日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"被時尅莫相對，終是艱辛病禍纏。金木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099193314410550"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戰兮憂病骨，水凌火氣眼生煙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水死兮爲風癩，上多水少敗丹田。土遭木尅脾胃弱，火勝金殘血裏眠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水深金重逢水厄，遇水定敎落深淵。水少火多應受渴，火多土少語狂顚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水若深兮火若明，水滿火明壽難延。金絶切忌四肢損，土多帶火受憂煎。木若盛時應蹇塞，更須仔細辨根源。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廣信集云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命禄對衝一辰，如坐命宫，或疾厄宫，主人手足有缺，身體不完，六厄亦係，名曰互戰。辛卯日時，名曰白虎閉目，火年必損眼，其餘辛與卯字者亦忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金衰火盛，嘔血不爾，脫肛；水竭土盈，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152491397146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病癖忽然耳聵，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"沈芝云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破碎羊刃招痕疾。疾宫六害還非吉，日時累犯旺鬼凌，無氣空亡纏病卒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月陰滛泆忌相逢，陰命須憂帶下通。月水不調缘好事，男兒痔漏及腸風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月陰，月煞也，卽寅午戌在卯之例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡欲推疾病灾厄，先看禄命身三等大小運如何。若三命無氣，禄馬敗絕，但得禄財、命財旺相，亦不至𣦸。若父病，推其子命。如子命遇孤辰寡宿、喪門、吊客，及白衣煞臨命，其父必有不可救之疾。夫妻亦准此推。論貧賤㐫惡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡貧賤之命，多無貴氣，或五行𣦸絶，支干閑慢，不相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099246049443855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干涉，或禄空亡，大耗尅身，天中臨目，或五行𣦸絶，又落空亡，或一位上聚諸禄馬生旺，却天中臨之，或有他位來刑害，至於氣散。或福聚處不能獨立，被衆位分擘其福，或驛馬尅身，或劫多逢尅制，或辰戌丑未相尅，五行無氣而不激揚，位位逢合，或不合不衝，上下相異其氣。或干支錯亂，陰陽偏枯，八字無格扶持，九命有刑駁雜，或先逢生旺，繼逢𣦸絶，或化氣失時，本命無氣，或假音殃尅，主本倒亂，父子乖違。以上此等之命，俱主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤之命，常用建禄、食神爲救神，命中有此二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152491413530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"救，雖貧不至困餓，雖賤不至奴婢，一遇運發，却小小稱意，運過仍貧賤也。鬼谷遺文有刑聚敗極，甲申得丁己、巳卯、己巳之類，四柱不收；甲子得丙寅、丁巳、辛亥、壬申之類，五形未备；甲子得庚子、己卯、癸卯之類，一方前後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如木命人得己丑之類，柱得隔角，如辛丑得辛卯，甲子得甲戌之類，皆主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡㐫惡之命，乃命與五行無氣，而又相尅，或支干乖戾，刑衝互相凌戰帶煞，或真衝刑氣散，或官符大耗，刑尅本命，五行𣦸絶，全然無救，或官符尅身，兩木相刑衝，或見辰戍魁罡相衝，全無貴人、驛馬相助，或五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099246049493007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行𣦸絕，相尅處見天火、水溺、白虎、自縊等惡煞，或五行皆旺，却，位位相尅，氣散，或交互見空亡孤寡，或歲破、白虎、羊刃等煞，或見天中大耗、刼煞、亡神同宫，重叠相尅，或柱多隔角帶煞，或日時刼亡並煞尅年，或懸針、倒戈、金神、七煞、羊刃等煞，重重尅本命，或刑聚。敗極，四柱不救，或四柱相刑，更臨虛廢之地。以上此等之命，俱主㐫惡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫惡之命，常以貴人、三奇、華葢夾貴爲救神，有此雖見㐫神，不至加害。大忌五行閑慢，而無建禄、食神，三才刑尅帶煞，而無貴氣相御，則其貧賤㐫惡也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152298754088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無疑矣。論壽夭夫脩短之數，大抵生旺則壽長，𣦸絕則夭折。譬如根深者蒂固，源濬者流長，亦理之自然也。凡命月日上逢生旺，時上雖有𣦸氣不妨。如月上𣦸絕，日時上雖生旺，氣不甚雄，葢生承𣦸絶故也。月日生旺，時上死絕，壽不過四十五歲；月日𣦸絶，時上生旺，𣦸在三十歲前。更有㐫煞五行凌犯，必爲殤子。常以月管一歲，至三十歲，日管三十一歲至四十五歲，時管四十五歲，至一百歲，或生旺或𣦸絕，逐限詳之。夫人氣聚則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099189992701979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生，氣散則死。若氣遇二運，太歲會集，在𣦸絕衰息之鄕，更太岁刑尅，與灾限相應者，定𣦸各發在身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無氣月日、時上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命中有生旺多，又不犯煞，應是少疾病善終，死於一念之間。若𣦸絕多帶刑煞，重，主憔悴苦楚之灾，或久淹歲月難瘳之疾。凡旺運中𣦸，或禄上𣦸者，主稱意中卒。老人行年生旺，𣦸於苦楚。葢生旺則尫羸淹久，少者則𣦸於善疾。命中是亡神，大耗重叠，𣦸須破屍。凡天干生旺，不損尅者壽。天干敗𣦸，有救助者尤壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099246049509391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天干敗𣦸，相賊者夭。天干生旺中有破尅者尤夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命鈴云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡欲知人夀命長短，但以本年納音觀其刑尅，若生月尅命，卽多夭折。命尅生月，主壽算延長。假令癸亥水命人四月生，卽無壽，以戊癸之年四月見。丁巳納音屬土，土能尅水，是生月尅命。又癸亥人四月生，爲禄命絕處，故無壽。如癸丑木命，三月生卽有壽，以三月建丙辰，納音土木尅土，是命尅生月，設如㐫煞下生，亦爲身制煞。又癸丑人三月生，爲禄命庫墓中生，多主有壽，但三十嵗以前，常有患難。缘前有絕鄉運，後有𣦸病，歷盡衰鄉，運到旺處，故主晩福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099232627638311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉門","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"關集云：凡壽以生月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定之，生月居支干納音旺處，及五音相生不逆，日時並胎皆得數，不相刑尅者，主上壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"玉霄寳鑑云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命有天壽朝元，乃納音居𣦸絕之地，而有眞五行與納音比合，居於生旺之位是也。假如乙酉人，納音水巳敗，若得辛亥、丙申，則丙申眞水復生於申，此類主享眉壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙亥人得癸亥、戊寅之類，亦是子平。以印綬重逢者壽，八字停均者壽，六格犯増嫌者不壽。余驗人命信然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃身旺鬼絶，雖破命而長年；鬼旺身衰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099246049558543"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢建命而夭壽。就中裸形夾煞，魄散酆都，所犯有傷，魂歸岱府，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸絕依前生旺，命曰返魂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃死而復生，絕而復旺於本命。之位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丘墓坐於本命，其名絶體，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"墓處爲丘，丘處與本命同一方。又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽處傷殘，本命必逄三合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如本命金而逢己酉丑之類。壺中子云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顔回夭折，只因四大空亡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子、甲午旬命無水，甲申、甲寅。旬命無金，若只見兩重，流年大運遇一重圓之，亦是。沈芝云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建命須知壽延長。如丑人見子，子人見丑之類。如遇滋助無尅，多長壽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"李虛中云：凡命帶長生多者，定有壽，須本家納音旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152491429914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，謂之長生，見尅制則夭。凡禄馬貴人徃來在生旺之地，兼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"原本無字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸絶之氣者，雖早發亦早𣦸，然須在乘旺之地，方爲福，餘且徒然。若時得力，則晩發而壽長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽算幽玄識者稀，識時須是泄天機。六格内有憎嫌者，歲運逢之總不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽星明朗壽元長，繼母逢之不可當。寵妾不來相救助，命如衰草值秋霜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙臨申位逢陽水，定是天年未可知。透出干頭壬癸水，其人必定𣦸無疑。如乙酉壬辰，丙申癸巳果㐫夭，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"理愚歌云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知天𥮅得遐長，五行生旺最高強。旺鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099193314525238"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅身爲短命，禄財無氣亦爲殃。神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白經云：火忌申酉亥。甲申、乙酉，癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金嫌亥子丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙亥，戊子、己丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水土寅卯巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水忌戊寅、己卯、丁巳，土忌庚寅、辛卯、己巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木怕巳午申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛巳甲午。壬申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更若逢陰鬼，壽美永不停。艱辛久住世，發即禍來寻。若人逢此地，不請怨天文。謂之人過鬼門，氣度蕭关也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼限生來有所憂，欲知人死向斯求。金哥出去休騎馬，火弟歸來莫跨牛。木通鼠蛇須遠走，水逢雞子也堪愁。土人更切防猪兎，難保年光到白頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"即小儿煞。中鬼關煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099239107821618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受氣重重鬼莫臨，四柱交加豈可親。時兼本命還相遇，富貴之中壽不存。有衝夭煞：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歌日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生日對時人短命，生年對月亦堪傷。此是人間短命法，人生值此少年亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如寅年申月午日子時，又月與。時對更被時尅者，是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生日對時人促壽，時日相衝夀不長。四大空亡難保守，定知惡死路頭亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"余見時日對衝者，多尅妻傷子不短。命惡死，亦有促壽者，四柱并詳之，難以對衝斷。或云衝而不破無害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生日對年須可嘆，生時對日亦堪傷。那堪生處時同嵗，二八風流壽不長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲寅年丁酉月戊申日甲寅時，不出周嵗死，信然，對月者亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有短命煞：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猪鼠無良犬戰牛，雞聲催促夜行彪。龍羊蛇兎不相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099193314558006"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入，巳午無人到白頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此與妨害中隔宿同例。三命鈴作夭年煞，主壽不長，多遇䘮禍。若身能尅煞，則可免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有急脚煞：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙申酉見闁王，丙丁亥子切須防。庚辛巳午如風燭，戊巳寅卯亦重傷。壬癸辰戌加丑未，永别浮生入鬼鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廣信集作天鬼截路空。若甲人見申，乙人見酉，生時带着支干。皆有者，定夭。如甲人見庚申之類，太歲與大運逢之，多主孝服，更與小運并，主夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金人沐浴火木胎，土死水墓四季裁命有限逢爲再犯，阎王急脚送書來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有截命煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歌云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命歸前次一支，子生須與丑爲期。三逢必定遭㐫死，兩見須憂血漬衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若子生人見丑，各於本命前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099232627654695"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰是有推命煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歌云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命後一辰不宜見，兩重見者渉疑猜。三重在外中年夭，五百年前禍必來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若子生人見己亥，各於本命後。一辰是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有五行滿數：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歌日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行生處定陰陽，日月平分兩位當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"初六日，木生至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六日初生名甲乙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡月一至十五日為陽，十六日至三十日爲陰。初十日，滿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸水流相註，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"十六日火生，至二十日满。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁依次火爲強。定。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如己亥年九月三十日己酉丁卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從兹生死不乖張，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二十六日水生，三十日滿。時其日值水滿，年是己亥，日是己酉，其水被兩土所克，此人夭壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有陰陽二極。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歌日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽二極君知否，男女皆從本命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099193314590774"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數，男逢九位女三雙，位位相逢兼順去，大小兩運氣全無。到此須知身死處。兩運有氣則無妨，合致一年災運苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"男以本命順數至九辰，爲陽極，女以本命數至六辰爲陰極。源髄歌云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木木遇巳，金逢寅，生火生金傷本身。五行命里皆防此，遇者知非鶴髪人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上諸說，須𥁞詳之。先以五行生旺死絶，次以格局有無損坏，然後考諸神煞，而以流年太歲参之，茂不中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之壽夭，稟父母，父精毋血，盛衰不同，故人之壽亦異。其有生之初，受氣之兩盛者，當得上中之壽；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152491479066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受氣之偏盛者，當得中下之壽；受氣之兩衰者，能保養，僅得下壽，不然多夭折。雖然，又不可以常理拘泥論也。或風寒暑濕之感於外，饑飽勞役之傷乎内，豈能一一𥁞乎所禀之元氣，而終其天年也耶？知命君子，要在修身以俟之而己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論女命或問：婦人何利，利在夫星。夫利，其婦必利，夫困其婦必困。婦人從夫，先觀夫星，以定出身之貴賤，再看子星，以察晚年之榮辱。官煞財得地，夫利也；食神得地，子利也。夫利則出身富貴，一生享福；子利則晩年厚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099193314607158"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"養，褒宠誥封。然亦有旺夫者，以食生財、財生官故耳，反是則否。女命以尅我者爲夫，我生者爲子，皆要得時乘生旺之氣。若旺氣只聚於時，亦可。用官爲夫，不要見煞；用煞爲夫，不要見官，一位爲好。有兩位官星，無煞以杂之，四柱純煞無官以混之，俱爲良婦。更得本身自旺尤佳。但旺不可太過，食爲子息引歸。時逢旺，再得二德扶身，乃夫貴子榮之命，不宜身旺重叠。暗藏夫神，及傷官七煞，魁罡相刑，羊刃太重，合多有情，皆主不美。岁運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看有八法，八格須細詳之。純","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099246049591311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純者，一也。如純一官星，或純一煞星，有財有印，不值刑衝，不相混雜是也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳、戊午、辛酉丙申，本身專禄，旺不從化，辛用丙官爲夫星，五月火旺夫健，丙用癸爲官，坐貴，見戊爲食，同歸禄於巳。辛金生壬水爲子，引入申時長生之地，天干癸戊辛丙，水火既濟，地支巳午酉申，拱夾財庫，所以嫁夫爲官，而食天禄，夫榮子貴之命。又癸亥、甲寅、丙戊甲午，丙用癸爲夫，臨官在亥，甲爲印，坐寅建禄，自身坐庫，己土爲子，歸禄於午，居時子息之位，甲木爲己土之官，四柱純一不雜，故主子貴蔭。餘倣此推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099246049607695"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和。和者，恬静也。如身柔弱，獨有一位夫星，柱無衝破攻擊之神，禀其中和之氣，則爲和也。如一命壬辰、辛亥、己卯己巳，巳用甲爲夫，亥乃長生之地，得天時地利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲以辛爲官，金生於己，巳以金爲子，亦生於巳，謂之夫得官星，子得長生，故主益夫旺子。雖自坐卯支爲煞，有巳中庚制，爲去煞留官之論，女命之貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑壬寅、丁酉巳𮠕，丁用壬爲夫，甲爲印，乃夫之食禄。丁酉日貴，生己酉之子，壬水得己土爲官，主夫貴；己土得甲為官，主子貴。酉中財旺，榮夫蔭子之造。餘仿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099189992734747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此。推清清者，洁浄之稱。女命或一官一煞，不相混雜，謂之清要。夫星得時，柱有財生，官有印助，身无一㸃混濁之氣，方為清貴。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一命巳未壬申，乙未甲申。乙以𢈏爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫庚禄到申，以丁爲子，丁旺於未，以壬為印，壬生扵申，又坐下支神爲乙木之財，財旺則能生官，四柱無刑衝破敗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印綬三般物，女命逢之必旺夫，故爲夫人之命。又甲寅、癸酉、丙寅戊子，丙用癸爲夫，坐酉自生，癸得戊爲官，癸禄居子，夫得禄者貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099246049624079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得戊土爲子，坐財逢煞印，主子貴。餘倣此推貴貴者，尊榮之號，命中有官星，得財氣以相資，三竒得其宗，四桂不值鬼病，乃女命尭舜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無煞女人之命，一貴可作良人。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命無煞，逢二徳，可两國之封。二德者，非獨天月二德，即財為一德，官為一徳，加之印食，愈爲貴也。如一命甲午、丙寅、丁未壬寅，丁以壬爲官，壬食甲爲印，壬用丙爲財，壬以亥爲禄，得一寅暗合，雖夫星失時，喜行西北夫旺之運，故主大貴。又乙亥、丙戌、辛卯癸巳，辛用乙爲財，旺於亥，丙爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099193314623542"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫星，坐庫，歸禄巳上，癸水爲夫之官，辛金生癸爲子，坐巳上，與夫禄同位，又是貴神，又爲財官雙美，乃得夫子俱貴，兩遇褒封。餘倣此推濁濁者，混也，乃五行失位，水土互傷，其身太旺，正夫不显，偏夫丛杂，柱多分别，無財官印食，為下賤村濁，或娼妓婢妾淫巧之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一命己亥、乙亥、癸丑、己未，癸水生，十月大泛，癸以戊爲夫，不顯時引己未，是偏夫，嫌丑未皆有土混雜，柱中無財，乙木爲食神，干旺，己土受尅，鬼敗臨身，五行失位，主先清後濁，不能享福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152491495450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又癸未、甲寅、辛酉、乙未、辛酉，八专自旺，用丙火爲夫，長生為寅，夫旺本好。但辛贪乙未，庫中財惹起，未中丁火爲暗夫，兩庫暗夫重过眀夫，明暗交集，雖有正夫，未免暗中偷夫得財，乃濁亂之象。餘倣此推。濫，濫者，婪也。謂柱中明有夫多，暗中財旺，干支又多帶煞，必因酒色私暗得財。此等之命，或爲奴婢，或尅夫再嫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅、丙戌、庚申、丁亥、庚申，八專自旺，丙火為夫，寅戌㑹局，時干又丁，愛重火情，庚申金暗尅寅亥木爲財，亥中壬水爲食生財，其人雖美貌有福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152302506036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不免濫而得財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子甲寅、巳未、丁卯正月，甲木旺卯未㑹局，偏正夫多，子上又有旺財，己合甲官，陰陽匹配，故雖聰明秀麗，不免失之於濫。况倒插桃花，上坐娣妹，不是官星，豈爲良婦？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又己酉、丁丑，癸丑、壬戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中明有已夫，二丑一戌，三夫暗藏。丁爲財，歸庫於戌，與丑相刑，二陽得令，火亦進氣，是夫多財旺。丁壬太过，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又甲辰、癸酉、丙子、辛卯、丙子日，犯陰陽煞，主男。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子挑誘。丙以癸爲夫，辰子会水，夫多日時，丙辛合子卯，刑支刑干合犯，荒淫滚浪，酒色昏迷。酉中財旺，癸夫專坐，二命俱妓，賣奸得財，餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099189992800283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"娼娼者，妓也，乃身旺夫絕，官衰食盛，或柱中不見官煞，或有而傷官傷𥁞，或官煞混雜而食神盛旺，此必娼妓之命，否則爲師尼婢妾，尅夫淫奔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命丁亥庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌戊辰、庚申，戊以甲爲夫，九月失時無氣，又被庚尅絶，時引入申，以庚爲食，建禄在申，戊辰魁罡生申太旺，亥中壬財亦旺，謂之身旺逢生，貪食貪財，夫絶而爲秀麗娼也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又乙亥、丙戊、甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子丙寅甲以庚辛爲夫，九月金衰氣退，時引食神長生，木地會局，甲木歸禄，身旺，庚金引至寅地，絕而無氣。二丙食神太旺，傷其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099239107788850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金夫，謂之自旺食盛，衣食雖好，不免風尘娼妓。又癸丑、庚申、戊辰庚申，戊用乙，夫絶在申戍日，得庚申為食神，月時重見，謂之食旺夫絶，故主爲娼。凡陽十女命，食神多者爲娼，隂干女命，食神多者爲妓，餘倣此。推淫，淫者，沃也，乃本身得地，夫星明暗交集，謂日干自旺，柱中皆官煞是也。在干者爲明，在支者爲暗，四柱太过，如一丁見三壬及辰子多之例，謂之交集，於人無所不納也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊辰、壬辰、壬戍、癸亥、丙辰、癸亥，本自得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099232627703847"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，明有戊土爲正夫，暗有辰戍爲偏夫。又庚戍、戊子、乙酉、甲申，乙以庚爲明夫，而身坐酉支，時又引身爲暗夫，運行西方金旺之地。二命俱夫星，明暗交集，淫不可言。又癸亥、壬子、丁丑、壬寅，丁火純於衆水之中，明暗夫多，淫乱無耻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁遇壬而太遇，必犯淫訛之乱是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又癸卯甲子、己卯乙亥，已用甲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲夫甲敗在子卯爲暗夫，坐於支下，又亥卯多明暗交集，正夫不能主張禁制，暗夫得势而入，正夫反回避也。餘倣此。推旺夫傷子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099246049656847"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫女人有旺夫傷子者何？此法皆時上推之，時爲歸宿之地，夫子二星，引歸於時，夫星生旺，子星衰敗是也。如一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命丙戌丙申、丁巳、辛亥。丁坐已自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺以壬水爲天，時上乃是夫星臨官之地，月支申金，乃夫星長生之地，以辛金爲財，七月金旺，二丙相比，皆坐夫之財印，故主夫聰秀富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁以戊爲子息之垣，引至時工見亥，亥中甲木能尅戊土，乃子星被尅而難得也，故主旺夫傷子。餘倣此。推旺子傷夫有旺子伤夫者何？此法專以月時推之，謂尅我者爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152302522420"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官爲夫，有氣得時，則夫發福。若支干失位，不得月氣，柱中又逢衝尅，時上又無旺氣，而巳生之子引至時上，逢長生臨官帝旺之地，又無刑尅，是旺子傷夫也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一命巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯甲戌、乙卯、戊寅，乙用庚爲夫，九月庚金。無氣乙用丙爲子，丙火長生於寅，與戌會局，皆屬火，月令既無金氣，時引絕地，又被火尅，是傷其夫星，旺其子息，故曰旺子傷夫。餘倣此推。傷夫尅子傷夫尅子者，乃夫星干支失位，生月失時，柱中又逢衝尅，時支亦不生扶，兼且印綬重逢，盗夫之氣，尅子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099193314656310"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之甚，夫子不能旺，反絶於時是也。如一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命丙子、庚子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥丙子，乙木以庚金爲夫星，十一月金寒水冷，又金死子地，支亥子水盗金氣𥁞，柱無土生助，傷官太多，故傷其夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木以丙火爲子，引至子時，乃水旺火滅之地，雖年時干二火，被羣水相尅，夫子皆亡，故曰傷夫尅子。餘倣此推。安静守分安静守分者，乃夫星有氣，日干自旺，相停無尅，不值刑衝，財食得所者是也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳庚申乙卯丁亥，乙坐卯，専祿自旺，又得時支亥字合局，是本身旺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099232627736615"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以庚金爲夫，七月庚禄到申，又得年支巳火爲金長生之地，是夫星旺也。亥中壬水，夫之食神天厨，故主夫食天禄。此乃自己夫星，兩不相傷，各乘旺氣，無混雜相侵，夫婦偕和，安靜守分格也。横夭少年夫横夭少年者，造化之窮絕，格局之變異也。有懸梁溺水，血産少亡，被人殺死若此者何？乃身弱而遇煞重，煞多尅身，又帶刑衝破敗之類。或命中元有官星受傷，行運復遇官鄉，或無官見傷，運復臨官之類，或帶刃無制，運行合刃之地，及亡神刼煞等類，此皆横","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099232627818535"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭類也，不獨女命有之，男命亦同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命。丁卯癸丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰丙子，庚用丁爲官，被癸水子辰傷官叠遇，尅之太重，水多金沉，一交丁巳運，傷官見官，又㑹丙煞尅。身故有溺水之害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又乙酉、戊子、丙寅、己亥日干丙火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生於寅，冬生亥子，官煞太重，謂之旺火，投於盛水，故生産而亡。又壬子癸卯、甲戌丁卯月令，羊刃時，丁卯傷官，羊刃，子刑戌合，柱中又無夫星、財星，癸酉年乙丑月己卯日，犯姦殺死。凡女命官煞太重，羊刃無情，非淫濫則㐫亡。餘倣此。推福壽兩僃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099232627785767"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫福壽兩僃者，造化之中和，格局之純粹也。有享用一生，永錫難老，若此者何？乃身坐旺鄉，通於月氣，支干相輔，更帶財官印綬，各得其位，不行脫財坏印傷官之局，尤喜食神天厨。若身旺而運行財食之鄉，此皆福壽兩僃之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午、庚子、辛酉癸巳，辛坐酉支，專禄自旺，時癸歸禄於子，爲食神壽星，子星得地。辛用丙火爲官，丙禄歸於巳，爲夫星得地。又十一月生人，乃金白水清之象，兼支干上下相輔，俱無傷損，身不從化，故主爲人美貌端正，夫子相停，福壽兩僃也。餘倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099232627802151"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正偏自處大正偏自處者何也？乃夫婦相合，復遇比肩分争。如一位夫星，有兩位妻星相合，謂之争合。若本身自旺，彼身値衰，四柱不衝，則我正而彼爲偏。若彼旺我衰，四柱衝我，則彼正而我爲偏矣。葢我身旺有氣，則夫從我爲正；我身衰而别位旺，則夫從别位，我反爲偏。謂之彼旺争去我夫，我只得爲偏。或自旺太过，柱無夫星者，亦爲偏。或官煞混雜，或傷官太重，亦爲偏。更淫濫。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子丙午、辛酉辛卯，辛用丙爲夫星，身坐酉支，専禄自旺，雖時引辛卯之金，彼却無力，故我","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099283340951586"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲正而彼爲偏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲二女争夫，正偏自處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又癸未，壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌癸巳壬子癸用土爲夫，癸巳水弱，壬子水旺，弱不能勝旺，被壬水争去。戊土正夫，乃彼勝我衰，我只得爲偏。但壬水重而太泛，又帶桃花，不能自處。餘倣此。推招嫁不定夫招嫁不定者，何也？乃月令中有夫星透干，與己相合，己身從伏，其夫星却無氣，時引夫星，或煞星却乗旺地，來尅己身，又從伏偏夫，故謂之招嫁不定。若夫星不旺，或受尅制，必嫁夫遲，或嫁夫不明，或夫不濟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099193314672694"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事，或有外情。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉甲子，巳未乙亥，已用甲爲夫，生於十一月，失時不旺，時逢亥字，乃用木長生，是夫旺也，却不合，又被乙木制。巳未未爲乙木庫地，甲生子月，夫坐敗地，不顯時上乙亥，亥中又有長生之甲，欲甲而又招乙也，此爲招嫁不定。餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰：凡觀陰命，先推夫子興衰；欲究榮枯，次辨日時輕重。官爲夫，財爲父，財旺夫榮；食爲子，印爲母，印盛子衰。日干不宜太旺，月氣务禀中和。日主旺相，奪夫權而孤苦；月令休囚，安本分而持家。官星得地，夫主榮華；傷官無尅，子當貴顯。有官而不可見煞，有煞而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099239107838002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可逢官。設使官煞混雜，爲人安得禎祥。官星無尅，值二德可兩國之封；七煞有制，遇三奇爲一品之貴。喜食神而制煞生財，惡傷官而尅夫盗氣。貪財坏印，豈是良人；用煞逢官，非爲節婦。孤貧下賤，盖因子𣦸休囚，富貴峥嶸；只爲夫興子旺，官太旺，公壽難延；財重叠，婆年早䘮。身居旺地，雖富足，夫子刑傷；日值衰鄉，縱貧寒夫子完聚。自旺而巧於婦業，日衰而拙於。女工貴神一位，不富即榮；合神數重，非尼即妓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人乘驛馬，决主風塵之美妓；官星帶桃花，定爲深院之良人。食神獨者，安和而有子有壽；合貴重者，嬌媚而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099283340967970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多賤多情。桃花不宜倒插，沐浴最忌裸形，犯之者多爲侍婢，值之者定作師尼。四仲全，乃酒色荒淫之女；四孟僃，乃聰明生𤼵之人。未丑刑而不忌，戌辰衝處非良。大抵夫星要值徤旺，己身須禀中和，食神不可刑傷，子星要臨生地，印綬生身一位則可；財神發福，多見無傷。財強身弱，不能發福；身強財弱，安得爲良。傷官叠遇，尅夫星而再嫁之人；印綬重逢，不死别即生離之婦。刑衝羊刃，惡狠無知；破害金神，血光產難。四柱無夫，不偏房，定爲續室；八字空亡，非寡鵠，决是孤鸞。大槩貴賤觀其夫位，榮枯究其財官，此爲天依","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152491528218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乎地，地附乎天，故貴者隨夫而貴，貧者隨夫而貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前八法以泄其玄機，後八格仍明其奥旨。倘有缺誤矣，知者擇焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾道成男，坤道成女，陰陽剛柔，各有其體，故女命以柔爲本，以剛爲刑，以清爲奇，以濁爲賤。故三奇得命，良人萬里封侯；三德歸垣，貴子，九秋步月。一官一貴，烏雲兩𩯭擁金冠；四煞四空，皓月滿懷啼玉筯。官行官運，鏡破釵分；財入財鄉，夫榮子喪，衣錦藏珍。官星有氣，堆金積玉，財庫無傷。大抵官多不榮，財多不富。用正印而逢梟，蘭階夜冷；用梟神而遇印，玉树","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152302653492"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春榮。金清水冷，日鎻鸞臺；土燥火炎，夜寒鴛帳。羣陰羣陽，清燈自守，重官重印，縁𩯭孤眠，田園廣置食神。得位不逢官，粟帛盈餘印綬；失時還遇煞，傷官不見官星，猶爲貞潔；無食多逢印綬，反作刑傷。窮梟見食，坐産花枯；惡煞混官，臨春葉落；遠合勾情，背夫尋主，衝官破食，棄子從人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財衰印絕，幼出娘門；身旺印強，早刑夫主。五煞簮花，日夜迎賔送客；三刑带鬼，始終尅子傷夫。楊妃貌美，禄傍桃花；謝女才高，身乗詞舘。華葢臨官，情通僧道；孤神坐印，身受尼姑，胞胎常墮；食旺身衰，鸞鵠頻分。官輕比重，娣妹剛強，乃作填房","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152302620724"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之婦；財官死絕，當招過繼之兒。官臨財地必榮夫，身入財鄉須尅子。煞梟破禄連根，墮冰肌於水火；比刃遭刑喪局，掩玉骨於塵沙。交馳逢驛馬，母氏荒凉；差錯對孤神，夫家零落。五馬六財，窮敗比肩之地；八官七煞，分離刑害之鄉。刑空官煞，幾臨嫁而罷濃粧；衝尅印財，縱得家，難成厚福；不若藏財不露，明煞無傷，重印行財，多財遇印，四敗匪佳人之有幸；四衝豈良婦而無嫌。水聚旺鄉，花街之女；金成秀麗，桃洞之仙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四生馳四馬，背井離鄉；三合帶三刑，傷夫敗業；暗煞逢刑，藁砧不善；眀官誇馬，夫主増榮，黄金滿盈；一財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099283340984354"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得所，紅顔失配，兩貴無家。先比後財，自貧至富。衝宫合食，靠子刑夫。𣦸絶胞胎，花枯寂寂；長生根本，瓜瓞綿綿。合貴合財，珠盈金屋；破財破印，衾冷蘭房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吕后名馳天下，只縁陰併陽剛，緑珠身墮樓前。葢是梟衝煞位，秋水通源，剔眸立節；冬金坐局，断臂流芳。娣妹同宫，未適而先抱恨；命財有氣，配夫到老無憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"通明賦云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人之命，一貴爲良，食重孤孀，貴多淫賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴指官煞言。食傷官煞，孤尅之星也。官煞叠見，淫乱之象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二德真貴，封贈可知；三奇眞良，國號自至。金木有堅心之淑德，水火生亂性之虛花。五行偏喜休囚，四柱不宜生旺，富貴貧寒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152302637108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全凭夫子；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二德即天月德也。女命得之，更有財官，純粹不雜，必受封赠。三奇，甲、戊、庚之類財官。印食亦爲三奇女，命中有此，必受國號。德者，純一不雜之謂。金木性純，本爲女人之所守。水流主淫，火炎。主暴。水火多則亂性，爲人虛花，不純而暴惡矣。陰主柔，陽主剛。女，陰也，與男相反，故喜休囚而忌生旺。継善篇云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人無煞，一貴可作良人；貴衆合多，必是師尼。娼婢。傷官尅則食絶孤苦；夫徤旺則子秀身榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"玉振賦云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰命印重，本絕嗣，運行官煞反吉；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫旺子生，此理。之常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女犯傷官，須尅配，運入財旺亦佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷生財，財生官，所謂能使無情。更有情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棄命就煞，必配名家。專禄食神，斷受誥命。孤鸞最利於七煞，桃花喜帶乎官星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此四格皆主富貴，益夫旺子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴太多，非偏房即爲舞妓；会合過盛，不媒妁則是尼姑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099239107870770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"女命雖不嫌官貴，多則不吉。天干地支三合、六合帶得多者，必爲此等之人。葢媒妁聮二姓以成親。尼姑受萬人之施捨，参之人事，章章明矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木坐申，透庚金，子都西子；丙火坐申，時壬水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大喬小喬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言此二日專用煞，苟無混雜，其女必有傾國傾城之色矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦云：庚寅戊寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或云戊申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱遇破敗猶得；己卯癸未，休敎紅艳相侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此四日俱自坐長生臨官之夫，如庚得寅，戊得申，乃上人之妻；已得乙、癸得巳，亦不。失爲佳婦。但五陰日不宜紅艳、桃花二煞，五陽遇之，縱爲不堪，亦可養身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官臨墓絕之地，老困嬌娘；夫居雜氣之中，最宜佳婦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚用丁爲夫，十一月生辛用。丙爲夫，八月生，雖名爲夫，實則不時，縱有貌，必然受困，所謂紅顔多薄命是也。如癸日生於未月，襍氣之中有丁乙巳，夫星，子息財帛全，雖居襍見之不忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官得令而逢傷，反作奴婢；煞當權而有制，當爲正室。日刃逢煞，不偏則尼；月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099251317424155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷叠刃，非奴則婢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日刃逢煞，如壬子日戊申時之例；月傷叠刃，如丁卯月、甲辰日之例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官奪夫之柄，化煞助夫之資。桃花喜共官星，紅艶休同煞伴，寒衾少怨，命值孤鸞，獨枕早孀；日臨寡鵠，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中絶無官煞，值此日爲忌。如有官煞等項倚靠，雖犯孤鸞，陰陽差錯，等日反吉，寡鵠即孤鸞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤鸞若遇夫星，必多子女；天德如逢煞化，定盛婢奴。一片比肩，官地争夫，擬定渾身泄氣；印星望嗣堪求。旺夫傷子，乃官令而梟強；旺子傷夫，因食時而官絕。印重盈盤，遇富夫而多得子；食清值令，得壯妹，必許夫榮；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"富夫乃官星帶財之論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印重官輕奪大權，鳯舞鸞飛坑婢命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孤鸞日乃旺毒之辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天月二德無他，乱衣錦冠。金。羊刃七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099152302686260"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞無善，降身塵髪垢。一逢陰煞，非守志必也無儿；兩透陽傷，且添身而不尅婿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五陰日見五陰煞，爲㐫𣆄傷官得印重，反榮身而不尅婿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日刃同刃，最忌生産；食神反破，難與留胎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日刃同刃是逢。衝也。如丙午庚子、壬子、癸卯，是年刃與曰刃相冲，食神犯破，是逄梟也。如丙申庚子、戊戌、丙辰，月干庚食。被時丙尅之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官臨死绝知夫喪，梟遇驱除斷子來。何知夫得貴，■■子得官，食附官而可知，官即食而可見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如巳未曰辛亥時，甲與己合，辛附甲官，食神健旺，子貴，逢破則子不肖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先後興衰，倚夫星之好恶；如■盛替，察子運之榮枯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如一命戊日生，春甲寅時，偏官。乃戊之■■□，不見財星，行至東方，又無金制，其木，其□無名無願。父到午運，夫星正值食得所，却是甲木衰地，故克之。再嫁。末申二運，财吊馳至大發，運至□□□年，□胎□壽。戊上丙火，至此俱𣦸，七煞見伤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099289330417703"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官田无倚而亡。○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壶中子云：登明足艶，太乙多淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥爲入夜之時，巳爲迎夜之候，女命而得，亥多者有姿，巳多者好色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛則妖妍，水澄則清潔；金冬□□□致剛強，土則富厚，負天月二德，則霞帔金冠，得禄命身三財，則夫榮子貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"岁干所尅者禄財，岁支所尅者。命財纳音所尅者身財，其三財所屬之五行，在命中一財不之而得之全者，夫必榮，子必貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切嫌者陰刃妨家，尊親最忌者純陰不宜子息，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdLi
