絶房煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"百忌暦云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以十二支辰月上呼，男害妻兒父母，女傷夫主公姑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子位者，以妻所生者爲之。假如木命人以土爲妻，土生金爲子。陰命以所生者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099289330581543"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲子。如木命人以火爲子。如子位在旺相之鄉，主有聰明忠孝之子，光顯祖宗，反之則否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知子之性情，各以五行推之。木命人以金爲子，主其子性懐亷正，剛烈自用。火以水爲子，性謙和恬淡，扶高接下。土以木爲子，性慈忠孝，柔順謙和，宜少不宜老。金以火爲子，性多貪濫，中心虚妄，逐利勝己，有始無終。水以士爲子，性緩慢，凝重耿介，老而有福。五行各在有氣之鄉，當以是論。若在休墓之地，反是男命。四柱内無鬼，各曰局中無子，却看生時在何地。如木命以金爲子，若局中無子，而得申酉巳時者，必有子，名曰子承旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099307903025167"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣。若金𣦸於子，絕於寅，則無子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡以時之納音推子之数，水一、火二，木三、金四、土五，有氣承旺，則倍數言之；無氣背時，則减數言之。有不依數者，在五十後，禍福方定。若男命犯局中無子，又時不在鬼生旺之鄉，却支干與年合者，但只生女得成，生子不育。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古詩云：哭子帶刑𣦸位傍，子多復是少年亡，忽若干支並。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"德合，只宜養女得成雙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未癸亥、丙辰、戊子。是局中無子，又在官鬼𣦸絶地，却癸與戊合，故生女多子皆不成。若見甲子，則主有子，以日干論。丙辰以癸爲子，引𡚖時上建録臨官之地，主多子，然却無子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099419848736803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以納音取年上論，亦准。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未甲子、辛卯、癸巳，是局中有子，在死地，喜時引官鬼長生之地，故生數子而少女。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又一命庚辰壬午，戊寅辛酉，白虎臨庭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五十六不禄，兒女俱無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尺壁云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命犯亥字多得兒，巳字多得女，時帶年衝刑破害、刃刼、元辰俱尅子，時帶年空亡，重者絕子。自刃、飛刃尅子，時坐華葢，尅子，五十後如見不牢，時帶自刑，子多疾病，六厄，子多厄，浮沉煞𣦸瀉痢，時坐本音墓，主有壽無子送老，但有孫息，坐日破空亡、刑衝食刃，皆主尅頭子，納音帶絶氣，又時在絶鄉，如癸巳、壬寅、庚申、乙亥、丁巳等時是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099343499935795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。假令庚申得壬寅時，定主絶嗣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命見申日亥時、己日寅時，互換見者，名曰狡害煞，主絶嗣，須庶出過房。佳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古詩云：五行狡害最不良，夫婦孤单獨守房。𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去墳前無子哭，求他異姓却相當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼谷遺文云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人生時見禄馬徃來朝命，不犯孤寡，亦有子孫。時干尅年干及倒食年干者，主生男不順。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行要論云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大小二運與岁命三合六合者，主有孕，生男女之慶。陽多生男，陰多生女。若純陽則極而反陰生女，純陰則極而反陽生男。假如甲子命屬陽，大小運臨辰位，或申位三合外夾辛巳太歲屬陰，則是陽多生男。餘准","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099394309685274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定婦人孕生男女訣日：父母歲數兩頭安，受胎之月中心取。乾坎艮震爲男兒，巽離坤兑總屬女。假父母年𩀱爲拆受胎月只爲单成次卦定男父母年隻爲单受胎月雙爲拆成離卦定女父年上母年下，胎月中。餘佳此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又一法","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以大衍之数推之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"訣曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七七四十九。問娘何月有？除却母生年，单奇雙是偶。奇偶若不常，壽命不長久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099394309898266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌日辛未時，先刑後八，寅卯酉丑年月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977492530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子申年","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977508914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月，位至六卿。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977508914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己巳進士。己亥，黄鳯翔榜眼，宗伯。乙亥、丁丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己亥，余懋學侍郎。己巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"臨宫開庫局，因得貴人𦔳。遇險免危灾，富貴莫疑猜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時逄辛未是財官，平歩青雲路不難。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977525298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好比退毛雞化鳯，得時飛上彩雲端。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977541682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲曰：時逄辛未，干官守庫相扶，貴人財禄是良圖，初","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977558066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苦末終榮富。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977558066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子遷官進職，常人豐厚充餘。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977574450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑衝破","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977590834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害，柱中無定，有青雲之路。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977590834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099448567136310"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲日申時㫁","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977607218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲生時遇壬申，明傷暗鬼坐其身，","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977607218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱無丙戊秋冬旺，坎下飄流無定人。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977607218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日壬申時，甲木絕在申，申上壬水長生，庚金建禄，","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977623602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明梟暗鬼，甲旺化鬼爲官，猶不免㐫暴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977623602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生秋庚","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977639986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，生冬壬旺，柱無丙戊制伏，漂流之象。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977639986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若巳午月","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977656370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉強横，透庚作煞論，運行北方貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977656370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子日壬申時，申子辰亥月，水泛木漂，移根換葉，玉","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977672754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堂金馬之貴，水土運㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977672754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚申，憲則壬寅，小貴。乙卯，都督。戊寅，戊申，丙戊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099394309914650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅日壬申時，旺中有失，辰戌丑未月，勾陳得位，寅","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977689138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午戌月偏官有制，秋月行東南運俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977689138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁巳，謝源明尚書。己酉丁酉，尚書。庚午，丞相。己酉。辛巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙午進士。己亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰日壬申時，寅辰年月，文章顯貴，透丙戊尤美。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977705522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙酉，丞相癸末，王廷左都。己巳，通判。丙子。癸亥壬申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥，孫承宗探花，督師。甲戌，舉人。甲寅，閣部。戊辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午日壬申時，申子辰月，攺姓更宗，敦厚之命，午月","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977721906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，一云高。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977721906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙卯，光禄。戊戌。府判。甲辰，舉人。壬申，丞相。壬午。卿。甲寅戊辰。丙午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099403499651124"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申日壬申時，寅月身煞兩停，卯月以刃合煞，俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977738290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子辰年月以煞化印，巳午火月，七煞有制，俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977754674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977771058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怕煞旺身弱，大㐫，","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977771058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離鄉發福","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977771058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚申，進士。己丑，評事。乙巳，平章。庚午戊子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丞丁。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977771058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑戊寅，辛巳相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁酉貴，庚寅富。庚申盗。丁亥癸卯殺。庚辰、田申。壬子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛巳，𭦌櫻尚書。庚子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌日壬申時，辰戌丑未月，衣錦有成，亥月學堂，寅","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977787442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建禄俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977787442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午酉月壽促，不然貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977803826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬申，丞相己巳，同知遣戌己辛丑亥。戊辰，大。甲戌，貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夢中得禄局，更有刑空尅。覺後没思量，平生心事忙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099347786465291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日時逢喜遇申，偏官偏印怕刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977820210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲求名利終難定，有救須敎運氣通。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977836594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日癸酉時，胎生元命，甲木酉上受胎，爲甲生氣，明","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977902130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸爲印，暗辛爲官，有己土破印不貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977902130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉爲金神，若","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977918514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099403499536436"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱有寅戌通火氣者，德性純厚而貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977918514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無火見水，𠒋","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977934898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暴殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977934898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子日癸酉時，春生木旺，酉月官純貴，若混之以煞，","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977951282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或煞多，柱中全無火氣，㐫，","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977951282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先破祖，後大富。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977951282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午主事，辛巳貴。甲申，賊刑。辛巳通政，甲子夭。丙申、壬申、庚子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅日癸酉時，春生壽，夏反覆，秋性不定，多㐫，冬平","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977967666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常，丑未月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325271977967666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲戌，憲副。壬申，尚書。癸亥，内官。辛未。癸丑。辛酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚申㐫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868267843595/1-c40a80e6d8e6913b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=FSvIhJCpCu6vIgoWNx0%2FyG4rNIM%3D","uri":"read/HY0741/18/ref/1ko7tci7o1gxs/1-c40a80e6d8e6913b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"⺊夕人","variants":"死","charPicId":"7456690868267843595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官煞兩旺。戊辰，龔三益解元，乙酉進十。柱無火制，壬戌翰林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日時臨丙子，傷官傷盡榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149458994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未月不尋常，運","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149475378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至身健，旺相辛庚不見發福，午衝丑絆平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149475378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逄刑","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149491762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅空一痬，此命或衰或旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149491762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙日丑時斷","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149508146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以下六乙日所忌月分，與上同時，亦併論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙日生時丁丑，食神相助遇財官，","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149508146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月通金氣化爲福，不是尋常下賤看。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149508146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日丁丑時，食㑹財官，丁爲食，庚爲官，己爲財，丑中","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149524530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有辛金合局，己土得位，如有倚托者，貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149524530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通金氣月","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149540914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化者，富𫝗尊重，不通月氣平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149540914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099454380523529"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑日丁丑時，秋生有權，主𭘧疾，夏吉冬平，春旺貴","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149557298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149557298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸丑，蕭注兩制。庚午，李胤吕觧元。乙丑丙戌，翰林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申，舉人。甲子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯日丁丑時，亥月身旺，見辛偏官，柱有丁制，風憲","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149573682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武職。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149573682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁巳，進士。乙未，憲副。甲辰癸未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳日丁丑時，生亥卯未寅月，貴，通金氣，月有倚托","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149590066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，福重。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149590066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申，布政庚寅，逰撃。倭殺。戊辰，大貴。丙寅。戊子，無子。辛酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099347786498059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申舉人。甲寅，顧秉謙大學士。丙午武狀。乙亥、庚午，辛卯元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未日丁丑時，辰戌丑未月富，春壽長，秋名利，夏貧","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149606450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下，冬平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149606450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申年月，武職三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149622834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁酉，僉憲。乙丑，主事。辛未，進士。戊申、戊寅夭。己亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉日丁丑時，若通木氣，有倚托者，顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149639218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申丑年月","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149655602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦好，寅亥尤佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272149655602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙寅，尚書。甲申，尚書。庚寅。乙亥。壬子，王昺侍郞。戊申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊寅，御史戊辰，太守。甲寅，沈自邠翰林。己未。乙卯。己巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛巳，㑹魁。丁丑，御史。丙寅，黄光升尚書。戊戌，乙巳。庚寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申，都督。甲午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未日甲申時，生未酉亥月，聰俊特逹，官至二三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272739905582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁寅午卯酉年月，傷食制煞，權貴","logicSentenceId":"7577325272739921966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺中，有","logicSentenceId":"7577325272739921966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失終旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577325272739921966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己巳，茅瓉狀元。癸酉，侍郎一恩廕，命同甲子侍郞。辛未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙未黄應鵬甲午己卯縣尹。甲辰都憲，舉人。癸未壬申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己酉進士。癸丑舉人。庚申元戎。甲戌壬申甲寅觧。壬午甲辰元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子日丁酉時，春𥡷夏貴，秋平冬吉，未申酉亥年月","logicSentenceId":"7577325273206849545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273206849545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有辰㑹子，有丑㑹酉，俱以貴論。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273206865929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2286","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辰，邵寶侍郎癸丑進士。庚辰進士。乙酉，名臣。癸亥、丁亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申，元戎。戊戌，郞中。壬辰，元戎，丁丑進士。庚寅、丙辰、癸卯、己酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅日丁酉時，卯亥未年月，干透官煞者貴，餘月有","logicSentenceId":"7577325273206882313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藝平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273206882313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙戌，李冲奎給事。癸卯，平章。辛丑庚申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申日丁酉時，通木水氣，月行水木運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273206964233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳午身旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577325273206980617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子官旺，年月兩全者，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273206980617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2305","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙巳，王一葵狀元。庚戌進士。丁丑戊元。子己卯、丁未。戎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2306","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己巳，畢自嚴尚書。乙亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯日癸卯時，寅卯月生，印綬帶煞，不爲㐫論，行官","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612615707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612615707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2669","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛丑，楊白泉髙書。癸巳庚戌，蕭良有㑹元，榜眼。丁亥，𥙊酒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2670","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己巳，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2671","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690865995284499/1-4b8e40e06593b50d.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=mYQC4DIo440QMbgT5k4TUhARchc%3D","uri":"read/HY0945/11/ref/1kohp15pghczw/1-4b8e40e06593b50d.webp","fontType":1,"components":"厶大丶𰛅","variants":"參","charPicId":"7456690865995284499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2672","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙未。太守辛巳，舉人。癸酉，戊寅，庚寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2673","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己酉一，庚午科，推官，歙人。辛未一，丙子科，學正，閩人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2674","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申，江鐸都憲。丙辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳日癸卯時，丑月生北方運，土厚地方吉，水秀之","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612632091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，二三品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612632091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉用財亦𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612648475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2678","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099554008039476"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2679","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙巳，郞中。丙戌，貴戚。戊戌，丞相。乙酉，御醫。甲申、甲午、癸亥、辛巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2680","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁酉進士。丙午，舉革巨富。癸丑丙申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未日癸卯時，偏官生印，春吉夏平，秋富冬貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612664859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或云：","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612681243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火不怕水，冬生亥子，煞重身柔，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612681243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未行東","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612697627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612697627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2686","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁亥丞相丙戊進士。丙申，韓紹方伯子敬。壬子辛卯、乙未㑹狀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2687","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁酉唐龍尚書。子汝楫，庚寅進士。丁未狀元。戊寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉日癸卯時，日時俱坐貴最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612714011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏身旺，化鬼爲","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612730395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，秋冬身衰勤苦。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612730395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己戌月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612746779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純午丑年月干透庚","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612763163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己清貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612763163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2694","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099650673967139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2695","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙子，楊忠烈。甲午，公繼盛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯金狀元。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612763163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612779547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2698","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午，李春芳狀元。己丑閣老。癸丑憲副。己巳訊事。丙辰、乙亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥日癸卯時，卯月印綬，近侍之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612779547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午京官五六","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612795931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"品。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612795931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2702","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙亥，主事。己未，禮部。戊子庚午郞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2703","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夢中蝶化局，覺後莫思量。運身通旺地，方許利名昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑日逄癸卯生，求名求利且中平。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612812315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身衰㺯巧翻成拙，得志須通遇貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612828699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁日時臨癸卯，身衰無倚平常，門中鬼賊，耗財糧守。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612845083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祖須防破蕩，父母鴈行少靠，妻子不免離鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612861467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運中身","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612877851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2709","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099650674032675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺煞方降，堪許利名榮暢。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612877851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六丁日甲辰時㫁","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612894235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六丁日生時甲辰，官星得位印生身。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612894235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不通月氣平爲福，有倚扶同禄貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612910619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁日甲辰時，印綬官庫，甲爲印，壬爲官，辰中甲木，印","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612927003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綬生身，官星合局，若通月氣，有倚托者貴，否則平","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612927003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612927003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春生喜北運，冬生喜南運吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612943387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑日甲辰時吉，亥子月富貴，申月東方運，午月金","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612959771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水運倶貴，純寅風憲極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612959771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2720","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申，樞宻。甲辰，冡宰。癸丑，敎諭。甲寅，舉人。庚子、壬申、辛酉、丁丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2721","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099650674049059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2722","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁亥舉人，癸丑舉人。辛亥癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯日甲辰時，辰戌丑未月，孤尅運通發財，丑月南","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612976155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方運貴，卯月金水運，近侍權貴，不利建白。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612976155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2725","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲寅，進士。庚辰，舉人。甲寅，舉人。癸未，諌垣。辛未。壬午、丁丑。乙卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2726","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申，同知壬戌，富。乙丑戊申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳日甲辰時，㐫刑孤尅，春印吉，夏秋平常，冬官旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273612992539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純戌木火運，官居冷職。","logicSentenceId":"7577325273613008923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2729","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙午，貴戚。乙未，知縣。丙申，陳子壯。壬辰。壬申探。己亥侍郞花。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2730","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙戌，陳觀陽銓部。癸未進士。癸巳乙丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日生時甲子，明見官星暗有財。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713344539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倚托若通於月氣，平生衣禄自天來。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713360923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日甲子時，明官暗財，己用甲爲官，癸爲財，辛爲食，子爲天乙貴，子上有明，甲暗，癸、辛長生，身若有倚托，通月氣者，富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713377307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不身旺，行土氣運亦好。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713393691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑日甲子時，化貴，午寅年月夭折，通土氣月貴，忌甲寅月貴，中惡𣦸，丁未月受刑，丁丑月破祖失鄉，惡𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713410075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099788540739619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉太守，乙巳進士，乙巳于愼行大學士，","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713426459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁巳丁亥甲戌，何寛尚書。丁亥，潘春谷少。己丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713426459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙子𠫭命同甲戊，癸丑刀筆，辛亥奔覔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯辛丑己卯日甲子時，先破祖，後旺，或旺中有傷，辰戌丑未月貴，午身旺，子聚貴，亥官長生，俱大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713442843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌己巳月破敗㐫𣦸，庚申月血光惡𣦸，壬子月刑害重。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713459227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚寅明朝弘治十八年庚子尚書己酉、少保甲申，賢君丙寅年崩。戊子庚午。癸亥，銓部。甲辰，布政。癸亥。乙亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳日庚子時，辰戌丑未月，風憲三品，要行水木運，西運無成，南運財官無氣，虛名薄利，貴而不顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713475611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713491995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099788540788771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年月東南運貴顯，","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713491995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神白經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化土主福，但不顯，忌壬寅月受刑，乙未月刑傷，癸酉月夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713491995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙亥，丞相。甲子，樞宻。癸亥，都憲。癸亥，州牧。己卯。己巳。甲寅。乙卯。丙寅小貴，甲午巨富。庚申，沈坤狀元，終於獄。辛丑、甲戌，戊子星案傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未日甲子時，高身坐官庫，辰戌丑未月吉，寅亥月官旺，文章振發，貴顯易成。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713508379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑文貴晚成，寅卯貧下，忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713524763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申月身不完𣦸，丙子月孤貧，丁丑月刑害。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713541147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚申，舉人。丁丑，𤎉憲。戊寅、己酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉日甲子時，寅申午未丑年月，文貴風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713557531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月東北運，極品，忌庚寅年破敗惡𣦸，己巳月㐫惡，戊戌","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713573915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099754394959906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月孤單血𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713573915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯，沈坤狀元。壬寅，府尹。辛亥，侍郞。壬子原本傳。甲辰庚寅。戊午，朱之蕃状元，尚書。乙卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日甲子時，春夏財官生旺吉，秋冬四季背禄逐馬㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713590299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月金火運郞官，午月東北運金紫，忌壬寅月惡𣦸，壬申月孤貧遭刑，癸酉月破敗。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713606683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬戌，部郞己卯，舉人。癸未，張道御史。無子。辛亥、丙寅、癸亥，巨富。丁亥，廕郎。壬寅。氣衝牛斗局，慱雅富文章。未遇雞窓客，逄時姓字香。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日喜逄甲子時，財官雙美貴希奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713623067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099772577349651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一朝得遇風雲㑹，獨歩蟾宫折桂枝。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713639451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日時臨甲子，化生土厚滋基，財官旣助，顯光輝，有。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713655835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似青龍戯水，不遇庚金，卯午爲人，禄至福齊，常人發福有施爲，君子登科及第。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713672219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日乙丑時斷","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713688603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以下六己日所忌月分，與上同時犯併論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日生時乙丑，煞星受制不爲傷，柱中身旺多榮貴，無𦔳生人書夜忙。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713688603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日乙丑時，專財逢鬼，丑上有明，乙爲鬼，暗癸爲財，若有倚托，通身旺者貴，通運亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354489713704987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鬼有𦔳旺不能任者，衣禄平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586629865510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099772577300499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑日乙丑時，時上偏官，居武職都閫，還看地方斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586629881894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月金水運，六七品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586629898278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子，劉鑰侍郞。乙亥。壬午，銓部。庚寅，太守。己巳巳卯。乙巳，佛印禪師。壬午。戊午，公鼐𥙊酒侍郎。壬戌。丁巳進士癸卯，女命岳元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868491419687/1-65ac8201d90499ff.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=QTo8svzmGYrwLn63ZUucGq1fPCU%3D","uri":"read/NA06804/2/ref/1kobikqzrhvec/1-65ac8201d90499ff.webp","fontType":1,"components":"士厂耳殳","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690868491419687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸卯癸亥，母三子甲科。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯日乙丑時，子申月行金土運，侯伯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586629914662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑戌年月俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586629931046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙巳，侍郞。庚辰，劉光濟尚書。乙酉。己卯，無子。辛丑，都憲。戊戌。丙子貴，辛丑、乙亥貴。庚戌，孫繼皋狀元、尚書。壬午丙戌。星案傳甲辰，禮科。己巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099772577267731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳日乙丑時，寅卯月偏官格，無酉戌字，文進貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586629947430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸卯，蔣狀。丙寅，楚王。甲辰，秦耀廵撫。謫戌。乙卯，元。辛卯丙寅。戊申武狀，庚申元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己未日乙丑時，時日併衝，妻生財可也。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586629963814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯午年月，金神入火鄉，西南運貴，辰戌四季全大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586629980198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干透丁辛，純陰亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586629996582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯，御史。庚午，郞中。乙卯進士。辛卯，進士。戊申、己卯、丙戌。戊戌。丁未，萬世德右都。丙戌，卿㐫。丁未辛卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉日乙丑時，卯月偏官，辰月財煞貴，申酉傷官傷𥁞，巳午印綬俱貴，丑戌亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630012966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099772577284115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午尹臺尚書，戊戌崔鈂翰林，","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630029350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰、乙丑己未，名將。庚戌，孫繼臯狀元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛末丙戌原本傳。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630029350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日乙丑時，卯月大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630045734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申月水木運，風憲方面。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630062118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙丑，通政戊寅，布政。辛卯，廕郎。庚辰。壬戌。癸巳。時上偏官局，身強印旺奇。若還無救助，名利總成虛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時逢乙丑本身衰，庫有財星内伏埋。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630078502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不遇鑰匙難顯逹，方知出外稱心懷。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630094886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日時臨乙丑，庫中耗鬼興灾，祖宗産業有盈𧇊，謀望財去財來。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630111270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌未刑衝發福，無匙來徃搬移。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630127654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙親鴈序事難依，有救末中取貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630144038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099743934414889"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日丙寅時斷六己日生時丙寅，暗官明印旺其身。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630160422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月通木氣無衝破，貴倚三台八位成。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630176806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日丙寅時，官印生旺，已用甲爲官，丙爲印，寅上甲旺丙生，若無破，通木局月氣者，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630193190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行木火，不宜金水歲君同。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630209574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑日丙寅時，春官旺，夏印旺，秋旣濟，冬平。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630225958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌年月，文貴顯達，純丑壽高。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630242342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月木火運，五六品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630258726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神。白經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土象主貴，有血疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630275110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申，丞相己亥。章極都憲，乙丑進士。壬申、甲戌、壬午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099700011630642"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰通判己丑己卯日丙寅時，午辰年月，文章顯逹，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630291494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午官至三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630307878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午尚書，丙子布政，甲辰布政，甲寅憲副，丙辰、庚午、癸酉、丙寅、甲申、劉𧦴狀元，壬辰主政，戊寅舉人，丙寅、辛亥、癸亥、","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630324262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙辰，蕭良譽進士，大𠫵。壬寅，進士。庚寅、庚子。壬子、辛巳，兵科。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅郎中。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630324262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午己巳日丙寅時，先刑後旺，寅月正官格，文章顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630340646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子水木運貴，純戌武職三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630357030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月申亥四生局全，大貴，或不善終。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630373414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099788540837923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己巳，魏謙吉都憲。壬戌，布政。己亥，給諫。丙子。壬戌、丙寅。丁亥舉人。癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未日丙寅時，生土厚地方貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630389798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水木年月行東北運貴，一","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630406182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云多庻出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過房，或父不見生。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630406182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬戌，布政。丁卯，布政。甲寅，權貴。己巳舉人。戊申、庚戌，丙子。庚午。甲子袁狀，丁丑元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉日丙寅時，月通木火局貴，木火運亦榮逹。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630422566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申，布政甲午，𤎉憲丁丑。丙寅。甲午，副使。癸酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日丙寅時，春生官旺貴，夏秋平，冬財旺吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630438950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630455334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099671532208165"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、巳午辰戌年月貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630455334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神白經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火木象貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630455334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申，靳貴閣老。戊戍，熊浹、尚聿曰。丁丑。丁巳。辛巳，沈應時侍郎。戊寅丞相，丙子元戎。辛丑丙辰、丁酉。丙戌，𠫭將𣦸於陣。丙寅，憲副。己卯卿。甲午、庚寅。乙亥。己丑倪嘉慶進士，户郎。乙亥上元人。君子。虎標標名局，財官内外明。若無衝破者，必定作公卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日丙寅時異常，少年未遇富文章，運行卯地生明月，平歩青雲到帝郷。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630471718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日丙寅時，正官星印綬長生，學堂三合喜光榮，博覧文章聰俊。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630488102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月無衝無破，定應金榜題名。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630504486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行官","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630520870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099754394992674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺主亨通，上等高人之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630520870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日丁卯時斷六己日生時丁卯，支千暗鬼梟虛神，柱中有𦔳方爲福，無𦔳難爲顯達人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630537254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日丁卯時，巳以丁爲印，乙爲鬼，卯上明丁暗乙，若歲月中無救助倚托者，虛秀不實，有成有敗。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630553638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月中見辛制伏，身旺者貴，運旺亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630570022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑日丁卯時，申子辰武職，亥卯未榮貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630586406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑行東北運吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630602790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己酉進士。癸酉舉人。丁巳進士，己酉舉人。乙亥、甲寅、乙巳、壬申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099772577382419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申進士。庚申理卿。丁卯舉人。甲戌、戊子。甲辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳卯日丁卯時，己酉年月，制伏得宜，庚申合煞，文進大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630619174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子月刑煞，遇貴主兵權，或法官，地支純印，或三合木局，運行寅混官，再遇流年衝運，㐫𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630635558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙巳，史道尚書。庚申，吳山尚書剛正。乙西。庚辰。癸未進士，壬申進士。辛巳，𡊮福徴進士。甲子、庚戌、丁酉。丙申宋開春户部郎中，平原人。余得三䇂卯命通㑹原本，卽此公所悪者。乙卯，大貴。戊子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳日丁卯時，無衝破，富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630651942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午辰年月刑傷不利。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630668326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥月木火運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630684710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若春生透甲乙者，官煞太旺，有制","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630701094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099671532224549"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化亦貴，否則㐫夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630701094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸卯，路通侍郎。丙子，吕調陽榜眼，閣老。辛酉、辛卯，純謹子進士。戊午，揮使丙戌舉人。丙辰、丁酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未日丁卯時，不貴則富，卯戌亥丑年月吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630717478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子進士。癸丑進士。癸丑，乙卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉日丁卯時，九成十破，末年旺，年月通身生旺，干頭有辛癸制伏丁乙者吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630733862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁丑，侍郎。己丑，憲副。壬戌，賈黙狀元。己酉、丁卯、丁未。丁卯，僉事。癸丑，太守。丙午。乙卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日丁卯時，秋生偏官有制，富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630750246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春壽促，夏身旺","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630766630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099743934496809"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，冬平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630766630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630783014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛酉，通政。乙丑，中丞。己巳，郎中。辛卯甲戍、丁丑。偏官偏印局，生人性剛強。身強爲大吉，如弱也平常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日卯時福自摧，求名求利總不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630799398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身宫但有刑尅字，離鄉别井走東西。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630815782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日時逢丁卯，倒食偏官交加酉，庚辛破受波渣，思想不能通達，父母鴈行難望，落花後立根芽。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630832166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圓虧離祖可成家，發跡山林澗下。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630848550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日戊辰時斷六己日生時戊辰，其身得位遇財神，","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630864934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099772577398803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田園富貴多誠信，甲乙提綱禄貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630864934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日戊辰時，財庫專位，己以壬癸爲財，辰上入墓，己士專位，爲人誠信富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630881318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若通月氣，或甲乙透出，是生月帶禄大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630897702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月身旺，不得父母力，見甲化土者，大富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630914086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬夏財旺，生官富貴，西運平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630930470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑日戊辰時，身孤，寅卯月禄旺，辰月透甲作化氣看貴，午富厚。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630946854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅酉風憲，年月子丑透甲，行東南運金紫近侍，怕西北運退職。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630963238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午，尚寳。乙丑進士。庚午，舉人。乙未，御史。乙亥，卿。丙戌乙酉。丙戌。壬辰傅應禎御史諫，甲午進士。癸卯戌，贈少卿。庚午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099700011696178"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯日戊辰時，卯月風憲，水木年月，行東北運，並同。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630979622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸未，羅瑶都憲。庚寅御史。癸酉進士。壬戊、乙酉。戊午。丁亥，都督。癸未，探花。甲寅，丁貴。乙卯，富未。乙卯。丁卯。癸未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午善奕，乙卯舉人，壬寅進士，甲子丁亥。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586630996006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉戊辰，舒弘志探花。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631012390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅己巳日戊辰時，身孤後發，春官貴，夏平穏，秋㐫暴，冬財旺，歲運同。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631028774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬戍，莊仁春太守與。戊子，高欽舜兩。壬淮寅，民争鹽院利，遭害。辛酉，追贜棄市。壬寅，李廷機解元，㑹元、榜眼。戊寅辛亥，大學士不僉事受餽。乙丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己未日戊辰時，丑月雜氣，財官吉，寅辰巳亥午戌年","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631045158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099743934513193"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月，文章貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631045158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛巳，丁士美狀元，宫止。甲辰，副使。壬申副使。壬辰，侍郎，丁丑年卒。丙寅丙午。丁酉，通判。戊申，貧蹇。丙辰，僧。壬子巳未。辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉日戊辰時，春官旺，夏平吉，秋暴狠，冬財旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631061542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁丑，侍郞。癸巳，員外。丁酉，御史庚午，進士。癸丑、丁巳。癸卯。庚辰。乙酉方逄年，壬戌進士，閣老，癸未富納，壬午两戊年，㐫𣦸，甲子中書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日戊辰時，丑月雜氣，財官貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631077926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月木水運，六七品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631094310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午子辰年月大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631110694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午，周廣都憲，戊子舉人。癸巳，貢士。丙寅。甲寅。甲寅。癸未，葉有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883213033491/1-a7db96258e912cf6.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=lVFW3RiCcnM2RdSfHUdRUUT1jTs%3D","uri":"read/NA11570/4/ref/1kr0r5inzl92c/1-a7db96258e912cf6.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土𡱡〢𠀃乂","variants":"聲","charPicId":"7456690883213033491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"副。壬寅，元戎。乙卯，都。辛亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099700011712562"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"翠竹緋桃局，依稀緑間紅。不逢寅尅害，開庫見錢龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰時巳日不尋常，内有錢龍鎮庫藏。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631127078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比刼不逢行運吉，定敎富貴廣田庄。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631143462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日戊辰時，遇身逢旺庫豐盈，果然花謝再重榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631159846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑戌刑衝財盛，壬申財官雙美，妻重子晚方成。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631176230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𩀱親鴈侣，事中平，獨立自成之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631192614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日己巳時斷六己日生時己巳，金神與火兩相和，不通月氣平常看，月氣如通榮甲科。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631208998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日己巳時，金火相合，己以丙爲印，巳中有丙建旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631225382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099788540887075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳又爲金神，坐於火位相合。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631225382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若通火月氣，四柱不見財星，破印，不行財運，發福非常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631241766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不通月氣，或在冬生，虛秀不實，不通得南運亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631258150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳丑日己巳時，辰月西北運貴，午未火旺，大貴，申子戌巳亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631274534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛丑，周啟祥舉人。辛卯，錦衣㐫𣦸。乙未、丁酉。壬辰，丞相丁未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯日己巳時，夾辰財庫，主大富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631290918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又卯以巳爲驛馬，二巳通看，謂之坐馬，再生午月，禄馬俱有，尤爲貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631307302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥月財臨旺地，官遇長生，巳月金神遇火，皆主","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631323686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099809390526505"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631323686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己酉，李植廵撫。庚午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子翁正春狀元尚書，一湖廣吏員。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631340070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑命同己巳日己巳時，午年月，權威赫赫，名譽昭昭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631356454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春月子孝妻賢，秋冬平常，貴而不顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631372838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌財印官食，申傷官生財，倶作吉推。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631389222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午康太和尚書，甲戌林廷玉都憲，壬戌丁丑年卒。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631405606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631421990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊戌，通政庚辰，運使。甲辰進士。癸卯庚進申甲辰士。壬申、壬戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未日己巳時，拱禄格，若無羊刃七煞，午字塡實，不犯空亡，主顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631421990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑辰、申年月行東運，文武極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631438374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格不如丁巳、丁未，以丁正祿，巳寄祿故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631454758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099743934529577"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午，部郞庚子舉人。乙酉，富。丁亥、癸未、己丑、己巳，壽。丙子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉日己巳時，夏生金神入火鄉，貴顯，歲運同前。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631471142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲寅，趙子昻學士。己酉學士，戊午舉人。甲戌、己巳，甲子。乙巳，千戶。辛巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日乙巳時，夏生資財滿目，行樂軒昂，冬平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354586631487526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月東南運，國師金紫，寅月亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237269530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊戌，錢汝京丁丑副使。乙卯，進丁巳尚書。甲辰，丙戌，士。己亥，通判己巳。火旺金神局，南方運氣佳。若生冬月令，財禄定虛花。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日重逢己巳時，金神化旺要相宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237285914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099811261186084"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南離運歩財官顯，寅卯東方遇亦奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237302298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日時逢己巳，夏生丙火金神不遇，戌亥與庚申無。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237318682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破聲名響應父母一衰一旺，刑空事業逡廵，要知顯達改名庭，火旺南方之運。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237335066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日午時斷六己日生時遇午，祿歸時地主昌榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237351450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中怕有官星見，若是伏晶另一評。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237367834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日庚午時，日祿歸時，己見庚爲傷官，乙爲正鬼，午上有明，庚合乙，傷官合煞，主人獨立有成。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237384218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年月無乙，而傷官臨於敗地，柱有甲丙二字伏晶格不","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237400602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099754395025442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"損，格局無衝破，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237400602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑日庚午時，寅月生貴，夏㐫秋暴，冬財旺子少，一云總貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237416986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子林茂達都堂，庚午楊思忠侍即，壬辰丁亥庚申僉事，庚子通判，丙辰武狀，辛巳丁亥丁酉元。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237433370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯日庚午時，巳禄居午，年月有甲丙及寅午者，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237449754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月煞旺庚合權貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237466138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑畢鏘尚書江南，一浙江生，甲申主政，乙巳池州石埭人員，命同乙亥乙未名將，癸卯太師，丙寅舉人，丁𮠕舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237482522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子乙卯、庚寅丙午。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237498906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申，舉人。丁卯，主政。丁未，羅朝國南尚書。甲寅，丁末。庚戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099788540919843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳日庚午時貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237515290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌月金神入火，𭅼作印綬論，貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237531674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未年月侯伯，若逢合煞運，必不善終，酉月東南運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237548058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯，瞿景淳會元，官止侍丁郞。乙丑未一云：丙午月丙戊駙馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子司訓。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237564442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥巳未日庚午時，背禄傷官，六親刑尅無破，晩年發旺，未戌年月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237580826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌通政，辛酉進士，己卯元戎，丙申𠫭將，辛未乙未、甲戍丁𮠕癸亥太守，壬辰舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237597210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己未戊申。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237613594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉日庚午時，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237629978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099811261202468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申馬士英，明末癸巳，入閣被刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日庚午時，午戌年月，財官禄印大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237629978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年午月巨富，卯月西運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237646362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午，毛鋼都憲壬中丞相。壬辰，平章。癸丑。丙午。乙巳。丁卯，僉事辛未進士。庚午，主政。丙子，知縣。戊辰、乙未、丙戌。甲午。巳禄歸時局，青雲定有期。若逢官惹絆，衝破不爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳逢庚午時歸祿，無破無衝能發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237662746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中丙甲若相逢，德潤身兮富潤屋。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237679130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日時逢庚午，名爲背祿傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237695514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝刑破害祸多端，骨","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237711898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099700011761714"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉六親冰炭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237711898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲丙柱中如遇伏晶之格清閑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237728282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月中丹桂任高攀，富貴不須推𥮅。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237744666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日未時斷六己日生時辛未，食神官庫喜相親。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237761050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木通月氣須言貴，月不通兮富命人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237777434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日辛未時，食神助官，己以辛爲食，甲爲官，未爲官庫，未上有明辛暗甲，若有倚托，通月氣貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237793818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神生旺勝過財官，通木氣，月官旺尤貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237810202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不通主富，通運亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237826586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑日辛未時，不貴卽富，通土氣月富，通木氣月貴","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237842970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099671532257317"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237842970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁未舉人。壬午舉人。甲寅，談相加御侍郎，以辛亥、癸卯、丙寅冩字出身後刑。辛丑女命，己亥貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
