{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯日辛未時，酉戌亥卯未年月貴，行東南運金紫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237859354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子，平章丁丑，丞相。辛未，主政乙卯，舉人。癸卯、癸卯。丙申。戊子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳日辛未時，金神日寅午戌月生貴，亥卯辰午，行金火水木運，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237875738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午，商輅三元閣老。甲辰，極品。己卯，副使。丁卯，名臣。戊辰。庚午。己卯，進士，不禄。壬申，通判。丙午舉人。己巳、甲辰、戊戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未日辛未時，春夏丑月，丰姿特達，言語清辨，名高","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237892122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099788540952611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄重，秋冬平常，木火運，刑害發財。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237892122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237908506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云：財中自害。乙巳，樞宻。癸巳，副使。己未，富壬午。丙辰。壬申，庚午，進士。丁亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉日辛未時，春反復，夏吉，秋壽促，冬財帛豐厚。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237924890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月金水運，五品以上貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237941274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月西南運郎官，辰戌財印庫地俱吉，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237957658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫刑後旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237957658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛巳，蔡克廉尚書。壬辰庚戌，林見素父。戊子贈尚書。甲寅，同知丙子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日辛未時，春貴夏穏，秋貧冬富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237974042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉月巳土長生，食神遇禄，享受自然，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237990426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴中㐫失。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683237990426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子，平章壬申即中。壬申，巳𮠕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099777706754075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時庫官星局，逢春最吉昌。運行官旺地，名姓自然香。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日相逢辛未時，燈窓寂寞有誰知。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238006810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行財旺兼官旺，名利𩀱全莫恨迟。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238023194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日時臨辛未，食坐官庫要開，丑戌刑衝，顯官財鎮閉，前程阻碍，君子文章福助，常人商賈奇魁，匙開發福命中該，財去財來常在。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238039578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日申時斷六己日生時壬申，損敗天元氣不全。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238055962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若失天元無倚托，非窮卽夭命難延。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238072346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日壬申時，水旺土虛，巳以甲爲官，壬爲財，庚背祿，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238088730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099811261235236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申上庚旺，壬生甲絶，巳土氣敗，若通四季土氣，或通土氣運吉，若失天時無倚托，不通月氣，非貧卽夭，不然殘疾末狼狽。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238088730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑日壬申時，酉年月，天干透印，富貴好禮，爲人慷慨，辰戌吉，亥年亁清坤夷大格，寅申官貴，相輔俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238105114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙寅，丞相。癸未，大𠫭。壬子，進士。乙酉、丁酉，貴。癸亥、乙巳、丙戌。戊申富，己丑，富，丙辰、壬申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳卯日壬申時，辰月雜氣，財官早貴，亥月南方運，五六品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238121498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申年三二品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238137882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099809390559273"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛亥，丞相。辛亥，丞相。辛亥，丞相。壬申，小𠫭。庚子。戊戌。壬寅庚子。甲寅，侍郎。壬子，王状。辛卯，布政。乙丑，都憲。壬申，甲辰，元。丁酉、己丑。壬寅，孫忠烈公子。己酉，如津錦衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳日壬申時，大㐫刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238154266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑月傷官，行財運吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238170650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌月金神入火鄕，運西南貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238187034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰月木火運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238203418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙午，進士。乙巳，御史。壬辰丙戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未日壬申時，巳月生，貫朽粟陳。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238219802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子寅月金火運，侯伯，辰亥年月近侍貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238236186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳，太守乙亥進士。癸未，進士。乙未，進士。壬戌、辛巳、戊午、甲申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099754395123746"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛丑，進士。癸丑，富。三子。辛丑。乙丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉日壬申時，己酉丑月傷官傷𥁞吉，寅月㐫暴，卯未武職，子未公侯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238252570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云：主心狂腎病，大貴。癸亥，俞大猷都督。戊申，戴時中都憲。丁未，狡猾。乙丑。庚午，都憲癸亥進士。庚戌，舉人。甲申，癸亥、癸未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日壬申時，卯未三合，㑹官干透印，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238268954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子月財旺生官，酉巳土受生，干透甲丙俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238285338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鸞鳯棲梧局，飛騰大不難。如逢刑尅破，勞碌不鲁閑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干是己會申時，無破無衝最合宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238301722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中縱然官不現，也交財旺定根。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238318106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238334490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099811261251620"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申時逢己日，就中三合爲宜，天乙貴人正入提，宜用財官顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238334490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳辰戌得位，文章廣學須知。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238350874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻賢子孝福文齊，刑破中年不利。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238367258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日酉時斷六己日生時癸酉，沐浴之鄉水土渾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238383642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財食支藏多聚散，身衰失地壽難存。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238400026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日癸酉時，水土渾濁，巳以癸爲財，辛爲食，酉上癸病，辛旺，比肩奪財，財多聚散，更身衰失地，主成敗反覆，不然壽促。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238416410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若通身旺月，或運吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238432794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑日癸亥時，春平夏穏，秋傷官傷𥁞，有威權，冬富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238449178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099827996491811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙寅巳月，金神遇火貴，丑月金水運，即官透乙，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238465562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午，逰擊夀五十九。乙巳進士。辛巳、丁亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯日癸酉時，時日相逢，卯酉主遷移刑傷，又傷官帶煞，主性𠒋暴，作事遲延，生四季月吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238481946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁巳，明建文君水土敗𮠕時壬子，犯破碎，宜失國。遊走。丁卯，副使。癸卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳日癸酉時，己酉丑月，偒官傷𥁞，居武職風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238498330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯戌月，金神入火鄉，貴而能言傷貴，收心早退，以水土敗在酉故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238514714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸未，副使己巳貴夭，己卯小貴，早退。甲子、壬申、丙寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099827996508195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申富，被刼。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238531098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅巳未日癸酉時，戌亥丑辰年月，西方運貴，子巳大貴，卯辰近侍不大。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238547482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子揚兆尚書，四千四，壬辰富，巳未運使。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238563866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳支互換貴全庚戌甲戌己酉日癸酉時，偏財遇食主峥嶸，丑未子午俱吉，酉月内戚。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238580250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如年月己酉，全犯破碎煞，主一生破敗，遊走無結果。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238596634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥太守，辛未貴，壬子舉人，甲子舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238613018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉、辛丑、丙午、丁卯己亥日癸酉時，通土氣，月行木火運，貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238629402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午舉人，癸丑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238645786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY1521/11/ref/1kwpglmjq7v9l/1-7443099827996508195_176253_2751460.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=B28SD7SboHquIuXXFhFscSLB%2B5E%3D","pictureHeight":1207,"pictureWidth":99,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY1521/11/ref/1kwpglmjq7v9l/1-7443099827996508195_176253_2751460.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=N77evH7MYJPZP%2FYSjchT%2FocbU4k%3D","uri":"read/HY1521/11/ref/1kwpglmjq7v9l/1-7443099827996508195_176253_2751460.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099808274841634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"食神生財局，刑傷更忌衝。若無犯此字，迟早攺門風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳逢癸水酉時生，食神生旺自從容。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238662170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱更兼衝尅破，此命依𥮅只中平。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238678554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉時逢癸酉，偏財喜遇食神鴈行無倚靠雙親，性格情懷不定。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238694938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財來財去，聚散眼前廣見難存，花開花謝再重新。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238711322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此命先逆後順。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238727706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日戌時㫁六己日生時甲戌，妻從夫化爲眞土。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238744090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如通月氣禄源深，反此而言平常取己日甲戌時，妻從夫化，己合甲木，化土成局，土神鍾","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238760474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099808274858018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀，禄源深厚，月中無化，取甲爲官丙爲印，戌上甲木成形，丙火合局，通月氣貴不通，有刑衝破害者，平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238760474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己身雖吉，父母早失。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238776858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰，御史。癸卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑日甲戌時，尅父太旺，辰月生土厚，居己午未申，臨官帝旺吉，亥戌寅卯土病𣦸㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238793242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉辰三四品貴，中年退閑，亥木火運，六七品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238809626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲辰，訓道。丁巳，周繼昌府丞。壬戌，解元。癸酉、辛亥。壬子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯日甲戌時，丙丁午戌年月干有庚辛制伏，官煞生山明水秀地方，官至二三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238826010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉丑月行火土","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238842394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099777706786843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運，四五品，午月東北運大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238842394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子月木火運，風憲，辰巳有倚托者，極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238858778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午，王正國侍郎。壬了。己巳，陳益都憲。戊辰。壬午，大富。乙酉，太守。戊辰，富五。辛酉。乙巳，大叅。丙戌乙卯，子。庚寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉部郎士辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238875162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳日甲戌時，寅午戌月，金神入火郷，貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683238891546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥戌年月，官居守令，極有","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241463835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868491419687/1-65ac8201d90499ff.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=QTo8svzmGYrwLn63ZUucGq1fPCU%3D","uri":"read/NA06804/2/ref/1kobikqzrhvec/1-65ac8201d90499ff.webp","fontType":1,"components":"士厂耳殳","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690868491419687"},"logicSentenceId":"7577354683241463835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241463835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子月木火運，極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241480219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子，員外。丁丑癸給諫。戊申酉舉人。丁亥壬寅，舉人。丙辰、巳酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未日甲戌時，尅陷遭刑，寅午年月，三四品貴；戌月東南運，五品純。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241496603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯年月刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241512987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099827996524579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸未，郎中、主政俱同。戊戌進士，壬戌舉人。乙丑。壬午，封官。二子，庚戌俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉日甲戌時，辰丑刑衝，財源益進，酉戌相害，名利中平。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241529371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子月己貴，寅月官印行印運貴純。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241545755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉年月頑暴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241562139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤獨離鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241562139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙丑，李克齋尚書庚寅進士，辛卯舉人。丙戌、戊子、壬辰。甲戌，舉人。癸酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日甲戌時，通土氣，月要行木運，通水木，月要行，身旺運俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241578523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁酉，宋景尚書。乙丑，學士。己未，御史。辛亥。庚辰，丙子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099671532306469"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"秋葉經霜局，須臾緑變紅。但逢衝尅字，凋落任西東。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己化土氣藏收，如逢匙鑰福優游。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241594907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假若逢財財不聚，渾如木葉值深秋。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241611291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日時逢甲戌，妻從夫化爲佳，庫財専待鑰匙開。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241627675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申丑神通泰，父母夭孤刑尅𤻉行，花果難諧。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241644059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢時運一時來，家業興隆亨快。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241660443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六己日亥時斷六己日生時乙亥，官藏煞見未爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241676827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢金制煞方爲吉，身不旺兮㐫可知。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241693211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日乙亥時，煞見官藏，己以甲爲官，乙爲鬼，亥上有","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241709595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099808274890786"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明乙暗，甲爲官煞混雜，柱中見辛制乙，去煞留官，通月氣者貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241709595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥上水旺土虛，漂流失業，見財不聚，成敗進退，要身鬼兩停方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241725979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不通月氣，通運氣亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241742363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳丑日乙亥時，己酉丑月，制煞留官貴，午月身旺亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241758747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子月火運，七八品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241775131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯未透辛制乙，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241791515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛未，嚴訥閣老。丙午，秦尚都憲。己亥。庚子。壬申，侍郎。己巳，司副。己丑，吴一琴主事，夭𣦸。癸丑、庚午。庚午。癸卯沈應文尚書一歙縣程監生。乙丑命同巨富。乙丑，趙標侍郎。己丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099808274874402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯日乙亥時，卯月偏官格，煞重身柔，作棄命㸔，壬字暗逢，志氣軒昻，柱有制伏，行土金運，官至三四品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241807899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月雜氣，辰巳西運金紫，亥月水運夭，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241824283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛巳尚書癸未，進士。乙酉，貧而濫，多子不才。癸巳、戊午、丁亥，㐫年不免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰貧苦，辛巳癈疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241824283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥己亥己巳日乙亥時，寅午戌月，金神入火鄉貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241840667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳月西北運，官至公卿，卯午風憲純子亥年月，以財黨煞作棄看，主大兵權。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241857051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯，李西涯閣老。丁未。戊申，金幼孜尚書。名臣。丁巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子戚繼光都督名將。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241873435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥沈懋學狀元。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241889819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥壬申","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241906203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099777706819611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯進士。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241906203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯巳未日乙亥時，無刑破混雜，清高富貴，文學堪誇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241922587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己亥，崔東洲侍郞。庚戌，黄佐翰林。丁卯己丑。乙亥，蔡白石都憲。丙寅，李旻狀元。丁亥、丁酉。丙辰，進士。癸酉，同知。壬辰，廕郞。壬辰、丁巳。壬寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉日乙亥時，春夏顯達，秋制伏太過，貧儒。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241938971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬財旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241955355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午巳戌年月，六七品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241971739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月行金火運，四五品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683241988123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午，菱芬待郎。乙亥𠫭政，乙卯進士。丙戌辛巳。丙戌。己酉，進士。乙亥，部郞。甲午，兵道。癸酉，刑人。乙亥。丁亥。乙亥。乙卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日乙亥時，年月透辛，制貴，無制亦主特逹。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242004507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242020891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099671532322853"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風憲，己亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242020891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑土厚之宫，官至三品，一","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242037275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云自刑多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成敗晩富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242037275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸丑，應檟總制。甲寅，名臣。癸丑，太守。庚寅，都諫。庚申。丙戌。乙丑，黃穆編修。丁亥。甲辰，舒芬狀元。戊辰。己卯進士。癸末。以上六日，得此時生者，多文學之士，出身高科，官居清要。魚入深潭局，無刑、空尅破，得志化鯨鰲，都省把名標。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元乙亥在時間，驛馬長生不等閑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242053659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺煞強駢福祿，功名顯逹自歡顔。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242070043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日時逢乙亥，偏官喜遇正財，若逢身旺亦爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242086427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"混","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242102811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099811261300772"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜天元减半，行藏進退無定，六親鴈佀興衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242102811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行禄馬自然來，富貴清閑自在。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242119195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚日子時斷六庚日生時丙子，身鬼俱衰退神強。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242135579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有托榮華無托賤，鬼逢生旺壽難長。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242151963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日丙子時，身鬼俱衰弱，庚以癸爲傷，丙爲鬼，子上庚𣦸，丙火無氣，癸水建旺，若身有倚托吉，無倚托，又行身衰鬼旺運，飄風夭賤，通火氣月要行西運貴，身弱不然。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242168347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子日丙子時貴，年月再子併衝，午中丁爲官，己爲","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242184731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099809390608425"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印，入飛天禄馬格，柱無財官填實，主貴爲僧道，一塵不染，萬法皆成，爲常人，有名有利，刑傷妻子，云先貧後富，忌己巳月破刑貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242184731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未月孤單，己亥月刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242201115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙子，喬行簡丞相。丁酉、丁卯，少卿。己卯，少卿。壬子、丙寅。癸酉，郞中甲辰進士。癸卯，郭子章尚。癸亥書。丙子甲寅。庚辰，進士。己未，部郎。癸未，丙子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅日丙子時，春生帶財帶煞，行金火運，金紫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242217499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏煞旺大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242233883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋身旺，須行南運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242250267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬身鬼倶弱，平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242266651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純午年月，位至公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242283035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子食前煞後隨，一陽生後，丙","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242299419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099827996573731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火有氣，貴極人臣。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242299419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌癸酉月破敗㐫，辛亥月血光，甲子月夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242315803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯明成化皇帝丁未，霍韜會元尚書。壬子乙巳，名臣丙午，黄冡。壬寅陳狀巳𮠕何天衢侍郞。甲午宰，乙巳元。辛未。癸亥，魏良貴都憲。辛卯，副使。庚午，御史。壬戌。癸巳，丁亥。丁丑舉人。己未進士。壬戌，陳堯侍郎。戊申、己巳。壬寅。丁卯，解元。壬辰，諫垣。辛巳，四月卒。癸丑乙丑。丁酉，太傅。庚戌，王佐尚書。壬子。戊寅。乙未乙卯郷試，甲戌進士。守道、塩道。戌運、壬運俱戊寅，不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099811261317156"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰日丙子時，月通木火氣，行西運妙，忌乙巳月破敗刑，丁酉月旺中刑㐫，己丑月破敗㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242332187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌大𠫭，乙巳會元，己巳儀部，己酉知縣，丙申、辛巳、甲戌、丙子、","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242348571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲寅二舉人命同，一辛巳林元，辛未美。子孫三五子一，無尚。庚寅書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰、𡊮宏道銓部。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242348571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子庚午日丙子時貴，時日相衝，憂傷妻子，運喜西南，通火木月氣，風憲三四品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242364955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋生丙火無氣，難爲子息，忌己巳月破祖㐫，己亥月被刼盜㐫，癸丑月孤。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242381339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子何鰲尚書。辛未癸進士。丑己卯元戎。庚子癸𮠕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申日丙子時，申月生，土厚地方貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242397723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰未年月，行西","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242414107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099777706835995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運，公侯，忌辛巳月㐫刑，辛亥月孤夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242414107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊辰，國公己未甲子。李本閣老。一云辛未壬午時。乙丑郎中。丁亥。丙午進士。戊寅，遊戎。壬申，解元。丙申進士。庚寅庚申。壬寅、丁酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戍日丙子時，春夏生西南運，秋月木火運俱貴，忌乙巳月㐫破，乙亥月官灾，多凶刑，己丑月破敗㐫，戊戌月惡𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242430491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥，文彦慱丞相。癸丑，馬西園侍郞。乙丑壬戍。乙卯，任中。戊辰進士。丙戌，銓部。丙戌，丞。戊午。辛丑。乙卯，大貴。丁亥。壬辰，蕭大亨尚書。辛丑，司丞。甲辰甲午。丙子，黄懋官侍郞，𣦸於亂軍。申价副使命同黄閩戊戌人。申，魏人。申院貞，黄後𣦸。申無子，黄一子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099827996606499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遊魚避網局，跳躍到天津。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242446875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運至凶歲吉，時來不受貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242463259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日相逢丙子時，傷官合局不爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242479643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𩀱親祖業難成就，燕寢鸞棲别立基。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242496027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日時逢丙子，刑官背祿安身。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242512411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙親尅陷早艱辛，鴈侣不能和順，廢學經商發福，田庄後懶先勤，家居財帛晩𦆵成，先暗後明之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242528795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚日丑時斷","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242545179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以下六庚日所忌月分，與上同時犯併論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚日生時丁丑，貴地逄官火太輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242545179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木火運通軒冕客，不通獨立只虛名。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242561563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日丁丑時，金重火輕，庚以丁爲官，以己爲印，丑上","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242577947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099671532372005"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火氣輕，己土正位，若通木火氣月，官印逢生旺貴不通虛名而巳。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242577947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通火土生旺月富，不通運遇，亦主名聲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242594331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子日丁丑時，春夏貴，秋平常，冬孤尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242610715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午，兵俻壬午，太守。丙申，主政。甲寅，舉人。丁亥、乙巳，辛卯。甲戌。甲申，賀烺侍郎。壬子，周文燭司業。丙寅。丙午。辛酉，進士癸丑，依覔丙寅。癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅日丁丑時，魁元寅卯午未亥月，清秀高命，行午未運貴顯通火土年月貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242627099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊午，倫以訓會元榜眼。乙巳，舉人。壬寅，元戎。乙丑，官止侍郎。己丑癸丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099809390624809"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午常少。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242627099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑申己卯舉人，壬戌癸亥、壬午遇難。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242643483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰日丁丑時，丑月富而壽促，巳近侍大貴，通火旺土生月貴，不得運遇，亦富有名譽。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242659867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊辰，丞相戊子戊舉午人。甲午，癸胡汝亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欽給諫","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242676251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊辰乙酉，顧錫疇禮部尚書。己巳乙酉依覔。庚午。庚午日丁丑時，通土月氣貴，不亦富有名聲。乙丑巌蒙丞相戊庚子，子大𠫭，庚寅進士。戊寅。甲午，同知戊丁亥戊，舉人。己辛巳未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉人","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242676251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己丑，丙辰，富。戊辰。壬子，楊道賔榜眼，侍郎。甲己酉。寅張。庚午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣修","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242676251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"榜眼謫戍。壬戌，雷轟三。巳酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十四歲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242676251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛未，庚辰進士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242692635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099671532421157"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申日丁丑時，丑月金火運極品，辰巳午未戌月，官印兩旺貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242692635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉身太旺，須行木火；寅卯財太旺，須行金水；亥子金寒水冷，須行火土運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242709019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙巳，尚書。壬申，陳虛窓都憲。己巳，副使。庚辰。己酉。己巳。己卯，御史。壬午，通判。丙午，進士。己巳，觧元。丙寅、丙午。庚子、庚午。庚子林春澤進士太守，壽一百丁亥四歲，候官人。戊申，御史無子。辛酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌日丁丑時，春財旺，夏官旺，秋平淡，冬無力，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242725403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑四十後發。丁巳，侍郎。庚申，州牧。乙未，知縣。己未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242725403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未壬午、戊子戊辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242741787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099777706917915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊戌舉人。丁酉解元。丁酉兵，丁巳道。癸丑、丁未。乙酉，黄道周詹事。假道學。庚辰，廷杖。己卯、丙戌，以領兵被殺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣吐紅蜺局，倉門庫戶開。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242758171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一朝時運至，福禄自然來。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242774555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚丁相合丑時全，好象明蟾耀碧天。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242790939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不遇刑尅真稀奇，財官興旺更長年。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242807323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日時逢丁丑，正官財庫相隨，午未戌月福優餘。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242823707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚取時逢金櫃，金逢火而成器，必然廕子封妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242840091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從來歌酒不相離，定主清閑樂意。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242856475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚日寅時斷六庚日生時庚寅，火生金絕福𧇊人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242872859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099811261349924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月通從革或秋降，却作皇家柱石臣。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242889243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日戊寅時，火生金絕，庚以丙爲鬼，戊爲倒食，寅上有明戊合癸化火，庚金氣絕，若不通金旺月，無救助者，夭賤貧下。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242905627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳月庚長生，丙健旺，身鬼俱強，運行西方，勇暴武貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242922011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉丑戌月，金火合局，化鬼爲官，更得身強運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242938395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子日戊寅時，寅午年月，登科顯逹，純申三四品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242954779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月金火運，公卿","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242971163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙巳，吕震尚書。己丑、巳未，極品。壬午，侍郞。癸酉。壬寅。己丑，𤎉使甲寅，進士。庚寅，𠫭將間𣦸。戊辰、甲戌、丙戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099671532437541"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙午，同知。乙丑，李騰芳少詹。癸巳。壬午。戊午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"國公，丙戌福王。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242971163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯，通𠫭辛亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯庚寅庚寅日戊寅時，月通火局，或秋生，行身旺運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683242987547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子月自𣦸，年見辛酉，貧夭殘疾，身衰，見丙太旺，同論","logicSentenceId":"7577354683243003931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申，尚書。壬辰，大𠫭。壬辰，𤎉使。壬子乙亥，進士。己酉。壬寅、庚戌。庚寅，進士。己亥，守僃。丁卯，縣尹。乙酉、己丑丙，知州。寅丁未、庚庚寅辰，極品。己亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"御史。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683243003931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅丙戌庚辰日戊寅時，春夏生干透丙丁運，行身旺貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683243020315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙寅，尚書壬子進士。壬戌辛卯，知州。戊戌壬寅進士。壬寅甲寅。丁卯舉人。壬戌，府尹丁戊辰進士。丑丁未。甲子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099777706950683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午日戊寅時，寅午戌月，金衰火旺，當帶殘疾，純寅反主極貴，秋金旺多貴，但忌時遇亡刼尅身則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683243036699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅祭酒，庚午大𠫭，庚申進士，丁丑僉事，丙寅、戊寅、戊寅、己酉、戊戌𤎉使，壬午元戎，庚子指揮，丙申富壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683243053083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申、丙午、己丑、庚寅、辛巳㐫𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683243069467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申庚申日戊寅時，時日併衝，憂傷妻子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683243085851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯辰月，火金運，侯伯，春月西南運大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300184091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月貴顯，不久","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300200475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先刑後吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300200475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚戍，彭韶尚書。己酉，余子俊尚書。丙戌，戊辰，名臣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥陳狀，丙戌舉人，丁丑舉人，壬戌元，己亥富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300216859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300233243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099809390657577"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌日戊寅時，貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300233243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月雜氣，財官印綬貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300249627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰年己卯月者，侯伯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300266011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉傳伯壽樞密，己未中書，壬申運使，丙申、丁丑、庚戌、","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300282395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁亥，少卿壬寅，劉堂錦衣。癸丑壬寅丁未，廕貧。丁未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳陳禹謨侍郞，己酉進士。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300282395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未丙子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300298779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"良工琢玉局，未遇在初時。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300315163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一朝逄巧匠，成噐貴人提。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300331547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日寅時甚可誇，無刑尅破顯憂華。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300347931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運來自有高人助，時至如𣸸錦上華。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300364315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日戊寅時，秀偏印倒食難收，少年未遇莫心憂，此命或貧或富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300380699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時至發財發福，運來順水行舟。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300397083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月中金","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300413467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099827996622883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水更相投，無破功名成就。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300413467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚日卯時斷六庚日生時己卯，胎生元命發因妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300429851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中有托逢庚旺，財禄豐盈福壽齊。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300446235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日己卯時，胎生元命，庚金卯上受胎，見巳爲生氣印綬。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300462619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚以乙爲財，卯有旺乙，因妻發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300479003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若柱旺丁生月帶祿者貴，有倚托者，富通生氣，財旺者生財旺運者俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300495387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子日己卯時，子卯相刑，憂傷妻子，子年月貴，丑未官至三品，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300511771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破祖失土，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300511771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099671532453925"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛卯太守。甲午萬崙尚書。庚寅乙巳，一命富同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅日己卯時，亥卯月財星格，早榮早退，午戌三合官局，干透金水，行西比運吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300528155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申，平章。丁卯，運判。乙亥，王錫爵閣。甲戌，老。癸卯。丙戌，父。癸巳，女命子中丞。乙丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰日己卯時，孤年月通木氣，及有倚托者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300544539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子，丞相。辛酉，大𠫭。丙辰癸卯，觧元。丙申庚子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午日己卯時，刑破申子辰、巳酉丑，俱行東南運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300560923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌、亥卯未，須得西比運爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300577307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙丑，御史。壬寅，監丞。戊辰，富乙。癸酉酉武。己酉。己卯。乙卯，元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099809390706729"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申日己卯時，卯月財星格，不貴卽富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300593691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑巳年月，翰林清貴，官至亞卿，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300610075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少貧，中年有小灾，尅妻少子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300610075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌丞相，己卯平章，甲午都督。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300626459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯甲寅、戊辰、庚戌日己卯時，少孤母賤，中年貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300642843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉辰丑月，官至公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300659227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申，南部癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰進士，乙丑運使。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300675611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉李戴冡宰，無子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300691995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌癸未乙巳：胎星元命局，財旺喜身強。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300708379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時來宜進逹，中末姓名香。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300724763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元庚己卯時連，禄見文書富貴全。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300741147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱無刑衝尅破，貴人接引上青天。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300757531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099777706934299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日時逢己卯，財官運氣亨通，若無刑衝定褒封，有破中年不順鴈行，六親難靠，自成家計無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300773915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時來發逹顯功名，自有高人引用。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300790299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚日辰時斷六庚日生時庚辰，金水秋生氣象純。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300806683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有魁罡包貴賤，財官喜忌六宫分。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300823067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日庚辰時，金水清白，六庚之中，庚戌、庚辰爲魁罡，怕見財官刑衝不見，主爲人麄豪暴男而貴，見則禍患百出。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300839451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子庚寅、庚午庚申，喜見財官生秋月。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300855835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲人秀麗，不貴則富，若身不化，得甲乙丁透出，生","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300872219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099808274972706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火木分野，亦作財官論，喜月氣通運者吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300872219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子日庚辰時，申月生井欄，又格柱併運，不見丙丁，巳午寅戌字貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300888603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純卯年月，位至公侯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300904987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午，京卿。庚辰觧元。甲申進士。戊申，都督。己丑、乙酉。壬申。乙丑。己巳，郭希顔諭德。庚申年以諌言梟示，痛哉！丙寅。命庚子、庚辰，祖父皆貴。申運申年問軍信，頑金要火。命純庚辰年月，強盜分屍，三柱魁罡獨旺，柱無火制，一片頑金，爲盗遭㐫宜矣。丁丑，遊擊。癸巳，僉事。乙巳。甲子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅日庚辰時，龍虎拱門，年月通火土者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300921371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純庚辰王侯，不然極㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300937755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年月遇木火運，再行極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300954139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099777706967067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午，王道立編修。乚己都憲。乙丑辛巳，僉憲。戊辰、丙戌。壬戌，大富㐫死。己未，劉廷柱，河間太。壬子守。壬申，被奴弑。戊子，孫𮡻庻吉士。乙亥，項甲鼎鉉庻吉士。寅。丙戌。辛丑，憲副丁酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰日庚辰時，魁罡年月不見財官並戌字貴，衝破者富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300970523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子年月作并欄义，行西南運吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683300986907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純庚辰、庚申或乙酉，化金通無火氣，𠒋徒小人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301003291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云刑。乙亥甲戌，運衝刃太歲。戊辰庚辰小運。壬寅巳未，進五十四歲，士凌遲𣦸。丁未。甲戊寅，子舉人。乙亥、辛酉。甲戌，太守。丁亥。張角胤尚書。乙一御史。亥。戊申，司","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099808274939938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申，元戎庚午，都司。甲寅，武貴陣亡。戍辰。丙申，王麟洲少卿。乙卯統制。甲午。庚辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午日庚辰時，自刑金神入火鄉，申月行火木運，官可六品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301019675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁巳，王嘉賔文選。丁丑御史。辛丑，太守。丁未。己酉。乙未。丙子，舉人。己卯，平章。己亥己巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申日庚辰時，子申年月入井欄义柱，運不逢丙丁巳午字貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301036059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301052443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申、庚辰行西北東運，武職極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301068827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申，郡王。乙巳，布政。癸亥，府尹。己卯，都譧。庚申。甲申。乙丑。庚寅。癸亥，員外。癸未，尹鳳武狀元。己亥，中書。庚申，庚中。辛未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099809390755881"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲寅給事壬辰縣尹戊寅末清霞道丙人。百二寅壬寅乙卯十歲。乙未，子黄士俊狀元。戊寅，錢龍錫閣老。庚謫，戍辰閣老。甲子。戊午周應秋尚書，辛酉進士。庚申、癸巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌日庚辰時，魁罡土厚地方，官高禄重，子月西南運貴，寅辰年月平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301085211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙辰，丞相。乙丑，胡璉都憲。癸丑辛丑，即中。己丑己未。甲申主政己酉作縣應癸酉丁伯卯丁丑朝拿問。乙卯。遠震雷霆局，爲人有變機。福星臨到處，身至鳳凰池。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚時辰仔細推，辰中印庫鑰匙開。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301101595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱若有衝刑字，安然福禄自天來。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301117979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099811261382692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日庚辰時，正地支三合爲魁，就中卯戌庫門開，無破紫袍金帶。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301134363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳午丙丁减福謀爲，財去財來，妻重子晩命中該，富貴清閑自在。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301150747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚日巳時斷六庚日生時辛巳，偏官合刃自身生。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301167131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲人剛毅妻財損，運到金鄉貴祿亨。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301183515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日辛巳時，陽刃偏官。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301199899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚以辛爲刃，丙爲殺，明辛暗丙，合煞爲權，通身旺月貴，不通無貴壽考。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301216283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子日辛巳時，春富夏，秋貴冬貧，辰戌丑未年月印綬，行西南運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301232667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099827996672035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己未，太守丁丑主政。己未，進士。己丑，副。丁丑癸卯。己巳戊辰，使。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戊運使，戊戊進士。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301249051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅王庭譔探花。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301265435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申、壬戍、戊辰、丙寅劉光復御史，以諌挺擊被謫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301281819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳，光宗登基，起陞光祿寺丞。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301298203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅日辛巳時，己酉丑月，身旺貴，煞旺身弱月貧𥾴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301314587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申年月大貴悠久。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301330971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥月東南運，主有權貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301347355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚子，侍郎甲午，陳祥都。甲申癸酉。憲，己酉進士。乙亥。壬辰，舉人。庚辰舉人。癸丑，太守。壬子辛亥，御。己丑史。癸亥壬寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰日辛巳時，終蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301363739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月不見財高，通木氣，行西南運，未申東北運，俱貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301380123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先無後有。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301380123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬申，汪鏜尚書。壬寅丙午，少卿。庚辰，主政。丁丑乙亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099827996688419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛酉，州牧。甲申，張學顔尚書。丙申丙子原本傳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午日辛巳時，己午丑年月，進士風憲，己申酉戌，行土木運，侯伯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301396507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子，主政。甲申，舉人。辛未，主政。己巳。甲戍。戊戍。辛酉，邵景堯榜眼。戊辰，壽八旬外。丁酉壬戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申日辛巳時，刑己酉丑月特達。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301412891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏木火旺，財官得地吉，辰戌丑未，印綬行南運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301429275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙寅，陶朱公。辛未，少卿。癸酉，縣尹。己亥。戊戌。乙丑。丁未，方伯壬寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌日辛巳時，年月遇財吉，午未行東南運，文職操","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301445659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099821428195379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"權，恐無好終。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301445659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申翰林宰輔，若行火運，亦難善終。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301462043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申，曹鼐狀元閣老。壬戌，翁溥丙尚寅，𣦸書土木之難。丁未。壬申學士。辛巳，狀元。戊辰𠫭。辛亥。戊戌。庚申政。丁丑楊旦癸丑進士。癸巳丙午，主。辛酉溺𣦸。乙丑，政。癸卯，女命夫劉勃進士。子元𢈫，乙未、元霖俱進士。日干生旺局，喜内運又藏。行憂財旺地，富貴不須求。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日相逢時巳生，爲人福祿依稀平。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301478427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑衝破害柱如有，自立自成免禍驚。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301494811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日時臨辛巳，敗財暗鬼偷尋。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301511195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財來財去小人侵，祖父家基難廕。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301527579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外合重行發福，兄弟鴈行無音。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301543963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻遲子","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301560347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099809390821417"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晩喜開心，先苦後榮之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301560347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚日午時斷六庚日生時壬午，官印福宫聚食神。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301576731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金土𦔳身須顯貴，月逢火旺命難通。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301593115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日壬午時，官印健旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301609499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚以丁爲官，己爲印，壬爲食，午上壬食無氣，丁巳禄旺，通金土月氣扶身者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301625883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通火氣，官貴太重，反化爲鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301642267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金柔弱，不能作福，運氣扶身亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301658651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子日壬午時，時日併衝，憂傷妻子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301675035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通金氣貴，火氣大貴，但多憂勞碌。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301691419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099811261415460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸酉，胡韶侍郎。巳未。庚子，周煦都憲。丙戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅副使，甲辰進士，己未觧元，戊辰、庚午、丙寅戊子余孟麟榜眼，甲子祭酒，無子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301707803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅日壬午時，辰戌丑未已申酉月，身旺俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301724187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午火旺，運氣再遇，壽促，不然殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301740571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己巳，趙時春會元，都憲，乙卯主政。甲戌丁卯進士。己丑甲戌。戊午狀元。己巳舉人。丙戌，羅鳯翔舉人。戊都憲。午己巳丙申時，落空亡少。丁子酉，沈一貫大學士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰日壬午時，食神旺，善飲食，有操持，發卽𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301756955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子劉誠意伯，地連。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301773339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申張學顏尚書。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301789723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099808274989090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午日壬午時，寅午戌月，金柔火旺，畏縮殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683301806107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子午月，行木火運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409235978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊子，銓部。癸酉，寺丞。己巳，太守。丙辰，御史。甲子。丁巳。甲午。乙未。癸巳，指揮。壬寅，推官。己丑，太守。己卯，舉人。丙辰，富。癸丑。丁丑。丁卯。庚寅，進士。府同。己酉，御史。乙酉。乙亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申日壬午時，禄馬同鄉最吉，如午未年月位至臺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409252362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閣卯辰巳貴，戌月行火土運，清虛冷職。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409268746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙午，工部甲子進士。丙戌，大𠫭。乙亥，州牧。庚子、辛未、丁酉。己卯。壬申州牧甲子吕本閣老，浙江人，江𡨴人。甲辰辛未，命同平常。庚戌，徐兆魁都院。辛未，孔貞時翰林。癸未，丁𮠕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099821428228147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉貧，庚子㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409285130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子庚辰庚戌日壬午時，卯月正財吉，未月雜氣財官貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409301514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰丑月同","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409317898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛未，祝學。辛卯，楊俊民尚書。乙未。辛卯。士大庚子𠫭。癸未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未進士，癸丑給事。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409317898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰楊旦閣老。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409334282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯乙卯甲申","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409350666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬申，洪承選丁酉觧元。癸辛、丁未丑進。甲丑士。未部廷試卒。甲午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"駿馬離羣局，人間將相才。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409350666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱無衝破，富貴命中該。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409367050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬庚會合時臨午，無破無衝福自來。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409383434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從此利名皆有望，貴人舉薦上天階。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409399818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日時臨壬午，支中官印俱藏，貴人禄馬更同郷，禍","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409416202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099865439027239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"患潜消福長。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409416202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅破刑衝不吉，柱中更忌空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409432586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將星天乙主榮昌，中暮家門興旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409448970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚日未時斷六庚日生時癸未，宫星魁制權星退。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409465354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中見已不逢丁，却能顯達得官位。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409481738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日癸未時，印財庫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409498122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚以乙爲財，未中入庫，用丁爲官，己爲印，未中巳丁，却有明癸制之。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409514506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱有己制癸，不透丁字，居官顯達。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409530890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無己透丁，爲禍百端，通火土運氣貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409547274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子日癸未時，年月無丁透露，有己土制伏癸水者","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409563658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099865439010855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409563658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己卯，鄭王賢誣發高。丁酉，益王三十六子。庚午，墻復正位。己酉。壬子，富戊申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅日癸未時貴，辰戌丑未，月高夏富，歲運同己酉申月身旺大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409580042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊子，汪俊尚書。辛巳，𭦌子拱都憲。庚申。辛卯。辛酉，王士翹都憲。戊子太守。乙亥，御史。癸巳。甲子。戊子。癸卯，憲副乙丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰日癸未時，魁罡日辰中有土制癸，年月無丁貴，卯月金水運，七品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409596426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099777706999835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午，舉人。壬子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午日癸未時貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409612810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉申己亥年月，總領兵戎，官至二品，先虛後實。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409629194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊戌，蔣詔侍郎。癸酉，潘仲𩥵編修。甲寅、甲寅，犯法問","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"
