{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099827996737571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌日癸未時，戍月東方運貴，辰月卯年大貴，秋生最吉，夏須西北運方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409661962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𨐋卯，李承勛尚書。辛巳，御史。壬辰。壬辰。辛王，劉以修，號九一，翰林四川人。丙申，寓福州。君子。鏡裏觀容局，喜中仍帶憂。雲開明月出，作事恐綢繆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日未時庫有財，鑰匙開處獨爲魁。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409678346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運至財旺生官地，富貴榮華不用猜。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409694730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日時逢癸未，喜逢丑戌榮財傷官背，祿庫難開，祖業盈全有碍，父母夭孤空尅妻遲子晩和諧。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409711114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行吉地免生灾，官旺財鄉通泰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409727498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099865439076391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚日申時斷六庚日生時甲申，歸禄帶財格最純。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409743882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丙與寅柱不見，功名富貴自然臻。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409760266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日甲申時，日祿居時，庚金申上見禄，甲爲偏財，柱中不通丙火，巳寅衝刑主貴有平常歲運同。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409776650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子日甲申時，時犯日祿見財星，柱無巳寅丙，富貴雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409793034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未土能生金，吉，寅午戌平常，申酉行火木運貴，寅亥三四品貴，卯刑子多㐫，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409809418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚戌孔子。此史記述之家語。又路丙戍御史戊子。史載己酉年癸酉月甲午。己未，李黙冡宰。丁未，彭黯尚書。己巳。辛亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099865439043623"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午，范惟一方伯。乙丑，洪己丑。庚辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"垣太守。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409809418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰劉存德副使，庚午楊以誠御史。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409825802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子辛己","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409842186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙亥，張星州牧。戊寅壬子徐生啓鎬。辛亥滄州人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳巳雙生，弟舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409842186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409858570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上諸公，皆有道義，故俱列名，豈亦同孔子之生而然耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409874954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅日甲申時，寅亥月，官至三品，丙寅通政，丙戊僉憲，甲子富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409891338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥庚子丙寅庚辰日甲申時，日魁罡又歸祿，俱不喜財官，柱無寅午戌丙丁巳字貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409907722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚寅丁亥，太守。戊子，通判。乙乙己酉，進壬子士。辛酉、丙戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099827996753955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳，劉堯翊御史。辛酉，官起倒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午日甲申時，貴，通身旺月，無丙巳寅午丁傷破貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409924106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子，頼學。己巳，大𠫭。庚午，黄甲，狀元。丙午士。戊辰、丁亥。甲寅舉人。庚午，孟時芳少詹。辛未巳卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申日甲申時，貴，無卯午未戌丙丁字貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409940490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑月金水運文貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409956874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余見庚申。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409973258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申專祿歸祿，堅金非火不能锻煉，故巳午戊月生者多貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683409989642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看歸祿有七法，勿以爲嫌，財月最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410006026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲戌，吳嘉會侍郞。壬午，武金都憲。己巳。丙午。庚辰，憲副。戊子，司業。戊辰，給事。己卯，州牧。乙酉、壬戊、庚申。甲戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099811261480996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑舉人，癸未武元，庚寅工郎㐫𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410022410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸卯甲申甲申丁酉，石星兵部尚書，卒於獄。一寒儒命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑子遣戍，東明人同鎭江人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410038794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌日甲申時，寅巳午戊月，妻賢子孝貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410055178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神白經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水帶印，主清顯之福。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410071562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙丑金尚。乙丑張大。戊午進士。己未舉人。戊寅書。丁亥𠫭。甲寅戊辰。乙卯，舉人。丙戌。庚日甲申時，刑衝事木奇。運行無破地，平歩上天梯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日祿居時喜遇申，柱中嫌巳丙和寅。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410087946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時來若遇高人薦，柳縁桃紅萬里春。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410104330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日申時爲主，是名財禄相扶，𤯔長清閑好詩晝，禀","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410120714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099811261497380"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性無嗔無怒，運拙農商工賈，時來職位遷除。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410120714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高人見喜小人扶，無破青雲有路。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410137098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚日酉時斷六庚日生時乙酉，金中相會化眞金。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410153482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中無火多剛缺，有火相成貴氣榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410169866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅日乙酉時，刑寅午戌吉，申子㐫暴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410268170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳，通政。甲寅，端逄赦。都憲。乙卯。丙寅。壬辰，元戎。己酉。丁丑，太守無子。癸丑。甲子，孫孟太守。丙寅。丁未進士，己巳舉人。甲申，林士章探花，尚書。癸卯己巳、丙子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰日乙酉時，刑寅卯午未年月，二品權貴，戌亥大貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410284554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神白經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化金主福厚。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410284554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁丑進士。甲子舉人。乙酉，張國彦尚書。𨐋亥。丙寅。戊子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午日乙酉時，刑中貴，寅午戌、亥卯未二局貴，巳亦","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410300938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099821428293683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410300938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王午，太守。丁亥，學憲。丁亥，蔡國珍尚書。丁未。癸卯。癸卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申日乙酉時，眞刑寅午戌大貴，巳𮠕丑中貴，申子辰富，亥卯未凋零","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410317322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410317322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯，趙司業丁未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌日乙酉時，刑後發，寅午戌官星明朗貴，亥卯未富，或五六品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410333706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑刃旺持權，主發迹於疆塲，武臣最宜，文臣，亦主掌兵權，究竟受羊刃之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410350090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙酉吳兊尚書一生員，命同辛巳俱浙人。戊申，李汝華尚書。乙丑，沈㴶閣老。乙丑。庚辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099865439092775"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午進士。庚辰。入海求珠局，天性富文章。君子陛官祿，士庻有財粮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元化合酉時生，生月之中見土亨，榮遇財官皆顯逹，功名利禄沐恩榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410366474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日時逢乙酉，就中合化眞金，財官運歩福源生，文秀聰明爲甚，不遇亥子尅妻，貴賤舉失胸襟，凡事後吉先多㐫，入品顯逹之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410382858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚日戌時斷六庚日生時丙戌，金火持争事不祥。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410399242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺月通印綬吉，不通無救禍難當。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410415626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099821428277299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日丙戍時，金火持争。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410432010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚以丙爲鬼，丙火戊土合局，金無氣，若通身旺印旺月有救取者貴，反是平常，或夭賤，運通亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410448394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚屬大膓，若丙丁旺甚，主痔漏臟毒膿血之灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410464778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子日丙戌時，春偏官用財吉，夏煞旺身衰囚暴，秋身煞俱旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410481162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑月，西方連腰金衣紫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410497546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅亥子月金絶病𣦸，多貧賤，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410513930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聾啞犬狼傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410513930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚寅，吳愼庵侍郞辛丑侍郞癸巳進士。丙戌辛丑。丙辰。壬午舉人。甲辰，魏兊中解元。㑹魁甲子常少。己酉。乙亥、丙寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅日丙戌時，申子辰月，偏官有制吉，秋生身煞俱。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410530314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099808275021858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺有祿權純午孤貧無倚，不然殘疾丑午行西南，公卿以上貴，純寅亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410546698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892822036534/1-c5347f7efa2f6a6a.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Zs6EaFr6L9wqPEzuFVj%2BLBa5e4M%3D","uri":"read/HY2121/3/ref/1kvzuubkokxsz/1-c5347f7efa2f6a6a.webp","fontType":1,"components":"勹丿丷勹丿丷阝","variants":"鄒","charPicId":"7456690892822036534"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應龍太宰。庚子，聞淵銓部。五子。戊寅甲申。丁未，黄宗明侍郞。丙午，江汝璧學士。癸丑、辛丑。乙未，鄭繼之冡宰。辛卯，方孔昭楚撫，謫戍。戊子辛卯。壬寅，廕郎。丁丑給事。癸巳，少卿。戊寅，舉人。己酉、丙午、乙丑。丙辰。戊寅，李勇總兵背義。庚戍，太守巨富，多子。乙丑，小人。甲申。丙戌舉人。戊子知縣。庚申，貧儒，無子。庚子、戊午、癸未。乙丑瞽一目，極貧。甲寅、庚辰木匠，癸亥㐫𣦸，丙戌年从無子。乙酉壬戌。壬午萬育吾少夵傳津總兵命同傳雍人。萬，冀人。癸丑庚生，雍則得地，生冀則太寒，傳宦西北，爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099863731945535"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"武臣萬宦，東南掌兵憲。萬三子，傳一子。年月不同，行運有異，中間懸絶如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰日丙戌時，時日相衝，憂傷妻子，月通金水氣貴，木火氣重者，艱辛，貧夭，或殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410563082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛酉，何遷侍郞。道學。壬午，御史。辛酉，御史。戊戌。癸丑。丙申。辛丑，蘇紫溪學憲。甲戍御史，壬辰進士。辛丑、癸酉、戊戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午日丙戌時，申西亥丑，富貴三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410579466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳午未申透出壬字，艮坎乾方運，卿相有壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410595850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙亥，吳道直侍郞。壬寅，大理。己亥，大貴。丁亥，癸丑，卿。癸酉。丙寅，次貴，甲戌享福，庚午舉人，壬午進士。癸巳、丙寅，丙戌、壬子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099870472208434"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己亥貧夭。丁丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申日丙戍時，戍亥年月，東南運貴，申月大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410612234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙戌，蔡茂春。會元。辛丑，官止副使。丁亥，𤎉使。己未，布。辛亥。甲戌，政。癸巳，推官丙子，推官甲戌，𭅺中。甲辰，例貢。己亥、丁酉，甲戍、丙寅。戊申，太守丙寅㐫，𣦸，乙卯、辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戍日丙戌時，辰戍丑未月，印綬生助吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410628618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰偏官有制，貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410645002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月通金氣，不透壬字，行北運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410661386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲辰，張甬川尚書。庚午。甲申，林爌尚書。丁卯。癸卯，金賁亨憲副，道學。丁未，府尹。丁亥，都事。甲子，三子俱進士。丙午癸卯。丙午進士。癸卯舉人。庚戌舉人。壬寅庚方寅伯。丙辰癸末。庚戍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099870472224818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰，周世選南兵部，壬子尚書。時上偏官局，身強最妙哉。秋生財鄉旺，福祿自然來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌時官庫最爲魁，丑戌相刑庫自開。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410677770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初主中年無顯達，没年晩景稱心懷。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410694154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日時逢丙戌，偏官倉庫埋藏，就中鬼賊不相當，身弱錢財虛蕩。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410710538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運旺身強發福，鴈行骨肉参商。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410726922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻重子晩免刑傷，老景封侯拜相。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410743306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚日亥時斷六庚日生時丁亥，官星失地自身衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410759690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不通月氣難成福，若見魁罡却妙哉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410776074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099863731961919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日丁亥時，庚以甲爲財，壬爲食，丁爲官，亥上丁火無氣，壬旺甲生，庚金失地，難任財食，若不通身旺月，不能成福。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410792458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通月氣，有陰土扶身者發財，官星有助，稍貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410808842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌、庚辰，此二日魁罡不宜財官生旺，時逢丁亥反貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410825226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子日丁亥時貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410841610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰月傷官勞禄，卯月金火運，五六品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683410857994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚申，進土。庚寅，知縣。丁亥、戊子。壬寅，顧可學原任𠫭議，以修養進身，官至尚書。甲辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅日丁亥時平，初貧中秀，末主富旺，辰戌年月貴","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564441651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099865439125543"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯，申酉亥卯巳午年月干透乙巳者，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564441651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚子，高公韶侍郞辛酉進士。丙寅富。甲申。辛卯、庚寅。辛巳舉人。辛巳舉人，乙巳極貴。壬午進士。癸巳、辛亥，甲由。庚戌。辛巳，舉人。丙申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰日丁亥時，純未顯達，巳午西北運，風憲金紫，亥卯金紫有權，申月建禄最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564458035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯，閔煦尚書。癸酉，郎中。甲辰，學士。辛亥、丙辰。壬申。戊辰，魏忠賢。乙卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午日丁亥時貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564474419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未月，土能生金，榮顯，申亥酉月行木火運，極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564490803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099865439141927"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑蔣瑶閣老，己卯，陳道基都憲，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564507187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸酉，丁丑、丁丑，尚書。戊午，布政。乙卯，太守。辛亥，太守。戊申、癸亥、己卯。庚子。丁丑，明經司道。丁卯，御史。壬戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉人","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564507187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己酉，庚戌。庚戌，癸巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李喬中丞","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564507187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁未，先令後貧𣦸。壬戌庚子貴，辛未貴，丁未、戊辰，貴，庚申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564507187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥、辛卯、戊午、壬午。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564523571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申日丁亥時，秋生南運貴顯，北運平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564539955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辰，李續尚書。丁丑，陸完尚書。通寕藩。己丑，癸丑，謫戌。乙酉，佟登元戎。甲申，副將。己巳，大𠫭。乙酉。丙寅。壬寅。乙未，御史。壬午貴。癸卯，貴。丁未，進士。丙戌，壬子，丙辰、癸丑。甲戌進士。己巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099863732043839"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌日丁亥時，辰、巳午月，官煞雖混，亦主武貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564556339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無衝尅破，福禄轉加餘。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564605491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥時逢庚日排，重重喜色照朱扉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564621875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃紅爛熳日時綻，一陣春風自顯威。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564638259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日時逢丁亥，柱中暗合三奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564654643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知子旺并三妻，父母鴈行可美。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564671027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳戊辛不遇，文章愽覧多知。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564687411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無衝無","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564703795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099870472241202"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破貴人提，終末亨通吉利。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564703795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日子時斷六辛日生時戊子，印綬學堂坐食神，不見丙丁同午破，必是榮華貴顯人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564720179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日戊子時，六陰朝陽，辛金子上長生學堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564736563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛以戊爲印，癸爲食，時上明戊暗癸，柱中不見丙丁，午字衝開，通身旺月大貴，犯者不貴，不通月氣，通運亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564752947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑日戊子時，丑月雜氣，財官貴，純丑儒職，純辰行西運都憲，酉月東北運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564769331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564785715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅月剌靣㐫，癸未","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564802099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099808275071010"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月受刑，癸丑月破敗孤㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564802099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙亥，孫慎都憲。癸酉，僕卿。辛丑，僉事。丙戌。乙丑戊戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯日戊子時，春生，寅貧，卯貴，夏清貴，秋羊刃無益，冬富，丑月尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564818483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、戌、未月，財官印綬俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564834867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神白經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云金火化主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564851251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌辛卯月父母㐫𣦸，辛巳月大破㐫，壬申月尸不全𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564867635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰都憲，庚辰御史，丁丑御史，辛卯進士。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564884019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰、癸未、癸丑、辛卯、乙未舉人，推官貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564900403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子舉人，乙亥舉人，己卯、壬子、乙卯、丙申舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564916787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉，劉一焜廵撫，己丑侍郎，丙申、庚寅、辛未。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564933171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉黄熈胤現太僕，壬寅正卿。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564949555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099868291137551"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳日戊子時，寅、巳午月，正官貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564965939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子傷官，子少妻多，卯戌五品貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564982323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神白經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金化象主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564982323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683564998707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅月刑平，乙巳月先貧，丁酉月夭","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565015091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙寅，尚書。癸丑，大𠫭。丙寅，同知。戊子戊戌，進。辛酉。丁酉。丁巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565015091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午，錢謙益探花侍郞。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565031475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戍丁亥，王及泉御史以訪異術，壬寅異人，陞侍講。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565047859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未日戊子時，貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565064243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅巳午酉年月火木運貴，亥子翰苑，辰戌丑未雜氣，財官印俱吉，忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565080627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申月尸不全𣦸，壬子月孤㐫，癸丑月㐫刑𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565097011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己未，彭鳯翰林。壬申，王國光尚。戊辰壬子書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099870472273970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子羅洪先狀元，江右人，松江生員，山東宗。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565113395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥室命俱同。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565129779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申郞中，乙卯御史，甲戍府尹，癸巳御史，戊戌、癸未、庚午、丙辰、甲戌太守，㐫𣦸，無子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565146163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅進士，癸亥學士。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565162547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑、辛亥、丁巳、癸酉太守。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565178931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己未，孟養浩南都院。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565195315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅丙子辛酉日戊子時，子酉月生，無丙丁火，不行南運，三四品貴，傷妻子，武職權重，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565211699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神白經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金火化主貴，破祖方發。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565211699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌壬寅月卤𣦸，辛巳月大敗祖㐫，庚戌月凶𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565228083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午，侍郞。丙子，侍郎。癸巳，元戎。丁卯。辛卯。甲寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥副使，庚子太守，甲子進士，丙寅大𭆞。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565244467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉、庚辰、癸酉、戊戊戊子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565260851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王凝侍郞，戊子學憲，丙戌中丞，乙丑、辛酉、辛丑，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565277235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099821428342835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊寅，宋師㐮府尹。乙亥，戊進午士。丁亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本年四月卒。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565277235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉侍郞，戊戌貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565293619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894708736063/1-8f7d717b56e74e77.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ExkymYzPEeW55HXIMaXVr3KkSfQ%3D","uri":"read/NA06725/6/ref/1knwquuuehp9h/1-8f7d717b56e74e77.webp","fontType":1,"components":"卜夕人","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690894708736063"},"logicSentenceId":"7577354683565326387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不全尸，丙申月失鄉惡𣦸，丁酉月失亡惡𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565326387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥日戊子時，不貴則富，亥月無官傷，官傷𥁞，發福，子少春夏。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565342771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子丑木火運局金紫，風憲","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565359155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸丑，尚書。壬午，胡杰祭酒。甲辰庚申，進辛士亥。丙寅。壬申，郞中。乙巳，太守，丙戌貴，巳癸丑亥㐫。辛巳、庚子、丙子。壬戍侯。丁未男女同，男遭刑。壬子女，丙午爲娼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099863732060223"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寒門生貴局，福祿自然彰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565359155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不犯刑衝破，陞遷到省堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565375539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元六辛子時生，春到花開燦爛明。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565391923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙巳午丁如破壞，功名難望晚方成。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565408307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日時逢戊子，六陰㑹合朝陽。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565424691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神印綬顯威光，相助一身榮旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565441075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳午逢之减福，丙離鴈侶尊堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565457459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻子勤助旺家庄，無破，寒門將相。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565473843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日丑時斷","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565490227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以下六辛日所忌月分同上，時犯併論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日生時己丑，金士持争勢不安。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565490227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月財官相救助，免交貧困受饑寒。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565506611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十日己丑時，金土相争，辛以巳爲倒食，丑上有明巳","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565522995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099863732076607"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暗辛歲月無財官救助者，貧困，得財官運亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565522995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑日己丑時，孤濁滯，生申酉月金旺，運行火鄉疏通，刑傷妻子，爲僧道貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565539379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純丑西南運，大貴","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565555763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午，布政庚戊，副使。丙午。壬寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會事。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565555763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊辛辰，巳，太，庚寅，守。辛酉。辛丑趙狀。戊子縣尹。丙申辛丑大𠫭。甲申元。甲㐫，子𣦸。乙未辛未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯日乙丑時，寅卯亥未等月，財星格，南方運貴，辰戌丑未印綬，南方運吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565572147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰，知縣。丙辰舉人。庚癸寅丑富，丁貴。酉丙戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳日己丑時，丑巳申酉月生金多尅木，損傷妻子，僧道貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565588531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯辰月南運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565604915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099808275103778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯明世宗皇帝一。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565621299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌代王，癸酉方伯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565637683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉云戊子時。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565654067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌甲子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565670451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯王邦瑞尚書，壬申舉人，庚辰檢討，癸未乙巳，戊寅甲辰封君。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565686835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥辛未日己丑時，寅卯未月財星格，巳午官顯，戊寅大𠫭，辛亥舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565703219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉龔用卿狀元。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565719603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯戊戌甲午。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565735987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉日己丑時，破祖。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565752371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑月，金多尅木，俊俏有財，難爲妻子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565768755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午月近侍貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565785139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丅卯尚書。癸未，王宗沐侍郎。辛巳，知縣。乙巳。甲寅、丁酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌知縣，庚寅進士。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565801523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳史埿小卿，𣦸於獄。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565817907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑甲申甲寅辛亥日己丑時，寅巳午月，官星明朗，立計成家，卯未","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565834291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099868291170319"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財局富貴，末戌衝吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565834291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰年月金水𣷉秀，佳𮠕建禄，行木火運吉，純亥金水𣷉秀貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565850675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己亥，王敎侍郎丁未進士。己酉進乙士。亥壬子。己巳。戊申舉人。甲申，知縣。辛亥，同知辛丑，通辛政酉辛未。乙未庚寅。倒食逢時上，財官庫内藏。時乖多險阻，骨肉且参商。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑時逢辛日險，財官埋没未爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565867059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六親骨肉多刑害，年月衝開富貴推。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565883443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日時臨己丑，總由倒食淹留，就中金櫃𦂳監收。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565899827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午未戌開成就，甲丙卯寅發福，癸壬亥子漂流。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565916211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少年謀望事難周，中末前程自有","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565932595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099821428391987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565932595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日寅時斷六：辛日生時庚寅，財旺生官遇貴神。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565948979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木局中通月氣，必爲榮貴富豪人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565965363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日庚寅時，貴人財官。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565981747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛以寅爲天乙貴，丙火爲官，甲木爲財，寅上丙甲旺，若通金木月氣，或通運，主富貴顯逹。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683565998131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑日庚寅時，春貴，夏官旺，秋顯達，冬吉，丑月南運風憲，或武貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683566014515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發，卽風疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683566014515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月酉申全無火氣，貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683566030899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辰，顧淸尚書。戊寅。己亥劉天。辛未和都堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099808275120162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬戌，御史。己卯，御史。己丑，郎中。丁未。辛亥。甲戌，丙寅。丙寅，沈演方伯。甲申，耿定向南京掌院。乙未。乙亥。乙酉，貧夭。甲申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯日庚寅時，午未亥子俱貴，寅卯申酉六七品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683566047283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云父早亡，多患風疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683566063667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸未，元戎乙亥太守。辛未舉人。丁巳卯未，舉人。丙戌、己亥辛亥。乙酉，舉人，丙寅進士。甲申、乙未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳日庚寅時，春貴，夏官禄，行西北運大貴，秋身旺，冬暴狠，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761557530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑後有財。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761557530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬申，太師戊午，丞相庚辰舉人。丙午、巳未。己卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099863732092991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未日庚寅時，巳未丑月，名標金標，妻賢子孝，晚年風疾，寅卯午戌俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761573914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅劉狀，甲戌壽，丁卯富，戊寅舉人，甲戌元。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761590298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午、丙午、乙卯、戊午孤貧，丙辰夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761606682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉日庚寅時，貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761623066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春財聚，夏官禄成，秋身旺，亥子丑戌午酉等年月俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761639450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙亥，吳三樂侍郞。丙申侍郞甲辰進士。己丑辛卯，丙子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉進士，辛酉㐫𣦸，壬寅依覔，丙辰吏科。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761655834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥、庚寅、庚戌、戊戌、己亥温純尚書，癸未舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761672218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未已未。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761688602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥日庚寅時，貴，主有暗疾，干透丙發，午酉寅亥年","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761704986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099870472306738"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月，南方運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761704986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙子，李幼孜尚書。癸酉，辛侍郞。卯庚子都憲。壬戌、己丑。甲子，大𠫭。戊寅，郞中。壬辰，庚午，主政。壬申舉。辛酉、庚戌、己酉人。辛未，都司戊戌，極富。己亥丁酉，㐫𣦸。乙卯、癸酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背暗向明局，平生志氣高。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761721370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官年月上，蘭蕙出蓬蒿。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761737754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛之日遇寅時，財旺生官互換推。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761754138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運拙利名應蹇滯，若行財禄更無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761770522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日庚寅時，遇弟兄，骨肉生疎，雙親祖業靠難成，鴛侣中年迷鏡。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761786906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥癸坎壬减福，丙丁巳午馳名，春生冬産貴人欽，中末榮華之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761803290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099821428441139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日卯時斷六辛日生時辛卯，妻子難爲遇比肩，秋産冬生貧下格，丙臨寅馬却當權。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761819674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日辛卯時，比肩分財。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761836058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛以乙爲財，卯上乙旺，遇比分奪，損傷妻子，生秋冬財官無氣，平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761852442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅巳午月，干透丙火，丙合辛生，官貴顯達。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761868826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯懸針煞，柱多不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761885210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑日辛卯時，春夏生土厚地方富貴，秋尅妻刑子，冬艱辛寅巳午月近侍貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761901594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌年月木火運，風憲","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761917978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申，尚書。壬辰，查布政㐫𣦸。甲申，御史。辛丑。庚戌、丙子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099821428457523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚申進士。辛丑，耿定力南掌院。乙巳丑卯庚寅進。戊子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761917978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯日辛卯時，寅午戌月，財官雙美，貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761934362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉申辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761950746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月近侍，貴見官印財星，妙云先苦，中年大發。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761967130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午徐閣，癸酉嚴世蕃","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761983514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以恩蔭至侍郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯老，丙辰罪大，惡極典刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761983514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午余元立翰林。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683761999898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥鄭紳尚書，乙丑丙子","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762016282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子，方伯丁卯進士。辛巳，御史。戊壬子。己酉。辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午年卒，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762016282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲戌，知縣甲子，憲副。己卯憲副。辛丑己巳。憲壬申，丁副卯辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯御史，己酉夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762016282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳日辛卯時，春財旺，夏官旺，秋身強，冬懦弱。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762032666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉年月，行木火運貴戚；申月水火運金紫，己月西北","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762049050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099868291252239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762049050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙亥𤎉憲辛未辰運，戊午年㐫𣦸。甲戌丙申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未日辛卯時，純未丁年月雖大權貴不善終。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762065434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅己亥純吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762081818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸未，趙鳯尚書。辛酉，傳鎭都憲。丁巳。庚寅。乙亥，殷士儋閣老。戊申進士，知州。乙酉。甲子。甲子，知州乙亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉日辛卯時，出身孤苦，中年獲福，末年封妻蔭子貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762098202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳月官印逢天德，貴當一品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762114586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月木火運中貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762130970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉亥年月，東南運風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762147354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099870472323122"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙酉張居正閣老，十年専政。丙子戊申布政。辛巳運末，壬午年𣦸，歲運衝故。戊午。辛卯舉人。丁亥，花應期狀元，侍郎。丙子行内申。辛亥縊𣦸。星案傳辛丑人。甲辰，孫嘉績進士，職方郎，才學俱佳。癸𮠕明末官至侍郞。辛亥，王國侍郞。辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥日辛卯時，春夏財官雙美貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762163738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬背禄逐馬，勞碌反復。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762180122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純亥金水𣷉秀，多發高科。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762196506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌吉，丑未尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762212890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛巳吳桂芳尚書一云：乙酉汪道崑侍郞有戊戌庚寅時己丑文名。乙丑，錢四窓御史，㐫𣦸。丁亥，范應期狀元侍郎。丙戌辛亥縊𣦸。原本傳己未，御史。辛丑，舉人。戊寅，御史。丙寅，御史。壬申、癸巳。壬戌。丙申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099868291268623"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"羊刃刼財局，皎月有盈𧇊。財祿中年聚，鴛佀恐傷悲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二辛遇卯禄分明，比刼逢財事不成。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762229274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏人生財禄旺，秋冬刑害命中平。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762245658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日時逢辛卯，二辛分奪妻財。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762262042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鴈行鴛侣少合諧，獨立自成無碍。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762278426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月財星生旺，忻然禄自天來。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762294810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行比刼事沉埋，火木運中通泰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762311194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日辰時斷六辛日生時壬辰，傷官傷𥁞倍精神。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762327578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱火虛防尅害，九流技藝卜醫人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762343962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日壬辰時，暗金沉水底，辛用丙爲官，壬爲傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762360346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762376730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099821428490291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水庫，丙辛無氣，壬水合局，若年月透丙，是傷官見官，刑禍百端。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762376730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲人氣高誇大，秀而不實，不通月氣無倚托者，爲人反復成敗，爲醫卜藝術。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762393114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱有木火，身旺，行東南運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762409498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑日壬辰時，春顯逹，夏平常，有名利，主暴虐。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762425882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉月行東運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762442266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌未四庫全，最貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762458650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純未雜氣財印，丑未衝開，主有權貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762475034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸未，王繼津侍，巳未郞。癸酉，殷正茂，巳未尚書。戊申進士。甲申觧元。壬癸亥午。劉堯誨尚書。戊辰巳𮠕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯日壬辰時，春財旺，妻賢子孝；夏傷官見官，然亦","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762491418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099821428473907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762491418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋吉，冬孤尅，多貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762507802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰，給諌丁卯進士。丁卯進士。乙巳貧生。辛亥、丙午。癸丑。壬午。壬申，何棟如進士，仕途起，戊申倒至南兵部主政。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳日壬辰時，春傷官生財，夏行藏反復，或㐫暴，午未亦奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762524186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋申酉身旺，得火則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762540570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬亥子傷官傷𥁞，有木土爲妙，貴重清高，未免刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762556954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未主武貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762573338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙酉，羅欽順状元。丙午，孫應奎尚書。戊子，名臣。辛丑，剛直。庚午進士。丁丑進士。癸丑，錦衣。己卯、丙午、丙辰。戊辰，𠫭戎丁巳，府尹。辛酉。丁未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099865439207463"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未日壬辰時，身孤。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762589722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春生財星格吉，夏勞碌，秋貴，冬傷官，傷盡爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762606106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚申，禮部尚書。甲申。壬申，楊𤎉侍郞。戊申。丙戌，王廷戊戌，聲侍郞。壬午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉人","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762622490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛未，知縣。丙午。庚子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子張秩翰林，早，乙丑卒，乏嗣。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762622490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉日壬辰時，春富貴雙全，夏好，秋身旺貴，冬白。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762638874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁子月辛生地學堂，主文學，年月火濟貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762655258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌月三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762671642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚子王己卯九庵尚書。丁巳王仲山僉憲。壬子子進士。丙子太守乙酉舉人。辛巳癸舉人。乙酉巳辛巳刑人。癸巳乙酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099868291334159"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己酉崔恒謙敗子甲申年乙亥，以投賊被刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥日壬辰時，貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762688026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春財旺扶身，夏吉，秋身旺好，冬傷官傷𥁞，自立自成。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762704410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯未年月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762720794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁亥，許國大學士。戊辰，太守。己酉，郎中。丁未，乙丱。癸酉。壬子進士。丁卯侍郎。癸巳舉人。戊午舉人。癸丑、丙午、壬戌、壬戊。甲戌閆汝梅江都人。丁酉舉人，戊辰進士。庚午刑部主事，篤厚君子。丙寅，張居正閣老母。壬辰。細水長流局，六辛總屬陰。運行財旺地，官祿自來臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日干時壬辰，鎻閉財官事未能，不通匙鑰兼壓伏，自古難𤼵少年人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762737178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099868291317775"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日壬辰時，遇傷官傷𥁞爲奇，祖業父母早難爲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762753562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鴈行分飛無意。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762769946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏財官生旺，東南方運施爲，自謀自立作家資，不得親人之力。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762786330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日巳時斷六辛日生時癸巳，貴氣無傷官印強。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762802714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月氣有通兼倚托，早年榮貴姓名香。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762819098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日癸巳時，官印扶身。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762835482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛以丙爲官，戊爲印，癸爲食神，巳上丙戊健旺，癸合化火，赤白文章。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762851866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有倚托，通月氣者顯逹。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762868250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月不通，運通亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762884634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑日癸巳時，㐫别父母發福，春夏吉，秋冬卤暴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762901018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099865439240231"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化貴戒酒。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762901018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊戊魁元，戊辰進士。丙辰，張懋修狀元。革。癸亥、丁巳。癸巳。辛卯，刑人。乙未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯日癸巳時，春夏身弱壽促，秋身強，勞力辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762917402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如月氣火木，三四品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762933786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙寅，郞中丙午進士。乙亥，郞中丙辰進士。甲午、辛卯、甲申、乙未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳日癸巳時，化貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762950170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午年寅午戌月貴，亥卯未清貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762966554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰無義之人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762982938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳癸巳，兩干不雜，寅辰透丙，俱主極貴，丑酉三合亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683762999322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙子，吕純陽。丙辰，富弼，鄭公名臣。癸巳，神仙丙寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099865439223847"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳冦凖萊公名臣","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763015706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳考道書：吕公生天寶十四年乙未四月十四日。己時考宋史，冦公七月十四日生，魏野詩云：何時生上相，明日是中元星家傳俱誣。壬午，太守甲戊胡朝臣，通𠫭沈束。甲戌、己巳。王子、甲戌，二公俱淹獄。戊午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元戎，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763015706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥舉人，庚子進士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑庚申、己卯辛未日癸巳時，寅午戌月高命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763015706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑身旺平𥡷，申子辰白丁，亥卯未清貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763032090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己卯鄒尚，丙午太守。甲子張潤，錦衣極富。辛未書多。丙申乙亥子壽不六旬。己未進士。戊戌，荒迷失家。庚午、巳未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉日癸巳時，貴顯酒色重，寅卯財旺，吉丑三合全","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763048474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099884556681256"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763048474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬寅，太守辛巳，富貴。丙寅，憲副。癸卯。辛丑。乙未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥日癸巳時，時日併衝，憂傷妻子，春財旺，夏吉秋平，冬㐫暴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763064858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉午年月，木火運，風憲都堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763081242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙戌，湛若水尚書道學。癸酉，布政。辛巳，僉憲。己亥。庚申。戊戌。己未，郞中。壬申。辛干時對局，官印喜相逢。不遇刑衝破，騰身到帝宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳時逢辛日干，柱中獨喜顯財官。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763097626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行禄馬無刑地，金榜題名歩御鑾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763114010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日時臨癸巳，春生財旺鎡基。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763130394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁午年最爲奇，破","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763146778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099870472372274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅刑衝不利。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763146778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸庚申無破，功名富貴爲的。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763163162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻賢子孝兩相宜，刑破巳時不利。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683763179546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日午時㫁六辛日逄甲午時，暗鬼梟神眞可畏，若無倚托反勞生，莫道六辛逄馬貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807694894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日甲午時，鬼旺身衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807711278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛用丁爲鬼，己爲倒食，甲爲財，甲午木𣦸則神無氣，丁巳健旺，雖見午爲天乙貴，平生反覆，縱通旺氣，亦貴不永。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807727662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生火土月，西方運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807744046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑日甲午時，未申年月，四柱有刑害，雖富壽夭通","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807760430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099884556664872"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金，雖貴不永。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807760430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙辰布政，壬戌進士，丁酉進士。甲午、癸丑、丁未官生同。壬辰，郞中丁未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯日甲午時，卯月武貴，寅戌破祖，不然殘夭，巳午七八，品貴運同。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807776814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙午，舉人。庚子，周王癸巳。甲午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳日甲午時，平寅午戌官旺，吉，申子辰平常，卯戌年官印雙全，公侯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807793198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸酉，𠫭政辛亥，縣尹。辛巳，楊成尚書。戊午。丙申，己亥。壬辰㐫，𣦸乙巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099868291366927"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未日甲午時，申子辰偏官有制，吉丑戌方靣，未月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807809582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁未，歐陽鐸侍郞。戊申甲戍，御史。戊午，舉人。甲戌甲寅。甲子，張居正閣老父。壬辰舉人。瞽。丁丑庚戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉日甲午時，春財旺，夏官貴，俱吉，秋身強，雖富不永，冬平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807825966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午，薛文清公從祀。乙卯，己舉人。己廟廷。丙寅。庚戌，紀正時以羣飲，行封侯令，被寺。壬午，僧首謀反，棄市。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥日甲午時，亥子年月，金水𣷉秀，文學堪誇，辰戌丑未雜氣，財官貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807842350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099870472388658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁亥，揚尚。癸亥，趙文華，尚書。王子書。巳未，嚴嵩黨。四意三心局，謀爲事滯疑。雖然財禄聚，擔是又擔非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日干時甲午，財神無氣不相當。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807858734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春生木旺財官運，一路滔滔姓字香。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807875118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日時臨甲午，妻財無氣身衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807891502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干強火旺爲鬼胎，火重金柔煉壞，最忌用神傷損。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807907886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金沉海底生灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807924270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無刑無破趂心懷，貴重光明廣大。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807940654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日未時斷六辛日生時乙未，火木相成金不畏。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807957038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月通金氣與春榮，財旺生官身自貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807973422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099863732142143"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日乙未時，天財入庫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683807989806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛以乙爲財，未土入庫，己爲倒食，丁爲正鬼，未上有暗丁，己被明乙制伏，不能爲害。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808006190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若通己酉丑月者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808022574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通火行西運，通金行南運，俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808038958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑日乙未時，刑亥卯未寅月，財旺生官，不貴則富，辰戌丑子","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808055342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690888941961270/1-c70ad44fb344fa8e.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=RZlleMreo6m6UEpurRXRUhpn3V0%3D","uri":"read/HY1496/6/ref/1kozzeifpqqzq/1-c70ad44fb344fa8e.webp","fontType":1,"components":"亻且八","variants":"倶","charPicId":"7456690888941961270"},"logicSentenceId":"7577354683808055342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808055342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙未，林省吾侍郞。己丑，御史。辛丁酉亥，學士。甲戌。戊戌。壬申胡汝霖都憲，丁卯進士。壬丁未午舉人。壬子、己酉。丁丑舉人。戊辰，舉人。庚寅，舉人。乙酉、戊申，諫庚垣申。癸未。丙戌。丙寅，陳紹儒尚書一監生命。庚寅，南海人，同，江右人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099868291383311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯日乙未時，亥卯未月，財盛生官吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808071726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛未，舉人。己丑，李國𬃩元戎。辛卯辛未，以失機𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳日乙未時，月通金火貴，運通亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808088110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲寅，易學。壬寅，大𠫭貪鄙。癸酉，憲。癸卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未日乙未時，寅卯未年月，財旺生官，名高禄重，通火氣行西，通金氣，行南俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808104494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸未，蔣冕閣老。丙寅，布政。丁酉，主政。乙卯。丙申。壬寅。甲寅，沈儆价𬉌撫，戊子進士。辛未乙卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉日乙未時，月通火氣，行東運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808120878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未最吉，亥卯貴顯不久。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808137262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
