{"lines":[{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋生身太旺，財官無氣㐫夭","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808153646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099900528590886"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己巳，歐陽紳納指揮，陞都司，陣亡。己巳甲戌，官生，蔭指揮子進士。戊辰巳未進士。乙亥。辛亥日乙未時，亥卯未月，財星格吉，秋冬孤獨，辰丑近侍三品。戊辰貴，己酉觧元，甲子、丁丑。偏財時旺局乙木庫中丑戌藏相，𮞦處功名翰墨香。未時辛日庫門開，卓立家成自發財。金木運中身旺吉，幾經險過福重來。辛日時逢乙未，庫中透出偏財，運行木金，忌身衰，丑戌之運通泰，經歷初年發福，鴛幃抵敵無灾，榮華富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099900528623654"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴命中排，無破爲官清泰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808153646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日申時斷辛日生時遇丙申，月通金火轉精神。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808170030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化成金水逢金地，聚福能爲富貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808186414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日丙申時，丙辛化水，申上長生，若月通己酉丑金氣者，精神秀麗，文章聚福，通火氣旺，有倚托者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808202798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉、辛未最妙，不成化象，申上官星無氣，平常衣禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808219182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑日丙申時，化貴，少年蹇剥中貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808235566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥月作化氣看吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808251950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戊巳未月，官星有氣，春財旺倶吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808268334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099935731351552"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉進士，辛酉貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808284718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰進士，己亥貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808301102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥、戊戌、庚申、壬申辛卯日丙申時，化貴，寅巳午未戌酉亥月，官星明朗，山明水秀，登科榮貴，通土氣亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808317486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一云：少蹇中未好。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808333870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申，舉人。辛亥，太守。乙未。戊戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳日丙申時，見血則福","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808350254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，中失。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808350254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申未年月，身厚，妻重子孝，武職三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808366638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊戌，侍郞。庚子，大𠫭。乙酉，元戎，辛亥，太守。甲子、戊子、甲申、甲午。丁巳周狀。丁亥巨富。乙巳進士，知州。庚戌元。壬寅辛巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未日丙申時，因貴人門下得富，春清貴，夏平常，秋","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808383022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099868291448847"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富，冬大貴，壽促，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808383022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神白經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水乖合，又化水主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808383022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己巳陸𣗳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868491419687/1-65ac8201d90499ff.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=y%2F6HtBmOugr2hnGRaubpB%2FjZeIY%3D","uri":"read/NA06804/2/ref/1kobikqzrhvec/1-65ac8201d90499ff.webp","fontType":1,"components":"士厂耳殳","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690868491419687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"會元尚書，壬戌太守。己卯進士。丁卯，壽九十七歲。丙午癸酉。甲午舉人。丁丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉日丙申時，寅巳午未戌月，官旺榮貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808399406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神白經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水化主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808399406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己酉，太守丁酉，巨富。庚午、己酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥日丙申時，發福，防孤尅帶疾，通金氣，主人秀麗，福厚，通水氣大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808415790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛亥，侍郞壬子，進士。甲申，學憲。癸未，太守。丙申。癸丑。乙亥。乙丑。乙未，馮銓閣老。壬午，薛國觀由外官入。己丑癸卯閣，賜𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099863732174911"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚戌，知州丁亥。合化天元局，冬生福有餘。時來隨貴顯，金榜把名題。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日良時遇丙申，天元化合得其眞。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808432174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬生若也無刑破，貴顯當登要路津。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808448558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日丙申時，遇長生禄馬希奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808464942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元化合顯光輝，職重名高威勢。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808481326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子文章上立，常人榮旺家基。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808497710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生時眞定却無𧇊，運喜西南東地。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808514094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日酉時斷六辛日生時丁酉，鬼破禄元禍百端。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808530478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倚托身強方斷吉，月通制伏是偏官。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808546862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099870472421426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日丁酉時，火金持争，辛金酉上健旺，見丁爲正鬼，酉上丁長生，破禄不成，其福反復，成敗身強，通月氣，有制伏者，作偏官論，更行身旺運貴，通金氣，無丁身強，行南運大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808563246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑日丁酉時，高平𥡷，酉月木土運方靣戌亥子巳未年月大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808579630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子，張岳侍郞癸丑進士。辛巳舉人。庚戌，名臣。癸亥辛丑。壬午，宗室乙未，以假印論𣦸。乙巳庚辰，狡脫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯日丁酉時，時日併衝，月通金氣，不透丙丁，南方運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808596014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099900528640038"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子，王凌侍郞。癸酉。戊寅，憲副庚辰進士。甲子乙酉。丙子，吳宗逹探花，己亥閣老。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳日丁酉時平，亥月反復不定，午月偏官帶疾，顯達壽促，子月貴戚，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808612398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有財有害，壽不過三十一。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808612398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子僉憲，辛巳同知。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808628782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥舒化尚書。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808645166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅辛卯、壬子","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808661550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辰，廕郞謫戌。丙子舉人。戊子、戊戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未日丁酉時，不貴則富，月通金氣，無丙丁字，行南運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808661550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉戴大賔編修考戴公自云：庚戌生附於壬申朱文公，己酉恐非惜不禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808677934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛丑主政，己未，富。辛丑，丙子丙申，壽踰下歲。庚子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099884556697640"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛西日丁酉時，年月通金氣吉，丑月西方運，風憲，寅午戌貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808694318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲辰，衛承芳尚書。壬戌方伯。庚申進士。甲戌、丙午、己卯。乙卯，楊錦經畧尚書。戊寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥日丁酉時貴，丑寅卯酉年月近侍金紫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808710702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙午婺源人中浙江舉人，名胡正隨，中北瘍舉人。己亥名正道，中南場舉人，名王國昌𠫭革。己亥，太守巨富。辛未，無子。時上煞生局，天元莫見官。身強財祿運，貴顯歩金鑾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉時辛日等同倫，出户相迎喜事新。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808727086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不遇刑衝空尅破，何愁富貴不加身。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808743470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099935731367936"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日時臨丁酉，偏官合局相投。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808759854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁重見生淹留，嗣息女多男少。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808776238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祖業殘花秋暮，遊人皎月雲收。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808792622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身強官旺福優游，運至財官大有。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808809006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日戌時斷六辛日生時戊戌，印綬生身坐𬓈堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808825390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有托𮂨人難靠祖，不通月氣是平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808841774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日戊戌時，禄同印堂同居。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808858158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛以戌爲祿堂，戌上有明戊爲印綬，以丙丁爲官，戌上戊土正位，丙丁火局，若有倚托，通月氣者，難爲祖業，不通平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808874542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑日戊戌時，刑害辰戌丑未，印綬行南運，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808890926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808907310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099865439305767"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳正官貴，子午卯酉，武職風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808907310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰，閣老壬午，布政。戊辰，太守。辛巳，舉人。甲辰、庚戌、甲寅、辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯日戊戌時，刑害饕餮，亥卯月木火運，五六品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808923694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛卯，襄王。丙子，霍冀尚書。丁未，布政。甲午辛卯，壽六十。辛亥。丁酉，太守庚寅，通判。丙午。戊子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳日戊戌時，辰戌丑未月，印綬文貴，少病，生土厚分野貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808940078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月行木火運，風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808956462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁丑，伯。乙亥，大参。己丑，高時給事問𣦸。丁未。壬午。己丑。丁未進士。庚申舉人。甲寅，周應賔禮部侍郞。乙巳甲申丁卯。乙未，曽朝節探花，侍郞，己亥，知州。甲申、丙子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099863732207679"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未日戊戌時，𠒋惡狠暴，憂傷妻子，寅巳午戌丑月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808972846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰亥，金水𣷉秀尤貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683808989230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅父母，身旺中年富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809005614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬申，王國光尚書。乙亥。甲子，壬子，少卿、副使。辛巳丁丑。辛未，副使两干不雜。甲戌。戊戌，御史。壬午，主政。丙寅庚戌。辛末舉人。甲寅甲午舉人，丁卯㐫𣦸。丁丑庚戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉日戊戌時，㐫刑己酉丑辰戌未年月，魁元卿尹之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809021998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙子，萬士和尚書。己巳巳待郎。丙亥辰御君吏子。癸酉庚寅。戊子太守丙寅進士。戊戌未知縣。辛丑舉巳。辛丑、庚卯，乙未人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099923790200871"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸丑少卿己卯中庚戌科進士。丙辰、丙寅，本年卒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥日戊戌時，卤狠機謀，奸猾計較。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809038382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云㐫，後發。乙酉，進士。甲申，舉人。丁亥㐫𣦸。戊辰，御史。戊寅。壬申、乙巳、辛酉。辛卯，伯己丑御史。乙未。丙寅。官印臨時局，早年事莫諧。末中時運至，倉庫自然開。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日戌時財庫閉，如開須待丑辰來。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809054766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月年甲丙天干透，富貴榮華不用猜。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809071150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日時臨戊戌，五行財祿榮昌，柱中辰戌兩相當，名曰鑰匙開藏，火水光輝發達，空亡鎻閉如常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809087534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行財地併官鄉，無破天然福相。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809103918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099935731384320"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日亥時斷六：辛日生時己亥，背祿剥官反破傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809120302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如作飛天祿馬貴，失時無合空忙忙。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809136686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日己亥時，飛祿合局。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809153070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛以丙爲官，亥上有旺，壬傷，故官無氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809169454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如再得亥月或亥日，以亥衝出，巳中丙火爲官星，若是辛酉、辛丑合局貴，其餘辛無合，不通月氣，無倚托，貧下有倚托吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809185838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑日己亥時，辰戌丑未及寅卯月生，作飛天祿馬貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809202222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月金水運，金紫方靣。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809218606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙亥林𤎉使合飛天格。辛酉喜東南，丁亥運亦貴。丙申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099923790217255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙丑兩司辛酉進士，甲辰中庚午科舉人。丙戌、戊戌、丁卯壬午遇難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯日己亥時，寅卯亥未月，財旺生官，終身有慶。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809234990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丁年月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809251374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁丑，郞中。辛丑張學。乙卯舉人。辛卯，給諫。壬寅，己亥士。戊子丁酉。壬戌，進士。癸卯，京卿。戊申，下賤。壬寅。辛酉。甲子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳日己亥時，塡實巳字，不入飛天格，作官印論，主父母竭力扶持，而後富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809267758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯，明世宗在位四十乙丑，沈良材侍郞。己酉五年，丁卯年崩。己丑。癸未諸大受狀元侍郎，一孤寒，丁亥知州。甲子癸酉年卒命同壬寅。甲子，貴天丁卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099863732240447"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未日己亥時，貴，亥卯未寅月，金能尅木爲財盛，生官，名利貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809284142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳午年月富貴，秋生透丙亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809300526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊寅，秦鳴雷狀元。丙午，觧元。丁酉，大𠫭。乙卯、丙申、壬子。癸亥，汪道崑父受，癸卯進士。甲戌解。乙丑，侍郎封元。辛酉、己巳。辛丑，田闢僉都。戊戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉日己亥時，辰戌丑未，雜氣財官吉，純亥衝巳中丙火爲官貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683809316910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁丑舉人。辛亥舉人。辛酉，鄭辛綱侍郞。亥。辛丑。己亥。丙子，趙錦尚書一高僧命。庚子副辛使。卯同四川人。己丑。庚午，宋鳳翔觧元。庚辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099923790266407"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥日己亥時，年月再亥，飛天禄馬，三四品貴，武職極品侯伯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683962884122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅巳塡實則减，子辰年月亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683962900506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸丑，御史壬辰進士。辛亥，進士。丁亥，布政。乙卯、戊申。癸巳。乙巳。甲子主政甲戊郞屮，己丑舉人。甲寅伯。乙亥、丁丑、己巳。庚午。丙辰，學道。庚辰司訓，壽七十。庚寅丁亥。苓芝出草局，親靣各支離。守舊難成就，平生自作爲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日天干己亥時，梟神背禄主灾虞。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683962916890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無衝發福亦不重，禄馬飛天貴自殊。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683962933274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日時臨己亥，梟神背禄同宫，好如缺月被雲籠。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683962949658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬巳甲寅無用，父母完全不睦，殘花結果防風，若無尅","logicSentenceId":"7577354683962966042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099870472470578"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破與刑衝，飛天祿馬福重。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683962966042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日子時斷六壬日生時庚子，子上明庚暗損傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683962982426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土月中仍主吉，不通𠒋狠只平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683962998810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日庚子時，刃旺身強。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963015194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬以庚爲倒食，癸爲羊刃，時上明庚癸旺，若通火土月氣制伏，庚癸大貴，不通𠒋狠平常，通運亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963031578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子日庚子時，辰戌丑未月，雜氣財官，巳申丑酉印綬居土厚，分野俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963047962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月金水運，近侍金紫；午月行西運，六品，子運敗㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963064346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若純壬子羊刃貧㐫，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963080730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099900528672806"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少年富，三十五後艱，辛末大富，忌辛巳月㐫惡𣦸，辛亥月大㐫，甲子月刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963080730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己卯，司冦。癸酉，侍郎。癸酉，李邦珍都憲。癸酉。乙卯己未。甲戌銓部甲申，嚴清尚書嘉興人。一平常命。乙亥己巳同北直人。甲子張狀。辛卯葉夢熊尚書，世襲一王孫。乙亥元。庚寅錦衣，命同。庚申袁宗道㑹元。戊午舉人。甲寅舉人。己卯，春坊。戊午、丁卯。辛丑，副使。戊戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅日庚子時，貴而刑，辰戌丑未月雜氣財官，巳申酉月印綬俱貴，忌乙巳月受刑，丁酉月大破祖惡𣦸，乙亥月刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963097114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099927451828265"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙巳，方獻夫閣老。癸酉，侍郞。庚午，布政。庚辰、甲寅、己丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰孫丕揚冡宰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963113498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰宋德成戊午舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963129882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰原本傳。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963146266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳乙亥遇難，乙亥舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963162650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963179034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰日庚子時，若寅午月生財星旺，辰戌丑未官旺俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963195418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純辰透庚，壬作壬，騎龍背格，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963211802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌丙辰月夭𣦸，尸不全。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963228186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未月破祖孤，辛丑月大破刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963244570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰趙丞，乙酉大𠫭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963260954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌宋儀望都憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963277338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辰相，甲申丙寅，庚戌經魁，己丑舉人，甲子中，辛亥宫壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子戊辰戊辰𣦸，戊戌。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963293722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬寅，吏目，八十九，猶健。癸酉工科。癸酉貧㐫。戊申、壬戌，乙丱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子小捎尚書，辛亥進士。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963310106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申己亥","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963326490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099884556746792"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午日庚子時，時日併衝，女多男少。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963326490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未月行南運，富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963342874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘年月觀諸貴命可見。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963359258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌甲午月自刑，多是非。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963375642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉月大破，失鄉，惡𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963392026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥月惡𣦸，","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963408410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛酉，僉憲。丁卯，僉憲。戊子，元戎。乙卯，主政。己酉。己丑。乙酉。甲午。癸卯，袁封君子宗道會元，宏道中道。丙寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉人乙丑俱進士。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963408410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫彭年進士，乙亥癸丑舉人，丙申武榜。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963424794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戍庚寅壬申日庚子時，貧刑未月雜氣財官，行財旺運，貴顯，先難後易。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963441178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰會水太旺，須行火土運吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963457562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑戌財官印綬俱吉，春冬平常，秋夏吉慶。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963473946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963490330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳月受刑天，丁酉夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963506714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥月孤，自刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963523098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099923790233639"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰夏邦謨尚書，壬午侍郞，己亥進士。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963539482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁丑丁未戊辰，己卯，進士。癸未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳萬言","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963555866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"翰林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥戊午壬戌日庚子時夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963555866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月金火運，辰未財官格俱貴，寅酉行西北運貴，申子辰行東南運，極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963572250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963588634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉月孤單㐫，丁亥月㐫刑惡𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963605018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑月刑","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963621402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰，鲁省吾尚書。庚午，邢一鳯探花。壬子後削籍。戊寅。乙丑，進士。丙戍。舟重沙灘局，颶帆待順風。幾畨㐫險處，遇吉又亨通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963621402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963637786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日時庚子，梟日由來遇刼財。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963654170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運弱妻兄防尅害，運強財祿自天來。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963670554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099923790282791"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日時逢庚子，刼財倒食留連，運行比刼事憂煎，財禄不能通顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963686938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鴈佀雙親失意，妻兄遲則團圓。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963703322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官運歩福滔然，祖業從新改變。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963719706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日丑時斷六壬日生時辛丑，下有官星上印綬，如通月氣運西南，官印扶身，人清秀。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963736090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日辛丑時，官印得位。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963752474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬以己爲官，辛爲印，丑上金局暗已得位，若通月氣，爲人清秀，祿貴安𥡷，不通主性僻詭譎。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963768858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子日辛丑時，己酉丑月印綬多，受父母蔭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963785242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申月火","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963801626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099870472486962"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土運，近侍有權，辰戌丑未，有官有印，丰餈曠達，名播天涯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963801626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戊月財破祿印不成局，平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963818010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥申年月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963834394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙辰，布政。丁亥，給諌。戊子，御史。壬子，小貴。丙申、戊申。辛酉。辛亥。丁卯，舉人。辛巳，富。丙戌，陳祖苞大𠫭。庚戌，甲午、丙申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅日辛丑時，丑月雜氣印綬高，辰巳煞強無制伏，財官身弱辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963850778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸未，給諫癸巳進士。癸酉，知縣。丙申，都間。乙丑巳未。乙丑。辛丑。壬辰，孫丕揚冡宰，無子。丁酉，董裕尚書。甲辰，無子。星案傳乙巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰日辛丑時，辰戌丑末，雜氣，財官印綬俱吉，春平。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963867162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099884556763176"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏財禄，秋吉中有㐫，冬身旺，須行南運方顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963883546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛丑，范文正公。辛丑布政。辛丑。丙申。丙申，潘旦都憲。戊辰，秦鳴夏修撰。辛丑，丙辰。庚寅，鄭洛尚書。辛未，李天寵都憲，㐫𣦸。丁亥，丁𮠕。辛未，耒宗道禮部尚書。戊戌，祝大舟御史，謫戌。戊戌、丙辰，中書，命同。甲子進士。辛未進士，戊戌舉人。丙寅、戊戌、甲寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午日辛丑時，禄馬同鄉貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963899930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏吉，秋財官印全，亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963916314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙辰，憲長。癸酉，僉事。己巳，太守。戊辰，給諌。丁酉。戊午。癸酉。丁巳。乙未，劉臺御史効張，居辛亥，鄒元標進士。効張，戊寅正謫戌，卒。丁酉，居正官至冡宰。己丑魏時春南刑部尚書，江右人。一無錫生員，丁丑，一四川吏，命同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099935731482624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉貴戚。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963932698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅鄧以讃㑹元探花，庚申辛亥侍郞。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963949082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申日辛丑時，寅卯亥未年月，進士風憲，官至二品，終有起倒。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963965466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌富足，申酉享用自然，行北運亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963981850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳未，鄭曉尚書。慱雅。庚寅，曹熈學士。丙寅。丁亥。丁酉附馬。丁未進士。戊申，封官。甲戌公。戊申庚戌。甲寅。壬申。癸亥，黄承玄廵撫。壬午，練國事廵撫。謫戌。辛酉。壬寅。己巳，舉人。丙辰，刑人。丁酉、戊辰、庚寅、辛亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌日辛丑時，辰月衝開財官貴，丑戌亦吉，柱有乙癸，卯字平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683963998234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙寅，何洛樞宻。乙酉，侍郞。己未，主政。戊戌。己丑，辛未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099927451910185"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子，梁封君子夢龍。辛酉伯，乙亥，尚書。癸巳。時臨官印局，身弱且如常。欲要功名顯，財官運歩昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日干辛丑時，官印相生事事奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964014618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月更通金土旺，爲官清貴定無移。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964031002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日時臨辛丑，財官印綬其中。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964047386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知開庫鑰匙通。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964063770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳相逢火重，癸卯乙字减福有遇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964080154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍虎相衝，只争遲早攺門風，富貴承恩拜𠖥。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964096538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日寅時斷六壬日生時壬寅，水火相逢旣濟論。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964112922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水木月通財禄貴，不通無救是常人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964129306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099927451992105"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日壬寅時，水火旣濟，壬用丙爲財，甲爲食，寅上丙生甲旺，壬水無氣，若通水局，有倚托，皆貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964145690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不通無救，福薄。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964162074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅日健旺，主大富，如不通月氣亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964178458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子日壬寅時，純子，年月無午衝破，入飛天格，富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964194842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯巳、申酉戌亥年月俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964211226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛巳，方良永尚書。庚寅，憲。辛酉。戊戌，都𤎉使。乙酉。辛卯。壬子，少卿己未，主政乙巳，進士。丁丑，知丁未縣。丙寅丁亥。乙巳。丙寅，李太。丁酉，貴戚。庚寅，貴戚。壬子庚大貴，子后。壬子。戊寅。壬子。癸卯，孫鑛㑹元，南兵部。辛巳，納貴。辛丑，丙伯辰尚書。丙申。戊戌。癸巳進士，庚子舉人。丁巳庚辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099935731417088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅日壬寅時，壬趨艮格，土厚地方，山明水秀，腰金衣紫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964227610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥年月，武職三品，富厚純篤。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964243994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年午月行北運金紫，巳月行西北運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964260378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未亦吉，純寅尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964276762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964293146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云中年貴，五十後大厄。戊午銓曹，丙申正鄉，壬寅韓都憲一氣生成丙辰丙申壬寅一巨富命同。壬午，進士。癸巳，林狀。戊辰，剌史。丁卯，舉人。戊申，甲子元。丙辰甲寅。癸酉張志發淄川人，由丙戌大富。壬辰刑人。甲子，刑部侍郞入閣。乙未甲辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰日壬寅時，純辰壬，騎龍背格，干頭無丙丁戊巳運，行比肩大貴，純寅大富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964293146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯戌月木金運，三五品貴，午月平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964309530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099927451959337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申，方純尚書。甲戌，僉憲。乙丑、癸亥、辛未、庚辰進士。甲子，許穀㑹元侍郎。戊辰極富。辛巳舉人，丁未舉人。辛丑、丁未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰劉楚先禮部尚書，己卯謝陞閣老。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964325914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑癸酉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964342298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯程國祥選郞高品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964358682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未，林釺探花閣老。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964375066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑壬戌乙卯通判。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964391450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964407834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午日壬寅時，少年多疾厄。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964424218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午禄馬同鄉，辰寅年。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964440602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月二品貴，申酉高尚。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964456986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若通木火，才名冠世，貴戌月行東南運，方靣極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964473370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚戌，盛端明尚書。庚寅，丞。壬申。丙戌，相，太守。己丑壬子。甲辰，胡儼祭酒。辛未，太守。辛酉。丙寅，御史。庚子。甲午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099884556845096"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅沈思孝庻吉士，戊辰舉人，戊戌舉人，辛亥侍即，無子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964489754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酒壬戊，丁亥㐫𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354683964506138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子壬申日壬寅時，己酉丑月，武職三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684071936027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯戌月亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684071952411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子寅大貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684071968795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧而發亦不久。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684071968795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申，蔡天祐侍郞。辛亥，郞中，壬辰進士。甲午壬寅、壬子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯進士，乙酉舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684071985179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午韓邦域進士知州。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072001563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌、戊寅、甲寅甲辰被弑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072017947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌日壬寅時，己月偏官格，名標金榜，身坐玉堂，純子三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072034331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯行北運，風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072050715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又六壬日見壬寅時，名白太虚，貴不久，盛而禍生。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072067099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥，閔如霖侍郞。甲子，京卿。壬寅，大𠫭。辛酉，丙子，戊申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099927451975721"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戍同知，壬申憲副。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072083483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅易應昌掌院","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072099867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子，壬子，壬戌、庚戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"御史。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072099867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙酉壬日壬時局無官亦有財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅辰重叠見，富貴自天來。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072116251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬逢虎是浮漚，富貴功名莫強求。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072132635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有印有官爲上格，驟然財禄免憂愁。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072149019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日壬寅時，遇比肩相遇食神，弟兄鴈侣少同羣。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072165403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是生時定分，坐局運行官地，身強禄位超倫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072181787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身衰刑害禍相侵，衣禄平常之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072198171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日卯時斷六壬日生時癸卯，引歸𣦸地勢難安。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072214555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099923790299175"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼財煞刃見傷鬼，倚托若無常命㸔壬日癸卯時，身𣦸刃生，壬以癸爲刄，卯爲暗乙而傷官鬼，卯上癸生，乙旺，壬𣦸，不通身旺月氣無救助及倚托者，夭賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072230939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑月，印旺無化者，性僻孤高虛詐，通身旺，見金氣，行財運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072247323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官傷𥁞，行南運亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072263707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子月癸卯時，子卯相刑，憂傷妻子，貴人提携，財帛盈餘，敦厚之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072280091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙丑，副使丁卯，舉人。丙申，盜典刑。癸未。壬寅。辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅日癸卯時，背財敗禄，或興或廢。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072296475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子年月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072312859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳月","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072329243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099900528705574"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官雖刑亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072329243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未，官煞制刃俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072345627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子倪岳尚書，己卯經歴。甲子年𣦸。己巳名臣。丙寅。丙子，觧元。癸巳，都督。戊戊巳未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰日癸卯時，通身旺月，見土金破刃，行財運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072362011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛酉，田汝成學憲。壬申，給諫。乙卯，僉庚事子。癸丑己卯。甲辰，太常卿丁卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午日癸卯時，壬居午位，祿馬同鄉，又値卯時，貴顯榮逹。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072378395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳午年月，武職風恧","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072394779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺中破。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072394779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸未，唐一麔觧元。己丑，平章。丙戌甲寅，敎巾投進士𣦸。丁卯甲申。乙未，劉臺御史劾張居正，謫戍。壬午，復官。戊寅，贈少卿。一云壬申日辛丑時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099884556877864"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑吳性侍郎丁丑壬申日癸卯時，亥卯未寅月，傷官傷𥁞，妻賢子孝土厚貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072411163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純辰醫卜，子月水木貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072427547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙午，李太后戊戌，真德秀名儒。庚子。壬戌。丙午，王象亁兵部尚書。甲子，周廷侍進士。庚寅五十年宦途。癸酉。辛丑，舉人。辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌日癸卯時，甲癸午酉年月，文貴，申平常，金火運。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072443931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072460315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁亥舉人。乙亥舉人，丁亥百戶。丁未、己丑、辛亥。刼財傷官局，早年事沉埋。生來財不聚，用𥁞復還來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099934955421747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸相逢見卯貴，刑衝破害不周全。月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢二德兼身旺，改禍爲祥樂自然。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072460315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬日時臨癸卯，敗財背禄相逐，平生反復事疑遲，水到東方失位。須有貴人救助自身，文福難齊祖財骨。肉有盈𧇊，命主晩成，先廢。六壬日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰時㫁","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072476699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六壬日生時甲辰壬，騎龍背坐食神。柱中有托無刑害，必是榮華富貴人。壬日甲辰時，亦爲壬騎龍背壬，以甲爲食神，辰上壬水合局，甲有生氣，食神，旺相通日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者，富貴福厚。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072476699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099884556861480"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月行卯運，不利。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072493083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子日甲辰時，純子年月飛天，禄馬無破，六卿己酉大貴，亥亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072509467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子尚書壬寅尚書甲午進士，丙申舉人。壬子、壬子、己巳、辛丑。丁丑進士。丁亥，舉人。甲午，陳大科右都。庚戌、壬寅、辛未。丙辰，趙拱極南都。戊戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅日甲辰時，巳月偏官格，不衝不破，貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072525851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午正官貴，辰卯局全，東方少年登科榮貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072542235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅陷極貧，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072542235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙寅，馬森尚書。丁酉，太守。乙卯，運使。庚午。丙午。丁亥。甲寅，府丞。癸卯，元戎。辛丑，舉人。壬寅，富。丙子。丁巳。戊戌。壬寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099934955454515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚寅，衷貞吉南兵部。乙未，劉甲申尚書。甲申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若宰狀元，甲辰壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072542235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅壬辰日甲辰時，辰月生壬騎龍背，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072558619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月不貴卽富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072575003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月雜氣財宫衝開辰庫高命，子月斷根損葉，成敗不定。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072591387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月金水運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072607771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一云：水火灾少孤，又云：有財自刑失。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072624155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子，曹一𩿾庻吉士。戊辰甲辰，齊王。庚辰，揚閣。丁巳丙戌，老辛丑，進士。戊寅，庚給諌。甲辰寅，運使。庚辰，辛𠙿。通丁判卯。庚辰。壬寅貴，戊戌進士。丙壬午，子，一品。戊夫人，無子。午己亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅富，戊申㐫𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072640539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰癸亥","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072656923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099927452024873"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午日甲辰時，水火灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072656923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅辰年月，翰苑宿儒，或居祭酒，純子風憲，卯寅富厚，辰子儒職，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072673307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑㐫惡𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072673307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙丑進士。乙丑，盛古泉少卿。巳未主政。癸酉、庚辰，丁亥多子。丙申，觧元。壬辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申日甲辰時，水火灾，丑寅年月，文行武權，純子金火運方靣。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072689691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳，周佥尚書。丁巳。丁巳，副使。辛亥，副使。辛亥。戊戌。乙卯進士。辛未，大𠫭。丁酉，徐學古副使。癸卯、己丑、庚子戊申運，辛巳年卒。丁酉，甲部。癸亥舉人，己巳，觧元。庚戌癸亥，壬申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099935731466240"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌日甲辰時，寅申酉月，行南運，貴戚。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072706075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未、申子辰巳午年月俱吉，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072722459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有財孤。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072722459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙子太守。乙酉太守。辛亥，進士。戊辰，元戎。庚子。甲辰。辛卯。甲子。丙午土際亨，丁丑進士，授南和令。半己亥月内遭失城之變，論法得免。壬騎龍背局，辰多官禄重，禄馬自然豐，寅多比石崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時遇甲辰壬日干，喜神重疊福多端。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072738843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時來早晩功名就，運至申辰作顯官。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072755227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日甲辰時，好，青龍入廟爲高，猶如蘭蕙出莲蒿，水木滋生榮茂。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072771611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時日衝開庫𦔽，自然成就窩巢。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072787995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行吉地逞英豪，貴顯親人難靠。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072804379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099927452041257"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日巳時斷六壬日生時乙巳，身絶有財不聚財。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072820763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進神暗鬼來相尅，透己相刑是禍胎。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072837147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬曰乙巳時，財旺身絶。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072853531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬用丙爲財，戊爲鬼，庚爲倒食，巳上有乙木爲傷官，丙戊健旺，庚金長生，壬水氣絶，柱有己官，禍患百端，傲物誇高，若不通身旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072869915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月無救助者，貧，有倚托通旺，或行身旺運，皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072886299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子日乙巳時，貴，但難爲妻子，性格剛強，不受擊觸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072902683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌年月純煞有制，行木金運，官至三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072919067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申，布政。甲戌，侍郎。癸酉，進士。庚午，中書。甲戌。甲戌、乙卯。壬午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099884556910632"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辰，劉存業榜眼。庚戊、戊子、乙酉，知州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅日乙巳時，孤高，刑妻尅子，如爲僧道富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072935451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅副使，戊寅主簿，乙巳陳于陛閣老，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072951835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬戌、甲寅、己丑壬申，王思善辛丑科進士宴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午日上馬，破卵而亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072951835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰日乙巳時，春平，夏財，秋𥡷實，冬無助救，主貧苦","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072968219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸未周孟尚書甲寅辛酉進士。甲申舉。甲戌、己巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072968219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳同知，有壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684072984603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子壬午日乙巳時，辰戌月貴，亥月金運，位至都帥。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073000987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲辰，敖銑祭酒。癸戊酉，御史。辰。戊午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申日乙巳時，身坐長生學堂，財帛進退名刊驅馳。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073017371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099900528754726"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月行北運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073033755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、戊丑俱吉，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073050139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手足折傷，自刑𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073050139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙辰，元帥。癸末，夏漢壽都憲。辛亥，尚書。庚寅、辛酉、戊戊。甲戌，大𠫭。癸丑，副使。庚午，進士。己亥，舉人。癸酉，乙丑。丙戌。戊辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌日乙巳時，寅年月人日德格貴，辰戌丑未貴，秋印，夏財官俱吉，春傷冬旺，看干透何如，亦可取貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073066523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙酉進士。丙戌知縣。丁未舉人。丙申進士。庚辰、甲午、壬子、丁酉。丁酉，趙参魯庻吉士，謫典史。癸丑，歷陞尚書。壬日乙巳局，柱中莫見官兄之防，不足刑害事多端。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日時逢乙巳臨，謀爲未遇且沉吟。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073082907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099900528787494"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人舉薦財官旺，子嗣鴛幃不一心。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073099291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日時臨乙巳，傷官背祿無取。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073115675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然天乙貴人扶，貴顯遇而不遇，謀望云爲，反覆，生平實事成虛。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073132059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時來發逹攺門間，猶似旱苗得雨。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073148443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日午時斷六壬日生時丙午，聚財之地坐胞胎。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073164827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月逢金水須富貴，棄命從來是就財。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073181211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日丙午時，禄馬三奇，壬以己爲官，丙丁爲財，午上丁己是祿馬，壬水受胎，有倚托，通金水月氣，就財棄命，主富貴，通火氣亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073197595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099927452057641"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子日丙午時，公直撑持，孤高而貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073213979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月子午字重，水火旣濟，極品","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073230363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺中，失傷妻子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073230363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰，太守丙午，大貴。戊戌，女命夫子進士。乙巳壬子、癸亥。己酉，舉人。乙亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅日丙午時，寅午戌月，財星格，但𭒡身弱，宜僧道吉，秋生印綬，冬身旺，行金火運金紫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073246747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛酉，侍郞。癸亥，觧元。辛未，何如𠖥閣老。庚子，乙卯辛丑。乙卯，同知乙酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰日丙午時，寅午戌月，財旺大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073263131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊辰，尚書。己巳，舉人。丙申，大𠫭。乙丑、癸酉。壬辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099884556927016"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午日丙午時，冬月身旺吉，夏財多身弱，丑月近侍貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073279515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午金土運，獨弱從強，棄命就財高命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073295899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊辰，𡊮煒會元，探花。己巳，郎中。庚辰僉。癸亥，閣憲，老，無子。己巳、丁亥。丙午，丞相。丁亥。太守乙亥，巨富。庚子，壬子。壬午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申日丙午時，通金水月氣貴不通，棄命就財主富，不然極貧下。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073312283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙亥，温如璋都憲，癸巳進士。丁亥中，己丑書。庚申戊申。丙午，富，癸巳。壬戌，富，丙午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌日丙午時，寅月三合財局，棄命相從，富秋身有托，貴冬亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073328667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099935731580928"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁酉，黄初榜眼。己卯，廖逢時都憲。戊申、戊辰。戊辰，霑弘詢刺史。富。辛巳僉憲。乙亥，舉人。庚申，子貴。庚寅、己卯。祿馬同郷局，身強財禄昌。常人能發福，君子坐朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午時生壬日強，時中禄馬不尋常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073345051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行吉地無衝破，早晩陞遷到省堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073361435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日時逢丙午，亦名禄馬同鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073377819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就中旣濟見文章，志氣寛洪海量。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073394203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不遇刑衝破害，自然財禄盈箱。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073410587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行財旺及官郷，定是朝中宰相。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073426971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日未時斷六壬日生時丁未，夫化妻從格局奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073443355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099935731564544"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是局中通水木，發財發福兩相宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073459739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日丁未時，夫從妻化，壬合丁未，上同木局貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073476123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月通木局，有倚托者，發財，不通，但有資助，因妻致富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073492507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子日丁未時，月通木氣，貴通金氣，富，通火土氣，富貴兩全。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073508891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不通行火士運，亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073525275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰，王狀丁𮠕節度。丙申，辛剌。庚亥寅元子舉壬人。丙申。戊子，壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貢士午巳壬。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073541659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅日丁未時，丁有化木，亥卯未寅月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684073558043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚子進士。戊寅，知己縣。卯甲寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰日丁未時，辰月生壬，騎龍背局貴顯，寅月妻重","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172599322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099923790381095"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子榮，三合水局，身旺無倚，多貧尅妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172599322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳，御史壬午，進士。甲午，刺史。辛酉。癸卯。乙亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午日丁未時，春平夏富，秋貴冬吉，巳午年月，位至王侯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172615706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月東運貴，子月正印，三奇俱藏，貴當極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172632090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲戌，楊二清閣老名臣。乙亥郞中。壬子進士。丙子，無子。癸未壬子。庚午富，壬申㐫，戊戌廕郞。壬午，壬寅、乙丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申日丁未時，大富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172648474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳午年月，或透戊巳，富貴雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172664858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙卯，監丞。乙酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌日丁未時，日德封妻蔭子，中年又損妻子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172681242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子申酉月貴，巳午不貴卽富，辰月天月德貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172697626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099934955503667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己卯，劉斯潔尚書。丁丑大𠫭。丁丑戊辰、甲辰、癸卯舉人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳給諌，丙午進士，辛卯貴，丁卯長史，丙子丙申、丙申、壬子、丙子舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172714010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小徃大來局，家門慚漸興。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172730394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一朝時運至，名利自然成。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172746778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日時逢丁未臨木化成林忌見金。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172763162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月若還無破害，必敎富貴福彌深。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172779546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日時臨丁未，就中暗合妻財好來丑戌鑰匙開，收樍錢財廣大。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172795930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月尅衝不犯，天然衣祿安排。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172812314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鴛幃子息早年乖，中末依然亨泰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172828698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日申時斷","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172845082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099923790413863"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日生時戊申，長生之地鬼傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172845082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身強制伏爲高命，反此定知貧薄人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172861466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日戊申時，水土混濁，壬以戊爲鬼，庚爲印，申上庚金健旺，壬水長生，戊土偏官，身鬼俱強，爲人勇暴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172877850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若通旺月，行身旺運，有甲木制伏者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172894234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不通聰明不貴，再行鬼旺運，難爲顯達。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172910618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子日戊申時，羊刃帶煞，貴人提携，巳午年月，近侍有權。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172927002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙卯，史際少卿富用。丙午，副使。甲戌，副使。甲申，江南。戊戌、丁亥。己丑，通判。丁巳，大貴。丙申，京棍。乙亥。戊子。乙未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099923790397479"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅日戊申時，時日相衝，身孤爲僧道吉，如寅午戌或純辰年月亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172943386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁未，元戎戊寅，吳。丁未。甲寅，遠都憲。丙戌，同知。庚子。丙辰，大𠫭。辛亥，中丞。乙未，甲駙馬。乙午卯。壬辰，癸御未。甲申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"史乙酉周憲主事由寒儒，四十後中有己卯好子，以八字四衝難㸔。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172959770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰日戊申時，戌月生，早登科甲，官至方靣。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172976154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯丑申、子午等年月極貴，武職一品，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172992538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸丑，劉文靖公健。戊寅。乙卯，曹金侍郞名臣。庚申。甲戌，張松總制。戊戌，四壬十申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五歳殺𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684172992538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子。己酉，張問逹冡宰。辛亥，甲部。郞戌。甲午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099923790446631"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午日戊申時，偏官偏印，亥卯未寅月威權，子丑月木火運，翰林清貴，戌月行東南運，高品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173008922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙寅，張秉壼侍郎。辛未，户垣。辛丑。丙申。辛未，林大欽壬辰狀元，一舉人。庚子丁酉卒，命同。丙子，元戎問𣦼庚子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申日戊申時，壬水長生居申，煞旺身強，更生亥卯未月，偏官有制吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173025306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁亥，董堯封都憲。癸丱侍郎。戊子，𤎉使。癸丑。壬戌、丁巳。壬申舉人。壬申貴。甲子武元。丙午、甲辰、己巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌日戊申時，破滯多蹇，純酉巨富，若不通身旺月，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173041690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099900528803878"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行煞旺鄉不吉，有甲制亦可。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173041690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
