{"lines":[{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳土重，主瞎疾平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173058074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊午御史。庚辰舉人。庚子，成德進土部郎。甲子，𣦸。壬午庚辰，崇禎之難。癸巳宣國柱庚辰進士，當癸亥年授科，當年謫。巳未，逆奴丁卯。申時壬日干，身旺不貧寒。大名通虎榜，險處發財官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申時壬戌合天元，運去財官福自然。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173074458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼旺身衰無救助，平生勞碌不週全。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173090842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日戊申時，顯支干煞旺雙全，喜逄辰子兩相連，正合衣錦局靣，被害刑衝尅戰，就中文福艱難。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173107226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行吉","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173123610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099935731646464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地紫泥宣，富貴妻多子健。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173123610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日酉時斷六壬日生時己酉，明官暗印有扶持。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173139994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月通身旺人清貴，猶恐戀花貪酒巵壬日己酉時，敗處逢生，壬水酉土沐浴，辛爲生氣印綬，酉上辛金旺用己爲官，酉上有明已，若通月氣，有倚托，行財官運貴，反是平常，但犯桃花坐命風。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173156378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流人物戀花貪酒壬子日己酉時，春平夏吉，秋常冬旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173172762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月生，好花酒。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173189146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099935731630080"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子吳阿衡侍郎。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173205530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子壬寅日己酉時，大富貴，喜通水氣，行官運貴，但好花酒，風流人物。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173221914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲辰，孫狀元閣老。癸未舉人，己未舉人。甲戌、乙丑、丁丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰日己酉時，高月同日，壬騎龍背，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173238298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳月行東北運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173254682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁未舉人。己未，趙堂典膳。五子。癸亥。乙亥，大富。乙未進士。丙戌。丙申，吕坤尚書。戊戊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午日己酉時，禄馬同鄉，先難後易。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173271066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑寅月行金水運，武職二品，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173287450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破祖㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173287450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099934955536435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊戌，桂蕚舉人，閣老。丙申，副使。癸巳，貴。壬戊、己亥、巳未。辛酉，程䡄侍郞。庚寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申日己酉時，官印臨門，局中無衝破，禄馬雙全，不貴卽富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173303834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月生東南方運，腰金衣紫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173320218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午，魁元。壬申，劉狀。甲午，陳思育祭酒。丙午己酉元。己巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌日己酉時，亥寅子月，行財官運，貴顯非常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173336602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純亥文貴","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173352986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午，趙賢尚書。戊子舉人，己卯舉人。丙寅、丁巳、丙寅。官印臨門局，無衝福禄全。東西須稱意，南北自安然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天干。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173352986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日酉時，眞攺禍爲祥遇貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173369370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099934955634739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不爲官封品級，晩年享福旺家門。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173385754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日時逄己酉，正官印綬無偏，榮枯貴賤是因縁，人自生成便見乙。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173402138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯衝破尅，駁雜財官减半，迍遭富貴不雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173418522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"差了生時難辯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173434906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日戌時斷六壬日生時庚戌，身臨財庫却爲魔。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173451290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明庚暗戌相刑尅，財禄生平聚散多。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173467674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日庚戌時，梟臨財庫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173484058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬以丙丁爲財庫，於戌庚爲倒食戊偏官，若通火木月氣，有倚托者貴，不通財帛聚散。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173500442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099935731662848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子日庚戌時，名利進退，庚辛年月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173516826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰丑刑衝，酉月破害，財庫得用，巳午財官旺俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173533210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙巳，太守乙酉進士。甲辰，指揮。丙申，指揮。庚辰、己丑。丙子。辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑忘恩負義。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173549594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅壬寅日庚戌時，刑妻尅子，若春生平，夏冬吉，辰丑未月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173565978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌太守，戊戌布政。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173582362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子沈幾觧元，進士。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173598746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑甲子，壬戌知州。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173615130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰日庚戌時，夏月不富則貴，春平秋穩，冬辛勤勞苦，或爲僧道，有財刑破。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173631514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099927452106793"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午日庚戌時，禄馬同鄉，壬自坐禄，有庚辛制甲乙爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173647898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未年月吉，申月學堂，文貴大顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173664282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子水旺，透壬主㐫，午戌透戊，煞旺亦㐫，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173680666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云名利進。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"退駁雜。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173680666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙亥，張守直尚書。甲申丙戌，丞相。戊子，侍郞。壬辰戊戌。壬辰，知縣戊子，都督。丁卯，白手成家。無子。辛亥。乙丑辛亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申日庚戌時，通火木月氣，富貴不通，行通運亦好。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173697050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑戌年月大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173713434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙子進士。丁酉。胡頥尚寳丞。癸巳進士。丁酉。戊申。甲子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099934955618355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙戊蔡茂春會元，三河縣籍，閩縣人。戊申元戎。辛丑。一松江生員，一江南僧。命同戊午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌日庚戌時，不利妻，主被妻妾害，反覆成敗，純戌貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173729818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅丑武職，申月長生學堂，修文多貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173746202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥月建禄，干透財官，卯月傷官，干透財星，俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173762586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月雜氣財官，丑戌相刑吉","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173778970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙戌，太守。戊辰，太守。辛未，太守。丙戌，元戎。庚寅、庚申。丙申、己亥。以失。巳未尚寳。戊戊守俻。丙午進士，知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縣城。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173778970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙巳亥，棄市。甲戌，卯。清濁難分局，運拙等時來。少年若發福，財庫鑰匙開。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬庚相逄戌時生，庫有財官鎻閉門。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173795354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"究竟無頭多反覆，功名到底似浮雲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173811738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099980107104308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日時逢庚戌，支干倒食難容，財官印綬，庫内封無鑰，不能取用。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173828122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑酉辰逢作福，更逄丁巳成名。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173844506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但怕尅害過刑衝，駁雜如常之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173860890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬日亥時斷六壬日逢辛亥時，印禄相随最是奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173877274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官不見無衝破，得路青雲報爾知。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173893658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日辛亥時，日祿居時，無尅破，有倚托，柱中不見財官，富貴顯達，行東運大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173910042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若通氣减福，南方運不貴巨富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173926426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子日辛亥時，主父毋不得善終，後發不富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173942810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯年","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173959194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099986784419903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月，文章進身大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173959194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1839","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木命貴，土命有財。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173975578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1841","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申，何洛文禮部。癸巳，御史。庚寅，太尉。辛丑，侍郞。壬戌。壬午。癸丑，饒景暉南兵。壬子進士。丁卯。㐫。壬戍，部侍郞。壬子。壬寅。申辰貧，丙寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅日辛亥時，艱難中發，未月雜氣，財官敦厚，中年貴，五十後終。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684173991962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥月東南運方面。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174008346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未李幾尚書，乙未凌相都憲，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174024730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1845","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙子庚辰，己卯，大𠫭。己卯，御史。丁酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進士，乙巳舉人，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174024730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1847","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛未甲戌，乙巳。乙𮠕丙戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"都司，己卯選郞。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174024730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午乙亥。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174041114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰日辛亥時，秀貴惡𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174057498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月干頭無己土，青雲得","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174073882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1852","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099934955667507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路，若有甲合爲去官留煞，三四品貴，𮠕月亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174073882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥蔡魯公一命同十，壬寅九歲溺𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174090266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未趙王縊𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174106650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申侍郎，己酉長史，乙亥乙亥乙亥","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174123034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1857","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁巳，蘇志臯都憲。辛卯太守。己巳辛亥觧。辛卯，丁卯，元。癸巳，郜光先兵部尚書。壬寅，王學夔尚書。壽。乙丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1858","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868267843595/1-c40a80e6d8e6913b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=FSvIhJCpCu6vIgoWNx0%2FyG4rNIM%3D","uri":"read/HY0741/18/ref/1ko7tci7o1gxs/1-c40a80e6d8e6913b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"⺊夕人","variants":"死","charPicId":"7456690868267843595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1859","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"後破棺被戮。戊申十三九。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯㐫棍，甲戌夭，己丑卽𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174123034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥壬午日辛亥時平。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174139418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月風憲，寅月禄馬同鄉，行金水運方靣。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174155802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月東北運，四五品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174172186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑午僧道官命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174188570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1865","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳，朱希周狀元，尚書。丁丑，潘晟榜。巳未眼，尚書入。丁未，閣辭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未尚書，丁亥司徒，乙丑僉憲，乙卯舉人，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174204954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1867","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099884556959784"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子主事，壬午給諫，戊申進士，己巳進士。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174204954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰庚戌、壬戌、甲戌、辛亥鄒元驃家宰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684174221338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申褚太初檢討以横。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277456906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉丙寅富，賈祸，棄市。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277473290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌甲部，壬子京卿。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277489674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申王佐侍郞。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277506058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌辛亥戊子壬申日辛亥時，貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277522442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未雜氣，財官吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277538826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月干無己土，入日祿格，酉月申卯年，行東北運，顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277555210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯御史，乙丑御史。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277571594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午、辛巳、癸未丙子陳粉左都掌院。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277587978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一南京人，甲子御史，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277604362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1880","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁酉，江右人，平常，命同。乙亥己巳給諌。庚子進士。庚辰，主事。辛酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"侍郞","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277604362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1882","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲戌，壬午、己卯，丁丑辛未，舉人。庚戊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277604362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未楊起元。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277620746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1885","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"翰林侍郞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰己丑、庚戌壬戌日辛亥時，少年富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277637130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥申巳戌年月，二二品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277653514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1888","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099934955651123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純戌水火運金紫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277669898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1890","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午，胡錠侍郞。癸亥，黄養蒙侍郞。丙寅。乙丑。壬子，大理。辛酉，布政。丙申，周用，都憲。己酉，卿。辛丑。戊戌。壬寅，韓雍都憲名臣。甲申，副使。丙寅，大𠫭。辛亥。丙子。辛丑。甲寅，郞中。庚午，御史。丁巳，舉人。己卯，沗將。乙亥。壬午。丙午。丁卯。丁未，魏允中閣老。壬辰。禄馬交通局，時來名利全。無刑衝尅破，平地可登仙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辛㑹遇亥時推，白玉休嫌出見遲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277686282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生祿馬無刑破，抛却麻衣掛紫衣。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277702666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日時臨禄馬，又爲印綬同郷，水從金木自然強，此","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277719050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1894","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099900528869414"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命極高爲上。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277719050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸乙暗合咸福無衝破顯文章，積玉堆金滿屋堂，蔭子封妻之象。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277735434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日子時㫁六癸日生時壬子，青雲得路最爲奇，若無己土衝尅破，自有功名顯逹。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277751818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時癸日壬子時，日祿歸時，癸水子上建禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277768202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年月干支無戊巳午未字刑衝破害，三元有倚托，通月氣者，文章秀麗，官職顯達。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277784586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若通木氣月亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277800970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如柱透己有甲合亦貴，否則反覆。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277817354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑日壬子時，午寅、乙丑、己丑年月，文職四五品，通","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277833738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1903","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099980107120692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺木氣，月無戊巳午巳字，顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277833738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未風憲，巳午進士，忌壬寅、乙未、庚戌月俱刑，乙丑月下賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277850122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1906","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬戌，太守。壬子，御史。庚辰，主事癸巳，進戊中士。癸丑辛巳庚申。辛卯進士。辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯日壬子時，時日相刑，傷妻尅子，近貴，無巳土威權，若亥巳倶全，進士烏府。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277866506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月純寅，傷官生財，非大貴，卽大富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277882890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌甲辰月㐫刑，孤，丙申月㐫惡，𣦸，己丑月刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277899274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1910","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬寅極品一富。壬寅命同。壬寅，戴燿尚書。庚戌。壬午舉人，乙酉南科，癸亥貧，戊午㐫，癸丑、戊寅，癸亥、辛酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1911","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099962591674419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳日壬子時，春夏發財福，辰戌丑未，不貴終富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277915658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌戊寅月遭刑，戊申月受刑，己酉月乞丐。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277932042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅御史，庚寅副使。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277948426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申湯封君子賔尹㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277964810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申乙酉庚申元榜眼。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277981194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑褚國賢武進人，癸酉丙戌科主政。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684277997578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑魯史餘姚人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278013962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯甲辰科主政。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278030346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己未憲副。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278046730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑癸未日主子時，申酉月貴，戌亥大富貴，寅卯孤，辰巳㐫忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278063114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申月身不全㐫，庚辰月㐫刑，乙丑月失土，㐫𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278079498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1923","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐階探花閣老，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278095882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1925","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙酉，太守癸未，安撫。壬戌。戊子。甲子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午序班。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278095882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278112266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1928","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099962591690803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉日壬子時，行藏進退，少子難爲，妻家忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278112266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅月不全尸𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278128650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳月大破㐫𣦸，丁酉月自縊𣦸","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278145034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1932","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸酉，徐陟大理卿。乙酉，御史辛戊午未舉。丙戌庚子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278145034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278161418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰舉人，己巳諫垣。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278177802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰、辛巳、甲戌","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278194186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1937","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁酉，徐元泰尚書。壬午，高𨜚州同以河壬寅工。戊申，棄市。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子，明神宗皇后。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278194186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥天月德全。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278210570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥日壬子時貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278226954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥月生飛天祿馬，登科，甲第大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278243338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又癸禄居子，壬禄居亥，日時互換，三四品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278259722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278276106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅月𣦸不全尸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278292490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申月孤貧，己酉月孤苦。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278308874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1946","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥，老彭身歸。冬丁巳。張甲子禎閣旺故老壽。癸卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1947","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099934955716659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉宋日克都憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278325258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戊太守，乙丑舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278341642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1950","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辰、丁丑、戊子，癸巳，貢𣦸。癸亥得禄生財局，沉潜外處通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時來名利順，富貴顯家風。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278358026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日禄歸時，局中得，食神喜遇怕刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278374410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官莫道傷財運，官不加兮財不豐。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278390794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日時臨壬子，名爲歸禄格同，家門白屋也峥嶸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278407178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武當權，禄重。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278423562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水清寳瓶益盛，文章𫧤覽多通，榮遷來歷紫薇封。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278439946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午寅亥破動。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278456330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日丑時斷","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278472714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1959","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以下六癸日所忌月分同上斷六癸時併論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日生時癸丑，支中暗鬼有刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278472714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1961","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099923790463015"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月通身旺防妻損，丑巳遥合貴異常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278489098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日癸丑時，支得隱鬼，癸以己爲偏官，丑中有暗已得位，癸以丁爲妻，丑中丁火無氣，若通身旺，比肩之月，防損妻財。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278505482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱丑寅多，以寅刑己，丑合巳刑，合出巳中丙戊爲財官，須干頭無戊巳字，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278521866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌巳未卯破格。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278538250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑日癸丑時，丑遥巳中，丙戊爲財官，若生丑寅申子酉三合年月，主妻賢子孝，榮貴特逹。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278554634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土運㐫，金水運吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278571018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1968","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤中失土貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684278587402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1970","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳，張瓉尚書。辛丑，孫恩侍郞。壬戊、辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1971","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099962591789107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1972","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申王家屏閣老，山西一寒儒，閪甲午通政。辛丑山陰人。人命同丙寅。壬午，宋纒都憲。辛未，大𠫭。癸丑，尚書。壬寅。己亥。癸亥。丙戌，給諫。癸酉，郎中。戊寅，元戎。壬戌，中丞。辛卯、癸亥。戊午。癸丑。庚申，大𠫭。庚申，于仕𤎉南太僕卿。庚辰、乙酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
