{"lines":[{"lineId":"2048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳日出烟霞局，否極泰來亨。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416049178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常人添厚福，君子進前程。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416065562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅癸日戊丙開，少年未遇且沉埋。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416081946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還四柱無衝破，平步登雲到省臺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416098330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日寅時尅應，支干相合光榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416114714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無壬巳戊庚申，必","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416131098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2054","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099966102421504"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然財祿豐潤，運至皇州顯達，文章虎榜標名。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416131098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但逄一字稍空衝，尅子傷妻剥俸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416147482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日卯時斷六癸日生乙卯時，長生之地遇食神，若無午酉兼辛巳，福壽雙全祿位人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416163866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日乙卯時，食神干旺，癸以乙爲學堂，食神卯上，癸水長生，乙坐祿柱中，無巳破辛奪，午酉刑衝，通月氣，有倚托，主聰明有壽，居官食祿，若有巳土不貴，春月生北運顯達。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416180250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑日乙卯時，辰丑月高貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416196634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2060","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少賤，中年貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416196634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2062","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099962591772723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2063","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙丑侍郞。甲寅舉人。壬寅，龍宗。己丑武。少𠫭。丁卯謫。戊申戍。甲辰，縣尹丙寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯日乙卯時，艱難，生寅卯月傷官格，難言富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416213018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未戌年月，技藝近貴，辰丑吉，巳丑丙子㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416229402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2066","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊午，林志學士。癸卯司業。庚午庚申進士。丁己、巳丑。甲寅，運使庚辰舉人。丁卯，舉人。辛未庚辰。甲辰。丙申，一品夫人。辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳日乙卯時，財官𩀱美。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416245786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春傷官，夏財旺，秋印穏冬。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416262170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416278554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丑午子亥年月，官至三四品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416294938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥乙酉殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416311322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2072","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099992601935899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2073","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁巳，侍讀。辛亥，太尉。己酉，黄嘉善尚書。己𮠕庚寅。庚午，卽墨人。庚戊、丁此，吕大𠫭謫戍。丙辰，卿。壬午、己亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸末日乙卯時，寅亥卯未月，傷官傷𥁞，剛斷平常，辰戌申子月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416327706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2075","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲戌，閣老王辰學憲。己亥，御史己酉進士。壬申、辛亥、甲辰、甲戌。庚申進士。乙丑，趙師尹探花。戊子己丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉日之卯時，申子辰月貴，寅午戊中，亥卯未平，己酉丑富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416344090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2077","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己卯，太守。癸亥，郭應聘尚書。戊辰甲申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥日乙卯時，辰巳月風憲，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416360474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2079","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099966102437888"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅大𠫭，己亥學憲，乙未進士，庚子御史。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416360474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2081","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己卯、丁巳庚辰癸未己丑，曹勲㑹元探花。丁未，侯丙子庚戌文星食，祿局，聲名到處聞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬庚加興旺，君子至公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416376858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙癸相逄旺食支，天工造物本無𥝠。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416393242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行自有高人薦，手攀丹桂上雲逵。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416409626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日時逄乙卯，貴人食祿之鄉，玉堂乙卯位侯王，使是金門將相。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416426010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子文章播發，常人財祿盈箱。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416442394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅辛酉頗安常，富貴榮華大享。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416458778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日辰時斷六癸日生時丙辰，偏官無氣未爲貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416475162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2089","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099966102454272"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無木氣通其局，定是清高福祿人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416491546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日丙辰時，身坐官庫，癸用戊巳爲官，辰上土墓爲官庫，見丙爲財，辰爲水局，丙火無氣，癸水合局，柱無甲破官損庫，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416507930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑日丙辰時平，辰戌丑未月，財官有氣貴","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416524314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2093","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財孤。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416524314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2095","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁丑，舉人。乙巳，少卿。丙寅，駙馬。辛丑。戊寅。壬辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯日丙辰時，孤獨難爲，樁萱有財帛，貴人欽敬。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416540698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯亥年月日貴格，午戌九品至五品，寅月行南運，風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416557082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2098","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099986784518207"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2099","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊辰，吕光洵尚書。戊寅，都督，無子。庚申，無子。甲寅。甲子，大𠫭。辛巳，太守。庚辰，沈同和。丙辰，會元。戊辰甲午。丁亥，因假文革戍。甲戌舉人。丙寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳日丙辰時，子月生南方，山明水秀，地方高貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416573466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子未年月富厚，戌卯近侍，未戌申儒官。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416589850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2102","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥，咸寜侯仇鸞。乙未，尚書。癸卯丙辰，侯破棺梟示。己丑辛酉。己丑，布政。辛丑，御史己巳。𫝊夏噐會元官賦。戊辰辛丑己巳中壽高壬子舉八。丙辰舉人。癸酉，府尹。壬寅、壬辰、壬戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未日丙辰時高，寅卯未月平常，辰戊丑月吉，巳月財官俱壤貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416606234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2104","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099962591854643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙辰，常卿。辛卯，舉人。丙寅，熊鏡湖都憲。壬辰壬辰。辛丑。癸亥，憲長多子。壬戌辛未，僉憲甲辰舉人。癸巳乙亥。己巳，熊廷弼經畧侍郞。丙寅。丁未汪道亨尚書。己卯癸末科婺源人。壬子，林學𭦌少卿壬辰科晉江人。丁𮠕，楚王壬戌，大𠫭。戊申。戊申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸𮠕日丙辰時，孤貴，己酉丑月貴，寅卯不吉，子午富，戌月大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416622618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申韓文。丁亥。秦鳳山尚書。丁巳舉人。庚申。公庚戌。庚戌。甲寅，林瀚尚書。戊辰甲戌，例貢。丁丑，宣。壬申癸丑。辛亥，饒位進士。己亥。乙丑，李柄廵撫。乙酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099962591887411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛亥卿，己亥，丁卯夭，壬子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥日丙辰時，柱無甲木，破損官庫，貴運喜南。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416639002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2111","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙子，樞宻。乙亥武貴多㐫，丁卯侯。辛卯，丁亥戊申。庚戌發財，㐫，𣦸壬午。玉出燕田局，休𭒡出現遲。鑰匙逢卯戌，財禄自天隨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日丙辰，官庫閉，財星雖透却無氣，官要匙開財要興，柱逢卯戊方爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416655386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日丙辰時，遇庫中鎻閉財官，要逢𫑗戌鑰匙開，人祖六親阻碍，暗有食神相助，空乏虚度資財，先貧後。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416671770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富命中排攺祖重興漸快。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416688154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099986784550975"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日巳時斷六癸日生時丁巳，貴地逢財遇暗官。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416704538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有托就看財禄盛，無依必定福偏殘。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416720922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日丁巳時，癸合財官，癸用丙爲財，戊爲官，庚爲印，己爲天乙貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416737306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳上庚金長生，丙戊建禄，癸水受胎，若有倚托，通水氣月貴，不通水氣，平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416753690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時逢三奇，大抵發於晩年。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416770074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑日丁巳時，先貧後富，行火水運發達。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416786458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸酉，太守。辛巳，舉人。庚戌，少卿。庚戌，乙部。癸亥、甲午、己丑。甲申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅侯恂戶部尚書。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416802842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416819226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2125","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099962591871027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯日丁巳時，若子月身旺財旺貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416819226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2127","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛酉，僉憲。庚申，中書。辛卯，丁亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳日丁巳時，財官雙美，子月貴，火月富，天干透土，地支午未，主大權貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416835610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純丑極品，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416851994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2130","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賤中貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416851994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴中血光𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416851994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2134","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辰，劉章尚書。丁亥。戊午翁萬逹尚書名。巳未。臣辛卯，許誥學士。辛丑。乙丑，李迨侍郎。己丑。戊辰，府尹。丙戌，鴻臚。辛酉，甲午，卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未日丁巳時，寅午戌月，身財旺顯，秋冬禄旺傷殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416868378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099986784534591"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2137","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯，路可由都憲。甲午，陳克宅進士。辛亥丁卯。丁酉，舉人。戊申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉日丁巳時，先貧後富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416884762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉月官印俱旺，亥卯未食傷，生財貴顯，午戌財旺亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416901146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2140","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午，李傑尚書。辛卯，少卿，辛巳，太守。己巳。辛卯。乙未。壬子，楊維聰狀元。丙子，副將。庚子，憲副。辛亥、丁酉。乙酉。辛卯，劉瑊榜眼。辛丑，大𠫭。辛卯、丁酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥日丁巳時，刑害，春夏月生好，秋印綬吉，冬平當。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416917530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅年月武貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416933914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛未，大𠫭。甲子，太守。壬子，御史丁卯，舉人。戊戌，丁耶。己酉。乙巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2144","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099985526243382"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未王琁都憲，甲午太守，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416950298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午丙子，鳯落荆山局，石中隠美玉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得志遇良工，不貴卽富足。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416950298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己時禄馬同争先造化無𥝠産大賢。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416966682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑衝减半無空尅，運至聲名揚九天。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416983066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日時臨丁巳，贵人禄馬同鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684416999450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三重蛇馬正朝綱，玉殿金堦來徃。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417015834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬亥申寅减半，只愁運落空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417032218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果無衝尅與刑傷，舞拜鳯凰池上。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417048602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日午時㫁六癸日生時戊午，化火臨時帝旺鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417064986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜東南木火地，爲官清正禄榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417081370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099985526259766"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日戊午時，化氣成火局，癸合戊化火，午上帝旺，合局而貴，身旺不化，癸水北方之氣，引到南方，癸水無氣，貴而壽促，東方運吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417097754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑日戊午時，財厚，南運主貴，壽促，東運吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417114138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2159","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁未進士，丁卯舉人，乙亥知縣。丙午、丙午、丁亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯日戊午時，申子辰亥月，身旺不化，平常，卯戌月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417130522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申顧東階侍郞庚申進士。甲午知縣。乙禾、癸未。壬申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳日戊午時，中年大富，若行東運貴顯，申未月亦貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417146906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099985526292534"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417146906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅癸未日戊午時，寅午戌化火合局，貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417163290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午御史，癸亥給諫，壬戌進士，甲午大忝。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417179674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥甲寅、戊申、己巳癸酉官生。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417196058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申周起元御史，丁亥大參。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417212442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥丙午、壬寅己酉進士，助敎。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417228826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰癸酉日戊午時，主傷妻家財，有始無終。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417245210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子年子貴而無禄，行南運好，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417261594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破祖㐫敗。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417261594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁亥，金澤尚書。庚申，林雲同左。庚戌，都御。戊寅，史","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯左都，丁巳府尹，己亥知縣，乙酉舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417277978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳壬子、丙子、壬申、壬寅進士，己未御史，丁卯甲部，甲辰、甲戌、戊申","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417294362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2177","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099985526308918"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥日戊午時貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417294362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月東方運，金紫","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417310746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2180","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云：有財㐫。戊申，極貴。癸亥，雙瞽。癸亥，以子封一品夫人。庚申、癸亥、乙卯。乙巳，舉革甲寅進士。戊寅舉人。甲申、甲戌、戊午。將星扶祿局，財旺生官禄。衝破合，平常奔走財不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將星扶祿命，高低見愛於人是與非。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417310746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得志退毛雞化鳯，虎卧平坡被兎欺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417327130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日時逢戊午，天元旣濟之方，化爲眞火顯威光，禍潜消除福長。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417343514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬㑹甲寅减半，是非成敗難防。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417359898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六親不睦暗刑傷，難得資財富旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417376282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日未時㫁","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417392666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2187","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099980107169844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日生時癸未，鬼旺身衰福不齊。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417392666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月氣不通無救助，平常衣禄有相戯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417409050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日巳未時，鬼旺身衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417425434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸以己爲鬼，未上明暗二已得坐専位，癸水無氣，渾濁不清，反復成敗。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417441818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若通月制，又不通水氣者，平常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417458202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸属腎，與膀胱爲腑，患膿膝下部之疾，或腎經所循脉路，生癰瘤。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417474586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑日巳未時高，年月俱丑，貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684417490970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未土旺，主目疾貧殘。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432646194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通金木水氣貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432662578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月東北運，六七品职","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432678962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑破。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432678962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2200","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰仕绅丙辰舉六。丙子徐閣老命婦。甲戌、甲戌、乙未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099966102585344"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯日己未時，子巳未年月二品，巳寅字刑六親。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432695346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子張經尚書，丁巳大𠫭，壬戌進士。壬子庚戌，丁未㐫終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳日己未時，財官雙美，柱無戊土，有卯木合局，作時上偏官有制，貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432711730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊寅，布政。戊辰，御史。庚午，通判。癸未，推官。庚申。乙卯。癸未。已未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥徐可求川撫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432728114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午癸未日巳未時，高，春偏官有制吉，夏平常，秋冬身旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432744498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申月行木運，顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432760882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己辰年六卿","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432777266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2210","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑偒。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432777266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌葉鏜侍郞，己卯進士，戊申丁卯癸酉日巳未時，寅巳申酉丑戌年月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432793650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2213","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099986784600127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2214","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬寅，毛伯温尚書。戊寅舉人。丁未甲寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥日己未時，貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432810034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月生，忠孝雙全，官至風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432826418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如煞官混雜，恐終在外。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432842802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥年月貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432859186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2219","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯，李東陽閣老丙子進士。庚辰丁未，通判。乙未丁亥。癸丑，大𠫭庚申。苦盡甘回局，未遇受奔波。少年難得遂，離祖可成家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏官暗鬼庫中埋，險難驚憂不聚財。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432875570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑戌相逄鑰匙吉，旺中發福定無灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432891954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日時臨巳未，庫中耗鬼身衰，不逢卯戌，鑰匙開鎻閉，不能通泰，花落重榮結子，雙親鴈侣難諧。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432908338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱然先","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432924722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099980107186228"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧後富來，棄舊迎新無礙。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432924722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日申時斷六癸日生時庚申，官星印旺在其支，柱中無巳丙寅已，自有榮華富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432941106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時癸日庚申時，作專印合禄，癸以戊爲正官，庚爲正印，申上庚旺，戊生，以申合巳中戊丙癸日得財官，若有倚托，柱中無財及破害刑衝，官印主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432957490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中有財，行財運反復，進退少貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432973874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑日庚申時，辰戌丑未年月，文章冠世，官至三品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684432990258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子月坐祿，亦吉，","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433006642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099966102568960"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2232","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙酉，丞相。庚子，韓淮侍郞。戊申癸未。侍戊子甲寅郞。丙申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元戎。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433006642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌大𠫭，巳未大𠫭，戊戌副。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433023026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未巳卯、甲戌、乙丑、壬午員外，癸酉同知。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433039410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌乙丑癸卯日庚申時，卯月作合禄格，西北運貴，金紫；申月東北運，風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433055794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰庚戌年月，正官格貴，辰月金水運，七品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433072178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2238","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸丑韓尚甲午，盛應期都憲。庚乙申卯，書指揮。甲戌甲申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳日庚申時，貧，亦是合禄格。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433088562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月生，問學有成，西北運貴，行東北運亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433104946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉侍𭅺，戊子受封一主簿。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433121330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申丙子命同。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433137714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099986784632895"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午舉人。丁酉兩司。辛未。丙午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未日庚申時，柱有甲寅、乙卯，巳與甲合，乙與庚合，妻賢子孝，榮華在後。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433154098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𮠕申年月，三四品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433170482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋生行木火運，二三品，亥卯文進貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433186866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2248","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙酉，丞相乙丑，少卿乙未，進士。癸未。丙戌。乙酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉日庚申時，卯酉戌寅年月貴，申酉火木運大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433203250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午，丞相。庚戌，元戎。庚戌元戎。壬申，舉人。乙酉、戊子。壬午，壬于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥日庚申時，性平身孤，卯未月飽學貴，命申亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433219634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子申近侍有權。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433236018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2253","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云：少貧，好學，有才幹。丁丑侍郎。癸卯貴，乙酉，貴。甲戍，評事。壬子、庚申，乙西，丙子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2254","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099992601968667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未通判。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433252402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2256","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙丑金烏太陽局，騰空向九霄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中無尅破，名譽鎮皇朝。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433268786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日庚申仔細推，禹門深處見龍飛。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433285170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文章得助雄威力，柱合財官世所希。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433301554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日庚申時，正印綬齊合官星。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433317938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥寅申，丙巳刑衝離合，立身不定，無破黄甲顯姓常人財祿安寜。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433334322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果無刑害與灾星，便是錦雞化鳯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433350706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日酉時斷六癸日生時辛酉，自身失地更何有。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433367090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支中明暗破辛傷，無助利名終不就。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433383474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2265","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099966102601728"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日辛酉時，明暗梟神，癸見辛爲倒食，酉上辛建旺，癸失地，若無倚托救助者，遇貴生涯，有倚托則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433399858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑日辛酉時，秋月印綬格行官煞運吉，冬𮂔禄雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433416242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子寅年月干頭無戊巳字貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433432626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2269","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙丑，侍𭅺。辛酉，馮京狀元。甲子，監丞。己丑辛卯，丙寅。己亥，唐九經進士，知縣。丁巳進士。甲申、乙部。壬申、丙午、己巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯日辛酉時，日貴格，辰戌丑未月貴，子卯年月大貴，巳午亦貴，又云：不利妻子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433449010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2271","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁酉明𥡆宗一云丙辰時，在位辛卯，元戎癸卯七年，三十七歲。庚子。庚子嚴嵩閣老。此老無子，世蕃其妻侄也，晩被大己卯祸，皆此兒所致，惜哉！以余論之，殊不足惜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2272","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099962591936563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午任丘劉封君二子，癸丑、元震、元霖。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433465394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳日辛酉時，孤寅卯年辰戌丑未月貴，子午卯酉中貴，寅申己亥最貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433481778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2275","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申，主政。辛巳，馮保太監未敗。乙亥己亥酉時，主結果。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未日辛酉時，春貧，夏先難後易，秋吉冬貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433498162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2277","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己亥，郎中。甲子，學士，甲寅，都事。壽三十，丙十五。己巳癸酉。壬辰，主政己酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉日辛酉時，申酉月印綬多能守祖破妻家。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433514546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子巳年月干透庚辛祿貴，印綬俱全，貴不可言。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433530930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅戌腰金，午亥大貴，丑月煞重卤夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433547314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2281","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099985526325302"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子明成祖戊午樞宻，壬子布政","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433563698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2283","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛巳、庚申、辛亥，甲子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"郞中，己卯御史。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433563698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥辛未。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433580082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥日辛酉時，戌月行東南運，金紫東北風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433596466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子月建祿，年遇財官大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433612850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2288","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥，明神宗享國戊寅倪啟祚辛酉四十八年。甲子，翰林壬午，副使。壬子。鴻鴈失羣局，親族各西東。六親亦少靠，守祖不成宗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元是癸時辛酉，用𥁞心機度日忙。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433629234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印相生逢印合，胸中便富且如常。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433645618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日辛酉時，遇倒食偏印難禁，柱中無依且安貧，財","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433662002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2292","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099962591969331"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官月遇亦稱。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433662002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只怕癸水失地，不能驅駕奚勝。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433678386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六親骨肉各西東，一生勞苦之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433694770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日戍時斷六癸日生時壬戌，支内正官生財庫月，兼有救貴多成，倚托若無終不富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433711154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日壬戍時，水火旣濟，癸用丙丁爲財，戊土爲官，戊與癸合旺，爲人智謀。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433727538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通月氣，有倚托者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433743922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不通平常，通火土月氣，富貴𩀱全，運氣通亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433760306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑日壬戌時，刑亥月，土𫝗地方上貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433776690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰申年月南方運狀元，五月南運風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433793074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若春秋生南方運，八九","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433809458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2303","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100042921017384"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433809458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午平章，辛巳僉憲，庚子焦竑狀元。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433825842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅戊戍戊子癸卯日壬戍時，日貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433842226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅巳年月，干透戊丁，財官而旺，大貴有權。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433858610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯辰丑午子等年月文貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433874994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉戌金土運，五六品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433891378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊寅，于肅愍公謙。壬午僉憲。壬辰，縣尹。丁巳。癸丑。壬寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳舉人，乙卯舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433907762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午壬申。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433924146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳日壬戌時，財官雙美，春平夏秋冬貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433940530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰丑未寅酉年月都憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433956914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2315","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸酉都憲巳未陳士賢都憲，辛酉進士。甲寅、丁丑、庚子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2316","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099980107218996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2317","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午楊太傅公夫人，侍郞公丁亥母。壬午年終。壬申甲部。庚戌戊辰，張以誠狀元，丙乙卯辰年卒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未日壬戍時，刑巳月，生三四品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433973298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子庚年月近侍貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684433989682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙寅，林廷機尚書。甲寅舉人。丙辰，大富。癸巳、庚午、辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉日壬戍時，亥子月，才智高貴，妻賢子孝，春平常，夏財官，秋印綬俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434006066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰丑刑衝戌庫，貴富两全。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434022450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月東南運武貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434038834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2324","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳，洪承疇閣老。辛卯，右方伯。壬戍。丙申。壬申進士。壬申舉人。戊申、丙午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥日壬戌時，春生傷官見官，夏財旺，秋冬吉，名利","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434055218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100039972405285"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有成。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434055218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌辰月行亥子運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434071602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子月行西南運，金紫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434087986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2330","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛未，何維栢尚書。乙亥，金立敬學憲。庚子丁亥。甲子，御史癸卯進士。己卯，都閫。甲辰，御史。丁丑甲子。丁卯。丙子。癸未，甲部。癸亥。田鼠船倉局，運拙且奔波。鑰匙逄辰丑，晩景福財多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙壬癸戌時排庫内財官等鑰開。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434104370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不遇刑衝空鎻閉，少年難發更生灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434120754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日時逢壬戌，就中倉庫盈餘，將星天德兩相扶。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434137138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌鑰匙開助，土旺長流水局，六親恩處成疎，不遇空亡有増餘，中末榮華享福。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434153522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2335","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100042921001000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日亥時㫁六癸日生時癸亥，禄馬飛天臨旺神，不見官星兼惹絆，必爲貴格異常人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434169906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日癸亥時，𬓈馬飛天格。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434186290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水亥健旺，癸用戊爲官，丙爲財，亥中丙戊俱絕，癸無財官，却亥去衝出，巳中丙戊飛來，就癸爲財官，柱無戊巳惹絆，及官星破祿，若見庚辛，清白而秀，爲人智慧，貴爲方靣。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434202674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑日癸亥時，作拱禄格。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434219058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑生，福德秀氣，午月平常，卯酉月行南運，金紫風憲，但難爲壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434235442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2341","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子，尚書癸卯，許成名侍郞。癸未，進癸士。丑癸亥，辛酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2342","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099986784649279"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥，給諌一都憲。癸巳，張位大學士。癸亥，命同。甲寅。辛未，舉人。辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯日癸亥時，平日貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434251826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯月傷官論，行金水運，風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684434268210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未月官旺純卯，三品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529115163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戍與卯刑，主孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529131547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2348","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬申，唐汝揖狀元。己丑副使。甲申進士。戊申、乙亥、丁卯。丁未，元戎。庚午，給諌。乙卯，太守。丙申，遊戎。壬寅。乙酉。壬辰。庚寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳日癸亥時，丑月雜氣印綬貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529147931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子年月行南運貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529164315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又祿馬同鄉格，巳申年月大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529180699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳許讃閣老，癸卯進士，壬寅舉人，庚申、甲寅、壬寅","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529197083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099966102618112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2354","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲寅，寺丞。癸卯，進士。庚寅，貧俗。己亥。乙辛，令未。癸亥。癸未。乙亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子侯。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529197083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅癸未日癸亥時，身下坐財官，辰戌丑未月行東北運貴，秋月東運，七八品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529213467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干透正印正官，金紫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529229851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳翰林，庚寅給諫，癸丑通判，丁丑觧元。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529246235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午、庚午、庚申、丁未、丙申李汶尚書一孤貧蘇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌任丘人，州人，命同。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529262619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳李橒廵撫。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529279003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌癸酉日癸亥時，辰戌丑未月，生涯遂意，酉月行東北運，八九品貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529295387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申月東方運，五品。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529311771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑張嗣修翰林，庚子尚書，壬辰萬戸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529328155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未丁亥，壬子、","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529344539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2366","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100039972454437"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌學士，辛未進士，丙子舉人，癸未舉人。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529344539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉、戊戌、丙申甲寅","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529360923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2369","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子舉人。癸卯，少𠫭。甲辰舉人。戊午，南道。丙辰、辛未。甲子壬申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥日癸亥時，性聰飄逸，中年大富。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529360923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月生飛天祿馬，無戊巳子字塡實，惹絆貴顯，不然孤尅，爲僧道，亦主清高。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529377307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月辰亥干透辛壬，無塡實己字，有智量，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529393691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月金紫，己丑亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529410075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2374","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰，王守仁尚書封。乙酉，宗臣學憲稱才子。己卯，壽三十六，無子。辛亥，新建伯。癸丑，少𠫭。己卯，𠫭議。丙午，太守。癸丑，陳狀。丁己巳巳。庚子。癸亥元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌劉時秋僉憲，壽不。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529426459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳侍郞。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529442843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉僕射。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529459227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未永九子。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529475611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥、甲寅、辛丑縣尹。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529491995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529508379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"周延儒癸丑科會元，狀元兩次，辛丑丙子入閣。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529524763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未年賜𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529541147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100039972470821"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2384","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鶯遷喬木局，背暗向明歸。鑰匙逢尅破，等待羽毛飛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰水重重透海波，少年未遇且蹉跎。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529557531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"困龍得志方能化，不遇時來虎卧坡。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529573915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日時逢癸亥，敗財帶祿亨通，喜遇秋夏忌春冬。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529590299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊丙庚木富盛。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529606683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥甲丙反復，六親大不和同，一身不定，好翻騰，先敗後成之命。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529623067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上諸命，原本十之六，増十之四，間有一命而兩載者，傳聞之誤，豈曰無之？","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529639451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要在知命者以意消息之可也。","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529655835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2393","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100039972487205"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2394","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099980107251764"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100033404157963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通㑹全十一冊卷之十","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529688603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100039972503589"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2398","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"司小。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下","logicSentenceId":"7577354684529688603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
