{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"㸔命口訣","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193268788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡㸔命，先㸔月支有無財官，方㸔其他月令爲命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193285172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月取支神，年取天干，日取天干，流歲取天干，大運取支神，年爲本，日爲主。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193301556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如月有正官及偏官，而時又入他格，只以月中取他格無用。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193317940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如月令全無可用，方㸔他格。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193334324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古歌云：三宫帶格混難詳，不曉慿誰是貴方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任三宮皆帶格，除非只得用提綱是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193350708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令用地支，假如官星，須要上下干支透出爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193367092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或干透出，支中不透，主聰俊。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193383476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌年與時衝月支，日支自衝不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193399860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193416244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099992602001435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運及嵗君來衝月支則禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193416244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡正官一位，乃君子貴人，篤厚純粹，剛直𤎉明，年時有印尤妙，多則反主成敗。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193432628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四位純官，仕宦虛名。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193449012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡七煞一位，聰明伶俐，二位、三位，先清後濁。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193465396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱純煞，有制貴，無制貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193481780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡財一位，務要得時，富貴成家。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193498164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲人性燥𦂳急，二位性氣减半；三位、四位，耗氣身衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193514548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若身旺甚，則可成立，弱則勞苦生受。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193530932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡印不論一位、二位、四位都好，格中不宜見財破印。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193547316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡行好運，日干傷流年歲君，干頭禍輕；行不好運，日干傷歲君，干頭禍重。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193563700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若巳發過則𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193580084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未各有三分餘氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193596468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如行午運至未，有三分火氣；行子至","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193612852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100033404125195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，有三分水氣之例，不可全作土論。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193612852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡陽刃格，歲運最怕衝合太歲，干合日時干者，爲晦氣煞；日時干支與流年干支同，爲轉趾煞，如庚申日見庚申或庚寅太歲之類，輕則遠遷，重則毁屋破財。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193629236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡年月日有吉神，要時引歸生旺之處；有㐫神，要時引歸制伏之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193645620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若時上帶吉神或㐫神，亦要年月日上吉者生之，㐫者制之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193662004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月上有用神，得祖宗之力；時上有用神，得子。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193678388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫之力，反此則否。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193694772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡看命，以日干用爲天元，是以干爲祿；日支、月支用爲地元，是以支爲命。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193711156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如壬癸日己未月，干支透出","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193727540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100033404108811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193727540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官論原有原無，地支原有財官，天干不露出者不問。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193743924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若地支無財官，只是天千透出，雖行好運，亦不濟事。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193760308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看流年歲君，只用天元，若行運雖重，地支亦要看運。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193776692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元人命柱中或有官星，或有偏官，有制伏太𨓺，而運干見官煞可發。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193793076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運支無財而運干是財，亦可爲福；運支無煞而運干是煞，亦可爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193809460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命以當生之月爲運元，最怕大運並歲君來衝爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193825844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以當生官星爲祿元，最怕衝壊。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193842228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁日生人，以壬爲官，而生亥月，亥中有壬，是丁之禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193858612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年與時有巳字，則衝壊禄元。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193874996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以當生財星爲馬元，最怕刼奪。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193891380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚日生","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193907764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099985526407222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人，以甲乙木爲財，而生寅卯月，寅中甲木偏財，卯中乙木正財。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193907764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年時有辛宇，却有争奪之患。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193924148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運同論。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193940532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡年干上有日之官星，福氣最厚；有日之七煞，終身不可除去。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193956916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星爲禄，財星爲馬，行官星𤼵官，行財星發財，二者不可缺一，各有所用。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193973300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月上有財官，必生富貴之家，祖父根基，少年便行官禄運，多是幼年拜命，早發功名。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354193989684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月無財官，日時有之，則是自己成立。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194006068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命以財官爲本，柱中但得其一，亦可發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194022452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱原無官星，不入他格。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194038836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日時，干支財多，又行財旺運，亦能成就功名。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194055220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以財旺自能生官，須身旺方許。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194071604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194087988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100039972552741"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月無財官，幼年又行不好運，多是出身卑微，破祖傷父，無見成之福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194087988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命官煞混雜，傷官合神重，男于犯之，躭迷酒色；女人逄之，不媒自嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194104372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡看命尃以日干爲主，取提綱所用之物爲命。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194120756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬月令，以金木、水火土爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194137140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但有一件，取其節氣先後，輕重淺深，成局破衝，細加考究。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194153524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰官、日印，曰財、曰煞，曰食神，曰傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194169908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以此六法消息之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194186292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄官看財，逄煞看印，逄印看官，取四者不偏不倚，生尅制化爲上，遇破害休囚爲下。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194202676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運有生有去爲福，有𦔳有剥爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194219060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有用年日時支合成格局者，然皆以月令爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194235444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令月用","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194251828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100033404174347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金只用金，用火只用火，十八格内取六格爲重，用相生定格合局，却用年日時下，以推輕重淺深。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194251828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逄官用印，不怕煞是煞局，印印局身，還作上局取之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194268212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄印看煞，但有官煞在命，行官煞鄉，亦作貴論。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194284596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令通官，柱中遇財，財旺生官，乃富貴；柱中見財，要人財旺運發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194300980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但見一煞，則以煞爲重，不可用財。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194317364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若行財旺運，乃財生煞黨，作貧賤言。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194333748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡格以煞爲重。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194350132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命先看干神有無尅制，支神有無刑衝，干支納音有無戰闘降伏。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194366516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲以寅爲禄，而寅上有何干，甲以辛爲官，而辛得何支？","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194382900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干不侵支，則天乃尊；支不犯干，","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194399284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100039972569125"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則地乃𤰞。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194399284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行不相賊，則人乃順；四孟不相害，則馬乃能馳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194415668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若干侵支犯，五行相賊，又當分别主本有氣無氣，有用無用，有救無救，成格不成格，則干支錯綜，五行變化，造化在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194432052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"李淳風云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行生旺，觀福氣之徃還；五行𣦸絕，在吉神之救𦔳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194448436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若五行得地，納音相生，吉神無𦔳亦榮；五行無氣，納音相妨，縱有吉神不用。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194464820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命天元喜地元有禄，如甲己喜四季，乙庚喜申酉，丙辛喜亥子，丁壬喜寅卯，戊癸喜巳午，地元喜天元。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194481204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有合如子丑喜戊，寅喜己，卯辰喜庚，己喜辛，癸午未","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194497588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100042921033768"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜甲，壬申喜乙，酉戌喜丙，亥喜丁，天元、地元皆有，平生福氣高崇，皆無名利，無成壞。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194497588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元者，三十九歲以前，名利難發；","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194513972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690885452922891/1-d8ba0304780aae04.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=m2o57x%2FOTc4pCOEPxOJ9AGBVoGo%3D","uri":"read/HY0710/1/ref/1kodrli0thedm/1-d8ba0304780aae04.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土亠𭾱","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690885452922891"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370354194513972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地元者，四十歳福不如前。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194513972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若天元秀氣坐禄，如癸得子、甲得寅之例，不貴卽富。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194530356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地元忌天元相尅，如子丑怕己，寅怕庚，卯辰怕辛，巳怕甲，壬午未怕乙，癸申怕丙，酉戌怕丁，亥怕戊，更㸔喜忌何如，不可執定。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194546740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命取干支與納音同類，壬子、壬午眞木，己酉己卯眞土，丙子丙午眞水，戊子戊午眞火，乙丑、乙未、庚辰、庚戌眞金。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194563124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乙酉日庚辰時爲精金，丁巳日丙午時","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194579508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099980107284532"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲精火，癸亥日壬子時爲精水，己丑日戊辰時爲精土，甲寅日丁卯時爲精木。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194579508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上遇者，俱主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194595892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若火人丙日辛時，辛日丙時；木人甲日己時，己日甲時；土人戊日癸時，癸日戊時；水人壬日丁時，丁日壬時；金人庚日乙時，乙日庚時。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194612276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖爲五行眞貴，重犯减福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370354194628660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命取五行真氣交互，如辛亥金人得丁巳土，有丁壬合真木徃來，有丙辛合真水徃來。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102629928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳土人得癸亥水，有戊癸合真火徃來，有丁壬合真木徃來。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102646312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊戌、癸亥、丁巳、辛亥，交互眞氣全，乃宰相命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102662696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午火得壬子，木中有丁壬真木，戊癸真火；丙申火得乙酉，","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102679080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100047694102540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水中有丙辛真水，乙庚眞金；庚寅得巳卯，土中有甲己真土，乙庚眞金。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102679080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚寅、己卯、庚寅、己卯交互全，乃兩府命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102695464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命先論化氣，考五運篇，以甲、丙、戊、庚、壬合五陰干爲太𨓺，乙、丁、巳、辛、癸合五陽干爲不及。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102711848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太過、不及之間，有權存焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102728232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考天元變化書，又分晝夜。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102744616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如六甲日生木，夜生化土，故六戊人得甲，取日生爲鬼，夜生爲官；用六乙人，日生用金，夜生用木，故六己人見之，日生爲官，夜生爲鬼，獨六己、六庚不變。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102761000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以五陽干晝生爲本體，夜生作化看；五陰干夜生爲本體，書生作化","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102777384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100033404207115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㸔。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102777384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六般陽命，男犯禄鬼倒食，須取夜生，反㐫作吉；呼鬼爲官，倒食爲喜神，却以日生爲順。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102793768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六般陰命，男犯禄、鬼倒食，須取日生，反㐫作吉，餘並同前，却以夜生爲順。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102810152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人皆反此求之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102826536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此晝夜氣象，是陰陽配合，剛柔體用也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102842920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命五行，下生上曰𦔳氣，主一生自享其福；上生下曰盗氣，主一生供人之福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102859304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上尅下曰順，主有威勢而制人；下尅上曰逆，主多沉滯而難發。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102875688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸絕尢𦂳，生旺差慢。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102892072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱納音鬼多，主本當時，名曰官星乘旺；納音財多，主本無氣，名曰財多害身。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102908456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099992602050587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命五行貴陰陽相等，如兩金見兩木，或兩火、兩土、兩水之類，各自成象方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102924840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若太𨓺不及，如三水一木、一水三木等類，俱不爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102941224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令金人，三金一木，金尅木爲財，三金争一木，是分擘其福多，主財物不遂。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102957608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若一金三火，火多金少，煎熬太𨓺，主一生不閑。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102973992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如甲人逄三壬三巳，謂之三吞三偶，主不吉；若逄兩巳兩庚，謂之重偶重傷，視三尢㐫，不貧卽夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771102990376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘以例推。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103006760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡看會傷官見官而早𣦸，七煞見財夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103023144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財逄刼𥁞𣦸重，財破印㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103039528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水盛木流，終爲外鬼；食神逄梟，𣦸於牢獄。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103055912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼重見財，𣦸煞旺掛根休。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103072296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神七煞衝刑，非徒","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103088680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100047694135308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流亦亡，縲絏傷官，羊刃重併，雖个體而𣦸，血光財星。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103088680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見刃財散人亡，生旺𣦸於庫墓，庫墓絶於生旺，睌有吉運行，㐫運未入，𣦸卒何分；有㐫運來，吉運未來，發福曷論。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103105064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當究進氣退氣之由，更審已發未𤼵之義。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103121448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將來而速進，功畢以先歸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103137832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生歲運皆㐫，年少早𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103154216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"末旬命星得地，老壽彌高。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103170600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老怕生旺，少嫌𣦸絶。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103186984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃逄生多惡𣦸，有根煞旺定㐫終。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103203368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春旺火多宜西北，𪪌是歸期；夏熒金旺利東南，鬼鄉壽地。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103219752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四刃星重，𣦸在正財之下；一官貴淺，終於陽刃之中。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103236136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱俱傷人自𣦸，金神入水溺爲灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103252520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃倒戈，無頭之鬼；煞星叠刃，半","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103268904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099980107333684"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103268904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制伏中和，煞極全而氣𣦸，生扶太𨓺，印更旺而身終。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103285288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官入墓，𣦸晩局最宜觀。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103301672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生而陰𣦸，陰𣦸而陽生。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103318056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞逄三合，太𨓺必傾，五行之内，宜細消詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103334440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡看命，五行太過不及，固不爲福，中間亦微不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103350824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如水土不嫌𣦸絕，以盈天地間皆水土，無分四時豈有𣦸絶之理？","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103367208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但辯輕重。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103383592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如㸃水滴衆土之中則乾，撮土壅衆水之中則散。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103399976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當論多寡，分重輕也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103416360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金非土不生，木非水不長，故金木欲其生旺，怕見𣦸絕。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103432744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如金𣦸則沉，木𣦸則灰，與水土不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103449128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火藏於木，宿於土，故不欲旺，旺則焚，亦不欲𣦸，𣦸則滅，惟得共平則隹。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103465512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行水","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103481896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100033404190731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土均頼，凡木金火之命，尢爲要也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103481896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡五行取象，本象取本象，如甲乙、丙丁木火象之類；化𧰼取化象，如戊癸丁壬，亦木火象之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103498280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水象不可見土，謂土雜水混，金自不清。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103514664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運遇土亦滯，惟金水不雜，生於秋月最貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103531048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如明神宗癸亥辛酉，癸亥辛酉，干支俱金水不雜，水生金月，金𦔳水淸，二水二金。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103547432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成象所謂金白水清，别無夾雜，又合兩干不雜，所以尊爲天子。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103563816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸酉、癸亥、庚子、辛巳，金生水月，金反泄氣，沉於亥子之中，所以不免水厄。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103580200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金土𧰼不可見木，謂木尅土，則土不能生金，不成象也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103596584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土積成金，土多","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103612968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100047694184460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金少，其福厚實。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103612968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金重土輕，福出艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103629352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金火象不可見水，見水則火滅金沉，不能成器。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103645736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金重火輕，發遅益壽；金輕火重，發早退速，或主壽𧇊。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103662120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木象不宜見火，活木畏金，見火成秀，𣦸木得金，方成造化。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103678504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金重木輕，令人骨痛。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103694888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木重金輕，主損錢財，或肺疾相攻，惟金木相宜則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103711272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水木象秀而清高，不可見。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103727656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳以水𣦸絕。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103744040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木火象秀而豐富，不可見金，以木受尅，流年遇之俱灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103760424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火象成，旣濟最妙，或未濟亦得，不可見土。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103776808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火多性燥，水多眼疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103793192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火怕𣦸，水怕浴，入酉火𣦸水浴，主艱難而𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103809576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運同此象，日時忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103825960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水土象不可見火，土重","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103842344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099992602066971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水輕，秀而不實，水重土輕，却有科名。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103842344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土象不可見水，火虛土聚，不成物，若同水流，主汨没。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103858728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊子、戊午、己丑、己未、丁巳、丁亥、丙辰、丙戌，丙丁與戊巳相夾，乃火虛土聚。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103875112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李九萬以戊子、己丑、戊午、己未、丙辰、丁巳、丙戌、丁亥，皆火土夾雜之象，不可以連珠爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103891496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上逢壬癸水，土滯火滅，平生蹇薄。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103907880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火火見土則暗，土土見火則虛，土輕火重則燥，己卯日見丙寅時是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103924264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火輕土重不明，丁酉日見戊申時是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103940648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103957032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"韓學士","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戊、丁巳、戊戌、丁巳，火土成象，又爲鳯凰干支格，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103957032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：金水多淸，金，土多厚，以其相生，金火多剛金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099980107382836"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木多正，以其相尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103973416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土多毒，火木多聰，火水多昧，火金多烈，木火文彩，木水清奇，木金方直，木土毒害，水。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771103989800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火智慧，水，木智仁，水、金秀麗，水土重濁，各以五行之性推之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104006184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命怕同類相破，如己未見甲辰，甲辰見己丑，巳五見甲戌，甲戌見己未，凡在四衝之地，納音同類，逐兩位逆數之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104022568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申、己亥，子午卯酉，亦以此取，主平生不足，多不成器，","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104038952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"道經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井欄互破，無藥可醫，遇空亡庻幾，歲運亦忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104038952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命主本逄歲運，不可遇𣦸地，如丙寅火畏乙卯水，","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104055336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100047694249996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳金畏丁酉火，甲申水畏己卯土，戊申土畏壬午木，己亥木畏甲子金，與人生怕𣦸同義，主本生𣦸同途，則不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104055336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命最怕鬼尅，而窠鬼最毒。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104071720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙子水見庚子土，丁丑水見辛丑土之類，窠中就位相尅，所以最毒。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104088104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有墓中鬼，如壬辰水見丙辰土，丙辰土見戊辰木之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104104488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有隔壁鬼，如庚子土見癸丑木之類。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104120872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有空亡鬼，如甲戌見甲申、乙酉之類，皆主爲害。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104137256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内墓鬼輕於窠鬼，壁鬼輕於墓鬼，空鬼輕於壁鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104153640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若木命人得火月、金日時之𩔖，有火尅金，金不得傷木，是禦鬼也，鬼不爲害。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104170024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104186408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100042921099304"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水命人，四柱有火土，土尅水，火又生土，是𦔳鬼也，其鬼尢内，千支通用，納音最𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104186408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禦鬼則立身於艱難，𦔳鬼則骨肉多生乎破闘。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104202792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鬼中有鬼，謂之鬼嘯。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104219176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如土命人生木月、金日時之類，以木尅土，金尅木，根基劣弱則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104235560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主本強健不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577370771104251944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803569152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命己未乙亥，丙寅，辛卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄三合生更遇，寅卯爲巳入官鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803569152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙與辛合，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803585536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柰己陰土逄乙木作鬼，又遇辛作乙木之鬼，變寅卯之官，作己土鬼，在亥卯未三合位，通是鬼尅，犯鬼嘯也，故主惡𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803601920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行切忌下賊上，平生不足事相縈。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803618304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼嘯分明格局惡，更加刑煞禍不差。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803634688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱使以前","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803651072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100047694200844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄富貴，定知日後厭年華。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803651072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡㸔命，取胎生旺庫爲四貴，𣦸絶、病敗爲四忌，餘爲四平。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803667456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以太歲干爲主，配於五行，取四貴、四平、四忌之位，而分貴賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803683840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇貴多則貴，遇賤多則賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803700224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四貴之中，又分四旺，庫爲上，胎爲次。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803716608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人命胎月日時遇三貴干，皆有輔，或正禄、正官、正印，三公命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803732992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶正天乙，如丑未生人，月日時得甲、戊、庚之類，帶本家禄，如寅生人，月日時帶甲之類，謂之福㑹，或天乙貴合兩重者，亦三公命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803749376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三貴上帶上下仝，或一官一印，及一正天乙，或一位本家禄三兩位貴人合者，宰輔命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803765760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803782144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100034058420276"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上遇兩貴而帶上件者亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803782144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若一位上遇灾煞、地煞、亡刼、羊力等神，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803798528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690865970888767/1-6de7f09069f783bc.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=i3Loth6cHPVFkIudo4ONMYvn%2Bqo%3D","uri":"read/NA03155/17/ref/1koet2p85bh1v/1-6de7f09069f783bc.webp","fontType":1,"components":"䒑〢⺕灬","variants":"兼","charPicId":"7456690865970888767"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370797803798528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主兵權、司馬、節鉞之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803798528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若胎月生月與日時上遇胎庫一貴，却帶正天乙上下合，或天乙貴合本家禄、正官正印、本家禄，但有氣，或貴人上亦帶前件祿干者，亦宰輔九卿命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803814912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月在忌神而日遇貴，或日在忌神而時遇貴，不害爲清華侍從之職。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803831296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日月俱在貴，而時遇忌神，此常調選人也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803847680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四忌主貧賤，亦有輕重。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803864064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸敗、絶爲重，病爲輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803880448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行各三位，如寅午戌火丙丁人遇之爲貴，與四貴三位同。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803896832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟闕胎貴一位，其主貴之福亦與四貴同。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803913216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽禄貴在臨","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803929600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100034058436660"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，陰禄貴在帝旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803929600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若陽禄遇旺，陰禄遇官，雖爲本位，其福减半。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803945984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若旺而無禄，如丙寅得戊午日時，更尅本命，又帶刑煞，主滛浪愚賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803962368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有遇一兩位貴，却爲㐫煞刑害，破得深重，亦主無禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803978752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"沈芝云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行以生旺爲君，臨官爲相。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797803995136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若納音是木，月日時遇寅、卯兩位，金遇申。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804011520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉水遇亥子，火遇巳午，土遇辰戌丑未，皆以貴論。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804027904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡看命，分五行生旺𣦸絶。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804044288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲甲、丙寅、己亥、辛巳、戊申，皆五行自長生，不論四時，超然得自生之理。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804060672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命禀之敏快高明，貴者得之，其進以漸，富者得之，亦無囘榮，而得其所以生也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804077056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子、戊午、辛卯、癸酉、庚子，皆","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804093440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100047694233612"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行自旺，不待四時，而能自致其旺，福力奮發，無與比擬。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804093440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未、壬辰、丙辰、甲戌、乙丑，皆五行自墓，乃歸根復命之時。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804109824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡庫之所在，必欲物聚之，則其庫𠑽。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804126208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬辰水，欲得衆水交歸，然後爲旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804142592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有金徃來相生，當得重權。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804158976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"儻水制火，火制金，更天中臨之，是爲負印不起，主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804175360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯、丁酉、壬午、甲子、己卯，此五行自𣦸者也，生則勞，𣦸則息，其理自然。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804191744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不有𣦸之地，其物無自而歸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804208128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂自𣦸者，得其眞歸之理焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804224512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命遇此，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804240896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872157372427/1-3f3dcc0584c9b748.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=u%2BLYn%2BwKIpWqaCEBH77LKOxTjss%3D","uri":"read/HY0741/18/ref/1ko7tci7o0f0g/1-3f3dcc0584c9b748.webp","fontType":1,"components":"上示頁","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690872157372427"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370797804240896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"特高明多慧少福，以静黙爲體而不利有爲，以淡薄爲事，而不利興起，惟可學道訪仙，超生𣦸之門也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804240896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳、","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804257280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099992602099739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥、庚申、壬寅、丁巳，此五行自絕者也，天之道無可絶焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804257280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支適㑹，巳絶則更生。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804273664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇此者，憂喜未定。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804290048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸巳絕水，得癸酉旺金扶之，是謂絕水逄生，尤爲吉慶。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804306432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命帶上𣦸絕、生旺、庫墓等，不可就以所帶言之，須㸔月令以辨清濁。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804322816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清者，有制伏之謂，如水病，見土則濁，却非土隄防，則不能止息。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804339200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣止息，則清之有漸也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804355584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濁者，無制伏之謂，如水多無土，則泛濫無歸，而水極生木，極則變，變則通也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804371968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢五行尚其變而不尚其常，貴其隱而不貴其顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804388352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸絕有救，則爲還魂，多以貴論；生旺有尅，則爲散氣，反主福淺。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804404736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫彼我之相生。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804421120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100033404239883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順則益本，逆則奪氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804437504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼此之相尅，順則勢強，逆則有傷，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804453888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：以小凌大，自貽其害；以弱勝強，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掇其殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804453888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一水尅三火，是以弱勝強，以陰勝陽，雖殃不彰；以陽勝陰，爲害不深。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804470272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩陽相梗，㐫禍旋至；兩陰相敵，不安其處。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804486656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙巳火尅壬申金，是以陰勝陽；壬申金尅己巳木，是以陽勝陰。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804503040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽有情，故無大害。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804519424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若丁卯見癸酉，是二陰相敵；戊午見甲子，是兩陽相拒，陽剛陰柔，必勝而後已，故禍","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804535808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太乙云：天地陰陽變化之機，未𡮢不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以陰召陽，陽召陰，則天地合正，五行氣融。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804535808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃陽從乎陽，陰從乎陰，則陰陽偏出，動静失序，所以禍福兩","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804552192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100042921132072"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"途也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804552192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵陰陽偏出，造化不成。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804568576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行如火多金少，聚散不得成形。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804584960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火少金多，旣不能銷鑠，反有煙滅之患，餘例推。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804601344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892557778998/1-d710eb14606e7e88.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=E49uxcFSE6i3xxOpkadxjY87NCc%3D","uri":"read/HY1130/40/ref/1koeg92oevvoa/1-d710eb14606e7e88.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丆囘","variants":"面","charPicId":"7456690892557778998"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370797804617728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局勢，然後","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804617728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690865995284499/1-4b8e40e06593b50d.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=mYQC4DIo440QMbgT5k4TUhARchc%3D","uri":"read/HY0945/11/ref/1kohp15pghczw/1-4b8e40e06593b50d.webp","fontType":1,"components":"厶大丶𰛅","variants":"參","charPicId":"7456690865995284499"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370797804617728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以喜忌好惡、旺相休囚。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804617728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如金人得庚辛或申酉爲體，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804634112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892557778998/1-d710eb14606e7e88.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=E49uxcFSE6i3xxOpkadxjY87NCc%3D","uri":"read/HY1130/40/ref/1koeg92oevvoa/1-d710eb14606e7e88.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丆囘","variants":"面","charPicId":"7456690892557778998"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370797804634112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得巳酉丑三合爲局勢，喜火制土扶，忌金寒水冷，生三秋四季爲旺相，春夏爲休囚。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804634112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘木火、水土，以例推之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804650496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金人遇庚申辛酉，爲五離煞，若生秋月，逄水則化金之毒，爲金白水清造化；逄火則制金之剛，爲煆成𨦟利之器。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804666880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804683264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無火無水，是謂頑金，主早年酒色，瘵痢身𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804699648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得戊","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804716032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100034058485812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅日時，剛處逄生，主富而壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804716032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"术人得土則根荄藉以栽培，得水則枝葉頼以條暢，得金斵削，便成材也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804732416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木逄寅卯，更在春生最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804748800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若三合㑹木局全，不須春生，多主仁壽术逄金制，金煆火伏，則剛柔相制。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804765184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若火太多則焚，金太多則損，土虛則不能培，水泛則不能潤，妙在得其中和。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804781568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水人以亥子爲源，以寅卯辰巳爲納，干源自北，萬折朝東，故水人喜逄東方，則浪息波平。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804797952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水頼土防，若生亥子，土多則吉，旣在東方，逄士亦吉，不宜土多，更有貴人財禄則貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804814336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日時遇庚申辛酉，水忌西流，恐壽不高。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804830720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於秋冬，生旺清澄，壬癸此時","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804847104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100042921148456"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而逄亥子，主有文學。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804847104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納音更水，則水太𨓺，柱無土隄，乃少子之斷，惟藝術空門則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804863488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更隔角重逄，定主刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804879872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春月乾渴而涸，夏月渾濁而泛，柱無水助，則不貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804896256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火居寅卯，生於春月，木秀火明，榮華富貴；生於夏月則太炎，柱中無水定夭，有水早貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804912640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於秋月，火𣦸金成，藏光内照，時日㣲逄旺氣則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804929024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢水火不嫌𣦸絕，只宜恬淡爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804945408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於冬月，柱中再得火𦔳，則潜消霜雪，温煖山河。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804961792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人云：冬日可愛，夏日可畏，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804978176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土逄四季，全上貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797804994560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如納音全土，柱中更得寅字爲艮山亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805010944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土能厚載，萬物資生，金木水火皆不可缺，故","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805027328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100047694282764"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此四行咸頼之也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805027328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫論五行之用，多則太過，少則不及，其氣其數，有餘不足，皆能致㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805043712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"抑揚歸中，然後爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805060096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功成者宜於退藏，將來者貴於榮振。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805076480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行禀旺，謂之成功，旺而能止息，是謂退藏。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805092864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行在冠帶胎養之地，其氣𧇊而未盈，是謂將來。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805109248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故欲子母相生，以益其氣，則有榮進振發之道。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805125632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如木非其時，衰則梗介，𣦸則枯槁，金旺太過，則動作多㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805142016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"炎炎者貴乎熄，不熄則有自焚之灾；滔滔者貴乎止，不止則有自溺之患。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805158400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火行南陸而化𤍠，盛則焚烈而害物，至酉亥，則陰能翕之，然後能温煖萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805174784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水行北陸而化寒，盛則嚴冷而","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805191168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100039972601893"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺物，至卯巳則陽能闢之，然後能滋生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797805191168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有生而不生，旺而不旺，此爲㐫乃先吉也，有𣦸而不𣦸絶。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858095139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而不絕，此爲吉，乃先㐫也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858111523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如水見戊申土，此生而不生，見庚子土，旺而不旺，遇此多成而反敗，因喜而反憂。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858127907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如水見癸卯金，此𣦸而不𣦸；見辛巳金，此絕而不絶。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858144291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行氣𥁞，而得父母之德以生益之，則其氣復生，遇之者危中有福，窮而通，屈而伸也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858160675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺太過，則福中藏禍；𣦸絶太過，則福無可托。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858177059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫𣦸絕逄生，殃變能迯。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858193443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土最先，金水猶後，火絕得土，曰𥈠","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858209827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火以土爲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子，火絶於亥，而見丁亥是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858209827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土絕得金，𣦸而不","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858226211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876296544297/1-ab01449b2277fb20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oHir1Qp0wqbSlQl75ZDGS3VX0X4%3D","uri":"read/HY0948/28/ref/1kof7c3v52jgv/1-ab01449b2277fb20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"二卜","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690876296544297"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370797858226211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858226211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100034058534964"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858226211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"絶，在也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金絶得水，精復繼體，金祀寅得抑，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858242595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水絶得木，魂復天逰，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858242595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水絕於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已得己巳木是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858242595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木絶得火，火出木燼，灰飛煙滅，故獨爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858258979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇馬無膽，於焉足證","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858275363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木絶於申，得丙申火是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858275363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇馬在位巳午，木歷巳午而𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858291747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木於臟屬肝，於腑屬膽，證木𣦸爲㐫也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858308131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身土遇火，生而漸利，命水得金，年乃優長。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858324515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金多須火，或從革以成名；木重得金，揉曲直而任使。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858340899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水流不止，須土以擁之；火盛無依，惟永以濟之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858357283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行用得其宜，雖相尅而爲福；若用失其宣，雖相生而爲灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858373667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100034058518580"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡五行怕太𨓺相忤。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858390051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如禄多則貧，馬多則病，印多則孤，庫多則虚。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858406435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺多無歸宿，𣦸絶多無激揚。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858422819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行不可太相傷，不可太純粹。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858439203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人馬多升擢，常人馬多奔馳，破要傷禍，空要空𥁞。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858455587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所愛者不可毁，所畏者不可旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858471971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先畏後愛爲福，先愛後畏爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858488355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合多不發而媚。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858504739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂多則無成，貴人多則巽懦而無立志。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858521123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬太顯，不可以貴人論；貴人表裏足，不可以常人論。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858537507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱俱陽，口惡心善；四柱俱陰，狼戾沉毒。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858553891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱要拱馬、拱禄、拱貴、拱福神，不要拱刑拱禍，拱歲拱時，陰陽貴在均恊，病傷要有尅制。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858570275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100042921197608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命丙辛壬癸見戊戊，則戊土當塗，刃傷折挫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858586659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子、丙午、丙午壬子，水木精神，陰陽純粹，餘位無𦔳，亦非常器。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858603043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加以季秀之氣，則曠世無忌，大德有容，乃丈夫也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858619427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉日出入之地，子午陰陽始分之官，遇之者令人徃來不定。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858635811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858652195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳亥爲兩極之地，地天幹旋；寅申爲三停之方，𨜚逓徃來。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858668579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人遇之，多不執一。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858684963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未遲遲，辰戌速速，遇之令人執方，性不通變。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858701347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌有氣，却能建立大事。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858717731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子人四柱有壬寅，是壬入丙家，就破不美。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858734115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子見庚午，是五鬼臨門。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858750499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅見甲寅，甲尅其戊，戊寅隨勢尅甲寅，是支干納音，上下不和，除","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858766883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099992602148891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"别有福神，方爲福力。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858766883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉見戊寅，戊土尅癸水，又金氣向絶鄉刼煞，元辰居中，除得月令中秀氣，方可爲用，亦久而不佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858783267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午、丁𮠕互旺互破，乃旺中破也，不可全爲福力。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858799651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未、辛酉，雖得食，却歸𣦸地，終久不隹。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858816035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑、乙未、庚辰、庚戌見戊寅，大好運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858832419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如得剛金濟戊寅，欲絶不絶，成福力。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858848803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯見戊寅，戊寅見乙卯，是大好命。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858865187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丹陽書云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇之際，尚有虛聲，𣦸絶之中，尤存生旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858881571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢三合三奇，不合月分則不貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858897955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲、戊、庚有子午時方貴，乙、丙、丁有寅卯時方貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858914339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天元變。化書云：乙丙丁正愛酉亥，更看納音有無交涉。又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100047694331916"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡三奇三合，帶月令中秀氣，入貴格，亦不免庻出𨓺房作贅。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858930723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"几命見三合三奇而本年不帶，在四孟生而得四仲四季月日時，四仲四季同論，及胎月日互換干合或六合而本命不帶，皆名曰掉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858947107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲多主離祖孤立，爲人不得力，少救𦔳，却宜義居，假合而立也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858963491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴命則多倚仗而升進。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858979875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡四柱帶三奇三合者，本身若不是𨓺房庻出，將來子孫必有𨓺房庻出，隨母之子。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797858996259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古詩云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合與三奇，清秀更饒肥。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859012643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不爲𨓺房子，便是隨母兒。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859029027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命前五辰爲宅舎，若遇有氣及吉神臨之，主有好","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859045411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100039972634661"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅，門閥崇峻，子孫華顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859045411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲申人宅舎在丑，十二月生，得天乙臨宅爲吉，若居無氣及㐫神臨之，主其宅虛耗，破壞不完，祖業不守。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859061795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令庚午人宅舎在亥，甲子旬亥落空亡，又遇刼煞臨之，爲㐫，餘准此推。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859078179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命後一辰爲破宅煞，若在破宅煞中，主無父祖産業，或客𣦸他鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859094563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又㸔宅納音與本命納音相生則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859110947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅尅身得好宅，身尅宅必破散。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859127331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲子金以己巳木爲宅，二月生，雖係宅旺，合有好宅，以身尅宅，後當破落。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859143715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午火以癸亥水爲宅，九月生宅冠帶，十月生宅建，十一月生宅旺，又値宅生尅身，必得好宅。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859160099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若宅鬼旺","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859176483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100034058551348"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中生者，有官則吉，無官則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859176483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡禄命雖有休旺，更論其宅，以辨吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859192867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"沈芝云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅怕犯破，如甲子人以己巳是宅，如犯亥字，其宅受破，命元稍薄，太歲衝年，亦須破，須是爲長方可斷。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859209251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙子人得辛巳金爲宅，遇乙亥流年之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859225635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命好亦更動，興作方應。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859242019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876296544297/1-ab01449b2277fb20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oHir1Qp0wqbSlQl75ZDGS3VX0X4%3D","uri":"read/HY0948/28/ref/1kof7c3v52jgv/1-ab01449b2277fb20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"二卜","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690876296544297"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370797859307555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"空亡支合無。兀元辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干，合無厄，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859307555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六厄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺無䘮，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859307555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"䘮門","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰無弔，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859307555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"弔客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻無刃，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859307555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"羊刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財無飛，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859307555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"飛亷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孟無孤，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859307555","marginNoteIdList":null,"
