pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孤辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"季無寡。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859307555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寡宿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體重須鬼，禄重須官夫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859323939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須尠，妻須倍，吉須顯然，㐫須沉昧。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859340323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支干太和而塞，夫婦失時而㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859356707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱主本，禄馬徃來，須分建破，天乙扶持，將德是衝，更辨尊𤰞。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859373091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有根而無苗，實貧而尚可","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859389475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690887117144105/1-655f9ae1be8ec023.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=KnEYc6lAtIcxSjJfPuF6Uq8zNGI%3D","uri":"read/HY0707/13/ref/1kns3ue5gbe37/1-655f9ae1be8ec023.webp","fontType":1,"components":"〢二一","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690887117144105"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370797859389475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食，本氣絕而花繁，縱子成而味拙。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859389475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至若貴神當位，諸煞伏藏，三元旺相，豈專神煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859405859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命中用煞，以五行爲本。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859422243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如五行得地，無貴煞而亦貴，雖有惡煞，無害於事。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859438627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若五行不得地，縱有吉煞，亦發不仄，如冬月中花耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859455011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100047694364684"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納音者，天地之舞數也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859471395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬學堂，居長生之位，才能官職，在旺相之鄉，文章富貴，處印庫之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859487779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逄衰敗，則减三分之一，更遇𣦸絕，則去十分之半。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859504163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切忌空亡衝尅，不宜刑害吞食。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859520547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故同源相成，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859536931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"順數爲上，雜數次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則天地舞全，基本強壯；同類相傷，","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859536931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如丁未刑丁丑之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則支神氣散，理無復合。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859536931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"管輅日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行互旺，雖衝氣完；五行相尅，雖合氣散。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859553315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859569699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：人生有始終功名富貴，有一旦崛起，忽然驟興，有始終剥落而中間","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859586083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883409870867/1-266de11b15e064b9.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=f2nY2urQh1sED2ZUY1NA174onZI%3D","uri":"read/HY1286/11/ref/1kowdgpnfyskz/1-266de11b15e064b9.webp","fontType":1,"components":"奞日","variants":"奮","charPicId":"7456690883409870867"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370797859586083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發，有半世淹蹇而晩年成就。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859586083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859602467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"荅曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫非命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859618851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其始終富貴，乃柱中身主","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859635235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100042921213992"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專旺，其所用吉神，或官印財食，俱各帶禄得令，不偏不黨，無刑衝尅害，出門行運，歩歩皆吉，故能成材，能振耀，紹前人之基業，立當代之功名，不招","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859635235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690878066950156/1-f97d399062b71ff0.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=OWEbcrqE%2BqGLsP2sF1NU8n5Xqw4%3D","uri":"read/HY1066/14/ref/1kop17pnqir6q/1-f97d399062b71ff0.webp","fontType":1,"components":"言欠口免","variants":"讒","charPicId":"7456690878066950156"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370797859635235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𧩂，不致傷害，保其終始，是命運生旺，體用俱得故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859635235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其一旦崛起，忽然驟興，繇柱中所用貴神，悉皆得位乘旺，又且合格，柰日主無力，不能勝任其福，所以勞困偃蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859651619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倐逄好運，生扶日干，得其強健，元命用神，方爲我用，我因乘之，虎嘯風生，大發富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859668003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是偏氣乘和，衰以遇旺，故迎吉而發，前後逈異。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859684387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有日主強旺，五行煞純。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859700771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不雜柰根本原無制伏，富貴不戊，惟待運來制伏，煞","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859717155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100033404289035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神化爲權柄，功名顯逹，出類超羣，制神力旺，發福非常，所以驟興。","logicSentenceId":"7577370797859717155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"繇貧賤而至極品，全繇行運得地，方見其興。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361411636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如運不至，卽常人耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361428020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其始終","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361444404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883409870867/1-266de11b15e064b9.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=f2nY2urQh1sED2ZUY1NA174onZI%3D","uri":"read/HY1286/11/ref/1kowdgpnfyskz/1-266de11b15e064b9.webp","fontType":1,"components":"奞日","variants":"奮","charPicId":"7456690883409870867"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370798361444404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發而中間剥落者，乃柱中日主健旺，用神亦旺，各相力停，爲富室朱門之賢子，及其長大成立，要逄好曜。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361444404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若大運加臨元命，見其財而奪之，因其官而傷之，臨其印而壞之，洚其食而梟之，遭際此運，禍不勝言，所以盛年見傾而不發。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361460788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如其惡運一去，又逄好運扶持，使用神一新，譬如枯苖得雨，勃然而興；鴻毛遇風，飄然而舉，不可禦也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361477172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若半世淹蹇，晚年成就，乃四柱身強，羊刃比肩，又","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361493556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100033404321803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各爭旺，惟財官煞神等物，虛浮輕少，無力而成功，各出門行運，又非作福之地，所以一生饑寒，勞苦剥落。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361493556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直至晩年，頓逄好運，補起財官煞神等物，假煞爲權，制伏羊刃，或得權貴而顯揚，或起資財而發福，當隨五行清濁，以其所遇之運别之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361509940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗟夫，窮通有命，富貴在天，孔子有是言也，豈人智力所能移易乎哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361526324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或問","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"興亡生𣦸，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361542708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"荅日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人命中有煞爲用，煞神未制，則爲白屋窮途之人，或作豪門卓犖之士。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361542708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要逄制伏運，假煞而興，切不可脫制伏運。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361559092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一入財鄉，財能黨煞，再遇流年，財煞𦔳旺，併力爲殃，身主孤寒尅害，輕同","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361575476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100047694381068"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傾家徒流，重則刑棄其身，煞神併合，㐫亡可畏。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361575476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此羊刃同論。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361591860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有柱中月令正氣官星，爲一生富貴，惟逢財印則利。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361608244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星喜財旺以生之，印旺以護之，故令其人能行仁布德，緯國經邦，權重爵高，後煞神得位。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361624628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲煞併臨，官化爲鬼，喪身必矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361641012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不行煞運，或行傷官運，又無印綬制之，傷官得地，貴禄遭傷，喪妻尅子，剥職生灾，更遇流年黨他，必致身亡𢡖惡。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361657396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如有高見明識，知進退存亡之機而保其身者，不遭非横，亦自己惡疾而終。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361673780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有柱中所専用神，無官煞氣，惟偏正財旺，財神當道，隱隱興隆，積財聚富，但少貴耳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361690164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再㸔行","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361706548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100042921230376"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運何如。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361706548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢官禄旺鄉，富貴𩀱全。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361722932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"設有不幸，財神脫局，羊刃相逄，更遇流年衝合羊刃，財神𥁞傷，元命衰絕，羊刃生灾，敗亡必矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361739316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生𣦸則以格局論，如印綬見財，行財運，又𠔥𣦸絕，必入黄泉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361755700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱有比肩，庻幾有解。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361772084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官見煞及傷官刑衝破害，歲運相併必𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361788468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正財偏財見比肩分奪，羊刃刼財，歲運衝合必𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361804852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官之格，財旺身弱，官煞重見，混雜衝刃，歲運又見必𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361821236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制則傷殘，拱禄拱貴塡實，又見官煞刼亡衝刃，歲運重見卽𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361837620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日禄歸時，刑衝破害，見七煞官星空亡，衝刃必𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361854004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞官大忌，歲運相併必𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361870388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘諸格，並忌煞及填","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361886772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100039972700197"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實，歲運併臨必𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361886772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹諸㐫神惡煞、勾絞、元辰、亡神、刼煞、弔客、墓病𣦸宫諸煞，九𣦸一生。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361903156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官太多，身弱，元犯七煞，身輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361919540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙丁日干年月時庚辛加酉運，或庚辛年必𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361935924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日干庚辛月時夾雜，年運見庚辛必𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361952308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有救則吉，無救定㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361968692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行神煞，金多夭折，水盛飄流，木旺則夭，土多痴呆，火多愚頑，太過不及。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798361985076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作此論，一不可拘，二須敢斷，求其生𣦸，决定無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362001460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至若五行生𣦸，如壬日生在二月，行申運卽𣦸，生在七月，行卯運卽𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362017844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃遇生怕𣦸，旣𣦸怕生，造化與人事一也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362034228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須並看之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362050612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100122012975123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡮢謂人之生𣦸，年月日時，俱皆前定，姑舉一二。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362066996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如定興張易金，嘉熈二年仲秋，以兒婦馬睦閣臨盆，乞靈寳泉寺，當境神夢金狗玉雞、黄羊青犬，次第而至，逮生勇九淮王，則戊戌、辛酉、己未、甲戌八字，果應淮王雲。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362083380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫壅七公相亦占胤於江文通祠，夢始出疲赤犬，再見肥黄狗在路傍，及白馬立平地木左，復覩赭猪聮咬，犬尾入屋上土。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362099764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公相自忖度，乃丙戌、戊戌、庚午丁亥年月日時。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362116148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成化歲次暮秋朔後夜半甫生子，果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362132532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又元文式五師，生大德丁未歲正月十七日壬午申時，至明洪武己未元旦，夢中得黄羊，觸數七十有","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362148916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100034058584116"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三，至斯際果逝。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362148916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其子式、敬、籌六爱數白兎入内，姜沉閨懐，及順帝十一年仲春甲辰昧爽，産淑、正求二者，四柱皆辛卯。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362165300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"后人有記云：暦周追憶古人心，仰止高山直到今。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362181684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𮋲兎兩雙生夢兆，四重辛卯又逄陰。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362198068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又白雞銀䑕，應辛酉庚子之祥，白雞在酉，值太歲不起之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362214452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由上數事觀之，人之生𣦸，信前定矣哉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362230836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若尹子常夢巳逹午厄，寅滅，後，見蛇入穴得金，墜馬、虎嚙，皆符。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362247220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孝介經三叟，夢逹逵逢乙巳對局，至成化三十一年，遇是干支登耋壽，四月望日，進宜義郎秩。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362263604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫幹父亦同前夢，後復以正德四年乙巳仲夏，遂陞衛侯。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362279988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362296372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100086994747401"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人祈夢，問子孫於土地神，得詩云：犬羊父母靑龍子，赤馬黄駒與白雞。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362296372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫虎曽同翁屬肖，丙隆一氣應多齊。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362312756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觧者以其伯子生甲辰，仲子生丙午，叔子生戊午，季子生辛酉，長孫生寅，曽孫生丙戌，推𥮅皆騐是。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362329140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一家祖父子孫，其生皆前定也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362345524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又古人祈祠社廟神示詩云：左龍右虎赤同方，只怕炎猴及木羊。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362361908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三十八年生𣦸隔，風雲際㑹總無常。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362378292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其後生𣦸年月日時，無不符驗。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362394676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人謂飲啄莫非前定，況功名乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362411060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况生𣦸平，况子孫乎？","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362427444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼不知命而妄圖者，其不爲鬼神所笑者幾希！","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362443828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100086994763785"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巫咸撮要：","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362460212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天元神趣經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡推人命，先詳日下，興衰變用，分局天地，方成造化。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362460212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴賤明於上下，興衰𥁞在干支。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362476596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四時中妙理窮通，五行内榮枯自禀。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362492980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以春生甲乙居寅卯，豈怕庚辛；夏長丙丁乘巳午，何愁壬癸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362509364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛値兑，秋生兮離火難侵；壬癸逢乾，冬降兮戊巳怎尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362525748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土生四季得時而遇鬼，其傷無害；設使五行失地而逄尅，其灾不愈。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362542132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又若化格成象，須分衰旺相停；尤宜配合之中，要識徃來去路。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362558516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金絶艮北，火没乾西，木落坤南而無形，水到巽東而無位。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362574900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃陽干皆𣦸，遇合而以","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362591284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100033404387339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"類相從妻若潜形，但見局中而可决。陰生四正時旺者，身貴家榮，𣦸絶墓衰類傷干，尤爲不足。化氣入格不破，大顯貴者，十有八九；化氣失局有傷，論顯榮者，百無一二。最高最貴者，居旺處三位，須要相扶至賤。至貧者居衰處，四柱難𡬶造化玄。象在地支之中，配合在天干之内，象成旺用，皆生火土之中，四柱無傷。直列朝廷之上，支中畏懼，亦須聲譽非貧；運至衰鄉，必主灾咎。化成造化，各居於衰墓絕鄕，象成襍局，遇合猶如不遇，夫行旺運，妻乃從夫，妻運扶持，夫從妻論，己身臨鬼，須明天地之中，象旺象衰，要識榮枯貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100033404403723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362591284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身衰鬼旺，應須肢體傷殘；身旺鬼衰，定作㐫徒之命；鬼身皆衰，男必飄","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362607668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890527735871/1-84e94468ff8e801e.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=GXrLLWD7QtKjd6D7iobKuOsuQPg%3D","uri":"read/HY2616/10/ref/1ks94rw4kaoty/1-84e94468ff8e801e.webp","fontType":1,"components":"艹辶夂干","variants":"蓬","charPicId":"7456690890527735871"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370798362607668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女作師尼。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362607668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏身潜匿，自居高名；月氣相傷，此乃伏象。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362624052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼皆全，遐齡不遂。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362640436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干中破敗，乃有技藝以隨身；支乃生全，難仗六親而獨立。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362656820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行屬於其象，皆在十二支中。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362673204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先分南北與東西，次看三合内别認。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362689588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳六親者，從象而推之；審富貴者，官祿而兩說。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362705972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有禄盛者，鰥寡孤獨；有官鬼者，殘疾夭壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362722356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身如顯化，自身無氣，本性全𧇊。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362738740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假五行成象，平生窘廹，豈得祖宗之財；顯福顯盈，因犯别房父母。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362755124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從象論引用爲氣化象論天地相停，從中有貴有賤，化内有富","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362771508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100122012991507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362771508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從中貴顯，得時而位列朝中；化内成局，運轉而成封帝側，從象衰而至老驅驅，化象伏而平生碌碌。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362787892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看子平之法，専論財官，以月上財官爲𦂳要。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362804276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發覺在於日時，要消詳於強弱。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362820660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論財官不論格局，論格局不論財官。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362837044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人格者，非富卽貴；不人格者，非貧卽夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362853428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一格二格，非卿卽相；三格四格，財官不𥾴，非刑卒多是九流。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362869812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官怕傷財怕刼，印綬見財，愈多愈灾；傷官見官，原有者重，原無者輕，重者遷徙，輕者刑責。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362886196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上傷官，父母不全；月上傷官，兄弟不完；日上傷官，難爲妻妾；時上傷官，子孫無傳；歲月傷官刧財，生於貧賤之","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362902580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100122013024275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家，或是庻出。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362902580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目時傷官，𨚫財，傷損子孫，主無晩福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362918964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞混雜，爲人好色，多滛，化事小巧寒賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362935348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有財印者吉，無財印者㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362951732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼財敗財，心高下賤，爲人貪婪。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362968116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正財月令，勤儉慳吝；柱有刼刃，比肩多者，刑父母，傷妻妾，不聚財。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798362984500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"商賈須觀落地之財，宰相須看得時正禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798363000884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞梟重，走遍他鄉之客；傷官刼財，瞞心負頼之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798363017268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重犯奇儀者貴，重犯亡刼者夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798363033652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞宜制，獨立爲强；鬼中逄官，逼廹太甚。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798373994511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明煞合去，五行和氣春風；暗煞合來，四柱刑傷害己。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374010895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞刃無制，女多産厄，男犯刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374027279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二德無破，女必賢良，男多忠孝。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374043663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印食，定顯慈祥之德；","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374060047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100033404420107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼傷比梟，難透寡惡之各。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374060047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝官無合，乃飄流之徒；坐馬落空，是落魄之軰。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374076431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令逄衝，𨓺房離祖；官印遇偏，庻出孽生。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374092815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干頭滅烈，堪嗟伯牛之疾；時日衝刑，難免卜商之泣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374109199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六虛臨於乙亥，孟浩然徒有文章，三才會於壬辰，石季倫恣情金玉，有文無印，賈誼屈於長沙。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374125583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有印無文，李斯専於上蔡。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374141967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑多者爲人不義；合多者，疎背皆親。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374158351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合多主晦，衝多主㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374174735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰多好闘，戌多好訟，辰戌魁罡，多㐫少吉；時月空亡，難爲妻子皆駝；驛馬離别，鄉土混雜，官煞奔走衣食。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374191119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬遭傷，名利成敗；天厨逄梟，食禄𧇊盈；傷官遇羊刃，刼財營食，終日區","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374207503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100086994780169"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"區；正官逢七煞，剥傷求生，一世忙忙。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374207503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官招丄貴之憐，煞傷慮小人之耻。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374223887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官無衝破，爵禄獨顯；財少傷刧，各利𩀱全。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374240271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印在刑囚之地，心亂身忙；日時在鬼墓之鄉，憂多樂少，福不福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374256655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恐吉還遭傷成不成。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374273039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是格中帶煞，財官兩旺兮主持節鉞，煞刃交顯兮掌握兵權。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374289423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官是扶身之本，官在長生須富學；財爲養命之源，財逢旺處，足錢帛。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374305807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印綬，三吉不可不逢；刼刃傷煞，四㐫不可不畏。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374322191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印臨天乙，受盛世之封；財藏官庫，畜希異之寳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374338575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇貴人見生時，舘學清華世所稀。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374354959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人若逢禄馬來，設使金章未爲足；官貴若逄財官𦔳，重","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374371343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100117793505343"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犯奇儀須宰輔。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374371343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不作","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374387727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690878107779135/1-a1cb2a7549fca4b1.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=HM%2Fkzv1fwFyg%2FhqdWCEZFyqWNXs%3D","uri":"read/HY0872/12/ref/1kob2uyrwgsh2/1-a1cb2a7549fca4b1.webp","fontType":1,"components":"辶𦮔","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690878107779135"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370798374387727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萊三島客，也須金殿玉階行。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374387727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"互禄互馬，共羡黒頭公相；帶刑帶破，終爲白靣書生。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374404111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有印無官，發不在迅速之内；有官無印，難求平榮𬱌之名。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374420495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官帶印，積玉堆金；偏正逢財，倉盈庫滿；印綬錦鞍勒馬，官貴玉帶金魚。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374436879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫莫㐫於羊刃，禍莫禍於傷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374453263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運逄羊刃，刼敗財物耗散。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374469647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃倘同生氣，閫外持權；傷官被合，妨妻害子；傷官帶刃，尅爺損娘。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374486031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官藏煞見，定招非横之灾；煞没官明，當膺藩輔之柄。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374502415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少樂多憂，官星又帶刼財，骨肉分離，孤鸞再遇傷煞，三刑六害，衝擊者，難得崢嵘；孤辰隔甬，重見者，爻主貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374518799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100042921279528"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"享用見成，出門便行財禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374535183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生寂寞，行運與命分張。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374551567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有官而不食禄；月上正官被傷，有財而不得享；柱中正財分奪，禄馬先逄於生月，陰德榮華；若日時再見財官，此乃遇而不遇。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374567951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四象之中，隐土而成；五行之内，干秀爲榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374584335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未滋榮甲乙，寅午戌聚福丙丁。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374600719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸喜生潤下，庚辛愛見從革，戊巳忻逄四季。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374617103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水潤下兮文學貴顯，土稼穡兮富貴經商。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374633487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春生甲乙，抱懷仁德之心；夏遇丙丁，胷藏明辨之才。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374649871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋金兮性多剛毅，冬水兮智足權謀。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374666255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛無金，雖仁不成造化；火旺木衰，縱學難得貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374682639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100086994829321"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水多遇土，成堤岸之功；木盛逄金，作棟鿄之美。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374699023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火相停成既濟；土逄木旺爲稼穡；金火氣均，煉出鋒刃之器。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374715407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行造化，皆因鬼而成功。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374731791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木敗不仁而𡚶作，金衰寡義亦無恩；火滅無禮之軰，水濁失智之人。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374748175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土遭木尅，言常失信；金鬼好殺，水盛多滛。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374764559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日旺仍須自立，更詳上下吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374780943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲月相扶，因祖而發；時日相衝，妻子無功；衰墓平生孤立；生旺一世峥嶸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374797327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下相合而無害，徃來尅戰乃多憂。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374813711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬時尅口破，縱職位終須退剥。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374830095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日旺時強，聚秀，無福，亦須横發。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374846479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月爲傷害，時得地，財運自能成立。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374862863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月遇絕傷，時對衝，門丘定有三遷。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374879247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374895631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099992602214427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄衰地，幼歲艱難；月在旺鄉，晩年不足。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374895631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時衰日秀，有始無終。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374912015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月弱時強，晚年榮顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374928399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元氣強旺，雖未逹，終顯功名。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374944783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"基本休囚，縱得地，難成富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374961167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫天元羸弱，命不再甦，忽值本主休囚，貧寒無地。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374977551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣旺遭傷，雖遇險，終身有救；氣敗逄生，縱得地，一世無成。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798374993935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行失地，休言禄馬同鄉；四柱無歸，難論財官雙美。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375010319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以日尅者爲妻，妻生者爲子，考其生旺，定其𣦸絶。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375026703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時臨旺處，必多兒，時在敗鄉，必絶嗣；男逄兩位之財，必須置妾；若遇合處逄禄，定挾妻榮；財鄉見合，立身倚妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375043087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽干上下逄合，妻多易得；合中更遇生氣，妻妾賢良。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375059471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱逓互，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375075855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100034058649652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相親，多生喜慶。五行來徃相傷，皆主不義。財失地而岐路經商，身旺甚則九流術業，火聚水德相刑爲僧。反覆水逄土旺相殘，爲道無終。火明木秀，幼年顯達朝廷；火炎水涸，終身求財市井；金白水清，多顯達鬼。位逄官，主困窮，財下見財，富而慳吝。羊刃帶煞被刑，男子身遭鞭配，財盛刑傷父母鬼旺後代昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榮從化","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375075855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"忌從返本，平生衰樂無寕。丙辛化水到水鄉，位列朝廷；丁壬化木臨木位，身居宰輔。東金西木不從化一世虛名，離壬坎丙得位時，平生顯跡。用神敗衰帶禄不能爲福。禄馬氣旺，遇貴合，主顯榮，有官無馬而職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100122013057043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"微，有馬無官而身賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375075855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱生旺，雖無官禄，亦長年。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375092239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行敗衰，縱帶禄馬，終夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375108623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡相逄衝尅，多遭刑獄；建禄無財刑制，定爲奴婢。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375125007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽火𣦸於墓絶，性𠒋頑，多爲酷吏；陰火生於長養，人豐厚，當爲富豪。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375141391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行忌沐浴逄傷，四柱喜生旺制煞，有害而姻親散失，遇戰而疾病纒身。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375157775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木火忌逄申酉，灾病呻吟；衰金畏遇旺火，苦形悲嘆。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375174159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時臨鬼地，無制多貧；運至財官，無刑必發。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375190543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞羊刃，名位大顯；正印官星，刑衝乃禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375206927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬趨艮位，遇之則發資財。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375223311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變煞爲官，幼嵗功名顯逹。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375239695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日午月，火多而運喜官鄉，財官敗地，一世貧寒；三奇無傷，平","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375256079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100034058666036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375256079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日雖建禄，不逢財官，主孤貧；日祿歸時，不遇財印，亦難發。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375272463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上偏財，運至兄弟之位，主妻灾；時上羊刃，歲遇偏正之財，生㐫禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375288847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官月上旺，富貴雙全；偏官時上逄，無情有禍；財歸旺地無破，家道興隆；印綬生身無傷，門閥光彩。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375305231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有官無印，卽非真官；有印無官，反成厚福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375321615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花帶合，風流儒雅之人；五湖雲擾，餓於首陽之客。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375337999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千刑支合，樂變爲憂；干合支刑，喜中不美。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375354383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不九流僧道，定須重拜爺娘。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375370767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓時雜氣，逄局鑰，始得顯榮；羊刃金神遇七煞，必爲大貴；雙辰夾角，偏生庻出之人；寡宿孤辰，異姓同居之子。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375387151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水騎龍，逄","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375403535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100034058682420"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰多少登天府；乙木捕䑕，遇子多早歩蟾官。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375403535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日禄歸時，没官星，錦鞍綉轡；月生日干，無財氣，玉帶金魚。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375419919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六陰朝陽，逢季月，只作印看；六壬趨艮，逢亥月，當以貧論。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375436303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格局無破無刑，名利成就；官印有傷有損，爵位𧇊停。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375452687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻宫羸弱，犯刼財，必損其妻；兄弟位柔，見官強，必傷昆季；天元羸弱失時，難獲延年；日主高強，化鬼，當膺厚福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375469071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日旺無依，離祖遷居；若不遷居，𣦸在外地；日旺無依，損財傷妻；若不傷妻，外家冷落。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375485455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官被合，平生名利皆虛；七煞被合，處世反㐫爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375501839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞旺更值身衰，衣食奔走；官柔又遇煞擾，行藏汨没；財旺身強，資","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375518223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443099992602230811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財疊積。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375518223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲辰甲戌落寅亥，金帛滿屋；丁亥、丁卯到酉亥，珍寳盈室。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375534607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲日遇庚辛，若重多，必主灾厄；六丙身居亥子，無制伏，定是貧儒。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375550991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行運得失，更當詳察。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375567375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得地失時，如田疇得雨；得時失地，如輗損塗泥。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375583759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得時者亦能舉躍，失地者難以升遷。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375600143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故火到南方而榮，水臨北地而盛，土到東而病，木至西而衰，金入北而沉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798375616527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺處生而𣦸處滅，𣦸處生而旺處脫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864728064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運俱傷，日主遇之，命必𧇊危。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864744448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣運與祖氣傷殘，門戶與父母俱損。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864760832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運神尅歲，刑訟來臨；歲尅運神，官灾競起。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864777216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金主刀刃刑傷，木主江河覆溺。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864793600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木則懸梁自縊，虎咬龍嗔，火","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864809984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100107869782031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則夜眠壓倒，焚𣦸蛇傷，土乃墻推土䧟。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864809984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行煞重，當如此詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864826368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有化而不化之繇，聚而不聚之機，合而不合之𩔖，秀而不秀之實。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864842752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化而不化，損於貴；聚而不聚，損於財，合而不合，損於官；秀而不秀，損於福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864859136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有不化而化之因，不聚而聚之機；不合而合之理，不秀而秀之用。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864875520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不化而化者，定居權貴；不聚而聚者，終於富足；不合而合者，必遷高職；不秀而秀者，須享禄位。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864891904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定四時有旺無旺，察五行有氣無氣，隨物而變物，因類而求類。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864908288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行俱要中和，一物不可偏枯。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864924672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水不勝火兮，奔波","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864941056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100086994862089"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流蕩；火不勝金兮困苦恓惶。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864941056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三辛見丙兮錢財破散；二壬見丁兮家道興隆。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864957440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有秀而無官者，但施巧於技藝；見財而無托者，惟遂志於經商。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864973824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲居從革之方，風灾困苦；金成潤下之局，萍梗他鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798864990208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱旺則從之所使，俱衰則變爲他物。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865006592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一鬼不能勝兩官，一禄不能勝兩鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865022976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行落在本鄉，不貴則富；四柱臨於破地，非賤則貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865039360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺爲上，德秀爲奇，身坐學堂，文藝清高之客；命臨鬼禍，徒流盜賊之人。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865055744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄内隠刑，定操兵戟於戎位；秀中見尅，必主案牘於公門。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865072128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼休母旺，錢財奴馬多招；鬼旺母衰，父母兄弟分散。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865088512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印兩全，秉旌旄而居","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865104896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100117793554495"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武職；淑秀全僃，應科甲而入文銓。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865104896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藏暗禄者，官居極品；遇真官者，禄位非常。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865121280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干臨𣦸絶病衰，賤居塵上；五行在三奇庫墓，榮列縉𦁴；兩位鬼鄉，逢倒食，必爲奴婢；一氣有歸，遇墓月，定主孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865137664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳得位，居辰巳，貴列三台；玄武當權，逢亥子，官封一品。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865154048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸見庚申居右職，辛逄戊子中高科。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865170432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰水遇秀，失地者，身爲僧道；陽火無歸，遇水兮，定作㐫徒。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865186816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金到火鄉，財多聚散；旺水入南，家道盈昌；庚居三冬，水冷金寒；得火相扶，莫作等閒，破禄則","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865203200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876296544297/1-ab01449b2277fb20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=fnJneu6OjCt4fCs6D0ww2yZdBGc%3D","uri":"read/HY0948/28/ref/1kof7c3v52jgv/1-ab01449b2277fb20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"二卜","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690876296544297"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370798865203200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣絕則病；時臨鬼位更逄衝，傷危不誣；臨官復加衰敗地，𣦸絶無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865203200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最貴者，官星爲命，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865219584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100122013106195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財得偏正爲福；最㐫者，七煞臨身，天赦二德爲祥。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865219584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星如遇比刼，雖官無貴；七煞若逄滋𦔳，其煞愈㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865235968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此合六合，歲運合而必榮；七官八官，月建官而爲喜；四合四刑，刑合當明邪正；七衝八擊，衝擊喜得㑹藏；夾貴夾丘爲暗㑹；財庫官庫要明衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865252352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星在生旺之方，逄則何須𤼵見；印綬藏孟仲之下，見而不用露形。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865268736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬得刼財爲貴，財元喜傷官爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865285120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官若見印綬，貴不可言；歸禄若遇食傷，福無限妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865301504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年日互有陰陽二刃，刑法重犯，官煞混逄。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865317888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天月二德，禄位高遷。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865334272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛刃伏刃，㑹刃多㐫；傷官剥官，見官爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865350656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃若逄印綬雖","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865367040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100117793570879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴而殘疾在身；七煞無制，逄官爲禍，而壽元不久。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865367040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三偏三正遇三奇，貴居一品之尊；四旺四生全四柱，福在衆人之上。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865383424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞化爲印，早擢巍科；財旺生官，少受貽澤。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865399808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞同來，要知扶官扶煞；偏正相㑹，須知合正合偏。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865416192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865432576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月逄羊刃，世事不明；金神運到水鄉，身屍分拆。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865448960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暗中藏煞，須明月下用神；見處無財，必受空中禍害；羊刃更兼㑹合，千里徒流；用財若遇刼奪，一生貧窘。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865465344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生前定，窮逹已分，須要識其消長，亦當究其始終。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865481728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當詳流運之源，要察行年之位。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865498112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱如逢七煞，運到制伏必傾；身旺若逢福輕，運到，衰敗必𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865514496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲輿","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865530880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100086994894857"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命不和，有灾有病；四柱與歲相生，無禍無殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865530880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱徒然入格，雖發早亡；福輕若遇休囚，必然傾夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865547264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以用神不可妄求，形迹自然發見，有福則當用彼，無時必是用身，禍害在於五門，福榮存於運氣，福厚人所共同。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865563648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如或傷原終困，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865580032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絕不能取生下之財，衰不能敵旺中之鬼，逆制無情，順生可救，主無而本有，可救一半。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865580032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時俱逄二德，百事無㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865596416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更值財官，定主豪富。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865612800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主本有力，鬼可爲官；本主無氣，官來作鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865629184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑衝之法，仔細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865645568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有刑出刑入，刑吉刑㐫，有衝動衝不動衝合衝不合之辨。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865661952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865678336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100107869814799"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰必定動揺，來合有情，方爲富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865678336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜氣藏蓄，要定誰先誰後。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865694720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"提綱專用，須分氣淺氣深。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865711104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一陽來復，木火用而水藏；一陰如生，火土盛而金伏。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865727488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將來者進，遇之有功，成功者退，得之何益。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865743872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建財官印綬，時作分野歸元，或補其不足，或抑其太過，要造化中和爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865760256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三元定命，先詳四柱有無；五行成格，次論命運強弱。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865776640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如身弱財旺，須假身強之鄉；若身旺禄衰，却喜禄生之地，印生爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865793024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畏見財鄉，煞在柱中，煞不宜旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865809408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命無財禄，運逄禄馬則灾；原有傷官，再遇官鄉則禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865825792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最忌者，日干衝運，所喜者，運干生於日干也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865842176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但看有","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865858560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100050856624165"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情無情，合與不合，㐫㑹吉㑹消詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865858560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如原有害刃，則骨肉殘傷；原有傷煞，地支𣦸絶，加以運中禄馬俱弱，禍不旋踵。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865874944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更以流歲抑揚禍福，無有不准。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865891328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逄建祿之地，名爲禄馬俱絶，壽限難迯。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865907712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内有禄絕而發，比肩而耗，氣有淺深，格有成壞，不可執一推之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865924096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100086994960393"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉井奥訣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865940480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"安東柱謙着。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡推究造化之理，其法以日爲主，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865956864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"单提作體，要認爲主者之端，爲化氣，爲本體，入門便要通變，識得主干，有本象，有化奐，方可消詳。如甲即本象是木，化象是土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐下支神，先求其意。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865956864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃日干坐下首，先㸔此地支與月支一位，時支一位，年支一位，刑衝破害、生尅比和何如，主干喜忌。何物得來，不可視爲泛常，不可顧盻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月氣淺深，何者主權，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865973248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月建之下，氣候淺深，五行之氣，是何干神？正當此日天時之令，五日一候之氣。一云德秀有無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地支至切，黨盛爲強。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865973248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100086994911241"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地支乃四位支神，至切者，視天干爲尤切也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798865989632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要看何者爲主千之宅舎，何者爲用神之基業，何者力。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866006016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輕何者力重，宅舎卽得地之方，基業卽乘貴之所。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866022400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一看其力勢衝起是何支神，二看其力𫝑拱起是何支神，三看其力勢刑起是何支神，四看其力勢合起是何支神，五看地支綂攝。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866038784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此法是空中立有者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866055168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論地支衝拱刑合四件，極切。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866071552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門庭一法，只拿日千作主取用。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866087936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中間或吉神有刑衝，㐫煞有拱合，其生旺休廢，交差不一，難下手脚。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866104320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不如只詳四個地支基址。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866120704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五氣中何物最重，將來品量，却能耗散何神，能生扶何神，能衝合何神，能變化何神，然後却看日干屬何五氣，與其最重之氣統攝何如，便拿財官等物用神之氣，共前五氣，引於時座𠫭較其物何者輕，何者重，義理調順爲祥瑞，反則卽爲乖戾矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866137088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此己立定，然後看其支氣，各有所喜所忌之端，不可不詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866153472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五氣謂如木、火、士、金、水五者，須要各各記住題目。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866169856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若五氣中何者黨多爲重，如支千内外明暗，木多則木氣黨盛。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866186240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矢黄喜忌門論於前五仃中，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866202624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100122013155347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專執用神，切詳喜忌","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866202624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"専執一位，用神爲尊長，爲權神，爲號令，爲本領，爲倚托，此非小可。執此推之，未敢縱求，其意外取用。神，或財、或官、或刃、或煞、或食、或貴、或印，或禄馬等件，各類例取，原無定法。其用神最忌損犯，兼怕分𥨸不宜太𨓺與不及。如太𨓺之物，本不好了，或歳運又來生扶，卽是傾覆壞了，如木則折，水則傾土。則崩，火則一發而滅，金則拆損。如不及之物，本不好了，或歲運又來尅𥨸，壞𥁞此物，豈獨有禍用神。喜忌至玄至妙，後篇别詳，務要得中和爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣氣切窮𥁞理物物至極轉𨵿。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866202624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金木水火土五氣，一陰一陽，共有十般消息，一件件要看衰旺輕重，明晦廣俠，窮則究理，𥁞處生何。神尅何神，刑何神，合何神之類，破壞之物，得生之物，主係何事，物物推將去，須要有依倚下落至無。可柰何處，便是轉𨵿入何，格調極處一轉，卽是建功。圓活叅透，却要定見下落，斷成噐不成噐，何如？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100122013188115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有氣者急，有情者切。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866219008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有氣乃當時也。㸔八字内外明暗干支，如六月中氣、大暑節，土金旺相有氣之類，此爲至急，餘則否。有情，乃合氣也。如甲見己、丙見辛、丁見壬之𩔖，中間于支明暗有合，皆取此爲最切也。一說非持合。氣有情吉神生我尅我，亦爲有情。虛拱貴氣，生我尅我，刑我合我，亦無異也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年干綂攝，次看月時，時如權衡，分毫加减，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866235392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"看年干所乘何支，與我如何相攝爲切，亦要引在有氣貴地，體局方大。又㸔用神却係歲君是何吉㐫神煞若更用神，與歲君和，全貴無疑。次㸔月時二于之關係，不可竟作差慢，不來扳攪。柱中象數。變化五氣，眞假吉㐫，神煞俱當引歸時座，細分輕重分毫，必須比較。又云：太歲一年之領神諸神。之主宰，極有用處。只因徐子平以日爲主，專取財官，悞了後人，多少錯會了義，故曰年如稱鈎綰起。其物月如稱繫，提起綱紐；日如衡身，星兩不差；時如稱𨪸，輕重加减，其譬可謂切矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100117793620031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨合仍緊。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866235392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遙合不閑","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866251776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"隨合如丙午氣壯，便知有辛未二字。如影隨形，亦看辛末還是我家恩人，却是讐人，遙合卽是支中。所藏之神，與彼所藏之氣合也，如申卯子、己亥午等類，葢有其氣類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690888900165644/1-e0559e09c0aed5f1.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=1%2B1rHWOG638ZaYMjocsplmG112E%3D","uri":"read/HY0653/23/ref/1kob82il11tev/1-e0559e09c0aed5f1.webp","fontType":1,"components":"辶爫正一","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690888900165644"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合事意自不放𨳲矢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體製，須廣大，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866251776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡八字要看氣象規模，𫝑况豁逹，天地相停，雄健壯實。五氣順尅而有力，倒生逆化而有功，貴氣徃來不雜，必非尋常格調。又看八字大意體叚：𨓺於清則或寒或薄；𨓺於厚則或濁或滯；𨓺於革麗則或輕或浮，𨓺於肆逸則或𣴑或蕩；𨓺於有情則或濫，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690879727861771/1-68e0a1672d374c59.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ANHrPAFrIrsqNA5VEBfLDdhohFc%3D","uri":"read/HY0710/1/ref/1kodrli0okeue/1-68e0a1672d374c59.webp","fontType":1,"components":"氵爫正一","variants":"淫","charPicId":"7456690879727861771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𨓺於孤介，則獨立不能容物；𨓺於剛勇則或暴或燥而無極養；𨓺於柔懦，則或愚或鈍而無作爲；過於執實，則拘局而只知有己；𨓺於軒豁，則圖謀廣而秀不能實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字靣分先後，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866251776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100122013171731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𦂳用字様，却逹在後。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866251776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或被别字閑神占先隔了。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866268160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866284544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無傷犯，須得歲運生扶，方爲全美。繄用字様雖近且先，𨚫有閑神字様遠處在後，動揺得切妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"碍用神字様，却看柱内何者，可以勦除去得天干専論生尅制化，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866284544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生則相生，有生不欲生之理；尅則相尅，有尅不欲尅之情。制則如水尅火，而有土制其煞，火能復生。之情化，則水本尅火，見木能𥨸其氣，火轉得生之理，餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地支專取刑衝破害","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866284544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑者，如丑日戌時之類，則刑其出；如巳日寅時之類，則刑其歸。惡物宜刑去，好物喜刑。歸衝者，吉象。宜衝㐫象貴氣宜衝。我家破者，大槩破壞其物，中間有吉有㐫。如卯破午，乃乙尅午家，己土受破，若己土爲煞，地靣有力，嵗運一露，其害無疑。若或不露，亦猶抱虎而眠。又看酉字有氣無氣，可能馭服。否。又如己爲貴氣，露而有力有勢，則亦因破而來爲祠害者，六害之處，若帶忌神㐫煞，來尅來𥨸，眞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100122013204499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲仇害，象成一家，不執貴氣","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866284544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人八字中，全無財官等件貴氣，有安然奮𤼵富貴者何？葢以相生之氣，自立成象也。生意滔滔，有不𥁞之晴，高遠堅實如此。本象配本，如甲乙、丙丁之類；化象配化，如戊癸、丁壬之𩔖。木火成象，火士成象士金成象，金水成象，水木成象，及有三象順序者，同此法。如火士、金象之類。又有四象，和協生育。者亦然，如水、木、火、土之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"根源。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866284544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一氣生物滿盈。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866300928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如金氣正臨天時建旺之序，旣無尅𥨸其氣，一徃據生其子者，水神也。水神既顯露於干，或泛濫於支物盛不祥，還得幾多火土，能隄防倚頼哉？餘倣此推，則造化盈𧇊之道，灼然有慿，萬無一失也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八法關鍵，五氣開端。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866317312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100107869831183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八法已論於前。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866333696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五氣有聚散完缺、實虛、深淺、敵交、狹廣、輕重、厚薄寒和之不同。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798866350080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千支俱有力尅物歸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881505295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窠精神強健爲聚，喜吉神，忌㐫煞，亦要輔佐。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881521679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉神衝而無義，刑而不歸爲散，宜㐫煞，忌吉神。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881538063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木水火土俱全順序爲氣完，五行欠一，以待歲運補足爲氣缺。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881554447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實則如甲戌見丙寅之類，有合有生，局於一象，滯於一方，柱中若無激揚昻藏之類，如此則不𨓺一富翁而己。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881570831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽有體無用，縱貴亦尸位素食。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881587215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
