{"lines":[{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如柱中土氣太重，畧見官來卽貴，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881603599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虛則如土入酉寅，木臨乙巳，金到辰亥，水向卯戌，火居丑申，氣虛而不能確固，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881619983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣深如木之本象化象，近清明節。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881636367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣淺如木之本象化象，方得雨水節之例。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881652751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣敵如辛酉見乙卯，大槩㐫甚，若見己未、己丑，轉有慿藉，反吉，如無慿依，又看賔主強弱。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881669135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主弱則爲鬼象，賔弱則爲財象。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881685519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交如丁巳見辛亥，丙戌見己丑，庚辰見癸未之類，仍分何者氣旺而言。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881701903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狹如用神局於一二支，神之情狹，亦有生旺引用處，其氣却來不得廣則引用處，其氣來得生源處，仍有精神通三合之氣，或通六合。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881718287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣輕如木之本象花象，却人金鄉，又非天時之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881734671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重如木象逄寅卯，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881751055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100034058731572"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃本象地面之𩔖薄，如木象逄自家𣦸絕之地靣，仍非天時之𩔖。厚。如木象逄來墓長生之地，或得天時或他干來𦔳之類，寒如木植火散，金寒，水冷土凍，天于休囚，地支𣦸絕之類，和則有合有生有。情有𦔳，有臨官帝旺，無休廢𣦸絕，或有旺相之神來扶𦔳，或當天時，前後有氣滿而盛，乃物無倚藉。隄防者不久而傾，有氣𧇊而衰，乃根本不實，仍未得時，氣亦不足，又無生扶，此等𤼵物，何可勝言有！氣衰而久，不得天時，又臨𣦸敗，却有暗干相生，引歸生旺之鄉。有氣旺非長，始則氣𦦨奮發通舒，自若終則收歛歸藏去處，竟無依靠，易於散漫。盛意無源，殊乏轉生乘勢無續有氣嫰易摧方來之氣。人皆以爲旺相之象，中間若逄頑𫝗之氣，尅𥨸者，㐫不可言。有氣𨓺耐遠，𨓺去氣候俱日休廢。又云：成功者退，殊不知餘氣忽被旺處資來，綰動生意，氣返實處，愈耐歲寒，餘氣卽休廢，别化他象故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"造物須原本體","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881751055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"東方陽散以洩而生風，風生木；西方陰止以收而生燥，燥生金；南方陽極而生𤍠，熱生火；北方陰極。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100086994993161"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而生寒，寒生水，中央陰陽交而生濕，隰生土。五行體象淵源，已取論於前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"噐完由出根基，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881751055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡成象處，是爲噐完。凡貴氣歸一，亦爲噐完。凡六親致一我生，卽子丙辛見木之𩔖是也。一說妻生。者卽子，兩義在活法而取，各有理趣。生我者爲母，合我者爲妻，成其物象噐僃，亦六親所生，致一而成者也。如運中成象，葢由根基原有來意，則成矣。謂木火必無相停，各有輕重。爲木重火輕，運上遇火于火支凑完眞象，若四柱中原帶火之臨官、帝旺、長生、庫墓等字，方是噐完，否則不眞不實不完。不正，似是而非矣。餘倣此義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法如搜檢，各禀吉㐫，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881751055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時與日、月與年，干支八字，要縱横來徃勾合，互相取用，不可有一處分毫照瞭不到。如四于乘四支。爲各自占貴占煞，或年干乘月支，時支取貴，或年干取日支，日干取月支，月干取年支，有貴有煞，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100117793636415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歲月二支，時口二支，自取干神貴氣，如此搜检，庻不差悞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物須提豁，方明輕重，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881751055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此一叚須要先看四支，一一將所藏干氣提豁出來，細推何者黨衆，何者力寡，何旺何弱，何輕何重。方明得用神吉㐫道理不去一一提豁大綱昏蔽，難以付度取舎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榮而易枯，發身暫致，顯而不露。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881751055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成物歲寒，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881767439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡脆虛浮嫰之氣，休廢敗絶之鄉，得支干夾扶，暫合而發於一時。倘遇歲運將賛𦔳之𥚞傷壞，或押揚其無氣，則易敗而不長久。如物不顯露，用神有氣，合神成象，相乘一路，運中無破，則耐久遠䙕有。歲君逐年駁雜，乃浮雲蔽日，𣗳影横陰而已，故不在露其干支中，隠藏有氣，得生反遠大也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奪胎換骨，意出自然。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881767439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"捨本逐末，原非眞義；","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881783823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"本象如有財官貴神，又有别位，通氣有化，有象有類，引用却清，宜乘福地者，非勉強而行，氣類有感。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100133954175011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必有所至也。欲化眞象，如丁壬化木之𩔖，萬妬合争戰未成者，忽至運中，却資𦔳本象具體乘其本象財官等貴，則棄其本镶之眞，逐其未節之氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大噐鎡基，自然遏惡而揚善；","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881783823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"體局若大，本源若重，用神若専，𠔥帶貴人、德秀，雖有大耗、元辰、刃煞等件爲惡，反能𦔳威，則所謂遏。惡而揚其善矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"薄才體局，方知害物更傷人。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881783823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歲與日辰力虛薄，不専被吉㐫神煞播美，隨氣動盪，精神被其所役，自家主張無定，多是㐫煞象内。刃煞、亡刼、金刃、白虎之𩔖作爲，故非德秀純厚之氣比也。建業立事，雖有偶成，豈不害物損人也哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人禄馬交錯，勾絞元亡，多端","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881800207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴氣不欲煩雜，用財只用財，用官只用官，如用禄馬、貴人、食神、印綬之類，只宜一件二什貴氣便當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100133954240547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔佐。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881800207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用財以官相輔，官申相承，禄馬𠔥行之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881816591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三件四件泛濫，便不歸一。又云：一項貴氣，須要貴人德神以𦔳，方可大顯勾絞、刼煞、元辰、亡神等物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若貴氣重則𦔳身行威，惡煞重則肆害酷切。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881832975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一説","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881849359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以此等煞多端，獨宜消息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉神𠫭天月扶持，㐫煞入空亡品藻。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881849359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴神、禄馬，皆吉神也，更遇天、月二德尢吉。勾絞、元亡，皆㐫煞也。若人空亡减半，互言之，吉神亦嫌空。亡㐫煞，亦要二德。舊註：吉神貴氣，雖清歸一，更無混濁，或入别格，因推其妙。若無天月二德，天月二合、月空、天赦之𩔖賛𦔳，亦减分數，福力非全空亡以生口係何旬所屬，如甲子旬卽戊亥二位是也。空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876296544297/1-ab01449b2277fb20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oHir1Qp0wqbSlQl75ZDGS3VX0X4%3D","uri":"read/HY0948/28/ref/1kof7c3v52jgv/1-ab01449b2277fb20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"二卜","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690876296544297"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有三神：一旬内之後，所藏干神，如甲辰旬甲乙二干是也。一旬後所遁到千神，如甲辰旬丙干。卽庚辛是也。一截路空亡，加至愈𦂳，如甲己日申酉時之類，㐫神宜坐空，吉神怕坐空，又云：金火宜空木土水忌空，又云：水亦喜空。又云：柱中㐫煞交併，有德神者，遇險自散，𣦸不致非命，日時帶則𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100050856689701"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十全貴氣，還看倚伏禍星。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881865743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一局㐫神，要識隠藏福氣，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881882127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴氣十分完僃，始終不壊，中間寕無一件禍神隠藏，㐫煞之神，徃來繁雜，其中却有一件福神隠隠。深奥，或虛夾遥合，或刑出衝歸，亦係切當有意處，不可便作滿盤㐫煞看，只待何運扶起局中福氣。則吉，扶起禍星破貴壊用則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"調峻格孤，勢窮力𥁞，義理正欲變通。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881882127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"究其月干用神，搜檢明暗造化吉㐫、神煞隠顯之處，其體孤峻，氣亦未爲窮絕，難於取周，此等至極。轉𨵿處自有窮則變、變則通之理，運迎何者之氣，一路挽囘，是何生意，起發情源，亦有無限之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣盈物盛，運併歳衝，身主何能恬静。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881898511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"欲觀其大槩之義，氣象或盈或流，察其物理之體，則盛且極，便自有不耐久之兆。况歲運抑則傾覆。揚則泛没，更若衝併，此身之主，獨能安然恬静不擾，無此理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100133954256931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日時，干支有序，君臣賔主，體格朝倫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881914895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月干宜在年干之次，時千宜在日干之次。若或循環，次第又奇，年爲君，日爲主，月時如賔，如臣輔佐。貴氣𠔥似，前法有次，朝其綱常，輔其倫序，正其尊嚴。又云：陽欲慎獨，陰欲羣隨。仍察貴煞所加之處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日主最喜先干，日主應𭒡次位，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881931279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己主先干，如甲日見癸之類，此等其益有三：一能合戊財資我，一能善於長發我，一能化其象生我。但已徃之氣稍慢，日主次位，如甲見乙之類。此等其損有四：一能刼妻財空我；一能合煞損我，一能。化象以泄我氣，一能欄截前路，作刃害我。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支神前氣，支神後宫","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881931279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"地支迎前之氣多者，平生爲人精神磊落，如甲子年或子日見丑，寅、卯、辰、巳之類是也。地支後宫者，主作事悔屯，或折挫，進退多端，如甲子年或子日見亥、戌、申、未之類是也。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100050856673317"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨掉歲君孤虛日主，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881931279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月日時支干作聮作黨，作旺作合，或成一象，或化一氣，獨太歲孤另一位，似遠似疎，必然離祖别宗。自立或偏出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868155318311/1-750b79eae7e46bdb.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=SUBarhr7K4ajFggTEgkXfHEbW6Q%3D","uri":"read/HY1521/12/ref/1kwqmxz0umecm/1-750b79eae7e46bdb.webp","fontType":1,"components":"虫𠖇","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690868155318311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蛉者有之。窮乏孤獨，年月時同上日主獨居孤寡，仍自無合無生，另立於缺陷處者。非異居同活，則乞養寄生，贅居外立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黨合𩀱爭，妻財兩義，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881931279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中如士黨既多，天時却係木旺，抑揚之道在如何用？不可便作兩讐相競。若土不虛，加厚木有氣。而露支音，𠔥不刑害衝尅，却能培養，木秀成林，爲用更奇。我合者爲妻，我尅者爲財，世人但知我尅。者總爲妻財紐繆未善，又還看化象如何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神一字，貴氣重來，象欲晶明，氣傷懶散。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881931279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中有平生獨用一字者，謂之不如格字，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892557778998/1-d710eb14606e7e88.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hXkbpybnCQRyW5r%2BdnaZgKmO3FE%3D","uri":"read/HY1130/40/ref/1koeg92oevvoa/1-d710eb14606e7e88.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丆囘","variants":"面","charPicId":"7456690892557778998"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俱合俱散，各自竟成羣，黑去了日干，亦另處懸一字無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100086995042313"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"依無倚，故用此字。或用二字用神，一能精神嚴切最妙。如川官星了，又見官星再來復建、禄等。或用。財又見食神、貴人，皆爲貴氣重叠，苖不秀，秀不實，用神壯健成象，意専力露，不虚不背書，夜如士木。水書生金火夜生柱中，如此豈不爲名利特逹之士？若地支天干與我竟不相顧，用神不合，星主孤。虛衝刑尅害相背，𥨸氣更多，𧰼無賛𦔳，叠見休廢者，無立無成，不足道之格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我生我尅情能退，他尅他生氣自歸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881947663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡我生我尅者，其義自然退散；他來生我尅我者，皆爲氣入，爲支生，爲尅入。吉神如此第一妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生尅來徃，合主扶持。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881964047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中合空，或有賛𦔳之神，合實，或有破壞之神，生有制者，尅有扶持者，來徃進退不一，萬一失取分。毫之間，便差遠千里，却會在合主扶佐何神，至切爲急事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡繁難，時分衆寡，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881980431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100133954289699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡二位俱衆，或錯或雜，但看時座聚衆。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881980431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休旺聚，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881996815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寡休旺惡衆則爲攅㐫聚煞，善衆則爲吉聚福集。善寡力怯惡寡，庻幾一云年與時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"互見貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798881996815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺與日和第一妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882013199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生而復生，皆倚托成於何者；","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882029583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙辛人見戊申運，却見庚申歲，轉有倚靠復生之意，有壬水精神自來，况丙辛化水，故得闽倚托。成於何者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化而又化，竟渺茫歸於何地。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882029583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如丁壬化木，况有寅卯亥未地靣，又有餘神水木，賛𦔳騰騰頑養之木，安可又用水來滋𦔳𣺌茫之氣無倚，却看運引，或有隄防馭制之道，方能爲福。若遇轉生處，一向汗漫，反不立矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五象相乘，有祥瑞，有乖蹇；五氣交戰，或傷殘，或","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882045967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883409870867/1-266de11b15e064b9.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=n4rmuBv7MJT30kkRzi%2FwapgLG4A%3D","uri":"read/HY1286/11/ref/1kowdgpnfyskz/1-266de11b15e064b9.webp","fontType":1,"components":"奞日","variants":"奮","charPicId":"7456690883409870867"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370798882045967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882045967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"祥瑞如木火火土、土金金水水木成象，得時謂得天時，得位謂得生旺位，或乘建禄等氣，得權謂乘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100133954273315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財官、貴人等，如有權有勢、有粧事者，乖蹇反是三者。若坐下貴氣，縱乘貴地地支，却又刑衝尅害，是。也。交戰，謂體均力停，如一物恃天時，一物恃其黨衆，或一物得地，或一物得權，水火士水交戰之類。水火士水相戰之類。傷殘，謂用神被尅，主干被害，或財亦被傷，官亦被尅，或一物有黨，成化却見尅。神來壞，如丙辛化水，忽見一土來尅之類，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883409870867/1-266de11b15e064b9.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=n4rmuBv7MJT30kkRzi%2FwapgLG4A%3D","uri":"read/HY1286/11/ref/1kowdgpnfyskz/1-266de11b15e064b9.webp","fontType":1,"components":"奞日","variants":"奮","charPicId":"7456690883409870867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"發物我相安，賔主和恊。我乘旺而相犯，他得地而相迎。我勢強而敵去，他有氣而來朝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官欲眞，致妙兮須理化氣，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882045967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙辛見戊癸爲財，甲己爲官，此爲眞造化秀氣不可言，餘皆類此推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官有象，致精兮要倚局神。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882045967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙辛見戊癸爲財，得火局，甲己爲官，得士𫵔，方就其噐完而且清純無比矣。餘例此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官雜氣，吉爲庫，㐫爲墓，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882062351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100157568090122"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財宫之氣均停有拱，更加貴氣於上，爲吉爲庫。庫中雜氣有三件，若當旺相爲貴，益我者妙。若官化。鬼入墓，財神休囚入墓，爲㐫，則不爲庫。若吉神入庫，仍帶休廢來刑，且尅我者，亦非庫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡衝神，尅則入，生則通，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882062351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"地支貴氣來衝，未可便言其吉，惡神未可便言其㐫，須是支干同尅，方爲吉㐫尅入，或一生一尅一和一制，此亦變化通逹在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土生下成，脫氣可憂，子旺母衰，三𥨸一生，用神翻喜于衰，母旺","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882062351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上生下，如干生支，支生音，一也；歲生月，月生日，日生時，二也。得生者，既爲子，若係閑神，三也。如木生火在夏，正爲子旺母衰，餘倣此。三𥨸一如金生三水，四水母生子廣，母旣當虛，卽喜子衰而母。在旺鄉爲吉。如木生火在亥，正爲子衰母旺，餘例此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100107869880335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而呼後應，生則繼，尅則治，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882062351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡格局一辰一干，有體用，冇本末，有呼應，難矣。生則繼續而無絕，婉轉有情；若尅則削朴煆煉既濟。隄防疎通，造物之切治也。如是局靣拘於生尅小節，所以不能洞究玄機耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左包右丞，收則歸，散則虚，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882062351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡一干一支挺立於柱中者，𩔖有左右相丞之兆，有包羅，有歸向，有散漫，有退脫，輕重較量，得失加减，宜處當然之義，不可務小棄大，捨本逐末。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局神無取，閑來一𣲖清冷。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882062351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中取其日主財官用神等件，或雜或濁，或繁或混，或欠勝負，或欠制降，無分優劣忽一閑干非主。非用却來左右逄源，能乘一貴氣，却取其干係日主之神，何等遁神，以别其用。虛處造象，或合官合。財等項，取其成局有切用者，始雖閑而無用，既而閑神時至，閒得成噐，際遇有用，則天下無棄物之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100117793718335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂况造化平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫氣混求，妙在各支匹配，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882078735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卽重犯奇儀之格，一體也。謂如官煞混紊，一有所配，一有未歸乘者，須得歲運更配，其未歸偶者吉。或官煞柱中，各尋所合所制則隹，有遍不及，又有潸息，極爲切事。又有兩官一煞，兩煞一官，皆此類。矣。如用士爲日，主，露甲乙爲官煞，支中有申酉宇或辰巳字，此爲所合所制也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交互有意，要審扶誰。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882078735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱夾雖真，當防損露，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882095119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"交互有意，如丙午見壬子，各有所頼，丙用癸官，壬用丁財己官，看餘神扶何者爲急，何者非急。拱夾雖真如乙人遇癸未、乙酉一位，明見拱夾印申之眞官，貴氣無疑。或餘神理藏火神，倘遇歲運見火。見庚，或見填實，其位𤼵禍，何可勝言哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合起力露，莫作等閑，脫廢精英，轉加時𦔳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882095119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100117793701951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天于相合，㸔支神吉㐫爲要。支神有力，則自然非常。如地支相合，㸔所乘之于力，力重愈精神也。一云：上下俱合，有眞合煞，如己亥見甲寅之類；又合煞如甲子見己丑之類。一云：煞神忌合，喜衝刑破。害干神、支神，一有閑慢，歲運合者，精神百倍。一云：禄馬宜六合，忌刑破，况柱中見合，力露，不等閑也。脫廢精神，如我生我尅之精，本散我氣，若加時上用神，㐫，則制馭却轉，來生𦔳主本者，則有挽囘生。意之妙矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羣分有日主專行，日辰務在吉㐫之位。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882111503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉神財元、官貴、印綬、食神，日德、月德、日禄、貴人、德神天月德合，天赦、月空、時禄、時象，奇寳、學堂㐫神。金神羊刃七煞空云六害、孤寡，隔角三刑，冲神、𣦸神、𣦸絶勾絞，一說在年亡神同上說元辰同上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類聚有年神領用，太嵗𠫭宅吉㐫之官。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882127887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉神建禄、驛馬宅神、天醫、福德、闕門進神生旺位，華葢三奇，㐫煞碎煞的煞、咸池沐浴、亡刼、白虎羊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100157568106506"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刃、飛刃破宅，大耗、勾絞、䘮弔、官符、病符、𣦸絕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時座消詳，有五理之當然，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882144271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894475100179/1-0f95ab12c2204794.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=DRH%2BI1u6PxsVK33z4J4YbidLBiQ%3D","uri":"read/HY1521/12/ref/1kwqmxz0ulp2e/1-0f95ab12c2204794.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𠃌一","variants":"刁","charPicId":"7456690894475100179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如時上之亡刼、刃煞、空亡、元辰、孤寡、𣦸敗、金神、白虎等項，惡氣貫聚，倒歸於日，有所刑冲尅犯者。不祥。若貴氣聚此，則爲祥瑞矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894475100179/1-0f95ab12c2204794.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=DRH%2BI1u6PxsVK33z4J4YbidLBiQ%3D","uri":"read/HY1521/12/ref/1kwqmxz0ulp2e/1-0f95ab12c2204794.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𠃌一","variants":"刁","charPicId":"7456690894475100179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年月目三項貴氣，三元福禄神引入，何者重，何者輕，分詳端確。何者來得安穏，何者不得停住，更自家還載得起否？或如船車，又如屋宅。又云：時之有家，却於年月。日上之處，又看有相依倚呼應否。又云：時座一位，竟作主體之端。余見未敢如此，亦係辨明吉㐫妙。理一致，斷得造化精切也。年月日内，有一位與時和者平；二位與時和者，小享富貴；三位共與時和。者，大發見，成富貴。但日𦂳年淺月緩，一時有尅破、衝害、和𦔳、勾引、空亡、𣦸敗等件，最爲𱗸要事體。如庚寅時，取乙亥爲用，旺相生扶，得氣得地，可否以慿藉𠫭考歲運，較其吉㐫𤼵廢之由。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894475100179/1-0f95ab12c2204794.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=DRH%2BI1u6PxsVK33z4J4YbidLBiQ%3D","uri":"read/HY1521/12/ref/1kwqmxz0ulp2e/1-0f95ab12c2204794.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𠃌一","variants":"刁","charPicId":"7456690894475100179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時欲旺相有氣，勿使休囚無情。又云：有初、中、末三次之情義。如寅時，初屬土，中屬火，末屬木，時相衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100050856788005"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑是切𦂳事也，載物不牢，時座五𦂳之序，爲至切至要之道。葢此日生辰，普遍天下，衆人所共大綱。造化也，唯時之刻，分毫不可差忒有惑故爲准則慿據。况交換之間，刻次日軌，本是未時一刻之次。其銅壺漏箭，却刻午時之七刻八刻，况有山僻村落夜誕者乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虛辰遁法，有三術之妙趣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882144271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一、禄馬貴人等吉，刃煞𣦸敗等㐫，一一俱有定位，乃用五虎遁元住干支，能司其官之事，極爲應驗。又云：言太歲所臨十二宫之善惡遁，亦只遁歲神之于吉處作福，㐫處興禍者，却用目主取財官等。件正要看歲日干之二位，的係當生所遁何等吉㐫，神煞所主，亦分輕重。如人出身處係何泒源流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"資格也，用神生時旺之方，當防尅制，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882160655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如用水爲官，忌土到申子辰等處；用木爲官，忌金到亥卯未等處。李虛中所謂傷破用神，家宅予獨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100050856755237"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以爲用神起發之處，先被傷壞，卽用神無歸着矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882160655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神坐令旺之所，反喜刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882177039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"忌神者，如用金爲財火，卽忌神，唯喜尅制之神，占上爲妙，却要水來寅午、戍、巳等處，以减忌神發旺。之基宅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神之鬼墓，得之爲殃，用神之貴情，亭亭賛𦔳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882193423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神自有鬼墓，吉則謂之官庫，如帶㐫煞來刑尅衝竊者，其用神自忌之，日主尤忌之，用神自有財。官貴氣，非本家之財官也。來意順生扶合，精神百倍，用神自喜之，日主尤宜見之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓絕併煞刃來刑，禍形惡㑹空赦領，財官爲體，禄集福加。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882209807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"墓絶𣦸敗，至不处道。若帶有月煞、亡刼、勾元等來衝刑尅𥨸日主併用神者，禍患立侵矣。月空天赦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100107869896719"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二神至吉善者，天月德、天月合，四神同斷，各司乃職主事。若又係財官等貴，主領者，更美其榮耀之。福氣駢駢然廣集矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類有傷官墓神，柱中尤惡；暗有刼財庫鬼，命分至㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882226191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官自有墓庫，如丙人土爲傷官，遇辰自家墓神，若帶㐫煞尅𥨸、刑衝、口主併用神，至爲𦂳切惡氣。刼財之庫墓，如丙人戌位，𠔥丁旺於上，帶㐫煞前來尅𥨸刑衝，其用神日主至㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬生鄉，宜乎潤澤；惡神𣦸地，怕作刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882242575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印綬本爲生我之神，若値印綬，自家生旺之所，又見生合之神，轉轉爲福，自家大義，綿綿不絶則可。或滿或溢，火出木焚，木浮水泛，士重金埋，火重土虛，水流金沉，反有太滿則傾，太盛則折之禍矣。㐫。惡之神，自家已在𣦸絶之處，於上又乘惡氣，尅𥨸刑衝用神，日主者狼狽。若𣦸絶墓敗上宫，主爲惡。來壞者，用前註斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100117793734719"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神惡没之所，地支豈欲全彰；納音生旺之方，用神坦然無忌；","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882258959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡用神之敗絶惡䧟等位，柱中忌露，多是卑賤下格，更帶㐫煞之神，可乎？恐見一二位猶可。或嵗運上扶起惡䧟之氣，𠔥㑹煞局者，卽爲沉淪喪敗、悔吝破失之氣類也。甚則𣦸無𦵏身之地，須空亡併煞方斷凡命之納音，常生常旺，四貴之地，月神來上，自然喜悅，皆無所忌憚，恬然自安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土之源，失中易化，塵濛之象；","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882258959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若火土不得造化中和之氣者，或燥或寒，或偏或枯，易於晦物之氣，乃滯暗昏𪷟之象，不能焕𤼵。遇而不成者矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸敗之象，有黨莫傷生旺之神。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882258959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如𣦸敗之象，有黨返來，刑衝尅𥨸，生旺之神，大不亨通之兆。如水人見卯家之木、酉金、辰土、巳火等。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100133954338851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神之𩔖，却將日主生旺，官主用神生旺，官主相犯相尅，爲咎不小，宜詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五氣布定東西，地理能培能竭，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882275343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥子水，寅卯木，巳午火、申酉金，辰戌丑未士。如金到亥子，則氣泄而竭；木到亥子，受養得培，餘倣此。推極爲切事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一辰聚藏貴煞，納音自旺自生，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882275343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如一辰貴聚長生，帶煞，在日時，爲生煞同途。一云：煞帶貴自長生，爲有用，此爲貴帶自生，又爲煞中。藏貴一云：年中干音随長生同神煞在日時者爲眞長生，乃聚年月日時之氣，又爲一強四弱。又云：四柱只要一位長生，專其旺氣，爲聚歛精神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡消息數端，豈止十干缺處，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882275343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此煞最爲要𦂳，中間輕重眞假，宜仔細詳審。一旬空亡十日分上下所管。如甲子旬中五陽工用戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100161628176438"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"空爲切，五陰十用亥空爲切，一氣分輕重。甲子見壬戌，眞空見戌戌，輕，一云上肩一位太重如甲人。見癸乙人見甲之類，卽十惡大敗。一旬中後禄遇空亡，如甲子旬壬申、甲戌旬庚辰之類，一五氣落。空如甲子旬水土，甲戌旬金，甲申旬火土之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴抑扶，兩立稱停，一路鎡基。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882275343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官星爲一身之貴氣，福源第一，切事，財神次之。若有一扶一抑，兩立其義，不分勝負，如陰陽氣不升。降一路運中當稱停其配屬強弱之情，以察典廢可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞見官隠以託情，官顯煞藏而立義。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882291727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞見有露神制合，均配官隠。無印更隱者，主外有權謀操畧，内懐奸宄奇計。若煞重而無馭官神無情者反是，官顯煞藏，内則性惡無情，外則義和謹節。大義如此，又當格物以消詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌煞氣專用神情，假用神力，切忌煞外馳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882308111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100122013286419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌煞有生有扶，或坐生旺之處，及有賛合六神，其","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882324495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"專之意，不可言也。柱中乃見用神，虛來生合，情假，露形有氣，或落天中，雖旺亦無地靣，情假力散，故自不若氣專者，若用神賛合，有扶有生，或力専生旺之位，亦有生助之神，有情或有力，切要分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690886946586660/1-1efe8385fbba6a4b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Gz6hQrXwmm2XHmV2Hnja%2FyN%2BtfE%3D","uri":"read/HY0936/11/ref/1koplwnvx0zen/1-1efe8385fbba6a4b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"日𡊪","variants":"曉","charPicId":"7456690886946586660"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"忌。神、煞神二者，雖在柱中作梗，力却自偏。歲運𠔥有尅𥨸，自然柱中停住。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不得氣散而外馳也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882324495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"缺用納音，全爲補氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882340879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大撓造納音之法，隔八有用之具，如何竟爲棄物？缺氣處，仍要納立日𥙷借。如欠土，納音，有土則補其不足休囚稍慢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物皆妙意，身不能任，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882357263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴氣或多或重，自身無氣，豈能勝任？如隨其類，逐其化，或從其象，應其氣，不在此論。二說身不能任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如病不能食，花不結實，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882357263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100050856771621"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢情充悅，發旺以時，象意空寒，幽棲度日。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882357263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"八字氣候𫝑况情思體叚，如人氣壯氣滿，似和煖喜悅之色，少能逹時通濟，利物𤼵朝，或嵗運扶持。更何言哉！若八字體制孤虛，氣象冷落，兼帶空亡、休囚者，任有智術才勇，無所施展，歲月空閒而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成功之氣，變化歸尊；交互之神，徃來俱貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882373647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"成功變化如壬水十二月氣本殘廢，有木象支干引化，第一妙事。交互俱貴。如丁巳見辛亥或庚寅。己卯之類，地支雖衝不和處，二支互有閑神貴氣來徃，其餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚更入空亡，時乖事退；旺相若𠔥生合，輻凑權行","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882373647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡休囚之物，本不好了，更入空亡，豈惟生不遇時，縱使乘時，事亦退散不濟。若五象旺相，到空猶可。金火旺入空却好夫旺相之神，本自當時，若生若合，愈見精神權變，福能駢集，可行其志，去就皆不。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失序。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882373647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100107869995023"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣巳𨓺者欲退藏，翻宜墓絕之地；物方來者將進取，原喜生旺之宫。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882390031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如三月甲木氣𨓺，理合退藏，惟宜於墓絶之地，乃道合自然也。若臨生旺之鄉，反主乖戾，方來生旺。者，如十二月甲木進氣，正月乙木進氣，將進方來，宜立生旺之地，爲禍爲福尤切。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚有用，發越仍遲；旺相無情，爲惡最速。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882406415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神雖貴有用，生我助我，或又臨天月、二德、天乙之類，若不臨天時旺相，縱有用，發越遲遲，柱中雖。帶旺相之神，與我無意，如半吉半㐫，至歲運只扶其㐫煞，爲禍最爲猛速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進神執權，至精至當；納音載貴，宜尅宜生","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882422799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"進神帶貴氣，柱中第一妙，引煞人内第一㐫。貴氣柱中雖吉情，若未切納音宜來尅我生我則方爲。有意以全其貴之美。若納音不生尅者，空負其貴，與我無綂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100161628192822"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺神衝氣透用凋枯，惡煞任權，本旬急切，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882422799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如丁未或生夏月得時之際，刑出丑中辛癸，透在柱中爲用者，其福氣薄，爲禍亦輕，惡煞旺相本㐫。若同日辰，一旬之内，禍速至重也。貴神本旬，至吉至𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神得勢至㐫；空亡遇衝必𤼵","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882422799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金神本㐫，若無火鄉所制，又被别處扶起，或旺相皆爲得勢，至暴至剛，爲㐫持甚，空亡䧟没無用，乃棄物也，遇衝神，必然起發，卽有用矣。如寅空見申之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刃併元亡金滿局，全頼火神旺相㐫煞火焚空，須慿水象。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882422799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金万殺害物命之象，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690879946227751/1-7ba14a3263994d76.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=dzB27L3Pq54gWlYB7124Tz0l2ys%3D","uri":"read/NA06813/37/ref/1kntaadyg28m2/1-7ba14a3263994d76.webp","fontType":1,"components":"氵艹丅⺝","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690879946227751"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"局金氣𠔥帶㐫煞等神刑尅者，我不殺害他人，必被人所剌。無火制，必驗火。若焚炎之象盛者，此等多値火灾。况歲運符合其氣，須藉水象既濟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100133954371619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木土氣託，以待發明。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882439183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅衝力停，未分勝負。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882455567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木非土則不能栽養，上非木則不能疎通，以待歳運，扶其不足，煥𤼵其氣，自然益堅。至於潤澤衝尅。有勝有負，力停則勝負未分，須觀其氣而消息之，方可㫁也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扶持生𦔳，察轉養之神；戰闘衝争，觀壞𥁞之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882471951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生𦔳滔滔者，看轉養之神，何處爲體用之基，爲吉㐫之兆而决之。戰闘衝争，觀壞𥁞之氣，卽此爲閑。退無用之人也。陰干取刃欲分明，支力當權防暗犯。支力一云貴力。陰干取刃，如丁巳見未，辛人見戍爲刃之類。支力當權。如未係貴神，或力重則合午，午衝子來犯未。又如未有力重，能衝起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑字中癸巳之物出來。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882488335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺神挺立，物莫當前；惡煞滿盈，干無停處。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882504719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100107869962255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如一位之干，有天時至旺之氣，草然柱中擅權，餘無牽綰者，其被尅之神，何敢現露？縱使藏伏，亦莫敢執事也。嵗干日干遇滿局煞刃等惡，自家干主竟無住處，决主不祥，貧夭惡𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼中逄鬼無去就；衝而遇衝，欠倚慿。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882521103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尅害我者爲鬼，倘鬼亦遇鬼來相害，展轉傷尅，氣極遏我。若更無轉制，促𣦸之兆。支神被衝，干神貴。氣便不安𥡷，柰何衝神又遇衝激，我家更無倚頼之基象不立，物亦不成，非禍則夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"併吞重尅皆成禍，二激雙衝總不祥。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882537487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲見二壬爲里吞，見二庚爲雙尅，柱中叠見衝神，或合處有刑有害，有尅有破，皆不祥之兆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行務要均停，偏倚難能濟物；四柱全宜匹配，興衰恐不成功。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882553871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"停均。其說有五：一、日主用神，冲和相濟，彼此各有所頼，不偏。一損用神之氣者，有物以制之，不致作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100161628209206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楚一干支上下字様相承得所，無過不及。一𣦸氣，或對活物，黨寡，不能勝黨衆。一欲變欲化，有妬有破欲静欲安，有犯有激者匹配。其說有六：一、衰神有用，須運扶衰者方可。一善惡雖能均配，看運扶。何者以别吉㐫？一雖有用神，一興一衰，偏枯不濟；一相安相濟，所應所求，各有倚頼；一旺欲成其物。一衰不可成全。一、干支各有所配貴氣者，或有所乖劣者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平生福德，不知化物，連綿次位；來神要識暗傷攔截","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882570255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"支内有己乙、辛丁之類，皆言七煞惡之，殊不知己土生乙金，乙金生辛水，辛水生丁木，續續不絶。况明露乎虛拱處，或有甲丙壬庚暗合完氣者，大富貴格。天干未來前一位，地支未來前一位，皆爲㐫。惡不可不知。如乙見丙合辛，暗損及有刃類，子見丑，丑見寅，寅見卯之類，有刃有煞，咸池、比肩惡氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多端。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882570255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干顧眞氣相凌，七煞犯尅神極切，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882586639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100133954404387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如乙酉見戊戍，卽戊火傷乙金，又六害之墓火，發其旺金之氣，餘倣此。七煞犯尅，如原用乙木行酉運丑歲衝損乙木，金局本壞，其乙木用神𠔥丑衝其虛未，將所藏之神碎壞倒地也。舉此一例餘局。細詳此叚止可言，七煞逄衝者不吉，不可論金局壞乙木用神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字帶煞刑胎意外須識四印何干乘氣類取其詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882586639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胎神所傳消息，各有異類。今人但總約十箇月之位，故無淺深，以致差池。一法，十箇月左右間其所生日辰對者，是如丙午日在何月節内，或十一月，或九月，遁而用之。若帶刑，主早妨父母，空䧟衝刑。四煞最惡四印，古歌云：辰戌丑未爲四印，戊己得之偏主信。甲乙若逄鄙且貪，内丁或遇多貧病。庚辛格號母生兒，聚煞丑宫多短命，壬癸未詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行分布方隅，𣦸水生金而異用，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882603023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂火生寅敗卯旺午，金生巳敗午墓丑之類。如甲子人遇巳，卽爲生金，生金尅甲，絕水，生甲臨官火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100157568139274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𥨸甲之𩔖，遇卯卽爲𣦸水生甲，旺木同黨，敗火耗甲，位位各有所司，看其餘局，次第扶抑而論之。餘干倣推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一神閑停左有傷官𥨸本以待時，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882603023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"閑停之神在左右者，卽月時歲干，多是不取用，故一向差慢，而至停囚長智，養病喪身，或係傷官之神無氣，不係爲事。忽歲運𦔳起此等之神，耗我之氣，傷我之用，半眞半假，其實則圉圉得執力小人逄寵有權，留此禍根，豈可忽哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干神彼此相安，方爲禄僃；地支來徃衝激，不柰馬馳。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882603023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲人禄在寅，見壬寅，則自家帶截路空亡，爲僧道有福；庚寅爲破禄，半吉半㐫。又如辛禄在酉，見癸酉爲火水相犯，丁酉爲空亡貴，丁木受氣，辛水沐浴，主奸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872425381907/1-084eba280adf55de.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=FRywcUHvgt7d1pWLozR6FInwCzc%3D","uri":"read/HY2033/9/ref/1kr69qi899yjs/1-084eba280adf55de.webp","fontType":1,"components":"女爫𠙻","variants":"婬","charPicId":"7456690872425381907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。禄上遁干，號爲眞禄，着落何方有。用其干見天乙貴人，其貴上之明干復坐貴禄，如丁人禄在午，遁至午得丙字，丙貴酉亥而逄辛酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100117793767487"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥則辛貴復見於午也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882619407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入格極品，此李虚中爲","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882635791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天禄互貴，一馬不喜衝，衝則動。馬上干神乘貴者吉，馬上遁干有情者吉。如丁丑人逄辛亥，是要貴。處有用馬上千神，自帶㐫煞空亡者惡，來尅主體及用神者惡，或支神激烈刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝轉轉，其馬豈得安休耶？","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882635791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷𥁞官星，方知用禄；衝破禄位，始得用官。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882652175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱内有傷官之神，官星明被尅害，却有日禄者，用禄却𥡷當，不致兩用不歸一也。禄位如被破壊，却只用官星爲定體，葢貴用一端最妙，多則散了精神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄位雖明化氣恐忌驛馬旣見日辰又重","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882668559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官星建禄等件，旣明無破，爲吉爲福必矣。若體用成化，却於其位有妬有奪，化來不得者，爲物不成。則亦苖而不秀，空貴無官，或有福而非財積福𫝗者，驛馬本理於太歲宫，要來乘用，若日宫又有馬。出重叠者，反爲賤局。一說：日辰馬併嵗馬雖重，馬若有用，貴氣相安者愈好，再見則不中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100133954420771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"記取禄賔爲用，細觀馬將爲元，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882668559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遁祿上之干，名爲禄賔，如無年禄，須看遁至禄官。干神爲用，主禄最切，却看日辰用爲何神也。馬將亦如禄法：譬如丁巳歲，丙日馬在亥，遁見辛，爲丙日之妻，主道途方外，所娶却分貴祿財官㐫煞輕。重言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用象契合，要防妬争，貴氣交通，切觀分奪。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882668559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神本與日干作合，有情有氣得侣，或其明暗，中有比肩，一争一妬，遇而不遇，用神自家之神争妬。者一體㫁法。歲運同。凡貴氣専用，則可兩處，三處分用，便是衆人之物，不惟平生多起分争之訟，自家財産亦爲比肩所擘，彼重我輕更甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官只倚日辰亡刼，須𠫭太歳","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882684943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰只取財官爲用，最爲親切。興衰旺絶，相生相尅，却與歲家如何綂攝，其行藏禍福極驗。亡刼二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100157568319498"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神一年至重之惡煞也，須准歲君推𠫭。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882684943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各有進退吉㐫，一十六般所致行藏取舎之道，已録於前。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882701327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴有等降，明輕重，富有高低分厚薄，察格局體制，如勢意猛烈，主本雄健，貴氣互𢰅。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882717711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徃","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882734095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"來㐫煞，輔佐得所，不致氣滿，無去就，第一義也。二用神至切至清，無破無壞，格局斤兩，相等而順。三。福神有情，化象得體；四、本等財官有用，運遇扶持不絶。五、所喜之物時，上與運中扶持。所惡之物時。上與運中制馭㐫處，𠔥有德神，苦處，每有焕發一大富，不在財神之輕重，大槩亦有貴氣倶全者不。𨓺看氣𫝗氣壯，但中間欠清純之象，二、精神有𦔳，閑神頗多，日主有倚印、食、財神三者至切。三、禄馬。扶身日主受氣，胞胎絶處，財官有用，或遇生氣，但流逺聚象之氣不廣，四庫財有拱或露，則要氣𫝗。得衝得刑，財印、食神，三位一位有用，日辰但拘切自専貴氣散漫詳之，各有高下明矣。五帶刑尅，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅我之物，係財星生旺之氣，或財神禄馬貴人之氣，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882734095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100157568270346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"贫賤而壽延，富貴而年夭。一應用神尅戰無倚，又𠔥休因無用，或臨𣦸絶駁雜獨身得中和之氣，運引而不偏，一身臨胞胎𣦸絶受氣之方，不帶福神運運不能害者，或空亡破碎元辰大耗六害、鬼墓、金神、白虎𣦹氣、刃煞交併歸局，獨有一印綬，或一食神，有力，運運引而駁雜。處不絶者，准前文。二福神徃來得勢，自身旺相，歲運顯揚，太滿而傾者，或欠轉生之神，或尅我處竟。無去就，或一空陷之物，刑衝我聚氣之所，一本象與化象，皆得用神爲福，左右逄其源，其身却化而。不化根本不穏者，一滿局貴氣，身弱，不任歲運尅戰日主。准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闉實亦由於火土","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882734095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火生土，意，最良最實，氣象自然固聚，必是敦厚務本，利名安享，處世游優，却非駕空建功立業者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流行，俱藉於根源","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882734095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100157568286730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大𭂫流年運限從容，不經風波成敗者，葢繇根基元有得力貴氣，引行歲運，賛𦔳不壞，有所慿藉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明無非德秀，晦懶總爲休囚，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882734095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"德秀如申子辰月，壬癸爲德，丙辛爲秀，帶此多是文業通達、聰明曉事之人。餘局例此，休囚廢𣦸者。天時也。𣦸敗墓絕者，五行也。如滿局俱帶此等氣數，一生謀望無成，退悔藏拙。若𠔥孤氣，出俗作林。泉人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏氣俱強而鄙俗，本源失托則漂流。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882734095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如人字純陰純陽，柱中因欠合神、財官等貴，用神旣偏且強，又能刑出衝飛之物，來者皆爲偏氣所致，雖豪亦俗，非俊秀才噐矣。日主象則無黨可就，氣則無貴可乘，柱中多係閒神慢煞，兼有刑尅衝𥨸散漫之氣。此等懶散馳逐，多謀少立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣如猛烈，害物傷人，象若純和，無操無縱，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882750479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100170784358441"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢當天時之氣，勇猛剛強。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882750479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若更帶金神、白虎刃煞，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882766863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑害之神，㐫則爲強盗刼掠，善則屠儈活計，終亦殺人害物，恐亦被人殺戮也。臨事有㫁，機變通利。皆由㐫煞之神不滯不塞，輔佐用神，有以使之然也。若柱中象數純和柔善，氣實則無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綱常倫序之能，雖有用神，亦難也矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882766863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"軒昂呼應，原慿刃煞之威；齷齪財豐，𥁞帶庫墓之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882783247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有貴氣無刃煞輔佐，不獨臨事無威勇作爲，殊欠相應合也。有此刃煞扶貴，必能做事立業，果决有㫁有人名目卑微，却𤼵財祿，乃庫基中雜氣，財官印綬親厚，有益於日主，况歲運扶合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身強露刃，翻宜聚歛營營。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882799631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干合多偏，倒亂精神渺𣺌。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882816015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身強力健，柱中暗有財源之意。若見刃露，本爲刼財。但我力旣専，財神有情，返宜刃露，葢我能執奪。歸歛其物也。此等格調，慳吝幹蠱，善能聚財。若柱中歲運有刃旺之地，未敢如此議斷，須别詳之。干合多偏如乙見三庚、二庚合者，豈惟氣不得中，亦自偏枯倒亂，縱化得成象，亦未成全美不過三姓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100170784407593"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"同居兩姓，合活接李換桃人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨爲煞布衆辰，虛張聲勢；一種貴由三處，分散英靈，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882832399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞本不聚，若只一位之煞，布向諸處，力自輕疏，不至謀多遂少，有口無心，𨓺望大節，力小任重一件。貴氣精専爲奇。若二三處皆有，如宻雲不雨，秀而不實，或空貴無官，多學少成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平頭帶來針刃，豈無傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882832399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾絞併至亡刼，寧惟狡猾。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882848783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"平頭乃甲、丙、丁等字様，引懸針、羊刃，刑害日辰。一云：日中帶煞帶華葢，主妻先嫁人，或殘疾，或愚鈍。一云：率因事而結婚，或有貌必淫。如己人未日，或己亥、己卯、己未。一云：日時羊刃爲貼身刃，妻有生。離𣦸别一云互換。懸針主帶疾及官刑，併惡煞，自刑立見，女人亦然。勾、絞二神，主狡猾破敗，吉則立。威若臨亡刼必㐫，况不和於日主者乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財居庫地，身入衰鄉，性能鄙吝，氣亦猥慵。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882865167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100107870027791"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財神遇庫閉藏旣欠刑衝開激，况身弱者，此等之人，度量慳鄙，噐宇少豁逹也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木遇學堂，火臨生地，文旣精華，志尤倨傲。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882881551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木火文明之象，居生旺之位，主文學疏通，才能雄健。但木火炎上之氣，爲人不顧細節，不能屈下倨。傲驕忽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890897539083/1-1cde8e516a7a07c6.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=VMMtvKRYKv2AA0w2LGqJDOVovIQ%3D","uri":"read/HY0653/28/ref/1kow1yvm3632n/1-1cde8e516a7a07c6.webp","fontType":1,"components":"扌畨","variants":"播","charPicId":"7456690890897539083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"德望之聲名，敏智謀之才畧，貴氣有𦔳，干有力。天月德辰及天乙互換來徃，主聰明雅望，兼藉空亡，刑衝得用，准上文。煞刃扶貴，象有制伏得中，日干可以馭伏，准上文。又云水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶貴氣，有扶𦔳，有隄防，才畧機變，智謀過人；財源拘局，街頭庫㽽經營；竊氣無憑，化外江湖奔走。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882897935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"格局不廣，噐宇不克，但有財源𦔳身，二二支伶俐生扶，而局於純粹之噐，𠔥庫神得用，宅神有情者。准上文。又云：食神或印，此例同㫁。凡泄氣之神，汗漫滔滔之勢，遠而有力，聚而無依，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100107870060559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江湖泛泛兮風飡甬宿，羅網𪷟濛兮利鎻名韁。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882914319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子爲江湖，若係財官禄馬用神，其氣泛溢者多，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882930703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"致道途生計，披星帶月，其水泛泛，其馬刑衝，方斷。辰巳爲地網，戌亥爲天羅，全者用神，其上失地。五氣不能成象，則利各碌碌無成，如塵埃所罩，昏霧所迷，歲運併臨，仍與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干尅害者天下。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882930703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火動揺，是非林裏立身，木金和恊，義禮門庭發財。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882947087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水火乃人間之動物，犯此格，多惹是非唇吻。凡立身爲事，每於閙𥚃出頭，闘喋之中着脚，若吉則有。决䇿之機，㐫則有不雅之號，金木無偏倚，氣和得中，陰陽相配，相濟者必務本實。我若尅彼，専當獲道義之財，若交錯無情，主被客凌者，主不義人損我無意中之財，或被不義事𡨚屈折辱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬得我尅他生，盡發外邦之禄；空亡有物明氣見，毎膺無意之名。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882963471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100170784374825"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遇馬上之干，日主能尅，或馬位有物生我者，多是遠方外財發越，或出外於邉境，得財禄空亡爲㐫。敗之所，若有喜象集來，如金火喜空、乘旺爲官貴等神，有情者，合此格局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身雖食禄，家計貧寒；庫有餘財，名目𤰞賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882979855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"八字體叚輕清，官神乘貴，地支或破其象，休廢其財，却又入𣦸絕等處，不帶墓庫，宅神之貴，宅神仍衝破者，准上文。貴氣落空亡，用神入𣦸敗處，仍無生意。其咸池沐浴，白虎空亡，却有拱護，柱中惟財。庫或財神専旺輔日，主有情尅助者，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲望闕門，當近朝堂之職；氣衝第宅，難依祖業之基。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798882996239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太歲對爲闕門，有拱人格，决主食禄職任，皆近於朝堂要路之處。歲前第五位，若是被衝，更與日主。非貴氣生扶𮈒攝者，决主祖上基業離破，不能居住。若乘官符並亡神，主爲官斷没抄封，犯破碎刼。刃，毁售必矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100157568303114"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二位不宜亡刼，拆屋售田。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798883012623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲若犯咸池，貪財美貌。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798883029007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歲前第五位爲命宅，後第五位爲禄宅。命宅爲第宅家舎，禄宅爲田庄丘墓，若帶亡刼，主平生愛費。財造屋置田，却主破壞，况與日家刑衝害刼破尅乎？子午卯酉全，古謂遍野桃花，又名𤎉貞沐浴。又爲暴敗，桃花帶此，主愛風流藝術，性巧情急，是非中立，身與日刑衝尅𥨸方准，忌水主淫兼貴煞輕。重言之，咸池𦂳，沐浴慢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬上空亡，毎遇異路之財帛；天中禄位，常招憎號之聲名。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798883045391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"馬上遁干得用，遇馬上明干𦔳我，或作財元，或馬坐財生旺之地，却坐空亡，有意多外方，出入獲外。方財禄或常招别門，無心利禄異路，言非本等之財也。天中卽空云帶禄，若衰敗者，准上文加白虎。在日𦂳切，或招人傳之惡名，况水火象并咸池、桃花乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100170784391209"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯酉好遷移門戶，巳午當感夢生胎犯卯酉字在日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時好粧餙堂亭，遷改門户。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798883061775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶馬則","logicSentenceId":"7577370798883078159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"常移居止，胎時加臨巳午，帶年禄和譛其日主者，主應父母。得夢生産。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺刃不兼餘煞，偏好異端；亡刼更引他神，只圖豪飲，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798883078159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺氣羊刃，别無餘煞者，剛𤎉正直，武勇愛籠養、打捕、起扮、社火之類，帶學堂官貴，别詳亡神刼煞羊。刃多聚，更與日不和恊，狼飡鯨飮，逐日醉飽，一任風波，落魄無成矣。桃花簮主恣風情，破碎朝元宜落魄。桃花簮主如卯人見寅午戌，酉人見申子辰之類。又謂倒挿桃花，爲人風流倜儻，却有賢而不賢也。與日尅𥨸，方准破碎朝元。如酉人見寅申、己亥丑。人見辰戌丑未之類，亦謂靣頭破碎，尅竊刑害日辰，主狡绢命夭輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則不能起發而貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798883078159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100050856820773"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官符落在天中，語多妄誕；空亡却臨天乙，性好謳際。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798883094543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官符卽亡神也，在空亡中與目尅竊，天乙貴人在空亡中與日尅𥨸，各准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𦆵傷用氣，抱怨嗟呼；重駕身強，妄爲狂蕩；","logicSentenceId":"7577370798883110927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神當生，縱無傷動，倘若歲運來尅，必須得意中反成失意，故嗟呼生怨矣。凡身旺之人，卽如飮酒。醉眩者，欲其無狂，不可得也。或又過歲運重駕，氣強，自然所爲滛蕩狂妄，𠔥破財産家業，胡做胡爲。柱有馭制，有倚托，别詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎兼刃，罵殺時人；華葢自墓，享於清福，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798883110927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎同刃，乃白虎與飛刃、羊刃同官，與日刑衝尅𥨸者如此。一云：若在日時上尅年者，娶妻鵑突不。然妻有異症，因服訟促逼結親則可，其妻亦愛罵人也。華葢自墓，若自生旺，又遇歲運與日和合，成局極受清高之福，否則爲僧道九流。如庚辰不能自墓，只是村巫，或爲粗魯手作人。一云華葢帶墓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100179592380450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有氣主福壽，但不至封爵之貴，或爲僧道名望人。若帶鬼咸池，非藝人，卽村巫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄命二神相激，鼓舞作爲貴煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798883110927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四位相承，聚歸取用，","logicSentenceId":"7577370798883127311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"前法禄命二宅，若犯激作刑衝尅害，㸔吉㐫之意何如，與日不和，應驗如此。葢禄、命二神實係衝命。左鼓右舞之氣使然也。或貴或煞，二重、三重，兼併一辰上者，况住中四位，各有吉㐫之神，要分聚在。何位最多，以較長短。寅申己亥無長生則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火之象。","logicSentenceId":"7577370798883127311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輕清則文章異術，刑衝則道德禪門，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355461667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水火乃坎離之神，有旣濟之造化。其中氣清則文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690885230215180/1-4235675abf36793e.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=k2y8JWcuKls5jWdi0cM5WklASv0%3D","uri":"read/HY0653/22/ref/1knvrjnvh6otf/1-4235675abf36793e.webp","fontType":1,"components":"立𠦆","variants":"章","charPicId":"7456690885230215180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"魁，罪輕則術業異常，空則仙風，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876069380132/1-5c72c34d03b20f4e.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=BaCJ8nwbJGniAHvFVz1YGIDzjuM%3D","uri":"read/HY1521/12/ref/1kwqmxz0um1pi/1-5c72c34d03b20f4e.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𮯰𰀁八","variants":"其","charPicId":"7456690876069380132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"質刑則道法。鬼符尅則禪宗空寂，野衲宿縁，𠫭究覺悟，専論日辰格象輕重而言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金土之源；氣老則財庫樓臺，殘嫩則經商手藝，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355461667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金土之義，有以賤生貴之功氣，老則成就其物，蓋宜於富藏，墻垣、第宅、莊營之壯觀，由此而致也。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100157568368650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰氣殘絕，或初新氣嫩，若非經商買賣，惻手藝工作之人。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355461667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢墓神，天月德合，泉石家風；𠇲囚日德，𣦸絕敗生，塵埃庻士，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355478051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"華葢墓神天月德合三件循環於柱中者，必有水邉石上宿縁辦道求仙至意。日德若休廢，虛有其德名矣。况又干音有𣦸敗等位，惡氣空亡，來生𦔳者，不𨓺碌禄一寒士爾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十惡大敗。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355478051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若眞貴爲將，賤爲冦，囚𣦸空亡，若聚生者道，衰者僧，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355494435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"十惡以道藏經所載爲准。貴氣相扶，淸厚入格，必掌兵權。若㐫煞癸集交併，柱中戰害，用神身主，則克日主用神，當休廢之時，落空亡，兼爲孤寡六害。若臨長生、臨官旺地，則爲黃冠，若處敗絕墓𣦸之。方則爲緇衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100157568335882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡權重，却害六親；刼寡雖孤，喜全三貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355494435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰爲天罡，戍爲天魁，最有權威力量，但孤尅之氣太重，未免妨害六親。刼煞寡宿，若帶長生貴人，有禄乃三件之福氣也，與日和恊，必主富貴。無此三件縱發，不久而貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吞啖勢繁，非偏房定乏乳哺。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355494435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤寡來併由異姓，假合同居，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355510819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吞啖乃倒食之神，倘多有力、有勢、有權，或臨生旺之鄉，太切准上文孤寡六害同併，却有印綬食神。一有用者，仍見宅神衝破，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重拜雙生。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355510819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥帶支干，同類巫醫酒色。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355527203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡刼犯咸池，貴人","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355543587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命帶己亥二位，又有别支别干，一類同者，有二三位者。如甲見甲，子見子，必是雙生，或重拜父母，須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100157568385034"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是于支俱有相同方的，更刼孤亦然。師巫藥術、牙儈等軰，仍分輕重高下，皆亡神、咸池二位主領兼羊刃破碎、墓鬼、白虎之類者，狂妄詭詐，迷花戀酒，九流不才之人。若貴人德神、財官生旺者，庻幾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離交㑹，老醉秦樓；象類清幽，幼登仙府。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355543587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子午上有干神鈎合，如壬子、戊午之類，戊合子癸，壬合午丁，或丁合壬，癸合戊，水火有情，至老迷戀。清則風流，濁則卑賤。五行之氣，至清成象，况引於幽潔之地，貴神歸一不雜，氣純清遠，别無𣦸絕等件惡神相犯，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論文學業特精英，長生德秀；滯酒惜花偏落魄，身旺咸池，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355559971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"長生帝旺，四貴等處，德秀二神，文學才能，藝術特逹精專，出類㧞萃人也。滯酒惜花，日千旺於咸池。之上，一也。本身自旺，受沐浴之神尅者，二也；本身太旺，沐浴更多福氣，散慢不聚，三也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100179592396834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻遇比肩旺奪，非是良人；財因沐浴強争，難辭滛濁；","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355559971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"妻干或𨼆或顯，而切切遇比肩，相近相親，其位被占奪。又或比肩乘旺，其妻必與外人𥝠通，不然娶婢妾、娼妓爲婚免此醜五行敗處爲沐浴，又名桃花咸池煞，一例同斷。其神若來乘勢争財，或財立。其上被他神所𥨸戰者，我身兼與用神之氣，不聚不歛，精神散漫，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"娶婚却因服訟。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355559971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類明六干生子，欲别賢愚。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355576355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體有五法，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355592739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰：丙子、丁丑、戊寅、辛卯、壬辰、癸巳、丙午、丁未、戊申、辛酉、壬戍、癸亥。犯此日，多因孝服、官訟二事臨逼結婚，或成親百日内，决主一家忽招訟服。或主無外家力，舅氏不諧，或無外家，或兩重父母，或無妻財或女命兩重，翁姑半眞半假，帶合神、桃花、花燭不明，或非良婦，或殘房入舎。此六干柱中多者。尤𦂳尤濫，卽陰錯陽差也。帶桃花在帝旺，多惹婦人官訟，或豪家，亦因妻黨婢妾致争，否則見女官。司也。别子賢愚五法：一以妻生而尅我者爲子。男以偏官爲子，女以正官爲子。一云：女以我生爲子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100161628258358"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"引至時上，逢生旺則好，仍以餘神會合，有情方貴。一云：我與妻同化者，如甲人以土爲子，引至時上。考究：一化氣所生者爲子，如甲人以金爲子，引至時上取用。一我之本氣所生者卽子，如甲人火爲子引至時上詳究一但是偏官、正官有情，引至時上，化得成象，卽好。子納音長生之氣賛𦔳妙甚。一云如以我生爲子類，以水、火、𣈆、木、三、金四、土五取之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惡攅時日，輕則子抝妻愚，重則空房隻影。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355592739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亡刼孤寡三刑，若三煞併而有救者，時上子多不孝，日上妻愚拙，或不和。若重犯力猛無救，孤獨貧。寒，一生自守空房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刃帶墓刑，吉而壽彌福厚，㐫而破帽单衣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355609123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"羊刃、飛刃犯墓刑二位，須有華葢始吉。及丑未干頭貴者，未有不享福也。與口宜和，若無華葢帶空。亡，𣦸絕，孤寒破敗人也，與日不和亦如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100050856853541"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日犯惡神有𦔳，再婚女妻；時臨㐫煞仍空，須招義子。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355625507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主犯年家亡刼，大敗破碎、臨官帝旺者，尅妻，却有干音生𦔳日主，必是再娶少年室女，或幼妾爲妻。若帶禄貴賛助者，貌美賢能。一云：若年之禄馬貴食六合在日，不獨妻秀，更能掌財。時上帶匃煞，落。空亡必主無子。若生𦔳食神，或日去衝尅者，必是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868155318311/1-750b79eae7e46bdb.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=SUBarhr7K4ajFggTEgkXfHEbW6Q%3D","uri":"read/HY1521/12/ref/1kwqmxz0umecm/1-750b79eae7e46bdb.webp","fontType":1,"components":"虫𠖇","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690868155318311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蛉之子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時日咸池帶煞，父命惡亡；休囚大敗臨空，妻家無宅；","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355641891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池在日時爲歲煞，主父惡𣦸，更加惡煞無疑。如金主刀兵，火主火厄，水主水厄，土主瘟疫，木主枷。杖以五象推之。一云：帶咸池。若旺犯華葢破碎，及陰錯陽差，因妻醜辱或離異，若貴豪之家妻父母。兄弟親屬内亂。一云：咸池羊刃，多𥮅多能，亦有宿疾互換，在日時𦂳切。日主宅神陷妻之氣，兼的煞。十惡大敗之日，休廢，又落空亡。如甲寅旬癸禄居子，爲空神，主妻家無片瓦根基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎神尅𥨸，横亡忌衝，局中之字，破碎空孤，離祖，因犯","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355641891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100170784440361"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄後之神，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355641891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胎神白虎煞也，永午金卯之類，衝局中字。如申子辰支係水命，怕午字之胎神，白虎來尅𥨸日主併。用神主血光横𣦸，以五象推之，禄後一辰，若係空亡、孤寡、破碎等煞，定主出祖旺相别立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支隔合衝二方此格多應自縊；合𠔥河井兩位犯者，無不溺亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355641891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自縊煞，乃戌人己、巳人戌之例，若帶金神、白虎、亡刼、鬼墓、空亡、官符、大耗刃煞，領其𣦸絶之地，來尅。其身廢，其用神，犯其太歲，刑其大運，准上文丙于旺水，癸未東井，癸丑三河帶咸池金神、羊刃亡神。多主𣦸於水中。一云：若帶亡神起端，因花酒惹事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳瞶耳盲，用神䧟切，血𣦸敗尅身，腰駝足跛，福氣衰頺，而刃煞刑主，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355658275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100133954469923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神被𣦸敗等物尅𥨸，又臨休廢時令，又被惡殷尅竊身者，准上文貴氣休囚，又被惡神尅制，𠔥莫倚托𣦸絶惡氣，出現沉淪，用𥚞之吉，刃煞仍刑我日主者隹士文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼嘯應知惡夭，本𧇊，非止貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355658275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼嘯如甲人遇庚，庚遇丙，轉轉相尅之類，有辛合其丙，方可貪合亡尅。一云：先問日，後問年，此格最𦂳本𧇊，乃𠒋神作黨，尅日家之氣，害年之干，所以貧難少亡不免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地具包藏之德，風雷遙激烈之聲。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355674659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申亥二字，明有力量，酉戌用神得所，正合此格。一云：申亥不露支神，虛夾二位有貴氣者，體局不凡。卯、巳二位，内有貴氣，柱中虛拱，歲運對衝空處，必能變化𤼵越。一云：拱夾穢處，又恐刑衝太廹走了。貴氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱將拱座并拱印，必是貴人；頋子頋母，尤顧身，自非","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355691043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100179592429602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗客。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355691043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"拱將謂本支三合，如于人見申辰之例。拱座謂對宫，如子人卽午之例。拱印謂甲綬正位，如甲人子。丑之例一說：印乃庫也，又云：印卽于庫，兼若財官貴氣有用，或財官生旺之鄉，皆富貴造化生我者。爲母，我生者爲子，𠔥自身三位俱無損，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"
