","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690885452922891/1-d8ba0304780aae04.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Y61zS1q%2BFU2S5cMfinsaML0S6bc%3D","uri":"read/HY0710/1/ref/1kodrli0thedm/1-d8ba0304780aae04.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土亠𭾱","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690885452922891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"徃來顧盻有福益者，爲有福人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三位奇寳用官神，流芳英烈；四干天乙臨華葢，曠世清高；","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355707427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時座三合，謂之奇寳。若官星居上，無破無忌，世代不絶，芳名勲業人也。古法不獨論歲口之干乘天乙之貴爲吉月時干有貴人乘者更妙。况臨本命華葢，生平不止無㐫，亦清高奇貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四靣宣明旺相，内庭食禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355707427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二煞若臨夾拱，沙塞揚威。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355723811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"青龍、玄武、朱雀、勾陳，爲四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892557778998/1-d710eb14606e7e88.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hXkbpybnCQRyW5r%2BdnaZgKmO3FE%3D","uri":"read/HY1130/40/ref/1koeg92oevvoa/1-d710eb14606e7e88.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丆囘","variants":"面","charPicId":"7456690892557778998"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"干祿歸心，各占方位旺相。如甲乙臨寅卯爲青龍，丙了臨巳午爲朱雀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100193353891892"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之類，准上文。亡神、刼煞二位俱空閑，而却各有拱夾者，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水文華而拔萃，土金阜富以成高。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355740195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金水二象，若清無其餘之氣，混濁其源者，文采英華，出類之格。金土相生，若各無偏倚，得中和之氣。者，似物漸長，生意益高，如此之象，當作富貴之格。或貴氣和恊，亦主功名食禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榮耀者，木火有發源；清貴者，水木多順序，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355756579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木火易於焕發，有來處根源，柱中生意，或引歲運，故能扶引而榮耀。所以人不知元有根氣，但知運上木火透發，耳水木清奇，若其氣不偏倚，順扶生旺帶貴者，必爲翰苑清要，或臺諫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"登金歩玉；貴人頭上帶官星，負笈挑簦。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355756579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂舘宁逄驛馬，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355772963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天乙頭上有官星顯露，謂之官星，坐貴主貴。學堂乃日主生旺之位，學舘爲官星生旺之方，臨官之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100206956019749"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"位亦同取用。遇驛馬在中，無甚貴氣者，空有才學無成，卽入仕途，亦多奔走道路，落空亡更甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翰苑標名，定禀乹坤瑞氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355772963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"薇垣秉政，應拱子午端門，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355789347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅、巳二位有力，能合亥申。乾坤又有三合拱者，子辰能拱申，卯未能拱亥。若無雜申亥，乘其貴氣，必爲出羣之造矣。子午二位，或有正拱，或有三合外拱，如有貴氣集上，勛業名家，人所未及。丑亥拱子。未已拱午爲正，申辰拱子，寅戌拱午，爲外。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡纔逄夾貴，風憲提刑，龍虎得以專職，玉堂拜相。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355789347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌二位逄夾貴爲風憲提刑者，謂有威權振作也。如壬癸逄己卯拱辰，丙丁逄酉亥拱戌是也。又明見魁罡重集，貴氣同前斷辰、寅二位，若遇正拱、外拱，有貴氣吉神聚其上者，妙合此格，或見寅辰。得氣集貴，旺相扶持，無衝刑尅害，仍得卯處有吉者，同前斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽偏川貴崇奮極品之尊；卯酉正門，權輔領外藩","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355805731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100161628291126"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之鎭。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355805731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"偏陰偏陽，其氣多是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883409870867/1-266de11b15e064b9.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=n4rmuBv7MJT30kkRzi%2FwapgLG4A%3D","uri":"read/HY1286/11/ref/1kowdgpnfyskz/1-266de11b15e064b9.webp","fontType":1,"components":"奞日","variants":"奮","charPicId":"7456690883409870867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"發風飛雷厲，貴氣若専旺相，力重驟進，極品者多。葢偏氣好争，挺然不配雄。豪力大，偏官易於起發，但是退速，或非命爾。若正官則穩，隨分遷擢，無生殺之權。卯酉乃日月出入。之門户，有貴氣拱夾得用者合此。或明見此二位，用神集福，有力無破者，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲駕禄馬帶財官，英雄超邁；貴局日時乘德秀，才業峥嶸。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355822115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡太歲禄馬二位，宜係日主財官居上，豈非英雄超邁。凡貴人局在日時，見德秀二氣者，合主文章。才業大噐，秀扳英傑之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用拙而運扶，枯鱗濟水，用強而運拙，曲港行舟。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355838499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神力慳，或有氣而被尅𥨸，或隠藏而無衝合，鈍而不利，運上却引生扶之氣，悠然暢意矣。用神或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100179592462370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有力或得時，或情合，若運中阻壞其氣者，東碍西撞，不能順駕，縱有一時風便，其柰何也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運以支重爲基，歲以于重乘氣，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355854883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"運之支神，太𨓺之物，則宜抑之，不及之物，則宜扶之，須要與當生支神貫穿，看其本末乖順何如若。只詳用神輕重扶抑者，亦未善。又論生氣尅氣，運支至重，次觀運干戰闘和諧何似，綂何杜中之物。有情而言，方吉。流年與太歲干神𨵿係最𦂳切。一年萬神吉㐫之主，日尅歲則灾，合則晦，若有化有情則有好事，所驗灾福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872501174284/1-d511fc1361ec2596.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hpobMY5%2Bmaqbaf8WGMYHhPjnh6c%3D","uri":"read/HY1038/37/ref/1kow1war2ktgm/1-d511fc1361ec2596.webp","fontType":1,"components":"辶尸丰","variants":"遲","charPicId":"7456690872501174284"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"速。仍察運中相攝如何，須𠔥用歲支刑衝破害，上言無偏則可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運馳行色，用分何弱與何強；歲攝兵權，勢持情急而情重。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355854883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如日爲身，貴爲用，二者難以偏廢。日主爲體，貴氣爲用，俱欲中和。一說：用神貴氣，如登程、行李、器物。粮草等件，運卽住脚，公","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690887260815371/1-6247c92b6fd42b9d.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=JuOUTYEaI2Ygixm4j%2BCO896Qi%2Bo%3D","uri":"read/NA02189/8/ref/1kns4mr79arru/1-6247c92b6fd42b9d.webp","fontType":1,"components":"厂觧","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690887260815371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"舘宇所泊之所，五氣貴煞何者，引彼地理所宜或順以𠫭考其否泰之兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100050856902693"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉㐫二象，運元未明，非歲則不能激揚其兆，唯歲君最嚴最切，至威至重，持握特急，𫝑來則如戰陣。闘敵迅速險大，難以卒然救應議捉也，雖鐡關金鎻，其能拒哉？亦有貴氣爲㐫，抑惡揚善，乘機凑濟。莫測。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄貴運欲顯揚，少壯宜兼旺地，㐫煞須從沉昧，老人更喜衰鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355871267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一、胞胎養沐長生冠帶之地，二十歲宜行臨官帝旺之運，陽氣強盛，三、四十歲宜行衰病墓絶之運。天癸枯竭，五六十歲，宜行其中合可之義，則造化取舎之道，通變爲言者也。運中少壯，合體固宜揚。其貴禄㐫神，運欲沉淹，老者宜行𣦸絶等運，仍不要與日主用神表𥚃生意者，誠爲福運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運氣發源力穏，方易成功；時干化象求情，行當領用，","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355887651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"行運𥤤考的騐福禍，亦是易事，當逐官消息，審其來意。如運之𤼵源，在年月日時上空衝𣦸敗之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100179592445986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"縱𤼵不久，發源在穏實住處，可耐患難，可享富貴，福澤悠遠也。行運之法，取時干之化象者，有體象。化象二意，二者得侣，有情有類，爲象成用，或行至運中扶持，或旋造成其噐，第一妙事，乃虛中家傳。之秘，有此極論，引用餘神之氣最切，宜取用生尅強弱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蜚黄騰踏運開一路官星豹變，典隆年綂平生。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355887651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財氣","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355904035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中帶官星，不若運運綂攝，官神得意，歩歩榮耀。八字中有財不旺，雖見無情，行運雖至生旺之處。仍未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883409870867/1-266de11b15e064b9.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=n4rmuBv7MJT30kkRzi%2FwapgLG4A%3D","uri":"read/HY1286/11/ref/1kowdgpnfyskz/1-266de11b15e064b9.webp","fontType":1,"components":"奞日","variants":"奮","charPicId":"7456690883409870867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"發葢氣，或𣦸絕，或滯塞。歳乃尊嚴之君，吉㐫神煞之主。流年或領財元，或生扶財象，或激開。財庫或遥合飛衝生旺之所，或拱夾暗包財神、禄馬、貴人之官，其財之旺，由此嵗君綂繫，豹變勃然。興，發也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運凌，身弱而適扶用神，運變，身強而抑其福氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355904035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"當生身旺，或比肩大繁，用神怯弱者，宜凌廢其身之氣，適扶我之用神，久是則不祥矣。當生本體氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100161628323894"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"弱，用神太𨓺，身不勝任，又或錯亂，不能歸一。所喜如是，反是則乖。葢當生本末，體用相稱，運扶身太。𨓺或困，其用神亦不中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲或運符吉罔㐫，歲或運昧善縱惡。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355920419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或當生㐫煞力重，吉神力輕，財官勢况散漫，歲運符合福神而抑㐫氣者有之。當生吉神力重㐫煞。氣薄，歲運，失紀綱制馭之道，或至於縱容惡煞，沉昧衆善者有之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉井奥訣，乃安東杜","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355936803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690874514112566/1-45ae6a4d0ab8cfbc.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=PUqdL6dwGwXHot6zEUa8ukxDVn4%3D","uri":"read/HY0852/33/ref/1koeun02uiek2/1-45ae6a4d0ab8cfbc.webp","fontType":1,"components":"言䒑〢𫜹灬","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690874514112566"},"logicSentenceId":"7577370799355936803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所著。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355936803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其間幽趣妙象，數見而用藏氣類，從無立有，倒飛暗合，得一分三。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355953187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脫胎換骨，入聖超凡，誠非易事。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355969571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲窮其絶處逄生，要識其旺而退藏。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799355985955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"器滿必傾，物𨓺則損，黨盛則隨類，氣衰則托情。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799356002339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用不用，眞假宜辯；變不變，象類先分。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799356018723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故氣禀有厚薄","logicSentenceId":"7577370799356035107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100206956052517"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焉，有清濁焉，有高卑焉，有晦明焉。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799356035107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬緒萬端，千變千化。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799356051491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣有生尅究竟，𥁞燭理外之理；物有造化活法，極𠫭玄中之玄。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799356067875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誠得李虛中餘學，一泒之正傳也。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799356084259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世之不得覩是書者多矣，予故表而出之。","logicSentenceId":"7577370799356100643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"育吾記。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通㑹卷之十終","logicSentenceId":"7577370799356117027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100206956085285"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100223343280140"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100170784473129"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善妻三命通㑹全十二册卷之十一","logicSentenceId":"7577370799356133411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與章","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100050856919077"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100206956101669"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通㑹卷之十一育吾山人著","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571713572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣象篇","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571713572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"醉醒子撰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今夫立四柱而取五行，定一運而𨵿十載。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571713572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清濁純駁，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571729956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬有不齊，好惡是非，理難執一。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571729956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故古之論命，研究精","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571746340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"微，則由體而該用；今之論命，拘泥格局，遂執假而失","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571746340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571746340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是必先觀氣象規模，乃富貴貧賤之綱領；次論用","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571762724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神出處，𥁞庻生窮達之精微。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571762724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不須八字繁華，只要五","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571779108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行和氣；浪指三元六甲，誰知萬緒千端。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571779108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者務要鈎","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571795492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄索𨼆，發表歸根，向實尋虛，從無取有。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571795492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖曰命之理","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571811876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"微，於此思过半矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571811876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然大海從於勺水，少陰產於老陽，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571828260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100179592495138"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成乃敗之機，變乃化之漸，此又所當深察。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571828260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃若一陽","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571844644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觧凍，三伏生寒，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571844644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此註已引前冬逢炎𤍠，夏草遭霜下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽剛不中，亢則害也；剛而能柔，吉之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571844644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此象亢陽無制，更不包藏陰物，而運又行東南，則陽剛失中，必主於害。用此者孤貧㐫暴，以於水火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之間，乃若五陽生於陰月，干文夾合陰柔之物，運道又行陰柔之鄉，乃謂吉也。用此者，雖出寒賤，終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柔弱偏枯，小人之象；剛健中正，君子之風。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571861028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此象不中之道也。四柱中但見陰柔而不入格，干支又不包陽，則終日柔懦。用此者機心陰毒，無所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不至。乃若剛健，君子之體也；中正，君于之德也。四性中陽而藏陰，剛柔得制，不犯破尅刑衝，用此者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"德行過人，中直葢世，故日君子之風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100161628454966"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨓺於寒薄，和煖處，終難奮發；𨓺於燥烈，水激處反有","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571877412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571877412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱純陰，生於十月，空絶五行之根，日干又見衰弱，而無強健之氣，𥾺遇和煖之鄉，終難發達。四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"純火生於夏至之前，火性燥烈，歲運中作，遇水激，不惟不能制，而反被害矣。用此者，夭折孤貧，多犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑憲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過於執實，事難顯豁；𨓺於清冷，思有凄凉；","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571893796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"執實者，用一而不通也。假如用官無財，用印無煞，多合少成者，遇事終無豁達。若金水𨓺於清寒，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遇和煖之運，如庚辛生於十月，柱中純水，運又行西北，平生獨食孤眠，生涯寂寞，人不堪其憂矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨓺於有情，志無違逹；","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571893796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"局中之物，不可𨓺於有情，若𨓺有情，則牵迷不能自脫，外無所見矣。如甲木以己土爲妻，情固宜有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100161628405814"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若甲巳支下又乘子丑，内外加合，而外無財官、印綬，動甲之心，則甲常處於己土之下，其志安能遠？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逹哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過於用力，成亦多難。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571893796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡柱中得自然之物爲妙，若用力扶持，終不爲美。且如用財，局中不見，必求傷官食神所生，如食傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"失時無氣，又求比肩轉助，或外衝遥合，皆謂𨓺於用力，其成就必艱難矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨓺於貴人，逄灾自愈；𨓺於惡煞，遇福難享。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571910180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"八字中原多貴人，二德扶用財官，不有刑破，雖居顚沛之中，亦無危矣。原多惡煞，三刑六衝又與財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官反背，縱遇財官之地，將何爲享福之基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行絕處，禄馬扶身；四柱奇中，比肩分福。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571926564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡遇絶處，不可便指爲㐫恭，㐫處亦有福神相扶。假如木絶於申，申有壬水爲印，庚戊爲財官，皆我。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100193353957428"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"所用之物，必能扶身進福，只愁有神尅害所用之宫，則所用絶矣。如此乃㐫，言以官爲貴，以財爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"局中得遇財官，乃爲吉矣。如見比肩無憚，争官刼財，則無全美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽固有剛柔，干支豈無顚倒。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571942948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽剛陰柔，天地之道也。顚之倒之，反覆之謂也，所以啟下文之端。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖聘妻不識其夫，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571959332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫婦旣入其宫，豈有不識？但情隔而不通，則不見其夫矣。如乙木用庚金爲夫，中間丙火，隔斷庚被。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火傷，或坐子午敗处之地，使其妻終不能見其夫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本有子不顧其母，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571959332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子之顧母，理也，情也。身有所覊，則不得終養。如甲用丙爲子，却被辛金合之，但戀妻之情而易母之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"愛矣，故局中雖有丙火，不可用也。凡命中議論，至此，庻幾無悞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100161628487734"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父無子而不獨，子有父而反孤，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571959332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木以火爲子息，四柱中如無丙丁巳午之位，則無子矣。若地支暗畜有火，或天干制化得用，亦不爲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無子木以水爲父母，若被損尅，則不得其所生。如甲乙日生於亥子之年，月値四季，水被士傷所生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之人失矣，豈不孤哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生尚可以再生，死不可以復𣦸，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571959332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"局中之物，原有長生，先被尅損，歲運復遇生旺之地，身力復強，如再生也。死者，終也。凡四柱之物，原","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"值死絶之宫，後來歳運再遇此地，不爲更卤之論，葢𣦸無二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣𣦸亦非爲鬼，逄生又不成人。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571959332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木値春生，得時乃旺。柱中雖遇死絕之宫，若運行生旺之鄉，亦不爲之𣦸也。木値秋生，失時，乃弱柱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中雖遇生旺之宫，若運行衰絕之地，約不爲之生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100193353973812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子多母病，如佃甫田；母多子病，如臨深淵。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571975716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子者母之所生，多則泄母之氣，正謂子能令母虛也。若母再加衰病，則精力不及，决不能以撫其子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其佃甫田之謂歟！母無二尊，其恩乃全。若母氏衆多，陰聚妬生，邪謀興矣。卽五星二，毋争權，姑思太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𨓺母失所愛，子何所倚？如更臨病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868267843595/1-c40a80e6d8e6913b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=olecMe3FSCPUVZ51vGj1dYm4o8M%3D","uri":"read/HY0741/18/ref/1ko7tci7o1gxs/1-c40a80e6d8e6913b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"⺊夕人","variants":"死","charPicId":"7456690868267843595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之宫，申生之變，必起朝夕也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不正不衝，不偏不合，不横不刑，不直不破。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164571992100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爲衝也，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572008484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"啟六極之岐門；其爲合也，闢萬物之形跡。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572008484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爲刑也，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572024868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變而改正；其爲破也，敵而有伤。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572024868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以𣗥地生金，不若","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572041252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藍田種玉。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572041252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上四端，乃戰尅擊剥之象也。内有刑虛鈎遠之用，若倒亂中而取用神爲貴爲福者，不若用財生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官用印得煞，自然之妙，此子平之所以專論財、印、食也歟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100206956134437"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉神相我，功求相吉之神；","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572057636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人命衰弱，或刑傷破害，不能成用者，必欲吉神扶佐，成我之福，又觀相我之神勢力輕重何如若。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無根失令，或自受傷，先用求助相吉之神何如？假如甲日夏生，遭火焚化，得壬癸亥子，相我爲救，但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水先受火土耗尅，不能爲我之福，必欲求金轉生水狂，使水有顧我之情。如此之功，不在水而在金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"矣。又如午破子衝，頼未合我而與子穿，則爲相我之神。如未受傷，不能爲用，必求生助未土之神。有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"力而未土，方得成用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶物傷身，解用傷㐫之物。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572057636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人命中若遇㐫神尅我身宫，必求杜中何物，能制傷我之神，則彼自觧不暇，焉能及我哉？如甲木原","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"被金傷，禍所不免，得火尅，危自遠矣。又如卯被酉衝，柱中見午，亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行各得其所者，歸聚成福。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572074020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100193353990196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡五行不可虛各失位，但要得令歸垣，方能爲貴。若歸聚一局，妙不可言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一局皆失其垣者，流蕩無依。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572090404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡日主用神，俱要着落之處，如四柱中不得通根有靠，又遇空亡、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868267843595/1-c40a80e6d8e6913b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=olecMe3FSCPUVZ51vGj1dYm4o8M%3D","uri":"read/HY0741/18/ref/1ko7tci7o1gxs/1-c40a80e6d8e6913b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"⺊夕人","variants":"死","charPicId":"7456690868267843595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"絶沐浴刑衝，則終無成立，必然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"流蕩失所矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大運折除成嵗，小運逆順由時。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572106788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二註巳引首卷論大運、小運中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文庫衝而文明盛，武庫掩而干戈寜。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572123172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌爲文庫，葢火爲文明，八字中原無財官、印綬、食神生氣，則無文章所學之機，徒得火庫，又被關鎻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此無文之人也。若暗有傷官，或印緩，𨼆而不明者，亦主聰明。柱中得辰未丑字，衝刑戌庫，更入東南。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"運道𤼵火光明，文章必由此而盛也。高擢翰苑者，予見多矣。丑爲武庫，葢金爲干戈，八字中如帶秋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100223343198220"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"氣中酉庚辛爲煞，偏官羊刃又見同宫，此無懼好戰之人也。柱中如得子己酉神合局，𠔥行束南木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火制其頑，金則掩其武，而干戈寕矣。壯士於此棄甲投閑者，予𡮢見之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛龍離天，隨雲入淵；潜龍在淵，隨雲上天。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572139556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍者，辰也，天者，亥也，雲，壬也。龍得其雲卽飛。若年見亥，月建辰，歲月干頭有壬，則龍在天矣。若日時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水旺與龍會局，龍必隨雲入淵。葢龍以水爲家，故上離於天，下潜於水。得斯象者，文章葢世，平生有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"塞有通，功名雖出於臺閣，事業終歸於林泉。柱中有巳午二字者，貧薄下流之命也。若年見亥，時見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰日月會水，則龍下潜於淵。若干支有刑衝尅破，龍不能安。要日時上有壬字，龍必隨雲上天矣。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"象如年無亥，用巳反衝，亦吉，但出寒賤，祖父無依，後必有人借力，奮𤼵功名，主近侍之貴。運行己酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"敗絶之鄉，喪家罷職。即壬騎龍背格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大林龍出値天河，四庫土全居九五；","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572155940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100223343247372"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大林龍者，即戊辰也。要四柱之中，納音得天河水，則龍飛在天，更全四庫，則四海俱僃，所以天下皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"沽雨澤，必爲九五之大人也。明太祖命戊辰、壬戌、丁丑、丁未，此亦有因而言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長流龍復歸大海；五湖水聚掌群黎。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572155940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"長流龍者，卽壬辰也。龍値長流，地支得亥，名曰龍歸大海，又曰龍躍天門。妙在納音得大海水。四桂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俱帶水者，則五湖之水，既僃且深，龍所益喜。要有庚辛以生之，則出入動揺山岳，非貴𧰼乎？如王阳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明封新建伯，壬辰、辛亥，癸亥癸亥，此亦因陽明而立論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合有功，權尊六部；","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572172324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡四柱中有刑衝尅害破象，本爲㐫論，得神挽合有力者，卽反爲祥，其福高遠。年月成用，大貴日時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"成用者次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑得用，威鎭三邉。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572172324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100223343230988"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑本不吉，得用者富貴聰明，無用者孤貧㐫夭。何以爲得用？三刑有氣，日主剛強，無用反是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午端門，雙拱岐㠜慿外正。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572188708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子午二位，正而不偏，故曰端門。若得夾拱，無破損者，更有力量人，必聰明奮至勲業。正拱者，亥丑拱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子巳未拱午，外拱者，申辰拱子，戌寅拱午，忌空亡、尅破爲害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己寅生地，十分秀氣合亁坤。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572205092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳寅生有力，能合亥申，亥乃乾也，申乃坤也，若無衝雜，申亥乃乘貴氣，才調出群。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地包藏神得用，顯豁胸襟。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572221476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥爲天，申爲地，明有力量。如八字中不見二字，得左右之神拱起二字，𠔥有貴氣，不落空亡，須當顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"豁或以申亥包酉戌，㸔係天干何物，以有用爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風雷激烈貴無虧。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572237860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛揚姓字，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572254244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100170784505897"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己僞風門卯爲雷門，八字中虚拱一位，更有貴人，歲運若逄衝起，必能𤼵逹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賊地成家。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572254244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賊亂家亡身必喪；","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572270628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此法月支五陰者是也。若歲日中有神，争合爲妻，月支䧟溺其中，欲出而不可得，故日賊地，更得歳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日之神自刑，無暇合我，得時支乘機，與月支爲合，是謂賊地成家，富貴不淺。大運去賊，則安再見賊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亂則㐫。一說：撫賊則安，勦賊則卤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梁材就斵，木多金缺用難成。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572270628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木本頼金，斵以成器，若金被神留合，不能來尅其木，却要木與金爲隣，就彼雕琢可也。若木盛金弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則雖就金，亦不能斵而有用。假使用木，與金作合，彼此兩強，乃爲貴論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純陽地戶包陰，兵權顯赫；","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572287012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"八字純陽，本僞偏黨，殊不知子寅辰午、申戌暗拱丑𫑗己亥、未酉之陰，二𧰼相濟，交感則反全天地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100206956167205"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之正氣矣。更要四柱無空亡，及天干有生意者，極妙。此𧰼權施邉塞，位至公侯，𤼵福非小。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨虎天門帶木，臺閣清高。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572287012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡岁月得寅一位，却要時見天門，虎必朝天嘯日。柱中更有卯、未合局，木盛生風，風從於虎，豈不偉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"哉！若使刑衝尅破，不得用綬財官，則無用矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂逄驛馬，山斗文章；","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572303396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身坐長生，位僞學堂，更得驛馬交馳，一衝一合，又得髙大氣象，帶財煞貴人者，最貴文童挺拔出塵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日主坐咸池，江湖花酒。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572303396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池又名桃花煞，男女逢之必然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690879727861771/1-68e0a1672d374c59.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=JOgheuoo7zKFc7A2KdHdCdLryCc%3D","uri":"read/HY0710/1/ref/1kodrli0okeue/1-68e0a1672d374c59.webp","fontType":1,"components":"氵爫正一","variants":"淫","charPicId":"7456690879727861771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𠃹。多因花酒，流落江湖。若見財官贵德同宫，反得標格清奇富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴安享，大忌刑合，只喜空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福滿須防有禍，㐫多未必無禎。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572319780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100223343263756"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大抵用印生身，乃爲我之福也。柱中原有官煞，轉生印旺，不遇財傷，食神泄氣爲貴，運行比印旺地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生扶太𨓺，福滿處豈無禍生？是以君子怕處其盛也。局中原多官煞，再行官煞歲運，其㐫乃甚歷𥁞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"艱險後必有制伏身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892809191465/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l9PxsAtYVVsYGFu9U3szWJfDA3o%3D","uri":"read/HY1123/8/ref/1koelguof5d03/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丅上王","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892809191465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之運，否極泰來之𧰼。如甲日原被官煞所困，運神再行神酒，乃㐫甚也。順去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有亥子印運逆行，有巳午制運，乃有救之物，豈不爲佳？此二句言陰陽消長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868063862795/1-a6f594037d63250b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Fbb8eotAgo0FQbxdyyXC4lun9hU%3D","uri":"read/HY1393/4/ref/1krcxzqiesum8/1-a6f594037d63250b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"示冂𠃊冋","variants":"禍","charPicId":"7456690868063862795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"福倚伏，天道人事相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲流通，宜細味之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬頭帶箭，生於秦而𣦸於楚；馬後加鞭，朝乎北而暮","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572336164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乎南","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572336164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言驛馬在日時之下者，必要帶合，謂之聮韁，聚大財福，幹事𨓺人。若馬前見有刑衝，謂之帶箭㫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"韁之象也。若來衝者屬金，受尅者屬木，其禍尤甚，主人他鄉喪亡。凡取用驛馬順，則年取其日時逆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則時用其日，主馬無隄攔，則縱肆而不可遏。如後再加刑衝，馬必疾行，終無安頓之地，主人一生勞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100179592560674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572336164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奔競四方。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572352548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若刑衝之神，遇","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572368932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有三合六合，則不爲加鞭矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572368932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性靈形寢，多因濁裏流清；貎俊心蒙，葢是清中𣷉濁。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572385316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡取用神，錯亂刑衝，未可便言獨而無用，當審其中有暗藏之物，如濁中流出一㸃孤清，則人雖朴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陋，多見性情颖悟，機謀異常，若用神清奇特立，不爲混雜刑傷，未可便言清也。但中間有暗藏之物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與所用之物有傷，其病終不可去。故人雖貌美，必然失學無成，昏迷酒色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一将當關，群邪自服，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572401700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"將者，貴重之神也。𨵿者，緊要之處也。邪者，妬我之物也。假如甲乙日生於金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892809191465/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l9PxsAtYVVsYGFu9U3szWJfDA3o%3D","uri":"read/HY1123/8/ref/1koelguof5d03/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丅上王","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892809191465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年月皆來尅我，得丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"透出月上，制煞爲權，而煞自服矣。又如壬癸遇我曰及支土亂尅，身不能敵。縈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690871967809590/1-7601475a1180217c.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=83IUoiyIRey2z5VtINNJFCmpGPI%3D","uri":"read/HY2912/13/ref/1kyhr9wcmi88m/1-7601475a1180217c.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𮯰冂","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690871967809590"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"女處，却要庚辛爲印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化煞不","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572401700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敢僞亂；","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572401700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆㐫尅主，隻力難勝。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572401700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100178543837222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言煞重身輕，孤獨無𦔳者，葢無當𨵿可救之神，則不能勝所尅矣，决主天疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脫此軰忌見此軰，化斯神喜見斯神。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572418084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"從化之妙，遽不可窮，務要用心詳察。如甲己化土，脫木氣而從妻家，若見甲乙，寅卯未亥，皆我比肩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則有原旺之藉，豈無戀哉？况比刄又能争合我財，使甲已不能相成，反有離間之恨也。又如乙庚化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金喜見金旺，而妻得倚其夫；丁壬化木，喜見木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892809191465/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l9PxsAtYVVsYGFu9U3szWJfDA3o%3D","uri":"read/HY1123/8/ref/1koelguof5d03/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丅上王","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892809191465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而女得倚其母；丙辛化水，喜要水莊，而母得倚其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子戊癸化火，喜要火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892809191465/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l9PxsAtYVVsYGFu9U3szWJfDA3o%3D","uri":"read/HY1123/8/ref/1koelguof5d03/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丅上王","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892809191465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而主得倚其財，大怕空亡見煞，比肩争妬，不成名卿巨公，則僞孤兒異姓矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬無韁，南北東西之客；","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572434468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無韁馬無合也，南北東西，無所不至矣。如人命遇此，必主飄零。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花帶煞，娼優𨽾卒之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572434468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"桃花日時上見是也。不惟忌刑合有情，尤忌五煞同處。凡遇此者，不受禮義亷耻之敎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100179592544290"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母子有終始之靠，夫妻得生來相依","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572450852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"母子夫妻者，専言體用兩端，惟在月日爲要。假如戊日坐辰，生於巾月，然土以金僞，子金養於辰，少。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"倚母而自強，土生於申，考得子而有靠，此𧰼甚奇，大忌歲運破而爲患。假如丙日坐子，月用酉金，然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火以金爲妻，辛金生於子，適夫家以養其身；火至酉亡，頼妻財以活其命。此象貴用財官，大怕刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"散局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙眼無瞳；火土𤎅乾癸水","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572450852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸水在人屬腎，爲一身之基，兩目之本。目關五行，惟瞳屬水，水涸骨虛，則瞳無所倚。若在日干，生於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火土月分日時，坐土塞源，而柱中遇木火耗𤎅，不成從化者，多患目疾。若在歲月時中，雖得秋氣，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"行西北大運，遇木火太炎之地，恐有喪明之苦；即水稍得通根，亦有下元之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大腸有病，丙丁尅損庚金，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572450852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100223343296524"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚屬大腸，宜臨水土。嫌者，丙丁寅卯得局無制，庚金雖得掛根，又被衝刑尅破，𠔥入木火，大運水土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衰處便有此疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土行濕地而傾根，伯牛有恨，火値炎天而得局，顔于","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572450852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無憂。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572450852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊土屬脾，四柱中不有生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892809191465/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l9PxsAtYVVsYGFu9U3szWJfDA3o%3D","uri":"read/HY1123/8/ref/1koelguof5d03/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丅上王","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892809191465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"通根之位，生遇陰濕之時，又加水侵土虛，運行隰地，歲見土尅，則脾士","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"受傷，因而有疾。火乃文明之象，生於九夏，三合寅午戌局，火愈發輝，少用木資其𫝑，不冝見水拖根。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遏火之熖，人生得此，樂道無忧。火行極處，多遇木生，反主夭貧，至不利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水泛木浮，死無棺槨；火炎土燥，生受孤單。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572467236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木從水泛，不遇運土隄攔，更値死絕之鄉，逢衝併煞，是必堕崖落水，横害毒亡，多不爲美。土因火燥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"萬物不生，初運南行，廢而無用，後來雖遇財官，不能爲用，以致孤貧，奔走無家之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100193354022964"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻多力弱，花粉生涯；馬弱比多，形骸飄泊。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572483620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡用財僞妻，最要得時得位，日主更喜剛強，歲月有倚，陰陽各得其所，良配可知。若財多散亂，刑合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不齊曰：主孤弱不能任用，必因妻獲利以養其身也。此又反言財爲養命之物，用不可無。凡遇財旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身強，平生安樂，若見財輕，比多不足其用，終必飄泊江湖，逐財勞苦，安享何能。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇凶神交㑹，善以少而難成；吉曜併臨，惡雖多而","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572500004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦化。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572500004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道從理悟，神人心生，熟讀苦求，巨微徴矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572516388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100178543869990"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六神篇","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572532772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行妙用，難逃一理之中；進退存亡，要識變通之道。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572532772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官佩印，不如乘馬；","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572549156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫用官之法，大要健狂清高，最忌淺薄。官旺宜印，弱則宜財，此不易之理也。今言用印不如用財者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃有一說：假如身旺官輕，多見印綬，則日主愈強，而官愈弱矣。壺中子云：官輕不若煞輕，所以喜財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺之地，生官尅印，表裏方得中和，於此足以發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞用財，豈宜得禄","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572549156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言煞旺太𨓺，日主無依，又加用財生煞，則日愈弱而煞愈旺矣。當之不能，遠之不可，只得棄命。相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"從，以免侵凌之患。運行財煞旺地，不易始從之心。一遇歲運歸禄，日主恃強，乃與煞戰，以寡敵衆，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"能勝乎，㐫可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100223343329292"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572549156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690874371440679/1-e2166576adcdd8f6.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=IrdALzx3LSGD5xexrywb1bGoX80%3D","uri":"read/HY1033/1/ref/1koee5rwr750k/1-e2166576adcdd8f6.webp","fontType":1,"components":"辶𡕖","variants":"逢","charPicId":"7456690874371440679"},"logicSentenceId":"7577343164572565540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財而罷職，財","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572565540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690874371440679/1-e2166576adcdd8f6.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=IrdALzx3LSGD5xexrywb1bGoX80%3D","uri":"read/HY1033/1/ref/1koee5rwr750k/1-e2166576adcdd8f6.webp","fontType":1,"components":"辶𡕖","variants":"逢","charPicId":"7456690874371440679"},"logicSentenceId":"7577343164572565540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印以遷官。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572565540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印乃清高正大之物，見財則不能保其名位。且如原用印綬，不以官以爲倚者，運行印官之地，仕路","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"清高。一遇財鄕，尅了印綬，柱無比肩爲救，不免罷職投閒，傷重者，必死於異郷。水火身旺，用財榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"可知再行財狂之地，主不能勝，却要印旺流年，取我根本，反能進爵遷官，不爲貪則壞印之論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命當夭折，食神孑立逄梟，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572581924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"七煞傷身，原無正印爲觧，獨以食神一位制煞。壯年運道喜行制煞之鄉，若遇梟神有力，尅我食神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱無偏財，遇敵不免，縱煞傷身，爲禍滋烈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運至㐫危，羊刃重逄破局，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572581924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"專言用財無煞者，大忌平刃爲禍。若歳運重逢羊刃刼財波局者，必有喪家囚獄之苦，傷妻尅子之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"悲，水火兵刃，悉有之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100178543902758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"争正官不可無傷，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572581924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官者禄也，無人不欲。若柱中多見比刃，只有一位官星，必然争奪。一見有禍，不如運至傷官，傷𥁞官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"星，則比肩無争奪，始可安矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸七煞最嫌有制。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572581924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此亦因比肩之謂也。葢四柱多見比肩，必然争禄争財，且奪歲運之物爲禍。如年月透出一位七煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"比肩知畏，勢必歸之。歲運一遇食神制煞，則柱無張主之神，使比肩復亂如初，則散財破業，横𣦸於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"苟貪之下，端有征矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官居煞地，難守其官；煞在官鄉，豈能變煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572598308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官爲純雅之貴人，煞乃奸邪之暴客。如官居煞黨，其勢不能獨立，必混化而爲煞，雖官有純雅之風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"安能守乎？煞乃剛暴之人，雖在官星禮義之鄉，終不由禮義而化，故不能變煞爲官也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100223343312908"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪財壞印擢高科，印分輕重，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572614692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命印重煞輕，終不爲貴。要行財旺之運，尅太𨓺之印，生不及之煞，煞印相停，必能超越。若印輕逄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財乃爲大害，宜消息詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇比用，財纒萬貫，比得資扶。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572614692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財乃我用之物，得之乃佳。柱中有一七煞専權，日主被制，則無暇用財。若得比刼透露，或歲運生扶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日主不致衰弱，可以敵多，而財始爲我用矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運到旺鄉身反弱，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572631076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言從財從煞，未成之象。日主衰弱，未肯棄命而從財煞。若大運行遇資扶之地，必與財煞争敵敵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之不勝，反遭財煞之害，愈見弱矣。是必因財橫禍，災病累身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572631076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690874371440679/1-e2166576adcdd8f6.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=IrdALzx3LSGD5xexrywb1bGoX80%3D","uri":"read/HY1033/1/ref/1koee5rwr750k/1-e2166576adcdd8f6.webp","fontType":1,"components":"辶𡕖","variants":"逢","charPicId":"7456690874371440679"},"logicSentenceId":"7577343164572631076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼處禍猶輕。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572631076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100178543935526"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身弱財多，當之不能行。遇比刼分財旺氣而禍反輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財不有傷，還忌陰謀之賊；","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572647460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中用財，無比刃刼奪者，則無所傷，尤忌支庫中有比刃暗藏，或被衝刑，則𥝠𥨸之害不免矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞無明制，當尋伏敵之兵。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572647460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞者，頋暴之人也。必欲食神明制，方可僞用。如柱中明無制伏之人，不可便以㐫言，要深求四柱支。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神如有食神暗伏，或遇刑衝，或就三合，亦可爲伏敵之兵。大運行制然鄉，必主成名進禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人頭上戴財官，門克駟馬，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572663844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此専言歲日互換貴人不遇空亡、刼害、煞刃同宫者，上戴財官，又居正位，帶合有根，得時進氣，乃爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴富權掌兵刑，非常之命。玉井云：登金步玉，貴人頭祀帶官星。是官視財爲尤要也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺宫中藏亡刼，勇奪三軍。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572663844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100193354055732"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"八字中如帶亡神刼煞，得遇眞正長生，及年支納音，或得長生臨官帝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892809191465/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l9PxsAtYVVsYGFu9U3szWJfDA3o%3D","uri":"read/HY1123/8/ref/1koelguof5d03/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丅上王","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892809191465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者，主武畧出群，有峰鼎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690879723028519/1-fa2dcd0eeb24ba6b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oZgykq6gheJFa%2B61gL0koURy67I%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0546/3/ref/1kr1q83mq2mfg/1-fa2dcd0eeb24ba6b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"扞又","variants":"㧞","charPicId":"7456690879723028519"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山之勇也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲跨馬以亡身，因得禄而避位。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572680228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中原多比刼無財用，歲運逢財，日主乃貪其用，比刃必然刼奪，重則損命䘮家，輕則休官罷職。原","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用官星帶財爲貴，運行歸禄之鄉，乃比肩旺地，必然争奪。官正謂遇比肩而争競，於此，反失俸禄故。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"避位也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印觧兩賢之厄，財勾六國之争。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572696612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兩賢者，二煞也。印者，仁也。凡用日主不弱，兩煞透出，天干并虐，日主無食爲救，縱有亦被梟神所奪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者最㐫。若能用印化煞，使降於我，如此不獨富貴出人，且能享福。一云：兩賢官與煞也。若止作煞言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"重下句，衆煞混行意財者，人所共欲之物，因兹而搆禍者多矣。若局有刃，伏於柱中，不遇其財則無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100206956199973"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"争劫倘有財爲用，或歲見財，惹起比肩混刼僞禍，刑耗傷妻，在所不免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆煞混行，一仁可化，一煞倡","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572712996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690866414452747/1-6c558be80c586671.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Ss3VKNZbirFg7ztVP49RD6biu94%3D","uri":"read/HY2040/10/ref/1ks8tlcitni16/1-6c558be80c586671.webp","fontType":1,"components":"爫𰀃夂乚","variants":"亂","charPicId":"7456690866414452747"},"logicSentenceId":"7577343164572712996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨力可擒。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572712996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞本待制而後服從，若見煞多，力不能制，制之則必致叛，故不若用印。印者，仁也，以仁化煞，使煞自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"降僞妙喜印旺鄉，乃益其化，不宜再見制伏，所謂疾之已甚，亂也。獨煞倡亂，勢力有限，一食制之，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"可以服，况食神多制者乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印居煞地，化之以徳；煞居印地，齊之以刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572729380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲日主用申爲煞，尅我無制，其㐫可知。殊不知水印長生於申，自能化煞，不使㐫暴。若干文多，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃成下格，比旺財輕者，用之更美。如乙木用辛金僞煞，遇子栽根，恃強尅我，雖爲我之印，乃煞所生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之宮，若更辛金透出，侵凌日主，干無食神爲救者，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892809191465/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l9PxsAtYVVsYGFu9U3szWJfDA3o%3D","uri":"read/HY1123/8/ref/1koelguof5d03/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丅上王","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892809191465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午衝子去生殺之宫，則幸無所倚，庶免尅身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100178543968294"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟破財財得用，煞官欺主主須從。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572745764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一局比肩，日干専禄，柱中不見財官，則無所用，却要比肩成黨，望空衝破財眡之宫，而財方爲我之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用大怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690869983690791/1-52fbcbf0aaf17796.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=z4FsjgJVtXraaSPVlCiZmjyLeFE%3D","uri":"read/HY0684/1/ref/1kp495xr3eejr/1-52fbcbf0aaf17796.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土十𠃊⺝八","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690869983690791"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"實衝宫，留合比肩。假如辛酉日，遇酉多衝卯，遇卯多破午，乃合正用，官煞太多，日主無力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱更不拖根，運途又行財煞，不如棄命從煞，遇煞旺之鄉，必能發福，大忌身性食神之運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一馬在廐人不敢逐，一馬在野人共逐之。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572762148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"馬，財也，乃比肩必争之物。若財明透四柱中，特立無遮攔者，譬如馬之在廐，其分素定，比肩不敢争。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逐太順，背財運道三合、六合之鄉，此肩乗機暗𥨸，致禍不輕。若用財不見明露，隠於支庫之間，乃人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"所不知之地，此肩競圖𥨸取，雖深藏固閉，難誤無患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨生庫破生宫，兼奉兩家宗嗣；","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572778532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命以印爲母，以則爲父，財固以印僞家，印必以財爲主，然財貴而印自榮，夫敗斯妻無倚，所以論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100178544001062"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人根基父母，必以看財爲先。若財有長生之宫，又見墓庫局，却有神破所生之宫，無犯於墓庫者，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲螟蛉𨓺繼之儿，棄父隨母之子也。葢生乃發蒙之初，庫在收歛之际，棄始由終，故如此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身坐比肩成比局，當爲幾度新郎。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572778532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命無傷官食神者，必然用財爲妻，妻所屬之宫，日下一位是也，却被比肩占了，又見三合成局。歳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月時中見財必奪，柱若無財，歲運見亦爲患，尅妾傷妻，豈止一二而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母一離一合，須知印綬臨財，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572794916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中財印，乃爲父母之神所處，不許同宫，雖爲父母之名，實有尅剥之意，豈能免離間之恨哉？若印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與財相連一宫，而財印皆有着脚，生禄同鄕者，終得聚合成家而無間矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻隨娶隨傷，葢爲比肩伏馬","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572794916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡論財爲妻室，財逢旺用之年，或有生助進氣，當得一妻。若財下原伏比肩，因被煞神制伏，不遂可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100178544017446"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奪之機。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572794916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572811300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"
