","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690888924790847/1-3a5823e5c3a0f7c2.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=BK7fITeKN81KqBmfqvWIuPvRjmI%3D","uri":"read/HY3005/3/ref/1krfdys02lrgf/1-3a5823e5c3a0f7c2.webp","fontType":1,"components":"辶人日冂","variants":"遇","charPicId":"7456690888924790847"},"logicSentenceId":"7577343164572811300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其財又見食神","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572811300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制煞，則縱志奪財，妻難久處，","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572811300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子位子塡孤嗟伯道，妻宫妻守賢齊孟光。","logicSentenceId":"7577343164572811300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子者，官煞也。子位者，生時也。時上要財及用官煞生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690892809191465/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l9PxsAtYVVsYGFu9U3szWJfDA3o%3D","uri":"read/HY1123/8/ref/1koelguof5d03/1-0b9b655ace8ebf20.webp","fontType":1,"components":"丅上王","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690892809191465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之氣，不逄刑害，孤虛，不失用神時候，則有子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"矣。若官失其令，更有傷官，食神爲妬徑來，時上塡實，反有伯道之嘆。妻者，則也。妻宫者，日支也，本宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若見其妻，乃得位矣。不逄比刃，不遇刑衝，不有桃花惡煞，仍得天月二德貴人同處者，不惟𨓺道韜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之才，且有孟光之德也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元一氣兮先天，禀清濁兮自然。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504217142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"著三才以成象，播四","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504233526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣以爲年。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504233526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此原造化之始，三命之所由生也。三命以干爲禄，謂之天元；以支爲命，謂之人元，以納音爲身，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"地元，此古人窺見造化，所以法天地而體隂陽，配四柱而成八字，此珞琭子首言之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以干爲禄，向背定其貧富；以支爲命，詳逆順以循𤨔。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504249910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"干猶木之幹，支猶木之枝。綂言之，干陽而支陰也。分言之，干支各有陰陽也。十干之禄寄十二支中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽道順行，陰道逆轉，皆自長生而數遇本音臨官以寓焉。此陽生陰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868267843595/1-c40a80e6d8e6913b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=olecMe3FSCPUVZ51vGj1dYm4o8M%3D","uri":"read/HY0741/18/ref/1ko7tci7o1gxs/1-c40a80e6d8e6913b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"⺊夕人","variants":"死","charPicId":"7456690868267843595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陰生陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894708736063/1-8f7d717b56e74e77.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=bgC%2BOCZPECSZDAu2MwxYSgOR%2B9o%3D","uri":"read/NA06725/6/ref/1knwquuuehp9h/1-8f7d717b56e74e77.webp","fontType":1,"components":"卜夕人","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690894708736063"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自然之理也。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"干爲祿，而推之則有向背。如甲禄在寅，遇丑則謂之向，見卯則謂之背，故禄前一辰日羊刃，禄後一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰曰：祿庫經云：向祿則生，背禄則死。此所謂向背定其貧富者歟。以支爲命而詳之，則有逆順。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100178544082982"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽男陰女，從生月順行；陰男陽女，從生月逆行。人禀受陰陽逆順之氣，在乎支干之中，周而復始，徃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"來循環，如寒暑之運四時而無窮者也。故曰以支爲命，詳逆順以循𤨔。曇瑩曰：干禄推之有向背。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉㐫究之有淺深。背而逆者，可定其貧，向而順者，以知其富。然而不在一途取軌，亦有逢背禄而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貧，於是支作人元，運商徒，而得失，男迎女送，否泰交居，㑹吉㑹㐫，作用定矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行則一辰十歲，折除乃三日爲年。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504266294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精休旺以爲妙，","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504282678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窮通變以爲玄。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504282678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"先言干支，則八字定矣。行運乃三命之最要者，故首舉其法以示人焉。運行則一辰十載，折除乃三。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日爲年，此古人立運之法也。折除要明實歷之數。命有節氣淺深不同，運有就生就節互異。中間或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"休或旺，要與八字符协。有喜生旺而惡休敗，有宜休敗而嫌生旺，千變萬化，非逹玄通幽，消息以𥁞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"造化之妙，其孰能與於斯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100178544099366"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爲氣也，將來者進，成功者退。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504299062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如蛇在灰，如鱔在塵。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504315446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"氣，五行之氣也，播於四時。如春則木旺火相，土𣦸，金囚水休，迎之以臨官帝旺，將來者進，背之以休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廢𣦸絕，成功者退。五行之氣，循環進退。人之行運，毎居一辰，相者既進，旺者則退，當權者用之爲福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不當權者，用之無益。若五行氣過則退。蛇、鱔皆屬火類，火至囚𣦸爲土，休廢爲灰。巳中三獸爲蛇、爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鱔爲蚓，故知蛇、鱔爲火，至囚𣦸休，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690894817951756/1-fcb26b35b5e293f7.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=HZZiWEfJ45O06w7TWIaKLa8Dmps%3D","uri":"read/HY0710/2/ref/1kp7yl33soz63/1-fcb26b35b5e293f7.webp","fontType":1,"components":"广𤼵","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690894817951756"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則在塵在灰，是土進而火退也。瑩和尚曰：鱔、蚓爲水土之屬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"居塵必憂，騰蛇乃灰火之神，處灰爲樂。方以類聚，物以羣分。順其所欲則吉，乖其所趨則㐫。卽物可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以觀造化也。人之行運，雖同一宫，而氣有進退，所處不異，而命有生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868267843595/1-c40a80e6d8e6913b.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=olecMe3FSCPUVZ51vGj1dYm4o8M%3D","uri":"read/HY0741/18/ref/1ko7tci7o1gxs/1-c40a80e6d8e6913b.webp","fontType":1,"components":"⺊夕人","variants":"死","charPicId":"7456690868267843595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見，其不可不精休旺窮通變。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也，此說得之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爲有也，是從無而立有；其爲無也，天垂象以示文。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504331830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此正明五行之氣，是從無而立有，故借天象、五星以明之。葢播物之初，孰爲之？有？太極之後，誰爲之？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100272097755163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無有出於無，無生於有。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504348214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在氣","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504364598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成象，在地成形，變化見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504364598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爲常也，立仁立義；其爲事也，或見或聞。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504380982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行在天爲五星，在地爲五嶽，在人爲五臓。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504397366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推而","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504413750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行之，則爲五常，常有可久之道。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504413750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：立天之道，曰","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504430134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂與陽；立地之道，曰柔與剛；立人之道，曰仁與義。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504430134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之道非仁與義，則不能立也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343277504446518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書曰：二五事：一曰","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178121258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貌，二曰言，三曰視，四日聼，五曰思。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178121258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五常五事，皆五","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178137642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行之變化，與人事相通。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178137642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之性情去就，見聞動静，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178154026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆不逃乎此數。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178154026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或見或聞，如金木水火、土，則見而","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178170410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宫、商、角、徵、羽則聞，貌、言、視、聼、思則見，而肅、义、哲謀聖則聞。葢五行之用，至不可勝窮，非圓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"機。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178170410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明智之士，孰能精察而黙識之哉？","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178186794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"崇爲寳也，奇爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178203178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將星扶德，天乙加臨，木主休囚，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178219562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行藏汨没。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178219562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"崇者，卑之反，奇者耦之對。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178235946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物以積而高，高之爲崇，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178252330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在五行。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178252330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上生下是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178268714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物以無與，耦之爲奇，在五行。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178285098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100272097820699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"異而乃羣是也。將星，月將也。德天，月德也。天乙貴神也。生年爲本，生日爲主，休囚對生旺言人命年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月日時四柱有五行，上生下有三奇，乙、丙、丁更帶將星德貴，主本生旺得地，所謂吉將交臨而福臻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"成慶此爲至貴之命賦先言崇奇爲寶貴，後言主本忌休囚，見崇奇爲難遇，以主本爲切要，而諸方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神煞則次而言之，是知命以五行爲先，生旺爲上，將星德貴，又神煞之最吉者歟。〇徐曰崇以主本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言凡命中掌壽、掌財、掌灾福之辰，亦謂之崇奇。以祿馬言，凡命中財官印食，亦謂之奇。德者，日支德。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰卽六合也。如壬寅年庚戌月癸卯日乙卯時，九月將在卯，扶其生日五行，九月金土六合，卯戌合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙庚合，戊癸合，如此五行，各不居休敗之地，則貴，似非賦義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至若勾陳得位，不𧇊小信以成仁；眞武當權，知是大","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178301482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才而分瑞。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178301482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此舉水土以例其餘。勾陳爲土之將，其於常也爲信；眞武乃水之神，其於常也爲智，信也者足以逹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256192970792"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"於聖智也者，足以撰其道。五行之用，獨善於兹。得位者，戊巳生七月，母在子鄉；當權者，壬癸生七月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子居母家𠄞，物同源，俱生於申，故也。徐以戊巳坐臨寅卯，並亥卯未，壬癸坐臨午巳，及辰戌丑未下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有官印禄馬，旺相庫墓，爲得位當權，似與賦義有背，不若只以土生四季，水遇三冬爲是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不仁不義，庚辛與甲乙交差，或是或非，壬癸與丙丁","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178317866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相畏。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178317866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上言當權得位，則不交差，不相畏也。若甲見庚，乙見辛，丙見壬，丁見癸，猶二女同居，兩男並處陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不合，不成慶也。庚辛主義，甲乙主仁，以交差，故不仁不義。丙丁主禮，壬癸主智，以相畏，故或是或非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若庚合於乙，辛合於甲，則剛柔相乘，仁義𠔥濟，非交差也。若丙見癸官，丁合壬禄，則陰陽相配水火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"既濟，非相畏也。或以甲申乙酉爲不仁，庚寅、辛卯爲不義，缘寅中庚、甲之交差，卯酉乙、辛之暗戰，丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與壬則丙非壬是丁，逢癸則癸是丁非。子午同然，巳亥一揆。凡命遇此一辰，始可言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100170784636969"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故有先賢謙己，處俗求仙。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178334250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"崇釋則雕宫修定，歸道乃","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178350634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水府求玄。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178350634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"仁義毎乖於得失，是非常絆於榮枯。於是日用不知，𭦌無休息。故有先賢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690874514112566/1-45ae6a4d0ab8cfbc.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=PUqdL6dwGwXHot6zEUa8ukxDVn4%3D","uri":"read/HY0852/33/ref/1koeun02uiek2/1-45ae6a4d0ab8cfbc.webp","fontType":1,"components":"言䒑〢𫜹灬","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690874514112566"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己處俗求仙，割愛少𥝠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寡慾，或崇釋以滅心之火，或歸道以益腎之精，内守精神，外除幻𡚶，達物我非有，明色空究竟者，莫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"非是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是知五行通道，取用多門，理於賢人，亂於不肖；成於","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178367018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙用，敗於不能。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178367018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"道無乎不在，物無乎非道。五行變化，通乎大道，何所不該？其取用不一，故謂多門，如識者取之以修。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"定，仙者取之則求玄，自非頓悟之士，豈能與此？是故賢者得之，能窮理盡性，逹五行之妙用。愚者失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之，終亦自昧而無所得。能者養之以取福，不能者敗之以取禍。易曰：苟非其人，道不虛行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256062947343"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見不見之形，無時不有；抽不抽之緒，萬古聮綿。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178383402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見不見之形如十千禄寄十二支，有見不見之形存焉。甲禄寅，寅爲顯見之禄，不見寅而見戌。以五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子元遁至戌，見甲戌，戌爲甲之禄堂，此所謂不見之禄。甲以辛爲官，辛禄酉，甲受金雞，酉爲明見之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官不見酉而見未，以天官遁甲入羊羣，未上有辛，此所謂不見之官。〇抽不抽之緒，如陽氣生子旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯終午，陰氣生，午旺酉終子，陽生則陰死，陰變則陽化。子午乃陰陽化生之始終，無極也。陰極則陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生，陽極則陰，生氣自子午中孚甲抽扎而出，出入無疾，徃來不窮，如絲緒之聮綿，萬古不斷之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太玄云：見不見之形，抽不抽之緒，則日遷月變，暑徃寒來，代廢代興，更休更旺，一顯一晦，一縮一抽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"綿綿若存，無時不有。葢陰陽五行，有見不見，有抽不抽，其理玄妙，其機發泄，無物不有，無時不然。自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有天地人以來，便如此，要頓悟何如？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以河公懼其七煞，宣父畏其元辰，峨眉闡以三生，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178399786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256193003560"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無全士庻；鬼谷播其九命，約以星觀。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178399786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今集諸家之要，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178416170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"略其偏見之能。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178416170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以未觧曲通，妙須神悟。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178432554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"元辰七煞，煞之最㐫；命禀五行，斯患孰逃？上古聖賢，如河上公，仙之流也；文宣王，聖之至也，猶俱畏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二煞，况其他乎？於是著書濟世，吉㐫禍福，告在未萌。峨眉仙闡以三生，非不精也，鬼谷子播其九命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"非不通也，指陳玄言，幽奥難測，故云約以星觀，無全士庻。三生禄命、身也。九命身命兩宫，祿馬二位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生年胎月日時也。珞琭子𠫭集諸家之要旨，略其偏見之能，獨發心得之見，著爲是文，大觧玄義曲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"通妙機，在學者神悟而變通之，斯爲善矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臣出自蘭野，幼慕","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178448938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690876069953572/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=qpmV4oj4bibEOkucfGFCxPC8O6k%3D","uri":"read/HY0653/23/ref/1kob7zqcc89x2/1-10e54895ba056a47.webp","fontType":1,"components":"上丄⺝八","variants":"與","charPicId":"7456690876069953572"},"logicSentenceId":"7577343407178448938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風，入，肆無懸壺之妙，游衢無化","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178448938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"杖之神。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178448938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"息一氣以凝神，消五行而通道。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178465322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"臣者，對君之稱。蘭野，地名，自叙所出。幼慕眞風，則其志大矣。懸壺化杖，乃壺公、費長房故事，稍前人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100272097787931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之至妙，悔在己之無能。外絶所欲，内無所思，息一氣以凝神，消五行而通道。故著此賦，名消息焉。葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"造化有消有息，故云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤立其牝肚，金木定其剛柔。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178481706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晝夜互爲君臣，青赤","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178498090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時爲父子。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178498090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此消急造化之大規摸也。亁屬陽，爲天道、君道、夫道；坤屬陰，爲地道、臣道、婦道。乾以動爲體，日闢戶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"坤以静爲體，日闔戶，亁坤立，陰陽牝牡之合，兩者交通，斯五行變化在其中矣。易首乾坤，正此義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"仁柔義剛，金木性之所司。一陰一陽，剛柔和推。獨剛而無柔，則不能生變；獨柔而無剛，則不能生化。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"晝爲剛，生變以進，夜爲柔，生化以退。積剛柔而成變化，則晝夜而成進退。晝爲陽，以象君，夜爲隂，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𧰼臣：晝夜之道，其微有消息，其著有盈虛，其分有幽明，其數有生死。一泰一否，一損一益，終始之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"囚，新故之相代，榮辱之所至，福禄之自來，莫不本諸此□五行之神，日帝，東方青帝之父，生南方赤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256193019944"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"帝之子，青赤之理，父傅子道也。言陰陽五行之中，有君臣父子夫婦之道存焉，是造化之大指通乎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人伦也歟？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可一途而取軌，不可一理而推之。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178514474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時有冬逢炎𤍠，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178530858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏草遭霜，類有陰鼠棲氷，神龟宿火。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178530858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言陰陽五行之道，微妙難通，隠奥難測，不可只一途取軌，一理而推之。如冬寒夏𤍠，此理之常時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之正也。若冬逢炎𤍠，夏草遭霜，則非其時矣。非其時而行其令，是可以常理拘乎？鼠火龟冰，此理之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有類之宜也。陰鼠棲冰，神龜宿火，則非其類矣。非其類而居其所，是可以一途論乎？常者易究不常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者難窮，造化豈易言哉！鄒子吹律而寒谷回春，孝婦令𡨚而六月飛霜。古今紀灾異，此類甚多，不可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂非陰陽五行之𦇥也。火鼠之毛，績而爲布，氷蚕之脂，登而爲爼，此世之所知也。神異經曰：北方有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"層氷萬里，𫝗百丈，有䑕重萬斤，毛長尺餘，在中藏焉，是陰鼠之棲氷也。爾雅曰：一日神龜，十日火龜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256193052712"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"郭璞讃云：天生神物，十朋之龜。或游於火，是神龜之宿火也。徐子平指冬至一陽生，夏至一陰生，爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冬逢炎熱，夏草遭霜。以癸禄在子，爲人元丙，以癸爲官印，戊禄在巳，爲人元癸，以戊爲官印，爲陰鼠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"棲冰，神龜宿火，恐非賦義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以陰陽罕測，志物難窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178547242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵三冬暑少，九夏陽多。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178563626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福有若祺祥，術士希其八九。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178580010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上文言冬熱夏霜，冰鼠火龜，非陰陽常理，物類相感，故云罕測難窮。此反照破上文言時有冬逢炎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𤍠，大抵三冬，暑必少也；夏草遭霜，大抵九夏，陽必多矣。寒暑既有其常，陰陽可窺其奥，禍福當以理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"推祺祥顯以類應，術士専門。論三命五行，行年歳運，遇旺相得位之運則泰，遇休囚失位之運則否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"只道其常，可希冀八九中足矣。人命行年、歲運禍福之應，如祺祥之變異，志物之難窮，挾術之士十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"分之中，此理亦難希其八九。葢天地無全功，而况於人乎？亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256193069096"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或若生逢休敗之地，早歲孤窮；老遇建旺之鄉，臨年","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178596394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偃蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178596394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃初㐫後吉，以源濁而流清；始吉終㐫，類根","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178612778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甘而裔苦","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178612778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身雖逐運，必假運以資身；勢須及時，亦假時而乘勢。生逢壯歲，運宜處於旺鄉；晩遇衰年，運恰宜於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"困地。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178612778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是乃随宜消息，休旺自如，初生歇㓕，而晩歲","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178629162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"興隆者，源濁流清之謂也。幼年建旺而臨老，蛉螟者，裔苦根甘之謂也。其乃較量運氣，窮究根源，先","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"察根基厚薄，兼明運限始終，雖未百發百中，亦可希其八九。大抵人命立年爲尊，其胎月日時，資以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"次之，故曰作四柱之君父，爲吉㐫之主宰，而立其年也。明運氣之本，推虛實之基，而取其月觀安危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之兆，察苦樂之原，而取其日；定貴賤之本，决生𣦸之期而取其時；辨幼䕃之始，究未立之前，而取其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胎月管初，主日管中主，時，管末，主年則總綂之。須要終始兼濟，前後相應，則富貴兩全，財禄雙顯。無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初吉終㐫，始㐫終吉之異矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178629162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然而不易得也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178645546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或只","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178661930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100230628704268"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中下興隆，亦可爲成實之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀乎萌兆，察以其原。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178661930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"根在苖先，實從花後。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178678314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"談命之說，以胎爲根，以月爲苖，以日爲花，以時爲實。窮根可以知苖，見花然後知實，是以聖人觀乎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"先兆見乎未萌，即察其根源，則知其苖裔也。徐曰：欲知運内吉㐫，先看根元勝負。根元有貴，則運臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴而必貴，根元有財，則運臨財而發財；根元有灾，則運臨灾而生灾，其說亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎生元命，三獸定其門宗；律吕官商，五虎論其成敗。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178694698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禽分三十六位，支列一十二辰，次而布之。一辰三獸。子人、鼠、蝠、鶯，丑人牛、蟹、鱉，寅人虎、狸、豹，卯人兔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"狐貉。辰人龍、蛟魚，巳人蛇、鱔蚓；午人馬、鹿、麋；未人羊、鷹雁；申人猴、猿猱；酉人雞、烏、雉；戊人狗、狼、豺。亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人、猪豕㺄凝神子云：象神者，即天禄，主大富貴；不象神者，天云不禄。具以形神性氣斷之，胎生元命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"只如甲子生人，生月癸酉，胎逢甲子，元命是同。又如乙丑金人，月居己卯，胎逢庚午，以土生金。二說。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100230628737036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"並詳，其意不遠。或曰：以年取月，以月取胎，觀三處承屬，謂之三獸，有無吞啖傷形，則可以定宗門之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出處：陽六爲律，陰六爲吕，五音總於律吕，律吕相合，分支定干，五行合爲五音。是故甲己宫士遁起","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙寅。乙庚商金遁起戊寅，丙辛羽水遁起庚寅，丁壬角木遁起壬寅，戊癸徴火遁起甲寅。五音皆自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅起寅，爲十二月之初二，六時之首也。人之成敗吉㐫，由此而始。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無合有合，後學難知；得一分三，前賢不載。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178711082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"道立於兩，成於三，變於五，而天地之數具。其十也，耦之而巳。無合有合，如甲與己合柱，不見巳而得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午缘午中有巳禄，寅與亥合，柱不見亥而得壬，缘，亥上有壬禄。又如寅午戌合，柱不見寅而得甲，缘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅中有甲禄，得一分三。如甲得巳爲一合，得午爲二合，得亥爲三合，此乃得一禄而分三禄，與前見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不見之形，抽不抽之緒，理相貫穿。李虚中論支干合全格：年月、日、時、胎五位，能合干支全，言子則丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"在言寅則亥，在言甲則已，在言乙則庚，在。禄干五位，如帶甲、乙、丙、丁、戊，自然合起己、庚、辛、壬、癸十二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100230628753420"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"支如帶寅卯辰、巳午，自然合起，未申酉戌亥，或於子丑位有禄馬加之，則十干十二支皆合全矣。徐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：無合有合，即刑合、王子、遥巳等格。得一者，既見有寅刑己丑破巳，而丙戊被刑破而岀，則便分三。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而行，是三合己酉丑也。古歌曰：虎生奔巳猪猴走，羊擊猪蛇自然榮。此解亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年雖逢於冠帶，尚有餘灾；運初至於衰鄉，猶披鲜福。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178727466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年，太歲也。運，大運也。年雖逢於冠帶，猶披暴敗之餘灾；運雖至於衰鄉，猶帶旺官之尠福。此行運所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以有前後五年之説，二句互文見義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大叚天元羸弱，宫吉不及以爲榮；中下興隆，卦㐫不","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178743850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能成其咎。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178743850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天元十干也。干以生旺爲榮，若衰病死墓絶，則天干羸弱，雖所臨宫分之吉，如得財官、將星、天乙之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"類，亦不及以爲榮。中，地支也，下，納音也。中下俱臨五行興旺之地，雖八卦定分爲㐫，亦不能致灾。徐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100272097853467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日：凡命天元臨財官之地，而生不得時，本氣𫎣弱，上下五行休旺，又不相輔，雖宫遇禄馬之吉，亦不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"及以爲榮。如庚辛生於春月，别位有火尅金，金見寅卯甲乙爲財，缘木中旺火害金，而金又不得其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"令雖宫屬財吉，而反發㐫禍之例是也。中者人元，下者支元。如丁以壬爲官印，中下禄馬，建旺成慶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖火臨絶地，却乘中下之貴。成鑑曰：祿雖絕而建貴。陶朱云：絕禄亡財，不爲㐫兆。是也。或以一吉三。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生屬九宫五鬼，絕命屬八卦，亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇尊㐫卑吉，救療無功；尊吉卑㐫，逢灾自愈。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178760234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄有","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178776618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三會，灾有五期。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178776618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"立年爲尊，其胎月、日時資以次之。大運爲尊，其太歲、小運資以次之。若遇本命與大運德合於建旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之鄉，其歲運日時㐫而不能爲咎；大運與本命争戰於死囚之地，其歲運日時吉而未足爲救，故日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云云。祿有三會者，長生帝旺庫也，其爲至吉之地；灾有五期者，衰病死敗絶，其爲至㐫之地。葢禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100230628769804"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"對灾言非干禄之禄，當以活看。今之學者，但舉三合，而以金逢巳𮠕丑，木居亥卯未火，得寅午戌水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遇申子辰，便是祿，有三會，非也。徐言以八字中内外三元有最得力者爲尊，即用神也。用神不可損。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷。若有損傷，則雖别位之吉不能救。若年月日時内外三元，雖有尅戰，但不損於尊者，即逢灾自愈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。更切消息所損之神，主何吉㐫，害命則身灾，害妻則妻灾，害官則官失。其說有理，但尊卑字灾通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫多吉少，類大過之初爻；福淺禍深，喻同人之九五。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178793002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㐫多吉少之命，以其休囚無氣，故不宜於進用，有類大過初爻，其父辭云：初六，藉用白茅，无咎。六隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柔無過人之才，初在下，非有爲之時，可以遁世而避位，戒人以愼之道也。夫子曰：愼斯術也以往，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"无所失矣。正此意也。福淺禍深之命，以其五行相尅而無氣，亦非謀望進用之宜，喻如同人卦中之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五爻辞云：同人，先號兆而後笑，大師克相遇。象日：同人之先，以中直也。可見直道難行，戒人以自克。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100223343427596"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞喜不喜，是六甲之𧇊盈；當憂不憂，頼五行之救助。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178809386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"聞喜以盈爲言，盈者益也；不喜以𧇊爲言，𧇊者，損也。損益之道，由六甲而推之，或以空亡爲天地虛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"脫之辰，六陽命畏於陽宫，六陰命畏於陰位，歲運行年，遇禄馬貴人而在空，𬼽五行之𧇊盈相制，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"聞喜不喜也，□當憂不憂，是五行休廢之處逢生，如木得甲申、癸巳之例，假如戊申人得丁酉，暴敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"破碎自刑，丁酉死火，巳化爲土，子傳母道。甲寅人運至申上衝刑，反吟禄馬俱絶，爲旺金所制，遁見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬申是干救，神術云：絶處逢父母，變灾爲福是也。余見六甲五行，其說圓活，或元命八字，有𧇊有盈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有救有助，或行運流年，有𧇊有盈，有救有助，不可執定。𧇊盈者，或吉或㐫之謂也。救助者，制㐫扶吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八孤臨於五墓，戌未東行；六虛下於空亡，自乾南首","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178825770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子旬中，戌亥爲空云，對衝爲六虛，乃辰巳也。戌亥是乾金之位，在西極之北隅。迤邐甲戌甲申，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100223343460364"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉南首，故寅申己亥四孤之地，辰戌丑未五墓之","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178825770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鄉，向戌未而東行，順空亡而逆轉。或以八孤者，除辰戌丑未乃五行之墓，其餘八音孤虛之辰，孤臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"於墓如申酉人，孤辰在亥，而寡宿居未，五行之墓寄於四氣之中，其氣皆随月建而來，行東之戌與。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未乃火木之墓，木自亥生，火從寅起，火木之氣皆自寅首之東行，而鍾藏於戌未之墓。如乙丑生人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以亥爲六陰，正空亡，亥衝巳爲六虛。亥爲乾天，巳爲巽地，已乃南方之首神，故云六虚下於空亡孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"既東行，虛則西回，二者常相對。此總論十二支中神煞之名，順逆循環孤虛空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178825770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五墓爲人命之最要者歟。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178842154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元一氣，定侯伯之遷榮；支作人元，運商徒而得失。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178858538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以干爲禄，故天元清秀，吉將加臨，人得之而貴也。以支爲命，故支元純粹，四柱比和，人得之而富也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此天地之分，干支之别也。天元一氣，不是一样，如今談命者所指，以其象天，故云一氣，天禄之所司。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也須禄帶天德、官印、貴食，五行四柱中兼得生旺氣者，至貴。商賈之徒，詳以人元定財物之得夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256193118248"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"須觀有氣無氣，當究進神退神。故下文云：財命有氣，財絶命衰。運對定而言，定則决定，運則流轉義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"各有所取也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但看財命有氣，逢背禄而不貧；若也財絶命衰，縱建","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178874922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄而不富；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178874922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人生以財命爲主，五行所尅者謂之財，有氣謂財與命皆得寓於五行生旺之地，雖四柱背禄使之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無官，亦不至貧賤。若命與財俱無氣，雖得月建坐禄，使有小官，亦不能致富貴。假如庚寅木尅丙戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土爲財，土旺在戌，身命二木至束南，戌雖背申之庚禄，以其財命有氣，故不貧。又如甲辰生人，得丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅火以金爲財，絕在寅辰。土至寅爲命鬼，兼遇空亡，財絕命衰，雖月建坐禄，以財命無氣，故不富。前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云：以干爲禄，向背定其貧富。葢指財命兩宫，各宜旺地，不但八字行運皆然。徐說以財命有氣如甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙見巳、午等月，建禄不富。如甲乙生寅、卯等月，當並詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256193151016"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃身旺鬼絶，雖破命而長年；鬼旺身衰，逢建命而","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178874922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178874922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"破命長年，以其本命旺宫逢絕鬼者是也。如火在巳宮，値水，木居寅地，逢金王向申鄉，遇木金歸亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中逢火，逢建命而夭壽，以其本命衰鄉逢旺鬼是也。以土到寅中，見木火歸亥地，逢水金在巳鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得火，火居申位，逢金，俱以納音取之。五行之理，受制則夭，制物則壽。舊云：建命主長壽，破年主夭殤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故竹輪經云：建命未必延長，破命未必夭壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178891306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此珞","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178907690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"琭子所以消息也。天元論貴，人元諭富，財命論富貧，身鬼論壽夭。各","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指其重者言之也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178907690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背禄逐馬，守窮途而恓惶；禄馬同鄉，不二台而八座。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178924074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禄者，爵禄之謂也。馬者，車馬之謂也。人命重禄馬，故先言之。禄馬皆可以致富貴，若禄背之而去馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逐之而散，二者俱失，所以守窮途而恓惶。背如陰陽之相背，非所謂何也。逐如散逐之逐，非所謂追。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100223343476748"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。如癸亥人得正月甲寅，癸禄在子，寅以背之，驛馬在巳，寅以刑之，前因刑而逐去其馬，後因背而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不能及禄馬在面前，禄在背後，向前趁馬，禄又不來，回住，待禄馬又漸逺。此正與捍祿攔馬相反同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鄉用日干遁禄、時干遁馬、五子元求之則可知。假令庚午人得壬辰日丁未時，便以丁壬庚子遁至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申，缘庚禄午馬同在申上，與本命相得尤佳。又如甲申人丁丑月己酉日丙寅時命生，時於帝座。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上會同禄馬，𠔥甲申、己亥、丙寅，皆禀五行清旺生氣，故應晩年有非常之遇，所以位至二公，壽逾七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"十徐說：以禄爲官，馬爲財，見傷官爲背祿，見比劫爲逐馬。如甲人生三春九夏，天元更帶丙丁、甲乙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或亥卯未之例同鄉，乃壬午、癸巳等日，柱有丁巳、丙戊歸禄午巳之例，並當詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官崇位顯，定知夾禄之鄉；小盈大𧇊，恐是劫財之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178940458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夾祿即拱禄，如癸丑得癸亥之例。劫劫煞如丁丑得丙寅歳，水以尅火爲財，丙寅乃自生之火，可謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"小盈丑人以孤劫在寅，丑土受寅木之制，爲財化鬼，斯所謂大𧇊也。三命以財旺爲吉人以有財爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100272097902619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福若値劫地，縱禄命有一二吉處，亦不免大𧇊。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178956842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178973226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論夾祿，如癸丑日癸亥時，不可本禄位爲歲月所","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178973226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占，别位又不可尅壞，天干衝動，地支夾貴不住走。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178973226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"了貴氣。所以福聚之地，不可被傷，祸聚之地，不可無救。五陽千見，五陰爲劫財，五陰干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見五陽爲敗財，劫凶於敗，其解尤善。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407178989610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生月帶禄，入仕居赫奕之尊；重犯奇儀，藴籍抱出羣","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179005994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之噐。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179005994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王廷光解：生月帶禄，以生月爲運元，帶天禄生旺","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179022378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣而行運者，主平生温厚，爲福最多。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179022378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉生月而","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179038762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生日生時可知。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179038762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或四柱五行互相带禄，兼乘生旺","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179055146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179055146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚解：本命禄元與生月同用日干","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179071530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求之，如庚子人甲申月，但得乙庚日，便用丙丁推","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179071530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，甲申是也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179071530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐子平解：甲乙人秋生，丙丁人冬生，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179087914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"即正氣官星，生月带之，則父子之氣近，爲祿相需。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179087914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更生日支内，天元自旺，生時不居休敗，行年復在","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179104298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄鄉，爲生月帶禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179104298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余見以戊日逢乙巳月，壬日逢","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179120682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥月，癸月逢戊子月，干支帶官禄，或年日時所，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179120682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256193200168"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"坐之支得生月干，以壬寅日得甲辰月，辛酉日得辛巳月之例，犬仕定居赫奕之尊。〇重犯奇儀王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廷光解：乙、丙、丁爲三奇，戊、巳、庚、辛、壬、癸爲六儀，十干用九，而遁去其甲者之謂儀。如乙巳生得辛巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月日辛爲儀之爲奇，乙以辛巳爲生成官文坐官禄，長生學堂，二已乃重犯奇儀。奇儀者，天地陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"耦合英秀之氣也。瑩和尚則以甲、戊、庚、乙、丙、丁，法天地二儀。李仝則以子加寅，順數至年月，見本命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"余觀遁甲論三奇六作，王廷光之解爲是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此以上論貴命根基，此以後說運中會遇，故下文云云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰男陽女，時觀出入之年，陰女陽男，更看元辰之嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179120682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"男女之别，男尊女卑，陽位本男，陰位本女。今言陰男陽女，失其序矣。既失其序，則運有逆順，大運出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"入之年，慮招不測之咎。陽男陰女，各得其宜。大運遷變之年，更看元辰等煞。是故吉卤悔吝生乎動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者也。行運爲三命之最要乎。徐子平解此最詳。元辰是當生元有害官印之辰，前云出入之年，此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100272097951771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"元辰之歲，其理無二。至於論節氣之淺深，財官之向背，皆前人所未發也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與生地之相逢，宜退身而避位。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179137066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫㑹吉㑹，伏吟反吟，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179153450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰錯陽差，天衝地擊，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179153450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此說運中所遇吉㐫禍福，生地相逄，瑩利尚則以本年長生中逢鬼旺，如金逢乙巳火，士遇庚申木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火見甲寅水，木逢辛亥金。王廷光則以五行有父子相繼之道。父壯則子幼，子強則父衰，子父同處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子既來矣，父已成功，自當告退，是知他生我而子休代父位也。易震爲長男用事，而乾父退居西北。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亦是此理。徐子平則以庚辛生人，運到申酉，以火爲官禄，火至申酉病死；木爲財帛，木到申酉死絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官財俱無，即建禄不富之說也，恐非賦義。行年歲運、禄馬五處皆在生旺之地，共來扶我元命謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉會共尅我元命，謂之㐫會。伏吟者，大運與元命相對，以隂遇隂曰錯，以陽遇陽曰差。人命有陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"錯雜人運有陰陽交差，元命與運在東南而遇太歲，在西北，謂之天衝；元命與運作西北而遇太岁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100272097935387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"在東南，謂之地擊，吉會㐫會，言運遇伏吟、反吟，陰错陽差，天衝地擊，其間亦有吉會㐫會，未必皆㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。如甲子金命伏吟庚子土爲吉，戊子火爲㐫，反吟戊午火爲㐫，庚午士爲吉，西北衝東南，主動改。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出入，是內衝外也。東南衝西北，雖衝而不動，是外衝内也。遇此者，皆主不寧。其間吉㐫兩存陰陽错。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"差則純陰純陽，不生不成，所作多奇而不偶。或曰：天衝地擊，乃天十地支大運與元命相衝擊，非専。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"指五行陰陽絶滅之地也。歲運得此，更在反伏吟上，則其爲㐫會可知。四柱寓於其上，纵貴不壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或逢四煞五鬼，六害七傷，地网天羅，三元九宫。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179153450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福臻","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179169834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成慶，禍併危疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179169834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扶兮速速，抑乃遲遲。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179186218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此皆言行運所遇之神煞也。命前四辰日四煞，乃寅申、己亥四衝之刼煞也。命前五辰日五鬼，乃子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人見辰亥，人見卯也。或指辰戌丑未爲四煞，五行遇尅，爲五鬼六害寅巳之例，七傷亡煞等神。或以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一吉、二宜，三生、四煞，五鬼、六害、七傷，八難、九厄，皆是三元九宫内諸神煞之名，歲運逢之，故多爲凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100292079435830"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若元命三元九宫，五行生旺，爲福之臻，尚可以成吉慶，以五行爲神煞之先也。若三元九宫五行四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱在衰敗之地，歲運又值諸㐫煞，所謂禍併危疑者歟。煞扶乃速速成灾，福抑乃遲遲爲慶。余以二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"句併兼禍福言，扶禍則速，扶福則遲，抑福則速，抑禍則遲。徐說元命犯辰戌丑未，大運又行到其上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂之四煞。大運干为鬼制財尅官印，與太歲同，謂之五鬼。丑未生人，柱中元有丑未，更大運在辰戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑未却遇太歲在子午卯酉者，謂之六害，運中逢七煞，爲之七傷。如甲乙人用庚辛爲官，運在南方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或逢寅午戌、巳與未，太歳是也。四煞輕，五鬼重，六害輕，七傷重，運逢之輕，歲遇之重，地網天羅，戌人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不得見亥，亥人不得見戌，謂之正天羅；辰人不得見己，巳人不得見辰，謂之真地網。中間又分亥見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌辰見巳爲尤重，遇之者灾病連綿。大凡推運，須看生年太歲與運生尅，生尅已定，然後参諸神煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則吉㐫無不驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歷貴地而待時，遇比肩而争競。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179202602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至若人疲馬劣，猶託","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179218986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256193232936"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺之鄉；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179218986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孟子云：雖有鎡基，不如待時。若運入貴神之地，待時數符合，則有福慶。最忌者，比肩也，如比肩並行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之運，必有争竞。弱者伏強，在吉凶神煞升降言之。若禄馬氣衰，但得禄財、命財旺相，亦可扶持。或日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"比肩争競，如兩庚奪一丁，兩丙食一戊，分擘其福。如此者，交相是非，人疲馬劣。本命支日，人元兼驛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"馬皆在五行衰敗無氣之地，其所以不為灾者，以財旺，如戊午火命，驛馬在申，申中金旺火衰是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"徐觧：歷貴地而待時，如壬辰、癸巳生人，用土爲官禄，用火爲財帛，而生月不居九夏，不在四季，雖歷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴地猶待四時基本，元有元無，也遇比肩而争競。如壬辰、癸巳，更在九夏四季，得其官禄之時，大運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又在火土分野，却遇太歲，是壬癸年，亥子丑亦同，或爲衝刑，或爲破害，主稱意中夭横，人疲者，人元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"疲，乏也。馬劣者，所合之辰馬弱也。如甲午生人，運行西方，午爲人元，屬火，火到西方，死絶，人疲也。甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以己爲財，午内有己土，已到西方，亦自衰敗，馬劣也。午雖疲乏，猶頼西方金旺爲財。秋金懐壬癸，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256193265704"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"可與巳破鬼生財，此說得之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或乃財旺禄衰，建馬何避，掩衝歲臨尚不爲灾，年登","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179218986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故宜獲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179218986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尅者之謂財，寓者之謂禄，乘者之謂馬，馬是扶身之本，禄爲養命之源。禄乘貴而遷官，馬運財而获","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"福禄財、驛馬兼得之，則富貴兩全，偏得之則次。或天禄雖衰，而身財猶旺，兼遇驛馬來乘，縱使揜伏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冲撃歳運，尚不爲灾，况後歲運，更在五行生旺會合豐登之處，故宜獲福之多矣。掩者伏吟，衝者反。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吟也。假令癸亥生得乙巳歲，遇禄水雖絶在巳，而以水人尅火爲財，火旺在巳，兼己上乘馬，雖己亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相衝臨於反吟之上，以身旺之財，不僞灾咎。若歳運不相衝，臨在三合、六合、五行生旺之地，又逢財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遇馬，可謂年岁豐登，故宜獲福者歟！徐日：此節與前意同而理異也。如丙午人運至西方，雖財旺而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禄衰下元建馬爲助，言酉中有辛合丙，則不畏掩衝，此與中下興隆不殊。前說財運掩衝，固不爲忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100344227201064"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此論岁臨運位，亦未可使言㐫咎。太歲爲造化之主，百煞之尊，來臨壓運，多匃少吉。若三元内外五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"行官印有用，亦可以利見大人而成吉會；財帛有用，亦可以因貴人而發財帛。且如生日是壬午，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"運是庚午，歲是戊午，此言歲運並臨，亦爲吉會。次年交辛未，其氣不殊，官印財帛有用，其獲福宜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉生逢小吉，反壽長年；天罡運至天魁，寄生續壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179235370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑爲大吉，未爲小吉。如癸未日生人行丑運，或丁丑日生人行未運，不得謂之反吟，皆謂之生氣癸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"受氣於巳而成形於未，丁受氣於亥而成形於丑，故日生逢。如六壬課發用，丁課在未，癸在丑，亦此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"意也。丑未爲陰陽之中，會天乙貴神所臨，主與本逢之，則有長年之壽。辰爲天罡，戌爲天魁，如庚戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生人行辰運，或甲辰生人行戌運，不得謂之反吟。庚受氣於寅，而成形於辰，甲受氣於申，而成形於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌皆是生氣，鬼谷子云：罡中有乙，魁裹伏辛，是也。前云生逢，後云寄生，義不殊也。或日：此後八句再","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明反吟吉㐫，無固必之義。假令乙丑陰命，男在六月生，遁見癸未木，雖本命生月相尅，合主夭傷，却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100272097984539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲乙丑納音金，尅癸未納音木，反壽長年歌云：便將生月用爲身，却以納音回作命，身衰尅命短天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年命徃尅，身長壽命是也。假令戊辰陽命，男在三月生，計五岁，起運，順行五十六運，至壬戌，納音水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"來生戊辰木，又三月天、月德俱在壬，寄在戌上又生木，故日寄生。續壽塋和尚曰：以下四節並用值","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印始得其詳。乙丑金印，癸未木印，壬辰水印，甲戌火印，戊辰土印。長生續壽，惟寄與，反除此五干未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有知其然也。缘丑中有乙木，未上有癸水，癸水生其乙木，增長禄元，反壽長年，莫非是也。戌中有甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰中有壬，壬水生其甲木，續甘丙火，故日天罡運至夫魁，寄生續壽，大要卜干爲禄，定人修短故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從魁抵蒼龍之宿，財自天來，太衝臨昴胃之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179251754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人元","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179268138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有害，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179268138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉爲昴胃之鄉，從魁是也；卯曰苍龍之宿，大衝是也。支元取財。今言天來者，缘酉上有辛，卯中有乙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛金制其乙木，故云財自天來。以共酉金尅其卯木，乙木畏於辛金，禄既破傷，人元受尅。若然酉人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100206956249125"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遇卯爲吉，卯人逢酉爲㐫，位列尊卑，剛柔斷矣。徐曰：蒼龍屬辰酉生人逢辰，是酉中辛金尅辰中乙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木爲財用，支内天元爲財也。卯人運至酉，金尅木而反相刑，支作人元，故曰有害。害者是七煞不犯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衝刑尅制，亦偏陰偏陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金禄窮於正首，庚重辛輕，木人困於金鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179268138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅深卯淺，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179284522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陰極生陽，陽極生陰，陰陽自然之理也。陽金生於巳而死於子，絕於寅；陰金生於子而𣦸於巳，絶於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯正死正生之謂重，偏生偏𣦸之謂輕。次以陽木生亥絶申，陰木生午絶酉，陽木申深而酉淺，陰木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申淺而酉深，盖寅卯指羣木之情，庚辛舉衆金之類。申是水生之地，木日困；寅是生火之宫，金云窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。一云：丙辛有合，故辛輕；乙庚有合，故卯淺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙在識其通變。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179284522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拙說猶神。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179300906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巫瞽昧於調絃，難希律吕。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179317290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命運吉㐫禍福，如上所云，賦特言其大槩，妙在識其通變。賦辭雖拙，而理妙應如神，設若不能通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100206956314661"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"變，譬之巫瞽昧於調絃，希律吕之和，難矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛臨於甲乙，君子可以求官；北人運在南方，貿易","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179333674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獲其厚利。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179333674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金木有相得之理，水火有既濟之道，故特舉而言之。日庚辛臨於甲乙，則餘八干可知也。北人運在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"南方，則餘東西可知也。言君子見小人則不然，言北人，須亥子方爲是。甲以辛爲官，乙以庚爲官，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛之運，歲來臨甲乙之人，故曰君子可以求官，在小人反以爲鬼也。亥子北方之水，巳午南方之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火以水行，運至火，我尅之爲財，所以貿易獲其厚利。或謂壬癸之位，其卦屬坎，丙丁之位，其卦屬離。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水歸火地，運至財鄉，不知壬癸是禄，巳午是命，干支不相入，如壬癸得丙丁，止可謂之禄財而已不。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"可以貿易言也。談命者，須當分禄命身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞朝歡而夕泣，爲盛火之炎陽；觀禍福之賒遥，則多","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179350058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100206956298277"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因於水土。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179350058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此論五行之性，明禍福之遲速也。火之性暴而多傷，故鑽木而烟飛，擊石而光發，朝歡旋泣今是昨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"非由火傳薪，莫知其極也。水土爲物，其性柔和，致於祸福之端，得其遲緩之意，葢智與信也。火木性","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"快，易發易休；水土性遲，難成難敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木未能成器，听哀樂以難名。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179366442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似木盛而花繁，狀密","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179382826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲而不雨。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179382826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言金者則尚木，金得用而木乃成，是以剛濟柔也。言木者則尚金，木成噐而金得著，仁者必有勇也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若有金無木，勇而無禮則亂；有木無金，庚辛亏而義寡。金者，西方之噐也主哀。木者，東方之物也主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"樂。樂而不淫者，木遇金也；哀而不傷者，金得木也。凡此者，皆大人之命也。若明水火之歸中用乎金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木之間隔，由是哀樂不能動其心，乃外方難名之人。若偏陰偏陽，似木盛花繁，偏陽之謂，伏密雲不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100344227233832"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雨偏陰之謂，見人命要陰陽兩停，則爲應格之命，故下文云云。又曰：金不能成噐，藉火以陶鎔木未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"能成功，假金以削刻。故樂必以哀爲主，益必以損爲先。木盛花繁，秀而不實；宻雲不雨，晦而難明。兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"在未測之間，擬議生矣。是故旺而不可無制，衰而不可無生，得處比和，復歸純粹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乘軒衣冕，金火何多，位劣班卑，陰陽不定，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179399210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"前論水火以相濟而成慶，次論金木而爲官鄉。是知水貴升，火貴降，木要濟柔爲剛，金要損剛益柔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則互用爲慶，其間獨有金剛火強，不可不知也。金至堅之物，非盛火則不能革化；火至暴之物，非金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無以顯諸，用金火兩停，方爲鑄印之象。故賦云：乘軒衣冕，此君子之器也，須金火兩停者當之。若火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"多金少，金多火輕，皆爲㐫暴之命。金旺於西方，火旺於南方，各恃其勢，則爲自刑之刑。如此之命，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日時有用，終歸於位劣班卑而已，是陰陽不能定分故也。金，陰也，火，陽也。既陰陽兩偏，則貴賤高卑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無所定著，况有金而無火，有火而無金，其爲㐫徒，又可知也。或曰：人命四柱五行，金火多者不足貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100292079468598"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以金剛不能順物，火暴而難益其生，爲氣不常，君子之鮮故道矣。庚人得丙，辛人得丁，純陰純陽，爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尅爲鬼，是爲隂陽不定，雖有出身，亦位劣班卑，不能大顯亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以龍吟虎嘯，風雨助其休祥；火勢將興，故先煙而","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179399210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後焰。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179399210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此爲上文五行相尅，或未成噐，合貴不貴。此又言相克相生之性，因以龍虎煙熖爲喻。若五行各得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"真所則如龍行雨降，虎嘯風生，又如火旺，先有其煙，後有其熖。或以龍吟虎嘯二句，喻人年吉而歲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"運又吉，若初㐫後吉者，必不然。譬若火之始煙，然先而後熖也。盖煙生於火，而能𣡸火，煙以有氣末","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"通爲義，豈非火外景而内晦，煙達而後生，不猶人之始㐫終古者哉？徐解龍吟虎嘯，當以戊辰、甲寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其義甚詳，不然，但遇寅與辰相得，亦是先煙後熖明，陰陽氣順有次序，與其爲氣也不殊，終非賦義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毎見㐫中有吉，吉乃先㐫；吉中有㐫，㐫爲吉兆，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179415594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100344227250216"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此本上文，言吉㐫相爲倚伏，如前論從魁抵蒼龍之宿，財自天來，吉也。是酉中辛尅辰中乙木爲財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰乃水鄉，復能奪辛金之官，論財却不缺而失官爲㐫。太衝臨昴胃之鄉，人元有害，㐫也却木用金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲官，西則不背官禄，㐫中反吉。賦意始於説運，次議五行之後，再詳言之。又如火人行水運，則是七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞，㐫也。或用水爲官，吉也。水行巳午運，南方獲利爲財，吉也，却下有戊巳七煞，㐫也。如此極多，要學。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人深造变通，以根本取最重者言之。曇瑩曰：吉㐫之相仍，禍福之相因，陰陽之常理也。世固有吉人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㐫於吉㐫人吉於㐫者，君子所不道也，亦道其当而己。凶若勝吉，吉藴㐫中；吉若勝㐫，㐫藏吉内。駁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雜生於純粹，比和出於戰争，故曰吉中有㐫，㐫爲吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍自向末，言福可以迎推；纔入衰鄉，論灾宜其逆課。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179415594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
