{"lines":[{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男迎女送，否泰交居，陰陽二氣，逆順折除。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179431978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言灾福吉㐫，由於行運，禍旬向末，如見㐫運十年終蒲前交吉運，若當生年月氣深，或行年太歲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100272098033691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"扶助，向禄臨財，更不須待。交運只在此運末，便可迎祥而推之。纔入衰鄉人命久，歷福地，方交背祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財絕之運，然末可便以㐫言，是論灾於逆課也。男迎女送，陽男陰女，運順行也。一運十年，更分前後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"各五年。凡入吉運，得節氣深，男迎者，前五年发福；女送者，後五年發福。或曰男詳大運初入之年。迎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"何灾福，故云迎女。詳大運将出之年，送何灾福，故云送男。迎女送。否泰交居，作一義看，迎吉送㐫迎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㐫送吉，是否泰交居也。陰男陽女，陽男陰女，依逆順行運折除，即前折除三嵗爲年也。看新舊運上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有何吉㐫，以運數言。曇瑩曰：此論行運，各指長生，次於衰地。如金生於巳，而衰於戌，戌上男順行於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𣦸囚休廢，女逆行於帝旺臨官巳上，男順旺於申酉之鄉，女逆困於寅卯之地，故云禍旬云云陰陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二氣葢言小運乃年之氣也，大運是月之氣也。日干爲運，月支爲氣，小運則從生日後交，大運則論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其氣而过，二氣運行，由我命者也，故曰陰陽二氣云云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占其金木之内，顯於方所分野；標其南北之間，恐不","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179448362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100206956331045"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利於徃來。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179448362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一旬之内，於年中而問干，一歲之中，求月","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179464746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中而問日。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179464746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向三避五，指方面以窮通；審吉量㐫，述歲","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179481130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中之否泰。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179481130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言運行東西南北、金木水火之鄉，有利不利，兼歲中否泰言也。王氏曰：木火、金水，乃四方専一之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"氣，各擅方所分野，如春之辛卯，夏之戊午，秋之癸酉，冬之丙子，四方各抱自旺之氣，而不可相犯，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行旺氣，取仲一辰，謂之白虎煞。如東方之木徃西方逢金，南方之火來北地遇水，所謂煞忌四仲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"物禁失道：曰君曰父，不可兩亡，以其相尅，徃必不利。若五行衰絕無氣，逢相衝徃來，則反互用爲福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如乙亥火，得癸巳水，火至巳而旺，水至亥而旺，互換逢旺，徃来何傷。壬寅之金，爲臣不強，庚申之木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"事君不暴，獨占一隅，□有造化。葢禄旺貴其自亨，患難欲得相救故也。一旬之内，於年中而問干，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年之干，則有以知甲之所寓。於是同旬之生也，一处之中，求月中而問日，謂一岁之中，則有異者陰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100341010219034"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽男女之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179497514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求於月而問日者，欲知節氣日數，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179513898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以定幾歲，爲行大運之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179513898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運之行也，宜向三元","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179530282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣，避五鬼絶路，指陳方面，窮通陰陽，𮗚禄馬之","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179530282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向背，大運之盛衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179530282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此以審吉凶，不出指顧間，能","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179546666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"述岁中之否泰。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179546666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或以生氣、福德、天醫爲向三，絶體、","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179563050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遊魂、五鬼、絶命、本官爲避五。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179563050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐曰：占讀作去。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179579434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"严看","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179595818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當生歲月所占。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179595818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如木用金為官，在陽命男運出未","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179612202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入申，陰命男運出亥入戌，是向禄臨財，於金木分","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179612202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野之際。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179612202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如金用木爲財，陽命男運出丑入寅，陰命","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179628586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男運出巳入辰，是向禄臨財，在木火方所之中。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179628586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179644970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加太歲、月令、氣候扶同言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179644970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"標對本言，又有标准","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179661354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之義，則是命基本也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179661354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南者，向眀而徃也；比者，向北","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179677738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而來也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179677738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言運氣出入動静，或吉或㐫，不可駁雜；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179694122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或遇交運之年，不可輕舉。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179694122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一旬之内，於年中問干，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179710506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是月中求日也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179710506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一歲之中，求月中問日，是年中求","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179726890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179726890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向三避五，是歲中求吉利方所也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407179743274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡坐作進","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580774463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"退，向吉避㐫，莫大於此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580774463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一旬十日也，年中生日","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580790847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580790847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡在一月之中，一句之内，將生日天元配合而","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580807231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言，則知其日中休祥，定立生日爲主也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580807231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一岁之中，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580823615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取月令以生尅配合而言，則知其月中休咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580823615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580839999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100344227266600"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如人生得地，須太歲爲尊，是一歲之中，求生月帶禄，或官印，原有原無，是月而問日，乃看命總法也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸乃秋生而冬旺，亥子同途，甲乙乃夏𣦸而春榮，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580839999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯一揆。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580839999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言人命有生旺死絶，而行運所值有宜與不宜，通指五行言也。庚爲衆金之主，故居申而生水水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歸亥子，冬天而旺，壬爲聚水之源，故居亥而生木。木歸寅卯，春天而旺，甲爲羣木之首，故居寅而生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火，火歸巳午，夏天而旺戊，爲衆土之尊，故居己而生金。金歸申酉，秋天而旺壬癸，亥子一類水也。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生於申而旺於子，甲乙寅卯一類木也，木旺於卯而死於午，故壬癸秋生而冬旺，甲乙夏死而春榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅丁卯，秋天宜以保持；己巳戊辰，度乾宫而脫厄。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580856383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此指納音言也。丙寅丁卯，廬中火，火之旺也，至秋宜以保持以火至秋而死，况他火乎？己巳戊辰，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"林木，木之盛也，度乾宫而脫厄，以木至亥而生也，况别木乎？又丙寅丁卯，舉火之類，火既克金，秋夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100292079501366"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"保持者何也？言水生於秋故也。己巳戊辰，舉木之類。木既生亥，乾宫脫厄者何也？言亥有乾金故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明五行休旺之道，造化目然之理，或元命，或行運，或流岁，皆宜慎之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"值病憂病，逢生得生，旺相峥嶸，休囚滅絕。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580872767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論其眷屬，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580889151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憂其𣦸絕。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580889151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"值病憂病，以休囚滅絕爲言；逢生得生，以旺相峥嶸爲義。值病憂病者，五行病中逢鬼是也。木值辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己金火值甲申水，土遇庚寅木，金逢乙亥火，如此之類，休囚滅絶，逢生得生者，五行生處逢生是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木臨癸亥水，火得庚寅木，水值壬申金，金逢丁巳士。如此之類，旺相峥嵘，或值之於當生，或逢之於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歲運更看始終，隨宜消息。五行生我者父母，我生者子孫，尅我者官鬼，我尅者妻財，比和者兄弟忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"在空亡𣦸絶之地，憂居休囚衰敗之鄉，隨眷屬所得言之。此總論五行，生乎天地之間，寓於十二支。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"内有長生、沐浴、冠帶、臨官、帝旺、衰病、死、墓絶、胎養，内有四吉四㐫、四平也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256062980111"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓在鬼中，危疑者甚；足下臨喪，面前可見。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580905535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"墓在鬼中，乃五行墓中逢鬼如金畏己丑火，木防乙未金，水愁丙辰土，土忌戊辰木，火怕壬戌水如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此之格或行乎歲運，主危疑之甚。足下臨䘮，以命前二辰爲䘮門，如辛亥人見己丑，既入墓，又临丧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃足下同爲禍，面前可見，言其凶速也。若太岁諸煞，大小運臨之，憂其不測之灾，防有外服之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凭陰察其陽禍，歲星莫犯於孤辰，恃陽鍳以陰灾，天","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580921919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年忌逢於寡宿。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580921919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅卯辰人，巳爲孤辰，丑爲寡宿，其寅辰爲陽之位，丑巳爲陰之位，故曰慿陰察其陽祸，岁星莫犯於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孤辰巳午、未人以申爲孤辰，辰爲寡宿，未已爲陰之位，申辰爲陽之位，故曰恃陽鑑，以陰灾，天年忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逢於寡宿，天年猶小運也；岁星猶太歲也。陽以孤辰爲重，陰以寡宿爲重。徐曰：陰以陽爲對，陽以陰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲耦，言陽則未嘗無陰，言陰則末嘗無陽。故馮陰可以察陽，恃陽可以鍳陰。歲星者，太岁也，不可在。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100341010169882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孤辰之上假令寅、卯辰人遇太歲在己卯寅人人䘮勾吊、絞辰人，謂之控神煞，又謂之邀神煞，主阻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"碍，抑塞天年，亦太歲不可在寡宿之上。如寅、卯辰人遇太岁在丑，辰人勾絞，卯人䘮吊，寅人謂之窺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神煞又謂之廹神煞，主人窺𥨸、逼迫陷害。其或三元刑戰，岁運不和，是五行禄馬爲害之年，則爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先論二氣，次課延生。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580938303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父病推其子禄，妻灾課以夫年。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580954687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行相生爲父子，其爲传受之氣，青赤等類是也。陰陽相制爲夫妻，其爲交合之辰，支干等類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假令金病無疑畏火，急求水以救之，以金生水爲子，能尅火故也。又如金之灾者，恐值火也，且看火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之休旺何如？此乃救解二法，最爲詳要。徐曰：二氣者，陰陽也；延生者，命運也。先别陰陽，次分命運。父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"病二句，是明陰陽進退之象也。假令庚辰人十月生庚，金病於亥，是父病也。庚生壬爲子，壬禄在亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是子有禄也。庚以乙爲妻，大運到巳，乙木病於已，是妻灾也，而庚金復得延年。五行俱如此類。如壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100341010251802"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸日生人，以庚辛爲父，行亥子運金病死。亥子主父母灾，或丁憂。丙丁日生人，以庚辛爲妻，行寅卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"運金絕寅卯，主妻灾，或丧偶。又如丙寅人大運至戊申，火雖病，而丙寅爲戊申之父，土至申長生子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禄既生，父承子禄之蔭，雖病亦不至𣦸。如丁卯人行運至甲午，火尅金爲妻，金至午而敗，可謂妻灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯火旺於午，又逢天禄，金火相得，陰陽相合，雖五行妻灾，以夫年旺而不爲㐫。葢父子天合夫妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人合是人之至親骨肉也。故觀其夫子之命，遇㐫神惡煞，當刑傷父母妻子，則父病必深，妻灾必重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三宫元吉，禍逢可以延推。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580971071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"始末皆㐫，灾忽來而迅速；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580987455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三宫乃禄命身三元長生之宫，四柱寓居，是禄宫馬貴逢人，五行生旺，謂之元吉，雖行年歲運逢㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神惡煞，欲爲之禍，亦迟延而不至於夭折。三元五行無氣，加以岁運㐫神惡煞來臨，是始末皆㐫。其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禍之至迅速而不可救。徐曰：前論陰陽始終，此說人命吉㐫，如命内天元、人元、支元内外歲月時中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"值貴禄，不居休敗，是根基主本，三元元吉。或值行年太岁，運命乖危之地，然亦可以推禍以迟延。□。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100344227299368"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若三元内外，雖有禄馬貴氣，却八字中衝刑破害，不唯有貴而不貴，又終爲㐫人之命。如遇吉運，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"防因福生，禍遇㐫運，則灾忽來而迅速。三解同一義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅墓受煞，落鿄塵以呻吟；丧吊臨人，變宫商爲薤露。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407580987455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命前五辰爲宅，命後五辰爲墓煞、刼煞、災煞、岁煞也。命前二辰爲丧門，命後二辰爲吊客、人、人元也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古之善歌者有绕梁之声，善唱者合宫适之曲。今易以呻吟愁嘆，變爲薤露挽歌，則丧吊臨門宅墓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"受煞故也。其或太岁凶煞臨併，大小運限刑衝，必致㐫禍，切宜預僃。或宅墓二位，若遇逐年太岁喪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"門吊客、黄旛、豹尾、太陰、大耗、將軍、諸惡煞入宅，一主呻吟，二主忍痛，三主分離，四主哭泣，此爲四声。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"入宅，或云：移居避舍可免。此言流歲所遇之㐫煞也。人命原有尤重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干推兩重，防灾於元首之間；支拆三輕，愼禍於股肱","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581003839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之内。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581003839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下元一氣，周居去住之期。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581020223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100257489092659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"干推兩重者，干爲天元，以象元首。遇德見貴者吉，逢煞值鬼者㐫。天元兩值受尅，如甲子生得庚午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月加以庚午日，謂之重者，千不勝重尅故也。防灾於頭目胸背之間，支拆三輕支猶人之支節主之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"於命帶三合、六合者吉，逢四衝、三刑者㐫，支辰三刑逢傷。如辛酉人得庚寅月丁巳日戊申時，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"輕者刑不至於本命故也。愼禍於腹脏股肱之内。或以三合逢傷，亦通下元一氣納音是也。其主宰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行遂干支遷變，而成否泰，其灾禍不拘元首股肱，故云周居去住之期。天干推兩重，况三乎支拆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三，輕况兩乎？此干支輕重之别也。或曰：此論十干遇大運在本年上值干，反尅太歲，干尅，名爲鬼臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頭患頭面之疾，十二支辰，若身命逢生死旺五鬼，須有四肢腰脚之疾，比於干爲輕也。復言氣運陶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"隠居歌曰：甲己五年乙庚四，丙辛三岁丁壬二，戊癸須從一岁推。又有納音行運氣相生，福德相尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㐫，五行恭順皆如意。金人遇金犯凶禍，木人見木營求遂。水人值水主動揺，運順逆氣須還記。假令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸酉男命三月生，三月建丙辰，便從丙辰起，三岁丁巳土，二歲。此五年，納音是土，别無刑尅，戊午住。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100341010300954"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一年巳未住五年，此六年納音是火，金遇火㐫。庚申十四年，辛酉三年，此七年納音是木。自十二至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"十八主營求稱遂。餘倣此。循環數之，或一宫住五年，或住一年，故云去住之期。大運住在旺鄉設使。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"氣有相制，則不能爲害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仁而不仁，慮傷伐於戊巳。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581036607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於寢食侍衛，物有鬼物，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581052991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人有鬼人，逢之爲灾，去之爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581052991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙木，五常爲仁，今反言不仁，以其尅戊巳，㐫也。如甲見戊，乙見己，偏陰偏陽，爲尅、爲伐、爲孤、爲背。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則五行爲不仁也。若甲見己，乙見戊，剛柔相乘，兩得其所，未可以不仁言也。賦中舉甲、乙、戊、巳爲例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其餘五行，可以例求。五行變化，與人事相通，至於寢食侍衛，皆不外於仁而己。五行我尅之謂財尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"我之謂鬼，譬之辛卯，人遇丁酉，辛禄在酉，逢丁爲辛之鬼，是之謂禄頭逢鬼物有鬼物命支屬木，酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"支屬金，金來尅木，是之謂人元受尅，人有鬼人。格局中類此者，運逢之則爲灾，去之則為福。或曰君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100341010268186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子晨興暮寢，常宜攝衛護持。其或食息弗調，動過生灾。於是合中逢鬼，吉内藏㐫。雖或人情所爲，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"被陰陽所宰然也。寢食，言調養之至切也；侍衛言左右之至近也。此二者甚不可輕忽，以物中有鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"物人中有鬼人，吉㐫之變，自近及遠，爲速之其也。且如戊見甲爲不仁，或岁月時中見庚、辛則爲仁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂戊食庚，庚來制甲，或見己亦爲仁，謂己合甲，能侍衛甲也。戊逢甲本不仁，爲灾有庚巳寢食侍卫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是謂去之爲福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就中裸形侠煞，魄徃鄷都；所犯有傷，魂歸岱嶺。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581069375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"就中是本上文鬼物、鬼人言，就中所遇極重者。五行沐浴之地，謂之裸形，如本音沐浴，大運逢之者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"灾水土人運在酉，木人運在子，火人運在卯，金人運在午，鬼谷子謂之波浪限。俠煞者，元辰七煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如人運在沐浴之上，与太岁併者，是，或當生歲時，原有所犯之神，則魂歸岱嶺，魄徃鄷都，此至㐫之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"名也。或云俠，侠拱七煞也。裸形見煞，尢爲不吉。午乃辛煞，酉乃乙煞，子乃丁煞，卯乃己煞。假如辛巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100257489043507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日乙未時，是裸形俠煞，餘倣此。或以甲子金人得戊午藏金，裸形在午，加以戊午旺火，夾帶自刑，反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吟灾煞破甲子之命，如此則所犯有傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或乃行來出入，抵犯㐫方，嫁娶修營，路登黄黑，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581085759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"行來出入，動作施爲也。嫁娶修營，乃動作施爲，中之大者。吉㐫悔吝生乎動，故君子慎焉。珞琭子既","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"談三命五行，又述出入方所，當避四魔、五鬼、六害、七傷、八難、九厄爲㐫方，一德二生爲吉方，取逐年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太歲神煞看之，行黄道爲吉，黒道爲㐫也。或日：此論人運氣，自運元而行來出入吉㐫之地。遇五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"行相尅相生，有嫁娶修營之理。五行我尅之謂妻。妻在五行生旺之地，則可娶，娶之則爲助，尅我之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂夫夫在五行生旺之地，則可嫁，嫁之則爲福，言出於夫婦，可以成嫁娶之義也。修營者，言五行雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有正性，兩間有不常之變，是以君子修德營生，以待時而巳。路登黄黑，指運元月建上行黑道十年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"順行至除溝，上行黄道，如運到黄道，凡百皆利；運至黑道，凡百抑塞。凡人修爲動作，進退向背，莫不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100292079517750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"本乎陰陽，體合運氣，吉㐫俱不能逃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾福在歲年之位内，發覺由日時之擊揚。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581085759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五神相尅，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581102143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三生定命，每見貴人食禄，無非禄馬之鄉；源濁伏吟，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581102143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惆悵歇宫之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581102143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡說岁中休詳，專看日時與太歲生尅刑衝言之。生日爲妻，生時爲子，日時與太歲和合，及財物有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用無諸壞者，依事物而言之。如太岁與日時相刑，或六合、三合中有元辰七煞者㐫，亦看類而言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"故下文云云。或日歲年，指太岁行年言。凡人命遇流年嵗君，㐫則爲灾，吉則爲福，皆由五行中日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時之激揚，響應於岁位。五神者，五行也；三生者，三元也。凡觀人命，須究根基，用三元定宫，以五行相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"配此法，以日時禄馬、五子元求之，或相生於本命建旺之鄉，或駁尅於當生滅絶之地。至若運限加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"临，必有吉㐫之兆。凡遇五行而造化滅絶空亡，更逢運限刑衝，惡星交併，主多憂少樂，必招天殞。惆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100230628818956"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"悵呻吟，故號歇宫之地。或指惆長爲煞名，子人見亥，卯人見寅，午人見己，酉人見申，指五神爲絶體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"游魂五鬼，絶命本宫，三生爲生氣天醫、福德。此以上謂出入嫁娶修營之法，非三命之說，謂用太岁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行之位内，看其灾福，亦須擇吉日吉時，乃可用事。其説亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狂横起於勾絞，禍敗發於元亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581118527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅墓同處，恐少樂而","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581134911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多憂；萬里回還，乃是三歸之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581134911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神煞者，天地五行精氣也，各有所主吉㐫。談命者，先推五行休旺格局，然後参以神煞，觀其事類陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命以前三辰爲勾，後三辰爲絞。陰命以前三辰爲絞，後三辰爲勾，或交臨運限，乃招狂横之灾。元辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亡神二煞，名更值當生㐫煞，岁運刑星，多因官事勾連，無端營絆。加以宅墓同處，於勾絞元亡之上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尤㐫。譬癸亥生前五辰見戊辰，乃水之墓，流年岁運若帶煞來同處其中，是宅墓同處也。三歸者，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌丑未，此云三丘，亦云五墓。萬物歸根復命，反本還元。凡此四辰，以應回環之象，或以三元五行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100341010284570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歸宿之地爲三歸。如甲子人得亥年爲木禄之一歸，得申月，是水命之二歸，巳運是身金之三歸，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"指三元本音長生之位而言，雖身客萬里長途，将有廻還之理也。徐曰：勾絞不可在元命日時二運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之上，更或與元辰七煞併者，尤㐫。宅墓如戊子生遇辛未太岁，亦須未子日上有日時，或大運同宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者則重，主不利陰人、小口、家宅。此言大運在十二辰之間，順逆回環，在三元本禄、本財終宿之地，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此者優安享福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四煞之父，多生五鬼之男；六害之徒，食有七傷之事。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581151295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此専論骨肉四煞，指刼灾天地言。或以辰戌丑未爲四陰煞五鬼乃子人見辰、丑見卯寅見寅卯見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑辰見子，巳見亥，午見戌，未見酉，申見申，酉見未，戌見午，亥見已，是也。三元受傷，於年養子，乃是五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼之男，反制受尅，不和順也。六害子穿未等例。十二支不順命，值一兩重六害，或展轉㐫煞併衝，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此之人命有七傷之事决矣。七傷乃害六親及本身也。或以四煞專指四刼，五行生於四孟生者萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100257489076275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"物之父，五行尅我爲鬼，人所遇生敗旺死、絶五變者是也。譬之甲申自生之水，爲木人刼煞之父，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生庚申木爲子，甲乃庚之父，至申而絶，逢庚爲鬼，加以丁亥，因爲甲申之六害。如此則命有七傷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"事矣。七傷亦神煞名，觀賦前云或逢四煞、五鬼、六害、七傷，可見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眷屬情同，水火，相逢於沐浴之鄉；骨肉中道分離，孤","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581167679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宿尤嫌於隔角。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581167679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此合上文言也。沐浴煞，長生第二位，子午卯酉是也。孤辰寡宿，已論於前，隔角寅申己亥是也。有人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命逢沐浴相尅，又孤辰寡宿臨於隔角之位，如卯日丑時、丑日卯時之例。丑者，北方之氣，卯者，東方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之神，其趣不同。眷屬情同水火，言不相合也。分離則又甚矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須要明其神煞，輕重較量。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581184063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身尅煞而尚輕，煞尅身而","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581200447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尤重。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581200447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256063012879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行所司者命也。論命必先之以五行四柱格局，次論神煞吉㐫，可以較量禍福之輕重而已。先論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行見根基之厚薄，分格局之高下，二者相参，庻不差誤。神煞上文，勾絞元亡，孤辰寡宿，隔角沐浴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宅墓、丧吊、伏吟、反吟、三歸、四煞、五鬼、六害、七傷等名是也。禄馬、財官、印綬、食神，乃五行生尅正理不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"可以神煞名之。身指岁干言，或以岁干支納音言。吉㐫神煞，或得於日時之間，或逢於歲運之内，但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以煞尅身而重，身尅煞而輕，更要隨五行四柱格局，詳審消息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於循環八卦，因河洛之遺文，畧之定爲一端，究之","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581216831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翻成萬緒。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581216831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子言三命五行，不外九宫八卦，循環推究，便有許多道理出焉。此非臆說，乃因河洛遺文而爲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之也。始出一端，易有太極是也。終成萬緒，變六十四卦，三百八十四爻，吉㐫悔吝，不啻萬緒而己。一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"端萬緒，在學者畧之究之，或日畧之，定爲一端，即元一氣兮先天也。究之翻成萬緒，即賦中所說五。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100344227348520"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"行三元運氣，行年禄馬、貴德、諸吉㐫神煞是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若值攀鞍踐禄，逢之則佩印乘軒；馬劣財微，遇之則","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581233215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流而不返。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581233215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"數起於一，而終於九，九者，究也，究窮數之終而極於九。九者九陽太过，窮極生化之數也。人貴賤成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"敗之理，莫不由之於数而己。譬癸酉生壬戌月丁亥日庚子時，坐天禄月、日、時中，納音水土，得三陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生旺之成數，陰生命三辰會禄馬攀鞍之上，斯命也，必致身於貴顯，故曰若值云云。如乙酉生丁亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月己卯日丁亥時命，亥月雖乘水馬，遇丁亥土尅之爲鬼。卯日雖坐天禄，以水土俱死於卯而遇身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼衝破本命，所謂禄馬返以爲鬼灾矣。禄馬既失，必藉身財爲資，而水以火財，自絕於亥生月日時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"皆臨三財死絶之地，此五行之窮數也。雖有禄馬身財，𥁞爲鬼物所奪，縱使得運以數之，終窮休敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"飄蕩無歸，故曰馬劣云云。或曰：馬前一辰爲攀鞍，馬后一辰爲鞭策。攀鞑有位與天元帶合者，人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100257489141811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得之貴也，須要加臨吉將，岁運資身，更於旺相之宫，始可言福。驛馬微劣，財命休囚，則塗炭辛勤，終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無成立此以四柱臨之，定主飄蓬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占除望拜，甲午以四八爲期；口舌文書，己亥慎三十","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581249599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有二。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581249599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡相伴，揺動遷移；夾煞持丘，親姻哭送。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581265983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此論行年大小運，由之於數，數有奇耦之變，吉凶自此以生也。甲午生人三十二，小運丁酉，金家旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鄉乙丑太岁本音正庫，又逢驛馬入宅，天乙加臨，故占除望拜之喜。己亥生人三十二，小運丁酉在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吊客太歲庚午在死鄉，仍爲六厄之宫，三元受尅，故有口舌文書之患。又歲運交宫，當須意㑹吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相伴，禍福交攻，未有不因遷變而興，故云善惡相伴，摇動遷移，則吉㐫悔吝生乎動者也。辰戌丑未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂之四煞，亦云三坵之地，各以五行五墓。假令己巳木命得乙末口生，此是本家三駈，又加以羊刃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"故曰夹煞持坵，危疑者甚。自行來出入，止夾煞持丘。此一節文，亦备陰陽地理、三元九宫之例用游","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100344227364904"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年太岁决其灾福，非盡三命之理，兹不盡述。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼須詳其操執，觀其秉持。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581282367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚薄論其骨狀，成器藉於","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581298751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心源。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581298751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木氣盛而仁昌，庚辛𧇊而義寡，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581315135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言雖用五行定命，見其貴賤灾福，慮有特傑非常之人，似冰鼠火龜，難窮罕測之資，則三元五行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不足以尽之也。兼須詳其操執秉持、骨狀心源，則視其所以，觀其所由，察其所安，心術制行兩得之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"矣，相貌德行，互見之矣。人焉痩哉！人焉瘦哉！此珞琭子觀人之法，而有合於吾儒之論也。麻衣有心","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無相相逐心生，有相無心，心隨相滅，亦是此義。甲乙木主仁，丙丁火主禮，戊巳土主信，庚辛金主義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸水主智，木盛則仁昌，金𧇊則義寡，餘皆象事知器，占事知來。此以五行配五常，定人之器量也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惡曜加而有喜，擬其大器，福星臨而禍發，以表㐫人。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581315135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"修之於身，其德乃真，故日忠孝仁義，德之順也。雖臨諸煞，反爲權星，富貴而驕，自貽厥咎，故日悖傲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100230628835340"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無禮，德之逆焉。善不失善報，爲惡自招殃。此珞琭子深戒之也。擬表二字最有味。惡曜宜加禍而反。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有喜，非大器之君子不能也。葢器識遠大之人，忠孝仁義，慎禮守法，禍焉能干？故曰擬其福星臨宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜而反有禍，乃小人恃命而妄作也。不忠不孝，不仁不義，悖逆無禮，禍焉能逃？故日以表語曰㐫人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㐫其吉，吉人吉其㐫，此之謂也。此承上文操執秉持，骨狀心源而言，君子小人見矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處定求動，尅未尽而難遷，居安問危，可㐫中而卜吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581331519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此珞琭子敎人求名謀動，趨吉避㐫之道也。天命在德，亦當論尅我尅彼。我尅彼則爲權，彼尅此則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲鬼，是尅是財，不剋不食處定求動，尅未𥁞而難遷。行年歲運五行來尅本命爲官，不能遷動，宜守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"静以待之，不衝不尅，則難以發越。居安問危，可㐫中而卜吉者。君子居則觀其象而玩其詞，動則觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其變而玩其占，是以自天祐之，吉無不利。且吉凶祸福之典也，非聖人孰能察於未萌之前哉？若能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"趨吉避㐫，居安慮危，亦庻乎其無咎矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100257489174579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴而忘賤，灾自奢生，迷而不返，禍從惑起。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581347903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"君子見天命而不敢求福於天；小人慢天命而不知正福於己。貴而忘賤，迷而不返，不能居安問危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而轉處定求動，是以灾自奢生，禍從惑起，至於亡身敗家而不悔，不亦深可哀哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊常易舊，變處爲萌。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581364287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福善禍淫，吉㐫異兆。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581380671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"動静爲利害之樞機，智慮乃禍福之門戸，術不可不愼，機不可不察。小人不知天命，不中常道，輕生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"易物，則禍滛，由此而始也。君子得時而動，失時而守，體天行道，畏於輕動，則福善由此而生也。易曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉㐫悔吝，生乎動者也。又曰：吉㐫者，得失之象也。積善之家，必有餘慶；積不善之家，必有餘殃。又曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"知進退存亡之道者，其唯聖人乎！此珞琭子篇終之大戒也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於公明季主，尚無變識之文，景純仲舒，不載比形","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581397055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581397055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100341010333722"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"管公明、司馬季主，郭景純、董仲舒。此四賢者，探天人之奥，原性命之理，窮陰陽象數，知未來吉凶。尚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無變識之文，不載比形之妙。言造化深隠，不易度量。珞琭子不言姓氏，不知何時人。觀其賦中自云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出自蘭野，又稱及於郭景純，疑六朝時人梁昭明，其近之。昭明所居，乃蘭陵之野也。或以爲周靈王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太子子晋則誣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳其徃聖，鍳以前賢，或指事以陳謀，或約文而切理，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581413439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多或少剰，二義難精。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581413439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今者𠫭詳得失，補綴遺蹤，規爲","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581429823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心鑑，永掛清臺。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581429823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"引列終編，千希得一。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581446207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"几論五行，離道者非也，離世法者非也，離人物者，亦非也。或約文而切理，或指事以陳謀，於中神煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"交𠫭，吉㐫互體。是知五行通道，志物難窮。流布其間，豈云小補。珞琭終於此談。言是賦之，作詳徃聖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之遺文，鍳前賢之得失。文博而言約，道妙而義深，顯仁藏用，乃五行三命之指南也。後學者継此而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100344227430440"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"發明之，使瞶者聰，瞽者明，歷百世而無窮，統一性之常在。觀其始末，通神合變、縱横之諭，皆不溺於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"他術戒諭之言，多有合於至道。若珞録者，豈非圓機之士，高尚之流也歟？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100257489207347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100257489272883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通玄子撰集珞琭子賦註：","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581462591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金逢寅午戌方吉，丙戊巳午喜慶德，甲乙寅卯是財","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581462591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神，壬癸潤下爲傷尅，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581462591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚用丁官，辛用丙官，喜丙丁，愛寅午戌，利己午未火旺之地，何禄臨官？辛巳庚午爲貴。假如庚申辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉庚午、辛未、庚寅、辛卯、庚子、辛丑、庚辰、辛巳、庚戌、辛亥，此十二宫命，金家以火爲官，木爲財，火到申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉亥子丑無氣，木到申酉戌子丑氣衰，是財命無氣，貧賤之命也。若生月日時遇旺相，坐午巳寅位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之地，可爲貴命，若不遇火，則非貴命。見壬癸亥子水者，爲背官背禄，不成慶也。得寅、午戌全爲官神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"入局天元戊癸全爲化火官局，地支巳午全爲暗官局，更遇木神補助，並爲上局。柱有壬癸亥申子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰水喜遇戊巳，尅水爲救，又爲印貴，見甲乙，寅卯亥爲財，未爲財庫，無刑害，財庫受實，可作𤼵財斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之背禄，不逢官印貴地，只遇木旺商徒發財之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100257489256499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸四季巳午荣。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581462591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳榮官財，丙丁甲乙曲直皆㐫","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581478975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，庚辛印顯附龍鱗。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581478975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸者，眞水也，喜戊巳、辰戌、丑未、已午方吉。葢壬用己官，癸用戊官，巳午官禄之地，四位之土皆歷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自旺之鄉，四五月上旬，六月中上旬及三月下旬，生官有氣，乃能成慶。水以土爲官位，若遇甲乙亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯未寅木破其官，尅害輕者，則官卑名微，尅害重者，不得其官。得庚辛金神旺相，可爲助救，反主貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火喜辰申亥子官，壬癸官旺土孤窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581495359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳退神甲乙","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581511743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進，金財榮顯禄興隆。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581511743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火見壬癸，葢丙用癸官，丁用壬官，眞造化既濟之道。見亥子爲正官位，丁猪丙鼠爲貴神，辰申亥子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以爲貴，逢土爲六害，無救則貧。再逢甲乙旺相爲救，庚辛巳酉丑爲財禄命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上值寅卯未亥局，甲乙榮官金破禄，庚辛背禄愛丙","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581528127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256063045647"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁，壬癸辰中長享福。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581528127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊巳值亥卯未爲貴，戊寻玉兎己猪頭爲貴。命又旺禄旺官之方，遇庚辛巳酉丑、辛戌，則破禄不貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四月、八月尤重，得丙丁爲救神。且如戊見丙，己見丁，未不能救，謂之偏陰偏陽。若戊見丁，巳見丙方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是救神，或生七月、八月，火，死囚無氣，不能救。見亥子辰爲財庫，主發財。少木一宫，亦可例見。喜巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉丑申，辛庚惡丙丁，炎上火局，愛壬癸亥子爲印，救助，戊巳辰戌丑未爲財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賢達之人明此訣，愚昧之人迷轉盛。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581544511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡論命，先明天干，後論地支，并納音爲九宫。三元分爲天、地、人三才，論五行，四柱遇一陰一陽之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581560895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"道，偏陰偏陽之謂疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳甲乙木格停，生旺官貴帝王臨。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581560895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊巳若逢支干木氣旺相，或見己亥癸亥眞長生官星，主極品貴。生月再旺無刑衝，富貴雙全看輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100341010366490"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"重之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸戊巳土旺方，大材分瑞上格詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581577279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸見戊巳，辰戌丑未土，巳午月生土，旺相爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛冬至一陽生，丙丁生氣福如林。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581593663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛生人，冬至後一陽生火有煖氣，木漸到旺，能生丙丁之火，爲官爲禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子夏生一陰長，亥子壬癸偏官鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581610047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此明水火有功，既濟之象。如夏氣淺則發早，夏至一陰長，水漸旺，故官禄生旺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲生人在寅月，建禄不富無差别。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581626431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六甲生人，正月建丙寅，是生月帶禄，爲尅妻絕嗣，貧賤之命。甲以己爲妻，月辛爲官星，爲子，皆絕於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅謂之金絶土囚之地，禄馬妻子皆絕，不爲貴氣。若用丙寅爲食神有氣，須是甲人見，庚申乙人見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100344227463208"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛或酉戌，却在七煞旺鬼之地，得寅生火鬼，逢伏化官爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙人辛多酉月生，鬼旺身衰帶疾侵。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581642815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙人見辛，爲干頭見鬼，名爲七煞。乙人見酉，身居白虎無氣之地，又遇七煞尅身，豈無疾患？甲人見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚與同其人若不帶疾須壽夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詞舘學堂主科名，若無官貴定虚名。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581659199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命逢詞舘、學堂，詞舘是官禄長生之地，學堂是本主長生之地，有官貴者，有科名，作貴命看，無官貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則虛名之人，前文有印甲見癸亥子是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁星若也逢官位，定是神童腹。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581675583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隱貴","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581691967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"魁星者，乃甲辰旬中，至癸丑十日是也。若遇本命官星，位逢官貴學堂，則應神童科。譬之癸丑人見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申同在甲辰一旬是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100344227479592"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官，逢處人欽敬。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581691967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天馬財庫爲貴命，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581708351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命犯臨官，人多欽重。天馬爲妻財論之，如甲見己，爲妻爲財，辰爲財庫，可作發財顯逹命看。若妻臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺相二運，或太岁再遇，多主婚姻、出入、修造之事。假如甲午人，己土爲妻爲馬，運到申酉戌午爲人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"元到西方火絶死之地，巳土自敗，有金旺土爲財禄，人元財皆無氣。又如丙午生，運至西方，丙見癸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲官癸水敗，西方是官衰。丙以辛爲馬爲財，酉戌有辛金，金爲丙財旺。辛爲馬，到酉建馬本畏衝不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衝掩藏，亦作發財命斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命犯貴地得亨通，命衰遇旺福不迎。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581708351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命坐貴地，行向禄向財運，可言榮顯。元命逢官貴旺相運雖㐫，未必爲灾。如壬癸生人，行巳午未運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"可發北人，運至南方貿易，獲其厚利。命遇休囚，無官貴，運行貴地，不能成慶。命旺原有官星在命運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"并背禄太歲衝害，有官休官行主本長生運，亦罷官失職，與生地休囚者，如甲乙人見亥，葢官病地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100257489289267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"故言休囚生地相逢，亦言官星病絶，主爲官之人，宜退身避位。若二運太歲併臨，䘮吊丘墓俠煞，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"哭声裸形，俠煞自主。嗚呼！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八孤五墓爲僧道，破祖飄蓬孤獨人。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581724735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假甲子旬中，戌亥爲空亡，爲六虚。乾屬亥成戌，南行三位是未，未，東行三位是辰，辰北行三位是丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑西行三位是戌，辰戌、丑、未四位爲孤寡五墓，多爲破祖孤獨飄蓬之人。九流之命，三元尅害爲孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"單命尅害若輕入舍命，如遇真孤神尅妻害子之命，通玄子解非珞琭本眞，乃自撰集，與徐子平同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100230628868108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100341010399258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明通賦：","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581741119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"東海徐子平撰。易水萬育吾解。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極判爲天地，一氣分爲陰陽，流出五行，化生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581741119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲人禀命，貧富貴賤由之，術士知機，吉㐫禍福定矣。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581757503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此原造化之始。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡看命以日干爲主，統三元而配合八字干支。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581773887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天有四時，造化萬物；屋有四柱，各立規模；命有四柱，註定榮枯。論者専以日辰天干爲命元之主支。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲地元禄支内所藏者爲人元壽八字，即四柱天干地支共八字也。繼善扁云：四柱排定，三才次分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"专以日干天元配合，八字干支是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論運者，以月支爲首，分四時而提起，五行消長。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581790271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大運以月支起，故月爲提綱。看月支節氣淺深，四時得何節，如春木、夏火、秋金、冬水、季土、初氣、中氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256063111183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"消長不同，所行之運，或順或逆，或旺或衰，與八字或助或泄，或尅或生者，本乎此。先言日干，次言月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"支舉其所要者以示人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向官旺以成功，入格局而致貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581806655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印財食爲吉，平定","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581823039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遂良；煞傷梟敗爲㐫，轉用爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581823039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行臨官帝旺，在四柱，爲本宫成功之地，入格局則貴，破格局則賤。如官印、財食，本是吉神，須無傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尅衝刑破敗，則爲平定遂良，乃入格也。煞傷梟敗，本爲㐫煞，若有制伏，去留合化，是謂轉用爲福，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"入格也。觀下取用諸格局，其喜忌自可見矣。四吉四㐫，格局之最重者，故首言之。賦云：日主最宜健。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺用神不可損傷是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全备藏蓄於辰戌丑未，長生鎭居於己亥寅申。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581839423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581855807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則成敗相逆，卯酉乃出入交互，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581855807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256063094799"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言十二支包藏十干，各有生死成敗出入交互。獨步云：辰戌丑未四庫之局，寅申己亥四生之局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子午卯酉四敗之局喜忌篇云：財官印綬全备，藏蓄於四季之中；官星財氣長生，鎭居於寅申己亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是也。或以子午爲天地之基柱，卯酉爲日月之門户，是指其地而遺其理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支干有不見之形，無中取有，節氣存有餘之數，混處","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581855807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求分，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581855807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此總言造化之妙，支干不見之形，節氣有餘之數，即上十二支中所包藏人元乃無中取有混處求。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"分如遥巳拱夹等格。是以天干而取地支之物，非無中取有而何？如子初三刻，分屬壬水，丑初三刻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"分屬癸水，寅初三刻，分屬艮土。是節氣藏於一字，而各有所主，非混處求分而何？賦云：無合有合後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"學難知得一分三，前賢不載。継善篇云：見不見之形，無時不有是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡相交，却喜化惡崇善；吉㐫混雜，至怕害吉添㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581855807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100257489305651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此下轉言看命之法，本上文取有求分而言。如甲日見丙丁背禄，爲惡爲㐫；見戊巳財星，爲善爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而丙丁化木助財，是謂化惡崇善；怕乙木尅害財星，是謂害吉添㐫。觀下文財印交差，喜官煞化之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官煞混雜，喜印綬化之，無印喜財馬資化之，無財印喜羊刃合之，或食神傷官制之，又如制煞受破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞制不住，印化見財，破化爲㐫，之類皆是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故得局朝元，非富則貴；犯垣破局，非夭則貧，","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581872191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"局者，三合四雜正局之宫，如亥卯未木局、辰戌丑未土局之類。甲乙見亥卯未爲本局，丙丁見亥卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未爲印局，戊巳見亥卯未爲官局，庚辛見亥卯未爲財局，壬癸見亥卯未爲傷局之類。元即本元垣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"廟如子宫癸朝元，丑未已土朝元之類。凡元垣得之，或用爲命元則壽，爲官印則貴，爲財則富，爲背。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禄生財益富，但得其一，無衝刑尅破者，功名富貴，反之則否。犯垣如子貴，忌丑未尅破，午衝破、卯刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"破之類，一子二午，破盡一半，得半福。破局如申子辰忌寅午戌衝破之類，大凶。若用星虚，成飛天禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100344227495976"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬格反貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581872191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581888575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得失均𠔥，進退仍復。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581904959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得朝犯破，此造化之有得有失，有進有退，此得則彼失，強進則弱退，中間均兼仍復，變化難測非精。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"察詳辨不能分也。如甲朝垣於寅，忌申衝破，若有二寅一申、二甲一庚，亦無害，以甲有力而進也。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅被申衝，有亥可救，亥字堅盛爲福。卜全亥或受戊尅巳衝則敗。若亥字多，不怕，亦強而進也。進退","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相仍，一成一敗，只看歳運助起何邉，爲福爲禍可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞相絆，輕重較量。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581921343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神煞凡財官、印食，傷煞刃敗，皆是。中間喜忌不同，愛憎互異，如下諸格所論是也。須輕重較量。何者？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"當時而重爲用，何者，失令而輕不用，重者留之，輕者去之。此與上二句總言其理當如此。詳較考珞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"琭賦須要明其神煞輕重較量，身尅煞而尚輕，煞尅身而尤重，是指諸吉㐫神煞也。徐子平專以官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100341010432026"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印禄馬貴賤之别名解之。如甲申丙寅，乙卯辛巳，乙用庚爲官，辛爲煞，庚官在申，得寅衝去丙合辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞，乙木生旺，故貴。甲寅、丁卯、癸丑、丁巳，是身尅煞，身弱財旺，力不能任其財官，故夭。如乙丑、辛巳、丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己巳酉身旺財亦旺，可任其財，所以止富。如甲子、辛未、乙卯、甲申，乙日用庚官，以辛爲煞，庚在申内。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六月生，官旺煞衰，此是正官得位，七煞失所，又喜身旺，變鬼爲官，故貴。辛丑、庚寅、乙巳、甲申，官衰煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"盛乙木無力，化官爲煞，一生嗜酒落魄，至乙酉運第五年丙申歳八月十九日死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内有雜氣，財官相兼，偏正兩印，同宫禄馬，號爲内外","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581937727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581937727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此正指神煞相絆，乃八字中有財、有官，有偏正二印，或同宫，或異位，或包藏，或透出相絆，難論吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"要輕重較量用之。故日内有三奇，歌曰：寅午戌酉是三奇，兎蛇隨侯不可移。己酉丑中逢子妙，馬侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見猪好光輝。辰巳子逢即奇處，午亥見寅是貴墀，猪來克兔馬當歡。寅酉見巳喜相宜，猪逐馬兒蛇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386069610546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"後援水鼠未人火竃池。又曰：神禄飛來就馬騎，资財官職兩相宜。旺中更得本元助，上格榮華第一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"奇如己丑、丁卯、壬午癸卯，壬用己爲官，丁爲財，丁巳歸祿於午，是此格也，故主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真官時遇命強，早受金紫之封；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581954111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此月令正官格也。以下詳言格局，如戊申、甲寅、己丑丙寅，翁仲益進士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"良馬月乘時健，末遷銀青之職。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581954111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此月令正財格也。財官二格，官當取貴，財當取富，今俱以貴言，是獨日干取得月内支干之財，無所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衝尅者言之，其福與正官同。詩云：日千愛取月支財，金玉家藏看積堆。更看天干財馬貴，紛紛金帛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自天來是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月印附日，無財氣，爲黄榜招賢；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581970495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此月令正印格也。喜忌篇云：月生日干無天財，乃印綬之名。又云：印綬生月歳時忌，見財星運入財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100376095621160"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鄉，却宜退身避職，印綬畏財，須天干歲時無財方取。又月印難得十全。如甲日亥月透出癸字變偏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲正，方爲十全，主招恩𠖥遇貴，又得祖父之財，然亦不免先遭耻辱。或偏生以賤至貴，以微至富，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"婢爲婦，以吏爲官，以卒補將，皆偏印之所致也。偏正俱有，又有淺灾，或重拜父母，或鲁俗相雜，或遍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"房寄養，或偏生正養，或正生偏養，又忌比肩争寵分恩。羊刃多，或合去，或印微，遇而不遇，雖有荐舉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亦不能拔萃超羣。賦云：印旺官生，必掌鈞衡之任是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日禄歸時，没官星，號青雲得路。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581970495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此日歸禄時格也。大抵印綬第一，最好行傷个官、食神、財運亦發，忌官刑衝羊刃，以上眞官、眞財、眞印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眞禄皆十干天地陰陽正氣，生尅至理，惟月分得之，無破，在經文有破壞者，隨輕重言之，時得發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"較晩，然皆自致，可以創業垂統。歸禄一格，只喜時上見之。若月支重見，名爲建禄不富，月单見時上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"却喜財食見官。語别格论。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100376095555624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令七煞，而煞身俱强，當爲黑頭宰相；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581986879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此月令七煞格也。大抵月令煞要身煞兩強，方主大貴。若身強煞淺，須則以生，煞強身弱，須印以取。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或羊刃合之，皆爲貴命。若印合與制星相攻，身弱必夭，不然殘疾。如癸卯、乙卯、己巳、乙丑、癸卯、丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己壬寅、甲辰、壬寅、乙巳、庚寅、丙子，俱身強煞旺有制，所以大貴。喜忌篇云：五行遇月支，偏官岁時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中，亦宜制伏，所以救賦之偏也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上偏財而財命並旺，須出白屋公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407581986879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此時上偏財格，也只一位爲吉，見合不爲福，忌比肩、兄弟争奪，刑衝尅破。如丙戌、戊戌、戊子、壬子、戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尅癸爲正財，重有子字，壬字爲偏財透露。又如丁亥、戊申、壬申、丙午，雖年有丁火，喜有合制，又陰火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"能奪陽火權，故貴喜忌篇云：時上偏財，别官忌見，所以補賦未俻之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建禄坐禄，或歸禄遇財官印綬，富貴長年。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582003263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386732277798"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"建禄以月言，坐禄以日言，歸禄以時言。此建禄格本身健旺，故獨遇財則富，獨遇官則貴，獨遇印則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"秀，以其干旺，又主長命，安享福禄。若三者兼有亦妙。如丁亥、己酉、壬午、辛亥，是日禄歸時，午中亦有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官星却得酉月爲印，合格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月刃日刃，及時刃逢官煞榮神，功名葢世。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582019647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此三刃格，要官盖煞绶相制化榮神，印綬異名。有官煞無印，有煞無官，俱得有印化煞尤佳只怕覊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"絆。如有官不可見傷，有印不可見財，有煞不可見食傷壓之，或制去合去，皆不成正格，如壬申、壬子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊午、乙卯日刃有乙卯制伏；丙戌、癸巳、戊午、丁巳日刃有印綬變化，故皆貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令專制七煞，身健鷹揚；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582036031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇云：若乃時逢七煞，見之未必爲㐫；月制干強，其煞反爲權印。即解此義也。一云：時上偏官通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月氣主旺，鷹揚，與此少異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100376095588392"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運元生發三財，命強豹變。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582036031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"運元月令也。三財禄命身也。此是日干背禄，即傷食格也。喜逢財星。如甲日逢己午月，須干頭透出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊字丑戌未日時，日主健旺，行東方運，必然大發財禄，白手成家。一云：月中正禄會财元，身強豹變。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與此少異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年見正禄正印、正財無破，必承祖蔭傳芳；","logicSentenceId":"7
