577343407582052415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"重在無破有破，不以此論年爲祖宗，故云云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日坐眞官眞貴、眞印有成，號曰福神治世；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582052415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"重在有成，有成卽無破，眞即正義。若𠫭之以偏，爲所假借，非眞正也。如丙子、丁亥、辛巳、庚午等日，僞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眞官丁酉、癸巳、癸卯、丁亥等日爲眞貴。甲子、乙亥時，日爲眞印，柱中無破，有助爲福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月内偏財，而無敗無煞，富出人間。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582052415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386732326950"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此月令偏財格，與時上偏財大同，怕比刼相尅，七煞泄氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日下正馬，而有助有生，名揚天下；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582068799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃甲午戊于等日，甲戊、乙丑等日，則偏與目坐眞貴格同論，有助是别支財，有生是别支食傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身淺坐煞，運行身旺之鄉，發財發福；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582068799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"坐煞乃甲申、乙酉等日，柱中無土爲身，清行寅卯運，大發財禄。此格喜印綬，忌正官、食神，犯之非身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"清，下等命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨主臨官，運至主貴之地，加職加封。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582068799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"獨主臨官，乃丁巳、癸亥等日，又遇貴人衝官星爲贵，岁運逢己亥，重併者，倍加封職。或以日遇官星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"行運再遇官地，爲觧亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神生旺，無印綬刑衝，乃母食子禄；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582085183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100292079550518"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此食神格也。如戊辰、丁巳、壬辰甲辰，貴而且夀，下末丙午、甲午丙寅，食神化作脫局，丁傷，辛官飛來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不得故貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主本臨官没官星煞敗，爲弟襲兄班；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582085183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃丁巳癸亥日，得寅戌月類也，無官煞比肩兄弟，本身自旺，必得高長之班，興家立業。何者丁之禄？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"在午，癸之禄在子，癸亥爲水，正旺之鄉，乃壬家之禄也。丁巳爲火，臨官之地，乃丙家之祿也。得此格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者，謂丁癸乃丙壬之弟，而己亥爲丙壬之禄位，故曰弟就兄班，必因兄有爲高兄一班。又丙午壬子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日亦是純粹，尤貴，駁雜者不入格。若有兄弟比肩，干支駁雜，爲兄星填實，便爲下矣。或官星填實，兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"弟比肩争差，身無容處，又作㐫断。若官星不實，單露天干，雖分星擘禄，亦可再成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒食本官臨官旺，乃侍臣叨禄之名；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582085183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚子見戊子歲月偏印在我本宫之上，名倒食，乃我之君父也，是偏印所坐與日干同宫，临於官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386069626930"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺之地，則受我命，生我福气。侍臣叨禄，言近君之寵也。如庚子、戊子、庚子、丙子，是此格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎生元命，無財星，爲赤子承恩之宠。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582085183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此庚寅、辛卯、甲申、乙酉等日，皆本主天元，自坐絶地，爲胎生之宫，即胞胎格也。其生甚微，所以喜印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"綬怕財尅，主少年招受皇恩，大槩與印格同論，如乙酉、乙酉、乙酉、甲申，是此格也。喜忌篇云云同義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲月正官，七煞混淆人下賤；時日獨強專制，職重權","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582101567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582101567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月時七煞，正官雜亂病交侵；岁運衝開合去官清","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582117951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582117951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶嫌过制，最忌争強。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582134335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇云：四柱純煞有制，定居一品之尊，畧見一位正官，官煞混雜，反贱類有去官留煞，亦有去煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"留官又云：四柱煞旺，運純身旺，爲官清貴。又云：月令雖逢建禄，切忌會煞爲㐫，官星七煞交差却有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合煞爲貴是也。此二格各有所主。岁月正官，以官爲主，无煞混之；月時七煞，以煞爲主，嫌官亂之。時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386732359718"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日獨強专制，歲運衝開合去，互文見義也。过制則七煞不顯，争強則難以去留，其理當細詳之。如壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子甲辰巳卯壬申月時，正官日下卯爲七煞，得申内庚金，合卯中乙木之煞，爲貴，又如張侍郎八字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日以庚爲正官，申内庚金，近七月生，庚旺辛衰，六月丁火旺，爲去煞留官，故貴。又如丙午、丙申、甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅丁卯丙丁雖多，不敵月令之煞，又行官旺運，身旺變鬼爲官，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元無氣，却宜中下興隆；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582150719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此印綬格也，如甲乙生於冬月，天元無氣，地支有亥子水生木，爲興隆之類。又如丁亥、丁丑等日，丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火無氣，又有壬癸來尅，亥子得之爲黨，反能生出甲木，爲地支興隆，喜土來尅財，丑中得之爲財，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"利之類。古人論中下，以日時支言，如日干月令無氣，若所坐之支及時得地，亦爲成實之命。若無氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而日時又在衰敗之鄉，則終身偃蹇可知矣。喜忌篇云：凡見天元太弱，内有弱處復生，是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年本偏官，須忌始終尅害。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582150719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100376095637544"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此歲德格也。如甲日逢庚申，太歲爲年上偏官，一名元神，一名孤辰，其煞最重，終身不可除去，故主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"始終尅害，尅害非専指祖父，六親，本身亦在其中矣。如丁巳、丁未、辛巳壬辰，喜一壬合二丁爲制乙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯丙子己卯丁卯，喜丁丙化去三乙，皆主貴，但尅害終不能免。或云七煞多根，切忌始終尅害，亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃極喜偏官，削平禍亂；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582167103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此羊刃格也。大抵羊刃忌財，以刃破財，財生煞，煞尅身，及刑衝三合、六合，喜煞制伏而煞自制者，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"作㐫斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神只宜制伏，降肅奸雄。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582167103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此金神格也。大抵金神不畏过制，只忌破制與失制歲運同。甲己日得此三時，惟甲日得之爲正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽德陰貴，旺則榮顯而弱可保名；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582183487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽德、天月二德及日德，陰貴、天乙貴神及日貴格也。弱雖不如強，亦可自守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100376095670312"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天罡地魁，衰則貧寒而強當絕世。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582183487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"即罡魁格也，喜強惡衰，忌財官要併踏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官庫財庫，衝開則榮封爵禄，塞閉則貧乏貲財。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582199871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此雜氣財官格也。如甲見丑爲官庫，見辰為財庫，見未僞本庫，見戌爲食庫，官爲上，財次之，本庫又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"次之。若庫在年月之中，管事太早，難發少年。喜在日下及時之中，雖晩發，不失爲富貴，造化要見衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑破害以開局論，怕有星閉塞。如丁用辰爲官库，或戊字僣之，或戊辰壓之，是閉塞也。如此則丁不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"能官須柱有甲戌，或歲遇之，方吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官正官傷𥁞則獨握權高，半殘則必遭蹇難。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582216255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此傷官格也。半殘言傷不𥁞。喜忌篇云：四柱傷官，運入官鄉，必破是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月倒衝，官禄無填無絆，而禄馬飛來；","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582232639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100230628917260"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此飛天禄馬格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地制合，煞神不过不失，而名利驟發。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582232639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天地制合煞神，乃天干地支，或是食神制煞，或是羊刃合煞，但制合不宜太过。如一煞二食，二羊刃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則過而失也。身煞兩停，制合不過，煞乃㐫神，故主驟發。喜忌篇云：偏官制伏太过，乃是貧儒見不可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"过也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟官印最宜相㑹，德政加封。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582249023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此官印格也。如甲日得辛爲官，又有癸爲印，或地支有酉子字，皆是官印於身，二尅一生，陰陽配合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而又自相生焉。故主爲相有王佐之才，爲将有運籌之智，爲守幸著循良之政，要本身與官甲相等。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃極品貴也。否則随力量升降輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有禄馬極喜同居，官能稱職。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582265407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386732343334"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此財官格也。如甲日見己丑、己酉及壬午、癸巳等日之類，是禄馬同居，與上官印相會，皆爲三奇格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也須要木身力旺，或遇時氣，可稱此格。禄身強弱不等，降下論之，身弱難壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬逢煞則發，逢合則晦，逢財則灾，破合去財亦發。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582281791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此總論印綬，喜忌逢煞，謂之印頼煞生，功名顯達。若遇偏財合去，正財尅去，皆主灾晦。柱中日干健。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺，或有比肩破合去財，則印煞可以雙收，亦主發逹，但不清也。詩云：忽逢甲巳加金局，丙火尋當便。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"可嗟運行旺火生身地，功名何處不光華。是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建禄遇官則貴，遇財則富，遇印則秀，敗財破印尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582298175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"建祿則身旺，故用官、用印、用財皆吉。有敗財。羊刃比肩則身太旺，皆足以刼我之財，分我之官，奪我。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之印建禄，尤喜印與財，故見敗財破印，則偏枯，不成造化，財印俱見混雜，不富不秀，無成之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞兩停，喜者存之，憎者去之。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582314559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武能去正留偏，化官","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582330943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256063160335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲煞；文能去偏留正，化煞爲官。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582330943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運逢身旺，必加封。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582347327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582363711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印交差。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582363711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲其進也，忌其退也。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582380095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴能見義忘利，取印捨","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582396479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財，富則見利忘義，取財捨印，歲遇命强而進爵。","logicSentenceId":"7577343407582396479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官煞不可並用，財印難以交留，故喜憎存棄。或去煞留官，或去官留煞，欲忌進退，或取印捨財，或捨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財取印，各從其有力而重者用之。文武富貴，亦推言其類，未必𥁞然。四格皆以身旺命強爲主。歲運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生扶爲妙。通融論之，身與財旺力停，得官煞來亦可，化則助印，爲福益厚。身弱無官煞乗化，不惟不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"勝官煞而財印交差，身制不護，無可爲倚，必定貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干背禄，喜見財豐。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440606762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敗逢比肩逐馬，官煞俱有，猶如","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440623146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去煞留官，印助身強，必定收功拜職。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440623146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言傷官格也。喜忌篇云：十干背禄，岁時喜見财星，運至比肩，號曰皆背逐馬是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100230628933644"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行食神，許乗馬盛，禍生正印梟神，官煞一來，誤致","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440639530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反賢敗德；梟神印旺，立見破敗傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440639530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言食神格也。此因上文背禄逐馬，窮極將官煞而轉爲福，故此章言因財致富，被官煞助印爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而反大壞。互文見義，不可不詳察之。葢食神喜財怕梟，官煞生印，則梟愈旺傷喜見印，食怕見印，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"並言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日午月，勿作刃看；時歲火多，轉爲印綬；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440655914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此羊刃與印同，官火多則印強，故能轉弱從強。然刃助身強，又得印助，則文理高致，可以隠惡而揚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"善。若有己字透出巳以刃斷，印刃俱有，其人不免性毒。有好運來成功，運退刃來，或被財衝起亦㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜正官制中爲妙。如癸亥、戊午、戊午、戊午，此命正合此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日丑時，非爲背禄；支干金旺，反作资財；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440655914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386732376102"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時，當時指月令也。丙日生逢丑月，丑中己土，傷官背禄，主貧。得干支庚辛金氣旺盛，土能生金，却爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財斷須丙日健，或寅午戌火局亦旺，可在其財。時支是丑，支中己酉合庚辛透出丙火生旺者，亦合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此格如丙日本身自旺，單見丑月，無庚辛透露，及己酉丑局，眞背禄矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官坐刃頭終被刑；貴壓三刑，須執政；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440655914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲日見辛卯月，及辛卯時，官不得令，反被卯中丁火傷尅，歲運又見，定然遭刑。若官煞制伏得道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖以貴論，遇刃年終㐫，是羊刃最壞造化也。貴壓三刑，乃命中犯三刑，雖㐫，若得一個天乙貴人，正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"照生旺得時，反主掌典刑政，可專征伐。貴人不生旺者，亦可作從政斷，是貴神最爲吉煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"德葢七煞，必是安禪之士；花迎六合，豈非淫荡之人。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440655914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"德即天月德，乃慈善神也。七煞乃孤辰煞也。德葢七煞，主人有道德，因道德而生富貴。花即桃花煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃淫蕩煞也，六合乃多情煞也。花迎六合，主好色，歌唱，大非端士。又如戊子生人見癸丑之類，乃支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256063176719"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"干交合，爲滚浪桃花，四柱子午卯酉，爲遍野桃花，主男不媒而婚，女不媒而嫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤寡雙全，帶官印，當膺住持；無則只爲道行，","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440672298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孤辰寡宿，二煞怕雙逢叠見，只一位，不論带官印在上，雖爲僧道，亦貴。如無只平常僧道而已。如甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌、戊辰、庚辰、丙子、甲戌、戊辰、庚辰、丁丑，俱是清高長老之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"控邀隔角逢生旺，必過房舍；絶則終守𩹌孀；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440672298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"控神、邀神，是孤寡煞也。假令寅卯辰人見巳辰人，謂之控神煞，又謂之邀神煞，見丑寅人，謂之窺神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞，又謂之迫神煞，餘倣此。更值歲運不和，三元刑戰，爲㐫尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吞䧟全排，家人消散；空亡徧見，親屬離傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440672298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吞䧟、空亡二煞，乃尅害孤寡之辰也，須全排遍見，方如經斷。若食遇吞陷、財食、貴禄等格，見空亡，尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲不𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100376095703080"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財印雙傷，斷其必無上下；官煞俱去，知其少失爺娘。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440688682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此二节専論骨肉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純耗純刃交差，牛羊類斷；純陰純陽排尅，猪狗徒看。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440705066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大耗羊刃，乃神煞之最惡者，孤陰孤陽，乃干支之不調者。耗刃攢聚，交至四柱上，主賤之極，作牛羊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之類斷之，天干皆是一偏，地支衝刑破害，必是無正性之人，作猪狗之徒論之。若驛馬六害、華葢、刼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞亡神年月等煞，見偏陰偏陽，尤㐫。如甲子庚午，甲子庚午，甲用辛爲官，庚煞透出，又不得令甲用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日爲財發禄，午月子午對衝，財又不成，作不仁不義斷之。又如甲午、甲戌、甲午、甲子，三甲並見用官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官不顯，財印俱衝，並無所托，當是貪圖無厭，不認六親，薄情背禮之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰受衆梟，乃是寄食長工；絶逢重食，宜作屠行牙儈。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440721450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"梟與食相反，故並舉之，其身嫌衰絶，一也。衰而逢梟，難作偏印；絕而逢食，難作壽星，故皆不吉寄食。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100292079632438"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"長工因梟，難得飽食；屠行牙儈因食，雖得飽而賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若也純官純煞，純馬純財，身旺無雜，則官居極品；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440737834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命以純粹不雜爲上，偏枯混乱爲下。且如甲日以辛爲官，柱中只有酉辛字，是謂純官，以庚爲煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中只有申庚字，是謂純煞，以正財爲馬，柱中只有丑未已字；以偏財爲財，柱中只有辰戌戊字，謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之純馬純財值身旺，爲大富貴格。建禄得格，出門便是富足。日下次之，時下又次之。建禄遇正官，第","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一、正財次之，惟煞壽不永。若羊刃之月，純煞第一財格，則防横事。癸卯、乙卯、己巳、乙丑，此命純煞，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"能𥁞善，亦貴爲極品。又如甲戌、丁卯、己巳、乙亥，官煞混雜，頼甲、己合化爲貴，因雜化力過，不得善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全印全衝、全制全食，命強無破，則禄受干鍾。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440737834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"全甲如甲日見子癸壬亥，或正或偏，無所駁雜。全衝，如地支純亥、純巳、純子、純午之類，衝出禄馬，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅申己亥，子午卯酉、辰戌丑未，𣅜是全制。如甲日見丁字或午字傷𥁞，官星虚空，生出土來爲財全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100292079599670"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"食如甲見丙，柱中純寅之類，須得日主生旺，正庫臨官月日時者，皆貴人也。如己未、乙亥、丙寅、辛卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此全印剥雜，又有辛財尅刑運，行身旺則貴顯，行身衰則刑䧟。如辛亥、己亥、辛亥、己亥，四柱純亥衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出巳中，丙戊全衝爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干太旺無依，若不爲僧，固宜爲道；天元羸弱無輔，","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440754218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不爲技，則當爲巫。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440754218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言太过不及，皆不爲吉也。太過則財官死絶，所以主孤；不及則財官難任，所以主藝。見造化貴中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"和也。若有依有輔，則不可以是論。喜忌篇云：柱中官星太旺，天元羸弱之名，日干旺甚無依若不爲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"僧即道：是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱有生必發，忌財馬以相傷；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440770602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此身弱用印，忌財傷印，爲貪財坏印之說，須分財印輕重言之。喜忌篇云：日干無氣，時逢羊刃，不爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386732392486"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㐫羊刃所以刼財，柱中財多身弱，故羊刃不忌，須並論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神逢枭則夭，喜財星而生救。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440770602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此食神怕梟，要財制，梟爲用神，有救，須分財梟輕重言之，印則忌財，食則要財，義各有所當也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子日逢子，時，没庚辛申酉丑午，謂之禄馬飛來。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440786986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此子遥巳格也，喜忌篇文義同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申時逢戊日，無甲丙卯寅午丁，名曰食神明旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440803370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此専食合禄格也。喜忌篇云：庚申時逢戊日名食神，干旺之方，月犯甲丙卯寅，此乃遇而不遇是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚壬子衝午禄，切忌丙丁；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440819754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此正衝禄馬格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛癸丑合己官，須嫌子巳；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440819754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100376095735848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此丑遥巳格也。喜忌篇云：辛癸日多逢丑地，不喜官星。歲時逢子巳二宫，虛名虛利是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午、丁巳准此，最忌刑衝；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440819754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此倒衝禄馬格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子癸亥例同，亦防填實。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440819754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上正衝、倒衝、遥合通融，互文見義。舉丙丁與己忌填實也，舉子忌刑衝也，如丙子庚寅、丙午癸巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚寅、壬午、丙午、戊戌二命，喜寅、午、戌全。如辛酉、癸巳、丁巳、乙巳、癸卯、丁巳、丁巳、乙巳二命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜巳字多，不論有合無合皆吉，惟忌辰字絆住，則不能衝。却喜己酉丑，全是正衝格也。喜忌篇云：若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逢傷官、月建，如㐫處，未必爲卤。内有正倒禄飛忌官星，亦嫌覊絆是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日而無午字，得戊子時，辛合丙官爲貴；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440836138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此六陰朝陽格也。如戊辰、辛酉、辛丑、戊子、戊辰、辛酉、辛酉、戊子、乙丑、庚辰、辛酉、戊子，是此格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100230628982796"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇云：六辛日時逢戊子，嫌午位運喜西方。是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日而無干土，得甲寅時，寅刑巳格尤奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440836138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此刑合格也。此格主性氣剛而見快太察。如乙未、甲申、癸酉甲寅，嫌申中庚傷甲木，寅申對衝，故雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴而减分數，利厚名低。喜忌篇云：六癸日時逢寅位，歳月怕己、戊二方是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸無丙火，戊巳庚申，時合一己之財官；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440852522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此専印合禄格也，與専食同看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬有子午卯酉正氣，柱兼四季之土禄；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440852522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬日爲主，既無官煞，却得子午卯酉爲四正，能合出辰戌丑未爲官禄，不須四正俱會，但得四字全","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日同上，土曜莫侵，得之者利害交併，官高身病；遇","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440852522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100376095768616"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之者刑惠確實，職重家貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440852522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸日爲主，却嫌土禄，見子午卯酉，與壬日同，吉㐫相伴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲曲直，丙炎上，官高尅妻而不富；戊從革，庚潤下，職","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440868906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重嗣少而自貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440868906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲見亥卯未，曰曲直，丙見寅午戌，曰炎上，戊見己酉丑，日從革，庚見申子辰，曰潤下。甲丙見木火局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則太旺，能三合义出官局，故主官高。然有羊刃刼財，故尅戊庚。見金水局則脫氣，能三合义出官局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"故主職重。然柱中原無官煞，故少子。要之，此四格皆偏黨，所以福禄不全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身犯休囚之地併衝，官貴何嗟；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440885290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛亥日既無官煞，身又不旺，豈不惆悵？不亥字多，亦能勾出知巳中官印爲貴，故曰何嗟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自专官旺之支，同釣禄子猶貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440885290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100292079665206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此即丁巳、癸亥、丙午、壬子等日，自坐臨官帝旺之官，支神多能衝出對官官禄，與上文義同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰木獨遇子，時没官星；乙鎮鼠窠最貴；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440901674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此六乙䑕貴格也，喜忌篇文義同。如甲寅、戊辰、乙亥、丙子，四柱别無他格，動揺丙子亦不動揺，安然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲貴。經云：用神不可動摇是也。如甲寅、癸酉、乙亥、丙子，月令偏官傷身，頼日下印旺，亦不失爲衣禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛亥、甲午、乙亥、丙子，此命貴被午破，兩亥自刑，本身既在死地，又見自刑，兩無所依，故主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽水叠逢辰，位無衝尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440901674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬騎龍背非常；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440918058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此壬騎龍背格也，喜忌篇文義同。如壬辰、甲辰、壬辰、壬寅，壬用己爲正官，丁爲正財，辰字多衝出戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中官庫虚合午中財官，寅午戊三合火局，壬人得之爲貴。如壬寅、壬寅、壬辰、壬寅，壬人見丙火生在。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅已是財丁，又寅字多合起午戌財官，故利勝於名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日全逢潤下，忌壬癸巳午之方；時遇子申，其福藏","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440918058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100346412433444"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"半。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440918058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此井欄义格也，喜忌篇文義同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合官合財作公卿，防休囚尅害之辱；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440934442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合官如乙日見庚之例，合則如甲日見己之例，乃十干變化之道也。賦云：化之眞者，名公巨卿化之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假者孤兒異姓，乙庚化金，見水地則休囚，見火地則尅害。凡帶合，或獨旺不肯自就，或合中見衝破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或一邉破尅，皆合不成。或化在休囚死絕之地，失誤與合，必然陷滯不利，是化之假也。如巳見甲見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1828","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳未爲得地，巳旺庫也。丙見辛，見辛卯，爲失地，丙火敗於卯也。戊與癸合，見戊午爲得地，戊癸化火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1829","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午爲火旺之地，故也，亦須癸水先得地，方合得中。若失地不得時，則損壽。葢化爲貴旺，身弱不能勝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1830","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"縱貴亦失。又丙與辛合，見辛未，陽火氣弱於未，多夭折，或因色傷，柱有壬尅丙，或壬居申上，自生對。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1831","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衝寅宫，火生之地，夭折無疑。亦有貪合忘官。如丁日見二三壬字，丁獨壬衆，一人不能勝，衆乃汗合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1832","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100376095785000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之士，無所卓立，豈能成功？丁有力，僅得半吉。又如甲與己合，甲木無通氣之宫，己土有正義之位，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合而失其正，亦同上論。若甲己兩皆得位，貴顯高極。經云：甲己木盛於土鄉，𤼵揚仁義佐明君。丙辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合丙旺辛生，鎭守威權之職。乙庚入金局，兼木，自𦕑文仁武義𩀱全。戊癸得火旺，更水，獨旺禮律智","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"勇俱备。丁壬水火既濟兮，魚水和同；陰陽干支相合兮君臣慶㑹。聴鳯鳴於高岗，必膺揚於疆場。是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。如甲辰、戊辰、己巳、辛未，已日得甲爲正官，三月通氣，引於未上，兼爲正印，故主極貴。如戊申、庚申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1838","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥戊午癸生七月，印旺天德之地，合戊爲官，引於午時火旺之地，又能資戊土之官，官身俱旺，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1839","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱貴拱禄爲將相，忌刑衝填實之㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440934442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1841","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此拱貴拱禄格也。喜忌篇文義同。如丁巳、丙午、甲寅、甲子拱丑貴，壬子、丁未、丁巳、丁未年支子字衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1842","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出午字，故大貴。癸卯、庚申、戊辰、戊午拱己禄，如辛丑、辛丑、甲寅、甲子，有丑字填實，却以辛爲正官論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1843","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100292079681590"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1844","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳未戊辰、戊寅、戊午，官煞多寅字衝申，爲衝，開則拱不成。如壬辰、戊申、己未、己巳，是此格也，故大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印暗合天地，其貴可知；福德隱在支中，其德尤萃。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440950826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1846","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官印暗合即食神暗合正官，偏財暗合正印。如甲用辛官，丙盛能暗合。辛未爲官，用癸爲印，戊旺能。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1847","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"暗合癸丑爲印，更得地支有子合丑，有午合未，方是福德隠藏。福卽福星，貴德即天月德，或指福德。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1848","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"秀氣或指天乙貴人，以藏在支中爲妙。如甲、戊、庚不見丑未，但得巳字，即是，見已在丑未宫，尤妙。柱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1849","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲天乙當職，見未夜生得力，爲福十全，反此一半論。四柱帶甲戊、庚全得乙丑爲聚貴，更加福力。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1850","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一庚一甲見支神，三四丑未爲會貴，亦加福力。若本主與貴人俱生旺，只消一字共福自全。喜三合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1851","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無卯乙破，更生四季月，巳土得令，主貴人見喜，前程尊顯、妻貌及得妻財。又云：甲人见丑，喜坐羊刃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1852","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六合忌休囚空破。詩曰：貴人帝座見生成，官旺之鄉名早成。若遇休囚並破制，虛名踪跡遠三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行正貴，怕刑衝尅害之神；四柱吉神，喜官在生合","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440967210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1854","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386069659698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440967210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1856","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行正貴，乃正氣官星，如甲生酉月之例，最怕酉刑卯衝，丁尅戌害，傷了貴氣，或以貴爲貴神，如甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1857","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見丑，丑中有辛，又爲甲正官之類，柱有卯乙尅壞丑貴，喜己酉三合，乙木尅衝丑不入，或有子合丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1858","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亦可隔木之尅。如有乙卯子卯相刑，不能尅丑未，爲天乙之貴。四柱吉神，乃官印、財食、奇貴、福德等。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1859","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"星皆是，但得一星臨長生、帝旺，臨官、正庫、三合、六合之位，無不富貴。詩曰：人命生時得一強，日時或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1860","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"臨禄馬鄉，須看前後扶助合，必然衣錦入中堂。喜忌篇云：五行正貴忌刑衝破害之宫，四柱干支喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1861","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三合六合之地，又云：地支天干合多，亦云貪合忘官。二義須並論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若也沐浴逢煞，魄徃酆都；元犯再傷，魂歸岳府。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440983594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1863","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此因上文刑衝尅害而言，怕裸形逢煞，以生之者微，而尅之者重，命元犯之，己爲不吉，岁運再犯，决","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1864","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𣦸無疑。如元犯官煞，去配不清，柱無食神可解，岁運再見則𣦸。若元犯破印，流年再犯則𣦸。凡用神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1865","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256063225871"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1866","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有損者，皆是此四句珞琭子本文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畏煞逢煞則夭，憂𨵿落關即亡；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440999978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1868","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此亦因上而申明之也。柱中原怕關煞，如甲見庚申爲煞，歲運再見，柱無救解者夭。年煞尤重有印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1869","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則化，有食則制，有刃則合，身旺則敵，若行煞旺運，亦夭。又如甲日見辰，爲陽數極，又爲鐡蛇關，壬見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1870","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑，庚見戌，丙見未申，皆陽關，曰重。乙見辰，癸見丑，辛見戌，丁見未申，爲陰關，稍輕。四柱犯流年，又犯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1871","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"運行休囚主𣦸，或被神煞鬼賊，或曰𨵿煞之名甚多，非直言七煞陽𨵿也。其詳見前。論壽夭及小兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1872","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"關煞下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"引合𨵿煞誤傷身，中下滅絶横夭壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408440999978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1874","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"引合𨵿煞如丙火既弱，又見辛未，丙辛既合，丙就辛官未位，乃内極陽關，再被壬來尅，即亡，或是辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1875","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥煞地尤𦂳，犯之横罹其咎。一命丙戌、丁酉、辛酉、乙未、壬申年𣦸是也。中下灭絕。如壬戊日爲坐財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1876","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100346412466212"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1877","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又坐煞，日支能有之，是則壽。若行壬辰運，壬癸水聚於辰，尅破戊中火，共别無可救，即夭，此名倒䡓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1878","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命元土旺則水旺，土身自崩壞，何暇救之？水旺則火滅，故云中下絶滅。中下者，即地元、人元、中下之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1879","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"分也，餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官見官，禍患百端；逐馬逢馬，勞苦千般。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441016362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1881","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言獨犯所忌，故不吉。傷官見官，惟有財星，可以解傷之毒，勸官之怒，轉禍爲祥。逐馬逢馬惟有官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1882","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞可以制刃之刼，雖勞亦得其財。若比肩多，他強我弱，雖减耗亦得其財。不得均平，止三四分之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財逢羊刃以多傷，印見妻財而不破。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441032746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1884","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此亦同上文之義。凡命最忌羊刃，財格被破，印格被奪，官格衝怒，只喜七煞制之，陰刃力微，無妨印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1885","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見妻財，是貪財壞印之說也。歲運又見，主破財傷妻，或因妻致訟。若原無財星，或財星力微，歲運見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1886","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之稍輕，惟官煞進生解劝，反得舉荐成名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1887","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100424376188968"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神遇梟，無財則夭；身弱有財，重逢正印亦㐫；制煞","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441049130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢印，有衝則誅；命強無官，單遇七煞尤勝。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441049130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1890","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌云：柱中七煞全彰，身弱極貧無地。是此義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑對衝横禍生；羊刃對合，非殃至。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441065514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沐浴從生無家","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441081898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"客，休囚見煞不埋人。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441081898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1894","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"沐浴休囚，皆身衰也。從生則泛，見煞則傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月下刼財主無財，喜煞無印而有获；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441098282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1896","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞能制刃，印能化煞，化則不能制刃，故喜煞而去印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暗中破印親壊印，喜官無食以加封。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441098282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1898","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財能破印，官能生印，有食則瓌官生財，印愈受傷，故喜官而去食。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1899","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100424376172584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞混雜，賤患兮兄弟太多；分散兮喜印無制能文；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441114666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜制無印能武；制印俱有，碌碌難成；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441114666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1902","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印能化煞，食能制煞，有化莫制，有制莫化。制化太多，則煞無氣，反不爲吉。羊刃全頼煞制，或化作印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1903","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"綬如戊日、午月之類，是制化止用其一，皆能有成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬背逐，饑寒兮財印相破，括囊兮喜官帶煞爲權，","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441114666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愛煞帶官爲貴，官煞單見，𤨏𤨏不遂。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441114666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1906","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禄馬背逐，財印相破，須官煞叠見，方能制此劫而生財，生印綬而化財，單見則力薄弱，豈能遂意？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梟印相雜，宠辱兮財馬太多，盜氣兮喜身旺而爲福，","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441131050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌運弱以生灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441131050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1909","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"偏正二印相雜，偏正二財俱有。若身弱不能雙成，其生並受其財。中間要分偏正強弱，若偏印偏財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1910","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100424376205352"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1911","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"強身旺運強，驟然發福，正印正財亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄尅破，夭𣦸兮，庫墓衝散，無餐兮。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441147434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌重破而無依，","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441163818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜比肩而可救。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441163818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1915","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宫官星禄正禄，如甲見辛寅，又見庚申及己與午之類，岁運再見，即夭。若身旺有比肩，亦可作旺論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1916","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又如甲以丑爲官庫，要得未字衝開，用未不可見二丑，有丑不可見二未。又忌丁丑、丁未，丁傷辛官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1917","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之類見癸未癸丑，癸水能制丁火，能己丑己未，已生辛土官，己爲甲財，癸爲甲印，丙爲甲食，支干生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1918","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺無破者，富貴。稍見衝尅，則减分數。衝爲尅太甚，反貧窘。以上雜舉財官、印綬、食神、傷官、官煞、羊刃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1919","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"比肩梟神相忌相須，相制相合，交互言之，看所用之神何如，日干強弱如何。經云：日主最宜健旺用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1920","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神不可損傷，斯言簡而𥁞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼財羊刃，切忌時逢；歲運併臨，灾殃立至。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441180202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1922","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100256063242255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲衝運則崩，運衝歲則晦。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441196586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1924","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此下専論歲運。岁者，天之所葢，運者，地之所載。歲運不可兩相衝激，重則崩，輕則晦，命中最要相和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1925","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則天地亨泰，福禄白臻。太嵗衝運，其禍重；運尅太岁，則禍輕。考淵源淵海諸說，俱以運尅歲爲重歲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1926","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尅運爲輕，卽日犯歲君之義也。驗余命行丁巳運，遇癸亥流年，癸傷丁，亥衝已，是歲衝運也，其年罷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1927","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官䘮母，受禍最慘，可以例觀矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰氣終而陽氣斷，未𣦸堪嗟；陽數極而陰命追，不殂","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441212970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何待。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441212970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1930","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲見辰，丙見未，戊見丑，庚見戌，壬見丑，爲陽氣極。乙見戌，丁見丑，己、癸見未，辛見辰，爲陰數終歲運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1931","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見之尤凶。又云：乙辰、丁未，巳丑辛戌，亦是陰符來追，陽數先斷。若止當生，四柱無害，最怕生既犯歲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1932","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"運又見立死。又云：陰干遇陽極，爲陰遇陽關；陽干遇陰終，爲陽遇陰關。身弱只力皆夭，身旺得比肩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1933","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100424376221736"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1934","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"黨助則無害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行有救，當憂不憂；四時逢空，聞喜不喜。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441229354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1936","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言人命遇歲運之㐫，以上衝尅，氣終數極之類。如五行有救，則當憂不憂；四時逢空，是流年太歲遇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1937","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉神却值空亡，則聞喜不喜。或曰：甲憂庚，得乙可救。春無土，不怕土爲㐫，不喜土爲福之類。經云：庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1938","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛來傷甲乙，丙丁，先見無危。又云：春無土，夏無金，秋無木，冬無火，是也。以下有論婦人二十句，己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1939","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"引專論婦人門，故不重録。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以陰陽罕測，不可一途而推；貴賤難分，要執兩端。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441245738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而斷畧究古聖之遺文，約以今賢之研詳，若遵此法，","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441262122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"参梧鍳命，庻無差忒","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441262122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1943","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此總結上文諸格之義。以上指出諸格，俱論前卷諸格下，故不詳註。喜忌篇、继善篇是從此賦變化。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1944","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386732539942"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而出。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441262122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今人但知有此二篇，","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441278506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而不知有此賦，故録之。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441278506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441294890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1949","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386732458022"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1950","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386069692466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜忌篇","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441311274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱排定，三才次分，專以日上天元配合八字支干，","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441311274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有見不見之形，無時不有。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441311274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞相絆，輕重較量。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441327658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃時逢七煞，見之未必爲㐫；月制干強，其煞反爲","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441344042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"權印。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441344042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印綬全僃，藏蓄於四季之中；","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441360426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星財氣長生，鎮居於寅申。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441360426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441376810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申時逢戊日，名食神干旺之方，歲月犯甲丙卯寅，","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441393194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃遇而不遇。","logicSentenceId":"7577343408441393194", {"lines":[{"lineId":"2087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬來尅丙，須要戊字當頭；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355063359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸去傷丁，却喜己來相助。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355063359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2089","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386069758002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚得壬男制丙，夭作長年；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355079743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲以乙妹妻庚，㐫爲吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355079743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元雖旺，若無依倚，是常人；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355096127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日主太柔，縱遇財官，爲寒士。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355096127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人無煞，帶二德，作兩國之封；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355112511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男命身強，遇三奇，爲一品之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355112511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲逢己而生旺，定懐中正之心；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355128895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁遇壬而太過，必犯淫訛之亂。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355128895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙臨申位，逢陽水，難獲延年；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355145279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2099","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月逢印綬，則安富尊榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己入亥宫，見陰木，終爲損壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355145279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時遇丙寅，則冠帶簮纓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2102","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100346412531748"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚値寅而遇丙，主旺無危；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355161663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙遇己而見辛，身衰有禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355161663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙逢庚旺，常存仁義之心；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355178047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙合辛生，鎭掌烕權之職。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355178047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一木叠逢火位，各爲氣散之文；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355194431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨水三犯庚辛，號曰體全之象。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355194431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水旣冬旺，生平樂自無憂；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355210815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木在春生，處世安然必壽。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355210815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全弱遇火炎之地，血疾無疑；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355227199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土虛逢木旺之鄉，脾傷定論。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355227199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2113","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100424376336424"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筋疼骨痛，皆因木被金傷；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355243583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼暗目昏，必是火遭水尅。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355243583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金逢艮而遇土，號曰還魂；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355259967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水入巽而見金，名爲不絕。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355259967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土臨卯位，未中年便欲灰心；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355276351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金遇火鄉，雖少壯必然挫志。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355276351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木交争刑戰，仁義倶無；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355292735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火递互相傷，是非日有。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355292735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木從水養，水盛而木則漂流；","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355309119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金頼土生，土厚而金遭埋没。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355309119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100372060700726"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以五行不可偏枯，務禀中和之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355325503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更能絶慮忘思，","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355341887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鑑命無差無悮。","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355341887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通會卷之十一終","logicSentenceId":"7577343409355358271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386732589094"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2130","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100372060831798"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2131","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100372060749878"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386069872690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通會全","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026686514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冊卷之十","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026686514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100372060766262"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三，命通㑹卷之十二育吾山人著。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026686514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元理賦","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026702898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"徐大升著，萬育吾解。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元一氣，生五行，統三才，周萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026702898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發亁坤之妙用，剖陰","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026719282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之樞機。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026719282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在乎推四方分其貴賤，得其中道，八字一","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026735666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定榮枯。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026735666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以強明其生尅制化，清濁貴賤，壽夭賢愚。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026752050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此原造化之始。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金頼土生，土多金埋；土頼火生，火多土焦；火頼木生，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026768434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木多火熾；木頼水生，水多木漂；水頼金生，金多水濁，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026768434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金能生水；水多金沉，水能生木，木盛水縮，木能生火；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026768434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火多木焚，火能生土；土多火晦，土能生金，金多士變，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026768434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100372060799030"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金能尅木；木堅金缺，木能尅土；土重木折，土能尅水；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026768434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水多土𣴑，水能尅火；火炎水𤍠，火能尅金。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026768434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金多火熄。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026784818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金衰遇火，必見銷鎔；火弱逢水，必爲熄滅；水弱逢土，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026801202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必爲淤塞；土衰遇木，必遭傾䧟；木弱逢金，必爲砍折。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026801202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上言太過不及，各有其害，如此，見五行四柱不可不中和也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"強金得水，方挫其鋒，強水得木方泄其勢；強木得火","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026817586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方化其頑，強火得士方止其熖，強土得金，方制其害。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026817586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上言五行尅制，要得中和，而太過不及，胥失之矣。所以照被上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理貫人融者，妙其幽，察其顯也。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026833970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爲體也，深能通變，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026850354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以究玄微，其爲用也，論其輕重，原有原無。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026850354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天理賦來，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026866738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100424376352808"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㐫動靜；人生分定，否泰盈𧇊。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026866738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上通論干支陰陽生尅制化之中，體幽用顯，輕重有無，而吉㐫動静，否泰盈虧，皆自此而生之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"妙在識其通變，究其玄微，由顯而幽，斯得其理。以下則詳言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞無刃不威，刃無煞不顯，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026883122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞乃尅我，刃乃刼我，命中之最㐫者，肯言煞刃，其知所重者歟！賦云：刃爲兵噐，無煞難存。煞爲軍令。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無刃不尊，刃煞雙顯，威鎭亁坤是也。徐大昇因見喜忌、繼善二篇，不足以𥁞人之命，故復撰此賦，所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以補其未借也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"權刃雙顯均停，位至王侯；刃煞輕重無制，身爲胥吏，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026883122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言煞刃相停者極貴，不相停者極賤。刃煞停不停，而貴賤之相懸如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生平富而且貴；煞重身柔，中途忽𣦸或危，運扶干旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026883122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100372060782646"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旣不相停，不如從煞。能從者，必煞重身柔而後可從，不然，不能從也。旣從煞，只以煞論，不可再遇身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺相敵，敵則反生禍矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處身僧道之首，用煞反輕，受職臺諌之除，偏官得地。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026883122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"七煞爲權星，又爲孤星，身煞兩強，七煞有制，身弱從煞皆貴。然多爲毫諫之官，若身旺煞輕，更入清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"奇必爲僧道之首矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知大貴者用財而不用官，當權者，用煞而不用印。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026899506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印頼煞生，官因財旺。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026915890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用財不用官，財生官也；用煞不用印，煞生印也。故云印頼煞生，官因財旺。非不用印用官而專用財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞則官印在其中矣。印頼二句𦂳水，上文四句自發明之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行消息，玄理可知；四柱推明，用神可見。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026932274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食居先，煞","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026948658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386069839922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居後，功名兩全。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026948658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𮠕破卯，卯破午，財官雙美，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026965042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人之八字，全看用神，如上用煞、用刃、用財，而不用官用印，其理甚玄，在人消息之耳。論煞當要刃無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刃要有制，煞強有制，皆爲貴論。煞主名，食主利，故曰功名俩全。酉破卯，卯破午，亦食前煞後之意。酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以卯爲財，午爲煞，財煞兼有，故主財官兩然美。所以相破者，以其相尅也，必四正相破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"享福五行，歸禄，眉壽，八字相停。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026965042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此舉命中最要者言之，要歸禄，要相停，不可𣦸絶偏黨。享福屬歸禄，眉壽屬相停，義各有所取也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晦火無光於稼穡，盜木多困於丙丁。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026981426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此以下正言不歸，禄不相停，故不得享福眉壽。土掩火光，士頼木踈，木本生火，火多則反盜氣見不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中，和也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火虛有熖，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026997810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100435826622514"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火怕晦，虚則有𦦨不晦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金實無","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026997810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868491419687/1-65ac8201d90499ff.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=QTo8svzmGYrwLn63ZUucGq1fPCU%3D","uri":"read/NA06804/2/ref/1kobikqzrhvec/1-65ac8201d90499ff.webp","fontType":1,"components":"士厂耳殳","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690868491419687"},"logicSentenceId":"7577322766026997810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金要火，無火煉則不成噐，實何以發聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水泛木浮者活，木上重金埋者，陽金。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766026997810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水盛則危，火明","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027014194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則滅。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027014194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此又細分五行不相停，而有陰陽之别，見五行不可太過，如水泛則木浮，在乙木則怕，甲木則否。土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"重金埋在庚金則畏，辛金則否。以乙木𣦸於亥，甲木生於亥，庚金出土之金，所以生巳。辛金帶水之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金所以生子，水盛則泛濫，故危，火明則煨燼故滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽金得煉太過，變革奔波；陰木歸垣失令，終爲身弱。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027030578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金實無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890917527593/1-e03974a3989ecf78.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=lCogLneFQHgU70670GvshCYRK4k%3D","uri":"read/HY2175/3/ref/1krfu08f8upf8/1-e03974a3989ecf78.webp","fontType":1,"components":"声耳殳","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690890917527593"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煉過，變革歸禄享福失令，身弱見要中和。陽金土重則埋，怕煉太過，是無土也。陰木失令。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100372060815414"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則弱，縱是歸垣，亦損壽也。此本土文活木陽金而言，又不可無水土生養也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土厚而掩火無光，水盛則漂木無定。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027046962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行不可太盛，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027063346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字須得中和。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027063346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"士厚卽晦火無光之意；水盛，卽水泛木浮之意。五行二句，又所以總結之，歸於中和而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土止水流全福壽，水無土止必傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027079730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此下言失中和，而五行有救，亦作吉論，無救助方㐫。如水流而有土止，則禄壽兩全，餘可例見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛多仁，土薄寡信。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027096114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水旺居垣須有智，金堅主義却","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027112498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能爲。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027112498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水聰明而好色，水土混雜必多愚。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027128882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言五行性氣太過，中亦各有所盛偏之爲害也。五行分四時，五常配五行，自然之理也。或盛或溏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或旺，或多，或混雜，而仁義智信、聰明愚魯，亦各從其類耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386069856306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遐齡得於中和，夭壽䘮於偏枯。","logicSen
