tenceId":"7577322766027145266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此又申言人命要禀中和，卽前眉壽八字停均之義。若太過不及，失於偏枯，安得遐齡之享哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌尅制，併衝必犯刑名；子卯相刑，門戸，全無禮德。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027161650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此以下提起地支相衝相刑言之，辰戌魁罡併衝必㐫；子卯母子相刑必亂，乃衝刑之最重者，餘稍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"輕寅申己亥爲四生之局，縱犯尅制刑衝，亦無大害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棄印就財，明偏正，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027178034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"前言大貴者，用財不用印，財有偏正，印亦有偏正。正印見財有禍，偏財見印無妨，正財不喜見印偏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財不忌見印，同此理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棄干從煞，論剛柔","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027178034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"前言當權者，用煞不用印，煞有剛柔，棄天干而從地支，陽剛陰柔，金水土可從，木火不可從，明可從。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100386069889074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可從之理，然後知","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027178034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印可用不可用也。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027178034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官無財可倚，雖巧必貧；食神制煞逄梟，不貧則夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027194418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官食神同類，傷官剥官，命中最忌，有財亦好，以傷生財，財生官故也。無財則以貧斷，食神制煞命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中最怕逄梟，以梟奪食，煞無制則尅身，故夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男多陽刃必重婚，女犯傷官須再嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027210802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"羊刃逄煞相停，固主貴矣。多則傷妻，男以財爲妻，刃則尅制，故重婚。傷官，有財可倚固，主貴矣。女則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷夫女以官爲夫，傷則尅制，故再嫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤者，皆因官處遭傷；孤寡者，只爲財神被刼。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027227186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官爲祿，有祿，安得貧賤？身旺得官微，復行傷官運，謂之背祿，則無官矣，安得不貧賤？財爲妻，有妻安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得孤獨財少，遇身旺，復行刼財運，謂之逐馬，則無妻矣，宜乎該孤寡財官，其人命之最要者歟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100347234615336"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨旺地人多福，官遇長生命必榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027243570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"前言食傷生財爲旺，此則直言財臨旺地。如甲用戊巳爲財，居己午之地爲𦔽。前言財旺生官，此則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"直言官遇長生，如甲用庚辛爲官，居己子之地爲生，二者必須身旺，方主有福榮貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去煞留官方論福，去官留煞不爲𤰞。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027259954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人命最怕官煞混雜，用官只用官，用煞只用煞，故有去留，方可言貴。如傷官、羊刃，人命逄之，多不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用之去官留煞，去煞留官，或者亦作福論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知遇正官却終俸禄，逢七煞乃有","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027276338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690890917527593/1-e03974a3989ecf78.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=lCogLneFQHgU70670GvshCYRK4k%3D","uri":"read/HY2175/3/ref/1krfu08f8upf8/1-e03974a3989ecf78.webp","fontType":1,"components":"声耳殳","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690890917527593"},"logicSentenceId":"7577322766027276338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027276338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正官七煞，君子小人之分也，豈君子不如小人？正官雖得純粹，七煞一有制伏，便發貴有聲。若正官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"純粹，發福悠長，豈七煞之比？此舉其偏重者言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逄傷官反見夫財命有氣，遇梟神而䘮子，福氣無依。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027276338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100347234631720"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命最怕傷官，有則傷夫，其理易曉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027292722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内有傷而反","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027309106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見夫者，乃財命有氣，傷官生財，財生官星，爲夫故也。女命以食神爲子，遇梟奪食，雖生子，不存女倚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子爲福旣無子，又何有福之可言。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027309106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命重夫子二","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027325490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星，故舉傷官","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027325490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神言之。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027325490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天干煞顯，無制者賤；地支財伏，暗生者奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027341874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命以煞爲重，前專以煞言，要刃合，要食制要從，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027358258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞如不合不制，不從天干，顯，則煞爲無情，故主貧賤。人命以財爲福，前専以財言，要傷生要酉破要。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"食旺，但財不喜露，要藏地支中有暗物以生之，則主豐厚，故。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲奇特。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027358258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三戌衝辰禍不淺，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027374642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"魁罡最怕相衝，不吉，若相停爲財，官庫不忌。如三戌一辰，甲辰日，主貪財生禍，以地網衝天羅，所以。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100424376401960"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"两干不雜利名齊。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027374642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"两干難得不雜，故主利名兼有。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027391026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然不可槩言。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027407410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027423794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或是財煞，或是官印，或是煞刃，或五行成象，更入格局方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作貴論。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027423794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子辛卯相刑，荒淫滚浪；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027440178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙辛合子卯刑干合支刑丙辛水象，子卯無禮，故主荒淫滚浪，言極淫也。女命尤忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉全僃，酒色昏迷。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027440178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上重子卯，此併論午酉爲四敗之局，號日遍野桃花煞全僃者，多貴，但主酒色昏迷，女命尢忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因財致禍，貪食種疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027456562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姪男爲嗣，義女爲妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027472946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上言財要伏藏爲奇，然財者衆所争，故有羊刃、刼則因財致禍，見財不可専也。上言食神制煞爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"然食者人所貪，故有梟神奪則因食生疾，見食不可貪也。男以官煞爲子，如羊刃刼財，官煞爲彼用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100435826671666"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是弟兄有子而我無子，故以姪男爲嗣，以偏正則爲妻。如柱中無財，正位而寄生别宫，是娶他人所。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"養女，故主義女爲妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時相衝，卯酉始生，必主遷移造化。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027489330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因逢戌亥，平生","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027505714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敬信神祗。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027505714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此又舉地支中卯𮠕日月門戶，日時遇之，主遷移不定。戌亥爲天門，日月逢之，多信神祗，或僧道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰尅陰，陽尅陽，財神有用，官無官，鬼無鬼，太旺傾危。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027522098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人命以財官爲重，故又舉而言之。人皆知正財爲用，不知陰能尅陰，陽能尅陽，偏財勝乎正財，造化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"反爲得用，官不可無官多，反主無官不吉；煞不可有煞多，得從其鬼，反不爲害，要之皆爲太𦔽身哀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不能敵，傾危之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得局失垣，平生不遂；歸垣得局，早歲軒昂。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027538482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100435826688050"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得局，爲合局也。歸垣，干歸禄也。此言人命要生旺成局勢爲福。若得局失垣，雖天干類象，而地支三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合却爲日干休囚𣦸絶之地，亦平生不遂。若得局又歸垣，如五星升殿入垣，乃得地得時之謂也。决","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主早歲發福，曲直潤下等格，卽得局歸垣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命遇梟神，而與富家營運；龍藏亥卯經商，利賂絲緍。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027554866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官俱敗者𣦸，食神逄梟者㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027571250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"梟神固可惡，小人得之有用，謂其與富家營運。如甲用丙火爲食，丙能生戊土，爲甲之財，壬水却爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木梟神，受戊驅使，丙火以托甲木，互換相生，爲主客之道故也。亦有爲商自營運者，謂龍藏亥卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅爲青龍，巳爲太常，亥卯未木局，八字用藏，亥卯未爲用神者，或用財，皆主絲緇之利。財官爲禄馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人最𦂳要，若俱在敗絶之地，或行運又到敗絶，用神損氣，安得不𣦸？食神人之爵星，生財制煞命中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𦂳要彼梟奪食，煞無所制，財無所生，安得不㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100426808918026"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳孤鸞，命遇聰明詩女，裸形沐浴，日犯濁濫荒淫；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027587634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此論女命，男亦同孤鸞，乃甲寅、丁巳、戊申、辛亥等日，坐四生之地，故多聰明。裸形沐浴，卽子午卯酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四敗之地也。月時犯無傷，只怕日干自坐，如甲子、庚午、丁卯、癸酉等日，身坐桃花煞，再遇帶合，故主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"濁濫荒淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁逢卯日，遇己土饕食之人；亥乃漿神，逢酉金嗜盃","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027587634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之客。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027587634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁干坐卯木，爲梟，若遇巳爲食，故主貪食，或因食生灾。亥爲登明，酉加水爲酒，酉日生人，逢亥必主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貪盃更帶刑衝，主落魄，或酒𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸祿得財而獲福，無財歸禄必須貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027604018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歸祿身旺，故用財無財而專歸禄無用，得傷官食神生財月吉，又怕見官煞𥨸財之氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100346412564516"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財印混雜，終爲受困；偏正錯亂，必致傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027620402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貪財壞印，故忌混雜。若先財後印，反主成其福，不以此論。官煞混雜，有去留亦吉，若錯亂，則傷身爲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㐫女命偏正錯亂，尤爲不吉。擇婦者須知之。或日偏正，就指財之偏正、印之偏正言，但於傷身難通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲忌逄戰闘，羊刃不喜刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027636786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此論日干與歲君相犯禍福。葢日犯歲君，以歲爲用神者，無咎。如六壬日以丙丁爲財，柱中原有根。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖犯太歳，反爲吉，身旺者㐫，弱者無咎。日與運俱犯之，方主大㐫。五行有救，亦減分𢿘，最怕天衝地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"擊當妙察性情，陰陽物元眞理。且如六乙人逢己歲，運活木尅活士，却有生意財源，倍有六甲生人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逄戊，歲運𣦸木，尅𣦸土，則不吉，重者䘮身。羊刃格不喜歲運刑衝，小人不可犯之。如八字旣有羊刃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"多煞制伏，行羊刃，歲運亦㐫。元有財者，更重帶𮐲衝刑戰闘，主禍出不測。經云：羊刃衝合，歲君勃然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禍至是也。戰闘獨舉太歲，刑衝獨舉羊刃，指其所最重言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100424376418344"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚逢丙擾，多有不仁；癸從戊合，少長無情；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027653170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言人之性情心術，金火相刑，故有此病。且主人剛暴。癸爲少陰，戊僞老陽，癸戊雖合化，乃無情之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合，故以少長言之，男命戊日見癸，當娶少年之婦；女命癸日見戊，必嫁老年之夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不從不化，淹留仕路之人；得化得從，顯逹功名之士。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027653170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不通月氣，時無所歸，又犯孤神，不從不化也。若通月氣，時有所歸，則以從化論。夫旺從夫化，妻旺從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"妻化人之行藏，豈止一事而立，終身無改。故從化成格，則富貴備矣。先論從化，後論財官，從以天干。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"從地支，如乙生八月，地支重金，則以金論是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化行祿旺者生，化歸祿絕者𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027669554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言得化得從，要得祿旺，不要𣦸絶。葢化成造化，行本局祿旺。如丁壬化木，月令春或東南方運，爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生行金鄕，或時遇申酉之地，爲𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100346412695588"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生地相逢，壯年不祿；時歸敗地，老後無終。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027685938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生地相逄，是命巳有長生臨官，行運復遇之。如庚辛臨官，帝旺在申酉，用丙丁爲官，用甲乙爲財火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"至申酉運則病𣦸，是庚辛無官也。木至申酉運則𣦸絶，是庚幸無財也。財官俱敗，用神被傷，雖壯年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不祿時爲結果。人之生時，最不可居於五行敗地，金敗午，木敗子，水土敗於，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690896366551051/1-d136cacb8b8c78c2.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=tKhN4bun9IWWhF%2Fe1%2FoCiSDc%2Bvk%3D","uri":"read/HY6360/3/ref/1kul8novn90z7/1-d136cacb8b8c78c2.webp","fontType":1,"components":"一凵日","variants":"","charPicId":"7456690896366551051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火敗卯時爲末主，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"居敗地，主晚年晦滯，破敗無終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁坐酉金，丙辛遇之絶嗣；財臨煞位，父𣦸而不歸家。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027702322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙用壬爲子，𡈼敗於酉；辛用丙爲子，丙𣦸於酉時，乃子官旣敗且𣦸，豈有嗣乎？如有嗣，則父必不禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人命以財爲父，財煞同宫，則難爲父。如庚辛用甲爲父，年月時見甲申，坐煞官，歲運煞旺，主父𣦸他。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鄕或云：煞刼殺財坐刧煞更父位，准賦義亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八専干支同類，煞運煞年多㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027718706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100347234746408"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"支干同類，如甲寅、乙卯、两午、丁末、庚申、辛酉、壬子、癸丑、戊午、己未、戊戌、己丑是也。歲運㑹煞，必主不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"祿，以其恃強，與煞相争，煞竟尅身故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若能詳觀玩覧，貴賤萬不失一。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027735090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"余見舊註分折破碎，有失賦旨，故畧註於下，以明作者之意云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100426808934410"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100346412646436"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真寳賦：","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027751474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明兵部尚書萬騏撰。萬育吾觧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星帶刃，無尅破，掌兵刑之大權；財印相資没刑衝，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027751474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"登黄閣三公之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027751474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官格喜羊刃，及財印相資，有傷官則尅，有刑","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027767858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝則破，無印無刃，只有財星資助亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027767858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲同","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027784242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官生旺，逢印綬，拜薇垣憲府之尊；三合印財會局","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027784242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全，登五馬諸侯之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027784242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官生旺，格柱有偏正印","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027800626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再三合印局，或財局吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027800626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官逢刼刃，𠔥將相於明時；印綬若相扶，登龍門於","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027817010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"早歲。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027817010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官格身弱，喜刃","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027833394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印相資扶則吉；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027833394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100346412662820"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官得食神重輔麟閣圖魏相之功。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027833394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運忌制伏刑","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027849778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝，再傷官而禍至。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027849778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官得食神，重叠相扶吉，所忌刑衝及制伏太𨓺，復行傷官運，不測灾來。柱中無，官喜行財官運無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印喜行印綬，運主遷官歲運同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財資七煞，威權獨壓萬人；印若相扶，斷定官居極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027866162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"七煞格喜財資助，又得印化最吉。惟煞故主有權；得印故主極品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月會旣同煞刃，英名儔漢室之霍光；時歲復帶印財","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027882546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高位，埒中興之鄧禹。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027882546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"七煞刼刃同在月令歲時，有財有印最貴，義同上文，但此又兼刃言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞失時而印無氣，更主旺而任常流。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027898930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100346412711972"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"七煞印綬若不當令司權，而日千自旺，用神輕微不遍，清虛冷淡之職，歳運行財煞則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印司令而煞相扶，再見財而官翰苑。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027915314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印綬格要當時月令日支，又得重生氣旺，不見刑衝破害，稍得一煞一財爲妙，太過不宜財印兩停。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃常流也。賦又云：印綬重逢，官居翰苑，是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財時上見官，早歲名標金榜；更得食神相輔，少年","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027931698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日近天顔。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027931698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時上偏財格，歲月有官星，又得食助，准上文忌。比刼逄比，百無一遂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福德見財而隠官，居極高之重任；柱運逢印而無土，","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027948082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處至下之孤刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027948082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"福德如壬癸日生冬三月之例，喜財官資助，干支作合，或得火局，及辰戌丑未，但逢一字爲妙。柱無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100426808901642"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財官而逄印綬，不行財官，而行印綬及比方之運，刑妻尅子，孤寡貧窮之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬趨艮，透財印以爲奇；官煞相侵，反貧窮而下賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027964466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六壬日逄壬寅時，乃趨艮格也。歲月再見寅天，于透丁辛爲妙，富貴雙全，最忌官煞，或行運見之。六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"親骨肉分散，貧薄，婢僕之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲趨亁，喜財印而位重名高；歲運衝刑，併煞官而","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027980850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾興禍至。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027980850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲日時逢乙亥，乃趨亁格也。歲月再見亥，又得財星重遇印綬生身，正官自然出現，再行財旺之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉忌己字刑衝，官煞尅破，甲乙刼奪，歲運同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財宿疊逄，得印生，少年受福；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027997234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卽先財後印，反成其福，不可以財壞印爲嫌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100347234828328"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒衝帶印，遇財食，早歲成名。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766027997234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"倒衝禄馬格，乃丙午、丁巳、辛亥、癸亥等日，柱有偏印，又行財食運爲貴，忌塡實官煞，不中賦。又云：倒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衝帶印，早歲成名，財食𠔥資，身近丹墀是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲德扶干，喜財星而嫌制伏；印星在運，會羊刃而掌","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028013618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兵刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028013618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年干七煞爲歲德，不宜重見，最喜財星及印綬、羊刃，不可制伏。歲運同如甲申、己巳、戊子、癸亥歲德。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無制有財，生煞得用，有印化煞助身，有刃合煞扶身，故大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二德配官，王陵爲漢朝之相；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028030002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛日生九月，以丙爲天月二德，又爲正官，喜財星資助，忌傷官尅制。賦又云：平邦國，統六師，頼官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"變爲二德是也。如乙亥、丙戌、辛丑、戊子合格，又官變德，居官無禍；財變德，得善中財帛，印變德，主受。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100347234762792"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父祖貽慶無禍，日干變德，則主本身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財星德秀，謝安爲晉代之公。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028030002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如戊巳以甲乙爲官，壬癸爲財，二德透干，爲德秀之辰，無庚辛制伏，不被比刼争奪，大貴。又如乙日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以庚為官，生己酉丑月，丙丁用庚辛爲財，生己酉丑月之例賦又云：王啇扶漢因財官而爲德秀之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"榮是也。或以德秀爲福德秀氣更是財官，尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官多而見官，頑石産玉；原有官而再見，灾禍連綿。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028046386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官格要柱中重見傷官，如有一位正官爲貴，無官喜行官運，傷官如石，正官如玉，若有官再行官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"運則禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官如帶煞刃，出将相而入公侯；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028062770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官爲主，柱帶煞刃，又得印綬，當時得令，有相益之情，不被刑衝，乃極貴之格。賦又云：傷官帶刃印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100347234811944"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"全僃掌兵符之重任是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"德秀若助傷官，握兵權而伏鉄鉞。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028062770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此又𠔥德秀言之，皆以傷官格爲主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地全子午卯酉，成大格而文武經邦；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028079154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四仲全看天千何如，須成大格爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱列己亥寅申，更奇儀而威權震主。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028079154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四孟全看天干何如，更得奇儀爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木生卯月，時會午而震動離明。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028095538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運至西南，官居極品；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028111922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此木火通明格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食遇印多再刼衝，天年必夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028111922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100435826720818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此食格所忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱盛食神，運財鄉，功名有准；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028128306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云：權臣内使，此食格所喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝陽帶印，資馬宿，青鎻黄門；柱無財印，職居民牧；歲","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028128306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運最𭒡填實。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028128306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六陰朝陽格，喜印綬財星，在歲月之中，入格而無財印，則减分數。運行財印官居轉運，忌衝刑、塡實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賦又云：朝陽带印，清朝逹士；財星資助，非青墳之榮，卽風紀之任。柱無印財，多居民牧，職守專城。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同貴帶食資印曜，薇垣藩省。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028144690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱有官煞，貧窮下賤；運","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028161074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"途不喜刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028161074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六乙鼠貴格，喜食神重見及印綬則吉，忌官煞衝刑害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100426808967178"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑遙合己宫，柱印財而爲極寳；歲運若無輔佐，登","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028177458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卑秩而坐寒氊。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028177458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子丑遥巳二格，要柱有財印必貴，無則否。運遇財印亦發。賦。又云：子丑遥合巳官，得財印而爲至寳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論道經邦，喜財官自禄而自旺；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028193842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲日以辛爲官，得酉建禄，己士爲財，長生在酉之例，入斯象大貴。忌刑衝、傷官，運歲同如呉嶽尚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"書甲子癸酉、甲辰、甲子合格，庚午年卒，平生正氣君子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"調元賛化，因三奇自旺而自生。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028193842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正正印、正財爲三奇。日以庚為正官，得巳官字長，壬為正大生，印生於申戊士止，財生於申，入斯𧰼貴。如譚論尚書庚辰、甲申、丁未丙午，財官印俱旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胡宗憲尚書，壬申辛亥，丁酉壬寅，財官建禄，印長","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028210226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100424376451112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生火，自生於酉，為貴神之地，又化木成象，所以威制四省，官居一品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欄义得印祿之相助，官居補衮阿衡；火刼𠔥歲運之","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028210226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不和，反作貧窮而下賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028210226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此格柱中有禄神偏正印，天干得財印爲妙。若見火神刧刃太重，歲運不和，貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄逢財印，青年及第登科；歲運刑衝，官煞逄之不妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028226610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歸禄格：歲月時中有印有財，地支三合為妙。運行財印之地，吉，忌刑衝破害、官煞破格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水清澄被傷，文章顯逹而壽𥮅難延；","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028242994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中己酉丑金局，申子辰水局，二局全，乃曰：金白水青，却被天干丙丁戊巳混尅，則文而不壽。賦云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金水清澄被傷，顔子秀而不實是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火衰盛不均，功名蹭蹬而夭折無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028242994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100470547054631"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙日生，柱中丙丁午巳火盛，卽乙木叠逢火位，名爲氣散之文，柱無財印，灰飛烟滅，尅子傷妻。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"殘疾，功名雖有，亦小就而已。得刼刃幇助壬癸，生扶戊巳，資益則貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲龍風虎若相從，擬作聖朝之大噐。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028259378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雲龍風虎如甲乙生春三月，或亥卯未月，爲青龍之宿，天干要壬癸水，謂之雲龍相從，或庚申辛酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"但得一字爲西方白虎之神，受亥卯未邀合，巳字爲巽風則貴。若見塡實，又無雲雨，謂之旱龍有陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而無陰有君而無臣。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028275762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛柔不相濟，反爲中庸；不逹","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028292146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之士也。或以辰爲龍，寅爲虎，壬爲雲，巳爲風，寅辰、巳壬局全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322766028292146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛祿倒衝資印綬，必爲昭代之名公。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327115302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"飛天禄馬倒衝之象，喜印綬財，忌正官、七煞，衝刑塡實，若行印財及三合之地，亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身雖旺而禄微輕，馬氏育菁莪於絳帳；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327131686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100470547087399"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲寅日用辛爲官祿，生冬三月，或四五月，用神旣淺，又無財星資助，止爲師儒之命。如生夏而財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"星資取富擬陶朱，若尅破制伏火重則否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格不清而用神休廢，蕭曹起刀筆於西秦。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327131686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"義同上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙若遇亁宫，會辰龍而必貴；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327148070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙二字，多逄干頭，地支，見亥一位，又得辰字，名羣龍無首吉，是剛能變柔，入斯象，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木神如逢壬癸，得巳午以爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327148070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日生，人得壬癸印生扶，支帶巳午，是有火氣","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327164454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水火旣濟，龍得飛騰之象，雲行雨施之功，命象位值斯近。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清光。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327164454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚遇壬癸，坐煞印而周瑜位重；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327180838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100346412728356"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六庚日生，柱中壬癸多，身坐七煞印綬者，主大貴。如何尚書壬子癸丑、庚午丙子余命壬午癸丑庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅、丙戌俱合此象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龜蛇持劒，兼金刃而賈復名高。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327180838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸日生，柱中丙火多，或寅午戌、申子辰二局，水屬⿔，火屬蛇，名龜蛇持劒之象。柱無金，其劒不出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛重而時見己亥，虎嘯風生，得戊巳以相資。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327197222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官居","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327213606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"極品。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327213606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛日主再見庚辛干，歲月時中得一巳爲巽風，或得亥亦可喜。甲乙亥卯未運行東南，權高禄重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"行北方富，入西禍莫測。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一氣相生，稱五行之順食，位近三台；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327229990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一氣相生，卽甲生丙，丙生戊，戊生庚，五行順食，更地支互益者，大貴。或以天元一氣觧之，則非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100461558677504"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神帶刃，遇火地之炎明。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327229990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官居内閣；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327246374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金刃格柱中有陽刃，又行火郷，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上偏官，喜刼刃印財而居歲月；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327246374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時上偏官格，歲月時中有財资，印化刃扶身，強，主風憲之權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父傳子道，兼文武將相而顯朝廷。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327246374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日生逢壬午時者，是乙屬東方青帝之神，午屬南方火帝之神，乙爲父，時爲子，得干上壬水，反生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙木是父傳子道之象，青赤相投之妙。入此格者，功高一世，寵壓千官，不宜水盛。乙木有泛，卽前木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生卯月，時會午，而震動離明，運至西南，官居極品是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官透而正官隠，運煞印而位重權高。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327262758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官透於歲月時干，正官隱於地支柱内，財印七煞全者，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100455208517686"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地天交而陰陽感，得戊巳而三台八座。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327279142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日時得亥爲乾天，歲月得申爲坤地，而干透戊己，是地在天上，有陰陽交感之意，内陽外隂，輝健順之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"象入此格者，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛金繁，得離明而公忠正直；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327295526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木頼金，削繁則金太多，要火制金，公忠正直，因金木而言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金白水清，遇長生而聰明出衆；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327295526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛日生於申子辰月，地支坐巳，柱有壬癸，無火土夾雜，主聰明有文學。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火明木秀，逢土現而早占鰲頭。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327295526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙日生，柱中有巳，或丙丁寅戌字在，春生奇特。若地支有午戌、亥卯未，各得一字，亦是不拘甲乙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100372060864566"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水木在春生，遇土金而作公侯之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327311910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水見土，木見金爲官，水見金印，木見士財，春則木旺水休，互相資助，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金逢火煉，早年出仕；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327328294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木得金裁，幼歲成名。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327328294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言五行之相濟也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金多失火，嗟性度之𠒋頑；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327344678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛無金，嘆功名之不遂。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327344678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土重而無木，疏通困苦奔波之輩；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327361062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水盛而無土，制伏破家淫蕩之人；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327361062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火盛而無水濟，𣦸而無悔之暴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327361062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327377446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100435826769970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木衰火盛變灰飛，功名遲而難迯夭折；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327377446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金白水清，被梟害，文章秀而莫永天年；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327377446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此總言五行偏黨無制化，皆爲不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金白水清，脫梟神而文章益顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327377446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與前金白水清過長生而聰明出衆，互有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞官兩露，遇二德而爵位崇高。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327393830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二德，天月二德也。煞官两露，疑混，得此觧之，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財資七煞，子儀司將相之高權；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327410214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱屮財旺生煞，煞生印，又得長生之地，日干旺，格局純，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神帶煞，𭁵凖擅廟堂之大噐。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327410214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100426809016330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金神重犯歲時月令，却逢七𭣦大貴忌刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗德逢財，煞栽根，早登顯仕；更加印刃，無妬合，預挴","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327426598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高科。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327426598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與前歳德扶干，喜財仇而嫌制伏，印星在運，會羊刃而掌兵刑，義同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲德逄財，少年請舉；嵗德帶刃，早歲成名。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327442982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歲德爲重煞，故屢言之。請舉少而成名，早擢高科而登顯仕，以年管初年，煞主威風故也。假如甲日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見庚年爲歲德，柱中要戊巳資煞，己酉丑衰根带刃，喜行印綬，忌正官妬合之辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月七煞而時歲食，肅憲府風霜之號令；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327459366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"食神制煞，理固然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月煞印而時傷官，受鳯閣龍樓之厚寵。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327459366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100461558693888"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令有煞印，歲干支得此爲極妙，要","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327475750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"透傷官，爲印之妻，作煞之制，故主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327475750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日丙火而時入亥宫，麗乎天而文明四海；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327492134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六丙日時得己亥，亥屬乾，爲天火，在天上，無所不照，命有斯象，自幼至老，貴顯崇高，掌兵刑之任上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"佐天子，下順四時，外撫四夷，所忌刑衝破害，有救者吉。賦云：陽火時逢亥位，文明光照乎四海是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干陽熒而時逢己丑，出乎地而照耀山川。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327492134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙日逢己丑時，是日出地上之象，順而麗乎天，大明之德，如安國、康侯多受大賜，命之值此𪔂鼐股","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"肱之任如姚來狀元，戊申戉午，丙辰、己丑合格賦，又云：六丙時臨己丑，日在地上爲極顯是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時辛亥而日逢丁，乃時三奇而科名早中。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327508518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六丁日見辛亥時，辛爲偏財，亥中甲木正印，壬水正官，謂之時上三奇，必主少年登科，富貴長久賦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：陰火時亥，富貴悠悠。是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100426809032714"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建申而歳時遇子，爲坤坎順而將相可期。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327524902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"欲知富貴，先觀月令乃提綱。月建申屬坤爲地，年支子居坎，為水地。水師卦，水不外乎地，兵不外乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"民得此象者，大貴，子時亦然，日支子者則非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時離歲巽，日陰金透，甲乙爲三台之貴；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327541286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午時生人，年支得巳字，日得辛金爲主，金用巽木爲財，離火爲官，名曰内得巽順而外得離明之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柔進而上行，得中而應乎剛。若巽居月令，則非入格大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木秀火明，春秉令入，斯象奪榜眼之魁。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327541286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"重在春生，卽前火明木秀，逢士現而早占鳌頭之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神帶刃，結局而位至三公；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327557670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲人食丙，要火局，己人食辛，要金局，但得一字更有刃助，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100435826819122"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神帶刃，坐官而勲高一品。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327557670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日主坐下官星，歲月時中又有刃食之現，大貴。所𭒡者偏印衝刑，若行財官二運，勃然驟發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星帶刃，班超萬里封侯；嵗月得時，周勃特然入相；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327574054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正官之格，用神要當時，柱有刼刃爲正官，妻財，則剛柔相濟，却得財星爲貴，官星刼刃，兩現天干之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上尤貴賦又云：官星帶刃，貴不可言。歲月透露，周勃特然入相是也。得時以官星乗旺言，帶刃以不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"拘干支言透露，則直指所重者言之也。刃爲㐫煞，官食帶之，皆作權貴看。如李邦珍都憲，癸酉巳未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子、庚子合格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官雙美，透財印而居臺省之尊；運至比肩，更刑衝","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327574054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"抱守株之拙。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327574054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳日坐向四月壬午日坐向午月天干透財印貴，不宜北方運，又怕刑衝，宜斟酌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100435826884658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官生旺，天干透露，爲奇而曳紫拖朱；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327590438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱財星旺，不必正官透財，自生官絶奇，或財官兩透，居生旺之地，皆主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺生官，印刃相扶，爲妙而三台八座。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327590438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中財星旺得令，又印刼扶持，大貴，再莫行財鄉運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干食神而時騎禄馬，初年題虎榜之榮名；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327606822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚日見壬午時，辛日見癸巳時，是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"透印綬而格得財官，早歲鎭邉隅之重任。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327606822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財官之格，要歲時透印干爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干健旺而印刃相扶，龔勝𥁞漢家之𣦸節；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327623206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賦又云：煞旺而得印刃之扶，龔勝𣦸節於西漢。是四柱純煞，或官星從煞，得印刃透出天干，乃忠節。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100470547103783"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之良臣也。前言日干旺而印刃相扶，則太過，焉得好處？當以後爲正。考龔勝，漢之處士，而能𣦸節，岂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"非五行太過之傷歟？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星帶刃而印綬帯煞，玄齡歩唐代之瀛洲。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327623206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三公之任，在乎煞刃司權，各遇長生，更得財資極貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327639590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲用庚爲煞，乙用辛爲煞，柱有巳子，則煞長生。甲見乙，乙見甲爲刃，柱有亥午爲刃，長生更得財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"資煞印化刃，極貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"司要樞，總戎政。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327639590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因刼帶印以資官，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327655974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月令時上正官，要羊刃資之，如甲用辛爲官，有乙字資官是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伸枉抑，理𡨚愆；爲財生煞而助印，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327655974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱七煞重叠，又得財官資助，則煞得勢，復生乎印矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100461558726656"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進𬽈言，趨金闕。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327655974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因煞刃兩露於天干，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327672358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此是煞格，而煞刃並現，歲月時中，主言路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居翰苑而掌絲綸，爲正官歸禄於四柱，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327672358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歸禄乃正官，如丙用癸爲官，有子字，則癸禄居孒，在冬三月生。妙賦又云：掌絲綸之命，列王堂之職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"因貴禄而得清奇是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年正印而月正官，居國監翰林之任；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327672358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正官喜現於月令之中，正印要露於歲元之上，不見衝尅之神，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格清奇而時得令，唱鴻臚玉殿之名。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327672358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"格局純和不雜，用神得令，有氣無刑衝破害，大貴之。造賦又云：格清局正，玉殿傳臚是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平邦國統六師，頼官星變爲天德，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327688742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100426809098250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理陰陽登宰輔，因禄馬又帶長生。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327688742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正財正官俱有長生，得刃生食，食生財，財生官，官生印，印生身，有周流不息之妙，必主大貴。賦又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財官有蒂，調和爕理之權。有蒂長生是也。只財官長生就貴。長生，指所居長生之地言，不必要刃食。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相生觧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格局純和而日干自弱，覧泉石而好幽棲，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327705126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神雖得時日，主衰不勝，却爲林泉晦迹之人，遇運扶身亦發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格局薄弱而用神輕微，縱資生而無過小職。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327705126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如其所用之神，不得時令，縱得資益之字，不過小官，比前格局純和者不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土重而支神厚載，畏玄武而喜青龍，格局苟逄，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327721510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必膺","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327721510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100426809065482"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327721510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"且如戊巳日，柱中又重戊巳字，或得一申字在地支，是純柔順之道，賦形有定之方，德合無彊，坤之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大也。值此𧰼大貴，忌壬癸，喜甲乙運同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛而土厚逢熒，順東方而行坤地，柱運順和，定顯","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327737894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功名。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327737894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天干甲乙一氣，地支戊巳重叠，却得寅午戍一字，順東方木得地也，行坤地，士得位也。如是則木愈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"盛而土愈厚矣。四九，上下應之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土多而居坤艮之上，則天道下濟而光明，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327754278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊巳居於歲月時干地支，又有其根，得提綱在寅，土爲坤爲地，寅爲艮為山，止乎内而順乎外，謙之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"義也。山至高而地至卑，乃屈而止乎其下，値此𧰼，貴顯亨通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100435826901042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刃逢祿馬三奇，得令透財，爲公侯一品之貴；柱㑹水火二局，露金藏土，爲龜蛇持劔之形。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"即前龜蛇持劒兼金刃，而賈復名高之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財星變德而坐煞，李靖兼文武全材，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327754278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙申日以辛金爲正財，要在四月中生，自坐申中壬水爲煞。己卯以壬水爲正財，要在申子辰月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生爲天月德之類，二者俱變爲德秀，又是財星變德值生旺無刼奪，武則鋤強殄暴，文則胙上分茅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賦又云：財星變德，登樞要而任股肱，是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞刃得印以相資，汲黯作朝廷之耳目。煞生印刃合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞全者，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷帶財印，𠔥生旺而持綱持紀。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327754278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100435826917426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官用財用印之義","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327770662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，須財印生旺方妙。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327770662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱均火土，逢木氣而爲國爲民，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327787046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火生土，爲食傷，木爲火印，爲士官故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王𭦌魁衆士，因官印帶食以相扶，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327787046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葉正占鰲頭，頼印星自官而自禄。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327787046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺無財官之輔，非技藝而必僧流；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327803430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人犯二德之純，受寵章而沾鳯誥。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327803430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"余觀此賦，不外子平，但多重七煞、羊刃、傷官、食神，而財官印綬𠔥資，並取成格，合局作黨，制化變德。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者，皆作大權大貴。萬公耳聞目擊，故以子平之法而推廣之。萬公其亦識微之士耶！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100487743717402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金聲玉振。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327819814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327836198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"玄虛道人著，育吾居士觧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受命之不同也，有如受形；測理之難精也，過於測海。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327836198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰𢡖陽舒，知盈虛之有數；天高地逈，極覆載之無疆。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327852582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或升之雲漢兮而非有所𥝠；或墜之淵泉兮而非有","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327868966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所惡。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327868966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其氣數定於太初，其培覆譬諸草木，妙訣不在","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327885350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於多言，至人奚事於強聒。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327885350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如類屬從化，格判旺衰，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327901734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"照伏拱遙，局分明暗。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327901734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見類屬要旺，從化要衰，照伏二者，皆取局於明；遥拱二者，乃取局於不見之形，故謂之暗。巳詳註前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"看命八法下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論用神，論日主，各有所宜。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327918118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取地脉，取天元，是或一道","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327934502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100487743701018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此泛舉談造化者之非一端也。或曰：此六句是申明以上八格之意，於義亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"游心於去留舒配，决意於喜忌愛憎。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327934502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此約言造化者之無多術也。中間妙理，則不能一言𥁞。如論用神，用日干，取地脉，取天元，喜忌愛憎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"萬有不同，若不去留舒配，何以成造化而分貴賤，談性命而决生𣦸，所以當游心詳玩，决意専察也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有源濁而流清，豈無根甜而裔苦。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327950886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如水生於土，令，其源本濁，運行西北，土化金，金化水，其流不亦清乎？若此者，先主㐫，後主吉。洪範曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"稼穡作甘，炎上作苦，木生土，令行南方，根甘裔苦之謂也。雖傷官能生財，然水不南奔，何以任之？或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂此二句總喻五行命運，不専指水火，亦通。珞𡍖子有初㐫後吉，始吉終㐫，則是譬喻，此則直言其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"理耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鴛鴦比翼，見江湖，必遂平生；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327967270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100455208501302"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙戌辛丑，丁巳壬寅，丙辛合丁壬合，寅戌合，丑巳合，若鴛鴦之比翼聮飛也。有壬水在柱，而又丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛化水，是江湖之象，可以遂其棲遲之性矣。或曰：鴛鴦比翼，只取其兩兩相合，卽德合雙鴦格也。江","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"湖字不必拘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醐蝶雙飛，逢園囿，方爲得所。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327967270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛未、戊戌、辛未、戊戌，未爲木庫，戊戌納音，又爲平地，木，乃園囿之所，故合格而貴。若無一點木氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"豈非虛名虚利之人乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"採精金於青沙黄磧，别利器於錯節盤根。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915327983654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午日見己巳時，乙未日見戊寅時。葢甲午、乙未本是沙中金，而戊寅則青沙，己巳乃黄磧也。甲乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生卯月，木旺之時，柱帶壬申、癸酉劎𨦟之金，正合此格，餘金則非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我生者，豈若生我之爲安；尅我者，曽如我尅者之爲","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328000038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100461558759424"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328000038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言傷官不及印綬，用煞不如用財也。葢傷官七煞雖或大貴，然多有得其祿者，弗若純用財印爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"享自然之福也。或謂用財似止於富，不曰財旺生官耶？故用財者制人，用官煞者制於人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢旣濟、未濟，休疑衝併；休疑無依，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328016422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如壬子、丙午、壬子、丙午，旣濟之格也；丁卯、丙午、丙戌、甲午，未濟之格也。二者俱大貴，如俗眼觀之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則前一命𭒡於衝，併，後一命𭒡於無依矣。或以未濟以火在上，水在下，柱中太旺爲觧，卽聚精會神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内有三正三偏，不必生扶，不必透露，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328016422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六壬生四月，巳中戊爲偏官，丙爲偏財，長生金爲偏印，故謂之三偏。癸生巳月，則爲正官、正財、正印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃三正也。水雖絕，巳金長生，則水不終絕，是以不必生扶也。翕聚則氣專發散，是以不必透露也。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100470547136551"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以生扶指財、官、印言，若日干衰弱，則不可不生扶耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奔道途而喪生，葢因秀氣繁亂，坐囹圄以亡命。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328016422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只爲","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328032806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比肩争闘。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328032806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如一甲三寅、一丙、三戌、一辛、三丙，禄庫、官星太多，無秀氣也。如三壬一亥、三庚、一丑、三己、一甲秀氣。","logicSentenceId":"0
