","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不勝其分奪也。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刃重官輕，業屠沽於市井；馬疲印破，弄刀筆於公堂。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328049190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官星帶刃本吉，官煞失時而刃用事，兹其所以賤也。凡遇此格，斷爲屠沽無疑。如寅午戌馬居申，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑衝破害則馬疲。甲木以壬癸爲印，無庚辛金生之，而有戊巳破壞，乃吏胥之徒也。或云：馬指財言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"疲，病也。財臨病地，謂之馬疲。考珞琭子馬疲註，王廷光以前說爲是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇再犯戌辰，作斵削裁縫之匠；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328065574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100477513875497"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"地三奇甲戊庚，天三奇乙丙丁，人三奇辛壬癸。干得三奇，地支有辰戌相衝，乃貴反爲賤之造遇此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者，可斷爲木匠及裁衣匠矣。遇寅辰則不然，或戌有合，辰有合，各分二局，則水火旣濟，亦不然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱𥁞歸禄位，享眉夀景福之人。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328065574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙寅甲午，乙己巳卯，丙禄居己，甲祿居寅，乙祿居卯，己祿居午，天干各有所歸，此人一生富而且","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壽卽消息賦享福五行，歸祿眉壽，八字均停之意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木衰火旺復行西，天年夭折；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328081958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲午日生，四、五月，木不南奔，又見金砍伐夭折，固宜行東北運則否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水冷金寒兼拱北，身世浮沉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328081958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金水傷官，只宜東南運行吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲春乙秋，偏宜官煞重叠。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328098342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100477513826345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生春，木旺，頼金刨削方成器。乙生秋，或化或煞皆吉，是以宜多煞。假若甲生秋而重受剋，必主大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㐫。乙生春而煞多，亦不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火卯月，難資印綬生扶。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328114726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"濕木不生無𦦨火，理固然也。乙卯、癸卯尤甚，丁卯庻幾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水繁而不制，病生於膀胱；金繁而不化，疾在於喉舌。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328131110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水屬精，金屬毂，水失隄防而無土制，則其人淫。水多太泛也。金太堅剛而無火化，則其人啞。金實無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彀","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328147494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328147494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官𩀱美，透露極榮；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328163878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一云：遇印極榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火木通明，見土","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328163878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328163878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財官雙美是辰戌丑未月生，或壬午、癸巳等日，固宜。財官透天爲妙。木火通明，須春生最吉土，所以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100477513859113"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宿火培木，故須見之方貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬趨艮，甲趨亁，須以財印助福；子遥己丑𬨶己，亦以","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328180262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財印相成。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328180262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上四格，堦頼財印輔佐而始大貴，不宜見官煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇伏歲支之下，少入翰林；三奇在時位之間，晩歸","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328196646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臺閣。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328196646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如六甲日主見己凡年者，是己丑中辛金癸水，己上爲財官，申之三奇也。如六丁日見辛亥時，亥中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𡈼水爲官，甲木爲印，又辛金乃財也，遇之，豈不居極品乎？夫三奇一也，而貴有老少之分，以年先而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時後，年近而時遥耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星得令，制伏諸鹵，貴人扶身，解脱百厄。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328213030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100461558792192"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言命中有官星貴神，不忌㐫神惡煞，葢邪不勝正也。須得令扶身，方准賦文。若官失令，受傷貴散。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"慢生嗔則否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞刃兩現干頭，定受言責之寄；一遇刑衝歲運，恐蹈","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328229414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不測之危。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328229414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞刃爲權星，刑衝最忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙臨子申，戊當頭而貴擬王謝；辛騎羊兎，乙透出而","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328245798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富比陶朱。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328245798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴以食神生旺言，富以財星祿庫言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八月官星見子辰，合來暗煞；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328262182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲生酉月，爲正官，歲時下有子辰，則會出申金，斯爲官煞混雜矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100455208550454"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三春丙火逢侯䑕，化作正官。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328262182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328278566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火辰土本是食神，有子申會成水局，非官而何？此二句乃不見之形。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水固聰明，有土反成頑懦，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328278566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土能濁水","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328278566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"埋金故也。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328278566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梟食雖貧夭，得財忽變亨通。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328294950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神乃財源，又爲壽星，梟印破之，貧夭無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328311334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一經","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328327718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財地，逐去梟神，㐫中反吉，此等命多，依他人取富。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328327718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙𣆎貴，愛見食神；六陰朝陽，何妨肩刼。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328344102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神帶煞","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328360486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入烏臺，偏官帶刃居憲府。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328360486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神羊刃皆惡星，喜官煞制伏，人命得","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328376870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，爲除奸去𡚁之象，故斷居此之職。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328376870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土叠臨寅官，喜財而不喜印；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328393254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100487743750170"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊寅雖坐煞，實長生地也。見火勿泥煞印是火蒸焦土。喜財者，財生偏官，官爲有氣耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水坐下，陽土透煞，切勿透官。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328393254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水固頼上止，亦惡混雜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財見官兼食神，榮華有準；身主用神或入墓，進取","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328409638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無緣。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328409638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木火相照，胸中萬斛珠璣；金水相𣷉，筆下千篇錦綉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328426022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"格見前，重舉之，以明其才華之卓越。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑失合，破相傷軀；六害多逢，辜恩負義。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328442406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡三刑若有合，則不成刑。如人争闘而有和觧之者，不然，寕免此患？帶六害多者，爲人必以薄爲道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡却損於妻子，隔角難爲乎兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328458790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100426809147402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"空亡如甲子，旬中無戌亥隔角，如丑寅，乃隔角方位也。日時見者重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬騎龍背，帶刃者，類烏獲孟賁；庚坐戌支，火多者，是","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328475174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邢侯雍子。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328475174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰中有龍，陽剛之物也。更逢羊刃，膂力絶入矣。經云：辰多好鬪。戌爲火庫，庚月坐之，再經火則煆煉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太過，其爲無情甚矣。况其中藏娄金狗，此宿乃狡猾之物，經云戌多好訟。邢侯雍子在春秋時争鄐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"田者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿路異香，富而好禮；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328491558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年月日時之天干見地支四位貴人者是也。如壬申、辛亥、己巳、丙寅，壬以巳爲贵，辛以寅爲貴，己以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申爲貴，丙，以亥爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一旬和氣，樂以忘憂。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328491558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100477513941033"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年月日時，共出一句，如甲子、壬申、己巳、癸酉，俱出甲子句中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸祿愛財星，見官則損壽；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328507942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財爲養命之源，歸祿之格，身旺愛財，𬽈忌官星竊財氣故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官得時令，有印不如財。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328507942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官印固妙兩全，苟無財星，官失其生意，印亦何用焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從革復出乎三奇，血食迄千年而未艾；","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328524326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日干庚辛，地支己酉丑或申酉戌全者，乃從革之象。庚日干頭再有甲戊，辛日干頭再有壬癸，其人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𣦸當廟食於百世矣。何以言之？夫金之爲用也剛，而其爲質也固。剛者，義氣之發；固者，可久之道人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之仗義者，生爲忠臣，𣦸必爲明神矣。此理可與達士論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲直𠔥資乎印綬，仁","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328524326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690883213033491/1-a7db96258e912cf6.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=GuFgMpKmEnC29H9DKt1BLJDNbF0%3D","uri":"read/NA11570/4/ref/1kr0r5inzl92c/1-a7db96258e912cf6.webp","fontType":1,"components":"土𡱡〢𠀃乂","variants":"聲","charPicId":"7456690883213033491"},"logicSentenceId":"7577322915328524326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"播九有以無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328524326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100477513891881"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曲直者，木象也。甲乙日主，倘見地支寅卯辰或亥卯未全者，是更逄印綬之相生，其人必有仁心仁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"聞矣。以理推之，仁者，天地生物之心，於時爲泰，於五行爲木。是木者有生意之物，而仁者實好生之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"德，更逄印綬，則生生而不息矣。得之者，澤被羣生，恩沽黎庻，故日仁轂播九有而無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地天泰，故斯人挺生；雲雷屯則經綸顯設。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328540710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此指上兩格之人，其生也旣有所自而不虛生，其出也必有所爲而不空出也。或云：地天泰乃戊申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見辛亥，雲雷屯，乃壬子，見乙卯，卽妙選地天交泰、雷雨𨒖春二格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是知術數無窮，實則不遺一理；言辭難悉，吾特舉其","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328557094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一隅。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328557094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯微闡幽，遵彼徃哲；引伸觸類，存乎人也。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328573478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100470547234855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金鼎神秘賦：","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328589862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"育吾著。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生有命，得失順殊，富貴貧賤，那能一體。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328589862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅光滿室，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328606246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行都聚於貴鄉，佳氣充廬，四柱並集於福地，先貧","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328606246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後富。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328606246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生時値祿馬同郷，始吉終㐫；日時犯空破之處，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328622630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平生坎坷；基薄與㐫運交雜，一世榮華。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328622630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命高逢好，運","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328639014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"叠至剛金遇火方成噐，决定超羣；旺火得水爲旣濟，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328639014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必然出衆。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328639014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木須金而不繁，水頼土而不散。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328655398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳見寅","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328671782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，得位於勾陳；壬癸坐巳午，當權於玄武。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328671782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴神入命，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328688166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇奇儀，必是公卿；華葢臨時，值孤寡，定爲僧道。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328688166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉堂","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328704550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拜相，炎炎火秀，在離宫；金闕朝元，洋洋水德。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328704550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅坎位","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328720934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100503933714483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重逢水位，斷爲雲水之仙；累犯純陽，定作空門之子。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328720934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇長生而聰明智慧，逢𣦸敗而蒙蠢愚頑，父母難靠，","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328737318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月俱䧟空亡，妻子易𧇊，日時併臨孤寡。","logicSentenceId":"7577322915328737318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉生逄","logicSentenceId":"7577322925447970854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅戰，敗門户而多灾；子午全居𣦸墓，走他鄉而爲客。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925447970854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午最嫌己亥，卯酉切忌寅申，宅墓受煞，門戸多破；","logicSentenceId":"7577322925447987238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時落天中子少。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925447987238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合逢干頭，妻多，年中無氣，幼而散失","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448003622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元基；月内逄空，門戸消索不立；日臨絕位，縱妻無恙","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448003622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦多離；時在墓中，後嗣有時也不順。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448003622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合地秀者貴，得","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448020006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天時者榮，五行無氣者貧，四柱有傷者賤；陰陽純一","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448020006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者孤，支干刑害者疾，用神休囚者，難求富貴；秀氣淺","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448020006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100503933730867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"薄者，多是藝術；刑尅互見身旺，定作軍徒；辰戌相加，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448020006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有損，斷爲獄吏。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448020006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水閑慢，落魄清貧之人；驛馬衝擊，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448036390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驅馳紅塵之客；魁罡重犯，生於屠宰之家；酉戌重逢。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448036390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身作奴僕之下，柱中子午雙包，尊居垣省；命内干支","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448052774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一氣，貴至侯王。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448052774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一片純陽獨尅，命不𣦸也傷，滿盤印","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448069158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綬俱生，身不貴卽富。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448069158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月併傷，父母妻妾難爲；年時","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448085542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"併傷，枯恃繼嗣不保。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448085542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年衝日兮父母旺，妻妾難存；時","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448101926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衝年兮兒女旺，父母易損。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448101926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破命者，少失雙親；破月者，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448118310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長尅昆季；破日者一身獨立；破時者，老無結果；破胎","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448118310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，母氏獨當。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448118310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此則論其大畧，尚未及乎精細。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448134694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100470547202087"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先提官貴，迥異常流。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448151078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戊庚引至丑未，貴神有氣；乙","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448167462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁出於酉亥，天乙加臨。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448167462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己逢坎位，乙在坤方，六辛","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448183846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜乎寅午，壬癸宜於己卯，此謂暗中得貴，更㸔官印","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448183846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弱強。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448183846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲逄酉位，乙到申方，丙得子官必顯，丁加亥上","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448200230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448200230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊見卯而能秀，己臨艮而聲揚。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448216614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚到離宫得氣，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448232998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛臨巽位安然。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448232998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬投午上旣濟，癸向巳内財官，此爲","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448249382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官正印。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448249382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看祿馬朝元，若無刑衝尅破，必作鼎鼐","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448265766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神仙。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448265766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次論財富，養命之源，先看財命有氣，次觀禄馬不貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448282150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木臨四季，向禄自然充裕；水到午上，財旺，必定豐隆。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448298534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100461558824960"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土逢潤下，金遇曲直，火遭金局，三合逢禄庫食神，五","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448314918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行値天厨財氣，四柱無傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448314918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時得地，身旺有氣，逢財","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448331302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化作官星；身衰失時，財多翻爲貧漢；若居煞地，多是","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448331302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠒋徒。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448331302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人有公吏軍戎，商賈藝術，四者不同，各有所居。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448347686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公吏之命，多帶尅刑，東西戰闘，南北衝擊，長生處破","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448364070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"了，𣦸絶處生起，五行錯雜，象不純一，倒食逢財，夾貴","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448364070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢破，財印相刑，引用無氣；秀中帶鬼，貴氣損傷，干支","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448364070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重㑹，提網懸針。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448364070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此等之命，不離公門。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448380454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至若帶官禄而","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448396838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可獲福，遇貴神而可進歩，則又有出仕顯逹者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448396838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100477513924649"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兵卒之命，與吏大同。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448413222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局中煞重而干支不等，象内貴","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448429606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輕而主本破𠋩。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448429606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲見卯支，丙臨三丁之地，辛向亥地，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448445990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬家二癸之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448445990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丁逢蛇，戊土奔馬，此乃懸針羊刃，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448462374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更犯尅破刑衝，又帶福氣，㐫中有吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448462374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懸針遇吉煞相","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448478758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扶，羊刃有貴神相助，由是從行伍而有權禄，自兵卒","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448478758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而任總戎。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448478758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然以煞爲重，則不可誣焉者也。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448495142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再看商賈，其命何慿？","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448511526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時併臨子午，三元都值寅申，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448527910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬前無轡，刼上逄財，或偏財身旺，復行財運，或六合","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448527910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會財，更坐馬郷。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448527910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬人運南，丙人運北，經營買賣之人，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448544294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人行西，庚人行東，質遷有無之軰。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448544294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙居坎，犯壬","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448560678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100455208583222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸，未免萍梗他鄉；玄武遇亥，無戊巳，諒必龍㫁外主。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448560678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於得利不得利，則専論財之旺與不旺而决之也。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448577062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再㸔藝術，又非商賈。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448593446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命遇德秀，犯刑衝，小道可觀；時","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448609830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢學堂，見空亡，多能可鄙。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448609830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚化金於坎艮，丁壬化","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448626214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木於兊乾，辛丙臨乎四季，戊癸居乎一宫，此乃秀而","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448626214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不秀，化而不成，格局破損，祿馬不全。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448626214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原夫秉賦聰明，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448642598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多因生遇學堂；至於成就淡薄，乃是命無根本。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448642598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無根本如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水人無金，火人無木之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱不相徃來，更五行再無氣象，天","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448658982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙閑慢，華葢叠逢，不作飄蓬尋幽之士，必爲九𣴑藝","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448658982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"業之人。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448658982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天乙閑慢如甲、戊、庚，上半年以未爲貴人不閑，下半年以丑爲貴人不閑，與六壬反看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100470547267623"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再看僧道，又非藝術。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448675366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行在無氣之鄉，十干臨𣦸墓","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448691750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之地，年月盡逢孤寡，日時全見元辰，累犯空亡，重臨","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448691750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢，妻子衰絕，身旺無依。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448691750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火盛而身心禪定，水多而","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448708134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自在逍遥。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448708134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命合貴格而𣦸絕，心樂清虛；命無貴氣","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448724518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而生旺，性好空門。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448724518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月上五行恬和，道行高潔，而敎門","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448740902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"増重；時上五行安静，行果相輔而徒衆數多。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448740902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月上福","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448757286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神得助，則善和，法眷而同衣賛美；日上刑衝帶煞，則","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448757286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求化無縁而行脚飄流；見煞印則當權服衆，遇喪弔","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448757286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則苦行傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448757286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢夾貴與三奇，雖云吉煞，自𣦸自絕，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448773670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自生旺則無吉助。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448773670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生旺太過而兼帶干鬼，則名利","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448790054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100455208648758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之心不忘；值尅害太甚而更遇㐫煞，則凡俗之還不","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448790054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"免。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448790054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池爲酒色之星，犯之則躭迷不檢；羊刃乃㐫惡","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448806438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之物，遇之則財利是圖。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448806438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運見䘮弔伏返，在俗人則","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448822822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫，而僧道則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448822822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元命遇孤寡亡刼，在常人有妨，而僧","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448839206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道無害。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448839206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古歌云：兩般父母見星孤，四季天上禄也無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未加臨著，多是道士及僧徒；","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448855590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合生人","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448855590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌時，定爲僧道不須疑。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448855590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還華葢併臨墓，嚢槖豐","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448871974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隆定紫衣。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448871974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡論僧道，又當以是質之。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448888358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有先貧後富，先富後貧，二者隔别，全看月日日時","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448904742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺，聚福兮晩景榮華；月令有氣，儲財兮早年富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448904742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100455208665142"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月吉而引用多輕，先富後貧；日強而本根不利，先","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448921126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧後富，生來受蔭。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448921126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月在財官之鄉，未主孤寒；日時","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448937510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犯空破之地，年月逢財無氣，幼年窘廹；日時遇食有","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448937510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，老景歡忻。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448937510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱衰微，平生不遂；背禄逐馬，一世栖","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448953894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惶。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448953894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫干頭財露，支内不藏；傷刼實地，祿馬虛浮，身","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448970278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺印𦔳，一生破敗；不聚財，身弱財多，外似有餘，内不","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448970278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448970278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或四柱原無財官，遇歲運忽然發跡，似此之命，有","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448986662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名無實。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925448986662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有抛鄉去井，失土離家，乃年尅月兮相制伏，日衝","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449003046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時兮在子午。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449003046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四煞若衝身命，定應遊走他鄉；三限再","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449019430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100470547300391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨𣦸絶，未免飄泊外處。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449019430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重重鬼害，纍纍刑空。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449035814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運拙時","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449052198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乖兮，别閭里而䟦踄程途；命蹇日衰兮，辭親戚而徃","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449052198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來岐路。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449052198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再論兄弟，以及妻子，木人春降到寅亥卯，昆仲必多，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449068582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生西南，必少。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449068582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金命。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449084966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋生臨巳申酉，兄弟盈門；若逄","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449101350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東地，不靠水居潤下遇亁坎，同氣多榮，徃來辰戌消","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449101350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洒；火向炎上，居離巽，連枝共美，到於酉亥彫零。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449101350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土臨","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449117734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四季，伯叔成行。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449117734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論得力不得力，三元不落空亡，四","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449134118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱不犯孤寡。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449134118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍作子，休婚白虎之妻，火德成男，莫娶亥子爲婦。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449150502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100503933780019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水生子嗣，母忌中央。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449166886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年合日時犯戊癸，决主三妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449183270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449199654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢二，已到巳午，不止兩婦。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449199654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙逢重，辛居酉子，多招寵","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449216038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妾；庚與乙合生卯午，定有偏房。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449216038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬重逄丁，在己酉，重","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449232422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婚别室。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449232422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽合陰盛妻雙立，陽合陰衰妻再娶。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449248806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有子多榮貴，亦有子少愚頑。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449265190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是理何說，要當詳論。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449281574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金居離位，逄炎火，兒孫滿前；火臨坎戶，遇順下，後代","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449297958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"克昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449297958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木逢庚辛到巳申，土生甲乙，見寅卯，水臨四季，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449314342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜見戊巳時，日生逄無尅制，子孫多榮；官煞重逄，見","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449314342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財生，嗣繼必貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449314342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫日臨衰墓𣦸敗，男女須傷；時犯","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449330726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡有尅，兒係必少。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449330726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木爲後代，忌逄申午之方；火若","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449347110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100503933796403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲男，休逢酉亥之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449347110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金爲子位，怕見坎寅，水作男官，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449363494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌見卯巳，土爲後嗣，怕臨震東，男取尅干爲嗣，女取","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449363494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干生爲子。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449363494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱歸於敗絕，五行都在傷官，雖有干支","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449379878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暗合，也須螟蛉作嗣，縱有偏出，實難定姓。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449379878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古有借妻","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449396262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安子，其理甚玄。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449396262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木兒見鬼，得北方坎女多存；水子遇","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449412646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，頼西方兌妻可養。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449412646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水制火男，借青龍爲妳母；木損","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449429030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土兒，覔朱雀爲繼娘。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449429030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行有損，須借相生，四柱雖尅，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449445414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦多無害。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449445414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不借母安子，豈能後嗣不乏。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449461798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至論女命，最怕刑夫，日生木蛇難成，婚配之期已用。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449478182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金鷄定是失夫之婦。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449494566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土爲夫婿，寅卯多寡，木作婚期，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449510950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100477514006569"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離宫須害，再犯孤鸞尤甚，更遇八専何說？","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449510950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於爲婦","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449527334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清潔，生而不犯貴合，若要秉性堅貞，長而不逄煞傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449527334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬無氣，必犯娼淫；戊癸休囚，多有濁濫。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449543718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱祿合，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449560102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三元純一，日時有合有夫，不離私情。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449560102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花刼煞，五行","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449576486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居墓，財祿沐浴背夫，别成暗約；陰遇陽干，合多不娼","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449576486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"即妓；比刼分争，身弱，匪妾即奴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449576486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至有五行失位，四柱","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449592870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚，十干上下交戰，運行無氣空亡，三元在沐浴之","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449592870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中，五行居𣦸墓之地，生爲奴婢，將誰怨尤？","logicSentenceId":"7577322925449592870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間有命犯倒食而無食，能與别人作福；偏財遇比而","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720600585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺，甘爲富室幹僕。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720600585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子舎居異姓，入贅金居金位，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720616969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100487743782938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遇卯寅，木到木鄉，逄丑未，日時犯月鬼，破門丙壬别祖宗，入墓魁罡臨命見華葢，一生就妻爲活丑未重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"犯遇寡宿，半世從婦入舍，四柱徃來，有情携手爲婚，三元重犯，陰合，不媒作室，陽衰陰旺，女招别姓，子爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"男命配成婚，休敗尅滞。後看相生，多招外婿。支多尅滯，定應知汝，波濤下上無生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一戶豈能堅守身如顯","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720616969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化自無氣，本姓全𧇊。若是假合别成，象孤兄異姓。平生窘廹，豈能得祖宗之財？若得興豐，因托别房父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此只論其大槩，尚未得其精㣲。命之理微，悟在心得。若夫疾病𣦸絶，貧賤凶惡，歲運晦顯，各有道理已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"著","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720616969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100477513973801"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以前，兹不重賦。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720616969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100455208730678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄機賦：","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720633353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極判爲天地，一氣分有陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720633353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干爲主，専論財官；","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720649737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月支取格，乃分貴賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720649737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有格不正者敗，無格有用者成。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720666121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有官莫尋格局，有格不喜官星。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720682505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印財食，無破清高；","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720698889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞傷梟刃，用之最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720698889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡相交，喜去惡而崇善；吉㐫","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720715273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"混雜，忌害吉而向㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720715273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有官有煞，宜身旺制煞爲奇；有","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720731657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞有印，畏財輿助煞爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925720731657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身強煞淺，煞運無妨；煞重","logicSentenceId":"757732292 ogicSentenceId":"7577322925976993819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲時逢而蓬門甕牗。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925976993819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣位逢尅，絕鵲之巢而鳩之居；","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977010203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻位犯煞，傷鸞之孤而鵠之寡。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977010203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行背祿，昔日富而","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977026587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今日貧；命遇旺財，昨日悲而今日笑。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977026587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱坐學堂之","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977042971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上，囘也不愚，三元助墓庫之中，子之好學。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977042971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年傷官貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977059355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才高那觧成名；時值偏官，家富又添好子。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977059355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚行丙地，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977075739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禱爾于祗；壬入戊鄉，胡不遄𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977075739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伯牛有疾，緣戰尅以","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977092123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100487743946778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交差；司馬何憂，葢比和而無位。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977092123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身中衰弱，逢吉運以","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977108507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲㐫；命坐堅實，遇禍年而反福。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977108507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞雖重而多合，何傷","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977124891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月之明；祿雖顯而有失，難際風雲之㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977124891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇而不遇。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977141275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛在壬癸之鄉，憂而不憂；甲乙行丙丁之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977157659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或若","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977174043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生逄絕敗，鄭谷歸耕；祿馬病衰，馮唐皓首，九官旺相。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977174043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難迯邀我於桑中；四柱合和，未免題詩於葉上。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977190427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西施","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977206811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貌美，自身多帶長生，縁珠墜樓，㐫惡又逄七煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977206811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤鸞","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977223195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入命，夫哭婦而婦哭夫，烟花絆身，女求男而男求女，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977223195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭目陷而肢體相𧇊，財帛耗而田宅有害。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977223195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生時若遇","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977239579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑衝，一生屢空；歲月若臨刼奪，百歲孤寒。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977239579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財入財窠，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977255963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100503933943859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不貴即當大富；煞居太歲，居安可不慮危。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977255963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃若官星","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977272347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"透露，未可便作貴推；煞星下攻，曷可便爲㐫斷。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977272347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977288731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴祿喜逄於印綬，刑煞宜値於制合。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977288731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以當憂不憂，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977305115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞喜不喜。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977305115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考其根而明其實，論其始而究其終。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977321499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977337883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻宫有尅，少年無早娶之人；兒位逢傷，末歲損成家","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977337883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之子。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977337883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平生不吉而壽𥮅椿松；財禄帶多而福姿蒲柳。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977354267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源清者其流必遠，本壯者其葉必榮。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977370651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命冠羣，不至","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977387035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，卽當大富；九宫陷弱，怕㐫運，又怕㐫年。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977387035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千條萬緒，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977403419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當求不見之形；百派一源，貴得彌身之地。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977403419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳陳本未，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977419803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僃祭盈𧇊。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977419803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後之君子，幸勿忽諸。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977436187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100557147013131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄妙論","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977452571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一名碧淵賦，一名千里馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡮢聞分二氣以定三才，播四時而成萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977452571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命榮枯","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977468955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得失，𥁞在五行生尅之中；富貴榮華，不越八字中和","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977468955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之外。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977468955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先觀節氣之淺深，次㸔財官之向背。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977485339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人命内，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977501723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難得實有財官；余觀格中，只要虛邀禄馬。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977501723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先賢已有","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977518107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成式，後學須要變通。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977518107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太𨓺無尅制者貧賤；不及失生","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977534491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扶者刑夭。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977534491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜向之而運背，决知貧賤；宜背之而運向，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977550875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定是困窮。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977550875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜生而逄生，貴而可取；愛尅而受尅，吉而","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977567259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堪言。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977567259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛逢金，斷作棟梁之任；水多遇土，妙爲堤岸","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977583643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之功。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977583643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火煉秋金，鑄出劒鋒之噐；木疎季土，培成稼穡","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977600027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100503933960243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之禾。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977600027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火炎有水，名爲旣濟之佳；水淺金多，號曰體全。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977616411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之象：亥卯未逢於甲乙，富貴無疑；寅午戌逄於丙丁，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977632795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榮華有准。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977632795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛局全己酉丑，位重權高；壬癸格得，申","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977649179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子辰，禄優財足；戊巳局全四季，榮冠諸曹；更值德秀","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977649179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇，名揚四岳。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977649179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木全寅卯辰之方，功名自有；金僃申","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977665563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉戌之地，富貴無𧇊。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977665563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水歸亥子丑之源，利名之客；火","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977681947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨巳午未之域，顯逹之人。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977681947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木旺宜火之交輝，秋闡可","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977698331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試；金堅愛水之相經，文學堪誇。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977698331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用火愁水，用木怕金。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977714715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春木重重，休爲太旺無依；夏火炎炎，莫作太燥有壓。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977731099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋金銳銳最爲奇；冬水洋洋專可美。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977747483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生我扶我爲忌，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977763867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100487743979546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅我制我有功。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977763867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行有配，曰𠪚日治曰和，四柱無情，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977780251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲亂爲傷爲禍，合中逄戰，如大治之遇亂離；𣦸地逄","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977780251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生，若極否更以盛世，一治一亂，柱中滚浪刑衝，乍旺","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977780251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乍衰，命裏交横破害。","logicSentenceId":"75773229259777 {"lines":[{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數科不第，只因財破文書，一舉成名，乃是魁星帶甲。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977944091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行消長，皆因鬼以成功；四柱興隆，若無病而不貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977960475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖用鬼病爲奇，終是去之爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977976859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更尋三合祿馬之年，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977993243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須看玉堂天乙之歲。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925977993243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁生於冬月，貴於戊巳當頭；","logicSentenceId":"7577322925978009627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛産在夏間，妙乎壬癸得局。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925978009627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙秋生，貴宜玄武；","logicSentenceId":"7577322925978026011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100557147029515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛夏長，妙用勾陳。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925978026011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁水多嫌北地，逄戊巳反作","logicSentenceId":"7577322925978042395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴推；庚辛火盛怕南方，遇戊巳，翻爲貴斷。","logicSentenceId":"7577322925978042395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙秋生，","logicSentenceId":"7577322925978058779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"透丙丁 0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬官星防刃傷存","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098579506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全玄武貴無疑；臘月傷官喜見，官破印傷，重禍而𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098579506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺生官者，乃貴少而富多；傷官見財者，又官高而","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098595890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財足。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098595890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
