926098726962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臣；歸祿衝食，逄刃傷，廊廟之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098726962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺有煞，逄印綬，權","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098743346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷之官；主弱逄印，見財星，尋常之客。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098743346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃偏官有制，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098759730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"膺職掌於兵刑；正官正印無傷，牧黎庻爲守令。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098759730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098776114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"稼穡，給餉之官；飛祿朝陽，侍從之職。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098776114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亁坤本清氣經","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098792498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"國之榮；子午爲尊極黄門之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098792498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日癸時，兼丑亥魁。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098808882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100548217257984"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名及第，入翰林，壬日壬時叠寅辰，高爵承恩登御間。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098825266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日德見魁罡，縱吉遇貧寒之士；魁罡值財，官任得地","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098841650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衣禄之人；傷官見官，妙遇財印之地；財星破印，貴行","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098841650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比刼之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098841650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命重財運逄煞，吉而堪言；命重煞運，逄財，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098858034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫而可决。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098858034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙運入西方，身旺功名可許；壬癸路經","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098874418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南地，主健財祿堪圖；刼煞不宜行旺地，食神最妙偏","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098874418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財郷。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098874418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命傷官歸禄，得之極吉；男造羊刃身弱，遇之","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098890802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098890802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神建祿欄义，女命逄之最忌；羊刃傷官七煞，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098907186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子遇之得權；金神入火，逄煞刃，貴而無疑；煞重有","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098907186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印，逄食傷，榮而有凖。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098907186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官正印，官居不顯；羊刃七煞，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098923570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100565455814683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出仕馳名。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098923570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺無依，僧道之輩；桃花滚浪，娼婢之流。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098939954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金弱火強，土木銷鎔之匠；土多水淺，行閒針線之工。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098956338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五湖雲擾，始榮終辱，己身貧；遍野桃花，一世風流，多","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098972722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酒色。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098972722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神拱煞，賊盗之徒；秀氣失時，清貧之士。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926098989106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印旺","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099005490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身強多嗜酒；丁壬妬化犯淫訛；身印俱強，平生少病；","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099005490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天月德助，處世無灾；食神生旺，勝似財官貴全。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099005490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財煞","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099021874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有棄命就財、就煞就官者，有餘富貴無依；専旺絕食","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099021874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絕財絶官者，無限。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099021874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧窮身弱，棄命要無根，官居宰府，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099038258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干衰身化，得其時，位近天廷。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099038258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男命類屬從化，照返鬼","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099054642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏，宜細詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099054642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命純和清貴，濁濫娼淫，當深究也。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099071026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100532740325428"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驚神論","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099087410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行生旺，朝中榮貴之人；四柱休囚，林下清修之客。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099087410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼旺身衰，少年難得榮華；禄破身刑，早歲失其怙恃。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099103794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男少女多，只爲陰神太重；男多女少，定是純陽有托。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099120178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逆尅懸針，雕靣打鐡之軰；魁罡煞刃，役身軍伍之流。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099136562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官遇亡刼兼七煞，當爲武將；貴塡財印，遇二德，得作","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099152946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忠臣。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099152946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財衝禄破，市井屠兒；禄旺身强，豪門貴客。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099169330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤辰","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099185714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"値華蓋，道士僧尼；刼煞遇魁罡，巫醫術士。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099185714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池坐旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099202098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶刃因色亡身；驛馬臨刑，帶禄爲牙致富。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099202098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命長富貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099218482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢縁天德遇長生，衣食豐盈，乃是財星無尅破。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099218482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日居","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099234866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100548217290752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專祿，支神全合貴無疑；支刃干官，時月重逄官必顯。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099234866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午戊午，貴因化刃生身，拱祿拱貴，禍爲歲來塡實，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099251250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財多露顯，有敗有成；財少暗藏，爛錢朽貫，早年無子；","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099251250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆因時日刑身，晩後添嬰。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099251250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知縁時得日貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099267634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申庚寅","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099284018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳，眞是貴人；甲子己巳壬辰，業専。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099284018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醫","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099300402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卜日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢刃煞，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099300402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻必産亡；時値孤虛，子當不肖。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099300402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子卯之中逄一癸，富","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099316786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且不貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099316786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支刑合帶咸池，娼門幇客；時上偏官有制，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099333170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晩子英奇；柱中財旺生官，早年清選。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099333170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池華蓋，月時","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099349554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相犯，主伶仃。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099349554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弔客䘮門；歲運併臨，方孝服。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099365938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水多則泛","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099382322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濫之軰，作事無成；土多乃愚濁之徒，化生須福。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099382322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬多","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099398706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100503933993011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則終年奔走，禄多則活計難停，刑多則終有殘疾，破","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099398706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多則一生苦恨。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099398706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬多祿少，奔馳詭詐之徒；財旺身強，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099415090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮顯忠正之士。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099415090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池帶合，遇鬼賊，家敗人離。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099431474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞無制，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099677234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃爲㐫惡之徒；傷官咸池，定作岐路之客。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099677234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡見日干","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099693618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太弱，内有弱處復生；若見旺相相生，亦有旺中尅破。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099693618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100565455863835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明津先生骨髓歌：","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099710002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知五行生𣦸訣，容易豈與凡人說。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926099710002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五星只在限爲","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211334171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憑，子平専以運中决。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211334171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生知富貴問前程，𣦸時未審如","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211350555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何截，格局只以用神推。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211350555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用不受傷人不滅，運行先布","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211366939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫，看於何宫受某節。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211366939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印綬與食神，當知輕","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211383323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重審分明。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211383323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星怕行七煞運，偏官尤畏正官臨。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211399707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211416091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"混行當知審，去煞留官仔細評。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211416091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"留官去煞莫逢煞，留","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211432475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞去官官莫逄。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211432475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞受傷人自絶，更看財格定前程。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211448859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時偏正問何財，又怕干頭帶煞來。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211465243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞運重逄人亦","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211481627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夭，孰知偏正是爲灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211481627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自専偏正皆爲福，兄弟同分是","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211498011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100565455880219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍媒。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211498011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運到正財必争競，各宜偏正兩分推。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211514395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有財官運","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211530779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須榮發，官運財鄉是福胎。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211530779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只怕日干元自弱，財多生","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211547163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼趕身衰。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211547163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財多身弱行財運，此處方知入泉臺。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211563547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官不","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211579931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受傷財不刼，壽山高聳豈能頺。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211579931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第一難推印綬鄉，運","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211596315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行身旺必榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211596315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鄉會合逄官職，𣦸地當知是禍殃。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211612699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是逢財來害印，懸鿄落水惡中亡。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211629083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官居在任他鄉","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211645467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣦸，經紀逢之在路傍。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211645467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印不逄財人不𣦸，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211661851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如前逐一細","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211661851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推詳，財官印綬分明說，更有食神非易訣，食神有氣","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211661851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勝財官。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211661851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只怕殘傷前後截，倒食運遇反傷年。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211678235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須知早","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211694619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下泉臺歇，前格敎君說短長。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211694619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後格也來前路截，却分","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211711003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1828","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100548217307136"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輕重細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211711003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大怕財官臨𣦸絕，傷官命運再逄官，斷","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211727387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是徒流禍百端。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211727387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日貴日德逄衝戰，此命危亡可立㸔。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211743771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛天拱禄𭒡塡實，更㸔絆神來犯干。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211760155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若依喜忌篇中","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211776539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷，格局逄傷作夭看。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211776539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後格𣦸生無異兆，第一財官爲","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211792923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𦂳要，運行若不遇財官。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926211792923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣遇財官無長少，問壽須知" 00146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2042","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100565455945755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神帶煞，身旺爲奇，更行火地，名利當時。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926224916530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日金𥚞，偏宜火制；己日金神，何勞火制。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926224932914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲生春，時犯金神，水鄕不發，土重名真。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926224949298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙丑月，時帶金神，月干見煞，雙目不明。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926224965682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅重寅，二巳刑煞，終身必損，遇火難發。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926224982066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲寅月，透財時節，西北行程，九流藝業。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926224998450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日卯月，金神剛烈，富貴比肩，旺横𣦸絕。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225014834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天干二丙，地支全寅，更行生印，𣦸見禍臨。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225031218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火旺二寅，透壬坐申，艮祿多厚，見水傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225047602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六戊重寅，月令水金，火鄉有救，見土刑身。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225063986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2053","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100565455929371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日月戌，火神無氣，多水多金，眼睧目閉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225080370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年干會火，日時會金，己干用印，官徹名清。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225096754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋金生午，丙火透露，運至南方，血傷泉路。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225113138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金旺三秋。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225129522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二庚火丙，到丑傷情，逄離順境。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225145906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金生午，辛金生未，透煞兩停，冬生最貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225162290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金月辰，庚金丑庫，逆數清孤，順行豪富。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225178674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛逄卯日，年月見酉，時帶朝陽，爲僧道醜。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225195058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金亥日，月逄臨戌，水運初行，須防目疾。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225211442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金坐酉，財官用印，順行南方，名利必振。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225227826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金坐巳，官印用祿，順行南方，貴顯榮福。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225244210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2065","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100566240313355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉金逄離，透土何慮，無土傷身，壽元不住。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225260594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月生四季，日主庚辛，何愁主弱，旺地成名。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225276978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金逄火，見土成刑，陽金遇火，透土成名。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225293362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬生午位，禄馬同鄉，重重遇火，格局高強。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225309746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸多金，生於𮠕申，土旺則貴，水旺則貧。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225326130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸向巳宫，財官拘印，運至南方，利名必振。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225342514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日己亥，煞財透露，地合傷官，有勞無富。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225358898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日申提，卯亥歲時，年煞月刼，林下孤恓。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225375282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日干巳，陰煞重逄，無官相混，名利必通。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225391666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官之格，女人最忌，帶印帶財，反爲富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225408050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2076","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100548217389056"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞多有制，女人必貴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225424434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星重犯，濁濫淫類。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225440818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星桃花，福德堪誇；煞星桃花，朝刼暮巴。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225457202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日申時，柱中金局，支無㑹合，傷官刼妻。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225473586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日寅提，壬日亥月，莫犯提綱，禍福難推。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225489970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日亁提，見煞喜比金水栽根，忌寅卯未。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225506354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳丑月，比肩透出，叠運入局，忌逄午未。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225522738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸坎宫，支逄午戌，干頭比肩，東行爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926225539122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙震宫，卯多須夭，逆順運行，子申發福。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349746203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛巳月，金生火旺，比刼栽根，兩行成象。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349762587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁𮠕月，比肩不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349778971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火入離宫，比肩一例。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349795355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2089","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100532740472884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲直丑月，帶印多金。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349811739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸丑月，士厚金沉，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349828123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神生旺，勝似財官。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349828123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濁之則賤，清之則垣。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349844507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2094","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身弱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽木無根，生於丑月，水多轉貴，金多則折。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349860891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木無根，生臨丑月，金多轉貴，火土則折。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349877275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火無根，子申全見，無制無生，此身貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349893659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲坐申，三重見子，運至北方，須防横𣦸。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349910043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙臨申位，陽水大忌，有制身強，旺成名利。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349926427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己入亥宫，怕逢陰木，月逄印生，自然成福。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349942811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日逢煞，印旺財伏，運轉東南，貴高財足。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349959195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅壬戌，陽土透出，不混官星，福崇顯祿。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349975579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100548217421824"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰水無根，火鄉有貴；陽水無根，火郷即畏。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926349991963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉陰柔，不愁多水，比肩透露，格中最忌。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350008347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅日主，何愁煞旺，露火成名，水來漂蕩。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350024731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午日主，支火炎炎，見土取貴，見水爲嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350041115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未身弱，卯提取格。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350057499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉身弱，見財害格。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350073883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳無根，火土重見，透財名利，露根則賤。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350090267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉八月，未時受生，人命遇此，平生多㐫，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350106651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2112","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"棄命甲乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無根，怕逢申酉，煞合逢之，雙目必朽。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350106651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木酉月，見水爲奇，有根丑絶，無根寅危。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350123035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木坐酉，庚丁透出，二庫歸根，孤神得失。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350139419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2116","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100605620420671"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火申提，無根，從煞有根，南旺脫根壽促。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350155803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽火無根，水鄉必忌；陰火無根，水鄉必救。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350172187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰火酉月，棄命就財，北行入格，南走爲灾。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350188571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己亥月，身弱爲棄。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350204955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月同推，嫌根刼比。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350221339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金無根，寅宫火局，南方有貴，須防壽促。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350237723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳陰柔，水囚官煞，運限加金，聰明發逹。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350254107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日戌提，癸干未月，運喜東方，逄衝則絶。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350270491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棄命就財，須要會財；棄命從煞，須要會煞。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350286875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從財忌煞，從煞喜財，㑹逄根氣，會損無猜。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350303259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此法玄玄，識得神仙學者，實授千金莫傳。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350319643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100532740489268"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100548217405440"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五言獨歩：","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350336027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有病方爲貴，無傷不是奇。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350336027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格中如去病，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350352411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財祿喜相隨。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350352411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯多金丑，貧富高低走。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350368795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南地怕逢申，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350385179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北方休見酉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350385179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"建禄生提月，財官喜透天。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350401563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜身再旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350417947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟喜茂財源。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350417947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土厚多逢火，歸金旺遇秋。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350434331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬天水木泛，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350450715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名利總虛浮。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350450715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙生居卯，金多返吉祥。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350467099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜重見煞，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350483483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100532740505652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火地得衣糧。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350483483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火忌西方酉，金沉怕水鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350499867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木神休見午，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350516251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水到卯宫傷。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350516251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土宿休行亥，臨官在巳宫。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350532635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南方根有旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350549019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西北莫相逢。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350549019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰日朝陽格，無根月建辰。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350565403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西方還有貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350581787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干怕火來侵。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350581787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木生居酉，莫逢全己丑。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350598171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴坎離宫，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350614555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧窮坤艮守。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350614555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有煞只論煞，無煞方論用。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350630939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只要去煞星，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350647323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2161","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100575106940979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不怕提綱重。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350647323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙若逄申，煞印暗相生。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350663707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木旺金逄旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350680091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冠袍必揖身。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350680091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火怕重逄，北方返有功。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350696475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然宜見水，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350712859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶恐對提衝。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350712859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八月官星旺，甲逄秋氣深。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350729243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官兼有助，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350745627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名利自然亨。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350745627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲直生春月，庚辛干上逢。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350762011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南離推富貴，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350778395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎地却猶㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350778395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙生三月，庚辛戌未存。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350794779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑宫壬癸位，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350811163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2177","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100617653878799"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何慮見無根。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350811163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木茂宜金火，身衰鬼作關。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350827547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時分西與北，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350843931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輕重辨東南。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350843931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上胞胎格，月逢印綬通。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350860315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞官行運助，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350876699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"職位至三公，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350876699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二子不衝午，二寅不衝申。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350876699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二午不衝子，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350893083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二申不衝寅。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350893083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得一分三格，財官印綬全。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350909467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運中逄尅破，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350925851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一命喪黄泉。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350925851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進氣𣦸不𣦸，退氣生不生。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350942235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終年無發贵，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350958619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100566240329739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶忌少年刑。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350958619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上徧財格，干頭忌比肩。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350975003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月生身主旺，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350991387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴氣福重深。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926350991387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上一位貴，藏在支中。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926351007771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是日主要剛強，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926351024155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名利方有氣。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926351024155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行十載數，上下五年分。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926351040539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先㸔流年歲，","logicSentenceId":"7577322926351056923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深知來徃旬。","logicSentenceId":"7577322926351056923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100605620469823"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2205","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100605620486207"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7443100575106973747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
